data.title: Sr Configuration Engineer
data.description:
Job Requirements

Siemens Healthineers is a global leader in medical technology, working to improve patient care and healthcare outcomes. XP (X-ray Products) is one of the key Diagnostic Imaging modalities, with a product portfolio spanning Radiography, Fluoroscopy, Uroscopy, and Women's Health. We, XP DevOps team is looking for an experienced Sr. Configuration Engineer to strengthen software configuration management, build engineering, release readiness, and DevOps automation across complex medical software solutions. In this role, you will provide and continuously improve the development, build, test, and deployment infrastructure used by development teams. You will work with IBM Rational ClearCase, Azure DevOps Server/Services, TFVC/Git, CI/CD pipelines, build tools, and automation scripts to enable reliable, traceable, and efficient software delivery. 

Your Role And Responsibilities

Operate, administer, and improve software configuration management environments based on IBM Rational ClearCase, including usage guidance, branching strategies, traceability, and process compliance. 

- Create, execute, monitor, and maintain software builds for ClearCase-based projects using medmake, omake, MSBuild, and related tools. 
 - Design, maintain, and improve Azure DevOps Server CI/CD pipelines that support automated build, deployment, validation, and release workflows. 
 - Support development and maintenance of software projects that contribute to finished medical devices by enabling integration of components, modules, and technology stacks into deliverable product software. 
 - Build and maintain automation using Perl as a mandatory scripting language, together with PowerShell and other supporting technologies where needed. 
 - Automate setup and deployment activities across test, pre-production, and production-like environments within CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Develop tools and scripts that improve build reliability, packaging, reporting, validation, and feedback cycles for development teams. 
 - Investigate and resolve issues related to software builds, product packaging, installation, deployment environments, and infrastructure dependencies. 
 - Drive continuous improvement by identifying new tools, technologies, workflows, and automation opportunities that reduce manual effort and improve quality. 
 - Collaborate closely with development, testing, infrastructure, architects, project managers, product owners, and global stakeholders. 
 - Create, maintain, and improve process descriptions, technical documentation, release artifacts, and configuration management procedures. 
 - Act as a DevOps and configuration management enabler for development teams, supporting adherence to established practices while improving delivery speed and reliability. 

Your Qualifications And Experience

- Graduate or postgraduate degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Medical or Life Sciences, or a related discipline. 
 - 7 to 13 years of experience in software development, software configuration management, build engineering, DevOps, or large multinational software development projects. 
 - Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience with IBM Rational ClearCase and builds using medmake and omake. 
 - Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps Server (formerly TFS) and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Experience with source control systems including IBM Rational ClearCase, TFVC, and Git. 
 - Development experience in C# and . NET technologies, with strong scripting experience in Perl and working knowledge of PowerShell. 
 - Good understanding of software build systems, C# compilers, MSBuild, product packaging, and package management concepts such as Artifactory, Azure Artifacts, NuGet, npm, Maven, Python packages, and feeds. 
 - Strong understanding of Windows operating systems, server environments, virtualization, networking fundamentals, and infrastructure concepts relevant to build and deployment environments. 
 - Experience working in Scrum teams within Agile or SAFe-based software development organizations, with a solid understanding of Scrum ceremonies, sprint execution, SDLC, release management, configuration management principles, team collaboration, backlog-driven development, and continuous improvement practices. 
 - Strong analytical, debugging, tracing, root cause analysis, and problem-solving skills. What Will Make You Successful
 - You are proactive, self-driven, and able to work independently while keeping commitments and priorities transparent. 
 - You communicate clearly in English with international teams and can explain complex technical topics to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - You enjoy collaborating across functions and locations, sharing best practices, and enabling teams to use DevOps systems effectively. 
 - You value process-oriented work, traceability, quality gates, and continuous improvement in regulated software development environments. 
 - You are comfortable reviewing scripts, build changes, automation solutions, and process updates to ensure quality, maintainability, and compliance. Nice to Have
 - Experience with WiX Toolset and COIN packaging tools. 
 - Experience with migration from IBM Rational ClearCase to Git. 
 - Experience with DevOps platforms and tools such as Azure DevOps Services, GitLab, GitHub, Jenkins, Ansible, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, or other Infrastructure-as-Code technologies. 
 - Experience defining KPIs for monitoring environments and operated software to provide proactive feedback to development and operations teams. 
 - Knowledge of additional programming or scripting languages such as Python, JavaScript, Node. js, React, C, C++, Go, or PHP. 
 - Experience guiding international development teams on DevOps principles, CI/CD quality expectations, and build/release practices. 
 - Openness to take on Scrum Master responsibilities when required, by facilitating Agile ceremonies, supporting sprint planning and retrospectives, improving team transparency, and helping remove impediments in close collaboration with product owners and development team

Why Join Us At Siemens Healthineers, you will contribute to healthcare technology that directly supports patient care and advances medical outcomes. You will be part of a global engineering environment where software configuration management, DevOps automation, and reliable development infrastructure are key enablers for high-quality product delivery. This role offers the opportunity to solve complex technical challenges, improve engineering productivity, and shape modern delivery practices for AWS Systems within the XP product portfolio. External Job Description We are actively seeking an exceptional and driven Sr. Configuration Engineer to join our AWS Systems team in Bengaluru. As a Sr. Configuration Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in providing development, build, test, and deployment infrastructure for platform and integrated software solutions. You will operate and improve configuration management systems, maintain automated build capabilities, and participate actively in continuous integration and continuous deployment processes. The ideal candidate combines practical ClearCase and Azure DevOps Server experience with strong scripting, troubleshooting, infrastructure understanding, and the ability to collaborate in an international Agile environment. 

Work Experience

7 to 13 years of experience in software development, software configuration management, build engineering, DevOps, or large multinational software development projects. 

- Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience with IBM Rational ClearCase and builds using medmake and omake. 
 - Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps Server (formerly TFS) and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Experience with source control systems including IBM Rational ClearCase, TFVC, and Git. 
 - Development experience in C# and . NET technologies, with strong scripting experience in Perl and working knowledge of PowerShell. 
 - Good understanding of software build systems, C# compilers, MSBuild, product packaging, and package management concepts such as Artifactory, Azure Artifacts, NuGet, npm, Maven, Python packages, and feeds.

Job Summary

The Technical Lead role focuses on designing and implementing robust SAP Security solutions to protect organizational assets and data integrity. This position involves collaborating with cross-functional teams in a hybrid work model to ensure the security framework aligns with business objectives and regulatory requirements. The ideal candidate will drive technical excellence and innovation while enhancing the overall cybersecurity posture of the company. 

Responsibilities

- Lead the development and implementation of SAP Security strategies that safeguard critical business applications and data integrity. 
 - Oversee the configuration and maintenance of SAP Security roles and authorizations to ensure compliance with company policies and industry standards. 
 - Collaborate with business stakeholders and technical teams to analyze security requirements and translate them into effective SAP Security solutions. 
 - Provide expert guidance on SAP Security best practices to enhance system protection against unauthorized access and potential vulnerabilities. 
 - Conduct regular security audits and assessments within SAP environments to identify risks and implement mitigation measures promptly. 
 - Troubleshoot and resolve SAP Security issues by applying advanced technical knowledge and practical problem-solving techniques. 
 - Manage the integration of SAP Security tools and technologies to strengthen overall security architecture and streamline access management processes. 
 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives for SAP Security processes by staying updated with emerging trends and regulatory changes in cybersecurity. 
 - Coordinate with IT and compliance teams to ensure SAP Security practices meet internal controls audit requirements and external regulatory guidelines. 
 - Facilitate knowledge transfer sessions and training programs to elevate team capabilities in SAP Security management and execution. 
 - Monitor and report on SAP Security metrics and performance indicators to provide visibility into security posture and improvements made. 
 - Support incident response activities related to SAP Security by analyzing root causes and implementing corrective actions. 
 - Advocate for secure coding and configuration standards during SAP application development and customization efforts to reduce security risks. 

Qualifications

- Demonstrate a minimum of five years of experience specifically in SAP Security design configuration and administration within enterprise environments. 
 - Possess advanced technical skills in SAP Security components including role design user provisioning access controls and segregation of duties frameworks. 
 - Exhibit good understanding of cybersecurity principles identity and access management and compliance requirements relevant to SAP ecosystems. 
 - Have hands-on experience with SAP GRC including risk analysis access request management and compliance reporting tools. 
 - Experience working in a hybrid work environment with the ability to efficiently balance remote collaboration and onsite presence. 
 - Be available to work the day shift ensuring alignment with operational and project schedules without the need for business travel. 
 - Demonstrate proficiency in communicating complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Have good to have knowledge of related ERP modules and integration points affecting SAP Security to provide comprehensive risk assessments. 
 - Possess strong problem-solving skills to address evolving security threats and adapt SAP Security configurations accordingly. 
 - Maintain fluency in English as a primary working language to support global collaboration and documentation standards. 
 - Show commitment to professional development and keeping current with SAP Security updates patches and industry best practices. 
 - Be familiar with IT service management frameworks to facilitate efficient incident and change management related to security aspects. 
 - Adapt well to shifting priorities and project demands within a dynamic multinational organizational context.

Certification in SAP Security or SAP GRC or equivalent credentials in cybersecurity or access management.

data.title: SAP Release Manager
data.description:
Job Summary

Architect role in a multinational company focusing on structured release management for complex hybrid environments ensuring reliable delivery of solutions across day shift operations with no travel requirement. The architect will design scalable patterns for multi channel platforms optimize deployment workflows and align technical decisions with business outcomes while collaborating across diverse product and operations teams. 

Responsibilities

- Design robust release management architectures that streamline build packaging deployment and rollback processes across hybrid infrastructure while maintaining high reliability and predictable delivery cycles
 - Drive standardization of release pipelines by defining reusable patterns templates and controls that reduce release risk and improve quality for products supported in a day shift environment
 - Coordinate end to end release planning by aligning development testing operations and business stakeholders to agreed schedules scope and success criteria ensuring smooth and well communicated deployments
 - Implement rigorous versioning configuration and environment management practices that protect production stability and support clear traceability of changes across applications and platforms
 - Optimize automation in release workflows using enterprise grade tools and scripts to reduce manual intervention shorten cycle times and minimize human error during deployments
 - Analyze release incidents deployment failures and post release defects to identify root causes and design sustainable improvements that enhance reliability for future releases
 - Create comprehensive release documentation including run books deployment guides and recovery procedures that enable operations teams to execute releases confidently and consistently
 - Collaborate with security and compliance teams to embed required governance checks approvals and audit evidence within the release management lifecycle supporting regulatory and policy adherence
 - Engage with product owners and solution teams to prioritize release content based on business value risk and readiness ensuring that changes delivered through each release contribute meaningfully to company objectives
 - Support multi channel initiatives by designing release strategies that coordinate deployments across web mobile contact center and other interaction channels delivering a consistent experience to end users
 - Mentor junior engineers and release coordinators by sharing best practices troubleshooting approaches and architectural rationale to build a strong organizational capability in release management
 - Monitor release performance using metrics such as deployment frequency failure rate change lead time and mean time to recovery translating insights into actionable improvements for teams and processes
 - Adapt release approaches for hybrid work model conditions by enabling secure remote access clear communication routines and collaboration methods that keep distributed teams aligned during critical deployment windows

Qualifications

- Demonstrate strong hands on experience in enterprise scale release management including planning coordination execution and post release validation across complex application landscapes
 - Exhibit proficiency with common release and deployment tooling and scripting approaches enabling efficient automation of build promotion configuration and deployment activities
 - Apply solid understanding of software development life cycle and continuous integration and continuous delivery practices to design release processes that integrate seamlessly with engineering workflows
 - Display working knowledge of multi channel domain concepts such as unified customer journeys synchronized updates across digital and assisted channels and consistent version rollout across platforms as a desirable capability
 - Show skill in analyzing logs metrics deployment records and defect trends to diagnose release related issues and implement corrective actions that prevent recurrence
 - Demonstrate clear communication and stakeholder management abilities to explain release plans articulate technical impacts and negotiate timelines with cross functional teams in a concise and structured manner
 - Leverage experience in hybrid work environments to maintain effective collaboration with onsite and remote colleagues through disciplined planning documentation and use of collaborative tools
 - Utilize strong problem solving and decision making skills to evaluate release risks choose appropriate mitigation strategies and balance speed with stability in production environments

Certifications Required

Preferred certifications include ITIL Foundation or DevOps related credentials such as Certified DevOps Practitioner focusing on release and deployment practices

data.title: Advisor / Sr Advisor – Synthetic Molecule Analytical Chemistry
data.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50, 000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work-but it's work worth doing. If you're driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. 

Company Overview

Lilly, a leading innovation-driven corporation is developing a growing portfolio of pharmaceutical products by applying the latest research from its own worldwide laboratories and from collaborations with eminent scientific organizations. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, Lilly makes life better - through medicines and information - for some of the world's most urgent medical needs. Founded over 150 years ago, the company has sustained a culture that values excellence, integrity and respect for people. This has resulted in Lilly frequently being ranked as one of the best companies in the world at which to work. Lilly understands its business has prospered because of its employees - people with a talent for innovation and a passion for making a difference by finding treatments for the most stubborn diseases; people whose talent is matched by their generosity, and people with strong values and a determination to prevail, regardless of the challenges. Join our team - and make a difference in improving health for people all over the world!

About Synthetic Molecule Design and Development (SMDD): SMDD is a critical function within Lilly Product Research & Development (PRD) responsible for the development of synthetic drug substances and drug products from the pre-clinical phase through commercialization. PRD at Lilly Bengaluru, established in 2016, is an integrated business unit with the Global Indianapolis functions supporting synthetic molecules, large molecules and drug delivery developments. Together we advance a dynamic portfolio of small molecules, peptides, oligonucleotides and other emerging therapeutic modalities. 

Job Description

PRD / SMDD @ Bangalore has an exciting opportunity for an Advisor / Sr Advisor - Synthetic Molecule Analytical Chemistry to join our multidisciplinary team of chemists and engineers. The individual will have ttechnical oversight of key process development activities performed at a strategic Indian contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO). The individual will act as the technical bridge between Lilly scientists and the CDMO, review & influence CDMO strategies, ensure alignment with Lilly requirements, escalate risks and develop mitigation plans. 

Empowered by access to world-class capabilities and extensive pharmaceutical development experience, you will help deliver technical solutions that enable deeper understanding of processes and products across the portfolio. Ideal candidates will possess experience across multiple analytical techniques (e. g. , HPLC, mass spectrometry, NMR), demonstrate an aptitude in technical problem-solving, and be motivated to work both independently and collaboratively in a dynamic environment. The individual will enable comprehensive characterization of materials and processes necessary to ensure the quality, safety, and efficacy of Lilly's medicines. This responsibility requires direct contribution to the development of analytical methodology and the design of experiments to generate key data. 

Role Overview And Key Responsibilities

Scientific & Technical Leadership

- Demonstrate learning agility across modalities (small molecules, peptides, and oligonucleotides). Drive the design, development, and implementation of product control strategies for synthetic / small molecule programs. Demonstrated ability to develop analytical methods, justify specifications, design stability studies, establish starting material rationales for synthetic processes, identify impurities, and test drug product performance characteristics (e. g. , dissolution/disintegration).

data.description:
About The Job

At Opella, we have one shared mission - we work passionately, every day, to 'serve healthier, fuller lives' now and for the generations to come. 

In order to do so, we strive to act as a force for good by integrating sustainability along our business and employees' mission and operate responsibly from both a social and environmental point of view. 

Everything we do is centered around people's interests - our consumers, our customers, healthcare professionals, and our employees - across the world. 

We are building loved brands that serve 1bn consumers worldwide, through our key platforms: Allergy, Physical & Mental Wellness, Pain, Digestive Wellness and Cough, Cold & Flu. 

We aspire to become the best Fast Moving Consumer Health (FMCH) company In & For the world and we aim to build a work environment where people can thrive, grow, enjoy and be at their best. 

Our Team

Our team is engaged in designing, delivering and supporting Digital Tech Services for all CHC worldwide. 

We deliver our solutions in a highly competitive market answering FMCH needs and sometimes supporting regulated environments (GxP, SoX and other regional or local regulations). 

Our team operates in an international context, serving all markets in most of the countries around the world. 

Digital Technology & Architecture organization encompasses following capabilities: Integration, Enterprise Architecture, Operations, Cloud engineering, Platform Engineering (e. g. DevOps & related framework), Enabling Platforms (ServiceNow, Observability, Chatbots, RPA, . . . ), Digital Workplace and more "classical" infrastructures (hosting, network, servers, . . . ). 

Digital Workplace Corresponds To Following Capabilities

Productivity & Collaboration suite (Microsoft 365, with Office suite, Teams, Email, . . . )

Videoconferencing (Zoom, Teams) & space booking (Logitech)

Devices & Mobility (Windows, Mac, Workstation as a Service, mobile phones & tablets, device imaging & software deployment, Intune, Industrial devices)

Digital Signage & IP-TV

Telephony (VoIP, Teams or fixed)

Secure Printing & Scanning services

Application store for applications deployed on or accessible from end users' laptops requiring either a license or a local setup (e. g. Adobe, Microsoft Office suite, Visio/Project, . . . ) As a target, all these capabilities will become full managed by Opella but most of them (less and less) are still operated by Sanofi for us. As a lead of Device & Software Experience, you oversee the 360° of Device and end-user software part of the Digital Workplace scope: hardware catalog, evolutions, roadmap, demand management, user education, corrective & preventive maintenance, build & run budget, . . . ) whether they are owned directly by Opella or still managed by Sanofi. 

Main objective is to shape our future state for Opella and take over the devices & manage our end-user software. As a leader of a team, below are the key responsibilities for this role and domain. 

Devices & Software inventory & lifecycle

Secure a clear cartography of Opella end-user devices to be ready for the takeover. This includes Laptops, desktops, mobiles, tablets, virtual desktops, industrial devices and printing. Manage device lifecycle, catalog and relationship with vendors to ensure the best and most cost-effective service In partnership with People organization and other stakeholders, determine a clear device assignment policy and end-to-end provisioning process, including imaging and enrolment, taking into account cybersecurity aspects

Setup a clear process for Opella to operate end-user software (approval, deployment, packaging, . . . ) and maintain it over time through evolutions. Oversee products lifecycle and build strategies (roadmaps, evolutions, Opella target landscape), especially to move from remaining Sanofi-operated capabilities to Opella target

Ensure close relationships with vendors (Microsoft, OEM, . . . ) to always get optimized costs, support & advices

Accurately & fully document solutions architectures, process and support models, especially in application referential (ServiceNow CMDB)

Ensure strong release management process including Change Management & Communications

Budget & TCO

Define and control the required budget to manage Devices & Software (new releases, licenses, run costs, . . . ) and ensure value maximization (e. g. fit-for-purpose licenses, streamline support partners, . . . ) Measure real consumption of products in scope and optimize costs for Opella User Experience, Adoption & Education

Ensure best user experience and education, by providing communications, learnings & trainings to end users, especially related to change management process (new features, catalog change, etc. . . )

Measure adoption and ensure maximum usage of products' capabilities

Automate repetitive tasks using scripting or configuration management tools (e. g. delivery of VDI or computers, inventories, . . . )

Share knowledge with colleagues and support teams to foster a culture of continuous learning Reliability & Operations

Through problem solving approach and in partnership with Support teams, contribute to root cause analysis and conduct post incident reviews to identify areas for improvement

In partnership with Support & Infrastructure teams, co-develop dashboards, alerts and metrics to proactively identify issues & anomalies Ensure full connection with Support teams to continuously improve the quality of service and propose fitted solutions Propose innovative solutions to reduce the burden of operations and maintenance for end-user hardware (i. e. self-healing, proactive monitoring, etc. . . ) while maximising end-user experience. Security & Compliance

Work closely with security teams to ensure compliance and address vulnerabilities (e. g. integrate security features in product's roadmap) Partnering with Digital Quality representatives, ensure alignment with regulations (GxP, SOX, . . . ), provide necessary documentation & answers to audits as required

Projects

Deliver evolutions & projects related to Digital Workplace scope, or oversee them if managed through Sanofi stakeholders

Ensure full involvement in the transition from Sanofi to Opella with regards to Devices and End-user software takeover (Hardware RFP, Intune setup, software packaging, . . . ) About you

Technical background required

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field, with various proven experiences in international context across global organizations

Proven experience in managing a Device & Software domain, close to end-user

Proficiency in Digital Workplace products & vendors eco-system, with deeper technical knowledge on devices, especially InTune and M365 in general. Expertise in end-user hardware management (brands, models, self-healing, monitoring, . . . ) Ability to use GenAI (Copilot or others) to solve complex problems and automate repetitive tasks Ability to be hands on and execute technical actions to solve issues or help the team to start up (scripting, technical design, configurations, . . . ) Soft skills required

Proven experience in managing global virtual teams and ability to work in an international matrix environment

Ability to lead and take ownership even in unclear situations. Contribute to clear the unclear

Excellent verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills, with ability to talk to Business and adapt "tech" language to this audience

Curious, open-minded, « out of the box » thinking

Agile and continuous improvement mindset, with critical-thinking and root-cause-analysis paradigms

Strategic thinking with ability to develop strategies for Digital Workplace products

Fluent in English

data.title: ERP Full Stack Development Lead - MERN & NestJS
data.description:
Job Description

ERP Full Stack Development Lead - MERN & NestJS

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly experienced, technically strong, and ownership-oriented ERP Full Stack Development Lead with deep expertise in MERN, NestJS, React. js, TypeScript, MongoDB, and enterprise ERP application development. 

This is not a conventional ERP developer position. The selected individual will be expected to take end-to-end technical ownership of the organization's current and upcoming ERP development projects, while also leading, mentoring, strengthening, and improving the productivity of the existing development team. 

The ideal candidate should have overall software development experience, with a minimum of 5 years of substantial hands-on experience in ERP / enterprise application development. 

The person should have practical experience working on an ERP product consisting of at least 10 integrated modules and should understand not only software development, but also business processes, workflows, integrations, data flow, implementation challenges, project estimation, delivery management, debugging, team productivity, and the complete ERP software lifecycle. 

We are looking for someone who can operate as a technical owner rather than simply a task executor. 

The Expected Outcome From This Role Is: 

AI-assisted development + Rapid Development + Higher Accuracy + Higher Developer Productivity + Faster Project Delivery + Stronger Development Team

Key Responsibilities

- End-to-End ERP Development Ownership
 - Take technical ownership of the organization's current and future ERP development projects. 
 - Understand the complete ERP product architecture, modules, workflows, integrations, dependencies, and technical ecosystem. 
 - Manage and guide the development lifecycle from requirement analysis → technical design → estimation → development → testing support → deployment → maintenance → enhancement. 
 - Ensure that development decisions are aligned with long-term ERP product scalability and maintainability. 
 - Identify technical risks, dependencies, bottlenecks, and delivery challenges before they affect projects. 
 - Establish development standards that can be consistently followed across current and future ERP projects. 
 - Ensure that new requirements are developed without unnecessarily compromising existing ERP functionality. 
 - Maintain technical consistency across modules and projects. 
 - ERP Domain Expertise

The candidate must have real-world ERP development experience, preferably involving an ERP product with 10 or more integrated modules. 

Strong Understanding Of Enterprise Workflows Such As: 

- Sales
 - Purchase
 - Inventory
 - Procurement
 - Production / Manufacturing
 - Finance / Accounts
 - CRM
 - Service
 - HR / Payroll
 - Projects
 - Reporting & Dashboards
 - Master Data
 - Approval Workflows
 - User & Role Management
 - Notifications
 - Integrations
 - Document Management

The candidate should be capable of understanding a business requirement and translating it into: 

Business Requirement → ERP Workflow → Technical Design → API → Database → UI → Validation → Testing → Deployment

The individual should be able to distinguish between a quick coding solution and a proper ERP-grade solution that can support future requirements. 

- Full Stack Development

Design, develop, review, optimize, and maintain scalable enterprise applications using: 

Backend

- NestJS
 - Node. js
 - TypeScript
 - Mongoose ODM
 - MongoDB
 - REST API development
 - API architecture and integration
 - Authentication and authorization
 - Error handling and validation
 - Business logic implementation
 - Backend performance optimization

Frontend

- React. js
 - JavaScript / TypeScript
 - Redux
 - Redux-Saga
 - Formik
 - React Hook Form (RHF)
 - Reusable component development
 - Complex enterprise forms
 - API integration
 - State management
 - Frontend performance optimization
 - Error handling and user experience

The candidate should be comfortable working across both frontend and backend, rather than being dependent on separate teams for basic full-stack development requirements. 

- MongoDB & Database Ownership
 - Design scalable MongoDB data models for ERP applications. 
 - Design and optimize Mongoose schemas. 
 - Write efficient MongoDB queries and aggregations. 
 - Identify and resolve database performance issues. 
 - Understand relationships and dependencies between ERP entities. 
 - Ensure data consistency and integrity across complex business workflows. 
 - Review database changes before implementation in critical modules. 
 - Identify potential scalability problems in database design. 
 - Project Estimation & Delivery Planning

The candidate must be highly capable of converting requirements into realistic, technically defensible ETAs. 

Responsibilities Include: 

- Analyze incoming requirements quickly. 
 - Break requirements into development tasks. 
 - Identify dependencies and technical complexity. 
 - Provide accurate development estimates and ETAs. 
 - Identify parallelizable development activities. 
 - Allocate work effectively across developers. 
 - Track estimated vs. actual development effort. 
 - Continuously improve estimation accuracy. 

The role should be capable of assessing and planning ETAs for a high-volume development pipeline, including 100+ new project/change requests or requirements in a month, without compromising technical quality. 

The expectation is not simply to provide an ETA, but to build a development system capable of predictable and measurable delivery. 

- Rapid Development & Faster Delivery

We are specifically looking for a developer who believes in rapid, disciplined, and intelligent development. 

The Candidate Should: 

- Develop rapidly without compromising maintainability. 
 - Minimize unnecessary development cycles. 
 - Reuse existing components, services, utilities, and patterns wherever appropriate. 
 - Identify repetitive development activities and automate them. 
 - Establish reusable development frameworks and standards. 
 - Reduce rework caused by incomplete analysis or poor implementation. 
 - Improve developer productivity continuously. 
 - Identify bottlenecks in the current development process and eliminate them. 
 - Convert requirements into production-ready functionality quickly and accurately. 

The Objective Is: 

More quality output in less time - not simply more lines of code. 

- AI-Driven Development

Strong practical adoption of AI-assisted software development is a core expectation of this position. 

The Candidate Should Actively Use AI Tools To Improve: 

- Development speed
 - Code generation
 - Code refactoring
 - Debugging
 - Error analysis
 - API development
 - Test case generation
 - Documentation
 - SQL / MongoDB query assistance
 - Technical research
 - Requirement analysis
 - Code reviews
 - Performance optimization
 - Repetitive development activities
 - Developer productivity

The candidate should not merely know how to use AI tools personally, but should be capable of introducing, standardizing, and improving AI-assisted development practices across the entire development team. 

The Candidate Is Expected To Continuously Identify: 

What can be developed faster with AI?

What can be tested more accurately with AI?

What can be automated with AI?

What repetitive developer activity can be eliminated with AI?

AI should be treated as a development productivity tool, while maintaining proper engineering judgment, security, correctness, maintainability, and code quality. 

- Team Leadership & Productivity

This position carries significant responsibility for the productivity and technical growth of the development team. 

The Candidate Should: 

- Understand the strengths and weaknesses of the existing developers. 
 - Assess the technical capability of individual team members. 
 - Allocate work according to capability and project priority. 
 - Mentor developers technically. 
 - Conduct meaningful code reviews. 
 - Improve development practices across the team. 
 - Identify productivity issues early. 
 - Help developers overcome technical blocks. 
 - Encourage AI-assisted development practices. 
 - Establish accountability for assigned work. 
 - Track commitments and delivery. 
 - Create a culture of ownership rather than dependency. 
 - Motivate developers toward continuous technical improvement. 
 - Uplift the overall technical capability of the team. 

The expectation is to make the team stronger, faster, and more independent over time. 

- Ownership & Accountability

The successful candidate must demonstrate a strong ownership mindset. 

This Role Requires Someone Who: 

- Takes responsibility for outcomes, not merely assigned tasks. 
 - Follows a requirement until it reaches completion. 
 - Does not wait for problems to become escalations. 
 - Identifies problems proactively. 
 - Communicates delays and risks early. 
 - Takes responsibility for technical decisions. 
 - Follows through on commitments. 
 - Maintains accountability for project delivery. 
 - Supports the team when critical issues arise. 
 - Takes ownership of both successful outcomes and failures. 

We Are Looking For Someone Who Asks: 

"How do we get this delivered?"

Rather Than: 

"Who is responsible for this?"

- Code Quality & Technical Standards
 - Establish and enforce clean coding standards. 
 - Conduct effective code reviews. 
 - Ensure reusable and maintainable architecture. 
 - Identify technical debt. 
 - Reduce duplicate and unnecessary code. 
 - Improve existing implementations where required. 
 - Establish common patterns for APIs, components, forms, state management, and database operations. 
 - Ensure proper error handling and validation. 
 - Maintain development documentation where required. 
 - Ensure that rapid development does not result in long-term technical debt. 
 - Git, CI/CD & Deployment

Strong Working Knowledge Of: 

- Git
 - GitHub
 - Git branching strategies
 - Pull requests
 - Code reviews
 - Merge conflict resolution
 - Release management
 - Jenkins
 - Continuous Integration
 - Continuous Deployment
 - Application deployment processes

The candidate should be capable of understanding the complete journey from: 

Developer → Branch → Code Review → Build → CI/CD → Deployment → Production

and should be able to troubleshoot failures across this lifecycle. 

- Debugging & Problem Solving

The candidate must possess exceptional debugging and analytical skills. 

Should Be Able To Independently Investigate: 

- Frontend issues
 - Backend issues
 - API failures
 - Database problems
 - Performance issues
 - Integration failures
 - Production defects
 - Data-related issues
 - Workflow inconsistencies
 - Deployment issues
 - Unexpected ERP business behavior

The Candidate Should Be Capable Of Moving Systematically From: 

Problem → Root Cause → Solution → Validation → Prevention

rather than simply applying temporary fixes. 

- Current Product & Future Product Development

The selected individual will be expected to understand the existing ERP product deeply and contribute to its continued evolution. 

Responsibilities Include: 

- Analyze existing architecture. 
 - Identify technical limitations. 
 - Recommend improvements. 
 - Improve development standards. 
 - Build reusable foundations for future modules. 
 - Support development of new ERP modules. 
 - Support integrations and third-party APIs. 
 - Improve application performance and scalability. 
 - Ensure new developments fit into the overall ERP architecture. 
 - Help establish the technical foundation for future ERP products and projects. 

Required Experience

Mandatory

- 10+ years of overall software development experience. 
 - Minimum 5 years of hands-on ERP / enterprise application development experience. 
 - Experience developing or maintaining an ERP/business management application with 10+ integrated modules. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with NestJS, Node. js, TypeScript, React. js and MongoDB. 
 - Strong experience with Mongoose ODM. 
 - Strong experience developing REST APIs. 
 - Practical experience with Redux and Redux-Saga. 
 - Experience with Formik and/or React Hook Form. 
 - Strong Git/GitHub experience. 
 - Practical Jenkins / CI/CD experience. 
 - Experience leading or mentoring developers. 
 - Experience handling complex enterprise workflows. 
 - Strong understanding of the complete software development lifecycle. 

Preferred ERP Experience

Experience in one or more of the following areas is highly preferred: 

- ERP
 - Business Management Systems
 - Inventory Management
 - Procurement
 - Purchase
 - Sales
 - CRM
 - Manufacturing
 - Production
 - Finance / Accounting
 - Service Management
 - HR / Payroll
 - Project Management
 - Enterprise Reporting
 - Workflow & Approval Systems
 - Third-party ERP integrations

Required Professional Qualities

The Ideal Candidate Should Demonstrate: 

- Strong ownership
 - High accountability
 - Excellent analytical ability
 - Strong problem-solving skills
 - Fast learning ability
 - Rapid development capability
 - Strong technical judgment
 - Business-process understanding
 - Leadership capability
 - Team-building ability
 - Excellent debugging ability
 - Ability to work under delivery pressure
 - Ability to prioritize multiple projects
 - Strong communication skills
 - Continuous improvement mindset
 - AI-first development mindset

What We Expect From This Role

This role is expected to become a key technical pillar of the organization. 

The Selected Individual Should Be Capable Of Progressing From: 

ERP Developer → Technical Owner → Development Lead → ERP Technical Leadership

The person should be capable of taking responsibility for the entire development ecosystem, including: 

ERP Architecture

↓

Requirement Understanding

↓

Technical Analysis

↓

Estimation & ETA

↓

Task Allocation

↓

Rapid Development

↓

AI-Assisted Development

↓

Code Review

↓

Testing Support

↓

Deployment

↓

Production Support

↓

Performance Improvement

↓

Team Development

↓

Future Product Development

Performance Expectations

Success in this role will be measured not only by individual coding ability, but by the overall output of the development function. 

Key Expectations Include: 

- Faster project delivery. 
 - Improved ETA accuracy. 
 - Higher development productivity. 
 - Reduced development rework. 
 - Reduced recurring defects. 
 - Better code quality. 
 - Better ERP workflow implementation. 
 - Increased reuse of existing components and services. 
 - Effective adoption of AI development tools. 
 - Improved team capability. 
 - Better accountability within the development team. 
 - Predictable project delivery. 
 - Successful management of multiple concurrent projects. 
 - Continuous improvement of the ERP technical architecture. 

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for an individual who is far beyond a conventional ERP developer. 

You should be someone who can look at an ERP requirement and understand the business problem, workflow, architecture, database, API, frontend, development effort, team allocation, delivery timeline, testing requirements, deployment implications, and future scalability. 

You should be comfortable getting hands-on with the code while simultaneously leading the team and improving the development process. 

You should be able to take an existing team, understand its capabilities, identify its weaknesses, introduce better development practices, actively adopt AI-assisted development, and progressively make the entire team faster, more accurate, more accountable, and more productive. 

We are looking for someone who does not simply ask: 

"What should I develop?"

We Are Looking For Someone Who Asks: 

"What needs to be delivered, how can we build it correctly and rapidly, how can AI accelerate it, how can the team deliver it, and how can we continuously improve the way we build our ERP?"

If you are an experienced ERP technology professional who can take technical ownership, lead people, solve complex problems, drive AI-powered development, and deliver enterprise software at speed, this role is intended for you.

Job Summary: 

This role is part of a peer leadership group with the Context Engineering Manager, who owns the context layer, and the AI Engineering Manager, who owns AI application and agent runtime. Together, the three leaders share ownership of the delivery platform, engineering standards, agentic pipeline, and shared skill and agent library. Each leader is also accountable for delivery in the product lanes assigned to their team. The role operates within the Advantage SDLC, ARB, firm policies, and security standards, and helps keep the practice aligned to one shared platform rather than allowing parallel stacks to form. 

Duties & Responsibilities

- Agentic Delivery Operations - Co-own and improve the shared agentic delivery pipeline with DT&I peers. Break work into units that agents can execute, with clear entry criteria, exit criteria, and verification steps. Contribute reusable agents, skills, and tooling back to the shared library, and track throughput per agent-hour, human review load, rework rate, and cost per delivered increment. 

- Context Engineering Practice - Lead the RISE context engineering team and co-develop practice standards with the Context Engineering Manager. These standards include context and prompt versioning, session and handoff artifact design, agent instruction inheritance such as CLAUDE. md and equivalents, context window management, and prevention of context drift across long-running work. Maintain change control over agents, prompts, context packages, and tool definitions as governed configuration items. 

- Validation, Evaluation & Quality Assurance - Own verification of agent-produced work products, including the evidence required, the accountable attester, the audit trail, and the steps a reviewer must follow to reconstruct how an output was produced. Build and maintain golden data sets, regression suites, adversarial coverage, drift detection, and evaluation-based release gates. Keep the deterministic and probabilistic boundary explicit in every design. 
 - Product & Platform Engineering Delivery - Deliver assigned features across the Advantage product portfolio on the . NET 10 / React stack, integrating Azure AI Foundry, Semantic Kernel, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure Container Apps, Dapr, and Microsoft Fabric. Take designs through the pre-build design review panel before pipeline entry and supply reviewers to it, and own CI/CD, testing, observability, and production support for what the team ships. 
 - Team Leadership & Capability Building - Build and mentor a RISE team of context engineers, evaluation engineers, and AI and full-stack engineers. Establish role clarity, performance expectations, and career paths for disciplines new to the firm, and staff for depth over headcount so capability growth shows up as throughput rather than team size. 
 - Risk Management - Ensure solutions and the agents that produce them meet firm security, privacy, and compliance baselines (SOC 2, PCAOB AS 2201, QC 1000, ISO 27001); define human-in-the-loop review as a documented control covering review depth, reviewer qualification, sign-off evidence, and exception escalation; and lead root cause analysis and corrective action for defects, agent failures, and control gaps. Supervisory Responsibilities

This role manages context engineers, evaluation engineers, and AI and full-stack engineers within RISE, and may direct contract resources. The role helps set DT&I engineering practice as a peer of the Context Engineering Manager and AI Engineering Manager, reviews code and evaluation results, and is accountable for the quality and reliability of what the RISE team ships to production. Portfolio priorities are set jointly with those peers and the AI & Digital Innovation Delivery Lead. 

Success in this role is measured by reliable delivery of assigned product increments, improved throughput through agentic delivery, reduced rework, strong evaluation coverage, compliant production releases, and sustained use of the shared Advantage platform and engineering standards. 

Qualifications

Key stakeholders include DT&I engineering peers, Assurance leadership, AI and digital innovation delivery leadership, infrastructure, data, security, compliance, and product stakeholders across RISE and BDO USA. 

- Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field required; Master's degree is preferred. 
 - Experience: Twelve (12-15) or more years in software, Data, or AI engineering, including five (5) or more years in Engineering Leadership, three (3) or more years in building Production AI, LLM, RAG, and/or Multi-Agent Systems beyond single-prompt applications, five (5) or more years of experience in leading large Program/Portfolio delivery and three (3) or more years of experience in Budget, Vendor & stakeholder Management. Demonstrated experience designing evaluation and validation approaches for non-deterministic systems, including regression testing and quality gating, required. Regulated or Professional Services experience is preferred. 
 - License / Certification: Relevant Azure or AI certification preferred (e. g. , Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate). 
 - Software: Azure AI Foundry, Semantic Kernel, Azure OpenAI / model APIs, Azure AI Search / vector stores, Azure Container Apps and Dapr, Microsoft Fabric, . NET / C#, React and TypeScript, Azure DevOps / CI-CD, evaluation and observability tooling, and Claude Code or equivalent agentic development tooling. Other Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

- Deep working knowledge of LLM context windows, prompting, retrieval, grounding, and multi-agent coordination, and how each affects accuracy, cost, and reliability. 
 - Evaluation and measurement mindset; able to define and defend accuracy, cost, and latency targets, and to evidence them under audit-grade scrutiny. 
 - Production-grade software discipline: testing, CI/CD, observability, and reliability in a governed environment. 
 - Builds shared standards with peers and extends a common platform rather than forking it locally, including comfort with adversarial design review in both directions. 
 - Clear communication and pragmatic delivery focus; partners across context, AI, infrastructure, data, and assurance stakeholders with meaningful daily overlap with U. S. hours.

data.description:
About the job

About the job

Position Title - Senior Firmware EngineerDepartment EngineeringReports ToEngineering ManagerDirect ReportsFirmware Engineers within the Avionics Software team. 

- Technical leadership of contract firmware engineers and interns assigned to certification programs. 
 - Position OverviewThe Senior Firmware Engineer is accountable for the design, development and certification of embedded firmware for Microair Avionics' DO-178C DAL-A/B airborne systems. Based at Microair's Indore facility and working across the company's Australian, US, Irish and Indian operations, the role owns firmware architecture and implementation from requirements through structural coverage and SOI audit, while leading and mentoring a team of firmware engineers to deliver against the certification schedule. The position is the technical authority on firmware design and coding standards, and is expected to represent Microair credibly in technical discussions with customers, DERs and certification authorities. Key Responsibilities1. Firmware Architecture & DesignOwn the architecture, design and implementation of embedded firmware for DO-178C DAL-A/B avionics systems (STM32/Cortex-M7, ESP32, RX72N), from concept through to certified release. 
 - 2. Requirements & TraceabilityAuthor and review High- and Low-Level Requirements (HLR/LLR). 
 - Maintain bidirectional traceability from system requirements through code and test, ensuring certification evidence and delivery status remain current. 
 - 3. Team Leadership & MentoringLead, mentor and review the work of a team of firmware engineers. 
 - Set coding and design standards. 
 - Conduct code reviews and build the team's capability in DO-178C-compliant development practices. 
 - 4. Coding & Static AnalysisDevelop and review safety-critical embedded C to MISRA C: 2012. 
 - Use PC-Lint Plus and equivalent static analysis tools to maintain DAL-A coding standards. 
 - 5. Certification & Audit LiaisonSupport SOI audits. 
 - Represent Microair in technical discussions with customers, DERs and certification authorities regarding firmware design, verification evidence and open findings. 
 - 6. Verification & TestOwn requirements-based test development and execution. 
 - Conduct MC/DC and structural coverage analysis. 
 - Drive closure of verification findings against DO-178C DAL-A objectives. 
 - 7. Configuration & Process ComplianceWork within the project's SCMP and SQAP. 
 - Maintain firmware baselines, problem reports and lifecycle data under control and audit-ready throughout the program. 
 - 8. Defect & Risk ManagementTriage and resolve firmware defects and anomalies. 
 - Assess certification and schedule impact. 
 - Drive root-cause fixes rather than workarounds. 
 - 9. Continuous ImprovementIdentify opportunities to improve firmware development tooling, review efficiency and team capability. 
 - Pursue improvements with the same discipline applied to program delivery. 
 - Skills & ExperienceEducationBachelor's degree (B. E. / B. Tech) in Electronics, Computer Engineering or a related technical discipline - essential. 
 - Formal training or certification in DO-178C software lifecycle processes - desirable. 
 - A substantial certified-firmware delivery track record is accepted in lieu of formal qualifications. 
 - Experience8-10 years in embedded firmware development, including at least 2 years leading or mentoring a team of engineers - essential. 
 - Demonstrated experience across the DO-178C DAL-A software lifecycle, including PSAC, SDP, SVP, SCMP and SQAP artifacts - essential. 
 - Experience authoring and reviewing HLR/LLR and supporting SOI audits with certification authorities or DERs - essential. 
 - Experience delivering requirements-based verification, MC/DC and structural coverage analysis on certified programs - essential. 
 - Fluent professional English and willingness to travel internationally to customer and Microair sites - essential. 
 - Avionics or aerospace background - essential. Equivalent experience in another regulated safety-critical domain such as defence electronics, automotive functional safety, medical devices or rail is accepted. 
 - System KnowledgeEmbedded C development on STM32/Cortex-M7, ESP32 and RX72N platforms, following MISRA C: 2012 and using PC-Lint Plus static analysis - essential. 
 - Avionics data bus standards - ARINC 429 BPRZ encoding, ARINC 664 Part 7 AFDX, CAN Aerospace Standards, MIL-STD-1553B Manchester II encoding, and 8. 33 kHz radio channel spacing - desirable. 
 - Requirements, test and traceability tools such as DOORS, Polarion, VectorCAST or equivalent - desirable. 
 - Working awareness of ARP4754B, ARP4761A, DO-160 and DO-254 - valued.

data.title: Quality and Project Platforms Lead
data.description:
Opella is the self-care challenger with the purest and third-largest portfolio in the Over-The-Counter (OTC) & Vitamins, Minerals & Supplements (VMS) market globally. 

Our mission is to bring health in people's hands by making self-care as simple as it should be. For half a billion consumers worldwide - and counting. At the core of this mission is our 100 loved brands, our 11, 000-strong global team, our 13 best-in-class manufacturing sites and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world's most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan. B Corp certified in multiple markets, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at www. opella. com. About You You will lead a team of 5 to 10 experts and platform owners covering three connected areas: Digital Quality, meaning GxP processes, computer system validation, and the Digital Control Framework. Testing and quality engineering, including test strategy, test management and automation on Xray and Tricentis Tosca. The Atlassian platform, where Jira and Confluence on Atlassian Cloud carry project delivery, documentation and compliance evidence for Opella Digital. The role is both platform owner and people manager. There is no intermediate management layer, so you lead senior specialists directly and stay close enough to the work to challenge a validation rationale, review a test automation approach, or settle a Jira workflow design. We are looking for someone with 12 to 15 years of experience who owns the outcome rather than the task, simplifies processes that have grown complicated, and works comfortably across Digital, Quality and the business functions. What you will do Lead the team Line manage 5 to 10 experts and platform owners, including internal staff and partner resources. Set direction and priorities across three areas at once. Give each platform owner clear accountability, decision rights and a roadmap they own, then hold them to it. Run objective setting, performance and development conversations, coaching, and skills, backup and succession planning. Shape resourcing, capacity and the balance between insourced and partner-delivered work. Own the budget and vendor relationships for the platforms in scope. Build one team culture across quality, testing and platform engineering rather than three separate groups. Digital Quality, policy and validation governance You are the global owner for GxP-relevant Digital Quality policies, standards, SOPs and work instructions, and for making them usable in practice. You own the Digital Control Framework: control design, control ownership, testing of control effectiveness, evidence retention and remediation tracking. The role covers controlled document management for CSV and CSA, data integrity under ALCOA+, cloud and SaaS governance, and electronic records and electronic signatures under 21 CFR Part 11. Digital solutions must meet GxP, ICH, HIPAA and 21 CFR Part 11 requirements, including how protected health and personal data is handled across regulated and commercial systems. You provide quality oversight for computer system validation using GAMP 5 and CSA principles, take risk-based decisions and document the reasoning. You govern validation plans, risk assessments and test strategies, and you review and approve URS, functional specifications, UAT reports, validation summaries and Authorization for Use. You manage validation deviations and CAPAs, oversee change controls for validation impact, and run GxP periodic reviews. You also govern digital supplier management: vendor inventories, assessments, quality agreements and performance monitoring. Testing, strategy, tooling and delivery assurance Own the global test strategy and testing standards for Opella Digital across functional, integration, regression, performance and user acceptance testing, in both GxP and non-GxP systems. You are accountable for Xray as the test management layer in Jira and for Tricentis Tosca as the automation platform, covering roadmap, licensing, environments, upgrades, integrations and adoption, working through the platform owners in your team. Grow automation coverage on the systems that matter most, such as ERP, supply chain, commercial and web, and make automated evidence usable for validation where the regulations allow it. Keep traceability intact from requirement to test case to execution to defect, which serves delivery quality and inspection readiness at the same time. Set testing metrics such as coverage, defect leakage, automation rate and cycle time, and use them to change how the teams work. Get involved early enough with project and product teams that testing is planned in from the start rather than added at the end. Atlassian platform Own Jira and Confluence on Atlassian Cloud, along with Jira Service Management, the Marketplace app portfolio and the integrations with the rest of the digital toolchain. Define and govern project templates, workflows, schemes, permissions and space structures so that they support agile delivery and the traceability a regulated environment needs. Cloud releases arrive continuously, so the platform roadmap has to cover release and change management, app rationalization, performance, cost and license optimization. Work with Cybersecurity, Identity and Internal Audit on security, privacy, access management, data residency and audit requirements, including the controls needed for Jira and Confluence to hold GxP-relevant records. Drive adoption and standardization across Digital and the business so the standard way is also the easy way, and run platform operations to agreed service levels with a clear support model and incident and problem management. Collaboration, audit and inspection readiness Partner with Digital, Manufacturing, R&D, Quality and Supply Chain teams to give GxP and testing guidance during system modernization. Work with Cybersecurity, Data Privacy and Internal Audit specialists so requirements are managed in one central framework rather than several. Build and deliver global training on digital and GxP policies, data integrity, validation, testing and Atlassian practices. Keep evidence packages and stakeholder coordination ready for audit at any time, not only when one is announced. Act as the subject matter expert during Health Authority inspections (FDA, EMA, MHRA and others) and internal or external audits covering digital systems, validation and data integrity, and lead CAPA development and effectiveness checks for findings related to digital quality governance. About you We look at potential, character and culture fit alongside experience. You have 12 to 15 years of experience across digital quality and compliance, software testing and platform ownership in a regulated industry such as pharma, healthcare or life sciences. You have managed people for at least 3 to 5 years, ideally senior specialists and platform owners in a flat structure, including hiring, coaching, performance management and leading work delivered through partners. You have owned an enterprise SaaS platform yourself, including its roadmap, budget, vendors, lifecycle, adoption and service levels. You know test strategy, test management, automation and the validation lifecycle for GxP digital systems. On tooling, you have worked hands on with Jira and Xray for test plans, executions, traceability matrices and dashboards. You understand how Tricentis Tosca automation is designed, maintained and scaled in a large system landscape. You can configure and govern Jira and Confluence Cloud, including workflows, permissions, apps and admin and security controls. You are familiar with ServiceNow, Veeva Vault or equivalent document management systems. On regulation, you know GxP, ICH guidelines, HIPAA and 21 CFR Part 11 for electronic records and signatures, together with GAMP 5, CSA, IT general controls and ALCOA+ data integrity principles. You have run GxP supplier qualification activities. You are fluent in English and comfortable working with stakeholders across a global matrix organization. The Opella leadership behaviors we are looking for We assess every candidate against our four behaviors. Behavior What it looks like in this role All in. Together. You lead one team across quality, testing and platforms, and you partner across Digital, R&D, Manufacturing and Supply Chain, asking for help and giving it freely. Courageous You challenge how validation and testing are done today, take considered risks on automation and platform change, and speak up during inspections. Outcome-Obsessed You own the compliance and delivery result, not only the task, and follow through with integrity and speed. Radically Simple You make GxP frameworks and platform configurations simple enough for teams to understand and apply. Opella is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where every candidate feels respected.

Maintain the validated state of regulated services/systems through Change, Incident, and Problem Management. Govern digital third-party management: vendor inventories, assessments, quality agreements, and performance monitoring. Ensure audit and inspection readiness at all times - evidence packages, stakeholder coordination, and post-audit remediation. Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) during Health Authority inspections (FDA, EMA, MHRA, etc. ) for digital systems and data integrity. Lead CAPA development and effectiveness checks for observations related to digital quality governance. You bring deep expertise, but also the mindset of a Challenger: curious, bold, and driven to make things better. Experience, Education & Skills 10+ years of hands-on experience in GxP Digital Quality and Compliance, with a strong focus on digital systems and validation. QA Foundations: Solid background in test strategy, validation lifecycle management, and the GxP aspects of digital systems. Tooling Proficiency: 🛠️ Jira & Xray: Experience using Jira/Xray for test management, including test plans, executions, traceability matrices, and dashboards. 🛠️ Atlassian: Proficiency in managing Jira and Confluence workflows to support compliance processes. 🛠️ Compliance Systems: Familiarity with ServiceNow, Veeva Vault, and equivalent document management systems. Regulatory Knowledge: Deep understanding of Annex 11, 21 CFR Part 11, IT General Controls (ITGC), and ALCOA+ data integrity principles. Experience in GxP supplier qualification activities. The Opella Leadership Behaviors We're Looking For We evaluate all candidates against our Four Behaviors - the foundation of how we lead and collaborate at Opella: Behavior What it looks like in this role 🟢 All in. Together. You partner across IT, R&D, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain - asking for help and giving it freely. 🟢 Courageous You challenge the status quo in validation processes, take thoughtful risks, and speak up during inspections. 🟢 Outcome-Obsessed You own the compliance outcome - not just the task - and follow through with integrity and speed. 🟢 Radically Simple You simplify complex GxP frameworks, making them easy for teams to understand and apply. Opella is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where every candidate feels respected. Why us? At Opella, you will enjoy doing challenging, purposeful work, empowered to develop consumer brands with passion and creativity. This is your chance to grow new skills and be part of a bold, collaborative, and inclusive culture where people can thrive and be at their best every day. We Are Challengers. About You The Quality Specialist - Complaint Management will support the end-to-end execution and oversight of product quality complaint activities, from intake assessment and investigation coordination through documentation review, quality decision support, closure, trending, and continuous improvement. The role is responsible for ensuring complaint records are complete, scientifically sound, data-driven, and compliant with applicable GMP, quality system, and internal procedural requirements. Working in a global and matrix environment, the role will help strengthen complaint governance, investigation quality, stakeholder follow-up, and process performance across Opella's self-care network.  - Relevant technical testing/reliability experience in electro-mechanical, electrical testing of Medical Devices. 
 - An understanding of test methods and processes as well as the methods used to verify product in the realms of; mechanical, electrical, functional testing environments.
