data.title: DevOps Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

DevOps Engineer

Role Overview

We are looking for a hands-on, responsible and growth-oriented DevOps Engineer with approximately 1-2 years of experience who is interested in building strong practical expertise in Linux, Docker, CI/CD, server management, deployment automation, security, monitoring and infrastructure management. 

GwayERP and ThiranERP are growing rapidly, and we are preparing our infrastructure and deployment processes to support an increasing number of ERP implementations and frequent application releases. 

The selected candidate will work closely with the development, QA and technical teams to maintain the existing environments, improve the current infrastructure, automate repetitive activities, strengthen security, improve documentation and progressively build a reliable deployment ecosystem. 

This role is ideal for someone who has a good foundation in DevOps and is willing to learn deeply, take responsibility, research solutions independently and grow into larger infrastructure and DevOps responsibilities. 

The candidate does not need to know everything from day one. 

However, The Candidate Must Have The Mindset: 

"If I don't know it, I will learn it, understand it properly, implement it safely and document it. "

Key Responsibilities

- Environment Management

Support and maintain the different application environments used by GwayERP and ThiranERP, including: 

- Development
 - Testing / QA
 - Staging
 - Trial / Demo
 - Production / Client environments

Responsibilities Include: 

- Maintaining environment availability. 
 - Checking server health. 
 - Managing application services. 
 - Managing Docker containers. 
 - Managing environment configurations. 
 - Supporting developers with environment-related issues. 
 - Identifying configuration inconsistencies. 
 - Keeping environments properly documented. 

The candidate will progressively improve the structure and reliability of these environments. 

- Local Server & Linux Administration

Work hands-on with our local/on-premises infrastructure. 

Responsibilities Include: 

- Ubuntu/Linux server administration. 
 - User and permission management. 
 - SSH configuration. 
 - Server resource monitoring. 
 - Disk and storage monitoring. 
 - Network configuration. 
 - Firewall configuration. 
 - Service management. 
 - Log analysis. 
 - System updates and patching. 
 - Troubleshooting server-related issues. 

The candidate should gradually develop the ability to independently troubleshoot common Linux infrastructure problems. 

- Docker & Container Management

Work with Docker-based application environments. 

Responsibilities Include: 

- Creating and maintaining Docker containers. 
 - Managing Docker Compose configurations. 
 - Managing container networks. 
 - Managing Docker volumes. 
 - Managing application configuration. 
 - Monitoring container health. 
 - Troubleshooting container failures. 
 - Managing application logs. 
 - Maintaining Docker images. 
 - Cleaning unused resources safely. 
 - Following standard containerization practices. 

The candidate should progressively learn how to design consistent and reusable Docker environments rather than maintaining containers manually. 

- CI/CD & Jenkins

Support and improve the organization's CI/CD processes using Jenkins, Git and GitHub. 

Responsibilities Include: 

- Understanding existing Jenkins pipelines. 
 - Maintaining Jenkins jobs. 
 - Supporting automated builds. 
 - Managing deployment pipelines. 
 - Troubleshooting failed builds. 
 - Troubleshooting deployment failures. 
 - Managing build artifacts. 
 - Supporting automated application deployments. 
 - Maintaining Jenkins credentials securely. 
 - Gradually improving deployment automation. 

The long-term objective is to reduce manual deployment activities and make deployments: 

Repeatable → Reliable → Automated → Traceable

- Deployment Automation

Work with developers to improve the way GwayERP and ThiranERP applications are deployed. 

The candidate will help establish a standardized deployment process such as: 

Code → Build → Release → Deploy → Verify

Responsibilities Include: 

- Understanding application deployment requirements. 
 - Preparing deployment scripts. 
 - Automating repetitive deployment tasks. 
 - Supporting application updates. 
 - Maintaining deployment configurations. 
 - Performing deployment verification. 
 - Supporting rollback procedures. 
 - Maintaining deployment documentation. 

The candidate should continuously identify opportunities to eliminate unnecessary manual steps. 

- Preparing for High-Volume Deployments

GwayERP and ThiranERP are expected to be deployed to an increasing number of customers. 

The infrastructure is being prepared for a future requirement of approximately: 

20-30+ deployments per day

The candidate will work with technical team members and developers to understand this requirement and progressively improve the deployment architecture. 

Responsibilities Include: 

- Identifying deployment bottlenecks. 
 - Automating repetitive deployment tasks. 
 - Improving deployment speed. 
 - Improving deployment reliability. 
 - Standardizing client deployment procedures. 
 - Supporting parallel deployment where appropriate. 
 - Maintaining deployment records. 
 - Learning and implementing suitable DevOps practices for higher deployment volumes. 

The candidate is expected to grow with the requirement and continuously improve the deployment system as the number of clients increases. 

- Secure Client Deployment

GwayERP And ThiranERP Applications May Be Deployed In: 

- Customer on-premises servers
 - Customer-preferred cloud servers
 - Other approved customer environments

The candidate will assist in developing a deployment architecture where the application can run securely in the customer's environment without unnecessarily exposing the organization's source code. 

The candidate should learn and work with concepts such as: 

- Docker images
 - Private container registries
 - Build artifacts
 - Runtime configuration
 - Secrets management
 - Access control
 - Secure deployment packages
 - Application versioning
 - Container security

The Objective Is: 

Customers should be able to run and use the ERP application without receiving unrestricted access to the development source code. 

The candidate should continuously research and recommend better approaches as the deployment model evolves. 

- Application Updates & Release Management

ERP Applications Will Continuously Receive: 

- Bug fixes
 - Security fixes
 - New features
 - Performance improvements
 - Workflow enhancements

The DevOps process must support updating existing client installations safely. 

The Candidate Will Assist In Building Processes For: 

New Release → Backup → Deployment → Database Migration → Verification

Responsibilities Include: 

- Preparing release packages/images. 
 - Supporting application updates. 
 - Checking deployment prerequisites. 
 - Supporting database migrations. 
 - Verifying application health after deployment. 
 - Maintaining release versions. 
 - Supporting rollback when required. 

The candidate must understand that ERP deployments involve customer business data and therefore require much greater care than a simple application redeployment. 

- MongoDB Backup & Recovery

Work with the technical team to maintain reliable MongoDB backup and recovery processes. 

Responsibilities Include: 

- Understanding MongoDB backup methods. 
 - Configuring automated backups. 
 - Monitoring backup jobs. 
 - Maintaining backup retention. 
 - Checking backup integrity. 
 - Performing test restores. 
 - Supporting database recovery. 
 - Maintaining backup documentation. 

The Candidate Should Develop a Strong Understanding Of: 

Backup ≠ Recovery

A backup should be periodically tested to ensure that it can actually be restored. 

- Data Safety During Deployment

The candidate must follow deployment practices that protect customer data. 

Before significant application updates, the candidate should ensure appropriate procedures are followed for: 

- Database backup
 - Application compatibility
 - Database migration
 - Configuration backup
 - Deployment verification
 - Rollback

The Objective Is To Minimize The Possibility Of: 

- Data loss
 - Database corruption
 - Incompatible application/database versions
 - Configuration loss
 - Failed updates
 - Infrastructure Security

Security will be an important responsibility of this role. 

The Candidate Will Work On: 

- Linux server hardening. 
 - SSH security. 
 - Firewall configuration. 
 - Port management. 
 - User access control. 
 - File permissions. 
 - Docker security. 
 - Database access restrictions. 
 - Jenkins security. 
 - Git/GitHub security. 
 - Secret management. 
 - SSL/TLS. 
 - Security updates. 

The candidate should continuously learn about current infrastructure and application security practices. 

- Monitoring & Logging

Help Implement And Maintain Monitoring For: 

- Server CPU
 - RAM
 - Disk space
 - Disk health
 - Network
 - Docker containers
 - Application services
 - MongoDB
 - Redis
 - Jenkins
 - Backup jobs

The candidate should help establish alerts for important conditions such as: 

- Server unavailable
 - Disk nearly full
 - Container repeatedly restarting
 - Database unavailable
 - Backup failure
 - Application health failure
 - Deployment failure

The goal is to identify problems before they become customer-impacting issues. 

- Documentation

One of the important responsibilities of this role is to improve the current level of infrastructure documentation. 

The Candidate Should Maintain Documentation For: 

Environment

- Server details
 - Application environments
 - Docker services
 - Ports
 - Network configuration
 - Application dependencies

Deployment

- Deployment procedures
 - Update procedures
 - Rollback procedures
 - Client deployment steps

Backup

- Backup procedures
 - Backup locations
 - Retention
 - Restore procedures

Infrastructure

- Server configuration
 - Docker architecture
 - Jenkins pipelines
 - Application deployment architecture

Troubleshooting

- Common problems
 - Solutions
 - Recovery procedures

The objective is to ensure that important operational knowledge is documented and repeatable rather than dependent on individual memory. 

- Git & Release Management

Work with Git/GitHub-based development workflows. 

Responsibilities Include: 

- Understanding branches. 
 - Understanding pull requests. 
 - Managing deployment branches where required. 
 - Understanding release tags. 
 - Tracking application versions. 
 - Supporting release management. 
 - Maintaining deployment history. 

The Candidate Should Understand The Relationship Between: 

Git → Build → Release → Deployment → Production

- Infrastructure Automation

The candidate should actively look for opportunities to automate repetitive work. 

This May Include: 

- Shell scripts
 - Bash
 - Docker automation
 - Jenkins pipelines
 - Deployment scripts
 - Backup scripts
 - Monitoring scripts
 - Server setup scripts
 - Configuration automation

Knowledge of tools such as Ansible or Terraform will be an advantage. 

The expectation is not that the candidate knows every automation tool immediately, but that they have the willingness and ability to learn them when required. 

- Working With Developers

The DevOps Engineer will work closely with developers and QA engineers. 

Responsibilities Include: 

- Understanding application requirements. 
 - Understanding environment requirements. 
 - Supporting development environments. 
 - Supporting testing environments. 
 - Supporting staging. 
 - Preparing deployment environments. 
 - Understanding application configuration. 
 - Supporting database migrations. 
 - Identifying deployment risks. 
 - Helping developers troubleshoot environment issues. 

The candidate should be comfortable discussing technical issues directly with developers. 

- Learning & Continuous Improvement

This position requires a strong self-learning mindset. 

The candidate will encounter technologies and infrastructure requirements that may not be known at the time of joining. 

The Candidate Is Expected To: 

- Research unfamiliar technologies. 
 - Read official documentation. 
 - Test solutions safely. 
 - Build proof-of-concepts where necessary. 
 - Learn from incidents. 
 - Improve existing processes. 
 - Keep up with DevOps practices. 
 - Learn security best practices. 
 - Learn infrastructure automation. 
 - Learn container orchestration and deployment approaches as the organization's needs evolve. 

We value the ability to learn and implement more than simply listing a large number of technologies on a resume. 

- Problem Solving & Troubleshooting

The candidate should develop strong troubleshooting skills. 

Problems May Include: 

- Application not starting
 - Container failure
 - Database connection failure
 - Network issue
 - Jenkins build failure
 - Deployment failure
 - Disk space issue
 - Permission issue
 - SSL certificate issue
 - Backup failure
 - Server performance issue

The Expected Approach Is: 

Understand → Investigate → Identify Root Cause → Fix → Verify → Document → Prevent Recurrence

Technical Skills

Required / Expected

- Linux / Ubuntu
 - Docker
 - Docker Compose
 - Git
 - GitHub
 - Jenkins
 - CI/CD fundamentals
 - Basic networking
 - SSH

data.title: DevSecOps Engineer
data.description:
Role: DevSecOps Engineer

Location: Bangalore (4 days WFO)

Team: Product & Engineering

Reports to: Director of Compliance

About Triomics: 

Triomics helps oncology organizations scale clinical research and high-quality data creation without scaling headcount. Our AI platform - powered by OncoLLMTM- automates the operational work behind trial screening, eligibility interpretation, and oncology data abstraction across Prism (clinical trial matching), Harmony (oncology registry + RWE curation), and Symphony (clinician copilot). Built for real-world hospital workflows, Triomics integrates with EHRs and CTMS systems and is deployed with leading academic cancer centers to improve speed, consistency, and audit-ready clinical accuracy. 

Role Overview: 

We are looking for a DevSecOps Engineer to help secure, harden, and maintain scalable, reliable infrastructure in a HIPAA-regulated, SOC 2-audited environment. In this role, you will work closely with engineering teams to build security into our cloud environments and deployment pipelines, and you will remediate security findings directly including in code. 

This role works under the direction of the Compliance and Security function, which sets priorities, requirements, and remediation targets. You will sit with engineers, work in their repositories and pipelines, and ship changes through the same development process they use. You will be responsible for cloud security across Azure and AWS, securing CI/CD pipelines, managing the vulnerability lifecycle from detection through verified closure, and supporting incident response and compliance operations. 

What You'll Do: 

- Secure and harden cloud environments Microsoft Azure and AWS: including identity and access management, network security, encryption, logging, and configuration baselines. 
 - Build security into CI/CD pipelines: secrets management, dependency and container scanning, SAST/SCA integration, and infrastructure-as-code review. 
 - Remediate findings from penetration tests, vulnerability scans, and code analysis writing fixes in application code where practical and driving engineering teams to closure where not. 
 - Manage the vulnerability lifecycle: triage, prioritize, track remediation in Jira, and verify closure. 
 - Support incident response and root cause analysis: investigation, containment, and post-incident hardening. 
 - Automate security operations and compliance evidence collection supporting SOC 2 and HIPAA obligations. 
 - Collaborate with development teams to improve security posture without slowing delivery. 
 - Maintain clear documentation for security controls, processes, and operational procedures. 

What We're Looking For: 

- 3-5 years of experience in DevOps, security engineering, or a related role. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Azure and AWS (security services, Entra ID, networking); 
 - Proficiency in Python and Bash scripting able to read application code and write fixes, not just configure tools. 
 - Strong experience with Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD tooling, VS Code. 
 - Solid understanding of Linux system administration, networking concepts, and security hardening practices. 
 - Familiarity with common vulnerability classes (OWASP Top 10) and remediation patterns. 
 - Experience with monitoring, logging, and incident response systems. 
 - Strong communication skills and the ability to document technical processes effectively. 

Education: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Healthcare Informatics, Life Sciences, Business, or a related field. 
 - Equivalent practical experience in technical program management, product delivery, healthcare technology, or software engineering environments may be considered. 

Nice to Have: 

- Experience in healthcare, health-tech, or AI/ML-driven products
 - Prior experience in a startup or high-growth company
 - Cloud security certification (AZ-500 or equivalent). 
 - Experience in a HIPAA, SOC 2, or otherwise regulated environment. 

What Success Looks Like: 

- New vulnerabilities stop reaching production: findings are caught in the pipeline or in QA
 - Pen test and vulnerability findings remediated within SLA, with closure verified. Tests come back cleaner each cycle. 
 - Security controls built into pipelines that speed up releases instead of blocking them. 
 - Security discipline is built into how the team works: secure defaults, automated checks, and paved-road patterns mean the remediation backlog shrinks quarter over quarter
 - Clear visibility for Compliance and Engineering on security posture, open risks, and remediation progress

Why Join Us?

- Impact at scale - The AI you build directly accelerates cancer research and improves patient outcomes worldwide
 - Cutting-edge problems - You'll work on some of the hardest and most interesting LLM engineering challenges in a highly regulated industry. 
 - World-class team - Collaborate with experts across AI, engineering, product, and oncology with best-in-industry compensation. 
 - Culture that ships - We're a team that works hard and plays hard (company-sponsored retreats in Bali, Sri Lanka, Goa, and more)

Employment eligibility: 

- Employment is subject to successful completion of applicable pre-employment verification, including identity, education, prior employment, references, and other role-relevant checks, conducted in accordance with applicable law. 

Perks & Benefits: 

- Lunch Provided at the Office - one less daily decision, one happier employee. 
 - Flexible Working Hours - we care about output, not clock-ins. 
 - Health Insurance - comprehensive coverage for you and your family. 
 - Zomato Meal Benefit - breakfast and dinner can be ordered when you come in early or leave late, because effort deserves fuel.

data.title: Software Development Engineer, AWS DynamoDB
data.description:
Description

AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations - from foundational services such as Amazon's Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS's services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you'll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services. 

Do you want to work on a product that can do the following?: 

Access petabytes of data in single-digit milliseconds

Replicate tables across continents

Stream terabytes of data updates per hour continuously

Back up hundreds of terabytes of data in seconds

Encrypt petabytes of data with no performance degradation

Amazon DynamoDB is a NoSQL database service that does all this and more. DynamoDB is a key-value and document database that delivers single-digit-millisecond performance at any scale. DynamoDB can store petabytes of customer data and handle peaks of more than 20 million requests per second. 

As a fast growing service at the core of the AWS Cloud, our business and engineering decisions have widespread impact across AWS, Amazon, and beyond. Many of the world's fastest growing businesses, such as Lyft, Airbnb, and Redfin, as well as enterprises, such as Samsung, Toyota, and Capital One, depend on the scale and performance of DynamoDB to support their mission-critical workloads. 

DynamoDB is one of the largest distributed database systems in the world, and we continue to believe it is Day 1 for the DynamoDB business. We are constantly improving and adding new capabilities to DynamoDB, and we are looking for a deeply technical, team-first software development engineer to push DynamoDB even further. 

DynamoDB engineers are constantly challenged to think of unique and innovative solutions. The quality bar is high. As an engineer here, you will work on the hardest engineering problems in distributed systems at a massive scale and on multiple dimensions. You will exercise your intellectual curiosity, work with motivated teams of sharp individuals, and get insightful guidance from senior and principal engineers. 

This is a hands-on position in which you will own everything from end to end: requirements gathering, designs, design reviews, implementations, code reviews, incremental feature launches, operations, mentoring, and the driving of continuous improvement. 

About The Team

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying. 

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating - that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. 

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. 

Mentorship & Career Growth

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. 

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud. 

Basic Qualifications

- Experience programming with at least one software programming language
 - 3+ years of building complex software systems experience
 - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

Preferred Qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. About Skyworks

If you are looking for a challenging and exciting career in the world of technology, then look no further. Skyworks is an innovator of high-performance analog semiconductors whose solutions are powering the wireless networking revolution. At Skyworks, you will find a fast-paced environment with a strong focus on global collaboration, minimal layers of management and the freedom to make meaningful contributions in a setting that encourages creativity and out of the box thinking. We are excited about the opportunity to work with you and glad you want to be part of a team of talented individuals who together can change the way the world communicates. 

Skyworks offers the industry's broadest Timing product portfolio of crystal oscillator, clock generator, clock buffer, jitter attenuator and network synchronizer products. Our patented technology combines best-in-class frequency flexibility with the lowest jitter in the industry, delivering quick-turn, customized solutions that simplify board design, eliminate discrete components, and maximize system performance. 

Position Overview

The IC Validation team leads all post-silicon activities, including chip bring-up, validation, and characterization of new timing devices. In this management role, you will recruit and build a new team of validation and characterization engineers in Skyworks' Bengaluru office to support local Timing Design teams. You will play a key role in our New Product Introduction (NPI) cycle, as our products cross from pre-silicon design to post-silicon validation to ensure exceptional product quality and performance. In this role, the ability to quickly debug and resolve performance issues will be critical to delivering world-class products to our customers. 

We seek candidates who demonstrate a passion for learning, initiative, curiosity, and engineering ingenuity. A positive attitude and a strong disposition for teamwork are essential. 

Position Responsibilities

- Build and develop a new team of validation and characterization engineers to support our Timing Design team based out of the Skyworks Bangaluru office. This team will: 
 - Test and debug system and block functionality of new timing ICs. 
 - Perform silicon characterization through the development of robust and reusable tests to determine device datasheet specifications 
 - Lead the design and development of high-speed PCBs (EEVBs), including discrete analog circuits, used for validation and characterization. 
 - Assemble and maintain test setups in the laboratory to support validation and characterization. 
 - Define, develop, and/or acquire software and/or hardware tools in support of silicon test efforts. 
 - Develop automation scripts to automate data collection, decrease data collection times, ensure repeatable measurements, and generate reports.

data.title: ML Evaluation Engineer
data.description:
Model Quality · Release Validation · Production Impact Analysis

Location: On-site, HSR Layout, Bengaluru

Level: Mid/Senior Individual Contributor / Lead-track IC

About Triomics

Triomics is building the agentic AI layer for oncology EHRs. Cancer hospitals spend billions on highly trained staff manually reading unstructured patient records - pathology reports, clinical notes, genomic panels - to power workflows like trial matching, registry curation, visit prep, and quality reporting. We replace that manual work with task-driven AI agents that sit inside the EMR and process records at scale, in real time. 

Our platform is trusted by leading cancer centers including Memorial Sloan Kettering, Mount Sinai, and Yale Cancer Center. We have grown 10x in the last year and process millions of oncology medical documents monthly. 

Our investors include Battery Ventures, Lightspeed, General Catalyst, Nexus Venture Partners, and Y Combinator. 

GROWTH PATH

This is an individual contributor role with strong ownership expectations. High performers may be considered for workstream lead or functional lead responsibilities after approximately 12 months, based on demonstrated ownership, delivery, technical judgment, mentoring, cross-functional influence, and ability to reduce dependency on the Director of ML. 

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an ML Evaluation Engineer to own model quality, regression testing, release validation, and production impact analysis for clinical AI systems. This role sits between applied ML, clinical data, MLOps, and production operations. 

Your job is to ensure that every model or workflow release is measurable, stable, and not degrading important clinical behavior. You will maintain evaluation datasets, create hidden test sets, run regression checks, analyze production issues, and produce release-readiness reports. 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Build and maintain evaluation frameworks for clinical NLP, LLM, RAG, information extraction, and structured abstraction systems. 
 - Create and manage hidden test datasets that are not directly visible to model developers, reducing overfitting risk. 
 - Define release metrics, regression thresholds, slice-based evaluation, failure-mode tracking, and release/blocker criteria. 
 - Compare model versions and identify performance degradation across clinical segments, document types, clients, data sources, labels, and edge cases. 
 - Work with Clinical AI Data Specialists to design gold sets, hidden test sets, adjudication workflows, and label quality checks. 
 - Work with Research Engineers to understand model changes, expected behavior, and evaluation risks without compromising test-set independence. 
 - Work with MLOps/Data Engineering to monitor production behavior, triage bugs, analyze incident impact, and prioritize fixes. 
 - Create release-readiness reports before production deployment. 
 - Build dashboards, scripts, and automated checks for evaluation, monitoring, regression testing, and model comparison. 
 - Prioritize model bugs based on clinical severity, user impact, frequency, regression risk, and operational urgency. 

WHAT WE EXPECT

- 3-6+ years of experience in ML engineering, data science, model evaluation, ML QA, applied NLP evaluation, or data-heavy quality engineering. 
 - Strong Python and data analysis skills. 
 - Strong understanding of precision/recall/F1, calibration, confidence thresholds, dataset splits, leakage, overfitting, statistical testing, and error analysis. 
 - Experience building evaluation pipelines, benchmark suites, test harnesses, dashboards, or regression frameworks. 
 - Ability to work with imperfect labels, annotation disagreement, clinical ambiguity, and hidden evaluation sets. 
 - Strong independence and judgment; ability to challenge releases when evidence is weak. 
 - Clear written communication for release reports, incident analysis, and quality decisions. 

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with LLM evaluation, RAG evaluation, extraction evaluation, clinical NLP, or healthcare ML. 
 - Experience with model monitoring, production incident analysis, data drift, or observability. 
 - Experience with MLflow, Weights & Biases, Evidently, Great Expectations, DeepEval, Ragas, pytest, Airflow, Prefect, or similar tools. 
 - Clinical or biomedical NLP exposure. 

SUCCESS IN 6 MONTHS

- Establishes a repeatable release validation process. 
 - Maintains hidden evaluation datasets and prevents overfitting to test data. 
 - Produces release reports that leadership, ML, and engineering can trust. 
 - Catches meaningful regressions before release. 
 - Provides reliable impact analysis for production issues and helps prioritize fixes. 

Why Join Triomics

- Impact at scale. The systems your teams build directly power AI workflows that accelerate cancer research and improve patient outcomes. 
 - Cutting-edge problems. Hard, data-intensive systems at the intersection of AI, healthcare, and scale - in a highly regulated industry where reliability is non-negotiable. 
 - World-class team. Work alongside top talent across AI, engineering, and product, with best-in-industry compensation. 
 - Culture that ships. Fast-paced, ownership-driven, with company-sponsored workations. 

Perks & Benefits

- Lunch provided at the office - one less daily decision. 
 - Flexible working hours - we care about output, not clock-ins. 
 - Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family. 
 - Zomato meal benefits for early starts and late nights. 
 - Remote Wednesdays

If you are looking for a challenging and exciting career in the world of technology, then look no further. The IC Validation team leads all post-silicon activities, including chip bring-up, validation, and characterization of new timing devices. Within EY's Business Consulting Practice, the Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group provides solutions that can help FSO clients to identify, measure, manage and monitor the market (trading book), credit (banking book), operational, and regulatory risks associated with their trading, asset-liability management, capital management and other capital markets activities. 

Role Overview: 

We are seeking experienced Credit Risk and Quality Assurance professionals to join the QA Managed Services team supporting Wholesale Credit Quality Assurance (WCQA) activities, where the role involves: 

- Independently reviewing credit portfolios and assessing underwriting quality in line with regulatory and internal policy expectations
 - Executing end-to-end QA processes within a managed services operating model while ensuring adherence to defined SLAs, quality standards, and governance frameworks
 - Executing and/or leading Quality Assurance Reviews (QARs) and associated testing across credit lifecycle activities
 - Providing credible challenge to underwriters and portfolio teams on credit decisions, documentation quality, and process adherence 
 - Generating thematic, portfolio-level insights beyond case-specific observations to identify operational and control weaknesses, training gaps, and process deficiencies, thereby supporting continuous improvement and strengthening overall credit risk management practices. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Perform periodic Quality Assurance Reviews (QARs) across wholesale lending credit risk activities, including underwriting & credit analysis, credit documentation quality, and overall process adherence. 
 - Assess the accuracy and appropriateness of risk ratings, financial analysis, and credit decisions
 - Deliver consistent, objective assessments using defined QA methodologies, sampling frameworks, and standardized review protocols. 
 - Review credit memos, financial models, covenant structures, and approval workflows
 - Identify and document process gaps, control weaknesses, and quality deficiencies, with a strong focus on thematic trends and systemic issues to drive continuous improvement. 
 - Provide credible challenge to Business/Portfolio Leads and Underwriters on underwriting quality, analytical rigor, and adherence to policies and standards, with appropriate escalation of material issues. 
 - Support the effective identification, measurement, monitoring, and control of wholesale credit risks, ensuring alignment with risk appetite and established risk governance frameworks. 
 - Translate policy and standard requirements into testing strategies and standardized test scripts and support planning efforts to enable efficient and scalable QAR execution. 
 - Prepare high-quality QA deliverables, including QAR workpapers, review summaries, scorecards, and management reports, highlighting key findings, emerging risks, and actionable recommendations. 
 - Generate portfolio-level insights and management information (MI), contributing to governance reporting and enabling informed decision-making by QA leadership. 
 - Track and manage corrective actions and remediation efforts, including follow-ups and validation of issue closure, supported by root cause analysis to minimize recurrence of findings. 
 - Collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders, maintaining strong working relationships to ensure alignment on QA scope, findings, and continuous enhancement of QA frameworks and protocols. 

Qualifications, Certifications And Education

Must-have: 

- CA or Bachelor's/master's degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field
 - 5-7 years of experience in one or more of the following areas: wholesale credit underwriting, credit risk management, loan review, credit quality assurance, or internal audit/assurance covering credit processes
 - Strong understanding of end-to-end wholesale credit risk lifecycle, including underwriting, monitoring, and credit risk governance (policies, standards, and process adherence)
 - Solid knowledge of risk management and control frameworks relating to corporate or counterparty credit risk; exposure to problem credit assessment and risk mitigation is an added advantage
 - Ability to evaluate credit processes and control design, identify quality gaps, and assess effectiveness of controls within a QA or review function
 - Proven capability to review and challenge credit work products, including credit analysis, underwriting rationale, risk identification, and monitoring approach, with clear documentation of QA conclusions
 - Strong written communication skills, with the ability to produce structured QA reports and articulate thematic insights for senior stakeholders
 - Demonstrated experience in cross-functional collaboration, working effectively with 1LoD/2LoD teams and stakeholders to drive issue resolution and continuous improvement
 - Awareness of emerging AI/ML methodologies and their use in credit risk management, QA review, and workflow automation. 
 - Basic AI knowledge, excellent communication, analytical thinking, and problem‐solving skills

Nice to Have Skills: 

- Professional certifications such as CFA, FRM, or equivalent
 - Experience building/testing QA test scripts, review checklists, or testing strategies mapped to policy requirements
 - Exposure to portfolio analytics / sampling / scoping methodology for QA coverage
 - Exposure to data analytics tools, reporting dashboards, or workflow tools
 - Experience in managed services or offshore delivery models
 - Advanced knowledge in AI is good to have. 

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.title: Senior Applied AI Engineer(AI Lead)
data.description:
Key responsibilities
 - Architecture: design a shared AI platform layer for all four products: model access, prompt and version management, retrieval, tool calling, logging and cost tracking. 
 - Model selection: choose and benchmark LLM, speech-to-text and text-to-speech providers on accuracy, latency, cost and data residency in the UAE and KSA. 
 - Evaluation: build automated test suites (evals) with golden datasets, so that every prompt or model change is measured before release. Track hallucination, omission and accuracy rates. 
 - Safety and compliance: put guardrails, redaction of patient data, audit trails and human-in-the-loop review in place, in line with HIPAA, DHA, Saudi PDPL and our SOC 2 and ISO 27001 controls. 
 - Hands-on delivery: write production code in Python and TypeScript for the hardest parts: agent logic, real-time voice and speech pipelines, and EMR integration. 
 - Team leadership: break work into tasks for our developers, review AI-related pull requests, and coach the team on building with LLMs and AI coding tools. 
 - Infrastructure: work with DevOps on deployment, monitoring of AI behaviour, rollback and cost controls on Azure. 
 - Clinical partnership: work with the clinical specialist to turn medical requirements into test cases and rules for the agents. 
 - Customer-facing support: join technical conversations with hospital clients and regulators on how our AI works and how it is validated. Must-have qualifications
 - 6+ years of professional software engineering, including ownership of systems in production. 
 - 2+ years building LLM-powered features that real users rely on in production. Demos and course projects don't count. 
 - Strong Python. Working knowledge of TypeScript and Node. js. 
 - Hands-on with agent design: tool and function calling, structured outputs, multi-step workflows, and handling failures and retries. 
 - Has built retrieval-augmented generation (RAG): chunking, embeddings, vector search (pgvector, Qdrant, Azure AI Search or similar) and checking retrieval quality. 
 - Has designed and run evaluation pipelines (LLM-as-judge, golden sets, regression tests), and can show how they measured output quality. 
 - Experience with at least one major LLM API (Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI or Google) and its tradeoffs on cost, latency and context. 
 - Solid grounding in security and privacy for sensitive data: PII/PHI handling, access control and audit logging. 
 - Clear written and spoken English. Able to explain AI behaviour to hospital IT teams and non-technical executives. Nice to have
 - Real-time voice agents: LiveKit, Pipecat, Vapi, Retell, Twilio or SIP, and tuning latency below 1 second. 
 - Speech recognition and diarization (Whisper, Deepgram, Azure Speech, AssemblyAI), especially for Arabic or medical vocabulary. 
 - Healthcare data standards: FHIR, HL7 v2, ICD-10, CPT and SNOMED CT. 
 - Has shipped an ambient scribe, clinical documentation or medical coding product. 
 - Azure (AKS, Azure OpenAI, AI Search) and observability tools for LLMs (Langfuse, LangSmith, Arize or similar). 
 - MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, or agent frameworks such as the Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph or similar. 
 - Experience leading or mentoring a small engineering team. 
 - Familiar with GCC healthcare regulation (DHA, DoH Abu Dhabi, Saudi MOH, NPHIES).

Job Description

The Associate Information Manager - BIM (Structures) is responsible for leading BIM delivery, digital coordination, information management best practices, and capability development across the Structures business within GCC (India). 

The role supports the delivery of major multidisciplinary projects for the Middle East region while ensuring compliance with WSP BIM standards, ISO 19650 principles, project requirements, and industry best practices. 

Reporting and aligning to the Department Head of BIM - Middle East, the Associate Information Manager - BIM acts as the focal point for all Structure-related BIM activities within GCC, supporting project teams, discipline leaders, and regional BIM leadership in delivering high-quality, coordinated, and information-rich digital outcomes. 

The role is responsible for driving BIM consistency, promoting structured information management, developing team capability, supporting project mobilisation, and advancing digital delivery excellence across the Structures business. 

Responsibilities

BIM & Information Management Leadership

- Act as the BIM and Information Management lead for the Structures business within GCC. 
 - Support the implementation of the Middle East BIM strategy, digital delivery objectives, and information management standards.

 - Promote the consistent application of ISO 19650 principles, BIM standards, workflows, and best practices.

 - Support the Department Head of BIM - Middle East with continuous improvement initiatives, BIM standards development, and implementation of digital delivery processes.

 - Promote best practices in information production, review, approval, and exchange processes.

Technical Expertise

- Provide technical leadership for Structural BIM modelling, coordination, and digital delivery workflows.

 - Support project communication, issue management, and BIM-related stakeholder engagement activities. 

Quality & Risk Management

- Conduct BIM audits, model reviews, and health checks to ensure compliance with project and business requirements. 
 - Monitor adherence to BIM standards, project BIM execution plans, and quality assurance procedures. 
 - Support the implementation of quality control processes for structural BIM deliverables. 
 - Contribute to lessons learned initiatives and continuous improvement activities. 
 - Identify BIM delivery risks and support development of mitigation and corrective action plans. 

Team Leadership & Development

- Provide leadership, mentoring, and technical guidance to BIM Coordinators/ Task team managers, BIM Modellers, and project delivery teams. 
 - Support recruitment, onboarding, and development of BIM resources within GCC. 
 - Deliver BIM training sessions, workshops, and knowledge-sharing initiatives. 
 - Promote collaboration between GCC and Middle East delivery teams. 
 - Support performance management, competency assessments, and development planning. 
 - Assist with resource planning, workload forecasting, and team capacity management. 
 - Support the establishment and monitoring of BIM team performance KPIs. 

Digital Delivery & Continuous Improvements

- Identify opportunities to improve BIM workflows, standards, and delivery efficiency. 
 - Support the enhancement and maintenance of BIM templates, content libraries, and automation tools. 
 - Promote the adoption of emerging digital technologies, automation, and AI-assisted workflows. 
 - Contribute to BIM innovation initiatives and digital transformation programmes. 
 - Support departmental training programmes and capability development activities. 
 - Participate in team-building initiatives and knowledge-sharing forums. 

Qualifications

What You'll Need

Education

- Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, Architectural Engineering, Construction Management, or related discipline. 

Experience

- Minimum 12-15 years' experience within the AEC industry. 
 - Minimum 8 years of BIM leadership experience on major multidisciplinary projects. 
 - Proven experience leading BIM delivery for large-scale structural engineering projects across the Middle East.

Integrate foundation models, customer data sources, APIs and existing applications into cohesive AI experiences. Optimize for latency, reliability, observability, cost and security. 
 - Own production: Take systems from design through production rollout and ongoing operations. Troubleshoot incidents across AI models, distributed systems, data pipelines and application services. Put in place monitoring, evaluations, guardrails, testing, CI/CD, rollback and resiliency mechanisms that keep AI systems healthy at scale.

Python: Strong, production-grade Python: clean code, testing, APIs and integration with enterprise systems. 

Agentic AI on AWS:   Hands-on experience building multi-agent systems on Amazon Bedrock and Bedrock AgentCore, including prompt engineering, tool calling and agent orchestration with a framework (e. g. Strands Agents, LangGraph, LangChain). 

RAG & retrieval: Building retrieval pipelines: embeddings, chunking and vector search (e. g. Bedrock Knowledge Bases, OpenSearch, pgvector). 

Core AWS services: Working knowledge of serverless and container services, storage, security and networking on AWS (e. g. Lambda, API Gateway, ECS/EKS, S3, DynamoDB, IAM).

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
Your role

What You'll Be Doing

Senior Software Engineer

What We Need

Corpay is currently looking to hire a Senior Software Engineer within our Alpha division. 

In this role, you will play a key part in designing, developing, and evolving the cloud-native applications, backend services, and event-driven systems that underpin Corpay's eMoney and FX platforms. Working closely with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, Architects, and cross-functional engineering teams, you will build secure, resilient, and scalable software solutions that support business-critical financial services. 

This team focuses on delivering software that improves operational efficiency, enables business capabilities, and provides reusable technical solutions across the organisation. You'll build applications and services that automate business processes, connect systems through event-driven architectures, and enable engineering teams to deliver scalable, reliable solutions. The systems you develop will play a critical role in enabling and supporting the platforms, workflows, and services that power Corpay's global payments ecosystem. 

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will contribute to architectural decisions, take ownership of complex technical initiatives, mentor other engineers, and champion engineering best practices while remaining hands-on throughout the software development lifecycle. 

At Corpay, we value engineers who are curious, collaborative, and pragmatic problem solvers. We encourage ownership, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing, giving our engineers the opportunity to influence technical decisions while building reliable, scalable software that supports our wider engineering organisation. 

How We Work

As a Senior Software Engineer, Corpay will set you up for success by providing: 

- A collaborative and supportive engineering environment based in our Chennai office
 - Company-issued equipment
 - Formal, hands-on training and onboarding
 - Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development
 - Exposure to modern cloud-native technologies and engineering practices
 - Opportunities to collaborate with globally distributed engineering, product, and architecture teams

Role Responsibilities

The responsibilities of the role will include: 

- Design, develop, and maintain secure, scalable, and highly available cloud-native applications and backend services that support Corpay's eMoney and FX ecosystem. 
 - Design and implement event-driven applications and distributed systems using asynchronous messaging patterns to enable scalable communication and integration between business systems. 
 - Design and develop software solutions using C# and . NET, leveraging AWS, serverless technologies, and modern architectural patterns. 
 - Develop reusable backend services, RESTful APIs, and shared application capabilities that can be leveraged across multiple products and engineering teams. 
 - Design and build software that automates business processes, improves operational efficiency, and enables scalable integration across business platforms. 
 - Collaborate with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, Architects, and engineering teams to analyse business requirements and deliver high-quality technical solutions. 
 - Contribute to the design and evolution of distributed systems, providing input into architecture, scalability, resilience, security, and performance. 
 - Take ownership of technical delivery throughout the software development lifecycle, from solution design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support. 
 - Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code while promoting engineering best practices, secure development principles, and coding standards. 
 - Participate in code reviews, providing constructive feedback and helping maintain high engineering standards across the team. 
 - Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through technical guidance, knowledge sharing, and day-to-day collaboration. 
 - Troubleshoot complex production issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement long-term improvements to system reliability and application performance. 
 - Work closely with DevOps and Infrastructure teams to ensure applications are scalable, observable, and operationally resilient. 
 - Produce and maintain technical documentation, including solution designs, API documentation, and architectural decisions. 
 - Continuously identify opportunities to improve software quality, operational efficiency, engineering processes, and system performance. 
 - Communicate technical solutions and progress effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

Qualifications & Skills

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 
 - Minimum of 8 years of professional software engineering experience designing and building scalable backend systems and cloud-native applications. 
 - Strong experience developing applications using C# and modern . NET. 
 - Strong experience designing cloud-native applications using AWS and serverless architectures. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems, microservices, and event-driven architecture. 
 - Strong experience designing and developing event-driven applications using messaging and event streaming technologies such as Amazon EventBridge, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Amazon SQS/SNS, or similar.

 - Experience building workflow automation, business process orchestration, or event-driven business applications.

 - Good understanding of Kubernetes and modern cloud deployment environments. 
 - Experience implementing monitoring, logging, and observability practices for production systems. 
 - Strong understanding of secure software development principles and cloud security best practices. 
 - Experience designing highly available, resilient, business-critical software systems. 
 - Ability to analyse complex business processes and design scalable software solutions that automate workflows and improve operational efficiency. 
 - Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills. 
 - Strong communication, collaboration, and mentoring skills. 

Nice to Have

- Experience within financial services, payments, banking, or other regulated industries. 
 - Knowledge of Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Clean Architecture, and modern software architecture patterns. 
 - Experience working with distributed caching technologies such as Redis. 
 - Experience contributing to CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery practices.

Corpay is a global technology organization that is leading the future of commercial payments with a culture of innovation that drives us to constantly create new and better ways to pay. Our specialized payment solutions help businesses control, simplify, and secure payment for fuel, general payables, toll and lodging expenses. data.title: Senior Civil Engineer
data.description:
Job Title: Senior Tekla Checker (AISC Standards)

Job Summary

Looking for an experienced Senior Tekla Checker with 8+ years of experience in structural steel detailing and quality checking. 

The candidate should have strong hands-on expertise in Tekla Structures, AISC standards, and US structural steel detailing practices. The role involves thoroughly reviewing Tekla models and structural steel drawings to ensure technical accuracy, constructability, completeness, quality, and compliance with project specifications and client requirements. 

Key Responsibilities

- Review and check Tekla 3D structural steel models for accuracy, completeness, and constructability. 
 - Check GA drawings, assembly drawings, single-part drawings, and erection drawings. 
 - Verify models and drawings against AISC standards, project specifications, engineering drawings, and client requirements. 
 - Identify and report modelling, connection, dimensioning, drawing, and detailing errors. 
 - Review structural steel members, framing, connections, and associated detailing. 
 - Verify coordination between structural/engineering drawings, Tekla models, fabrication requirements, and erection requirements. 
 - Conduct detailed quality checks before project submission. 
 - Review complex structural steel structures and connections. 
 - Provide clear and actionable correction comments to Modelers and Detailers. 
 - Coordinate with Modelers, Detailers, Engineers, Project Managers, and clients to resolve technical issues. 
 - Monitor the quality, consistency, accuracy, and completeness of project deliverables. 
 - Ensure all identified corrections are properly implemented before final submission. 
 - Support project teams in resolving technical and detailing-related issues. 
 - Provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior Checkers and Modelers. 
 - Independently manage assigned checking responsibilities and ensure timely completion of deliverables. Required Skills & Competencies

- 8+ years of experience in structural steel detailing and checking. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Tekla Structures. 
 - Excellent knowledge of AISC standards. 
 - Strong understanding of US structural steel detailing practices. 
 - Knowledge of structural steel members, connections, fabrication, and erection. 
 - Ability to interpret structural, architectural, and engineering drawings. 
 - Experience checking complex structural steel projects. 
 - Strong understanding of constructability and fabrication requirements. 
 - Excellent attention to detail and quality orientation. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. 
 - Good communication and coordination skills. 
 - Ability to independently manage project checking responsibilities. 
 - Ability to identify technical discrepancies and provide effective corrective feedback. Preferred Experience

- Experience working on US-based structural steel projects. 
 - Knowledge of AISC, AWS, and project-specific detailing standards. 
 - Experience checking large and complex commercial or industrial steel structures. 
 - Experience coordinating with US-based clients, engineers, or project teams. 
 - Experience with Tekla model coordination and clash checking. 
 - Experience mentoring or guiding junior Checkers or Detailers. Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be a technically strong and quality-focused professional who can independently review AISC-based structural steel Tekla models and drawings. 

The candidate should be capable of: 

- Identifying technical, modelling, connection, and detailing issues. 
 - Assessing constructability and fabrication requirements. 
 - Coordinating effectively with project stakeholders. 
 - Providing precise and actionable technical feedback. 
 - Ensuring corrections are completed before final submission. 
 - Delivering accurate, complete, constructible, and high-quality project outputs within timelines.

data.title: Senior Analyst, Manufacturing Engineering
data.description:
The Impact You'll Make

As our Senior Analyst, Manufacturing Engineering, you'll play a key role in driving manufacturing excellence by improving process efficiency, product quality, and operational performance to support reliable and sustainable operations. 

You will help improve productivity, reduce waste and downtime, strengthen process capability, and ensure stable manufacturing performance that supports customer delivery and business goals. 

You'll collaborate with Production, Quality, Maintenance, Supply Chain, and Engineering teams while taking ownership of process improvement initiatives, engineering documentation, and operational performance optimization to help us build a more efficient and continuous-improvement-driven future. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Identify, develop, and implement continuous improvement projects to enhance productivity, reduce waste, and optimize machine performance. 
 - Track, analyze, and report actual vs. standard consumption, implementing corrective actions for process deviations. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve process-related issues and align operational objectives. 
 - Develop and maintain PFMEA, Control Plans, Standard Work, and other engineering documentation. 
 - Lead structured problem-solving activities (4Step, 8D, DMAIC) to eliminate chronic defects, improve first-pass yield, strengthen process capability, and reduce variability. 
 - Improve equipment performance, reduce downtime, identify bottlenecks using data analytics, and support smooth production flow and material movement. 
 - Support production planning and scheduling by eliminating constraints and contributing to stable manufacturing performance and customer service objectives. 
 - Drive Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives across operations. 

What We're Looking For

 - Strong hands-on troubleshooting skills with machinery and equipment such as Hydraulic Test Stands and assembly equipment to ensure operational reliability and efficiency. 
 - Experience with PFMEA, Control Plans, SPC, DOE, and structured root-cause analysis methodologies to improve quality and process capability. 
 - Proficiency in CAD, process documentation, and data analysis tools, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams and drive continuous improvement initiatives. 

What You'll Get From Us

- We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities. 
 - You'll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us. 
 - We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

Ready to Make a Difference?

data.title: Software Engineer, Evals
data.description:
About Glean

Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry's most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles. 

At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean's agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry's broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. 

Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World's Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC's Disruptor 50, Bloomberg's AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner's Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1, 000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we're helping the world's largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. 

If you're excited to shape how the world works, you'll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more - deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. 

About The Team

Building a great AI assistant is only half the battle; knowing whether it is actually great is the other half. The Evals & Observability team owns the measurement and quality layer that makes Glean's Assistant and Agents reliably better over time: evaluation pipelines, quality evalsets, LLM-powered judges, agent observability, and the tooling engineers use to understand what changed and why. 

This is a rare opportunity to work at the intersection of distributed systems, data infrastructure, applied AI, and product quality. You will help build the systems that decide whether new models, prompts, retrieval strategies, and agent workflows are ready to ship to enterprise customers. 

About The Role

We are looking for backend and infrastructure engineers in Bangalore to build the platforms that measure, explain, and improve AI quality at scale. You will own core systems for running large-scale evaluations, processing traces, powering observability workflows, and giving engineers clear signals about assistant and agent behavior - including how Glean evaluates frontier model releases and the latest open-source model drops before they shape customer-facing AI experiences. 

This role is ideal for someone who loves building reliable distributed systems, cares deeply about product quality, and wants their infrastructure work to directly shape how AI products are shipped. You will work on systems that need to be scalable, secure, permissions-aware, fast, and cost-efficient. 

You will

- Design and build large-scale evaluation pipelines that measure assistant and agent quality across thousands of real user and synthetic workflows. 
 - Evaluate frontier model releases and the latest OSS model drops, building the infrastructure and quality signals that help Glean understand regressions, tradeoffs, and launch readiness. 
 - Build agent observability infrastructure, including trace enrichment, durable telemetry pipelines, dashboards, and debugging workflows that make AI behavior inspectable. 
 - Own backend systems from architecture and design docs through production rollout, reliability, monitoring, and iteration. 
 - Partner with product, ML, and infrastructure engineers to make evals a first-class part of how Glean ships AI features. 
 - Improve the quality loop by connecting eval results, customer feedback, regression analysis, and engineering workflows into concrete product improvements. 
 - Build systems that balance speed, reliability, enterprise security, and cost across modern cloud-native environments. 
 - Mentor other engineers, raise the bar for technical design, and help shape the engineering culture of Glean's Bangalore AI quality team. 

About You

- You have 6+ years of software engineering experience building backend systems, infrastructure, distributed systems, or data platforms. 
 - You have strong coding skills in Go, Python, Java, C++, or similar languages, with an emphasis on reliability, scale, and well-tested components. 
 - You are comfortable working with distributed data pipelines, production services, observability systems, or cloud-native infrastructure. 
 - You are analytically rigorous and care about whether metrics reflect real user experience, not just whether dashboards look good. 
 - You enjoy customer-focused, cross-functional environments and are willing to take on whatever is most impactful for the company. 
 - You care deeply about quality, both in the systems you build and in the AI product you help measure and improve. 
 - Experience with LLM applications, evals, tracing, data warehouses, workflow orchestration, or ML infrastructure is a strong plus. 

Location: 

- This role is in person in Bangalore, India

Compensation & Benefits

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. 

We are a diverse bunch of people and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. 

AI-First Mindset At Glean

At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today - prior Glean experience isn't required. 

Global Data Privacy Notice For Job Candidates And Applicants

Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), or other privacy laws may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. Our full notice outlining how data will be processed as part of the application procedure for applicable locations is available in our Privacy Policy. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. US applicants and their applications are subject to arbitration of disputes as outlined in our Applicant Arbitration Agreement. 

By clicking "Submit Application, " I confirm that I have read the Global Data Privacy Notice and the Applicant Arbitration Agreement, and I agree to the terms.

data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

Risk Consulting - Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) - Capital, Stress Testing & Credit risk management (FSRM) - Manager

Description

EY's Financial Services Office (FSO) is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. FSO practice provides integrated consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, investment banks, broker-dealers, asset managers (traditional and alternative), insurance and energy trading companies, and the Corporate Treasury functions of leading Fortune 500 Companies. The service offerings provided by FSO Consulting include: market, credit and operational risk management, regulatory consulting, quantitative consulting, structured finance transaction, actuarial consulting, technology enablement, risk and security, program consulting, and process & controls. 

Within EY's Business Consulting Practice, the Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group provides solutions that can help FSO clients to identify, measure, manage and monitor the market (trading book), credit (banking book), operational, and regulatory risks associated with their trading, asset-liability management, capital management and other capital markets activities. 

Role Overview: 

We are seeking experienced Credit Risk and Quality Assurance professionals to join the QA Managed Services team supporting Wholesale Credit Quality Assurance (WCQA) activities, where the role involves: 

- Independently reviewing credit portfolios and assessing underwriting quality in line with regulatory and internal policy expectations
 - Executing end-to-end QA processes within a managed services operating model while ensuring adherence to defined SLAs, quality standards, and governance frameworks
 - Executing and/or leading Quality Assurance Reviews (QARs) and associated testing across credit lifecycle activities
 - Providing credible challenge to underwriters and portfolio teams on credit decisions, documentation quality, and process adherence 
 - Generating thematic, portfolio-level insights beyond case-specific observations to identify operational and control weaknesses, training gaps, and process deficiencies, thereby supporting continuous improvement and strengthening overall credit risk management practices. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Perform periodic Quality Assurance Reviews (QARs) across wholesale lending credit risk activities, including underwriting & credit analysis, credit documentation quality, and overall process adherence. 
 - Assess the accuracy and appropriateness of risk ratings, financial analysis, and credit decisions
 - Deliver consistent, objective assessments using defined QA methodologies, sampling frameworks, and standardized review protocols. 
 - Review credit memos, financial models, covenant structures, and approval workflows
 - Identify and document process gaps, control weaknesses, and quality deficiencies, with a strong focus on thematic trends and systemic issues to drive continuous improvement. 
 - Provide credible challenge to Business/Portfolio Leads and Underwriters on underwriting quality, analytical rigor, and adherence to policies and standards, with appropriate escalation of material issues. 
 - Support the effective identification, measurement, monitoring, and control of wholesale credit risks, ensuring alignment with risk appetite and established risk governance frameworks. 
 - Translate policy and standard requirements into testing strategies and standardized test scripts and support planning efforts to enable efficient and scalable QAR execution. 
 - Prepare high-quality QA deliverables, including QAR workpapers, review summaries, scorecards, and management reports, highlighting key findings, emerging risks, and actionable recommendations. 
 - Generate portfolio-level insights and management information (MI), contributing to governance reporting and enabling informed decision-making by QA leadership. 
 - Track and manage corrective actions and remediation efforts, including follow-ups and validation of issue closure, supported by root cause analysis to minimize recurrence of findings. 
 - Collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders, maintaining strong working relationships to ensure alignment on QA scope, findings, and continuous enhancement of QA frameworks and protocols. 

Qualifications, Certifications And Education

Must-have: 

- CA or Bachelor's/master's degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field
 - 7-10 years of experience in one or more of the following areas: wholesale credit underwriting, credit risk management, loan review, credit quality assurance, or internal audit/assurance covering credit processes
 - Strong understanding of end-to-end wholesale credit risk lifecycle, including underwriting, monitoring, and credit risk governance (policies, standards, and process adherence)
 - Solid knowledge of risk management and control frameworks relating to corporate or counterparty credit risk; exposure to problem credit assessment and risk mitigation is an added advantage
 - Ability to evaluate credit processes and control design, identify quality gaps, and assess effectiveness of controls within a QA or review function
 - Proven capability to review and challenge credit work products, including credit analysis, underwriting rationale, risk identification, and monitoring approach, with clear documentation of QA conclusions
 - Strong written communication skills, with the ability to produce structured QA reports and articulate thematic insights for senior stakeholders
 - Demonstrated experience in cross-functional collaboration, working effectively with 1LoD/2LoD teams and stakeholders to drive issue resolution and continuous improvement
 - Awareness of emerging AI/ML methodologies and their use in credit risk management, QA review, and workflow automation. 
 - Basic AI knowledge, excellent communication, analytical thinking, and problem‐solving skills

Nice to Have Skills: 

- Professional certifications such as CFA, FRM, or equivalent
 - Experience building/testing QA test scripts, review checklists, or testing strategies mapped to policy requirements
 - Exposure to portfolio analytics / sampling / scoping methodology for QA coverage
 - Exposure to data analytics tools, reporting dashboards, or workflow tools
 - Experience in managed services or offshore delivery models
 - Advanced knowledge in AI is good to have. 

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
