data.title: Robotics Engineer (Motion Control)
data.description:
🚀 We're Hiring: Robotics Engineer (Motion Control)
📍Location: Hubli, Karnataka
Experience: 2+ years
Domain: Motion Control | Embedded Firmware | Actuators and Sensors
❗Freshers are not eligible. 
❗Candidates must be willing to relocate. 
About this role
You will own the motion system of a two-axis, remotely operated, stabilised platform for defence use. That covers the software (control loops and real-time firmware) and the hardware (motors, drives, sensors, harnessing) that keep a payload pointed precisely at a target. 
You need working depth in both software and hardware. Core mechanical design is handled by a separate Mechanical Design Engineer. 
This is not a ROS demo or simulation-only role. Your code will drive real motors on hardware that goes to field trials. 

What you'll be doing
Software
Design position, velocity and current control loops and IMU-based stabilisation
Write real-time control firmware in C/C++ on microcontrollers (STM32 or similar)
Implement operator control modes, travel limits and safety interlocks
Take low-latency tracking commands from the vision software and close the loop on them

Hardware
Size and select motors, gearboxes, encoders and brakes against torque, speed, accuracy and weight budgets
Integrate and commission BLDC/PMSM motor drives, IMU and feedback sensors on a two-axis platform
Define wiring harnesses, connectors and power distribution for a battery-powered system
Build test rigs and measure backlash, friction, pointing accuracy and repeatability. 

System
Tune the complete system on real hardware for pointing accuracy and smooth tracking
Support environmental, EMI/EMC and field trials, analyse the logs and fix what they find

Mandatory skills and experience
2+ years of hands-on work on robotic or electromechanical products (robotics, gimbals, drones, automation, EV or defence), covering both firmware and hardware
Software
Embedded C/C++ on microcontrollers, with an RTOS or bare metal
Control fundamentals: PID, cascaded loops, feedforward, and BLDC/PMSM control including FOC
IMUs, encoders and sensor fusion (complementary or Kalman filters)
MATLAB/Simulink or Python for modelling, tuning and test scripts
Hardware
Actuator sizing and selection: BLDC or servo motors, gearboxes, encoders or resolvers
Motor drivers and interfaces: CAN, RS-422/485, SPI, UART
Able to read electrical schematics and mechanical drawings
Comfortable with oscilloscopes, power supplies and data loggers

Good to have
Experience with gimbals, pan-tilt units, antenna positioners, drone flight controllers or robotic arms
Working knowledge of CAD (SolidWorks or similar)
Exposure to ROS 2, MIL-grade harnessing, JSS 55555 or MIL-STD-810

Why join us
Work on real defence hardware that goes to field trials, not demos or PoCs
Own a complete subsystem from design to deployment
Work in a small team directly with mechanical, electronics and software engineers

About Astr Defence
Astr Defence is an award-winning Indian defence manufacturer building next-generation armaments and counter-UAV systems for modern battlefield requirements. 

📩Apply: send your profile to career@astrdefence. com with the subject "Robotics Engineer".

EnCharge AI is building the next generation AI platform. Our novel in-memory-computing architecture delivers a 10x step-function improvement in compute energy efficiency and performance for AI inference workloads. As the demands of artificial intelligence move beyond today's models, we believe fundamental underlying infrastructure must evolve. We serve open-weight models and our own bespoke checkpoints on EnCharge hardware. The models change often, and the harness around them needs to keep up. Overview

WELCOME TO SITA

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry. 

You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2, 500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward-we're proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work® by our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow. 

Are you ready to love your job?

The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA

PURPOSE

We are seeking a highly technical Engineering Manager who has progressed from a Software Developer to Technical Lead and ultimately into Engineering Management. 

This role is not a traditional Project Manager or Scrum Master position. The successful candidate will be expected to actively participate in architecture discussions, influence technical decisions, guide solution design, and lead software engineering teams in delivering high-quality products. 

The Engineering Manager will serve as the technical bridge between Architects, Product Owners, Development Teams, QA, DevOps, and Senior Leadership, ensuring business objectives are translated into scalable and sustainable technical solutions. 

The ideal candidate combines deep software engineering expertise with strong people leadership capabilities and is comfortable challenging technical assumptions, driving technical roadmaps, and influencing architecture decisions.

Technical Leadership & Architecture

- Actively participate in architecture and solution design discussions alongside Enterprise Architects and Technical Architects. 
 - Drive technical decision-making and ensure architectural choices align with product strategy and long-term business objectives. 
 - Review and challenge proposed designs to ensure scalability, maintainability, performance, security, and operational excellence. 
 - Lead technical roadmap definition and execution. 
 - Guide teams in adopting engineering best practices, coding standards, design patterns, and modern development methodologies. 
 - Assess technical feasibility, technical debt, and implementation complexity during planning exercises. 

Engineering Leadership

- Lead and manage cross-functional software engineering teams including Developers, QA Engineers, DevOps Engineers, Technical Leads, and Contractors. 
 - Mentor Technical Leads and Senior Developers on architecture, design, and engineering excellence. 
 - Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, continuous improvement, and technical ownership. 
 - Drive engineering effectiveness through metrics and data-driven decision making. 

Product & Delivery Ownership

- Collaborate closely with Product Owners to translate business goals into technical solutions. 
 - Break product roadmaps into technical epics, features, and user stories. 
 - Ensure user stories are technically sound, properly estimated, and aligned with architectural principles. 
 - Support backlog refinement, sprint planning, PI planning, and prioritization activities. 
 - Drive predictable delivery without compromising technical quality. 

Stakeholder Management

 - Drive adoption of automation, DevOps, observability, and AI engineering tools including GitHub Copilot. 
 - Champion continuous improvement initiatives across development lifecycle processes.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

Essential

- 10+ years of software engineering experience with at least: 
 - 4+ years as a Software Developer / Senior Software Engineer / Technical Lead. 
 - 3+ years leading software engineering teams. 
 - Demonstrated career progression from Software Engineer → Technical Lead → Engineering Manager. 
 - Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale software products. 
 - Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, distributed systems, and cloud-native applications. 
 - Experience leading architecture reviews and technical design workshops. 
 - Hands-on software development background in: 
 - Java and/or . NET ecosystems
 - REST APIs and Microservices
 - Event-driven architectures
 - Cloud Platforms (Azure preferred)
 - Experience with DevOps and CI/CD practices. 

Highly Desirable

- Experience with: 
 - Kubernetes
 - Docker
 - Azure Services
 - Kafka/RabbitMQ
 - API-led integrations
 - React/Angular front-end architectures
 - AI-assisted software development tools (GitHub Copilot)

MUST-HAVE TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES

- Software Architecture
 - Technical Solution Design
 - Domain Driven Design (DDD)
 - Cloud-Native Architecture
 - Microservices Architecture
 - System Integration
 - API Design and Governance
 - DevOps & CI/CD
 - Security by Design
 - Performance & Scalability Engineering
 - Technical Risk Management
 - Engineering Estimation & Planning
 - Technology Roadmap Development

PEOPLE LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES

- Coaching and Mentoring
 - Talent Development
 - Technical Leadership
 - Stakeholder Influence
 - Strategic Thinking
 - Decision Making
 - Communication
 - Conflict Resolution
 - Cross-functional Collaboration

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field. 
 - Cloud certification (Azure/AWS/GCP) , Nice to Have. 
 - TOGAF, Azure Architect, or equivalent architecture certification is nice to have. 
 - Agile certifications are beneficial but not a substitute for strong software engineering experience. 

What We Offer

We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever. 

🏡 Flex Week: Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team's needs)

⏰ Flex Day: Make your workday suit your life and plans.

🌿 Employee Wellbeing: We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health - a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs. 

🚀 Professional Development: Level up your skills with our training platforms, including LinkedIn Learning!

The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it's a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough, " you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called "surges. "  learn more about working at Coinbase. 

  

Staff Software Engineer, Customer Administration

The Customer Administration Engineering (CAE) team is a core pillar of Coinbase's Enterprise Applications and Architecture (EAA) org, responsible for building and operating the secure, foundational platforms that power customer data operations across Coinbase. Our flagship product, Control Center, is Coinbase's secure system of action for internal specialists across CX, Compliance, Legal, Global Investigations, Trust and Risk, and dozens of other teams. It serves approximately 7, 000 internal users via its UI and powers a growing ecosystem of internal tools and AI automation via its backend APIs and MCP. We are at an exciting inflection point: evolving Control Center from a human-specialist UI into a modular, AI-agent-ready operations platform. As a Staff Software Engineer, you will be a technical anchor for the CAE team, driving architectural decisions, mentoring engineers, and leading the delivery of high-impact, cross-cutting platform capabilities. 

What You'll Do

- Architect and deliver foundational platform capabilities including MCP tool registries, AI orchestration layers, risk-based access automation, and the away-team contribution model that enables product groups across Coinbase to build on the platform safely and at speed
 - Drive the evolution of Control Center into an AI-agent-ready, headless operations platform, designing and implementing MCP procedure constructs, agentic guardrails, HITL orchestration, and evaluation frameworks that enable both human and autonomous AI agents to execute sensitive customer operations securely
 - Partner with the Engineering Manager and Product counterparts to define architectural roadmaps, author TDDs, lead design reviews, decompose complex initiatives into deliverable milestones, and raise the engineering quality bar through code review and mentorship
 - Build and maintain highly reliable, secure, distributed backend services, owning SLO definitions, observability instrumentation, incident response, and operational readiness for Tier-1 platform systems
 - Collaborate across EAA engineering teams, Product Engineering, and Security Engineering to deliver cross-functional outcomes and drive shared platform primitives that eliminate duplicated infrastructure across the portfolioRequired Skills and Experience
 - 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with a demonstrated track record of architecting and delivering large-scale, high-traffic distributed systems in production, including deep proficiency in backend service design, API development (gRPC, MCP, GraphQL), and scalable microservices architectures
 - Proven ability to independently lead ambiguous, high-impact technical initiatives from whiteboard to production, writing high-quality, well-tested code and setting the standard for others across complex, multi-team problem spaces
 - Strong experience with cloud-native infrastructure and the modern backend stack: AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, BuildKite/CircleCI, event-driven architectures (Kafka, MQ), distributed caching (Redis/Memcached), and proficiency in SQL and/or NoSQL databases
 - Track record of building secure, compliant internal tools or platforms, with deep appreciation for security controls, access management, audit logging, data governance, and engineering rigor in a regulated financial services environment
 - Experience building or integrating with agentic AI systems, including MCP servers, LLM orchestration layers, RAG pipelines, HITL workflows, or evaluation and guardrail frameworks for production agentic workloads
 - Proficiency in Go (Golang) as a primary backend language, with willingness to work across Python where applicable in the evolving AI stack
 - Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.   Pay Transparency Notice: The target annual base salary for this position can range as detailed below. Total compensation may also include equity and bonus eligibility and benefits (including medical, dental, and vision). 

Annual base salary range (excluding equity and bonus): : ₹9, 424, 500 INR - ₹9, 424, 500 INR

- Application Limit: Candidates may submit a maximum of 3 applications within a 6-month period. 
 - Equal Opportunity Employer: Coinbase is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information. Applicants with criminal histories will be considered consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. 
 - US Applicants: View Employee Rights, Know Your Rights, and E-Verify Notice of Participation. 
 - Accommodations: If you are an individual with a disability who needs a reasonable accommodation, email us your request and contact info at accommodations[at]coinbase. com.   Need screen reading technology? Click here to download a free compatible screen reader and view the tutorial.

Future Talent: ServiceNow Specialist (Talent Community - India)

Location: Bengaluru

Position Type: Future Opening - Talent Pipeline

While we may not have an immediate opening today, this dedicated ServiceNow Talent Community enables us to engage with strong professionals early and connect them with future opportunities. 

By joining our ServiceNow engineering community, you'll gain insights into our technology landscape, platform strategy, engineering culture, and upcoming opportunities, and be among the first candidates considered when relevant roles become available.

Design, Build & Configure

- Design, develop, configure, and enhance solutions on the ServiceNow platform.

What You'll Bring

- Build With Purpose

 - Learn and Be Curious

Why Connect Now?

Priority Consideration

Candidates in this talent community will be considered for upcoming ServiceNow opportunities across Bengaluru and Hyderabad. 

Exclusive Insights

Receive invitations to technology webinars, hiring events, and ServiceNow-focused networking sessions. 

Career Alignment

We will reach out only for opportunities that align with your expertise and career aspirations, whether in development, administration, consulting, architecture, integrations, or platform leadership. 

Career Stage: 

Senior Associate

London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information: 

Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you. 

LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth. 

Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.

Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. 

You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas. We are committed to sustainability across our global business and we are proud to partner with our customers to help them meet their sustainability objectives. Our charity, the LSEG Foundation provides charitable grants to community groups that help people access economic opportunities and build a secure future with financial independence. data.title: Sr Mgr Software Engineering
data.description:
Powering the world's payments ecosystem
ACI powers the payments ecosystem - globally, and you power ACI. You'll innovate, collaborate, and grow - in an energetic technology culture with decades of proven success. ACIers - in all roles and levels - are truly your colleagues and many are your friends. Our size and reach allow you to see the global impact of your work. You are visible, your talents are valued, and you are empowered to shape the future of payments. 
As a Sr Mgr Software Engineering in Pune, you will join a diverse, passionate team, dedicated to powering the world's payments ecosystem!
Role Summary
We are seeking a Sr Mgr Software Engineering to lead a cross-functional team (Software Engineering, DevOps/Platform, Support and Quality Engineering) building and operating a low-latency, high-throughput core banking product platform. You will be accountable for end-to-end delivery: architecture-to-production execution, operational excellence, reliability, security/compliance, and an automation-first quality strategy. You will also bring demonstrated experience delivering AI-enabled initiatives and implementing AI-based solutions in production. 

Key Responsibilities
1) Engineering Leadership & Delivery
- Lead and grow a cross-functional team spanning backend, frontend, DevOps/Platform engineering, and Quality Engineering; drive strong ownership, execution discipline, and continuous improvement. 
- Own delivery for roadmap initiatives and platform modernization across the full SDLC: planning, design, implementation, reviews, testing, release, and production operations. 
- Establish and communicate technical direction in partnership with Product Management and Architecture to ensure the platform meets business goals and non-functional requirements. 
2) Low-Latency, Reliability, and Performance (NFR-First)
- Drive performance and latency engineering: define latency/throughput SLOs, performance budgets, regression testing, and capacity planning to maintain predictable low-latency behavior under load. 
- Build "always-on" operational readiness: observability (logs/metrics/traces), runbooks, safe rollouts (feature flags, progressive delivery), and rapid rollback practices. 
- Partner with Platform/SRE functions to ensure Kubernetes runtime reliability patterns (HA, scaling, and operational tooling) are built into the product delivery lifecycle. , 
3) DevOps / Platform Engineering Ownership
- Lead the team's cloud-native delivery model on Kubernetes (including GitOps-based deployment and configuration-as-code). , 
- Own and evolve CI/CD and artifact practices using technologies such as Ansible, Nexus, Carvel toolchain (e. g. , ytt, kapp-controller), and Kubernetes-native release workflows. 
- Ensure secure, repeatable environment provisioning and reliable deployments across dev/test/stage/prod with automation as the default. 
4) Quality Engineering & Test Automation (Shift-Left)
- Build a "quality-first" culture with an automated testing strategy across unit/integration/e2e, with strong coverage targets and non-negotiable quality gates. 
- Implement and operationalize modern test orchestration and automation tooling, including Testkube, and enforce reliable, maintainable CI test execution. 
- Drive security and compliance testing as part of CI/CD (SAST/DAST/dependency scanning), ensuring regulated-workload readiness and auditability. , 
5) AI-Enabled Engineering & Delivered AI Projects (Must-Have)
- Lead delivery of AI-enabled initiatives in two dimensions: 1. AI-accelerated SDLC (planning, code review, test generation, documentation, defect reduction), and
2. AI/ML/GenAI solution delivery where AI is part of the shipped product or operational capability. , 

- Establish responsible AI usage practices: teams are encouraged to use AI, but remain accountable for outputs; validate correctness, security, and maintainability before merging. 
- Enforce safe prompting and data handling: never place secrets/credentials/PCI/PII into prompts; use placeholders and abstractions. 
6) People Leadership & Stakeholder Management
- Coach engineers, DevOps, and QE leads; build career plans, performance feedback loops, and hiring strategies to raise the talent bar. 
- Collaborate with Product, Security, Compliance, and Operations leaders to deliver outcomes with transparency, predictable execution, and clear metrics. 

Required Qualifications
- 15+ years in software engineering building distributed systems; 5+ years leading teams (engineering + DevOps and/or QE leadership experience strongly preferred). 
- Proven experience building and operating low-latency, high-throughput systems in banking, payments, or other regulated transaction platforms. 
- Hands-on expertise with: - Kubernetes and cloud-native architectures (microservices, containerization, orchestration)
- Java backend development (high-performance, concurrent, resilient services)
- Angular (modern web UI, performance-minded frontend engineering)
- Ansible (automation/configuration management)
- Nexus (artifact repository and dependency management)
- Cloud Infrastructure ( Familiarity with deployment and development on public and private cloud Azure , AWS, OpenShift)
- Carvel toolchain (e. g. , ytt, kapp-controller) for packaging/config/deploy workflows
- Testkube for test orchestration and automation

- Demonstrated delivery of AI projects implemented in real environments (production or production-like), such as: - GenAI-assisted developer workflows with measurable outcomes (quality/velocity/defect reduction), and/or
- AI/ML capabilities embedded into product or operations (e. g. , automated diagnostics, anomaly detection, intelligent triage, or similar). 

- Strong engineering excellence mindset: automated testing, security-by-design, observability, and disciplined release practices. 

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with GitOps and Kubernetes platform components (policy-as-code, secrets management, progressive delivery). , 
- Experience with regulated environments and compliance constraints (PCI/GDPR/SOC2) and integrating security controls into CI/CD. , 
- Experience scaling test automation and implementing testing pyramids and coverage standards across multiple teams. 
- Familiarity with internal developer platform concepts ("golden paths", self-service, reduced cognitive load). 

In return for your expertise, we offer opportunities for growth, career development, and a competitive compensation and benefits package-all within an innovative and collaborative work environment. 
Are you ready to help us transform the payments ecosystem? To learn more about ACI Worldwide, visit our web site at www. aciworldwide. com

data.title: ASIC Methodology, Flow and Integration Engineer
data.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It's a unique legacy of innovation that's fueled by great technology-and amazing people. Today, we're tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what's never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world's best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you'll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. We are now looking for ASIC Flow and Integration Engineer to drive design methodology, automation, and integration for our High Speed IO team. 

What You'll Be Doing

As one of the primary methodology engineer, you'll work across all NVIDIA-delivered projects, owning the integration process and collaborating with global teams to define and implement best-in-class methodologies. You'll operate beyond RTL coding-building infrastructure and systems that are modular, reusable, and easily deployable across diverse silicon platforms. During the course of a project you would end up driving the following aspects of: 

- Own the full-chip and block-level integration process across multiple NVIDIA SoC and GPU projects. 
 - Stitch together RTL units and ensure seamless connectivity, and hierarchy management. 
 - Define and evolve internal design methodologies to improve scalability, quality, and turnaround time. 
 - Build automation pipelines using Python/Perl to streamline integration, debug, and delivery. 
 - Develop modular and reusable systems that can be easily delivered and adapted across different SoC and GPU architectures. 
 - Collaborate extensively with RTL, verification, physical design, and architecture teams to ensure flow compatibility and design readiness. 
 - Drive full-chip debug efforts, connectivity, and functional issues across multiple hierarchies and technology nodes. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement of internal standards and mentor engineers on flow usage and integration practices. 

What We Need To See

- BS or B. Tech or MS or M. tech in EE, ECE, CS, or equivalent degree with 2+ years or more experience in design integration and methodologies for ASIC design. 
 - Comprehensive understanding of IP development flows, build flows is a must
 - Excellent influencing skills resulting in collaboration with cross-cultural, multi geography and matrixed teams
 - Good debugging, analytical and problem solving skills
 - Great interpersonal skills and ability to work as an excellent teammate
 - Working exposure with AI tools like Claude and Cursor would be a plus

We have some of the most brilliant and talented people in the world working for us. If you're creative and independent, with a genuine real passion for technology and improving the state of art, we want to hear from you! Widely considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www. nvidiabenefits. com/

data.title: Software Engineer, Agents
data.description:
About Glean

Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry's most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles. 

At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean's agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry's broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. 

Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World's Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC's Disruptor 50, Bloomberg's AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner's Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1, 000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we're helping the world's largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. 

If you're excited to shape how the world works, you'll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more - deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. 

About The Role

Glean is looking for product engineers to help build the future of AI Agents at work. In this role, you will work across product, AI, and platform to help users build, evaluate, self-improve, deploy, and operate powerful agents inside Glean. This is a highly cross-functional role for engineers who like owning user-facing product experiences end to end while staying close to the underlying systems that make those experiences work. You will help shape how users create agents, how those agents run in auto-mode or independently, how they are evaluated and improved over time, and how we make them reliable, safe, and easy to deploy at scale. The role provides ample opportunities to work on some of the most important challenges in modern AI product development: building intuitive agent-authoring experiences, designing strong eval and feedback loops, enabling self-improvement flows, defining safe and scalable deployment patterns, and making complex agent behavior feel understandable, controllable, and effective for end users. Like the original role, this team values strong technical execution, customer impact, reliability, and thoughtful tradeoffs between speed, quality, and system cost. 

You Will

- Build end-to-end product experiences that help users create and configure AI agents for real work. 
 - Design and ship workflows that help users evaluate agent quality, inspect results, and understand failure modes. 
 - Build product loops that help agents improve over time through feedback, evals, optimization, and self-improvement primitives. 
 - Help users deploy and operate both auto-mode agents and more independent agents with the right guardrails, controls, and visibility. 
 - Work across frontend, backend, prompting, harness behaviour, infrastructure and product systems to turn agent capabilities into polished user experiences. 
 - Partner closely with design, product, research, and go-to-market teams to identify high-value agent use cases and make them successful in practice. 
 - Balance product ambition with engineering rigor, making thoughtful tradeoffs across quality, latency, trust, and cost. 

About You

- BA/BS in computer science, or related degree. 
 - Minimum 6+ years of experience building product software. 
 - Strong coding skills in languages such as Go, Python, Java or Typescript, with an emphasis on building reliable, well-tested systems. 
 - Experience building AI, agentic, workflow, automation, or developer-product experiences is a strong plus. 
 - Strong product sense and comfort working across both user-facing experiences and backend systems. 
 - Leadership skills and past management experience are a bonus. 

Location: 

- This role is in person in Bangalore, India. 

Compensation & Benefits

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. 

We are a diverse bunch of people and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. 

AI-First Mindset At Glean

At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today - prior Glean experience isn't required. 

Global Data Privacy Notice For Job Candidates And Applicants

Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), or other privacy laws may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. Our full notice outlining how data will be processed as part of the application procedure for applicable locations is available in our Privacy Policy. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. US applicants and their applications are subject to arbitration of disputes as outlined in our Applicant Arbitration Agreement. 

By clicking "Submit Application, " I confirm that I have read the Global Data Privacy Notice and the Applicant Arbitration Agreement, and I agree to the terms.

data.title: Senior Manager – Manufacturing Test Operations
data.description:
Job Overview

This is a senior leadership opportunity to drive manufacturing test operations for next-generation semiconductor products across high-performance segments including Cloud, Infrastructure, and Automotive. 

As a Senior Manager, you will lead the definition and execution of test strategy for complex, high-performance SoCs while remaining highly hands-on with Advantest V93K (93K EXA Scale) platforms and SmarTest (SMT7/SMT8) environments. 

A key aspect of this role is end-to-end ownership of manufacturing test, including lab bring-up and infrastructure development from scratch, enabling characterization and production readiness. You will work closely with OSAT partners to ensure smooth production ramp, yield optimization, and operational excellence. 

Key Responsibilities

Test Strategy & Technical Leadership

data.description:
Your role

What You'll Be Doing

Software Engineer

What We Need

Corpay is currently looking to hire a Software Engineer within our Alpha division. 

In this role, you will contribute to the design, development, and enhancement of the cloud-native applications, backend services, and event-driven systems that underpin Corpay's eMoney and FX platforms. Working alongside Senior Software Engineers, Engineering Managers, Architects, Product Managers, and cross-functional engineering teams, you will build secure, scalable, and resilient software solutions that support business-critical financial services. 

This team focuses on delivering software that improves operational efficiency, enables business capabilities, and provides reusable technical solutions across the organisation. You'll develop applications and services that automate business processes, connect systems through event-driven architectures, and enable engineering teams to deliver scalable, reliable solutions. The systems you build will play an important role in enabling the platforms, workflows, and services that power Corpay's global payments ecosystem. 

As a Software Engineer, you will take ownership of delivering high-quality software features, contribute to technical discussions, continuously develop your technical expertise, and work collaboratively with experienced engineers to build reliable, maintainable software solutions. 

At Corpay, we value engineers who are curious, collaborative, and eager to learn. We encourage continuous improvement, ownership, and knowledge sharing, providing opportunities to develop your technical skills while contributing to meaningful engineering challenges. 

How We Work

As a Software Engineer, Corpay will set you up for success by providing: 

- A collaborative and supportive engineering environment based in our Chennai office
 - Company-issued equipment
 - Formal, hands-on training and onboarding
 - Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development
 - Exposure to modern cloud-native technologies and engineering practices
 - Opportunities to collaborate with globally distributed engineering, product, and architecture teams

Role Responsibilities

The responsibilities of the role will include: 

- Design, develop, test, and maintain secure, scalable, and reliable cloud-native applications and backend services. 
 - Develop software solutions using C# and . NET, leveraging AWS, serverless technologies, and modern software development practices. 
 - Contribute to the development of event-driven applications and distributed systems using asynchronous messaging patterns. 
 - Develop backend services, RESTful APIs, and system integrations that support business capabilities across Corpay's platforms. 
 - Build software solutions that automate business processes and improve operational efficiency. 
 - Collaborate with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, Architects, and fellow engineers to understand business requirements and deliver high-quality software solutions. 
 - Contribute to the design and continuous improvement of distributed systems, considering scalability, resilience, maintainability, and security. 
 - Participate throughout the software development lifecycle, from design and implementation through testing, deployment, and production support. 
 - Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code that follows engineering standards and secure development practices. 
 - Participate actively in code reviews, incorporating feedback and contributing constructively to improve overall code quality. 
 - Support troubleshooting and root cause analysis for production issues, implementing improvements where appropriate. 
 - Work collaboratively with DevOps and Infrastructure teams to ensure applications are reliable, observable, and production-ready. 
 - Produce and maintain technical documentation, including API documentation and technical designs. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve software quality, engineering processes, and application performance. 
 - Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

Qualifications & Skills

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 
 - Minimum of 5 years of professional software engineering experience designing and developing backend systems and cloud-native applications. 
 - Experience developing applications using C# and modern . NET. 
 - Experience developing cloud-native applications using AWS and serverless technologies. 
 - Good understanding of distributed systems, microservices, and event-driven architecture. 
 - Experience developing RESTful APIs, backend services, and system integrations. 
 - Experience developing workflow automation, business process orchestration, or event-driven business applications. 
 - Experience working with messaging technologies such as Amazon EventBridge, Amazon SQS/SNS, Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar. 
 - Experience working with relational and NoSQL databases. 
 - Experience using Infrastructure as Code with AWS CloudFormation. 
 - Working knowledge of Kubernetes and containerised application deployments. 
 - Experience implementing logging, monitoring, and observability within production applications. 
 - Understanding of secure software development principles and cloud security best practices. 
 - Ability to understand business processes and develop software solutions that improve operational efficiency. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a willingness to learn from and support other engineers. 

Nice to Have

- Experience within financial services, payments, banking, or other regulated industries. 
 - Familiarity with Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Clean Architecture, and modern software architecture patterns. 
 - Experience contributing to CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery practices. 
 - Experience working with distributed caching technologies such as Redis. 

Benefits & Perks

- Earned leave, sick leave, casual leave, national holidays, maternity, paternity, bereavement, and adoption/surrogacy leave. 
 - Group medical insurance for employees and eligible dependents. 
 - Personal accident insurance. 
 - Wellness allowance and annual health check-ups for employees and their families. 
 - Broadband reimbursement and meal card support. 
 - Commuting allowance. 
 - Provident Fund, Voluntary Provident Fund, Gratuity, and Pension benefits. 
 - Opportunities to participate in philanthropic initiatives. 
 - Inclusive workplace culture with employee engagement activities and company events. 

About Corpay

About Corpay

Corpay is a global technology organization that is leading the future of commercial payments with a culture of innovation that drives us to constantly create new and better ways to pay. Our specialized payment solutions help businesses control, simplify, and secure payment for fuel, general payables, toll and lodging expenses. Millions of people in over 80 countries around the world use our solutions for their payments. 

At Corpay, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful workplace where employees are valued for their diverse perspectives, experiences, and contributions. We believe that diversity, equity, and inclusion strengthen our teams, drive innovation, and support our continued success globally. 

As part of our hiring process, offers of employment may be subject to the successful completion of pre-employment screening conducted by an authorized third-party provider, in accordance with applicable laws and Corpay policies. Screening requirements may include employment references, identity verification, criminal record checks, financial or sanctions screening, and other background checks relevant to the role and permitted by local law. 

Notice to Recruitment Agencies and Search Firms: Corpay does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies or search firms without a valid written agreement in place. Any unsolicited candidate submissions will become the property of Corpay, and no fees will be paid related to such submissions. 

Learn more about Corpay: https: //www. corpay. com

Transparency & Compliance

Equal Opportunity Employer

Corpay is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, marital status, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Corpay is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where individuals are respected and valued for their diverse perspectives, experiences, and contributions. If you require reasonable accommodation during any part of the application or interview process, please notify a representative of the Human Resources Department. 

Use of Artificial Intelligence in Hiring

Corpay may use artificial intelligence (AI) and other technology-enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process, such as application screening, candidate assessment, or interview scheduling. These tools are designed to enhance efficiency, consistency, and fairness throughout the hiring process. AI tools do not make final hiring decisions. All employment decisions involve human review. Corpay is committed to the responsible use of AI, including appropriate oversight and safeguards designed to support fair and unbiased outcomes. 

Candidate Privacy Notice

For information about how Corpay processes personal information during the recruitment process, please review our Candidate Privacy Notice: https: //www. corpay. com/privacy-policy. 

Pay Philosophy

Corpay is committed to fair, equitable, and transparent compensation practices. Compensation decisions are based on objective, job-related factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and market benchmarks. Where required by applicable law, salary or compensation ranges will be included in the job posting or provided prior to the interview process, where required by applicable law. Additional compensation elements such as bonuses, incentives, benefits, or variable pay may apply where applicable.

We are looking for a Jr. ServiceNow HRSD Developer to join FME's Enterprise Tools team and support our HRSD implementation alongside the HRSD Team. Fresenius Medical Care is a global leader in renal care products and services, dedicated to improving patient quality of life. Our Enterprise Tools team owns the ServiceNow platform and is undertaking a major HRSD implementation to replace the legacy Dovetail case management system with a modern, scalable, employee-centric HR service delivery platform. 

The HRSD program covers: Case Management, Employee Relations, Employee Center Pro, HR Agent Workspace, Employee Document Management (replacing PeopleDoc and OnBase), Knowledge Management (with SharePoint external source), Universal Requests, Workday HCM integration, Internationalization (3 languages), Dynamic Translations, Data Migration from Dovetail, and OCM.

 - Support Internationalization: assist with localization property setup, field/label export preparation, and import of translated values.

Testing, Migration & Quality

- Execute unit testing on all assigned configurations and document results against sprint acceptance criteria. 
 - Assist in building and running ATF test scripts for HRSD configurations. 
 - Support data migration activities: assist with Dovetail case migration template validation, field mapping review, and import staging/validation under Sr. Developer oversight. 
 - Assist with EDM Bulk Document Import staging: validate file sizes, naming conventions, and metadata from PeopleDoc and OnBase source systems. 
 - Log, track, and retest defects during UAT cycles; assist Sr. Developer with defect remediation tasks. 
 - Maintain configuration documentation, sprint notes, and technical runbook updates. 

Collaboration

 - Assist with update set preparation and environment promotions (Dev → Test → Prod)

data.title: Sr. ML Engineer - Consultant
data.description:
About Ushak Kaal

Ushak Kaal Communications Limited is a technology company that builds and runs applied AI systems for businesses. We work with clients to put AI agents into real customer conversations and make them measurably better over time. 

The Role

We are hiring one hands-on senior engineer to build a shared brain for our AI agents across texting, calling and email. It should remember past lessons, use our team's feedback, and steadily improve how conversations turn into bookings. 

The Problem Today

When an agent makes a mistake, we capture the conversation and edit its instructions by hand. Those fixes don't last or carry across channels. We need every correction to become a lasting lesson that guides future texts, calls and emails. 

Customer accounts stay in the existing CRM. This project reads from it and adds a memory of lessons learned on top. 

What You Will Build

The system should work like coaching a new employee: show it what went wrong, explain what to do instead, save the lesson, and check that it handles similar situations better next time. 

- Capture every conversation. This covers text messages, email threads, call transcripts and relevant call audio, plus confirmed bookings and every point where a person had to step in. 
 - Set goals and rules per channel. Define what good looks like for text, calls and email, including correct pricing, valid bookings and appropriate call handling. 
 - Review conversations automatically. Check them against those rules, flag likely problems, and give our team a simple way to mark what was right or wrong. 
 - Store approved corrections as lessons. Each lesson holds the situation, the better response or action, the reason, and which channels it applies to. 
 - Apply lessons in live conversations. Use relevant lessons in future texts, calls and emails, share them across channels where they fit, keep channel-specific guidance separate, and always use current business and pricing information. 
 - Test before release. Run changes against past mistakes and new situations in all three channels, compare results with the current agent, and keep a one-step way to roll back. 

How Success Is Measured

Success means more confirmed bookings and fewer repeated mistakes across all three channels, measured against today's starting results. 

- Booking rate: the share of conversations that end in a confirmed booking. 
 - Repeated mistakes: how often an error that already has a lesson happens again. 
 - Human intervention: routine conversations run with zero hand-holding, and exceptions hand off cleanly to a person. 
 - Accuracy: correct pricing, valid bookings and appropriate call handling. 

Who We Are Looking For

We want a senior AI or machine learning engineer who has shipped AI agents used by real customers and can write the software behind them. You will own this system and work with the existing engineering team to connect it to our live agents. 

Must Have

- Hands-on experience connecting AI models to texting, calling and email systems, including OpenAI APIs and live voice agents. 
 - Experience storing lessons or feedback and testing improvements against human judgement. 
 - Strong Python or TypeScript, plus solid database skills. 
 - Ability to build a simple internal screen where the team reviews mistakes and enters corrections. 
 - Clear communication, with real examples of improving a live AI agent using feedback and measurable results. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with booking, scheduling or sales-conversion flows. 
 - Familiarity with CRM integrations and consumer-facing service businesses.

Fandoro is building technology for responsible businesses and investors. 

Our platform brings together ESG data, sustainability frameworks, climate intelligence, risk assessment and workflows to help businesses and capital allocators make better decisions. 

We are now building the next layer of Fandoro: a proprietary ESG Intelligence Engine that combines our domain knowledge and data with AI, machine learning and LLM technologies. 

This is an opportunity to join Fandoro at an early stage of that journey and play a foundational role in shaping the technology. 

The Role

We are looking for a hands-on AI & Data Lead who can architect and build Fandoro's AI and data layer. 

This is not a traditional Data Scientist role and it is not simply an "LLM Engineer" role. 

We are looking for someone who can work across: 

Data → ML → ESG intelligence → LLM/RAG → AI agents → APIs → production systems

You will work closely with the Founder/CEO and the ESG domain team to convert Fandoro's proprietary ESG knowledge and data into scalable intelligence products. 

What you will own

* Design Fandoro's ESG data and intelligence architecture

* Build the foundations of our proprietary ESG Intelligence Engine

* Develop ESG scoring, risk and benchmarking models

* Design data pipelines for structured and unstructured ESG data

* Build RAG and knowledge systems over ESG regulations, frameworks, methodologies and company data

* Work with embeddings, vector databases and knowledge graphs where appropriate

* Build and evaluate LLM-powered applications and agents

* Develop AI workflows for use cases such as ESG due diligence, BRSR, materiality, climate risk and ESG remediation

* Establish model evaluation, accuracy and hallucination-control mechanisms

* Design APIs and services that expose AI capabilities to the Fandoro platform

* Decide when to use foundation models, fine-tuning, RAG or traditional ML

* Establish good practices around AI security, governance and responsible AI

* Work with the engineering team to take prototypes into production

* Build systems that can progressively learn from Fandoro's proprietary data

The technology stack may include

Python | SQL | PostgreSQL | FastAPI | Pandas | scikit-learn | PyTorch | LLM APIs | RAG | Embeddings | Vector databases / pgvector | Knowledge graphs | Cloud | REST APIs

You do not need to know every technology listed above. 

What matters is that you are a strong builder who can learn quickly and make good architectural decisions. 

What we're looking for

* 5-10 years of strong software/data/ML experience

* Strong Python and SQL

* Hands-on experience building production ML or AI systems

* Strong understanding of LLMs and modern GenAI architectures

* Experience with RAG, embeddings and vector databases

* Experience designing data pipelines and data models

* Strong understanding of APIs and backend systems

* Ability to take an idea from problem → architecture → prototype → production

* Strong engineering fundamentals

* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

* Curiosity and willingness to understand ESG/business problems deeply

A major plus

Experience with any of the following: 

* ESG / sustainability

* Climate / climate risk

* Financial services

* Risk modelling

* Knowledge graphs

* Enterprise SaaS

* Responsible AI

* Regulatory intelligence

* Document intelligence

* B2B AI products

What this role is NOT

This role is not for someone who: 

* Only wants to work on research

* Only builds notebooks and models without productionising them

* Has only worked with prompt engineering

* Expects a large engineering team around them

* Needs detailed specifications for every task

We are building a small, high-performance technology team. 

You will have significant ownership. 

Why join Fandoro?

You will have the opportunity to build an AI system around a domain that is becoming increasingly important globally: 

responsible business + capital + sustainability + AI. 

You will work directly with the founder and ESG experts and have the opportunity to shape: 

* The data architecture

* The ESG intelligence methodology

* The AI architecture

* The product roadmap

* The technology stack

* Fandoro's long-term technology/IP moat

Compensation

Industry best standards will be met. 

How to apply

Please send: 

1. Your CV/LinkedIn profile

2. 2-3 examples of AI/data products you have actually built

3. GitHub or relevant work, if available

4. A short note answering: 

"If you were building an ESG Intelligence Engine for investors and businesses, what would you build first and why?"

We care more about what you have built and how you think than the number of certifications on your CV.

data.description:
Full-Stack Product Engineer - Founding Technology Team

Location: Delhi NCR / Hybrid

Experience: 4-8 years

Employment: Full-time

Company: Fandoro Technologies Pvt. Ltd. 

About Fandoro

Fandoro is building technology for responsible businesses and investors. 

Our SaaS platform brings together ESG data, sustainability reporting, risk assessment, climate intelligence and workflows to help businesses and capital allocators make better decisions. 

We are now expanding the platform with a new AI and data layer. 

We are looking for a hands-on Full-Stack Product Engineer to become one of the core members of our technology team. 

The Role

You will own a large part of the actual Fandoro product-from database and APIs to dashboards and user experience. 

This is not a narrowly defined frontend or backend position. 

We want a strong product engineer who can move comfortably between: 

Backend → Database → APIs → AI integrations → Frontend → Deployment

You will work closely with the AI/Data Lead and Founder to turn product ideas into production software. 

What you will build

* Fandoro's web application and dashboards

* ESG data collection and management workflows

* Investor and portfolio dashboards

* ESG scoring and risk interfaces

* ESG CAP/remediation workflows

* Reporting workflows

* AI-powered product experiences

* APIs and third-party integrations

* User authentication and role-based permissions

* Maker-checker and approval workflows

* Document upload and processing workflows

* Admin interfaces

* Notifications and workflow automation

* Integrations with external data and climate APIs

Technology

Our preferred stack is approximately: 

Frontend

* React

* Next. js

* TypeScript

* Modern component libraries

Backend

* Python

* FastAPI

* REST APIs

Database

* PostgreSQL

* Redis where appropriate

* Vector databases / pgvector where appropriate

Infrastructure

* Cloud deployment

* Docker

* CI/CD

* Monitoring and logging

The exact stack is open to discussion. 

We care more about engineering judgement and ability to ship than familiarity with one particular framework. 

What we're looking for

* 4-8 years of software engineering experience

* Strong experience building web applications

* Strong backend fundamentals

* Good React/TypeScript experience

* Strong Python or willingness to work extensively with Python

* Experience with REST APIs

* Strong SQL/PostgreSQL knowledge

* Understanding of authentication, permissions and application security

* Experience integrating third-party APIs

* Ability to work with AI/LLM APIs

* Good understanding of cloud deployment

* Ability to take a feature from idea → design → development → testing → deployment

You should be comfortable doing this

A product requirement comes in: 

"We want an investor to see the ESG risk of all companies in their portfolio and drill down into the reasons. "

You should be able to think through: 

Database → API → business logic → AI integration → dashboard → permissions → deployment

without needing five different people to make it happen. 

A major plus

Experience with: 

* B2B SaaS

* ESG / sustainability

* FinTech / financial services

* Data-heavy applications

* AI products

* Analytics dashboards

* Workflow platforms

* Document processing

* Enterprise integrations

What this role is NOT

This is not a role for someone who wants to work exclusively on: 

* Frontend UI

* Backend APIs

* A single microservice

* Maintaining an existing codebase

You will be part of a very small founding technology team. 

You will have significant ownership and influence over the product and architecture. 

The kind of person who will thrive here

You are: 

* A builder

* Curious

* Comfortable with ambiguity

* Product-minded

* Able to make decisions independently

* Comfortable learning new technologies

* Interested in AI, not just traditional software development

* Excited by the opportunity to build something from an early stage

Compensation

We will meet the industry standards. 

How to apply

Please send: 

1. Your CV/LinkedIn profile

2. Links to 2-3 products you have built

3. GitHub, if available

4. A short note answering: 

"If you joined Fandoro tomorrow, what would you look at first in our technology architecture before building new features?"

We care more about what you have built, how you think and how independently you can operate than about certifications.

It's a challenge to deliver trustworthy and inspiring content in the moments that matter most during the discovery and purchase cycle. The result? Time and money spent on content that doesn't attract new consumers, convert them, or earn their long-term loyalty. 

Our brand promise : closing the gap between brands and consumers. 

Founded in 2005, Bazaarvoice is headquartered in Austin, Texas with offices in North America, Europe, Asia and Australia. 

It's official: Bazaarvoice is a Great Place to Work in the US , Australia, India, Lithuania, France, Germany and the UK!

About The Team

We are building our next-generation Data Enrichment Platform and we need a heavy hitter to help us scale. We aren't just moving data; we are building the real-time engine that powers our business. 

As a core member of our engineering team, you will architect high-throughput pipelines, solve complex latency challenges, and define the standards for a robust "Lakehouse" architecture. If you obsess over JVM internals, distributed consistency, and Exactly-Once semantics, this is the role for you. 

How You'll Make An Impact

Architect at Scale: Lead the design of distributed streaming architectures using Kafka Streams, Spark, and Flink. You will build the roadmap for our transition to a robust Lakehouse architecture. 

Performance Tuning: Dive deep into the system to identify bottlenecks. You will own the stability of pipelines processing massive events per second, solving for data integrity and low latency. 

Quality by Design: Set the engineering standard. You will drive a culture of reliability through robust monitoring (Datadog/Prometheus), observability, and automated testing frameworks. 

Modernization: proactively identify opportunities to refactor and modernize the platform for maximum efficiency and cost-effectiveness. 

The Must Have Skills

Veteran Engineer: 8+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 5 years of deep production expertise in Scala or Java (concurrency, memory management, GC tuning). Deep JVM knowledge required. 

Streaming Expert: 5+ years hands-on with the Kafka ecosystem. You understand offsets, partitions, rebalancing, and state stores intimately. Apache Kafka, Kafka Streams, Kafka Connect, Flink, Spark. 

Data Architect: You have a proven track record of designing systems that remain resilient under heavy load. You understand the trade-offs between consistency models and storage formats. 

AWS Native: Mastery of the AWS ecosystem (handling TBs of data) is second nature to you. AWS (MSK, EMR, Athena, Lambda), Terraform, Kubernetes. 

Why You'll Love Working with Us?

Work with cutting-edge technology in a collaborative, global team

Competitive salary + good benefits (insurance, annual leave, bonuses, referral rewards, and more). 

We're Great Place to Work Certified (4 years in a row!). 

Hybrid work model (3 days in office - Prestige Tech Pacific). 

Interview Process

Tech Round 1: Coding interview with our team. 

Tech Round 2: System design discussion. 

Hiring Manager Meeting: Team, values & culture check. 

Leadership: AI & Solution design discussion

Final Round: Chat with HR/Senior Leadership. 

If this sounds like you, let's talk

Why join Bazaarvoice?

Customer is key

We see our own success through our customers' outcomes. 

We approach every situation with a customer first mindset. 

Transparency & Integrity Builds Trust

We believe in the power of authentic feedback because it's in our DNA. 

We do the right thing when faced with hard choices. Transparency and trust accelerate our collective performance. 

Passionate Pursuit of Performance

Our energy is contagious, because we hire for passion, drive & curiosity. 

We love what we do, and because we're laser focused on our mission. 

Innovation over Imitation

We seek to innovate as we are not content with the status quo. 

We embrace agility and experimentation as an advantage. 

Stronger Together

We bring our whole selves to the mission and find value in diverse perspectives. 

We champion what's best for Bazaarvoice before individuals or teams. 

As a stronger company we build a stronger community. 

Discover Life at Bazaarvoice

Regional Teams: Visit our APAC Life Page to see what life is like in our local offices.

data.description:
Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world-leading MCUs, SoCs, analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world's leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you. 

Renesas employs roughly 21, 000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what's next in electronics and the world. 

Job Description

In this role, you will lead the definition and execution of AI/ML-driven initiatives, drive adoption of ML/AI across frontend and backend design and development flows across the company, enable next-generation intelligent design automation capabilities, and collaborate with cross-functional leaders to integrate AI into engineering productivity, automation, and decision-making processes. 

Job Responsibilities

- Define and own the AI/ML strategy for Engineering group's software and design flows
 - Lead the transformation of semiconductor design workflows by deploying AI-driven (agentic) solutions across Frontend (modelling, synthesis, optimization) and Backend (place-and-route, timing closure, physical optimization)
 - Drive end-to-end integration of AI into engineering toolchains
 - Establish scalable frameworks for: 
 - Data collection, labelling, and pipeline management
 - Model training/fine tuning, validation, and deployment
 - Lead cross-functional collaboration with: 
 - EDA, design, architecture, and platform teams
 - External vendors and partners as needed
 - Build and grow a high-performance engineering team
 - Define KPIs to measure productivity gains, quality improvements, and ROI from AI initiatives
 - Ensure alignment with enterprise AI programs and governance frameworks
 - Drive continuous innovation and adoption of emerging AI/ML technologies in semiconductor workflows

Qualifications

- MTech/BTech in EE/CS with 20+ years of software development experience and 10+ years of engineering management experience (including leading managers or large teams)
 - 7+ years in semiconductor and/or EDA industry
 - Proven experience in Applying ML/AI to real-world engineering or automation problems
 - Proven experience building and scaling AI/ML platforms leveraging technologies such as LangChain, vector databases, and RAG-based architectures
 - Deep understanding of LLM ecosystems, including embeddings, knowledge retrieval, and integration of AI agents into production workflows
 - Strong understanding of software architecture, distributed systems, Data pipelines and ML workflows
 - Demonstrated ability to Lead cross-functional initiatives and translate business/engineering needs into technical solutions
 - Should have exposure to quality processes for project execution, delivery, and working with multiple teams across geos
 - Strong communication skills for executive-level engagement
 - Preferred Hands-on experience with EDA tools, chip design flows, or semiconductor development lifecycle
 - Prior Hands-on experience with AI/ML frameworks (e. g. , TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar) is a plus
 - Prior experience building AI-driven solutions for Design optimization and Automation/ productivity improvement is preferred
 - Familiarity with Cloud platforms and scalable compute infrastructure and Data-driven decision systems is preferred

Additional Information

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose 'To Make Our Lives Easier. ' As the industry's leading expert in embedded processing with unmatched quality and system-level know-how, we have evolved to provide scalable and comprehensive semiconductor solutions for automotive, industrial, infrastructure, and IoT industries based on the broadest product portfolio, including High Performance Computing, Embedded Processing, Analog & Connectivity, and Power. 

With a diverse team of over 21, 000 professionals in more than 30 countries, we continue to expand our boundaries to offer enhanced user experiences through digitalization and usher into a new era of innovation. We design and develop sustainable, power-efficient solutions today that help people and communities thrive tomorrow, 'To Make Our Lives Easier. '

At Renesas, you can: 

- Launch and advance your career in technical and business roles across four Product Groups and various corporate functions. You will have the opportunities to explore our hardware and software capabilities and try new things. 
 - Make a real impact by developing innovative products and solutions to meet our global customers' evolving needs and help make people's lives easier, safe and secure. 
 - Maximize your performance and wellbeing in our flexible and inclusive work environment. Our people-first culture and global support system, including the remote work option and Employee Resource Groups, will help you excel from the first day. Are you ready to own your success and make your mark?

data.description:
Company Description

ComplianceMedQRA provides regulatory and quality consulting services to medical device, software, pharmaceutical, and life sciences organizations across the full product lifecycle, from early regulatory strategy to market authorization and post-market compliance. The team's expertise covers EU MDR, IVDR, FDA pathways, SaMD, AI-enabled medical devices, and GCC/UAE frameworks, including MOHAP/EDE, UAE PDPL, and healthcare data security requirements. The company also offers QraOne, an AI-enabled eQMS platform designed for MedTech, SaMD, IVD, and life sciences organizations, translating regulatory and quality experience into automated workflows that streamline compliance and improve audit readiness across EU, U. S. , and GCC regulations. 

Role Description

We are looking for a hands-on Software Development Team Lead to lead and contribute directly to the development of a SaaS-based software platform. It is not a purely managerial role. The successful candidate must be a strong full-stack developer who is comfortable actively coding, designing solutions, troubleshooting complex technical issues, and building key parts of the platform while also coordinating and supporting the development team. You will take ownership of day-to-day software development activities, help translate product requirements into technical solutions, coordinate development priorities, review code, support releases, and ensure that the platform remains secure, scalable, reliable, and maintainable. You will also work closely with product, QA/RA, Sales, and Customer-facing teams to understand business and customer requirements, evaluate feedback, and prioritize product improvements. Experience developing SaaS platforms, document management systems, workflow applications, eQMS platforms, compliance software, enterprise management systems, or similar business applications would be a strong advantage. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and coordinate the software development team while remaining hands-on with coding and technical implementation. 
 - Develop, maintain, and improve both frontend and backend functionality. 
 - Contribute to system architecture, technical planning, and key development decisions. 
 - Translate product and business requirements into clear technical tasks, priorities, and development plans. 
 - Review code, troubleshoot technical issues, and provide guidance and support to other developers. 
 - Develop and maintain APIs, databases, integrations, authentication, user roles and permissions, workflows, and document management functionality. 
 - Support the development of AI-enabled features, including LLM and RAG-based integrations. 
 - Work closely with Sales and Customer teams to understand customer needs, gather feedback, and prioritize product improvements and development requests. 
 - Coordinate testing, bug fixing, deployments, releases, and continuous platform improvements. 
 - Support and improve DevOps and CI/CD processes. 
 - Ensure the platform remains secure, reliable, scalable, and maintainable. 
 - Take ownership of technical delivery, track development progress, and communicate key risks, blockers, or delays. 

Qualifications and Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field. 
 - Minimum 5 years of professional software development experience, including at least 1-2 years in a technical lead or software development team leadership role. 
 - Strong hands-on full-stack development experience. 
 - Experience managing and coordinating software development projects, priorities, and releases. 
 - Experience with modern web applications, APIs, databases, Git, and cloud-based deployment. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to independently troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues. 
 - Good communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical teams. 

Preferred Technical Skills

- Experience with some of the following technologies and areas would be an advantage: AI/LLM/RAG: LLM integrations, RAG-based applications, AI APIs
 - Frontend: React. js, Next. js, JavaScript, TypeScript
 - Backend: Python, Django, FastAPI, Node. js
 - Database: PostgreSQL
 - Cloud: AWS or similar cloud platforms
 - DevOps: Git, CI/CD, Docker, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Kubernetes
 - Testing: Pytest, Jest, Cypress, Playwright, or similar testing frameworks
 - Experience in healthcare, MedTech, life sciences, or other regulated industries would be an advantage, but is not required. 

Language

Excellent command of English, both written and spoken. Knowledge of additional languages is an advantage. 

Location

Remote - preference for candidates based in India, Nepal, or elsewhere in South Asia. Candidates from other locations are also encouraged to apply. 

Please note: This role requires full professional commitment and availability. It is not suitable for freelancers or consultants. 

Interested?

Apply via LinkedIn or send your CV to info@compliancemedqra. net
