data.title: Staff Design Verification Engineer
data.description:
About Analog Devices

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www. analog. com and on LinkedIn and X. 

Staff Design Verification Engineer

About The Role

As a Staff Design Verification Engineer at Analog Devices, you will provide technical leadership in developing verification strategies for our most complex analog and mixed-signal designs. You'll architect sophisticated verification environments, mentor junior engineers, and collaborate across organizational boundaries to ensure product quality and reliability. 

Working with limited direction, you'll apply your deep technical expertise to solve critical verification challenges while representing ADI in interactions with key customers and industry partners. This senior position involves significant influence on verification methodology adoption and technical decisions that impact crucial organizational objectives. 

Key Responsibilities

- Strategic Leadership: Architect and lead verification strategy for complex digital and mixed-signal designs, acting as a key contributor in critical verification environments
 - Verification Architecture: Design and implement sophisticated UVM-based verification environments that ensure comprehensive test coverage and design quality
 - Technical Mentorship: Guide and develop junior engineers, serving as a resource for colleagues with less experience while modeling professional behaviors
 - Cross-Functional Direction: Coordinate work across organizational lines, collaborating with design teams on verification requirements and sign-off criteria
 - Problem Resolution: Lead complex debugging efforts across RTL and gate-level simulations with minimal direction, developing resolutions that require in-depth analysis
 - Coverage Closure: Drive functional and code coverage closure using advanced verification methodologies to ensure design accuracy
 - Post-Silicon Support: Lead post-silicon validation activities, contributing expertise to address critical issues
 - Customer Representation: Serve as principal customer contact on projects, representing ADI's technical excellence and customer commitment

Must Have Skills

- SystemVerilog and UVM Expertise: Expert-level knowledge of SystemVerilog and Universal Verification Methodology for architecting advanced verification environments for complex designs
 - Test Planning and Strategy: Demonstrated ability to develop comprehensive verification plans that drive coverage-driven methodologies and verification closure
 - Mixed-Signal Verification: Deep understanding of mixed-signal design principles and verification methodologies, with experience implementing sophisticated verification approaches
 - Debugging Mastery: Advanced debugging skills across multiple design abstractions, with proven ability to resolve complex verification issues with minimal direction
 - EDA Tool Proficiency: Extensive experience with electronic design automation tools (Cadence/Synopsys) and formal verification techniques
 - Scripting and Automation: Advanced proficiency in Python, Perl, TCL, or Shell scripting for creating sophisticated verification automation frameworks
 - Technical Leadership: Demonstrated ability to influence verification direction, mentor junior engineers, and drive methodology adoption across teams

Preferred Education And Experience

- MS/PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
 - 7-10+ years of relevant digital design verification experience, with particular emphasis on mixed-signal verification

Why You'll Love Working Here

At Analog Devices, you'll be part of a collaborative and innovative team that's shaping the future of technology. We offer a supportive environment focused on professional growth, competitive compensation and benefits, work-life balance, and the opportunity to work on cutting-edge projects that make a real impact on the world. 

Your expertise will shape the future of technology, and you'll be supported by a culture that values continuous advancement and professional growth. Join us and help create the technologies that bridge the physical and digital worlds, making a tangible difference in how people live, work, and connect.

Department of Commerce - Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U. S. Department of State - Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. As such, applicants for this position - except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U. S. C. 1324b(a)(3) - may have to go through an export licensing review process. 

Analog Devices is an equal opportunity employer. We foster a culture where everyone has an opportunity to succeed regardless of their race, color, religion, age, ancestry, national origin, social or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, parental status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, union membership, and political affiliation, or any other legally protected group. 

Job Req Type: Experienced

Required Travel: Yes, 10% of the time

Shift Type: 1st Shift/Days

Principal Research Engineer, Applied AI

www. enchargeai. com

About EnCharge AI: 

EnCharge AI is building the next generation AI platform. Our novel in-memory-computing architecture delivers a 10x step-function improvement in compute energy efficiency and performance for AI inference workloads. As the demands of artificial intelligence move beyond today's models, we believe fundamental underlying infrastructure must evolve. We are an experienced team of AI researchers, silicon & systems engineers, and architects backed by leading investors, poised to become the essential platform for the next wave of AI innovation. 

The Opportunity: 

Modern AI workloads-from large language models to diffusion-based generators to multimodal systems-represent some of the most compute-intensive frontiers in AI, and some of the most promising applications for our hardware's energy efficiency advantages. We're building a vertically integrated AI stack that will showcase the transformative potential of our silicon while delivering real value to customers today. 

We are seeking a Research Engineer to push the boundaries of AI model capability, quality, and efficiency. You'll build fine-tuning and post training pipelines, develop rigorous benchmarking frameworks, and work at the intersection of ML research and hardware-aware optimization-ensuring our models run beautifully on our silicon. 

This is a role for someone who thrives at the boundary between research and engineering. You'll read papers, implement techniques, and ship production-quality code-all in service of making AI inference faster, cheaper, and better. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Algorithmic Acceleration: Research and implement state-of-the-art techniques to accelerate AI inference-quantization, sparsity, distillation, speculative decoding, caching strategies, and architectural modifications. Systematically characterize tradeoffs between model quality, latency, throughput, and power consumption to find optimal operating points across different use cases. 
 - Hardware Co-Design: Partner closely with hardware, compiler, and quantization teams to ensure algorithmic improvements translate to real gains on our silicon. Identify optimizations aligned with our architecture's strengths-maximizing throughput while minimizing power. Shape the feedback loop between model development and hardware.

data.description:
Role: Quality Engineer - CNC/VMC Machined Automotive Components

Location: Bommasandra Industrial Area, Bengaluru

Employment Type: Full-Time | Monday-Saturday

Experience: 2-5 Years

Qualification: Diploma / B. E. / B. Tech - Mechanical / Production / Manufacturing / Automobile Engineering

Job Summary

We are looking for a Quality Engineer with hands-on experience in CNC Turning, VMC machining, and automotive/precision component manufacturing. The candidate will be responsible for maintaining dimensional and process quality of machined automobile components through shop-floor inspection and process control. 

Key Responsibilities

- Conduct first-piece, in-process, and final inspection of CNC/VMC machined components. 
 - Read and interpret engineering drawings, tolerances, and GD&T. 
 - Inspect dimensions such as OD/ID, length, holes, threads, runout, concentricity, flatness, and surface finish. 
 - Use Vernier, Micrometer, Bore Gauge, Height Gauge, Dial Gauge, Plug/Ring Gauges, etc. 
 - Monitor machining quality, tool wear, dimensional variation, burrs, and process deviations. 
 - Identify and control rejection, rework, and non-conforming components. 
 - Conduct 5 Why, Fishbone, 8D and CAPA for quality issues. 
 - Maintain inspection reports, rejection records, calibration records, and other quality documentation. 
 - Coordinate closely with CNC/VMC operators, setters, and production teams to resolve quality issues. 
 - Support PPAP, APQP, FMEA, Control Plan, MSA, SPC, and IATF 16949 requirements. 

Required Skills

- Strong practical knowledge of CNC Turning & VMC machining quality. 
 - Good knowledge of GD&T, engineering drawings, machining tolerances, and precision measurement. 
 - Experience in automotive components / auto ancillary / precision machined parts is preferred. 
 - Hands-on shop-floor quality inspection experience is essential. 

Important: This is a Manufacturing Quality / CNC-VMC Machining position, NOT Software QA / Software Testing.

data.title: Software Dev Engineer II, Profit Intelligence
data.description:
Description

Are you interested in building intelligence systems from the ground up?

Are you interested in working with Applied Scientists, Big Data Engineers and Software Development Engineers to build large-scale data intelligence systems?

Are you interested to work in a team that positively impacts different key pillars of Amazon like Pricing, Promotions, Advertising, Auto inventory purchasing, Auto inventory removal, Inventory placement?

Are you interested in working for a team that builds cool systems yet has great work-life balance?

Profit intelligence systems measures, predicts true profit(/loss) for each item as a result of a specific shipment to an Amazon customer. 

Prot Intelligence is all about providing intelligent ways for Amazon to understand profitability across retail business. What are the hidden factors driving the growth or profitability across millions of shipments each day?

Profit Intelligence provides these answers. 

We compute the profitability of each and every shipment that gets shipped out of Amazon. Guess what, we predict the profitability of future possible shipments too. We are a team of agile, can-do engineers, who believe that not only are moon shots possible but that they can be done before lunch. All it takes is finding new ideas that challenge our preconceived notions of how things should be done. Process and procedure matter less than ideas and the practical work of getting stuff done. This is a place for exploring the new and taking risks. 

We push the envelope in using cloud services in AWS as well as the latest in distributed systems, forecasting algorithms, and data mining. 

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to design and build AI-powered data platforms that transform large-scale business data into actionable insights. You will work at the intersection of machine learning, distributed systems, and data engineering - owning end-to-end development of tools that help business leaders make faster, better decisions. 

This is a high-impact role on a team where the software you ship directly shapes financial and operational strategy across Amazon. 

Key job responsibilities

Key job responsibilities

Architect and build scalable platforms that ingest, process, and serve insights from petabyte-scale datasets

Integrate large language models and generative AI capabilities into internal analytics tools - enabling natural language querying, anomaly explanation, and automated reporting

Design ML pipelines for anomaly detection, forecasting, and trend analysis over structured and semi-structured business data

Partner with scientists, analysts, and PMs to translate ambiguous business problems into well-scoped technical solutions

Drive engineering excellence: define coding standards, lead design reviews, and set the bar for operational health (monitoring, oncall, runbooks)

Mentor junior engineers; raise the technical capability of the team through clear documentation and code review

Own your services in production - you build it, you run it

Build and operate our foundational data infrastructure comprising of the entire spectrum of AWS Services - Storage (Redshift Data Shares, s3 data lakes), Orchestration (Step Functions, Glue and Internal Java Based Orchestration Tools), Processing (Spark & Flink - KDA), Streaming services (AWS Kinesis) and real-time large scale event aggregation stores. 

Making it fully configurable and self-service for non-engineers. 

Build and evolve tools that empower Amazonians to access data and build reliable, scalable and configurable way to generate Unit Economics for all Amazon Businesses. This includes UIs and frameworks for configuring rules, simulating their application, approval workows for rule changes, APIs and caching layers for high-throughput serving of Unit Economics Historicals and Predictions. 

Build systems that secure and govern our data end to end: control access across multiple storage and access layers (like inhouse Reporting Applications and BI tools), track data quality, catalogue datasets and their lineage, detect duplication, audit usage and ensure correct data semantics. 

You will be responsible for designing and building platforms for crunching 100s of TB of in-coming data from dozens of sources and financial events around the company.

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience

Description

Invent the future with us. 

Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute. 

As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable computing for AI, Cloud, and edge applications. 

Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team - we'd love to have you apply!

About The Role

We're seeking a Senior Principal / Lead Analog Mixed-Signal Design Engineer to drive high‐impact, high‐visibility analog IP for next‐generation AI, cloud, and edge applications. You will own critical power‐management and analog IP from concept to production, lead cross‐functional teams, mentor engineers, and influence roadmap and make/buy decisions. 

What You'll Achieve

- Own end‐to‐end design of LDOs, buck/multiphase converters, references, op‐amps/OTAs, comparators, and current/thermal sensors. 
 - Define specs with system architects and AI hardware teams; translate workloads into efficiency, transient response, ripple, PSRR, noise, and reliability targets. 
 - Drive architecture and control strategies, loop compensation, and stability across PVT and load conditions. 
 - Build behavioral models (Verilog‐A/AMS), run AMS co‐sims, corners, and noise analyses. 
 - Guide layout and physical integration, substrate noise isolation, and ESD/latch‐up robustness; partner with SoC PD/package/PDN teams. 
 - Lead silicon bring‐up, test plans, debug/root cause, and close on yield and variation. 
 - Establish best practices and mentor the team; report progress and trade‐offs to leadership. 

About You

- Bachelor's degree with 12+ years or Master's degree with 8+ years of experience in analog/mixed‐signal design with a strong record of productized IPs /SoCs; 3+ years leading projects or teams. 
 - Deep expertise in power‐management/precision circuits and load‐transient optimization, protection, and telemetry. 
 - Strong command of noise, PSRR, and stability/compensation. 
 - Skilled in variation/reliability (PVT, mismatch, corners/Monte Carlo, aging) and post‐silicon correlation.

data.description:
About the Company: 

The National Crop Insurance Portal (NCIP) is the central platform of the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY). Farmer enrolment, premium calculation, loss intimation, claim settlement and payment through PFMS all run on it. It is used by farmers, banks, CSCs, insurance companies, State Governments and DA&FW, and is supported by a set of ancillary applications - the Farmer App, AIDE, CCE-Agri, CLAP, WINDS, YES-TECH, CROPIC, KRPH and the WhatsApp bot. NeGD is taking over the technical and managerial ownership of NCIP and these applications from the incumbent vendors. The first year covers the takeover, the thirty-five Schedule-II modules, and the consolidation of fourteen surfaces into a farmer app, an intermediary app, a field evidence app and the NCIP portal. Three years of operations and maintenance follow, across three full Kharif and Rabi cycles. The platform runs on Node. js services with a React front end, on MS-SQL and Elasticsearch, with Android applications in the field. The Node. js and React versions in use are past active support and are to be upgraded as part of the work. 

About the Role: 

Own the programme plan across the takeover, the thirty-five Schedule-II modules and the three years of operations and maintenance. Run the governance cadence with DA&FW - weekly progress, monthly steering, and the decisions log. Lead the handover from the incumbent vendors until source code, credentials, environments and runbooks are in NeGD custody and a release can be deployed and reversed without them. Hold the agency to the agreed staffing, timelines and service levels, and certify its deliverables for payment. Maintain the risk, issue and dependency registers, including dependencies on insurance companies, banks, PFMS, States and the KRP agency. Plan capacity and releases around the Kharif and Rabi enrolment and claim windows. Prepare the material for Parliamentary questions, audit observations and reviews by senior officers. Manage the change requests that follow scheme policy decisions, with an impact note on scope, cost and timeline for each. 

Responsibilities: 

- Own the programme plan across the takeover, the thirty-five Schedule-II modules and the three years of operations and maintenance. 
 - Run the governance cadence with DA&FW - weekly progress, monthly steering, and the decisions log.

 - Hold the agency to the agreed staffing, timelines and service levels, and certify its deliverables for payment. 
 - Maintain the risk, issue and dependency registers, including dependencies on insurance companies, banks, PFMS, States and the KRP agency. 
 - Plan capacity and releases around the Kharif and Rabi enrolment and claim windows. 
 - Prepare the material for Parliamentary questions, audit observations and reviews by senior officers. 
 - Manage the change requests that follow scheme policy decisions, with an impact note on scope, cost and timeline for each. 

Qualifications: 

- Essential. B. E. or B. Tech in any discipline, or MCA, from a recognised University or Institution. 
 - Desirable. MBA or PGDM. PMP, PRINCE2 or an equivalent programme management certification. 

Required Skills: 

Experience

- Minimum 15 years of experience after qualification, including at least 7 years managing large IT programmes with multiple vendors. 
 - Running a programme of 25 or more people across development, operations and helpdesk. 
 - Taking over a live system from an incumbent vendor, or handing one over, without service disruption. 
 - Managing an application that carries financial transactions or benefit payments at national scale.

 - Contract management: SLAs, deliverable acceptance, payment certification (Essential)
 - Delivery methods: Agile and hybrid delivery for government projects (Essential)
 - Reporting: MS Excel, Power BI, briefing notes and presentations (Essential)

Preferred Skills: 

Experience

- Desirable. Programme management on a Government of India platform, and familiarity with GFR 2017, GeM and government procurement. 
 - Work in agriculture, insurance, or a Direct Benefit Transfer scheme. 

Skills

- Procurement: GFR 2017, GeM, RFP and RFQ processes (Desirable)

Our client is a global connectivity solutions company serving hyperscalers, enterprise customers and data center markets across global geographies. data.title: Shopfloor Apps Software Engineer - Cloud & Integration
data.description:
About Us

PHINIA: Advancing sustainability today, powering a cleaner tomorrow. 

PHINIA is an independent, market-leading, premium solutions and components provider with over 100 years of manufacturing expertise and industry relationships, with a strong brand portfolio that includes DELPHI®, DELCO REMY® and HARTRIDGETM. With over 12, 500 employees across 43 locations in 20 countries, PHINIA is headquartered in Auburn Hills, Michigan, USA. 

At PHINIA, we provide fuel systems, electrical systems, and aftermarket products and solutions of the highest quality - developed and manufactured responsibly - that are designed to enhance efficiency and reduce the environmental impact of vehicles, industrial machinery, and other applications. In doing so, we contribute to a cleaner tomorrow, treat our people and surrounding communities with respect, and hold ourselves accountable to robust ethical standards. 

Our Culture

PHINIA promotes and cultivates an inclusive culture and diverse perspectives, strives to maintain its reputation for excellence, thrives on the power of collaboration, and fosters the development of our talented employees. We believe in making a positive impact through our business and actions, and we take our collective responsibility seriously. 

Career Opportunities

We believe in building a brighter tomorrow for our employees as well as our customers and encourage you to learn about our long history, strong culture, new technologies, and future vision. We offer a strong local presence and interesting global opportunities. Join us on this shared journey toward a brighter tomorrow. 

Job Purpose

PHINIA is seeking a Shopfloor Apps Software Engineer with a cloud and integration focus to build and maintain the data pipelines and applications that ingest IoT/manufacturing data, process it, and surface it in dashboards and apps for plant stakeholders. This role owns the portfolio of cloud side applications and integrations that turn raw machine data into usable information - from streaming ingestion through to the dashboards that plant managers use daily. The engineer works under the technical direction of a Bucharest based architecture lead and coordinates with a local delivery coordinator in Bangalore. 

Key Responsibilities

- Build and maintain end‐to‐end IoT and manufacturing data pipelines - from plant‐floor data sources (sensors, PLCs, OPC‐UA gateways) through cloud ingestion (Azure IoT Hub, Event Hub, Kafka, MQTT) to storage and visualization. 
 - Develop and maintain production‐facing applications: OEE dashboards, downtime trackers, quality reporting tools, and operator‐facing UIs using React/Angular frontends and . NET/Node. js/Python backends. 
 - Build secure, event‐driven integrations between shopfloor solutions and MES, ERP (SAP), PLM, SCADA/PLC, historians, and IoT platforms using REST/GraphQL APIs, MQTT/AMQP, OPC‐UA, and middleware. 
 - Own CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or equivalent), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), infrastructure‐as‐code, and environment promotion across dev/test/production for shopfloor applications. 
 - Implement and maintain real‐time streaming architectures handling high‐throughput manufacturing data with proper handling of backpressure, out‐of‐order events, schema evolution, and failure recovery. 
 - Write and optimize non‐trivial SQL queries against production databases for data mining, reporting, and integration validation; design data models for time‐series and manufacturing datasets. 
 - Implement observability (logs/metrics/traces), SLOs/SLIs, and proactive alerting using Grafana, Prometheus, or Azure Monitor; ensure high availability during production shifts. 
 - Troubleshoot integration failures end‐to‐end: capture raw payloads, compare against schema, identify encoding issues, trace through network layers, and resolve root cause across JSON, XML, and SOAP integrations. 
 - Develop and maintain real‐time dashboards, machine connectors, and monitoring tools; integrate time‐series data from sensors/PLCs/historians for actionable insights (OEE, scrap, downtime, anomaly trends). 
 - Ensure all solutions meet PHINIA's standards for reliability, cybersecurity, ISA/IEC 62443 alignment, Zero Trust, data integrity, and operational performance. 
 - Apply automation‐first engineering: test automation, containerization, repeatable builds, and standardized templates/components for reuse across global sites. 
 - Explore and implement edge AI/computer‐vision capabilities (e. g. , defect detection) and cloud/edge patterns (Azure IoT, Functions, Event Hub, Kafka) where value is demonstrated. 
 - Produce and maintain technical documentation including architecture diagrams, data‐flow diagrams, configuration guides, and runbooks. 

What We're Looking For

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related technical field
 - 4-7 years of experience in cloud engineering, integration engineering, or software engineering for manufacturing/industrial environments
 - Hands‐on experience with Azure cloud services (IoT Hub, Functions, Event Hub, App Service) or equivalent cloud platform
 - Experience with real‐time streaming technologies (Kafka, MQTT, NiFi, Azure Event Hub) including handling of backpressure, deduplication, and late‐arriving data
 - Strong programming skills in Python, Node. js, C#/. NET, or Java; modern frontend frameworks (React/Angular) for dashboard development
 - SQL fluency (joins, window functions, query optimization) for data mining against production and analytics databases; comfort with time‐series data modeling
 - Big data awareness: familiarity with data lake architectures, batch and streaming ingestion patterns, and time‐series databases (InfluxDB, TimescaleDB, ADX)
 - Fluency reading and debugging JSON, XML, and SOAP payloads across integration boundaries
 - Basic algorithm understanding (sorting, searching, graph traversal, complexity analysis)
 - CI/CD pipeline experience (GitHub Actions or equivalent); containerization (Docker/Kubernetes)
 - Experience with monitoring and observability platforms (Grafana, Prometheus, Azure Monitor)
 - Understanding of IT/OT security principles (ISA/IEC 62443, Zero Trust) and manufacturing network basics
 - Integration experience with MES/SCADA/PLC/ERP/PLM using REST APIs, OPC‐UA, MQTT/AMQP
 - Microsoft Azure certifications (AZ‐900, AZ‐204) - preferred
 - Docker/Kubernetes certifications - preferred

What We Offer

We provide compensation and benefits programs intended to attract, motivate, reward, and retain an incredibly talented, globally diverse workforce at all levels within our organization. Our compensation programs are informed by market data and business needs, and we are committed to providing equitable and competitive compensation. We are committed to providing our team with quality and competitive benefit programs, including health and well-being resources, family-centric policies, and an agile workplace program, where not precluded by collective bargaining agreements or national statutory plans. Plans are benchmarked for competitiveness and value. 

We provide formal development opportunities at all levels and stages of employee careers. These opportunities are delivered in a variety of formats to make our portfolio of solutions agile, sustainable, and scalable to support our employees in developing the skills needed to succeed. 

What We Believe

- Product Leadership - Innovation that brings value to our customers 
 - Humility - Seeking out diverse perspectives and working collaboratively 
 - Inclusivity - Recognizing our differences makes us stronger; we are bold and intentional 
 - Net-Zero - Committed to energy efficiency, waste reduction and beneficial reuse 
 - Integrity - Taking responsibility for our decisions and doing what is right 
 - Accountability - Taking ownership of our actions and driving results

SAFETY

You will consistently hear us say Safety First! We are committed to continually improving our strong safety performance supporting the health and wellness of our employees!

We also believe employee health and safety is everyone's responsibility. We encourage safety learning and collaboration to help employees understand and follow applicable safety policies, standards, and procedures and identify opportunities to minimize or eliminate risk. Work is expected to be conducted in a manner that stresses the importance of preventing incidents and illnesses, including attending all required safety meetings and trainings. It is expected that all incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions are immediately reported to the direct manager, Human Resources, or Safety Representative. 

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

PHINIA is an equal employment opportunity employer such that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. 

VISA SPONSORSHIP

PHINIA does provide sponsorship for employment visa status based on business need. However, for this role, applicants must be currently authorized to work on a full-time basis, in the country where the position is currently based. 

NO UNAUTHORIZED REFERRALS FROM RECRUITERS & VENDORS

Please note that PHINIA does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or offers from third party recruiters or staffing agencies associated with any published or unpublished employment opportunities. Any unsolicited information sent to PHINIA will be considered as unencumbered and free from any fee or charge whatsoever. Only members of our Human Resources Team have the authority to engage or authorize recruiting services, which must be agreed upon before the unsolicited resume or offer is received. 

GLOBAL TERMS OF USE AND PRIVACY STATEMENT

Carefully read the PHINIA Privacy Policy before using this website. Your ability to access and use this website and apply for a job at PHINIA are conditioned on your acceptance and compliance with these terms. 

Please access the linked document by clicking here, select the geographical area where you are applying for employment, and review. 

Before submitting your application you will be asked to confirm your agreement with the terms. 

Career Scam Disclaimer: 

PHINIA makes no representations or guarantees regarding employment opportunities listed on any third-party website. To protect against career scams, job applicants should take the necessary precautions when interviewing for and accepting employment positions allegedly offered by PHINIA. Applicants should never provide their national ID numbers, birth dates, credit card numbers, bank account information or other private information when communicating with prospective employers or responding to employment opportunities online. Job applicants are invited to contact PHINIA through PHINIA's website to verify the authenticity of any employment opportunities. 

Advancing sustainability today, powering a cleaner tomorrow. Join us on this shared journey to a brighter tomorrow. For more information about PHINIA, please visit www. phinia. com.

data.title: Business Analyst
data.description:
About the Company: 

The National Crop Insurance Portal (NCIP) is the central platform of the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY). Farmer enrolment, premium calculation, loss intimation, claim settlement and payment through PFMS all run on it. It is used by farmers, banks, CSCs, insurance companies, State Governments and DA&FW, and is supported by a set of ancillary applications - the Farmer App, AIDE, CCE-Agri, CLAP, WINDS, YES-TECH, CROPIC, KRPH and the WhatsApp bot. NeGD is taking over the technical and managerial ownership of NCIP and these applications from the incumbent vendors. The first year covers the takeover, the thirty-five Schedule-II modules, and the consolidation of fourteen surfaces into a farmer app, an intermediary app, a field evidence app and the NCIP portal. Three years of operations and maintenance follow, across three full Kharif and Rabi cycles. The platform runs on Node. js services with a React front end, on MS-SQL and Elasticsearch, with Android applications in the field. The Node. js and React versions in use are past active support and are to be upgraded as part of the work. 

About the Role: 

This role is a Business Analyst position on NeGD's rolls, responsible for supporting the takeover, enhancement, and ongoing operations and maintenance of the National Crop Insurance Portal (NCIP) and its ancillary applications, working closely with DA&FW and other stakeholders across the full lifecycle from requirements to release. 

Responsibilities: 

- Document the As-Is processes of NCIP and the ancillary applications, from scheme notification through to grievance closure. 
 - Write the requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria for the Schedule-II modules, and get DA&FW sign-off before build starts. 
 - Map the business rules for premium, subsidy, claim calculation and notification, and keep them in one maintained register. 
 - Turn policy decisions and circulars from DA&FW into change requests the development team can size and build. 
 - Specify the data exchanged with insurance companies, banks, PFMS, States, AgriStack and the KCC ecosystem. 
 - Write the UAT scenarios with the users who will run them, and track defects through to closure. 
 - Maintain the traceability from each requirement to the build, the test and the release. 

Qualifications: 

Essential: 

- B. E. or B. Tech in any discipline, or MCA, or MBA, from a recognised University or Institution. 

Desirable: 

- Graduate or postgraduate degree in Agriculture, Agricultural Economics or Insurance. 
 - CBAP, CCBA or an equivalent business analysis certification. 

Required Skills: 

Experience: 

Essential: 

- Minimum 6 years of experience after qualification, including at least 4 years as a business analyst on web or mobile applications. 
 - Writing BRDs, FRDs or SRS documents that a development team has built from. 
 - Process mapping and requirement workshops with senior users. 
 - Running UAT with business users through to sign-off. 

Skills: 

Area: Technology

- Process modelling: BPMN, Visio, draw. io or Lucidchart (Essential)
 - Requirements: User stories, acceptance criteria, traceability matrix (Essential)
 - Tooling: Jira or Azure DevOps, Confluence (Essential)
 - Data: SQL queries for analysis, MS Excel (Essential)

Experience: 

Desirable: 

- Work on a Government of India or State Government scheme portal. 
 - Knowledge of crop insurance, PMFBY, RWBCIS, or agricultural credit. 
 - Working ability in Hindi and one other Indian language. 

Skills: 

- Prototyping: Figma or Balsamiq wireframes (Desirable)

We are looking for an experienced QA/QC Engineer - Electrical & Instrumentation to oversee quality assurance and quality control activities for electrical and instrumentation installation, testing, pre-commissioning, and commissioning works on large industrial and semiconductor projects. The role requires strong expertise in quality management systems, inspection planning, FAT/SAT participation, NCR management, and coordination with multidisciplinary project teams. 

Key Responsibilities

- Prepare, review, implement, and maintain Project Quality Plans (PQP), Quality Assurance Plans (QAP), Inspection & Test Plans (ITP), and Inspection Test Reports (ITR). 
 - Inspect and verify installation of HT/LT switchgear, transformers, UPS systems, MCC/PCC panels, bus ducts, cable trays, earthing systems, and power distribution equipment. 
 - Witness and support FAT/SAT activities, vendor inspections, factory testing, and site acceptance activities. 
 - Perform and witness electrical testing activities including insulation resistance (IR), continuity, grounding/earthing, relay testing, transformer testing, and functional testing. 
 - Verify instrumentation installation, loop checking, calibration activities, hook-up compliance, and P&ID requirements. 
 - Review and close NCRs, punch points, and non-conformities through structured RCA and CAPA methodologies. 
 - Coordinate with engineering, construction, commissioning, vendor, consultant, and client teams to resolve quality-related issues. 
 - Maintain quality dossiers, turnover packages, inspection records, test reports, and project QA/QC documentation. 
 - Ensure compliance with project specifications, approved procedures, and applicable industry standards. 
 - Support quality audits, site surveillance activities, and commissioning readiness reviews. 

Key Requirements

- 8+ years of experience in Electrical & Instrumentation QA/QC, Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Commissioning, or Installation. 
 - Hands-on experience in developing and implementing PQP, QAP, ITP, ITR, and quality documentation. 
 - Strong experience with FAT/SAT, vendor inspections, testing, and commissioning activities. 
 - Proven experience in NCR management, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA), and punch list closure. 
 - Strong knowledge of electrical systems including HT/LT switchgear, transformers, UPS systems, MCC/PCC panels, bus ducts, and cable installations. 
 - Experience in instrumentation inspection, loop checking, calibration, and control systems verification. 
 - Working knowledge of SLD, P&ID, GA drawings, loop diagrams, hook-up drawings, and power distribution systems. 
 - Familiarity with IS, IEC, IEEE, and relevant international electrical/instrumentation standards. 
 - Demonstrated experience working with cross-functional teams including Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Vendors, Consultants, and Clients. 
 - Willingness to travel 10-20% as required. 

Qualification

- B. E. /B. Tech in Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, Electrical & Electronics Engineering, or related discipline. 

Preferred Industry

Industrial / EPC / Data Center / Semiconductor / Pharma projects

You will be supporting the team responsible for developing solutions to challenging issues associated with the design, development, and sustenance engineering for our new and existing Disposables for the Acute Therapies portfolio focused on Lab testing and administration. Candidate needs to work with R&D engineers to help build Test fixtures/assemblies and assisting with Lab logistics. The candidate will also be a part of Lab Management team to ensure the Laboratory controls are in place in line with applicable international standards and guidelines. You will be expected to support and contribute to the Projects/Initiatives involving Lab testing for Product quality issues, root cause analysis, Test Method development, verification & validation, Design of Experiments testing. 

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

- Supports the R&D development and sustenance activities to execute global cross functional projects relating to Acute Therapies Disposables. 
 - Should have good understanding of principles of mechanics, thermodynamics, hydraulics, heat transfer, and materials to support development and sustenance activities of mechanical and Fluid flow systems involving injection molded components and soft tubing. 
 - Will work with senior members/SME of the team to carry out root cause analyses in case of product failures with minimal supervision
 - Supports the R&D function to execute Lab testing activities relating to Acute Therapies Disposables.

 - Support consumable management/Logistics/ Tracking of parts. 
 - Support Project execution support for tests involving Reliability equipment's and Thermal Chambers

Education And Experience

- Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical engineering / Biomedical Engineering / Polymer Engineering Related disciplines of Engineering
 - Overall 4 to 8 yrs of experience with minimum 2 years in Medical Device Verification testing [Mechanical Hardware/Disposables]. 
 - Experience in Lab Management and establishing Laboratory controls in line with International Standards regulations [FDA]. 
 - Experience in developing the Procedures and Processes for Engineering labs and Testing facilities. Relevant technical testing/reliability experience in electro-mechanical devices.

data.title: Senior Principal Designer – Instrumentation & Control (Resources Hub)
data.description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good. 

Your impact

Help shape the future of mining and metals projects across Australia and India. As a Senior Control & Instrumentation (C&I) Designer, you'll play a key role in delivering complex mining, metals, and material handling projects that support the energy transition, operational decarbonization, and sustainable resource development. Working as part of Jacobs' growing India-based mining and metals team, you'll collaborate closely with our Australian Resources Hub and global engineering specialists to deliver high-quality solutions for major clients. 

In this role, you'll have the opportunity to lead C&I design activities across the full project lifecycle, from concept studies and FEED through to detailed engineering and EPC delivery. Your work will directly influence project outcomes by ensuring safe, efficient, and integrated instrumentation and control system designs. You'll work within multidisciplinary teams, contribute to global project delivery, and support the development of junior designers through technical guidance and mentoring. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and execute Control & Instrumentation design and drafting activities across concept, FEED, detailed engineering, and EPC project phases. 
 - Prepare, review, and check C&I design deliverables, including instrument location layouts, cable routing layouts, cable schedules, hook-up drawings, junction box layouts, control room layouts, and installation details. 
 - Develop and maintain engineering documentation, including P&IDs, instrument indexes, I/O lists, loop diagrams, termination diagrams, wiring schematics, and interconnection drawings. 
 - Collaborate with process, electrical, mechanical, piping, and civil disciplines to deliver coordinated and clash-free designs. 
 - Participate in model reviews, design reviews, and interdisciplinary checks to ensure compliance with project requirements and applicable standards. 
 - Provide technical guidance and mentoring to designers and drafters, promoting quality, consistency, and effective delivery. 
 - Ensure compliance with client specifications, engineering standards, project procedures, and relevant industry codes. 
 - Partner with clients, vendors, and Australia/New Zealand (ANZ) project teams to resolve technical and design challenges. 

Here's what you'll need

We're looking for someone who can demonstrate the following capabilities

- 11+ years of experience in delivering high-quality C&I design and drafting outputs across multiple project phases within mining, metals, and material handling industrial environments. 
 - Produce and review a broad range of C&I engineering deliverables, including drawings, schematics, layouts, and instrumentation documentation. 
 - Apply practical knowledge of PLC, DCS, SCADA, field instrumentation, control systems, and industrial communication networks to project delivery. 
 - Expert proficiency in AutoCAD, MicroStation and related engineering design software Experience with OpenPlant Bentley or similar 3D software is a plus. 
 - Coordinate successfully with multidisciplinary engineering teams to achieve integrated design outcomes. 
 - Build productive working relationships with clients, vendors, and geographically distributed project teams. 
 - Prioritise and manage multiple project deliverables while working independently and collaboratively within global project environments. 
 - Provide technical direction, quality oversight, and mentoring to designers and drafters. 
 - Contribute experience gained in mining, metals, and material handling projects. Experience in power, process, or other heavy industrial facilities would also be beneficial. 

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients' expectations. 

Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you. 

At Jacobs it's all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!

We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work. 

Your application experience is important to us, and we're keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

data.title: Vice President / Database Administration Manager
data.description:
Company Description

As a leading global investment management firm, AB fosters diverse perspectives and embraces innovation to help our clients navigate the uncertainty of capital markets. Through high-quality research and diversified investment services, we serve institutions, individuals, and private wealth clients in major markets worldwide. Our ambition is simple: to be our clients' most valued asset-management partner. 

With over 4, 400 employees across 51 locations in 25 countries, our people are our advantage. We foster a culture of intellectual curiosity and collaboration to create an environment where everyone can thrive and do their best work. Whether you're producing thought-provoking research, identifying compelling investment opportunities, infusing new technologies into our business, or providing thoughtful advice to clients, we're looking for unique voices to help lead us forward. If you're ready to challenge your limits and build your future, join us. 

Job Description Summary

We are seeking a PUNE based VP Database Operations Manager to join our GTI ( Global Technology Infrastructure) in Global Technology & Operations. 

Team/Group Description

This position operates in a fast-paced, innovative, and globally distributed environment with On-Call responsibilities for critical incidents. If you are a passionate technical leader with deep SQL Server, Oracle and Azure expertise, strong automation capabilities, and a desire to drive excellence within the DBMS Operations group, this role offers an outstanding opportunity to lead enterprise database strategy and deliver transformative business value

Role Description

The Enterprise Database Operations Lead is a senior technical leadership position responsible for directing the database administration team and ensuring the high availability, security, performance, and scalability of enterprise database platforms across the global organization. This role combines hands-on expertise in relational database management systems (strong emphasis on Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL in Azure, Oracle and Sybase) with strategic oversight and team management to drive operational excellence, innovation, and alignment with business objectives in a fast-paced, mission-critical environment. 

Applications And Business Or Enterprise Functions The Role Supports

Working closely within the Global Technology Infrastructure group, the candidate will collaborate extensively with various support groups, such as Unix and Windows Administration, Storage Management, and global application support teams. This role underpins support for mission-critical enterprise RDBMS systems, that include financial trading systems, accounting, brokerage, business intelligence and advanced analytics, regulatory compliance and data governance, customer-facing applications, and disaster recovery/business continuity operations. By maintaining robust, high-availability database infrastructures, optimizing performance at scale, and enabling seamless data integration, the role minimizes business disruptions, supports real-time global decision-making, powers enterprise-wide reporting and analytics, and enables strategic initiatives such as cloud platform modernization, large-scale data platform modernization / migrations, and adoption of advanced data services

Key Job Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To

- Leading, managing, and mentoring a team of Database Administrators within the DBMS Operations group, including performance evaluations, coaching, resource planning, and fostering a high-performance, collaborative culture centered on knowledge sharing and continuous technical growth. 
 - Serving as the organization's primary subject matter expert on database platforms, diagnosing and resolving complex issues, establishing and enforcing best practices, and ensuring rapid, effective incident response to maintain minimal business impact. 
 - The candidate will be responsible to manage scalable, resilient database solutions, including advanced high-availability configurations, disaster recovery strategies, and integration of modern technologies-in close partnership with the broader DBMS Engineering group and cross-functional stakeholders. 
 - Developing and maintaining sophisticated automation frameworks using advanced scripting (PowerShell, T-SQL) and tools (SQL Agent & ControlM scheduler) to streamline critical operations such as backups, patching, monitoring, alerting, capacity management, and routine maintenance. 
 - Collaborating intensively with application development, infrastructure, and business teams to optimize database design, query and indexing strategies, performance tuning, and application-database integration while safeguarding data integrity and compatibility. 
 - Driving proactive performance and tuning, capacity planning, monitoring, and bottleneck resolution using enterprise-grade tools to deliver optimal system efficiency and reliability. 
 - Championing knowledge transfer, technical training, and continuous improvement initiatives within the DBMS Operations group; analyzing performance metrics and trends to identify and implement impactful enhancements. 
 - Providing strategic technical guidance and roadmap input to the enterprise application teams on database platform evolution, including Azure cloud adoption (IaaS/PaaS), platform upgrades/migrations, and evaluation of emerging data technologies to support long-term organizational objectives. 

What Makes This Role Unique Or Interesting

This role combines strong technical leadership with operational responsibility inside the Global Technology infrastructure team, giving you real influence over our enterprise-scale data infrastructure. 

You'll gain deep expertise in advanced data server management, large-scale automation, and modern observability/logging systems - while guiding a talented team through complex, high-impact challenges. 

With global scope, mission-critical systems, and the chance to shape the future of our DBMS strategy, this position bridges hands-on operations with strategic business impact. It's both highly rewarding and intellectually stimulating. 

Professional development value of this role

Working within Global Technology Infrastructure group this role accelerates growth in advanced technical domains (SQL Server high availability/business intelligence stack, Azure PaaS/IaaS database services, enterprise automation, performance and tuning, Database Virtualization - such as Delphix) and observability, while significantly strengthening leadership, stakeholder management, and strategic planning capabilities. You will gain experience leading in a sophisticated, global operations environment, handling enterprise-scale complexity, and driving innovation in cloud and data platform modernization. These experiences position the candidate exceptionally well for future advancement into senior roles such as Senior DBMS Architect, Cloud Data Platform Lead, or broader data/infrastructure leadership positions. 

Job Qualifications (The Ideal Candidate Should Have The Following)

The ideal person will work closely within the DBMS Operations group and should possess: 

- Demonstrated success leading large-scale, global or multi-site database environments with strong emphasis on high availability, performance optimization, capacity planning, and mission-critical system reliability. 

Qualifications, Experience, Education

The ideal person will work closely within the DBMS Operations group and should possess: 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field. 
 - 8+ years of progressive, hands-on experience in database administration and engineering, with at least 3 years in a leadership or team lead role managing database professionals in an enterprise setting. 

Skills

- Proficiency across RDBMS platforms (Microsoft SQL Server primary; Oracle, PostgreSQL, with some knowledge of Sybase & IQ, Redis Cache experience beneficial)
 - Expert knowledge of SQL Server technologies, including Failover Clustering, AlwaysOn Availability Groups, Log Shipping, SSIS (Integration Services), SSRS (Reporting Services), and SSAS (Analysis Services). 
 - Advanced programming skills in PowerShell and T-SQL for sophisticated automation, scripting, and query optimization; familiarity with . NET development is advantageous. 
 - Strong experience with performance monitoring and management tools (e. g. , SCOM, Foglight, or equivalent enterprise solutions). Knowledge in database virtualization techniques such as Delphix
 - Deep understanding of Windows Server, Linux and Solaris operating systems. 
 - Proficiency with Cloud (Azure) technologies, including IaaS and PaaS database offerings, virtual machine sizing, disk and storage management, and related cloud infrastructure components. 
 - Knowledge of Splunk and other logging/observability technologies for centralized monitoring, alerting, and root-cause analysis. 
 - Advanced SQL skills for complex data manipulation, performance tuning, indexing strategies, query plan analysis, and optimization. 

Soft Skills And Other Requirements

- Exceptional communication skills, with proven ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences (engineers, architects, executives, and non-technical stakeholders), produce clear documentation, and facilitate productive cross-team collaboration. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset, rapid adaptability in high-pressure situations, and the ability to balance independent initiative with effective teamwork. 
 - Preferred certifications: Microsoft Certified: Microsoft SQL Server-related certifications, Azure Database Administrator Associate (or equivalent), Oracle Certified Professional (OCP), or relevant Azure/AWS cloud database certifications. 

Pune, India

data.title: Member of Technical Staff - Linux Kernel - FlashArray
data.description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3. 7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem. 

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us. 

THE ROLE

As the Team Lead for Initiator & Protocol Engineering, you will spearhead the critical bridge between our industry-leading FlashArray and the Linux/VMWare ecosystems. You will drive the performance and reliability of our storage protocol stacks-spanning NVMe over Fabrics and Fibre Channel-ensuring Pure Storage remains the gold standard for enterprise connectivity. Collaborating closely with cross-functional hardware and software teams, you'll mentor a high-caliber engineering squad to solve complex kernel-level challenges and influence the global Linux upstream community. 

What You'll Do

- Own the Protocol Lifecycle: Lead the development, maintenance, and optimization of Linux and VMWare initiator stacks (NVMeoF, FC-SCSI, iSCSI) and target drivers to ensure seamless, high-performance integration with Pure FlashArray. 
 - Drive System Resilience: Architect enhancements for Fibre Channel and NIC driver stacks that improve RAS (Reliability, Availability, and Serviceability), specifically focusing on multipathing logic and link health monitoring. 
 - Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Guide a team of senior and junior engineers through complex project deliveries, conducting deep-dive code reviews and setting the technical bar for C/C++ and Python development within the kernel space. 
 - Solve the Impossible: Act as the final escalation point for the most challenging system-level bugs found in the field or internal testing, utilizing protocol analyzers and kernel debugging tools to provide root-cause analysis and long-term fixes. 
 - Shape the Ecosystem: Optimize initiator behavior for maximum throughput and minimum latency, contributing key performance enhancements and bug fixes back to the Linux upstream kernel to benefit the broader storage community. 

What You Bring

- Kernel & Driver Mastery: Proven expertise in Linux/Unix kernel development and writing robust device drivers, specifically within storage or networking subsystems. 
 - Protocol Architecture: Deep technical command of storage protocols such as NVMe (TCP, ROCE, FC) or SCSI (FCP, iSCSI), including experience designing and implementing significant components of these stacks. 
 - Leadership Impact: Demonstrated ability to lead complex engineering projects from conception to delivery while mentoring peers and fostering a culture of high-quality, automated-first development. 
 - Advanced Problem Solving: Expert-level debugging skills for complex system/kernel issues and a track record of using performance analysis tools to optimize storage system bottlenecks. 
 - Location: We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the {{OFFICE_LOCATION}} office in compliance with Pure's policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave. 

What You Can Expect From Us

- Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers. 
 - Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in TechnologyTM, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay AreaTM, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!
 - Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good. 

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out http: //benefits. everpuredata. com/ for more information. 

Accommodations And Accessibility

Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at TA-Ops@purestorage. com if you're invited to an interview. 

Our Commitment To a Strong And Inclusive Team

We're forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn't just accepted but embraced. That's why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership. 

Everpure is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire. 

Join us and bring your best. 

Bring your bold. 

Pure and simple.

data.title: Principal Track Engineer
data.description:
Mott MacDonald is a global engineering, management, and development consultancy committed to delivering impactful work that shapes the future. 

We are a team of over 20, 000 experts working across the world in more than 50 countries and 140+ offices. 

We work across incredible global industries, delivering exciting work that is defining our future and making an important societal impact in the communities we serve. We have a reputation for delivering technical excellence on some of World's most prominent and challenging projects, and for working across multiple markets, including transportation, energy, water, and the built environment. 

Our people power our performance - we succeed when they do. With countless opportunities to collaborate, learn, and grow, the possibilities for excellence are as varied as every individual. As a proudly employee-owned business, we benefit our clients, our communities, and each other, investing in creating the right space for everyone to feel empowered, included, and valued. 

Whether you want to grow as a subject matter expert or broaden your experience with roles across our international community, you're surrounded by global specialists who want to combine their expertise and championing you to be your best. 

Join us and shape your story with Mott MacDonald, where everyone has the opportunity to be brilliant. 

Our teams take an active part in international infrastructure projects, specializing in bridges, highways, geotechnics, railways, tunnels, and foundations. 

Job Description
We are to recruit an enthusiastic, imaginative and committed person to join our growing, world-class rail business as a Principal Track (Permanent Way) Engineer who would like to further develop their career and lead a track team in India in a supportive and multidisciplined environment focused on the UK and Ireland markets. 

We are looking for an experienced Principal Track (Permanent Way) Engineer to establish and grow a Mott MacDonald Track team in India. You will help us grow and develop the team to ensure that we: 

- Optimise our opportunity to secure and deliver track design works for multiple projects. 
 - Have competent engineers available to successfully represent Mott MacDonald on schemes. 
 - Provide technical mentoring and guidance to the Apprentices and Graduates for our teams in the UK, Ireland and India. 

You should have excellent knowledge, understanding and experience of: 

- Plain line and S&C design. 
 - Gauging principles. 
 - Track materials, componentry and drainage. 
 - UK health and safety requirements, standards and design acceptance and assurance in relation to construction and railways. 
 - Surveying techniques in a railway environment. 

You will also promote Mott MacDonald's health, safety, and well‐being policies, ensuring adherence within the team, and support the delivery of design outputs that meet the quality standards and requirements set out in our Business Management System (BMS). 

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate and take positive steps to create an inclusive culture. 

Job Location: Noida

Key Responsibilities: 

- Your primary responsibility will be a track design lead to successfully deliver multidisciplinary projects throughout their lifecycle. 
 - The role is varied and responsibilities include but not limited to: 
 - Lead and mentor a team of engineers and designers, fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement. 
 - Oversee all stages of track projects from conception through to completion, ensuring they meet client specifications, budgets, and timelines. 
 - Provide technical leadership in track design, ensuring adherence to industry standards and best practices. 
 - Engage with clients, contractors, and public agencies to understand project requirements, communicate progress, and resolve any issues that arise. 
 - You will serve as a technical expert, pioneering the development and application of advanced engineering concepts and strategies to address unique challenges. 
 - Your role will involve seeking innovative solutions in the design and implementation of various projects. 
 - You will lead, mentor, and oversee all team members in both technical and project management aspects to ensure successful project delivery, while also supporting their technical and professional growth. 
 - You will engage in internal client communication, monitor budgets for ongoing projects, participate in recruitment efforts, contribute to business development activities, and prepare fee proposals. 
 - You will play a key role in preserving the team's culture and fostering a positive working environment. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to achieve project objectives to develop design solutions that meet client requirements, regulatory standards and comply with industry standards and safety regulations. 
 - Ensure all work is carried out in accordance with Mott MacDonald's quality standard procedures. 
 - Maintain up-to-date knowledge of industry standards, regulations, and new technologies. 
 - Provide technical support and guidance to bidding teams to secure future works. 
 - Contribute to the successful performance of the existing track teams around the UK and Ireland. 

Candidate Specification

We are looking for a flexible and motivated professional with a genuine passion and a desire to make a difference in the world. 

Academic, professional qualifications and experience: 

- Degree qualified in Civil Engineering Engineering. 
 - Minimum 12+ years of experience
 - Ideally a professional member of a relevant institution (e. g. chartered or incorporated engineer with RailEI, IET, IMechE, ICE or INCOSE). 
 - Demonstrated experience working for an engineering consultancy within the UK rail sector. 

Essential Skills and Experience: 

- Focus on safety and safe by design. 
 - Highly proficient at track alignment design. 
 - Proficient with OpenRail and MicroStation packages. 
 - Familiarity with BIM and common data environment platforms such as Bentley ProjectWise. 
 - Demonstrate a rounded track design experience covering a wide range of interfaces, e. g. formation design, interface with structures, stressing design, drainage design etc
 - Demonstrate an understanding of Railway Group Standards and UK Company Specific Standards, e. g Network Rail/LUL including Project assurance requirements
 - Proven experience in successfully leading a team and managing relationships with stakeholders. 
 - Experience in liaising with clients, co-professionals, and design teams. 
 - Exhibit excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
 - Effective time management and strong organisational skills. 
 - Strong interpersonal skills supporting collaborative working with colleagues. 
 - Problem-solving attitude with a high level of responsibility for assigned tasks and projects. 
 - Professional and respectful approach towards others. 
 - Experience in managing design teams of different sizes. 
 - Experience in drafting bid fee proposals, monitoring budget, raising an early warning notice, preparing and monitoring programmes, and ensuring delivery within time and cost constraints. 
 - Experience of working with UK railways clients such as Network Rail. 
 - Chartered or Incorporated Engineer status of a recognised professional institution would be an advantage. 

Desirable Competencies / Skills: 

- Able to scope and manage gauging survey and analysis from ClearRoute (or D/Gauge Rift). 
 - Proficient with Autodesk products including AutoCAD and Civil 3D.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior AI/ML Engineer with 5-9 years of experience designing, building, and operating production-grade AI and Generative AI solutions. You will provide hands-on technical leadership across solution architecture, data and model pipelines, agentic systems, evaluation, cloud deployment, and observability. The ideal candidate pairs deep AI/ML expertise with strong software-engineering discipline and sound architectural judgment and can lead delivery for complex enterprise use cases. 

What You Will Do

- Own AI/ML and GenAI solutions end to end - data pipelines, model and prompt workflows, APIs, evaluation, deployment, observability, and continuous optimization. 
 - Design enterprise RAG platforms: secure ingestion, chunking, embeddings, hybrid/vector search, reranking, citations, and access-aware retrieval. 
 - Build production agentic systems using tool/function calling, structured outputs, planning and memory, multi-agent orchestration, human-in-the-loop approvals, failure recovery, and auditable traces. 
 - Architect and operate MCP clients and servers that expose enterprise tools, resources, and prompts - with secure transports (stdio, Streamable HTTP), authentication, least-privilege access, tenant isolation, and protection against prompt injection and unsafe tool execution. 
 - Integrate agents with enterprise systems (document repositories, source control, ticketing, databases, ERP/CRM, cloud services) through reusable connectors and governance patterns. 
 - Define evaluation strategies and quality gates for accuracy, groundedness, safety, latency, and cost, and establish end-to-end observability for agent and MCP activity. 
 - Build production services in Python with strong engineering practices, GitHub-based CI/CD, and cloud-native deployment on AWS or Azure using Docker, Kubernetes, and infrastructure as code. 
 - Partner with product, architecture, data science, security, and business stakeholders; lead design and architecture reviews and mentor engineers. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Data Science, AI/ML, Engineering, or a related field - or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 5-9 years developing production software, data, ML, or AI solutions, including hands-on delivery of GenAI/LLM applications. 
 - Advanced Python and practical experience with data/ML libraries (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or equivalent). 
 - Strong grasp of LLM and agentic architecture: prompting, context engineering, embeddings, RAG, tool/function calling, structured outputs, orchestration, evaluation, and human-in-the-loop controls. 
 - Proven experience designing APIs, distributed services, and event-driven or asynchronous workflows with secure tool execution for AI agents. 
 - Hands-on experience with Git/GitHub and CI/CD, including automated build, test, security-scan, and deployment workflows. 
 - Strong experience with AWS or Azure and containerized deployment using Docker; Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code experience expected. 
 - A current, role-relevant AWS AI/ML certification or Microsoft Azure AI certification is mandatory. 
 - Hands-on production experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) is mandatory - consuming and developing MCP servers, integrating clients with agent frameworks, defining tools/resources/prompts, managing stdio or Streamable HTTP transports, and implementing security, approvals, testing, and tracing. 
 - MLOps/LLMOps practices: experiment tracking, model and prompt versioning, tracing, evaluation, monitoring, and cost optimization. 

Preferred Experience

- GenAI or agent frameworks such as OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph/LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Amazon Bedrock Agents, or Azure AI Foundry Agent Service.

 - LLMOps/observability platforms (MLflow or comparable) for tracing, evaluation, prompt management, and governance.
