data.title: Senior Software Engineer- Payroll Data
data.description:
About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. 

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365-all within 90 seconds. 

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1. 8B+ from the world's top investors-including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock-and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. 

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling. com addresses. 

Why This Role

Rare Opportunity

Rippling is looking for a seasoned Senior Software Engineer to join the Payroll Data team, one of the most foundational teams in the Global Payroll organization. While other teams build features on top of payroll data, this team defines what that data looks like and how it gets materialized - decisions that shape the capabilities and constraints of the entire payroll product. 

In this role, you will design and evolve the core payroll data models that represent earnings, deductions, taxes, and employer costs across dozens of countries. You'll architect materialization pipelines that transform payroll events into consistent, queryable datasets consumed by reporting, analytics and compliance. You'll define data contracts and interfaces that multiple teams depend on, and you'll make principled trade-offs between model expressiveness, query performance, and operational simplicity. 

This is an opportunity to do work with deep technical leverage: a well-designed data model or a faster materialization pipeline doesn't just improve one feature - it improves every feature built on top of it. 

What You Will Do

- Own the design and evolution of payroll data models spanning earnings, deductions, taxes, contributions, and employer costs across 40+ countries, balancing correctness, extensibility, and query performance. 
 - Architect and scale materialization pipelines that transform raw payroll events and configurations into consistent, query-ready datasets for reporting, analytics, filings, and compliance. 
 - Define and maintain data contracts between the payroll data layer and its consumers - run management, tax engine, filings, object graph, RQL, and finance reporting - ensuring stability and clarity at every integration boundary. 
 - Tackle hard data modeling problems including temporal state management, multi-country regulatory variation, and bitemporal data patterns. 
 - Drive performance optimization across materialization and query paths, ensuring payroll data is available with the latency, freshness, and correctness guarantees that downstream systems require. 
 - Improve observability and operational tooling for data pipelines - monitoring for drift, staleness, schema violations, and materialization failures in a system where incorrect data has direct financial consequences. 
 - Lead cross-team technical discussions on data model changes, schema evolution, and materialization strategies that affect multiple payroll teams. 
 - Mentor engineers and raise the team's standards for data modeling rigor, pipeline reliability, testing, and documentation. 
 - Shape the long-term data architecture by working with stakeholders across payroll, platform, and analytics to anticipate new country launches, product features, and reporting requirements. 

What You Will Have

- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience with a strong focus on data modeling, data pipelines, or data platform work. 
 - Deep experience designing data models for complex, real-world domains - you think carefully about normalization, temporal state, schema evolution, and the trade-offs between flexibility and query performance. 
 - Strong backend engineering fundamentals, with experience in Python, Django, or similar stacks. 
 - Experience building and operating materialization or ETL pipelines - transforming event-driven or transactional data into consistent, queryable datasets at scale. 
 - Proven ability to design clean data contracts and interfaces consumed by multiple teams, with attention to backwards compatibility, versioning, and documentation. 
 - Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, particularly in systems where data correctness issues surface downstream and require tracing back through multiple layers. 
 - Comfort working in ambiguous, cross-functional environments where data model decisions require understanding both technical constraints and business domain nuance. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to articulate modeling trade-offs, align partner teams on schema changes, and document data semantics clearly. 
 - Experience with payroll, fintech, HR tech, or regulated financial systems is a plus. 
 - Familiarity with bitemporal data patterns, event sourcing, or analytical query engines (e. g. , Trino, Iceberg) is a plus. 

Why This Role

- Foundational leverage: Every payroll feature - runs, filings, reporting, analytics - is built on top of the data layer you own. 
 - Hard modeling problems: Temporal state, retroactive corrections, multi-country variation, and strict correctness requirements make this genuinely challenging data work. 
 - Platform impact: Your data model decisions shape what's possible for dozens of teams across the Global Payroll organization. 

Communication matters: This role sits at the intersection of many teams - your ability to define clear abstractions and align stakeholders is as important as your code. 

Additional Information

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics. Rippling is dedicated to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling. com. 

We highly value in-office collaboration to foster a cohesive work environment and company culture. For employees residing within a defined radius of a Rippling office, working on-site at least three days a week is considered an essential function of the role. 

This position offers a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and equity opportunities. The exact salary will be determined based on factors such as experience, skills, and location. 

Join us at Rippling and be a part of transforming how businesses manage performance-based compensation.

data.title: Principal Engineer - AI Engineering
data.description:
Job Description Summary

Entwirft, programmiert, dokumentiert, testet und behebt Fehler, die beim Erstellen und Warten von Anwendungen und Frameworks auftreten, die in einem Software-Release-Lebenszyklus zu einem digitalen Produkt führen. Beeinträchtigt die Fähigkeit des Teams, Service, Qualität und Aktualität der Ziele zu erreichen. Die Rolle unterliegt operativen Richtlinienzielen. Innerhalb der Rolle besteht eine moderate Autonomie. Um die gewünschten Ergebnisse zu erzielen, ist ein hohes Maß an operativem Urteilsvermögen erforderlich. 

Job Description

Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten

- Entwerfen, erstellen, stellen bereit und warten Softwareanwendungen und -dienste. Arbeiten in den Bereichen Maschine, Cloud, Plattformen und/oder Anwendungen. Verantwortlich für den gesamten Software-Lebenszyklus einschließlich Aktivitäten wie Anforderungsanalyse, Dokumentation/Verfahren und Implementierung. 
 - Erfordert Fachwissen innerhalb der Funktion. Beeinflusst die Strategieentwicklung für den Verantwortungsbereich, einschließlich Kontrolle der Ressourcen, und beeinflusst die Richtlinienformulierung. 
 - Wertet einfache interne und externe geschäftliche Herausforderungen aus und empfiehlt Best Practices zur Verbesserung von Produkten, Prozessen oder Dienstleistungen. Bleibt über Branchentrends informiert, die die Arbeit informieren können. 
 - Verwendet ein hohes Maß an Urteilsvermögen, um Entscheidungen zu treffen und komplexe Aufgaben oder Probleme in den Bereichen Betrieb, Produktmanagement, Fertigung, Technologie oder Konstruktion zu lösen. Hat die Fähigkeit, die Qualität der bereitgestellten Informationen zu beurteilen und Stakeholdern relevante Fragen zu stellen. Kann neue Lösungen für Probleme anbieten, die außerhalb der festgelegten Parameter liegen, und ist in der Lage, Empfehlungen zu erstellen und abzugeben. Verwendet mehrere interne und einige externe Quellen außerhalb der eigenen Funktion, um eine Entscheidung zu treffen. 
 - Kann Funktionsteams oder Projekte mit minimalem Ressourcenbedarf, Risiko und/oder moderater Komplexität leiten. Kommuniziert schwierige Konzepte und kann die Optionen anderer zu bestimmten Themen beeinflussen. Kann andere anleiten, einen anderen Standpunkt einzunehmen. 

Grundqualifikationen

- Diese Rolle erfordert umfangreiche Erfahrung. Der Wissensstand ist vergleichbar mit einem Bachelor-Abschluss einer akkreditierten Universität oder Hochschule. 

Gewünschte Eigenschaften

- Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Ausgeprägte Sozialkompetenz und Führungsqualitäten. Nachweisliche Fähigkeit, Probleme zu analysieren und zu lösen. Nachweislich eFähigkeit, Programme/Projekte zu leiten. Fähigkeit, Programme zu dokumentieren, zu planen, zu vermarkten und auszuführen. Dokumentierte Projektmanagementfähigkeiten. Hinweis: Um die Einwanderungsbestimmungen der USA und andere gesetzliche Anforderungen zu erfüllen, muss die Mindestanzahl der Jahre an Erfahrung angegeben werden, die für eine Tätigkeit in den USA erforderlich sind. Für Rollen außerhalb der USA sollten sich die JDs auf das für die Rolle erforderliche inhaltliche Erfahrungsniveau konzentrieren, um die Einhaltung der geltenden Rechtsvorschriften zu gewährleisten, und eine Mindestanzahl von Jahren sollte NICHT verwendet werden. Diese Stellenbeschreibung soll einen allgemeinen Leitfaden für die Rolle liefern. Sie soll jedoch nicht die von jedem Mitarbeiter gemäß dem jeweiligen Arbeitsvertrag und/oder gemäß einer anderweitigen Vereinbarung zwischen einem Mitarbeiter und seinem Vorgesetzten geforderten Pflichten ändern oder anderweitig einzuschränken/erweitern.

At IPS, we are global leaders in developing innovative solutions for the consulting, architecture, engineering, project controls, procurement, construction management, and CQV of technically complex facilities, primarily in the life sciences industry. We are looking for a talented Senior Manager, Life Sciences, to join our dedicated team at our office in Naraina Vihar, New Delhi. . 

In this role, you will responsible for the technical and commercial leadership of complex pharmaceutical, biotech, API, formulation, sterile manufacturing, laboratory, and research facility projects. The role involves client relationship management, project delivery oversight, team leadership, and ensuring compliance with global regulatory requirements such as GMP and FDA standards. 

Position Responsibilities

- Lead life sciences projects from conceptual design through construction and validation. 
 - Manage project scope, schedule, budget, quality, and resource allocation. 
 - Oversee multidisciplinary engineering and project delivery teams. 
 - Identify project risks and implement mitigation strategies. 
 - Serve as the primary point of contact for pharmaceutical and biotechnology clients. 
 - Develop and maintain strong client relationships. 
 - Participate in business development activities, proposals, and project presentations. 
 - Review and approve engineering deliverables, process designs, P&IDs, and facility layouts. 
 - Ensure adherence to cGMP, FDA, MHRA, and other applicable regulatory requirements. 
 - Support equipment selection, procurement, commissioning, and qualification activities. 
 - Lead, mentor, and develop engineering and project management teams. 
 - Promote collaboration across process, mechanical, electrical, HVAC, automation, and CQV disciplines. 
 - Drive a culture of safety, quality, and continuous improvement. 

Qualifications & Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Chemical, Mechanical, Pharmaceutical, Industrial, or related Engineering discipline. 
 - Typically 15-20+ years of experience in pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, or life sciences projects. 
 - Proven experience managing large-scale engineering, EPCM, or design projects. 
 - Strong understanding of GMP facilities, cleanrooms, utilities, validation, and regulatory compliance. 
 - Master's degree preferred. 

Key Competencies

- Strategic leadership. 
 - Project and stakeholder management. 
 - Commercial acumen. 
 - Regulatory compliance expertise. 
 - Team development and mentoring. 
 - Excellent communication and client-facing skills. 

About Us

IPS, a Berkshire Hathaway company, is a global leader in technical consulting, architecture, engineering, procurement, construction management, commissioning, qualification, and validation services for technically complex facilities. data.title: Integration Architect
data.description:
About Refold AI

Refold AI is the AI integration platform built for agents, made for modern SaaS companies that need to ship enterprise integrations at scale. We're reimagining integrations with AI agents that work like business consultants and integration engineers, building them 10x faster, in hours instead of days. The payoff: integrations stop being a bottleneck that costs you deals and burns margin, and become a growth engine. You win the enterprise deals that hinge on them, onboard faster, and scale without an army of consultants. 

We've grown rapidly, reaching seven-figure ARR and 30+ paying customers, powering the product and professional services teams at modern SaaS companies, from Incorta, Kantata, and Coupa to Highradius, Naehas, and OvationCXM. 

Refold AI has raised $6. 5M from world-class investors including Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber), Tidal Ventures, and Better Capital. 

About this role

The Integration Architect is Refold's resident integration expert who owns the architecture for our hardest enterprise problems. You've spent years in the integration space, know iPaaS platforms inside out, and have a deep, hands-on command of APIs and how enterprise systems talk to each other. You set the technical approach where there's no playbook and serve as the primary technical point of contact for enterprise accounts. 

- Team: Senior technical IC role within the delivery org, owning enterprise architecture and implementations
 - Building: Mission-critical agentic AI integrations at enterprise scale - the problems for which no playbook exists yet. 
 - You'll work with CTOs, VPs of engineering, and integration leaders at Fortune 500 enterprises and $50M+ ARR software companies. 

What you'll do: 

- Own the architecture for the hardest problems. Design complex, mission-critical agentic AI integrations spanning Salesforce, SAP, Oracle, Workday, ServiceNow, and modern data ecosystems, especially where no playbook exists yet. 
 - Be the technical POC for enterprise accounts. Serve as the senior technical voice enterprise customers trust and the technical owner of their most important integrations. 
 - Make the decisive technical calls. Own the hard decisions on data modelling, agentic orchestration, authentication, idempotency, error handling, and performance under real enterprise load. 
 - Speak credibly to enterprise security. Be the trusted technical voice with customers' security and compliance teams on VPC, mTLS, SSO, and our SOC 2 Type II / ISO 27001 / ISO 42001 / HIPAA posture. 
 - Shape product direction. Be the most credible field voice in the room. Translate patterns observed across accounts and deals into identified gaps, reference architectures, and durable product bets, partnering directly with Product and Engineering on the roadmap. 
 - Codify what works. Turn hard-won learnings into reference architectures, integration patterns, and runbooks that scale across the delivery team and feed the support knowledge base. 
 - Bring architecture expertise to high-stakes deals. Partner with pre-sales on the prospects where getting the technical approach right is what wins, leading architecture reviews and technical deep dives. 

What we're looking for: 

- 6-10 years in integration engineering and solutions architecture, with a substantial, demonstrable background in the integration space. 
 - Mandatory hands-on experience with iPaaS/integration platforms (e. g. , Workato, Boomi, MuleSoft, Informatica, SnapLogic, Fivetran, TIBCO, and SAP CPI); you've architected and delivered enterprise integrations using an integration platform. 
 - Excellent, deep understanding of APIs and the integration landscape, REST, GraphQL, SOAP, webhooks, and auth models. 
 - A deep technical problem-solver, you design solutions from first principles for problems that have no established answer. 
 - Deep expertise in enterprise integration architecture, data pipelines, and modern cloud infrastructure. 
 - Strong technical communication; credible as the senior technical voice with CTOs, VPs of engineering, and integration leaders. 
 - Startup-grade agency, high ownership, low ego, comfortable building the playbook as you go. 

Nice to have: 

- Hands-on experience with LLMs and agentic frameworks (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source models, agent orchestration). 
 - Prior principal/staff solutions architect, lead integration engineer, or founding solutions engineer role at a high-growth enterprise startup. 
 - Direct experience integrating with Salesforce, SAP, Oracle, Workday, NetSuite, or ServiceNow. 
 - Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, and Azure), containerised environments (Docker and Kubernetes), and modern data infrastructure.

This role is based out of Chennai, India with a hybrid approach and is an exceptional opportunity for someone who relishes the chance to engage with cutting-edge technology, influence how our team builds and stays relevant, and work in a fast-paced environment with engineers on a high-morale, tightly knit team. Our engineering values are deeply ingrained in our culture. 

What you'll do: 

- Write and refactor code to help Arcadia efficiently collect and extract utility data

- Learn and understand the Utility Domain to be able to understand the requirements

- Rapidly learn and become proficient in our internal platform/framework, leveraging its capabilities to efficiently develop and deploy code

- Develop and refactor code on top of our internal platform to support the efficient collection and utilization of energy data

- Build and maintain complex data pipelines (within the platform's ecosystem) to parse and standardize large amounts of data, enabling our unique energy products. 

- Contribute to a streamlined CI/CD pipeline for frequent and reliable deployments of new functionality, adhering to the platform's deployment processes. 

- Collaborate frequently with other engineers, provide thoughtful code review, and contribute to knowledge sharing within the team, especially regarding platform-specific best practices

- Partner with external stakeholders like Product, SRE, Data Engineering, and Analytics to deliver the best possible product for our members and enterprise partners

- Flexibility to work on low-code platform and willingness to learn and work on different technologies

What will help you succeed: 

The following list reflects our current technology stack-- you'll need to have some overlapping or analogous experience, but not necessarily an exact match. 

- Experience with the programming languages we use: 

- Java, Python and OOPS

- HtmlUnit (Good to have)

- Selenium (Good to have)

- Puppeteer (Good to have)

- Experience with infrastructure found in our stack: 

- MySql or similar relational database

- Ability and internal drive to problem-solve, both creatively and pragmatically

- Skill with mentoring and learning from other engineers, and treating colleagues with respect

- Ability to scope, prioritize, and deliver on project commitments

- Ability to learn new technologies quickly

- Passion for our mission, sustainability, and drive a clean-energy future

Benefits: 

- Competitive compensation based on market standards  

- We are working on a hybrid model with remote first policy

- Flexible Leave Policy

- Office located in the heart of the city in case you need to step in for any purpose

- Medical Insurance (1+5 Family Members)

- A supportive engineering culture that values diversity, empathy, teamwork, trust, and efficiency

Eliminating carbon footprints, eliminating carbon copies. 

Here at Arcadia, we cultivate diversity, celebrate individuality, and believe unique perspectives are key to our collective success in creating a clean energy future. data.title: AWS Cloud DevOps Engineer -
data.description:
Who We Are

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation. 

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30, 000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability. 

We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal. 

#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

About This Role

We are seeking an AWS Cloud DevOps Engineer to design, implement and maintain secure, scalable and highly available AWS cloud and networking solutions supporting business-critical Vodafone applications and customers across Europe. 

You will help design, plan and implement AWS cloud services that provide mission-critical infrastructure to internal customers. The role combines cloud infrastructure engineering, Kubernetes platform administration, infrastructure automation, continuous delivery, observability, security, cost optimisation and Level 2 and Level 3 operational support. 

You will work with multiple technology functions, including solution design, delivery, architecture and IT security. Your work will directly influence cloud service delivery, production stability and customer services. The position is based in India within VCI Professional Services. 

What You'll Do

- Manage project-led integrations and the day-to-day administration of AWS cloud solutions 
 - Design, prototype and build reusable modules and cloud solutions aligned with the CET framework and Agile delivery cycles 
 - Provision and maintain CET framework components and other AWS services using Terraform and Terragrunt 
 - Manage the lifecycle, maintenance and upgrades of AWS Elastic Kubernetes Service, CET-EKS components and associated observability capabilities 
 - Administer Kubernetes clusters, including capacity management, platform troubleshooting and preparation or modification of Kubernetes manifests and resources 
 - Perform Bottlerocket AMI rotations and worker-node patching 
 - Maintain AWS Relational Database Service infrastructure, including upgrades and rightsizing 
 - Design and deploy hybrid connectivity solutions across CET-based AWS accounts 
 - Build and manage continuous delivery pipelines for Kubernetes modules and applications 
 - Configure ArgoCD environments and deploy infrastructure components using ArgoCD and Helm charts 
 - Apply GitOps practices using GitHub, ArgoCD and Amazon EKS 
 - Drive infrastructure and operational automation through CI/CD pipelines, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Bash and Python 
 - Conduct peer reviews and maintain established coding standards 
 - Troubleshoot AWS cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, networking, storage and performance issues 
 - Manage platform monitoring and observability capabilities, including Grafana dashboards 
 - Identify and implement cloud cost optimisation opportunities 
 - Monitor expenditure using AWS Cost Explorer and AWS Budgets 
 - Manage cloud platform security, vulnerabilities and compliance, including security and compliance requirements for EKS clusters 
 - Perform proofs of concept for AWS infrastructure enhancements 
 - Maintain accurate infrastructure and operational documentation in Confluence 
 - Provide Level 2 and Level 3 incident and problem-management support 
 - Help establish collaborative DevOps practices and cloud engineering methodologies across the organisation 
 - Share AWS knowledge and support the development of cloud expertise within the team 
 - Contribute towards cloud-service availability, cloud adoption and consistent feature delivery

Who You Are

Essential experience and knowledge

- You have at least three years of experience in cloud computing, or at least five years of experience in enterprise IT 
 - You have practical expertise in AWS cloud infrastructure and cloud platform operations 
 - You have experience administering Amazon EKS and Kubernetes platforms 
 - You understand Kubernetes lifecycle management, capacity management, security, compliance and troubleshooting 
 - You have hands-on experience with infrastructure as code using Terraform and Terragrunt 
 - You are experienced in GitOps and continuous delivery using technologies such as GitHub, ArgoCD and Helm 
 - You understand CI/CD practices and have worked with tools such as GitHub Actions or Jenkins 
 - You are proficient in version control using Git 
 - You can use Bash or Python to automate operational tasks, including user administration and security hardening 
 - You understand cloud networking, connectivity, storage, security, monitoring and performance management 
 - You have experience supporting AWS RDS infrastructure 
 - You can manage observability and monitoring solutions, including Grafana dashboards 
 - You understand cloud cost optimisation and can use AWS Cost Explorer and AWS Budgets 
 - You have experience with enterprise ticketing tools and Agile delivery methodologies 
 - You can produce clear technical and operational documentation 
 - You communicate effectively and use structured, solution-focused thinking to address technical challenges 
 - You hold a degree in an IT-related discipline

Desirable Experience And Qualifications

- Three to five years of experience in programming or systems analysis within Agile delivery environments 
 - Experience applying DevOps practices in a cloud environment 
 - Experience managing highly business-critical technology environments 
 - A relevant DevOps, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, AWS or HashiCorp Terraform certification 
 - Broader knowledge of AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud technologies 
 - Experience evaluating technical requirements, reducing service disruption and adopting emerging cloud technologies

Not a perfect fit?

Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best. 

What's In It For You

- The opportunity to work with production-scale AWS cloud infrastructure supporting mission-critical services 
 - Exposure to modern cloud-native technologies, including Amazon EKS, Kubernetes, Terraform, Terragrunt, ArgoCD, Helm and GitHub Actions 
 - Experience collaborating with solution design, delivery, architecture and IT security teams across a complex international technology environment 
 - The opportunity to contribute to high-availability services with a target uptime of 99% 
 - Scope to influence cloud automation, platform stability, security, compliance, cost efficiency and DevOps adoption 
 - Opportunities to conduct proofs of concept, evaluate infrastructure improvements and contribute to cloud platform evolution 
 - The opportunity to share knowledge and build AWS capability across the wider team

What Skills You Will Learn

- Advanced lifecycle management for Amazon EKS and Kubernetes platforms 
 - Cloud infrastructure provisioning and maintenance using Terraform and Terragrunt 
 - GitOps-based deployment using GitHub, ArgoCD, Helm and Amazon EKS 
 - CI/CD pipeline design and configuration for infrastructure and Kubernetes workloads 
 - AWS RDS infrastructure maintenance, upgrading and rightsizing 
 - Bottlerocket AMI rotation and Kubernetes worker-node patching 
 - Cloud observability and monitoring using Grafana and related platform components 
 - AWS cost monitoring and optimisation using Cost Explorer and Budgets 
 - Security, vulnerability management and compliance for AWS and EKS environments 
 - Hybrid cloud connectivity design and implementation 
 - Structured troubleshooting across cloud networking, storage, platform capacity and performance 
 - Operational support practices for business-critical cloud services 
 - Cross-functional collaboration with architecture, security, design and delivery teams

VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment

Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background. 

Join Us

At Vodafone, we're working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this. 

We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together. 

With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

data.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (US Hours)
data.description:
Department: Engineering

Location: Ahmedabad/GiftCity

Description

Trading Technologies builds professional trading software, infrastructure, and data solutions for a diverse community of professional traders and market participants. With over 500+ employees across Chicago, New York, London, Singapore, India, Japan, Australia and beyond, TT powers some of the world's most sophisticated trading operations with low-latency, highly reliable technology. 

The Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) is a development-first role focused on coding, automation, and platform stability. The ideal candidate is a skilled software developer who values a balance between building new tools and maintaining operational excellence. To ensure this balance, we adhere to the following 4 week rotation: 3 weeks pure development cycle, 1 week dispatch cycle responding to alerts and mitigating production issues. This position supports the US time zone. 

What You'll Be Doing

Platform Reliability & Automation

- Design, build, and maintain advanced telemetry and automation tooling to monitor global platform health and trigger automated corrective actions. 
 - Own and improve incident response runbooks and automated remediation workflows, reducing MTTR over time. 
 - Participate in on-call rotations, diagnosing and resolving system issues and escalations from the customer support team (this is an internal-facing role, not customer-facing). 
 - Drive continuous improvement through post-incident reviews (PIRs) and engineering initiatives that eliminate classes of failure. 

Software Development

- Develop advanced monitoring software in python and GoLang. 
 - Contribute to full-stack troubleshooting across our React. js frontend, Python backend services (Flask, Litestar, Celery), and AWS-managed Kafka (MSK/ESK). 
 - Write infrastructure-as-code using Terraform, building reusable modules and submodules to provision and manage cloud resources. 

Key Responsibilities

- Development Cycle (3 Weeks): Focus on coding advanced telemetry, implementing automation strategies, and building tools that proactively monitor platform health. 
 - Operations Cycle (1 Week): Rotate into an operational role to swiftly diagnose system issues and handle internal escalations, ensuring continuous platform stability. 
 - Continuous Improvement: Use insights gained during the operations week to develop automated solutions that reduce future incidents and optimize system performance. 
 - Supports US hours

Skills, Knowledge And Expertise

Essential Skills & Experience

- It is essential that you are able to cover US working hours

Software Development

- Extensive professional Python development experience, including object-oriented design and multi-threaded applications. 
 - Experience with Golang
 - Substantial hands-on Terraform experience-able to author modules and submodules from scratch. 

Cloud & Infrastructure

- Substantial hands-on AWS experience across EC2, Lambda, CloudWatch, EKS, ECS, MSK, ELB, RDS, DynamoDB, and SQS. 
 - Solid Linux systems experience, including monitoring critical system health parameters. 

Desirable Skills & Experience

- Familiarity with trading systems, financial markets, or low-latency environments
 - AWS Associate-level certification or higher (preferred but not required). 
 - Experience with chaos engineering, SLO/SLI frameworks, or formal reliability programs. 
 - Prior on-call experience at a high-traffic or mission-critical platform. 
 - Experience building or supporting React. js applications. 
 - Working understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, and load balancing concepts

What We Bring To The Table

Competitive Benefits & Perks in India We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. 

- Health & Financial Security: 
 - Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
 - Time Off & Flexibility: 
 - Enjoy the best of both worlds: the energy and collaboration of in-person work, combined with the convenience and focus of remote days. This is a hybrid position requiring three days of in-office collaboration per week, with the flexibility to work remotely for the remaining two days. Our hybrid model is designed to balance individual flexibility with the benefits of in-person collaboration, enhanced team cohesion, spontaneous innovation, hands-on mentorship opportunities and strengthens our company culture. 
 - 21 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, with the option to roll over unused days. 
 - One dedicated day per year for volunteering. 
 - Two professional development days per year to allow uninterrupted professional development. 
 - An additional PTO day is added during milestone anniversary years. 
 - Robust paid holiday schedule with early dismissal. 
 - Generous parental leave for all parents (including adoptive parents). 
 - Work-Life Support & Resources: 
 - Budget for tech accessories, including monitors, headphones, keyboards, and other office equipment. 
 - Milestone anniversary bonuses. 
 - Wellness & Lifestyle Perks: 
 - Subsidy contributions toward gym memberships and health/wellness initiatives. 
 - Our Culture: 
 - Forward-thinking, culture-based organization with collaborative teams that promote diversity and inclusion. Trading Technologies (www. tradingtechnologies. com) is a global capital markets platform services company providing market-leading technology for the end-to-end trading operations of Tier 1 banks, brokerages, money managers, hedge funds, proprietary traders, Commodity Trading Advisors (CTAs), commercial hedgers, and risk managers. With its roots in listed derivatives, the Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) company delivers "multi-X" solutions, with "X" representing asset classes, functions, workflows, and geographies. This multi-X approach features trade execution services across futures and options, fixed income, foreign exchange (FX), and cryptocurrencies, augmented by solutions for data and analytics, including transaction cost analysis (TCA); quantitative trading; compliance and trade surveillance; clearing and post-trade allocation; and infrastructure services. The award-winning TT platform ecosystem also helps exchanges deliver innovative solutions to their market participants and technology companies to distribute their complementary offerings to Trading Technologies' clients. 

Trading Technologies is backed by leading global investment firms Thoma Bravo, one of the world's largest and most experienced software investors, and 7Ridge, a global growth equity firm focused on technology-enabled businesses. 

This investment supports Trading Technologies' continued focus on product innovation, platform scalability, and long-term growth for customers and partners worldwide. 

Trading Technologies (TT) is an equal-opportunity employer. Equal employment has been, and continues to be, a required practice at the Company. Trading Technologies' practice of equal employment opportunity is to recruit, hire, train, promote, and base all employment decisions on ability rather than race, color, religion, national origin, sex/gender orientation, age, disability, sexual orientation, genetic information, parental status, veteran, or any other protected status. Additionally, TT participates in the E-Verify Program for US offices.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

 - Conduct code/design reviews, provide actionable feedback, and ensure performance, maintainability, and security expectations are met.

 - Experience delivering decisioning solutions and working with data platforms/technologies in enterprise environments. 
 - Familiarity with GCP services such as BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, and data patterns including ETL, data warehousing, and data lakes. 
 - Understanding of DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and release management to support efficient, reliable delivery. 
 - In-depth knowledge of Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban); Agile certification (CSM, PMI-ACP, etc. ) is an advantage.

data.title: Lead Data Engineer
data.description:
Job Title Lead Data Engineer (Cloud)

Job Type Permanent

Relevant Experience 10+ years' experience in in the field of Datawarehouse, Data Engineering, Big Data, Cloud & Analytics. Familiarity with AWS is required; experience with Tableau or other BI tools is an advantage. 

Reports into Data & Analytics Manager

Job Description

We, at Jet2 (UK s third largest airlines and the largest tour operator), have set up a state-of-the-art Technology and Innovation Centre in Pune, India. We are recruiting for an experienced and passionate Lead Data Engineer to join our growing Data Engineering program which is focused on making data assets from across our business available in cloud for advanced analytics, data science and automated decision making. These data assets drive mission critical processes across our commercial and operational teams contributing towards profitable growth, competitive advantage, and exceptional customer satisfaction. This is an exciting opportunity to help us become a leading data-driven organization through the effective use of data. 

The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in the success of our Data Analytics and Engineering program, working closely with colleagues across our business and technical teams. You will be designing and building complex data ingestion pipelines from different Jet2 and third-partysource systems will ensure data is cleansed, well structured, and appropriately transformed into our data lake to support a wide variety of use cases ranging from self-service analytics through to data warehousing and data science. 

Key Responsibilities

The successful candidate will be in a lead role with responsibility for both solution delivery and direct management of a team of up to 6-7 Data and QA Engineers (across Senior, Mid, Junior and Graduate levels). They will own delivery commitments for the team, run sprint planning and execute prioritization order set by Product team, conduct performance reviews and 1: 1s, and collaborate closely with stakeholders in Pune and Leeds UK. 

- Design and deliver scalable and reliable data ingestion pipelines to support data consumers across Jet2. com and Jet2Holidays
 - Ingest, cleanse and transform data from a wide variety of sources systems into our cloud data lake to support advanced analytics, data warehousing and data science
 - The primary focus is: ingest data cleanse data apply light transformations make data ready for downstream analytics teams. 

Below are the main areas of responsibility for this role -

- Data Ingestion
 - Build and maintain data ingestion pipelines from multiple source systems into the cloud data platform. Ingest data from databases, APIs, files, event streams, and third-party systems. 

Support batch, near-real-time, and real-time ingestion patterns where required. 

- Ensure ingestion jobs are reliable, monitored, and recoverable in case of failure. 
 - Work with source systems owners / Architect s teams to understand data availability, structure, refresh frequency, and extraction constraints. 

Data Cleansing and Standardisation

- Apply basic data cleansing rules and standardization as part of ingestion. 
 - Implement basic validation checks to ensure data completeness, accuracy, and consistency. 
 - Identify and raise data quality issues with source system owners or relevant stakeholders. 
 - Maintain reusable cleansing patterns and standards across ingestion pipelines. 

Light Data Transformation

- Perform simple transformations to achieve standard data platform formats. Conversion from semi-structured to structured data. 
 - Create clean, structured, and well-organised staging or curated datasets. 
 - Avoid complex business logic, KPI definitions, semantic modelling, or advanced analytics transformations unless clearly assigned. 

Ingestion Pipeline Development and Maintenance

- Develop, test, deploy, and maintain optimized data ingestion pipelines using approved cloud data engineering tools. 
 - Ensure pipelines follow engineering standards for code quality, configuration, logging, and error handling. 
 - Monitor pipeline performance and resolve failures or data load issues. 
 - Support pipeline scheduling, orchestration, and dependency management. 
 - Data quality reconciliation checks, monitoring, and incidence management
 - Participate in code reviews, testing, deployment planning, and production support. 
 - Work with cloud storage, data warehouse, and data lake technologies. (AWS S3, Snowflake , GCS)
 - Follow Jet2 s data platform standards for data storage, partitioning, naming conventions, access control, and security. 
 - Ensure data is stored in appropriate zones such as raw, cleansed, staging, or curated layers. 
 - Support metadata capture and basic data cataloguing requirements. 
 - Follow governance, privacy, and security guidelines while handling enterprise data. 
 - Understand in detail Jet2 s current data warehouse architecture and standards (architecture, coding, data modelling etc ) and do detail designing in compliance those and stated business requirement
 - Support the continual training and development of your team and the wider data engineering function at Jet2 to keep up to date with developments in data engineering and drive continual improvement across the team
 - Help to recruit, train and mentor a team of highly skilled Data and QA Engineers with a wide range of technical knowledge and experience
 - Plan, prioritise and oversee end-to-end delivery for the team managing capacity, sequencing work against business commitments, removing blockers and ensuring quality through robust QA practices

Technical Skills & Knowledge

- Expert-level SQL advanced query optimisation, window functions, complex joins and performance tuning across large datasets; experience with a variety of source systems including Microsoft SQL Server
 - Cloud Platforms (mandatory): You should have experience working with key services on AWS (preferred) or GCP / Azure. Key services include following: 
 - AWS Data Firehose 
 - AWS S3 / Data Lake 
 - AWS Lamda 
 - AWS SQS SNS 
 - AWS Event bridge 
 - AWS Step Function 
 - AWS Athena 
 - AWS DynamoDB 
 - AWS CloudWatch 
 - AWS MWAA (Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow)
 - Apache Kafka 
 - AWS API Gateway 
 - Terraform 
 - Deep expertise in Snowflake warehouse sizing and cost optimisation, RBAC, micro-partitioning, clustering keys, Time Travel, Streams & Tasks, Snowpipe, and zero-copy cloning
 - Experience working with DBT to develop, test, deploy and monitor data transformation code
 - Ability to use the AI Tooling @Jet2 (Snowflake Cortex Code, GitHub copilot, AWS Kiro etc. ) to effectively to deliver faster value to business by rolling out data products to business
 - Experience working with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), specifically with Terraform (equivalent experience with similar technology also accepted) Develop and maintain Terraform scripts/modules to provision and manage cloud data engineering infrastructure. 
 - Experience of working in an Agile delivery team using automated build, deployment and testing (CI\CD, DevOps, DataOps)
 - Experience with one or more programming language compatible with developing functionality on the above platform (Python or Java preferred)
 - Data Visualisation tool (Tableau) knowledge is a plus
Soft Skills

- Excellent communication skills verbal and written
 - Strong team and stakeholder management skills you should have the ability to build strong relationships with people across a wide variety of teams and backgrounds
 - Experience working with people across different geographical regions, particularly UK (Leeds and Sheffield) and India (Pune)
 - Excellent planning and time management skills to ensure projects are delivered on time and to requirement with issues being escalated and addressed effectively
 - Exceptional documentation and presentation skills you will be responsible for documenting solution designs for presentation and sign-off as well as delivering internal presentation to support continual development of your team

Leadership & Organisation Skills

- Lead a team of 6 Data and QA Engineers (Senior, Mid, Junior level) working across multiple projects, with full accountability for delivery, quality and team development
 - Set individual development goals, monitor, and manage performance, provide timely feedback and take responsibility for professional development of team members
 - Collaborate with wider data team including Solution Architects, Specialists, Enterprise Architects, Data Scientists, Data Visualisation Specialists, Analytics Engineers and Test Engineers

Qualification & Certification

- B. E. /B. Tech/ MTech in IT or Computer Science from reputed institute (preferred) or master s degree in quantitative Subjects e. g. Mathematics, Statistics & Economics
 - Any certification or formal training in the following areas would also be highly beneficial: 
 - AWS Clod
 - GCP Cloud OR Azure
 - Terraform
 - Cloud Certification in AWS/GCP with the following being preferred
 - Cloud Architect
 - Cloud Data Engineer

Who we are

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation. 

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30, 000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability. 

We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal. 

#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

About This Role

We are seeking an experienced Oracle Middleware professional to provide senior subject-matter expertise and end-to-end operational ownership across Oracle Middleware, Enterprise Integration and Enterprise Content Management services. 

Based at SP Infocity, Pune, this role will support the reliable operation, resilience and continual improvement of Oracle SOA Suite, Oracle Service Bus (OSB), Oracle WebLogic Server and Oracle WebCenter Content (WCC) platforms underpinning critical Telecom BSS, OSS and enterprise applications. 

You will lead production support, major incident recovery, service transitions and platform stabilisation while advancing observability, automation, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices and AI-driven operational optimisation. This is primarily an Application and Middleware Operations and Service Management role rather than an application development position. 

Candidates should bring 12+ years of relevant experience, including substantial hands-on responsibility for Oracle Fusion Middleware production environments, together with technical leadership and service-governance experience. 

What you will do

Middleware and integration operations

- Own the operational health, availability, performance, resilience and supportability of Oracle SOA Suite, OSB, WebLogic and WCC platforms 
 - Act as a senior technical escalation point for complex middleware, integration, service orchestration and content-management incidents 
 - Govern critical integration flows, messaging frameworks, service orchestration processes and enterprise content services 
 - Maintain service-level commitments across middleware and integration platforms 
 - Lead capacity planning, performance optimisation and technology lifecycle activities

Incident, problem and service management

- Lead P1/P2 major-incident recovery and coordinate troubleshooting across application, infrastructure, database and network teams 
 - Lead root-cause analysis, corrective actions and known-error management to reduce recurring disruption 
 - Maintain SLA and KPI performance across Incident, Problem, Change, Service Request and operational-risk processes 
 - Establish proactive support practices focused on resilience and reduced service downtime 
 - Conduct post-incident reviews and translate findings into continual-improvement actions

Service transition and operational readiness

- Lead due diligence, knowledge acquisition, service transition and operational takeover 
 - Coordinate shadowing, reverse-shadowing and knowledge-transfer activities 
 - Establish operational-readiness requirements covering documentation, monitoring, runbooks, access management, escalation procedures, capacity planning, security controls and disaster recovery 
 - Own early-life support and stabilisation of transitioned services

Platform governance and administration

- Monitor and maintain the operational reliability of interfaces, APIs, web services, message flows and enterprise integrations 
 - Manage Oracle WebLogic domains, clusters, managed servers and application deployments 
 - Support Oracle SOA composites, BPEL processes, Mediators, Adapters and OSB services 
 - Administer and support WCC repositories, content workflows, storage utilisation and service availability 
 - Perform environment validation, deployment verification and patch-coordination activities 
 - Identify performance degradation, integration failures and bottlenecks and coordinate appropriate remediation 
 - Maintain middleware compliance with applicable security and audit requirements

Automation, observability and continual improvement

- Automate health checks, deployment verification, service validation, housekeeping and operational reporting using Shell Scripting, WLST, SQL and relevant automation technologies 
 - Develop proactive monitoring, dashboards and alerting using enterprise observability platforms 
 - Apply operational insights and AI-driven approaches to improve efficiency and reliability 
 - Use service trends to reduce Mean Time To Restore (MTTR), repeat incidents and manual operational effort 
 - Improve alert thresholds, event correlation and proactive issue detection

Stakeholder and technical leadership

- Partner with Business, Enterprise Architecture, Service Management, Infrastructure, Database, Security, Application and Vendor teams 
 - Provide technical leadership and mentoring to L2/L3 support engineers 
 - Support knowledge management, cross-skilling and succession planning 
 - Facilitate operational reviews, governance forums and service-improvement initiatives 
 - Maintain clear stakeholder communication during outages, service changes and transition activities

Who you are

You bring 12+ years of experience in Telecom IT, Middleware, Integration or Enterprise Application Operations, with substantial hands-on experience supporting Oracle middleware in highly available, mission-critical production environments. 

Essential technical knowledge

- Oracle SOA Suite administration and production support
 - Oracle Service Bus (OSB)
 - Oracle WebLogic Server administration
 - Oracle WebCenter Content (WCC)
 - Enterprise Application Integration (EAI) and Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA)
 - BPEL, Mediators and Adapters
 - SOAP and REST services
 - API and message-based integration
 - Middleware performance tuning
 - High Availability and Disaster Recovery
 - Unix/Linux administration and Shell Scripting
 - Oracle SQL and PL/SQL
 - WebLogic Scripting Tool (WLST)
 - Middleware and application log analysis
 - Interface troubleshooting and monitoring
 - Oracle Database fundamentals
 - SRE practices and AI-driven operational optimisation

Service and operational expertise

You have demonstrable experience in major incident and problem management, service recovery, service transition, operational readiness, ITIL-aligned service management, observability, automation and operational improvement. You can apply independent judgement to complex production issues while coordinating effectively across technical and business stakeholders. 

Knowledge of managed-service governance, vendor management, audit and compliance readiness, business continuity, disaster recovery, capacity and availability management, and operational risk management is also relevant. 

Desirable exposure

Experience with one or more of the following would complement the core requirements: 

- Oracle API Gateway and Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC)
 - Oracle Identity Management, Oracle Access Manager and Oracle Internet Directory
 - Apache Web Server and load balancers
 - Control-M
 - Splunk, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Kibana, Grafana or Zabbix

A bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience is required. ITIL Foundation certification is preferred. 

Not a Perfect Fit?

If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best. 

What's In It For You

This role provides the opportunity to take end-to-end operational ownership of business-critical Oracle Middleware and Integration services within a large-scale telecom technology environment. 

You will have opportunities to contribute to service transitions, platform stabilisation, automation, SRE practices, observability improvements and AI-driven operational optimisation, while collaborating with technical, service-management, business and vendor stakeholders. 

What Skills You Will Learn

Building on your existing middleware expertise, the role provides opportunities to further develop:

Join Us

At Vodafone, we're working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.

Use Case Identification

Local AI & Analytics

Application Development

Architecture Recommendations

Multimodal AI

Hardware Planning

- Benchmark AI models against available and prospective hardware (GPUs, edge servers, storage).

 - Familiarity with workflow automation tools (n8n, Airflow, LangChain, CrewAI).

What We Offer

- Direct access to senior leadership - your work will drive real business decisions.

 - Opportunity to build a local AI ecosystem from scratch.

data.title: Head of Engineering
data.description:
About CTeBS

CTeBS (Classic Technologies & Business Solutions) is a purpose-built software company for the fashion manufacturing industry, and a subsidiary of Classic Fashion Apparel Industry Ltd. We build the Trendz Biz Suite - a unified enterprise platform covering production planning, ERP, quality management, HR, and data intelligence for fashion manufacturers. 

With a 70+ person team in Kochi and live deployments in production, we are now scaling our engineering organisation to match our next phase of growth. This is a pivotal leadership hire. 

The Role

As Head of Product Engineering, you will be CTeBS's senior-most engineering leader - building the leadership layer, establishing the culture, and designing the operating model that takes our engineering function from delivery-focused to capability-driven. 

You will lead 30+ engineers across three product teams through a layer of Technical Managers, and sit on the CTeBS leadership team reporting directly to the Business Unit Head. 

This is not a role for someone looking to grow into engineering leadership. It is for someone who has done it - and wants to do it again with full ownership and executive backing. 

What You Will Own

Engineering Organisation & Culture

- Lead three product engineering teams through Technical Managers - build their capability as much as the team's
 - Establish engineering values, norms, and a culture of accountability, ownership, and craft
 - Design and implement career ladders, performance frameworks, and individual development plans
 - Drive active, structured hiring - own the talent pipeline from sourcing to onboarding

Strategy & Delivery

- Translate product vision and business goals into multi-quarter engineering plans
 - Move the organisation from reactive firefighting to proactive, planned delivery
 - Own platform architecture direction in partnership with Solution Architecture
 - Represent engineering credibly at the leadership table - costs, timelines, tradeoffs

Team Building & Long-Term Thinking

- Identify structural risks, capability gaps, and technical debt early - and build plans to address them
 - Create an environment where strong engineers stay, grow, and do their best work
 - Balance the urgency of today's delivery with the investment required for tomorrow's scale

What We Are Looking For

Must-Have

- 14-20 years in software engineering, with 5-8 years in engineering leadership - managing managers, not just engineers
 - Demonstrated experience leading engineering organisations of 25+ people across multiple teams in a B2B SaaS or enterprise product company
 - Proven track record of building engineering culture - not just inheriting a healthy team
 - Active owner of hiring: built pipelines, interviewed at scale, closed strong candidates
 - Strong communicator - equally credible with engineers and business stakeholders

Strongly Preferred

- Exposure to manufacturing, supply chain, ERP, or industrial enterprise software domains
 - Experience leading an engineering org through a growth or transformation phase
 - Prior title of Director of Engineering, VP Engineering, or Head of Engineering at a product company
 - Familiarity with modern engineering practices - CI/CD, platform thinking, developer experience

What Success Looks Like

- Deep understanding of team health, delivery state, and key risks across all three teams: First 30 days
 - Technical Managers identified or in place; clear ownership and accountability structures established: 60 days
 - Engineering metrics baseline set; active hiring pipeline running; firefighting visibly reduced: 90 days

data.title: Manufacturing Process Design, Senior Leader
data.description:
Position Summary

JOB DESCRIPTION

- Vertiv is seeking a Manager / Senior Leader of Manufacturing Process Design to act as the lead architect of our production ecosystems. In this role, you will be responsible for the "Virtual-to-Physical" transition of our Power and Thermal products, serving as the primary bridge between R&D and the shop floor. By integrating Full-Line Balancing with high-fidelity Discrete Event Simulation (DES), you will ensure that our manufacturing lines are mathematically optimized for maximum efficiency long before the start of production. This role requires a blend of deep industrial engineering expertise, leadership acumen, and advanced data modeling to drive a "Right First Time" global launch strategy. 

Responsibilities

- Up-Front Design Integration: Lead the New Product Introduction (NPI) process by collaborating with R&D at the earliest design stages. Ensure manufacturing constraints, plant capabilities, and automation requirements are integrated into the product DNA before design freeze. 
 - Synchronized Process Design & Bottleneck Neutralization: Drive operational excellence through rigorous Yamazumi modeling, ensuring all manufacturing processes are perfectly balanced to Takt time. By neutralizing bottlenecks and bridging disconnected "islands of automation, " you will create a seamless, synchronized flow that eliminates process unevenness and waste, minimizing WIP and maximizing plant-wide throughput. 
 - Data-Driven Simulation (DES): Oversee the translation of Yamazumi work-content data and line-balancing profiles into Discrete Event Simulation models. Capture granular process data-including MTBF, MTTR, and precise step-level cycle times-to virtually "stress test" the production environment and validate throughput targets before physical implementation. 
 - Proactive DFM/DFA Leadership: Direct the execution of rigorous Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) reviews. Act as the final gatekeeper for manufacturability, identifying assembly risks early to reduce engineering change orders (ECOs) post-launch. 
 - Virtual Commissioning & Validation: Utilize simulation tools to perform "What-If" analysis on proposed line layouts, accounting for variable demand and supply chain lags. Oversee the selection and validation (IQ/OQ/PQ) of manufacturing equipment specific to power electronics. 
 - Root Cause & Continuous Improvement: Lead root cause analysis for production issues using FMEA and Six Sigma. Establish a feedback loop where real-time plant floor data from BackEnd/ERP systems updates to feed into the simulation models for continuous optimization. 
 - Cross-Functional Launch Orchestration: Drive alignment between global design centers and local plant operations. Serve as the technical management lead during the "Cradle-to-Grave" lifecycle to ensure a flawless handoff to production teams. 
 - Team Leadership & Mentorship: Manage and mentor a team of engineers, fostering best practices in Yamazumi modeling, DFM/DFA, and advanced manufacturing technologies. 

Skills

- Advanced Simulation Modeling: Expert-level capability in building and interpreting Discrete Event Simulation models to justify CAPEX and process changes. 
 - Industrial Engineering Toolkit: Mastery of Takt time analysis, Work Content Graphing, and Yamazumi work-balancing techniques. 
 - Executive Communication: Proficient in presenting complex simulation data, project timelines, and ROI projections to senior leadership. 
 - Systems Integration: Familiarity with ERP (SAP) and MES environments, with an understanding of how to structure "simulation-ready" manufacturing metadata. 
 - Bilingual Proficiency: Professional fluency in English and Spanish to facilitate global technical collaboration and cross-regional manufacturing support. 

EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATIONS

- Degrees: Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Systems Engineering, Operations Research, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Manufacturing Engineering. 
 - A Master's degree in Industrial & Systems Engineering (ISE) or Data Analytics is highly preferred. Experience: Minimum of 15+ years of hands-on experience in manufacturing process design for power products (UPS, DC power systems, or similar complex electronics), including experience in a leadership or project management capacity. 
 - Proven Launch Track Record: Demonstrated success applying DFM/DFA and high-fidelity simulation modeling to reduce manufacturing costs and improve reliability in high-volume, international environments. 
 - Software Proficiency: Expert in CAD software (SolidWorks, AutoCAD) and Advanced Simulation tools (e. g. , FlexSim, Arena, Simio, or AnyLogic). Proficiency in data visualization tools (Power BI/Tableau). 
 - Lean Mastery: Extensive experience with lean manufacturing principles, specifically Yamazumi (Work Balance) modeling, Kaizen events, and the mathematical removal of process waste. 
 - Certification (Preferred): Six Sigma Black Belt, Lean Manufacturing Certification, or Professional Engineering (PE) license.

No Special Physical Requirements

ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS

No Special Requirements

data.title: DevOps Lead (Enterprise)
data.description:
About Refold AI  

Refold AI is the AI integration platform built for agents, made for modern SaaS companies that need to ship enterprise integrations at scale. We're reimagining integrations with AI agents that work like business consultants and integration engineers, building them 10x faster, in hours instead of days. The payoff: integrations stop being a bottleneck that costs you deals and burns margin, and become a growth engine. You win the enterprise deals that hinge on them, onboard faster, and scale without an army of consultants.   

We've grown rapidly, reaching seven-figure ARR and 30+ paying customers, powering the product and professional services teams at modern SaaS companies, from Incorta, Kantata, and Coupa to Highradius, Naehas, and OvationCXM. 

Refold AI has raised $6. 5M from world-class investors including Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber), Tidal Ventures, and Better Capital. 

What you'll do: 

- Own our Helm chart as a product: values design, subchart and global merge semantics, secret handling, ingress and gateway topology, probes, resource envelopes, HPAs, and upgrade paths that survive contact with real customer state. 
 - Own the Terraform that deploys into customer clouds - VPC, EKS/GKE, managed Postgres and Redis, object storage, IRSA/workload identity, storage classes, autoscaling - written well enough that a customer's own platform team can read, review and run it. 
 - Run releases: one global platform version, every service image built and published, the release stamped, the digest-pinned bill of materials generated, the release branch reconciled. Make it boring enough that nobody hand-patches a cluster to ship. 
 - Lead enterprise installs and upgrades with customer platform and security teams - scope their network and compliance constraints, do the deployment, and fix the root cause instead of leaving a workaround behind. 
 - Debug production across the stack: pod crashloops and OOM kills, failed schedules, DNS and ingress behaviour, CSI and PVC issues, stateful store failover, slow queries, memory leaks. 
 - Extend the observability stack - OpenTelemetry collectors, Prometheus metrics, alert rules, PagerDuty routing - and make the same signals work inside an air-gapped install where nothing phones home. 
 - Keep the deployment documentation true: install guides, upgrade guides, backup and restore, troubleshooting. Customer teams read these instead of talking to us, so they ship in the same pull request as the change. 
 - Maintain developer environments - a per-engineer namespace on a shared dev cluster running the whole platform from production images, plus the local Compose stack - and keep both current with the chart. 
 - Automate operational toil in Terraform, Bash, Python or Go. If you've done it twice by hand, the third time should be code. 
 - Partner with security on secrets management, image provenance, CVE triage, patching cadence and audit evidence. 

What we're looking for: 

- 5+ years in DevOps/platform/SRE, with Kubernetes in production at depth - you've upgraded clusters, debugged a failing node, worked through RBAC and admission, and can explain why a pod wouldn't schedule. 
 - Helm as an author, not a consumer. You've designed and maintained charts other people install: umbrella charts, subchart values and global merges, template helpers, hooks, and versioned upgrades against live state. 
 - Terraform in anger. Modules, state and backends, provider quirks, drift, import, targeted operations, and the discipline of a plan someone else reviews. Comfortable with the Kubernetes and Helm providers and clear-eyed about where they hurt. 
 - One major cloud at production depth(AWS or GCP) - VPCs and subnets, security groups, IAM trust policies, managed databases, object storage. Enough to deploy into someone else's account without root. 
 - Real CI/CD ownership. You've designed or substantially rebuilt pipelines for multi-service systems - build, publish, promotion, environment gating, and rollback that works under pressure. 
 - Solid Linux, container, and networking fundamentals-processes and memory, file descriptors, DNS, TLS and certificates, load balancing, proxies, multi-stage Docker builds. You can trace a request end to end. 
 - Scripting proficiency  in Bash plus Python or Go for anything longer than a screen. 
 - Customer-facing composure. You can run an install call with an enterprise's platform and security team, take their constraints seriously, and write down what you promised. 
 - Clear written communication-runbooks, install guides, and postmortems are part of the job, not an afterthought. 

Nice to have: 

- Self-hosted or on-premises delivery to regulated enterprises: air-gapped installs, VPN-only networks, private registries, customer-supplied certificates. 
 - Stateful workloads on Kubernetes - MongoDB, Redis, Postgres - including backup, restore and failover drills. 
 - Temporal, or another durable-execution or queue-heavy system, in production. 
 - Observability tooling depth: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana or SigNoz, Alertmanager, PagerDuty. 
 - Service mesh or API gateway experience (APISIX, Envoy, Istio, Kong). 
 - Secrets and supply chain: External Secrets, Vault, sealed secrets, image signing, SBOMs. 
 - SOC 2, HIPAA or ISO 27001 environments and the operational discipline they require. 
 - Cost optimisation on a real cloud bill - spot capacity, autoscaling, scale-to-zero, right-sizing. 
 - Node. js and Python service operations, gRPC/Protobuf toolchains, or monorepo build tooling.

 - Process Rigor: Advanced proficiency in Agile/Scrum methodologies, JIRA customization, issue tracking, and version control (Git).

data.title: Software Engineer II - Product Data Gateway
data.description:
About The Role

At Abnormal AI, we are on a thrilling mission to safeguard the world's largest enterprises against a vast range of relentless email and collaboration application cyber security attacks. Our relentless pursuit involves crafting an exceptional suite of products that empowers customers to seamlessly visualize, expertly control, and fearlessly combat cyber-security threats. 

The Multi-Product Platform (MPP) organization owns the product platform that enables scalable product development, helping the business build and launch enterprise-grade products with a consistent customer experience. 

This is a chance to build the data backbone that every Abnormal product depends on. As a Software Engineer on MPP, you'll create the standardised data layer that becomes our single source of truth - the one governed path through which any system, agent, or interface can reach data from across every product, from a single record to cross-product aggregates, online or offline, in whatever shape it needs. It's a genuinely hard, high-leverage problem: the layer has to serve the entire platform at high throughput and low latency without ever becoming the bottleneck, while enforcing tenant isolation, authentication, and fine-grained access control so every team inherits strong security and reliability for free. You won't be maintaining someone else's system - you'll be defining the foundation every product is built on, where getting it right compounds across the whole company. 

If you're energized by 0→1 platform work, driving cross-team standards, and owning a system end-to-end, this role is built for you. 

What You'll Do

Technical Delivery & Operational Excellence

- Design, build, and iterate on the APIs and services that make up the standardized data access layer. 
 - Drive adoption of API-gated data sources, so product teams expose their data once and every consuming surface can reuse it, instead of building one-off integrations. 
 - Design and implement standard labeling for data ownership, and build the validation logic that checks incoming requests against it. 
 - Own the reliability and stability of the components and features you build. 
 - Contribute to the team's architectural decisions, and write technical design documents for the areas you own. 
 - Participate in regular code and design reviews as well as the team-wide on-call rotation. 
 - Write code with testability, readability, edge cases, and errors in mind. 

Teamwork & Collaboration

- Communicate effectively in an asynchronous manner with team members to provide updates, discuss challenges, and propose solutions. 
 - Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and other engineering teams as they adopt the shared data layer. 
 - Take ownership of projects and act as a driver who adds instant adrenaline and drives positive impact when placed on projects and teams. 
 - Participate in team roadmap discussions. 
 - Actively contribute to knowledge sharing within the team and participate in professional development activities. 

Must Have Skills

- Software Engineer with 4+ years of industry experience and strong software engineering fundamentals. 
 - Growth-oriented, looking to increase impact, responsibility, and ownership over time. 
 - Proven ability to own complex problems and multi-component features end-to-end, with a growing ability to collaborate and influence across teams. 
 - Strong experience writing production code in Python and/or Golang, and working with SQL and NoSQL databases. 
 - Experience with system design and building reliable, scalable applications with an emphasis on operational excellence. 
 - Detail-driven, and care about code quality, testing, and performance. 
 - Ability to make practical trade-offs - evaluating multiple approaches and selecting the one that best balances customer impact, system complexity, and long-term maintainability. 
 - Able to write technical design documents and contribute to design and architecture reviews. 
 - Strong understanding of service health, monitoring, fault tolerance, and incident response practices. 
 - Strong communication skills and proven ability to work autonomously and asynchronously with remote collaborators and stakeholders. 
 - Shares knowledge with teammates and helps establish team-level patterns and best practices. 

Nice to Have Skills

- Experience designing or building data access layers, APIs, or platforms that other engineering teams build on top of. 
 - Experience treating an internal platform as a product - building for other engineering teams as your customers. 
 - Familiarity with ChatGPT, Cursor, and other GenAI productivity tools.
