data.title: Principal Engineer/Sr. Principal Engineer - CQV
data.description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good. 

Your impact

Design Manager-CQV is responsible for leading and delivering end-to-end commissioning, qualification, and validation (CQV) programs for pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device projects. This role combines technical subject matter expertise with project leadership, ensuring compliance with global regulatory standards while meeting project timelines, quality, and budget targets. 

The role requires deep experience in GxP environments, risk-based validation, and facility/equipment qualification, along with strong stakeholder and team management skills. The role will require an experienced, energetic, and committed CQV person with broad experience in C&Q, particularly biopharmaceuticals and having experience of >15 years. The person should have experience of leading CQV engineers for big projects and managing the C&Q documentation and execution lifecycle, from SLIA generation through to OQ/ PQ completion. They will work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, quality assurance, and manufacturing, to support the successful delivery of projects. 

- Lead and execute CQV activities across multiple CQV projects, ensuring timely execution and compliance with industry regulations. 
 - Act as an SME for CQV having technical authority for systems such as process equipments, process utilities, automation, HVAC and controlled environments. 
 - Manage multi-disciplinary teams including CQV engineers, vendors, and contractors. 
 - Serve as the primary CQV interface with clients, design teams and Quality & regulatory teams. 
 - Track project deliverables, budgets, risks, and timelines and provide regular project updates and status reports to stakeholders. 
 - Drive decision-making and resolve escalations with engineering team and client. 
 - Involve in GMP review of layouts and systems and ensure CQV requirements are embedded early in the design lifecycle. 
 - Review P&IDs, layouts, URS, FS/DS, equipment specifications and vendor documentation. 
 - Mentor and guide CQV engineers and junior staff. 
 - Establish best practices, templates, and standard methodologies. 
 - Drive continuous improvement and knowledge sharing within the team. 
 - Prepare C&Q plans in line with the strategic goals of the client and manage timely and compliant delivery of the plan. 
 - Ensure all commissioning and qualification procedures are implemented and adhered to at office and at site level. 
 - Complete the development, review and execution of validation plans, URSs/DQ/TMs/FATs/SATs/IQ/OQ protocols/reports. 
 - Ensure all CQV activities comply with relevant regulatory requirements (e. g. , FDA, EMA) and industry standards (e. g. , ISPE, ASTM) and meets data integrity (ALOCOA+) principles. Well versed in commissioning and qualifying CIP & SIP systems

Here's what you'll need

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred. B. Pharm. , M. Pharm. , B. Tech or BE or MSc. 
 - 15+ year's experience in CQV within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, specifically in drug substance manufacturing. 

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients' expectations. 

Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you. 

At Jacobs it's all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!

We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work. 

Your application experience is important to us, and we're keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

About The Role

The mid-senior architect of the Frontier pod. Having graduated from hands-on engineering, the Master owns the design and governance of agentic systems within a domain, sets the quality bar for the pod's build, and is the principal technical advisor to both the pod and the client. Translates complex requirements into scalable AI solutions, governs orchestration and quality, and mentors Frontier Engineers. The connective tissue between engineering execution and enterprise architecture. Works across the three Frontier axes (technical depth, domain expertise and business mindset), asking what the function should look like in an AI era before deciding what to build, and ties the pod's design to the customer outcome. 

What You Will Do

- Design and deploy custom agents and agentic workflows; govern permissions, context-sharing and data access. 
 - Architect agentic deployments on enterprise platforms; design trust-layer and cross-agent governance. 
 - Define AI orchestration architecture and state, tool-calling and failure-mode patterns for the domain. 
 - Design agentic quality-assurance frameworks: agentic test orchestration and synthetic-data strategy. 
 - Engineer enterprise knowledge bases, ontologies and retrieval pipelines for agent grounding at scale. 
 - Translate complex domain requirements into AI functional specifications for the pod. 

What You Bring

Core skills: Agentic system architecture, Enterprise agent platforms (Copilot Studio/Agentforce), AI orchestration & state-management patterns, Agentic test-framework design, Knowledge graph & ontology engineering, RAG-at-scale & grounding strategy, MCP/A2A agent protocols, AI security & access controls, Technical advisory & client engagement. 

Competencies: AI-Native Solution Architecture, Agentic Engineering & Orchestration, Context & Retrieval Engineering, AI Quality & Evaluation Design, Technical Leadership & Advisory, Domain Fluency & Contextual Judgment, Business-Outcome Orientation. 

ENTRY AND GROWTH

Experience: 10-20 yrs delivery with deep AI-systems design experience. 

Entry: Demonstrate independent agentic-system design and domain governance; pass the Frontier CoE assessment at Specialist level. 

What Success Looks Like

Builds, ships and permanently owns AI-native systems end to end in a small Frontier pod, and is measured on the customer outcome the pod commits to, not on technical throughput alone.

data.title: QA Engineer - Databricks
data.description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today's risks into tomorrow's opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are-with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody's is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we're advancing AI to move from insight to action-enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence. 

If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity. 

Skills And Competencies

- 4+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance or Data Quality Engineering within large-scale enterprise data platforms
 - Strong hands-on experience with Databricks SQL and Python, including testing of notebooks, workflows, and scheduled jobs
 - Solid understanding of Medallion architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold) and data lifecycle validation practices
 - Expertise in PySpark for data validation, test automation, and building scalable testing frameworks
 - Strong proficiency in SQL and data validation techniques across dataset, record, schema, and transformation levels
 - Experience designing integration, end to end, and regression testing strategies with an automation first mindset
 - Experience working in Agile or Scrum environments with tools such as Xray for test management and Jira for defect tracking
 - Demonstrated proficiency in artificial intelligence concepts, with hands-on experience using AI tools to streamline workflows and enhance operational efficiency. Proven ability to implement AI-powered solutions to solve business challenges. Demonstrates a growing awareness of AI risk management and a commitment to responsible and ethical AI use. 

Education

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field

Responsibilities

Ensure data quality, reliability, and correctness across large scale Databricks batch pipelines through automated validation and testing practices. 

- Own end to end data quality validation for Databricks pipelines across Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers
 - Validate data completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and business rule correctness using Databricks SQL and Delta tables
 - Perform dataset, record, schema, and transformation level validations including source to target mapping and derived field checks
 - Design, develop, and maintain reusable and scalable data validation frameworks using PySpark and Python on Databricks
 - Automate integration, regression, and end to end testing for notebooks, workflows, and scheduled jobs
 - Define and implement test data management strategies including data refresh, masking, and environment isolation
 - Manage test cases, execution, and defect tracking using Xray and Jira while maintaining test documentation and validation evidence
 - Collaborate with engineering, platform, and product teams to enforce data quality standards and communicate risks and release readiness

About The Team

Our Data Platform and Engineering team is responsible for building and maintaining scalable, high quality data solutions that power critical business insights and analytics. By joining this team, you will collaborate with cross-functional experts across engineering, product, and platform functions to drive innovation in modern data architectures using Databricks and Delta Lake. The team is committed to adopting automation, advanced analytics, and responsible AI practices to ensure reliable and high performing data ecosystems. 

Moody's is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law. 

Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody's Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.

- Opportunities to grow your career locally and collaborate with colleagues across Citi's global network.

WCR In-Business QA verifies that established standards and processes are followed and consistently applied. WCR and ICM Management utilize the results of Quality Assurance Reviews (QARs) to assess the quality of the group's policies, procedures, programs, and practices as relates to the management of wholesale credit risk. The results enable management to identify risks associated with operational and control weaknesses, training needs, and process deficiencies. 

The WCR Head of In-Business QA reports results of QARs providing insight and observations on deficiency and areas of improvement, engaging management of the respective In-Business Credit Risk, Independent Risk, Banking & International Credit Review, Internal Audit and Regulators.

data.description:
Responsibilities

Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India. 

Adani Solar: Adani Solar is India's 1st and largest vertically integrated solar PV manufacturer with 4 GW cells & modules and 2 GW of ingots & wafers manufacturing capacities

Job Purpose: The job purpose of a Lead - Cell Maintenance is to manage and oversee the maintenance operations specifically for PERC (Passivated Emitter and Rear Cell) technology, ensure the optimal performance and reliability of PERC solar cells, lead troubleshooting and repair efforts, and implement preventive maintenance strategies to maintain high production quality and efficiency. 

- Key Responsibilities of Role

Safety Compliance

- Ensure that all maintenance procedures for PERC technology comply with safety standards and protocols, focusing on handling and processing sensitive components like passivation layers. 

Innovation

- Driving continuous improvement by leading R&D efforts to develop advanced solar technologies and identifying market trends to maintain a competitive edge. 

Digitalization/Data-Driven Decision Making

- Overseeing the implementation of digital tools and smart technologies to optimize manufacturing processes and enhance data-driven decision-making across the organization. 

Leadership In Change Management

- Leading effective change management strategies to guide the organization through transitions, ensuring smooth adoption of new processes and technologies. 

People Development

- Leading from the front & being accountable for the professional growth of your teams. Developing/conducting/promoting training & learning initiatives to enhance skills & empowering them to take ownership of key processes and decisions. 

PERC Technology Management

- Oversee maintenance operations specifically for PERC (Passivated Emitter and Rear Cell) solar cells, focusing on the unique aspects of this technology, such as passivation layers and rear surface treatment. 

Issue Diagnosis And Repair

- Address and resolve issues related to PERC cell performance, including troubleshooting problems with passivation layers, rear surface contact, and overall cell efficiency. 

Preventive Maintenance

- Develop and execute preventive maintenance schedules tailored to the specific needs of PERC cells, such as ensuring the integrity of the passivation layer and rear contacts. 

Quality Assurance

- Ensure that maintenance practices uphold the high standards required for PERC cells. Perform detailed inspections to verify the condition of passivation layers and rear surface contacts. . 

CAPA (Corrective And Preventive Actions)

- Identify and address specific issues affecting PERC cells, such as degradation of passivation layers or rear contact problems, and implement corrective and preventive measures to enhance cell performance. 

Team Leadership

- Lead and coordinate the maintenance team in handling PERC cells, providing specific guidance on handling and maintaining passivation and rear contact systems. 

Performance Monitoring

- Track performance indicators specific to PERC cells, such as efficiency metrics and degradation rates of passivation layers, to optimize maintenance strategies and improve cell longevity.

- Production Team
 - Engineering Department
 - Quality Assurance Team
 - Operations Management

Key Stakeholders - External

- PERC Equipment Manufacturers
 - Spare Parts Suppliers
 - Technical Consultants
 - External Auditors

Qualifications

Educational Qualification: 

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 

Work Experience (Range Of Years)

- 12-14 Years of experience in cell maintenance, with specific experience in PERC technology.

data.title: Data Center Manager, Data Center Operations
data.description:
Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain - and we're looking for talented people who want to help. 

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. 

You will be a proven manager with experience managing teams of high performers. You will have the ability to refine and develop processes to optimize operational excellence in every area of your role. You will be able to drive performance levels to achieve the pace at which we build and operate Data Centers in India for Amazon Data Services India Private Limited ("ADSIPL"). You will have previous experience in Data Centers, either building or managing (or both) along with exposure to developing great relationships with both internal teams and external vendors. 

You will also have a passion for technology along with a desire to be the best at your job every day!

Key job responsibilities

About The Role

As a Data Center Manager in ADSIPL, you will get to manage the world's largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure in India. We encounter interesting, challenging & complex problems every day, being a technical manager in ADSIPL means that you can innovate to solve these issues and help drive Operations Excellence in all areas of your role. 

Your day job at ADSIPL will include (but not limited to): 

- Managing and developing teams of engineers, providing both technical and leadership expertise and ensuring highest levels of performance. 
 - Maintaining existing co-located and in-house Data Centers
 - Helping build and bring online new Data Centers
 - Constantly improving all our processes and procedures. We believe there is nothing we cannot improve
 - Assisting & managing relationships with external vendors & contractors
 - Liaising with internal teams & management groups
 - Ensuring we adhere to and exceed local Health & Safety standards in all our Data Centers
 - Creating and maintaining metrics on all aspects of our Data Centers and utilizing those metrics to drive positive changes
 - Assisting in implementing service methodologies including incident management, problem management, change management, capacity management, etc. 

What are we looking for in a successful AWS Returner Data Centre Manager (DCM) candidate along with the technical knowledge and experience. 

People Management. 

As a successful candidate you will have managed a team of at least 5 individuals, over a period of at least 3 years. You will be able to demonstrate how you have continued to improve performance of an existing team along with displaying skills in creating or growing a team. Experience managing both high & low performing employees will be of advantage along with conflict management. 

Incident Management. 

You will have a lot of experience dealing with high severity situations, show a clear understanding of the wider blast implications of any issue/outage and potential consequences of differing outcome scenarios. You will also have experience in Change Management & Fault Management. 

Vendor Management. 

An Amazon, individual has to deal with vendors, contractors & security companies. You will be able to prove you have experience dealing with external vendors and be able to display incidents of both problem & conflict management when dealing with same. 

Process Improvement. 

You will be able to demonstrate an ability of taking both a good working process & a bad process and improving. You will have experience in processes mapping, implementing remediation steps and how this affected the overall business you were working in. Experience in Kaizen/Lean/Six Sigma is preferable

Health & Safety. 

Health & Safety should be at the forefront of every manager's mind. Managers should be able to positively influence the Safety culture of the Data Center organization. 

About The Team

About AWS

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying. 

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating - that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. 

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve. 

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do. 

Mentorship and Career Growth

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. 

Basic Qualifications

- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience in software development and experience in technical support
 - 5+ years of operations management experience
 - 3+ years of managing technical teams with significant personnel management experience and examples of developing engineers and building successful teams experience
 - Experience in facilities management, or experience in project management

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in engineering or equivalent STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) field, or 6+ months of network and operating system support experience
 - 1+ years of agile software development methodology experience
 - Knowledge of six Sigma/Lean processes
 - Experience creating and implementing large-scale programs
 - 2+ years of capacity planning, operations planning, business analysis or similar experience

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https: //amazon. jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. 

Company - ADSIPL - Telangana

data.title: Staff Engineer – Enterprise IT Automation
data.description:
Netradyne harnesses the power of Computer Vision and Edge Computing to revolutionize the modern-day transportation ecosystem. We are a leader in fleet safety solutions. With growth exceeding 4x year over year, our solution is quickly being recognized as a significant disruptive technology. Our team is growing, and we need forward-thinking, uncompromising, competitive team members to continue to facilitate our growth. 

About Netradyne: 

Netradyne provides AI-powered technologies for fleet management and safer roads. An award-winning industry leader in fleet safety and video telematics solutions, Netradyne empowers thousands of commercial fleet customers across North America, Europe, and Asia to enhance their driver performance, reduce risk, and optimize operations. 

Netradyne sets the standard among transportation technology companies for enhancing and sustaining road safety, with an industry-leading 25+ billion miles vision-analyzed for risk and an industry-first driver scoring system that reinforces safe behaviours. Founded in 2015, Netradyne is headquartered in San Diego with offices in San Francisco, Nashville, the UK and Bangalore. 

For more details visit: www. netradyne. com

About the Role: 

Netradyne is seeking a highly skilled and experienced dedicated Enterprise IT Automation Engineer to join our dynamic team in Bangalore. This role is critical and serve as the centralised enabler of generative-AI adoption across the enterprise. As a Enterprise IT Automation Engineer, you will turn fragmented, team-by-team AI experimentation into reusable, secure, and scalable capabilities that every function - Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, HR, Admin, Legal, and Finance. 

This is a hands-on, build-first role for an engineer who can solution Agentic AI workflows and agents, integrate them into day-to-day operations, and partner with business leaders to ideate, prototype, and scale high-impact use cases. You will operate as a horizontal force-multiplier across the organisation initiatives and embedding responsible AI into how Netradyne works. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Design, build, and maintain reusable Agentic AI Agents, workflows, MCP connectors, and assistants for business and support functions, prioritising templates that scale beyond a single team. 
 - Integrate MCP Connectors with Gen AI platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, Open AI, Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, into existing Enterprise IT & business systems. 
 - Automate business workflows and cross-functional processes, and continuously optimise systems for performance, cost-efficiency, reliability, and scalability. 
 - Apply solid software-engineering practices (version control, testing, observability) to AI solutions so they are maintainable, monitored, and production-grade. 
 - Partner with function teams to ideate, prototype, and scale AI use cases from concept to production, embedding into their workflows rather than handing off in isolation. 
 - Collaborate across Sales, Marketing, CS, Product, Engineering, HR, Admin, Legal, and Finance to identify high-value automation and Gen AI opportunities aligned to organisational goals. 
 - Ensure ethical and secure AI deployment in line with Netradyne's Responsible AI principles, data-protection obligations (including GDPR), and InfoSec policies. 
 - Support governance of Gen AI tool budgets and purchases org-wide, including visibility into shadow-AI spend and usage-based billing models. 
 - Monitor, troubleshoot, and enhance the performance of deployed automation tools and AI systems, ensuring scalability and reliability in production. 
 - Stay current with advances in Gen AI, agentic frameworks, and IT automation, and translate them into actionable recommendations for continuous improvement. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, AI, or a related field. 
 - 8+ years of experience in an IT engineering with at least 5+ years of experience in IT automation, AI tools solution and implementation 
 - Hands-on experience designing and shipping Gen AI solutions using tools such as OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot, Claude, Cursor, Github Co-pilot & Others. 
 - Proficiency in a programming language such as Python, Java, or similar, with the ability to build and integrate APIs and workflows. 
 - Working knowledge of AI / ML frameworks, prompt engineering, RAG patterns, and agentic / workflow automation (e. g. , n8n, Zapier). 
 - Strong understanding of enterprise IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, and cloud technologies (Azure, AWS, and / or Google Workspace). 
 - Experience with Microsoft productivity and platform tooling: O365, SharePoint, and the Microsoft 365 / Power Platform ecosystem. 
 - Demonstrated ability to integrate AI solutions with existing IT systems, with a focus on scalability, security, and reliability. 
 - Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, and stakeholder-management skills. 
 - Experience deploying Gen AI in a high-speed, AI-driven organisation, with a focus on innovation and scale. 
 - Familiarity with IT security frameworks and identity tooling (LDAP, Entra ID, SSO / IdP, VPNs). 
 - Exposure to SOC automation, AI-driven ITSM, and / or InfoSec response automation. 
 - Understanding of SaaS / Gen AI cost governance, usage-based billing, and license management. 
 - Experience mentoring engineers and leading cross-functional technical initiatives.

Description

Come build the future of entertainment with us. Are you interested in shaping the future of movies and television? Do you want to define the next generation of how and what Amazon customers are watching?

Prime Video is a premium streaming service that offers customers a vast collection of TV shows and movies - all with the ease of finding what they love to watch in one place. We offer customers thousands of popular movies and TV shows including Amazon Originals and exclusive licensed content to exciting live sports events. We also offer our members the opportunity to subscribe to add-on channels which they can cancel at anytime and to rent or buy new release movies and TV box sets on the Prime Video Store. Prime Video is a fast-paced, growth business - available in over 200 countries and territories worldwide. The team works in a dynamic environment where innovating on behalf of our customers is at the heart of everything we do. If this sounds exciting to you, please read on. 

Our Playback Operations Systems Group is looking for a motivated, results-oriented, dedicated and operationally focused System Development Engineer to support the fast-evolving and expanding device automation systems, that support our live events and 24/7 linear operations. You will have an enormous opportunity to work within multiple systems analyzing and identifying the common issues, and driving the teams towards resolution to have a positive impact on customer experience. This job requires you to learn quickly and work on disparate and overlapping tasks. 

Key job responsibilities

- Design and deliver systems and automation that scale Prime Video's Live OTT delivery and 24/7 linear operations
 - Own the operational health of device automation and monitoring systems - identify resilience risks and deliver solutions that eliminate them
 - Improve monitoring capabilities and system reliability, reducing manual operational load across the team
 - Define and maintain operational metrics and service level objectives, with alarming based on service health
 - Drive resolution of difficult performance, reliability, and availability issues, leaving systems better than you found them
 - Partner with adjacent Live Ops engineering teams to improve how systems interact and integrate

A day in the life

Your morning starts by reviewing operational dashboards and alerts, ensuring live services are healthy. When issues arise-latency spikes, availability drops-you collaborate with the team to diagnose and resolve them quickly. 

Mid-morning shifts to development: enhancing automation scripts, improving device monitoring workflows, and testing changes in staging environments to reduce manual intervention during live events. 

Afternoons bring cross-team collaboration-troubleshooting priority tickets with encoding and operations engineers, deploying fixes before high-profile events go live, and designing monitoring solutions that scale with Prime Video's growing live sports portfolio. 

About The Team

The Playback Ops Systems Group build and maintain reliable, high performance customer experience monitoring tooling and infrastructure. We take ownership of the end-to-end live monitoring experience -- from a Living Room device, through our encoding and analysis platform, out through to our Live Ops AVOCs (Amazon Video Operation Centres). Our team makes a big impact because nothing is more important to us than delighting our customers, continually earning their trust, and thinking long term. If you crave a sense of ownership, this is the place to be. 

Basic Qualifications

- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby
 - Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting large-scale infrastructure
 - Experience with Linux/Unix
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes
 - Experience with distributed systems at scale

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
 - Experience utilizing AWS cloud solutions in a DevOps environment
 - Experience establishing metrics for measurement of engineering and operational excellence
 - Experience in major facilities incident management
 - Experience in creating process improvements with automation and analysis, or experience working in a large team or fast-paced corporate environment
 - supporting or automating physical device fleets, encoding appliances, or hardware infrastructure

data.title: Data Platform Engineer
data.description:
Why Verifone

For more than 30 years, Verifone has established a remarkable record of leadership in the electronic payment technology industry. Verifone is one of the leading electronic payment solutions brands and among the largest providers of electronic payment systems worldwide. 

Verifone has a diverse, dynamic, and fast-paced work environment in which employees are focused on results and have opportunities to excel. We take pride in working with leading retailers, merchants, banks, and third-party partners to invent and deliver innovative payment solutions around the world. We strive for excellence in our products and services and are obsessed with customer happiness. 

Across the globe, Verifone employees are leading the payments industry through experience, innovation, and an ambitious spirit. Whether it's developing the next generation of secure payment systems or finding new ways to bring electronic payments to emerging markets, the Verifone team is dedicated to the success of our customers, partners, and investors. It is this passion for innovation that drives every Verifone employee toward personal and professional success. 

Verifone is proudly an in-office work culture as we see immense benefits to career development and business results from our colleagues being physically co-located. 

What's Exciting About The Role

Verifone is looking for a Data Platform Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team. Rather than being a single-technology specialist position, this is a unique opportunity to your generalist skillset to own and evolve a broad data platform that spans streaming pipelines, multiple database technologies, on prem and cloud infrastructure, and DevOps/SRE operational tooling. 

We are looking for experience in core technologies including Kafka, Redis, Data Lake technologies and Cloud Engineering, with the opportunity to leverage other skills such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, SQL Server and more. You will design and operate end-to-end data pipelines that power new AI and analytics initiatives, migrate streaming services to Kubernetes, and build the automation and tooling that reduces operational toil across the team. 

If you are energized by working across the full data stack-pipelines, databases, infrastructure, observability, and CI/CD-rather than going deep on a single technology, this role is built for you. 

Key Responsibilities

Data Platform & Pipeline Development

- Design, build, and optimize end-to-end data pipelines-streaming and batch-that serve Verifone's AI, machine learning, and analytics initiatives. 
 - Work with diverse data technologies and formats: streaming via Kafka, batch via ETL processes, file formats such as Parquet, and table formats such as Iceberg or Delta Lake. 
 - Collaborate with data engineering and development teams to enforce best practices for data flow, schema design, security, scalability, and performance. 
 - Continuously improve data pipeline reliability, latency, and throughput across the full SDLC. 
 - Support and integrate AWS data tooling including Athena, Glue, Redshift, and S3-based data lake patterns. 

Streaming Infrastructure (Kafka & Ecosystem)

- Manage and support Apache Kafka clusters (including AWS MSK), Kafka Connect, and KSQL for high-throughput, fault-tolerant event streaming. 
 - Handle day-to-day Kafka operations: offset management, lag monitoring, consumer group management, cluster rebalancing, and partition tuning. 
 - Perform cluster maintenance: upgrades, configuration changes, scaling events, and health checks. 
 - Drive incident response and root cause analysis (RCA) for streaming platform issues. 
 - Participate in the active effort to migrate Kafka and related services to Kubernetes. 

Database Operations

- Operate and support multiple database technologies in production: Redis, PostgreSQL and MySQL (indexing, replication, HA/DR, query tuning), and MongoDB. 
 - Perform routine maintenance across database platforms: upgrades, configuration tuning, health monitoring, and capacity planning. 
 - Support Snowflake data warehouse operations and integrations as part of the broader analytics stack. 
 - Implement and uphold data security practices including encryption-in-transit/at-rest, secrets management, and least-privilege access across all data stores. 

DevOps, SRE & Automation

- Develop and maintain automation scripts (Python, Bash) to reduce manual toil and improve platform reliability. 
 - Design, implement, and manage CI/CD pipelines for patching, deployment, and configuration automation. 
 - Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, Ansible, or similar tools. 
 - Containerize and orchestrate workloads using Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Manage cloud infrastructure on AWS: EC2, VPC, IAM, MSK, ElastiCache, CloudWatch, and related services. 
 - Set up and maintain observability tooling-metrics, logs, and tracing-and participate in on-call incident response. 
 - Support cloud migration tasks, moving workloads between on-prem and cloud environments. 

Required Qualifications / Skills

We are looking for a well-rounded platform engineer with experience in Kafka, Redis, Data Lake technologies and Cloud Engineering. Candidates should demonstrate breadth across data, databases, DevOps and SRE skills: 

- 5+ years of overall engineering experience, with demonstrated work across data pipelines, database operations, and infrastructure-not limited to a single technology. 
 - Hands-on experience with Kafka or another distributed streaming platform (Kafka, Kinesis, Pulsar) in a production environment. 
 - Operational experience with at least two of the following database technologies: Redis, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redshift or Snowflake. 
 - Proven data pipeline experience: building or maintaining ETL/ELT processes, batch jobs, or streaming pipelines that serve analytics or operational use cases. 
 - Strong scripting and automation skills (Python and/or Bash) with a track record of reducing manual toil. 
 - CI/CD pipeline development and Infrastructure-as-Code experience (Terraform preferred). 
 - Solid Linux fundamentals: networking basics, log analysis, system troubleshooting, process/memory/disk management. 
 - Cloud engineering experience, preferably AWS (EC2, VPC, IAM, MSK/ElastiCache, CloudWatch). 
 - Familiarity with observability practices-metrics, logs, tracing-and incident response workflows. 
 - Understanding of distributed systems trade-offs: availability, consistency, partitions, backpressure. 
 - Strong communication skills including the ability to present platform status and technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Flexibility for on-call rotation and occasional weekend support. 

Preferred Skills (Highly Desired)

Data Engineering Depth

- Experience with stream processing frameworks: Kafka Streams, Apache Flink, or similar. 
 - Familiarity with data lake table formats: Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Apache Hudi. 
 - Hands-on experience with AWS data services: Athena, Glue, Redshift, or Lake Formation. 
 - Working knowledge of Snowflake-data loading, query optimization, or integration patterns. 
 - Understanding of data quality, data lineage, or schema registry concepts. 

Infrastructure & Security

- Container/Kubernetes depth: deployments, StatefulSets, storage classes, Helm. 
 - On-prem infrastructure experience: VMware/KVM, SAN/NAS storage, network configuration. 
 - Security and compliance experience, particularly PCI-DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard). 
 - Secrets management tooling: HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, or similar. 

What We Offer

- Broad platform ownership-you will work across Kafka, Redis, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Snowflake, and more, growing as a well-rounded platform engineer rather than a single-tool specialist. 
 - Direct impact on Verifone's global payment infrastructure-your work keeps billions of transactions flowing reliably every year. 
 - Ground-floor involvement in building the data pipelines that will drive Verifone's AI, machine learning, and analytics strategy. 
 - Hands-on participation in a Kafka-to-Kubernetes migration-a meaningful infrastructure modernization project from day one. 
 - Mentorship from senior engineers and platform architects with deep production experience. 
 - Clear career progression path from mid-level to senior and lead engineer. 
 - Funded certification paths-Confluent (CCDAK, Certified Administrator), AWS (Solutions Architect, MSK Specialty), CKA, dbt-plus budget for courses and technical conferences. 
 - Hybrid/remote working flexibility with a collaborative team culture. 
 - Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives. 

Our Commitment

Verifone is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Verifone is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status.

data.title: Agent Operations Engineer
data.description:
About Sidekick Machines

Sidekick Machines is an AI startup that builds and runs AI agents for enterprises. Most agent projects stall on infrastructure: identity, security, integrations, approvals, monitoring and cost. We built our own platform, Sidekick, on Microsoft's agent stack to handle that infrastructure. Our engineers spend their time on the work that matters, and we stay on to run every agent we ship. 

Agentic AI is new, and nobody has a decade of it. We hire people with strong fundamentals and the drive to figure things out, and we teach the rest. 

The role

We don't build an agent and walk away. We stay and run it, and that's one of the most important things we offer our clients. You'll keep their agents healthy in production: watching quality, controlling cost and fixing what breaks. The Sidekick platform gives you the tracing, evals and controls to do this across many agents at once, so you spend your time improving agents, not building tooling. 

If you've worked in managed services or application support at a consultancy, you already know most of this job. The difference is that the systems you run are AI agents. 

What you'll do

- Track evals for the agents you look after, and catch quality drift before users notice. 
 - Engineer cost: find where agents spend too much and bring it down without hurting quality. 
 - Handle break-fix: trace a failure to its cause (a prompt, a tool, an integration, a model change) and fix it. 
 - Test and roll out model, prompt and tool updates safely. 
 - Report to clients on how their agents are doing, in plain business terms. 

What we're looking for

- 3-5 years of experience in managed services, application support, SRE or DevOps, ideally at a consultancy or systems integrator. 
 - Strong troubleshooting. You're comfortable digging through logs, traces and metrics. 
 - Enough scripting (Python or similar) to automate checks and ship fixes. 
 - Comfort with numbers: usage, cost, SLAs. 
 - Calm, clear communication with clients, especially when something's broken. 

Bonus

- Exposure to LLM apps, evals or observability tools. 
 - Experience with cloud cost optimization. 

Training

We'll teach you how agents fail and how to fix them, and you'll shadow the team on live client agents before you look after your own. 

Compensation and how to apply

- Compensation: Salary plus ESOPs
 - To apply: careers@sidekickmachines. com

About The Business

Tata Electronics Private Limited (TEPL) is a greenfield venture of the Tata Group with expertise in manufacturing precision components. 

Tata Electronics (a wholly owned subsidiary of Tata Sons Pvt. Ltd. ) is building India's first AI-enabled state-of-the-art Semiconductor Foundry. This facility will produce chips for applications such as power management IC, display drivers, microcontrollers (MCU) and high-performance computing logic, addressing the growing demand in markets such as automotive, computing and data storage, wireless communications and artificial intelligence. 

Tata Electronics is a subsidiary of the Tata group. The Tata Group operates in more than 100 countries across six continents, with the mission 'To improve the quality of life of the communities we serve globally, through long term stakeholder value creation based on leadership with Trust. '

About The Role

An IC Test Development Engineer develops and implements automated test equipment and programs for design verification and production testing of integrated circuits (ICs). This includes designing electronic circuits, writing test software, and ensuring robust and cost-effective testing solutions. Develop the test hardware Load board and Probe cards for the devices. 

Key Responsibilities

- Test Program & Solution Development: Takes ownership of the entire test solution development process, from initial concept to implementation. 
 - Test Plan Development: Creating comprehensive test plans to cover all aspects of the chip's functionality. 
 - Sound knowledge on Digital, Mixed signal, RF test methodologies. Experience in developing the test programs in ATE environment for Digital, mixed signal, RF devices. 
 - Device debug for Digital, Mixed Signal, RF devices using ATE tools and verify with bench Test results. 
 - Responsible for working with different teams for understanding the device datasheet and come up with a detailed Test procedure/plan to test the chip in ATE environment. 
 - Strong working experience in Teradyne test systems like ETS (364/88/800), Ultra Flex, J750, Magnum, Advantest V93K systems or any other ATE Tester. 
 - Build ATE hardware design (load board & probe card), PCB design tools and Signal Integrity analysis. 
 - Need to interact with the PCB design team for developing the necessary hardware - Test load board, bench board and probe cards. 
 - Knowledge on Device Characterization, testing at different temperatures. 
 - Knowledge on data extraction tool like Perl, Python will be added advantage. 
 - Performance Optimization: Improves testing processes and methodologies to ensure efficient and cost-effective testing. 
 - Documentation: Creates and maintains test documentation, including test plans, specifications, and procedures. 
 - Collaboration: Works closely with cross-functional teams, including design, manufacturing, and quality assurance, to ensure seamless integration and testing of ICs. 
 - Test Execution: Running tests on the manufactured silicon, including both pre-silicon (emulation) and post-silicon platforms. 
 - Expertise in High Speed Serdes Interface characterization and protocol compliance testing such as PCIe/Ethernet/SDI/Coa Xpress/JESD204, MIPI D-PHY, MIPI CSI/DSI-2, USB and DisplayPort/HDMI etc.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer - Logistics Microservices
data.description:
Job Description

About Williams-Sonoma, Inc. 

Founded in 1956 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is a Fortune 500, digital first, multi-channel specialty retailer. Our company vision is to own the home, and the places where our customers work, stay, and play. We bring the latest home furnishing trends to life for customers through the individual lenses of our ten distinct brands, each serving different life stages and rooms of the home and beyond. Our brands include Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, West Elm, Rejuvenation, Mark & Graham, GreenRow, and Dormify. We are committed to sustainability, continuously working to protect our planet, while building an open and collaborative culture across our organization. 

With more than 500 retail stores globally and multiple international franchise operations, technology is a core driver of our business strategy. We build and operate in-house platforms powering e-commerce, supply chain, merchandising, analytics, and customer experience ecosystems worldwide. 

The Logistics Technology team at Williams-Sonoma, Inc. builds and supports the platforms that move product across our supply chain - from distribution center operations and warehouse management to transportation and delivery for brands including Williams Sonoma, Pottery Barn, West Elm, and Rejuvenation. We partner closely with Supply Chain, Distribution Center operations, and third-party vendors to deliver scalable microservices that keep fulfillment fast, accurate, and cost-effective. It is a hands-on, high-ownership team where engineers work end to end - designing systems, integrating with WMS and TMS platforms, and applying automation and AI to improve how our distribution network runs every day.

data.title: Senior Member of Technical Staff ML Systems and Infrastructure
data.description:
About DevRev

At DevRev, we're building the future of work with Computer - your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools, Computer unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers - updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries. 

What You'll Do

- Architect the Future of AI Infrastructure: You will design, build, and own the end-to-end platform that supports the entire lifecycle of our ML models-from massive-scale distributed training to ultra-low-latency, highly-available inference. 
 - Optimize and Serve Cutting-Edge Models: You'll implement and scale sophisticated inference stacks for LLMs using frameworks like vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, or SGLang. You'll solve complex challenges in throughput, latency, token streaming, and automated scaling to deliver a seamless user experience. 
 - Empower AI Innovation: You will act as a strategic partner to our AI Research and Data Science teams. You'll create a seamless developer experience that accelerates their ability to experiment, fine-tune, and deploy groundbreaking models with velocity and confidence. 
 - Automate Everything: You'll develop robust CI/CD/CT (Continuous Training) pipelines using tools like Argo Workflows, ArgoCD, and GitHub Actions to automate model validation, deployment, and lifecycle management, ensuring our systems are both agile and rock-solid. 

What Are We Looking For

- Experience: 5+ years in infrastructure or software engineering, with at least 2+ years laser-focused on MLOps or ML infrastructure for large-scale distributed systems. 
 - Education: A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Kubernetes & Cloud Native Expertise: Deep, hands-on expertise with Kubernetes in production. You are fluent in the cloud-native ecosystem, including Helm, ArgoCD, and Argo Workflows. 
 - GPU & Cloud Mastery: Optimize the platform's performance and scalability, considering factors such as GPU resource utilization, data ingestion, model training, and deployment. 
 - Modern LLM Serving Experience: Hands-on experience with modern LLM inference serving frameworks (e. g. , vLLM, SGLang, Triton Inference Server, Ray Serve). You understand the unique challenges of serving generative models. 
 - Strong Coder: Strong programming proficiency in Python or Go, with experience using ML frameworks like PyTorch, Jax, TensorFlow. 
 - Observability Mindset: A passion for building observable and resilient systems using modern monitoring tools (e. g. , Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry). 

We Would Love To See

- Deep performance optimization skills, including writing custom inference kernels in CUDA or Triton to accelerate model performance beyond what off-the-shelf frameworks provide. 
 - Experience with model optimization techniques like quantization, distillation, and speculative decoding. 
 - Exposure to training and serving multi-modal models (e. g. , text-to-image, vision-language).

data.title: Staff Software Engineer (Technical Lead)
data.description:
Job Description Summary

As a Staff Software Engineer (Technical Leader), you will provide technical leadership for a Scrum team while shaping the architecture and long‐term technical direction of the product. You will own system‐level design decisions, guide teams through complex technical challenges, and ensure scalable, high‐quality delivery. This role blends hands‐on engineering with mentorship, cross‐functional collaboration, and strategic influence to elevate both product outcomes and engineering maturity. 

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

Technical

- Own and drive the technical design and architecture of large systems, feature areas, and critical components. 
 - Lead architectural discussions, design reviews, and technical decision‐making across one or more Scrum teams. 
 - Define and evolve clean interfaces, data flows and system boundaries across modules and services. 
 - Make high‐impact technology and design decisions through deep analysis, trade‐off evaluation, and long‐term impact assessment. 
 - Establish and uphold engineering standards for code quality, testing, performance, security, and reliability. 
 - Proactively identify and address scalability, performance, and resiliency concerns at a system level. 
 - Serve as a technical authority in core data structures, algorithms, and the primary technology stack. 

Process & Delivery

- Partner with Product Owners and Scrum Masters to shape technical roadmaps and align execution with product vision. 
 - Provide technical input into scope definition, planning, estimation, and risk assessment. 
 - Guide the breakdown of complex epics into executable stories while ensuring architectural integrity. 
 - Enable consistent, predictable delivery in a fast‐paced Agile environment. 
 - Drive continuous improvement in engineering processes, CI/CD pipelines, and development practices. 
 - Balance short‐term delivery needs with long‐term technical sustainability. 

Mentorship & Organizational Impact

- Act as the technical leader for the Scrum team, influencing engineering practices beyond direct reporting lines. 
 - Mentor Senior and mid‐level engineers, raising the overall technical bar and engineering judgment across the team. 
 - Provide thoughtful, timely code reviews focused on design quality, maintainability, and system impact. 
 - Identify and resolve technical blockers, dependencies, and cross‐team coordination challenges. 
 - Champion engineering best practices and foster a culture of ownership, learning, and accountability. 
 - Serve as a trusted partner to architects, product leaders, UX, and other engineering teams. 

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related STEM field. 
 - 10+ years of professional software development experience with demonstrated technical leadership. 
 - Proven experience leading architecture and design in Agile/Scrum environments. 

Desired Characteristics

- Deep expertise in modern C++ (C++14) and large‐scale, production‐quality system design. 
 - Strong experience with embedded Linux development and close collaboration with hardware teams. 
 - Advanced knowledge of Yocto, IP networking, device drivers, interfaces, and embedded system architecture. 
 - Solid experience with DevOps practices, CI/CD, and containerization (Docker). 
 - Strong background in network programming, including TCP/IP and socket‐level development in C++.

 - Ability to influence technical direction, communicate complex concepts clearly, and lead through expertise rather than authority.

data.title: Engineering Manager, Data Platform – Managed Connectors
data.description:
About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. 

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365-all within 90 seconds. 

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1. 8B+ from the world's top investors including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. 

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling. com addresses. 

About The Role

Rippling is building a Data Cloud that powers analytics and intelligence across 30+ products, and the Managed Connectors team is a critical part of that platform. 

As the Engineering Manager for Managed Connectors, you'll build and lead this charter from India, owning the platform that brings data from systems such as Salesforce, GitHub, Google Calendar, databases, and other third-party applications into Rippling's analytics ecosystem. 

Today, the Data Cloud runs 60, 000+ analytical workloads every day, with that scale expected to grow to hundreds of thousands of workloads as we expand the platform. 

This is a highly technical EM role. You'll stay close to architecture and system design, lead a strong engineering team, partner with Product on roadmap and strategy, and help define how Rippling builds and operates connectors at scale. 

About The Team

The Managed Connectors team is responsible for integrating data from external sources and internal Rippling products to fuel the company's analytics ecosystem. We build the bridges that allow our customers to bring in data from sources such as GitHub, Salesforce, and Google Calendar to drive deep insights and trends analysis. 

The broader organization has 30+ engineers across San Francisco, Toronto, and Bangalore. The Managed Connectors team builds the infrastructure that allows customers to bring external and internal data into the platform reliably and at scale. 

What You Will Do

- Own the Managed Connectors charter end-to-end, from technical strategy and architecture through execution and operations
 - Define the team's roadmap in partnership with Product and Data Cloud leadership
 - Build scalable distributed systems that reliably ingest data from a wide variety of external sources
 - Create strong engineering mechanisms around reliability, quality, observability, and operational excellence
 - Help shape the team's culture, hiring strategy, and technical direction as the organization grows
 - Drive automation that makes building and operating connectors dramatically more efficient

What You Will Need

- At least 8 years of experience in software development and delivery, with in-depth knowledge of software architectures; and at least 3 years of experience as an Engineering Managers in leading development teams
 - A strong technical foundation in backend engineering, distributed systems, data infrastructure, or platform engineering
 - Experience owning complex systems from architecture through production
 - The ability to lead engineers while remaining deeply hands-on and engaged in technical decision-making
 - Team development skills: ability to set a roadmap and goals for a team and every one of its members, delegate intelligently, offer engineering advice, deliver frequent and transparent feedback, work with team members to grow in their careers, and ensure everyone delivers quality results
 - Experience working across engineering, product, and other stakeholder teams to drive ambiguous initiatives to completion

Additional Information

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling. com

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

data.title: Full-Stack Engineer Senior Manager, SDLC Platforms
data.description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact. 

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures-and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive. 

What You'll Do

As the Technical Lead for SDLC platform engineering and automation, you will define the technical direction for an enterprise AI platform that transforms the software development lifecycle through intelligent automation. Working in close partnership with Product Management and engineering leaders, you will design scalable AI capabilities - including integrations across the Atlassian ecosystem (Jira, Confluence, Forge, Atlas, Automation) and modern practices such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP), event-driven architectures, and retrieval-augmented workflows - that improve developer productivity, accelerate software delivery, and strengthen engineering quality across the organization. 

You will serve as the technical authority for AI architecture, establishing engineering standards, guiding implementation decisions, and mentoring engineers while driving the evolution from event-driven AI capabilities toward increasingly autonomous, multi-agent systems. You will lead architecture reviews, evaluate emerging AI technologies, and ensure platforms are secure, resilient, observable, and aligned with enterprise architecture, governance, and Responsible AI principles - balancing innovation with enterprise-grade reliability and operational excellence

What You'll Bring

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related discipline (must have); relevant AI or cloud certifications are a plus 
 - 8+ years of software engineering experience, including demonstrated technical leadership designing and delivering enterprise-scale software platforms (must have). 
 - Demonstrated expertise in enterprise AI, Generative AI, and intelligent agent architectures, with experience building secure, scalable, production-ready AI solutions (must have). 
 - Strong knowledge of software architecture, cloud-native engineering, distributed systems, API-first design, and event-driven architectures across Azure and AWS; experience with OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, MCP, and orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph or Semantic Kernel 
 - Experience integrating modern engineering platforms and DevSecOps ecosystems, including Atlassian products (Jira, Confluence, Forge, Atlas, Automation) and CI/CD pipelines; proven ability to influence technical direction and mentor engineers (preferred). 

Who You'll Work With

You will work as part of a multidisciplinary engineering organization focused on transforming the software development lifecycle through AI-driven automation. You'll partner closely with Product Management, Platform Engineering, Software Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Security, and DevSecOps teams to design and deliver scalable AI capabilities, and will engage regularly with engineering leaders, architects, and technical specialists to establish standards, evolve platform capabilities, and drive adoption of modern AI engineering practices. 

Additional info

YOU'RE GOOD AT

- Performing and managing rigorous, logical, and accurate analysis of complex AI architecture and platform challenges - identifying and framing complex problems, addressing root causes, and drawing out innovative insights rather than surface-level fixes. 
 - Writing clear and concise communications and leading conversations and meetings effectively - modulating your style to audience and context, actively listening, and driving to conclusions based on data and expertise to influence engineering leaders and cross-functional stakeholders. 
 - Structuring, planning, and prioritizing complex technical work; anticipating and managing changing priorities while managing and delivering high-quality output that is mindful of impact on the broader business. 
 - Partnering effectively with diverse teams and networks - Product Management, Platform Engineering, Security, and DevSecOps - while coaching engineers, creating opportunities for their development, and striking the right balance between empowerment and managerial direction. 
 - Embracing change with adaptability and agility, bringing curiosity and creativity to continually evolve how the team works, while performing with the highest level of integrity and a growth mindset that generates trust across the organization. 

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development. 

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices. 

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork. 

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

 - Experience with cloud data infrastructure and databases, including understanding of performance, scalability, reliability, and cost tradeoffs.

data.title: Support AI Manager
data.description:
About Ethos

Ethos is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten. 

About The Role

We're looking for a Support AI Manager to lead the team that builds and safeguards the quality of our AI-powered support bots. This role owns two connected functions: the bot building team (led day-to-day by a build Lead who designs ERDs and manages hands-on development) and the bot monitoring team (with functions including bot functionality audits, bug handling, quality control, and support). You'll manage and scale both, while remaining hands-on enough to personally evaluate bot builds against spec and catch issues before they reach customers. 

The what and how of the roadmap are owned by our CX AI Product Manager, who sets priorities and writes the PRDs. Your job is to make sure what gets built actually matches that spec, to define how we test and monitor bots on an ongoing basis, and to make sure quality issues make it back into the roadmap fast. This is a hands-on technical leadership role, not a purely administrative one - you should be comfortable reviewing a build yourself, not just hearing about it secondhand. 

Duties And Responsibilities

- Manage and grow the bot building team and the bot quality/monitoring team, including coaching the build Lead as they grow into managing a focused, subject matter expert team of builders. 
 - Personally review bot builds and version deploys against approved ERDs and PRDs, catching spec drift, gaps, or quality issues before launch. 
 - Define and own the testing cadence for the team - pre-launch UAT, regression testing, and frequency and scope of live bot audits. 
 - Own the feedback loop between quality/monitoring findings and the roadmap, making sure issues surfaced by your team get back to the Product Manager and build Lead quickly and are prioritized appropriately. 
 - Consolidate all feedback into a clear, structured format, ensuring all items are accurately tracked and escalated where appropriate. 
 - Serve as the primary escalation point when a build doesn't match spec or a quality issue is found, working directly with the build and quality teams to resolve it. 
 - Partner closely with the CX AI Product Manager to keep the build and quality functions aligned with roadmap priorities and sequencing. 
 - Use bot performance metrics (deflection rate, true resolution rate, CSAT, error rates) to spot systemic quality issues and drive process improvements across build and monitoring. 
 - Build and evolve the team's testing/monitoring playbook as the bot portfolio grows. 

Qualifications And Skills

- 4+ years of experience managing a team, ideally across more than one function or workstream. 
 - Hands-on experience with the design, build, or QA of AI-driven voice, chat or email bots - enough technical depth to personally evaluate a build against an ERD or PRD. 
 - Experience working within a product pod or similar cross-functional product team structure, partnering closely with a product manager. 
 - Strong process orientation - comfortable defining and owning a testing and monitoring cadence from scratch, not just following an existing one. 
 - Detail-oriented, with strong problem-solving instincts and a track record of leading a team through issue resolution. 
 - Excellent communicator, able to translate technical build or quality issues for both technical teams and product/business stakeholders. 
 - Experience with support bot platforms (e. g. , Forethought, Ada, Sierra, Decagon) is a strong plus. 

Don't meet every single requirement? If you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At Ethos we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. 

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the SF Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider employment for qualified applicants with arrests and conviction records. 

To learn more about what information we collect and how it may be used, please refer to our California Candidate Privacy Notice. 

Recruitment Notice: Please be aware of recruitment scams. All legitimate communication from our team will only come from email addresses ending in @ethos. com or @getethos. com. 

We will never ask for payment, banking details, or sensitive personal information during the hiring process. If you are contacted by someone claiming to represent us from a different email address, please treat it as fraudulent.

At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today.

Full-Stack AI & Automation Engineer

Human Resources - Strategic Planning & Analytics CoE

About The Team & Your Role

Strategic Planning & Analytics team is architected to move beyond traditional HR, functioning as a strategic engine that fuels ST's growth through five specialized pillars: Business Partnerships, Products & AI, Workforce Insights, Data Science, and Workforce Planning Architecture. We are currently in an ambitious build-phase, moving away from legacy processes to create a sophisticated, tech-enabled function that mirrors the engineering excellence of the semiconductor industry. We don't want to just manage headcount; we want to orchestrate the future of HR using AI. 

As a member of this team, you won't be working in a silo. You will be at the intersection of human capital and advanced technology, leveraging AI and data science to solve complex organizational challenges and expected to be a foundational builder. We are looking for pioneers to help us design and implement our first generation of advanced analytics and AI-driven products. You won't just be using technology-you will be architecting the roadmap, selecting the tools, and establishing the frameworks that will define how ST manages its global talent for years to come. If you are energized by the challenge of redefining the "H" in HR through the lens of data and innovation, you've found the right place. 

Responsibilities

- End-to-End AI Prototyping: Architect, build, and deploy conversational bots and transactional AI agents from scratch in a sandbox environment. 
 - Workflow Orchestration & Automation: Design and manage complex, multi-system automation workflows using tools like n8n to automate actions (e. g. , orchestrating system lookups, mock API executions, and conditional task routing). 
 - LLM Integration & Prompt Engineering: Integrate prototypes securely with internal OpenAI/ChatGPT APIs, mastering prompt design, function calling, tool use, and state management. 
 - Interface & UI/UX Evolution: Build lightweight, responsive web interfaces (e. g. , Streamlit, Next. js) for quick stakeholder testing, ensuring the backend logic is decoupled via webhooks for future migration into Microsoft Teams.
