data.description:
If you are looking for a challenging and exciting career in the world of technology, then look no further. Skyworks is an innovator of high performance analog semiconductors whose solutions are powering the wireless networking revolution. At Skyworks, you will find a fast-paced environment with a strong focus on global collaboration, minimal layers of management and the freedom to make meaningful contributions in a setting that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking. We are excited about the opportunity to work with you and glad you want to be part of a team of talented individuals who together can change the way the world communicates. 

Requisition ID: 77773

About Skyworks

If you are looking for a challenging and exciting career in the world of technology, then look no further. Skyworks is an innovator of high-performance analog semiconductors whose solutions are powering the wireless networking revolution. At Skyworks, you will find a fast-paced environment with a strong focus on global collaboration, minimal layers of management and the freedom to make meaningful contributions in a setting that encourages creativity and out of the box thinking. We are excited about the opportunity to work with you and glad you want to be part of a team of talented individuals who together can change the way the world communicates. 

Skyworks offers the industry's broadest Timing product portfolio of crystal oscillator, clock generator, clock buffer, jitter attenuator and network synchronizer products. Our patented technology combines best-in-class frequency flexibility with the lowest jitter in the industry, delivering quick-turn, customized solutions that simplify board design, eliminate discrete components, and maximize system performance. 

Position Overview

The IC Validation team leads all post-silicon activities, including chip bring-up, validation, and characterization of new timing devices. You will play a key role in our New Product Introduction (NPI) cycle, as our products cross from pre-silicon design to post-silicon validation to ensure exceptional product quality and performance. In this role, the ability to quickly debug and resolve performance issues will be critical to delivering world-class products to our customers. 

We seek candidates who demonstrate a passion for learning, initiative, curiosity, and engineering ingenuity. A positive attitude and a strong disposition for teamwork are essential. 

Position Responsibilities

- Support our Timing Design team based out of the Skyworks Bangaluru office with new IC bring-up, validation, and characterization. 
 - Test and debug system and block functionality of new timing ICs. 
 - Perform silicon characterization through the development of robust and reusable tests to determine device datasheet specifications
 - Lead the design and development of high-speed PCBs (EEVBs), including discrete analog circuits, used for validation and characterization. 
 - Assemble and maintain test setups in the laboratory to support validation and characterization. 
 - Define, develop, and/or acquire software and/or hardware tools in support of silicon test efforts. 
 - Develop automation scripts to automate data collection, decrease data collection times, ensure repeatable measurements, and generate reports. 
 - Own post-processing the characterization data, conducting a detailed analysis (we use JMP for this purpose), and then reviewing the analyzed data with the IC design and marketing teams. 

Required Experience And Skills

- Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering with 5+ years of relevant experience, or a Master's with 3 years of experience. 
 - Strong EE fundamentals; experience with PLLs, synthesizers, and jitter strongly preferred
 - Background in validation, test, or characterization of IC devices
 - Extensive hands-on experience with lab instrumentation (oscilloscopes, signal generators, spectrum/phase noise analyzers, power supplies, etc. )
 - Ability to troubleshoot and debug hardware and software
 - Experience developing automated test systems and validation infrastructure
 - Proficiency in programming for test/automation (Python, . NET preferred, or similar)
 - Experience with test frameworks and data analysis tools (JMP, MATLAB, or equivalent)
 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to cross-functional teams

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa's all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

Generic Skills

The Quality Advisor works closely with the Asia HSEQ team and reports to the Associate Quality Excellence (India). This person will also ensure quality compliance and liaise with Project teams where required, closely work with the Associate Quality Excellence (India) to provide source support and guidance to our Project Leaders, Quality leads, and their teams deliver an effective quality management framework across their project programmes.

- Ensure that our people follow our way of working, the requirements of the Project Life Cycle (PLC) and Integrated Management System (IMS) 
 - Support and promote our quality management system (QMS) 
 - Perform online scheduled quality audits and reviews across all projects and undertake surveillances as required, including reports. 
 - Use quality management tools and techniques to promote continual improvement and quality awareness 
 - Predict quality performance using trends and reports, lead actions to address risk elsewhere in the business 
 - Provide quality management support and assistance, working closely with the project teams 
 - Provide inputs to our quality statistical tracking and trending data, provide weekly and monthly reports. 
 - Advises the projects on suitable quality objectives, KPIs and targets in line with WSP and client quality requirements, report for any deviations noted.

Why does it matter to our Business?

 - Process and system audits enable us to understand the true position of compliance and risk 
 - Embedding a compliance and improvement culture drives long term resilience in our approach to right first time and maintains our organisational ISO certifications 
 - Ensures that our governance and operational process are fit for purpose. 

How do I know when I am successful at what I do?

- Reduction of complaints and improvement in project teams compliance with WSP way of working. 
 - Building strong relationships with project leads and Quality Managers 
 - I achieve our targets and objectives for support, compliance, and training. 
 - Our people are actively engaging in quality collaboration and excellence

- Strong Analytical Skills 
 - Attention to Detail 
 - Technical Proficiency 
 - Excellent Communication Skills 
 - Problem-Solving Abilities 
 - Knowledge of Quality Techniques 
 - Adaptability and Continuous Learning 
 - Strong Documentation Skills.

 - Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process - including documents uploaded - is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner". 

About Us

WSP is one of the world's leading professional services consulting firms. We are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower. We are technical experts and strategic advisors including engineers, technicians, scientists, architects, planners, surveyors and environmental specialists, as well as other design, program and construction management professionals. With approximately 4, 000 talented people across 3 locations (Noida, Bengaluru & Mumbai offices) in India and more than 73, 000 globally, in 550 offices across 40 countries, we engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come. 

At "WSP" we draw on the diverse skills and capabilities of our employees globally to compete for the most exciting and complex projects across the world and bring the same level of expertise to our local communities. We are proud to be an international collective of innovative thinkers who work on the most complex problems. Unified under one strong brand, we use our local expertise, international reach and global scale to prepare our cities and environments for the future, connect communities and help societies thrive in built and natural ecosystems. True to our guiding principles, our business is built on four cornerstones: Our People, Our Clients, Our Operational Excellence and Our Expertise.

Job Description

Senior Demo Platform Architect - Contact Center and Customer Experience

Position Overview: We are seeking a seasoned Senior Demo Platform Engineer with deep expertise in contact center technologies and CX suites, preferably Zendesk, Amazon Connect, and AWS. This role will own the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of shared demo environments and reusable customer service use cases. The ideal candidate will combine hands-on technical expertise, strong operational ownership, and independent decision-making to ensure demo environments remain reliable, current, scalable, and ready to support both internal teams and occasional customer-facing engagements. 

Core Daily Activities

- Own and Optimize Demo Environments - Maintain reliable, scalable, secure, and high-quality shared demo environments leveraging Amazon Connect, AWS, and Zendesk. 
 - Develop New Demo Use Cases - Design and build compelling, reusable demonstrations that showcase contact center, customer experience, AI, automation, analytics, and integration capabilities. 
 - Support Custom Demo Requests - Partner with presales specialists and architects to develop opportunity-specific configurations, integrations, workflows, and demonstrations. 
 - Maintain Product and Release Readiness - Track Zendesk, Amazon Connect, AWS, and related technology releases and incorporate relevant capabilities into the demo portfolio. 
 - Drive Automation and Standardization - Develop reusable components, templates, deployment processes, and automation to improve the speed and consistency of demo delivery. 
 - Ensure Security, Governance, and Best Practices - Maintain appropriate access controls, data standards, platform governance, cost management, and technical quality across demo environments. 
 - Support Customer-Facing Activities - Occasionally participate in customer demonstrations, proof of concepts (PoCs), technical discussions, and presentations for prospects and clients. 
 - Develop Technical Documentation and Demo Collateral - Create technical guides, setup instructions, troubleshooting documentation, architecture diagrams, demo scripts, and internal enablement materials. 
 - Engage with Vendors and Partners - Work closely with AWS, Zendesk, and other partners to remain aligned with product capabilities, best practices, and technology advancements. 

Key Responsibilities

- Demo Platform Ownership: Define and execute the technical vision for shared demo environments, proactively identifying improvements, resolving issues, and ensuring environments remain available and ready for use. 
 - Demo Design and Development: Build compelling end-to-end contact center demonstrations leveraging Zendesk, Amazon Connect, and AWS services to showcase customer experience, agent productivity, AI, automation, and operational performance. 
 - Integration Management: Design and maintain integrations between Zendesk, Amazon Connect, AWS, and other enterprise systems to support realistic workflows, consistent data, and reusable demo scenarios. 
 - Custom Demo Support: Work with presales specialists and architects to understand opportunity requirements and deliver tailored demonstrations while identifying opportunities to create reusable assets for the wider team. 
 - Technical Oversight: Establish and maintain high standards for demo architecture, configuration, testing, security, documentation, reliability, and overall presentation quality. 
 - Stakeholder Collaboration: Engage with internal teams, business leaders, product specialists, engineering teams, customers, and external partners to gather requirements, propose solutions, communicate tradeoffs, and deliver effective demonstrations. 
 - Innovation and Best Practices: Stay ahead of product releases, industry trends, and emerging technologies in contact center platforms, AI, and automation, applying them to continuously improve the demo portfolio. 
 - Independent Execution: Establish priorities, manage multiple concurrent requests, make informed decisions, and deliver outcomes without requiring detailed day-to-day direction. 
 - Governance: Establish and enforce governance frameworks for security, access control, data management, cost optimization, platform reliability, and lifecycle management of demo environments. 

Qualifications

- Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or Business Administration - or equivalent experience. 
 - Experience: Minimum of 8-10 years in solution engineering, platform engineering, solution architecture, software development, or a related technical field, with at least 5 years of experience in contact center technologies, including Amazon Connect and CRM/CX technologies, preferably Zendesk. 
 - Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in designing, implementing, and supporting scalable solutions using a CRM/CX platform, Amazon Connect, AWS Lambda, Amazon AI Agents (Bedrock), Amazon Lex, IAM, DynamoDB, S3, API Gateway, CloudWatch, and other AWS services. We will rank you higher if you have experience or exposure to Python and/or NodeJS. 
 - Demo Development: Demonstrated experience creating technical demonstrations, reusable use cases, prototypes, proof of concepts, or reference implementations that translate technical capabilities into compelling business scenarios. 
 - Platform Management: Experience maintaining shared technical environments, managing releases and configuration changes, troubleshooting complex issues, and proactively improving platform availability and reliability.

The Cisco Crosswork Network Controller quality engineering team helps ensure that a highly scalable, microservices-based SDN controller delivers reliable automation for IP transport networks.  - Validate integrated solution behavior across installation and upgrades, device onboarding, service provisioning, topology, telemetry, high availability, scale, and failure recovery.

As a Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) Technical Leader on the Intersight Team you will play a key role in ensuring the reliability, scalability, and security of our cloud platforms. The broader team is composed of experienced engineers who value innovation and accountability. You will represent the Intersight SRE team, driving technical leadership, solving complex challenges, and shaping and delivering the team's technical roadmap. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, product management, customers and security, to design, influence, build, and maintain SaaS systems operating at multi-region scale. Your work will directly impact the success of our initiatives by ensuring the underlying platform infrastructure is robust, efficient, and aligned with operational excellence. 

Your Impact

We are seeking an experienced Engineer to represent a high-performing team dedicated to ensuring the reliability and scalability of cloud services, with a focus on a rapidly growing next-generation project. The ideal candidate will have hands-on SRE or systems/network administration experience, with familiarity in AWS. This role involves close collaboration across product engineering, service engineering, and SRE teams in a high-trust, well-coordinated environment. 

If you are looking to excel in a fast-paced environment creating innovative solutions and want to make a significant long-lasting impact, this job is for you. 

- Design, build, and optimize cloud and data infrastructure to ensure the high availability, reliability, and scalability of systems to meet customer needs, while implementing SRE principles such as monitoring, alerting, error budgets, and fault analysis. 
 - Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including customers, development, product management, and security teams, to create secure, scalable solutions and enhance operational efficiency through automation. 
 - Troubleshoot complex technical problems in production environments, perform root cause analysis, and contribute to continuous improvement efforts through postmortem reviews and proactive performance optimization. 
 - Lead the architectural vision and shape the team's technical strategy and roadmap, balancing immediate needs with long-term goals, driving innovation, and influencing the technical direction. 
 - Serve as a mentor and technical leader, guiding teams and fostering a culture of engineering and operational excellence by sharing your deep knowledge and experience. 
 - Engage with customers and stakeholders to understand use cases and feedback, translating them into actionable insights and effectively influencing stakeholders at all levels. 
 - Utilize your strong programming skills to integrate software and systems engineering, building core data platform capabilities and automation to meet enterprise customer needs and roadmap objectives. 
 - Develop strategic roadmaps, processes, plans, and infrastructure to efficiently deploy new software components at an enterprise scale while enforcing engineering best practices. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science with 8-14+ years of related experience
 - Extensive practical experience in several of the following areas: Linux, Public Cloud, Docker, Kubernetes, Ansible, Networking, Security, Systems Administration, Software Development, and CI/CD
 - Ability to design and implement scalable and well tested solutions, with a focus on streamlining operations. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in cloud, preferably AWS. 
 - Strong Infrastructure as Code (IaC) skills, with experience in tools such as Terraform, Ansible or CloudFormation. 
 - Experience with observability tools using Prometheus, Grafana, Thanos, CloudWatch, Splunk or Open Telemetry. 
 - Strong coding skills in Python, Go, or similar languages. 
 - Good understanding of Unix/Linux systems, the kernel, system libraries, file systems, and client-server protocols. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience building/managing a cloud-based data platform, automation and orchestration of their infrastructure and maintaining high availability, system reliability at scale. 
 - Ability to handle multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced environment
 - Have experience with architecting software and infrastructure at scale with a sense of ownership and accountability. 
 - Strong personal interest in learning, researching, and creating new technologies with high customer impact
 - Superior verbal and written communication and presentation skills, ability to convey complex technical information to non-experts
 - Excellent collaboration skills and the ability to bring out the best in a technically diverse team
 - Certifications: CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator), CKAD (Certified Kubernetes Application Developer), AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, or equivalent certifications in cloud and security domains. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

data.title: Salesforce Commerce Cloud (PWA / SFRA) Developer
data.description:
Why Valtech? We're the experience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world's most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience. 

The opportunity

At Valtech, you'll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries. 

We Are Proud Of

- The work we do and the innovation we drive 
 - Our values of share, care and dare 
 - A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy 
 - Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

The role

As a Salesforce Commerce Cloud (PWA / SFRA) Developer, you are passionate about experience innovation and eager to push the boundaries of what's possible. You bring 6+ YEARS of experience, a growth mindset and a drive to make a lasting impact. 

You Will Thrive In This Role If You Are

- A curious problem solver who challenges the status quo 
 - A collaborator who values teamwork and knowledge-sharing 
 - Excited by the intersection of technology, creativity and data 
 - Experienced in Agile methodologies and consulting (a plus)

Role Responsibilities

- Design and build React-based (or equivalent) composable storefront components consuming SCAPI/commerce APIs 
 - Implement checkout, PLP/PDP, personalization and search experiences per approved user stories and design specifications 
 - Integrate the storefront with CMS platforms (e. g. Coremedia), search providers (e. g. Algolia), PSPs and analytics tools 
 - Write unit/integration/end-to-end tests and support performance and accessibility (WCAG) compliance 
 - Participate in Agile ceremonies and provide effort estimates for backlog items 
 - Collaborate with design stakeholders to implement pixel-accurate, accessible and performant interfaces 
 - Support code reviews, deployments and monitoring of front-end performance (Core Web Vitals) 
 - Produce and maintain technical documentation for delivered work 
 - Where allocated (typically C3 grade), contribute a share of time to L3-level incident root-cause analysis and bug fixes

Must Have Qualifications

To be considered for this role, you must meet the following essential qualifications: 

- Solid hands-on experience with React (or equivalent) and modern JavaScript/TypeScript for composable/headless storefronts 
 - Experience consuming Salesforce SCAPI/commerce APIs or comparable headless commerce APIs 
 - Understanding of front-end performance optimization, accessibility standards (WCAG) and responsive design 
 - Experience integrating with CMS, search and personalization services 
 - Experience with version control and CI/CD tooling 
 - Good written and spoken English

Nice To Have Qualifications

- Salesforce B2C Commerce Cloud Developer certification / PWA Kit experience 
 - Experience with Coremedia or other headless CMS platforms 
 - Experience in retail or luxury goods eCommerce environments

If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn. 

Commitment to reaching all kinds of people

We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we're intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we're creating a more equitable Valtech for all. 

The Benefits

This is a fulltime position based in Bengaluru. 

Beyond a Competitive Compensation Package, We Offer

- Flexibility, with remote and hybrid work options (country-dependent) 
 - Career advancement, with international mobility and professional development programs 
 - Learning and development, with access to cutting-edge tools, training and industry experts

Our benefits are tailored to each location. Your Talent Partner will provide full details during the hiring process. 

Your application process

Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. Your CV should cover key information on relevant experiences and expertise. We do not require information such as age, gender, marital status, or a headshot in your application. We review all candidates based on skills, experience, and potential. 

⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud! Only engage with official Valtech email addresses ending in @valtech. com. 

We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know. 

About Valtech

Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world. 

At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L'Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen Dolby, and more. 

At Valtech, we don't just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate. 

Are you ready to create what's next? Join us.

You are an engineer who can turn ideas into extremely reliable and scalable designs. You code in such a way that other engineers find your code easy to comprehend, modify, and build upon. You believe in the power of Integration and APIs to transform how systems are integrated and how applications are built. 

You will be successful in this role if you: 

- Enjoy helping and mentoring others around you as you grow and become a successful engineer and developer
 - Have excellent written and verbal communication skills
 - Are capable of working in a distributed team and able to excel in a remote culture
 - Are self-driven and able to work on key initiatives
 - Take pleasure in making things happen and listen to the input from peers
 - Are able to make data driven decisions
 - Are a believer in a best idea strategy regardless of where or who ideas come from

Qualifications

We are looking for: 

- 10+ years of experience in building large scale distributed applications. 
 - Strong experience building multi-tenant SaaS applications
 - Strong problem-solving, debugging, and analytical skills with great attention to detail
 - Experience with Microservices and Cloud-based architectures/design patternsTechnical Skills and Experience: 

- Strong Experience in Java
 - Substantial experience with top tier RDBMS such as SQL Server and MySQL
 - Excellent JavaScript, CSS and HTML authoring skills. 
 - Proficiency with Javascript, TypeScript, Java Node. js, or Go. 
 - Familiar with application deployment via Docker and/or Kubernetes. 
 - Hands-on experience with AWS services such as DynamoDB, S3, or CloudFront. 

Additional Information

What You'll Get: 

- Work for a growing leader within the Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS) tech space
 - Join a mission-driven company that is transforming the industry by changing the way customers use API creation within business-critical processes.

data.title: Software Development Engineer II, AWS Compliance & Security Assurance, Denied Party Screening
data.description:
Description

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our mission is to prevent "denied entities" from transacting with Amazon businesses. We build automatic mechanisms to detect and prevent prohibited transactions with the "denied entities" using a diverse set of algorithms and machine learning techniques. We screen over a billion events every day and deal with unique scaling and TPS challenges. We are still Day 1 and have an exciting road map to build detection and resolution systems to help scale Amazon for years to come. 

We are looking for a software engineer who has the passion for working on challenging problems from the very early stages. Together with a multi-disciplinary team of engineers, ML scientists, and subject domain experts, you will help define our customer experience and protect Amazon brand. If you have an entrepreneurial spirit, know how to deliver, are technical and innovative, and looking for an opportunity to build systems and solutions optimized for relationships (or graph), we want to talk to you. 

Key job responsibilities

As an SDE in this role, you are responsible for: 

- Building large-scale, high-availability, low-latency distributed systems. 
 - You work with your team to design, implement, test, release and maintain high-complexity software. 
 - You propose new and innovative solutions that you then develop and refine for production. 
 - You are the end-to-end owner of critical components that keep Amazon and its businesses compliant. 

A day in the life

You'll see hundreds of millions of transactions being screened on a daily basis. 

You will hear about various critical Amazon Businesses (our clients) and about Amazon Legal, Compliance or Operations (our stakeholders). 

You'll work with highly experienced and dedicated peers to deliver on critical tasks and then you'll see your work directly impact our customers and our stakeholders. 

About The Team

Diverse Experiences

Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying. 

Why Amazon Security?

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon's products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores. 

Inclusive Team Culture

In Amazon Security, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices. 

Training & Career Growth

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. 

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred Qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https: //amazon. jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Job Description

As a Design Manager at WSP, you will lead and manage design projects within the Water sector. Working closely with the Project Director and Project Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing engineering design activities and ensuring compliance with industry best practices and UK regulations. 

At WSP, our Design Managers are adaptable professionals who thrive in a variety of situations. They possess an innovative mindset, are willing to take on new challenges, and are comfortable working on significant and complex projects or programmes of work. We collaborate closely with external clients and internal multidisciplinary project teams to deliver successful outcomes. 

To ensure effective project delivery, we operate across WSP offices, client offices, and site locations, supporting programmes of strategic regional and national importance. 

Joining WSP offers an exceptional opportunity to take the next step in your career. You will have the chance to build on your experience and qualifications, achieve your professional ambitions, and benefit from excellent support for personal development and career growth within both local teams and the wider WSP business. 

Responsibilities

- Provide leadership and direction for BIM and digital delivery across multiple UK Water projects and frameworks. 
 - Develop and implement BIM strategies aligned with business, client, and project objectives. 
 - Support business growth through digital solutions, innovation, and BIM capability enhancement. 
 - Contribute to regional and global digital transformation initiatives.

Leadership & Management

 - Results-driven and accountable.

The Opportunity

Hitachi Energy is currently looking for a Testing Engineer to join their team in Maneja, Vadodara, India. This team seeks a skilled and motivated individual. The ideal candidate must enjoy working in a dynamic, fast-paced business environment. He or she must be flexible to accommodate business requirements and experience in working with diverse groups and cultures. The ability to multitask & deliver within timelines is essential. 

How You'll Make An Impact

- Led and supervise the routine testing of high-voltage circuit breakers (72. 5 kV to 800 kV) ensuring full compliance with relevant standards and quality requirements. 
 - Managed Test plant operations to achieve Business Unit (BU) revenue targets while maintaining quality and efficiency. 
 - Provided support in new product development, including testing validation and performance evaluation. 
 - Coordinate and attended customer inspections, ensuring compliance with specifications and handling technical queries.

Position Responsibilities

- Support our Timing Design team based out of the Skyworks Bangaluru office with new IC bring-up, validation, and characterization.

 - Lead the design and development of high-speed PCBs (EEVBs), including discrete analog circuits, used for validation and characterization. 
 - Assemble and maintain test setups in the laboratory to support validation and characterization. 
 - Define, develop, and/or acquire software and/or hardware tools in support of silicon test efforts. 
 - Develop automation scripts to automate data collection, decrease data collection times, ensure repeatable measurements, and generate reports. 
 - Own post-processing the characterization data, conducting a detailed analysis (we use JMP for this purpose), and then reviewing the analyzed data with the IC design and marketing teams. 

Required Experience And Skills

- Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering with 8+ years of relevant experience, or a Master's with 6 years of experience. 
 - Strong EE fundamentals; experience with PLLs, synthesizers, and jitter strongly preferred
 - Background in validation, test, or characterization of IC devices

 - Ability to troubleshoot and debug hardware and software
 - Experience developing automated test systems and validation infrastructure

data.title: Associate Director, Software Engineering
data.description:
Some careers have more impact than others. 

If you're looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you'll be. 

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions. 

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Software Engineering

Principal responsibilities

The Performance Testing Engineer will be responsible for defining and executing performance testing for HSBC Open Banking Cloud solutions, ensuring services meet non-functional requirements for scalability, resilience and stability. The role will work closely with engineering, SRE/DevOps, and product teams to identify bottlenecks early, drive performance improvements, and embed performance testing into CI/CD pipelines. 

- Define performance testing strategy, approach and success criteria aligned to Open Banking non-functional requirements (throughput, latency, error rates, capacity and scalability). 
 - Design, build and maintain automated performance test suites (load, stress, endurance/soak, spike), integrating execution into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Create realistic workload models using production-like usage patterns, including API-level test scenarios and data design suitable for performance testing. 
 - Analyse results (response times, resource utilisation, thread/connection behaviour, queueing), identify bottlenecks and provide actionable recommendations to development and platform teams. 
 - Collaborate with SRE/DevOps to set up performance environments, monitoring, dashboards and alerts using tooling such as Splunk, AppDynamics and CloudWatch. 
 - Validate performance of cloud-native components (for example API Gateway, AWS Lambda, Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), load balancers, databases) and support tuning activities. 
 - Produce clear performance reports and communicate risks, remediation plans and trends to stakeholders; promote performance engineering best practices across the team. 
 - Support releases by providing performance sign-off evidence and contribute to incident triage where performance degradation is suspected. 

Requirements

- Minimum Bachelor Degree of Engineering with excellent verbal and written communication skills. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in performance testing and performance engineering for APIs and distributed systems. 
 - Proven experience with performance test tools such as JMeter and/or Gatling (or equivalent), including scripting, parameterisation, correlation and result analysis. 
 - Experience implementing performance testing in CI/CD (for example Jenkins) and using version control and collaboration tooling (Jira, GitHub, Confluence). 
 - Good understanding of AWS and cloud-native architectures, including performance characteristics of networking, load balancing, auto-scaling and container platforms. 
 - Strong skills in monitoring/observability and performance diagnostics using tools such as Splunk, AppDynamics and CloudWatch; ability to interpret metrics, logs and traces. 
 - Working knowledge of Linux and scripting (Python and/or Shell) to automate test execution, environment checks and reporting. 
 - Strong understanding of non-functional requirements, resilience patterns and high availability concepts; ability to translate requirements into measurable test outcomes. 
 - Good to have banking domain knowledge and familiarity with Open Banking/API ecosystems. 

You'll achieve more when you join HSBC. 

www. hsbc. com/careers

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website. 

Issued by - HSBC Software Development India

Job Description

About Compliance Engineering

The Core Engineering is a global team of more than 300 engineers and scientists who work on the most complex, mission-critical problems. We build and operate a suite of platforms and applications that prevent, detect, and mitigate regulatory and reputational risk across the firm. 

Our engineers have access to the latest technology and massive amounts of structured and unstructured data, leveraging modern frameworks to build responsive, intuitive front-end and Big Data applications. The firm is making a significant investment to uplift and rebuild the Compliance application portfolio. 

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled and hands-on Vice President (VP), Full-Stack Engineer to join our technology team in Hyderabad. In this role, you will bridge the gap between high-level business strategy and technical execution. You will be responsible for architecting, designing, and delivering scalable, secure, and high-performance full-stack applications. 

As a VP-level engineer, you will maintain a strong hands-on presence-actively writing code, contributing to system and application design, reviewing implementations, mentoring engineers, and driving engineering excellence across the entire software development lifecycle (SDLC). You will partner closely with business, product, and engineering stakeholders to build modern platforms that are reliable, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise standards, drawing on your architecture and design background to strengthen technical solutions. 

Experience in Generative AI, machine learning, and Large Language Model (LLM) integrations is expected for this role to help build intelligent, AI-enabled engineering solutions. 

Key Responsibilities

- Technical Leadership & Architecture
 - System Design: Architect and design robust, scalable, and secure full-stack applications, microservices, and APIs that align with enterprise standards. 
 - Technology Strategy: Evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and industry trends (including AI-assisted development) to continuously modernize our frontend and backend tech stack. 
 - Standards & Governance: Establish and enforce coding standards, architectural principles, and security best practices across frontend and backend systems. 
 - Design Decisions: Bring a strong architecture and design background to modular design, integration patterns, security, performance, scalability, and long-term maintainability.

 - Full-Stack Development: Write clean, maintainable, and high-performance code across both frontend user interfaces and backend services using Java, Spring Boot, React or Angular, and Python. 
 - Backend Development: Design and implement scalable microservices using Java and Spring Boot. 
 - ETL Pipeline Engineering: Build and maintain robust ETL/ELT workflows using Spring Batch. This includes configuring components for complex data transformations and high-volume ingestion. 
 - API Design & Security: Develop and secure RESTful APIs to facilitate seamless data exchange between internal systems and external partners, ensuring low latency and high availability. 
 - Database Management: Optimize database schemas, queries, and data pipelines across relational (e. g. , PostgreSQL, DB2, Oracle) and non-relational (e. g. , MongoDB, Cassandra) databases. 
 - AI & Intelligent Automation: Apply hands-on experience in Generative AI, machine learning, and large language model (LLM) integrations to build intelligent features, automate workflows, and enhance user and operational outcomes. 
 - Team Mentorship & Collaboration
 - Mentorship: Mentor engineers and promote a culture of technical excellence, strong design thinking, continuous learning, and operational discipline. 
 - Code Reviews: Participate in and lead code reviews and technical design discussions to improve quality, maintainability, and consistency across teams. 
 - Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate with product managers, designers, QA, and business stakeholders to convert requirements into sound technical designs and delivery plans. 

Required Qualifications & Skills

Education & Experience

- Experience: 8+ years of progressive experience in full-stack engineering, architecture, or related roles, with a strong track record of building enterprise-grade applications and implementing large-scale, enterprise-level data solutions. 
 - Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related quantitative field. 

Technical Skills

 - Spring Ecosystem: Deep proficiency in Spring Boot and Spring Batch. Must understand job partitioning, multi-threaded steps, and fault-tolerance policies (skip/retry). 
 - Frontend Expertise: Strong front-end development experience using React or Angular to build responsive, user-focused web applications. 
 - Python Development: Solid Python development experience for automation, services, scripting, analytics workflows, or platform enablement. 
 - AI & Machine Learning: Hands-on experience with Generative AI, machine learning, and LLM-based solutions, including practical use of AI APIs, prompt-driven workflows, intelligent automation, or AI-enabled application features. 
 - Architecture & Design: Strong architecture and design background, with knowledge of microservices, API design, secure coding, and distributed systems patterns. 
 - Messaging & Streaming: Experience designing and implementing event-driven architectures and messaging-based integrations using technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ for real-time data triggers. 
 - SQL Mastery: Advanced SQL and database skills, including schema design, query optimization, and performance tuning across SQL and NoSQL technologies. 

Interpersonal Skills

- Strong problem-solving, critical thinking, and decision-making skills in complex technical environments. 
 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to engineering, product, and business stakeholders. 
 - Collaborative working style with experience driving cross-functional initiatives and influencing technical direction. 
 - Commitment to engineering excellence, automation, and continuous improvement. 
 - Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high standards of quality and delivery.

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world. 

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7, 000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide. 

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you're ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us. 

About Our Team

At Agoda, our Backend Engineering team builds high-scale, fault-tolerant distributed systems that power a global travel platform serving millions of users daily. We own mission-critical domains across inventory, pricing, booking, payments, and customer/partner platforms. 

Our systems run with high availability, low latency, and zero-downtime expectations, powered by modern technologies such as Scala, Go, Java, Kotlin, Kafka, and Aerospike, along with strong foundations in CI/CD, automation, and observability. 

We ship fast-often dozens of releases a day-and design systems that are resilient, self-healing, and built to scale globally. 

The Opportunity

As a Staff Backend Engineer, you'll own the design and reliability of a critical service or domain end-to-end - from architecture through production. Beyond writing code, you'll be expected to identify problems before they're assigned to you, make independent calls on ambiguous technical trade-offs within your domain, and raise the technical bar for your immediate team. You'll combine hands-on coding, system design, and technical ownership - accountable for outcomes within your service, and a trusted technical voice when your work touches adjacent teams. 

What You Will Do

- Design, build, and own scalable distributed systems and microservices within your domain
 - Lead development of complex features and technical initiatives end-to-end, within your service or team
 - Drive system design, API design, and engineering best practices for your team
 - Own scalability, performance, reliability, and fault tolerance of the services you're responsible for
 - Optimize high-throughput, low-latency systems
 - Proactively identify gaps, risks, or improvement opportunities in your domain, and drive them to resolution without waiting to be asked
 - Make independent architectural and technical trade-off decisions within your service's scope, and be accountable for the outcomes
 - Collaborate with adjacent teams when your service's boundaries or dependencies require it, and raise engineering standards within your own team
 - Partner with your product and business stakeholders to translate business needs into technical priorities, and technical constraints into business context
 - Stay hands-on with coding and system design
 - Mentor engineers on your team with a structured approach, supporting their growth
 - Handle production issues within your domain, drive RCA, and lead follow-through improvements

What We're Looking For

Technical

- 8-12 years of backend engineering experience
 - Strong experience building and owning distributed systems at scale, within a service or domain
 - Expertise in: Java, Kotlin, Scala, or Go
 - Strong understanding of microservices architecture, REST APIs & system design, SQL/NoSQL databases, and performance, scalability, and concurrency
 - Strong coding and problem-solving ability

Beyond the technical bar: 

- A track record of taking ownership beyond your assigned tasks - initiatives you drove within your domain because you saw the need, not because you were told
 - Comfort making decisions under ambiguity and owning the consequences, technical and business, within your area of ownership
 - Experience communicating trade-offs to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders, adjusting your framing accordingly

Read everything carefully. The requirements and screening questions are critical and if not answered correctly and satisfactorily will result in auto-rejection and waste of your time.

 - Junior candidates with 2 years experience are suitable

GPU Cluster & Kubernetes Engineer (Linux Infrastructure)

About Qubrid AIQubrid AI is building a full-stack AI infrastructure platform that combines GPU cloud, inference APIs, AI orchestration software, and enterprise AI infrastructure. Our platform powers AI workloads across cloud, hybrid, and on-prem environments using state-of-the-art NVIDIA technologies and open-source AI frameworks. 

We are seeking a hands-on GPU Cluster & Kubernetes Engineer with deep Linux and Kubernetes expertise to deploy, manage, and optimize GPU clusters used for AI training and large-scale inference workloads. 

Role OverviewAs a GPU Cluster & Kubernetes Engineer, you will be responsible for building and operating highly available Linux-based GPU clusters. You will work across Kubernetes, container platforms, networking, storage, and NVIDIA technologies to deliver reliable, scalable infrastructure for AI workloads. The ideal candidate enjoys troubleshooting complex distributed systems and automating infrastructure at scale. 

Responsibilities
 - Deploy, configure, and maintain production Kubernetes clusters for AI and GPU workloads. 
 - Build and operate Linux-based GPU clusters supporting training and inference environments. 
 - Install and manage NVIDIA GPU Operator, drivers, CUDA, and container runtimes. 
 - Configure Kubernetes scheduling, namespaces, quotas, node pools, taints, tolerations, and affinity rules. 
 - Deploy and manage GPU workloads using Helm, Operators, and GitOps methodologies. 
 - Configure high availability and cluster upgrades with minimal downtime. 
 - Troubleshoot Kubernetes, Linux, networking, and storage issues. 
 - Configure and manage container runtimes including containerd and Docker. 
 - Implement cluster monitoring, logging, and alerting. 
 - Automate provisioning and operations using Ansible, Bash, and Python. 
 - Manage persistent storage solutions and distributed file systems. 
 - Collaborate with GPU engineers and AI platform teams to optimize infrastructure for inference and training. 
 - Participate in customer deployments and provide operational support. 
Required Qualifications
 - 4+ years of Linux systems administration experience. 
 - 3+ years of hands-on Kubernetes administration experience. 
 - Strong expertise with: 
 - Kubernetes
 - Kubeadm
 - Containerd
 - Helm
 - Docker
 - Linux (Ubuntu, Rocky Linux, RHEL)
 - Experience deploying and managing multi-node clusters. 
 - Experience with NVIDIA GPU Operator and GPU-enabled Kubernetes environments. 
 - Solid understanding of: 
 - Networking fundamentals
 - DNS
 - Load balancing
 - Ingress controllers
 - TLS certificates
 - High availability
 - Experience with container networking and CNI plugins such as Calico or Cilium. 
 - Strong scripting skills using Bash and Python. 
 - Familiarity with Git and Infrastructure as Code principles. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot distributed systems and performance issues. 
Preferred Qualifications
 - Experience with GPU clusters and AI infrastructure. 
 - Knowledge of NVIDIA drivers, CUDA, MIG, and DCGM. 
 - Experience with KubeVirt and GPU virtualization. 
 - Familiarity with Ceph, Longhorn, OpenEBS, NFS, or other persistent storage solutions. 
 - Experience with monitoring and observability tools including: 
 - Prometheus
 - Grafana
 - Loki
 - Alertmanager
 - Experience with ArgoCD, FluxCD, and GitOps workflows. 
 - Understanding of RDMA, RoCEv2, InfiniBand, and high-speed networking. 
 - Familiarity with Slurm and HPC environments. 
 - Experience with Rancher, OpenShift, or VMware Tanzu. 
 - Exposure to AI inference frameworks such as Triton, vLLM, SGLang, and TensorRT-LLM. 
Nice to Have
 - CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator), CKS, or RHCE certifications. 
 - Experience supporting H100, H200, B200, A100, or HGX-based clusters. 
 - Familiarity with SONiC networking and NVIDIA Spectrum switches. 
 - Experience operating clusters with hundreds or thousands of GPUs. 
 - Infrastructure automation using Terraform or Ansible. 
 - Experience with hybrid cloud environments. 
What You'll Work On
 - Large-scale GPU clusters for AI training and inference. 
 - Kubernetes-based AI platforms and multi-tenant environments. 
 - NVIDIA GPU Operator and containerized AI workloads. 
 - Distributed storage and high-performance networking. 
 - Infrastructure automation and GitOps. 
 - Hybrid cloud and on-prem AI deployments. 
 - Enterprise AI factories and next-generation GPU cloud infrastructure. 
Why Join Qubrid AI?At Qubrid AI, you'll help build the infrastructure behind the next generation of AI. You'll work with cutting-edge GPU clusters, Kubernetes, and NVIDIA technologies to power AI applications at scale for enterprises and developers worldwide. 

If you enjoy Linux, Kubernetes, automation, and solving complex infrastructure challenges, we'd love to hear from you.

data.title: Senior Platform Engineer
data.description:
About Gravitee

Since 2015, Gravitee has grown into a global force, recognized as a 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader for API Management. What started with four developers challenging the complexities of APIs has evolved into a revolutionary platform powering API and event stream ecosystems worldwide. We drive digital transformation for top enterprises - from Michelin to Roche to Blue Yonder - offering unmatched control over APIs and event streams. 

Now, we are leading the next evolution: AI Agent Management. Our platform brings security and governance to the agentic ecosystem - with our Agent Gateway for A2A protocol communications, native Model Context Protocol (MCP) support, and multi-agent, multi-LLM control. We are building the infrastructure that lets enterprises unlock the full potential of AI, securely and at scale. 

Our rapid growth and leadership in API management are fueled by our team's commitment to excellence and our core values: 

- Passion: We bring excitement to everything we do, constantly innovating to stay ahead of the curve. 
 - Hold Nothing Back: We go above and beyond to help customers and teammates succeed, holding ourselves to the highest standards. 
 - Professionalism: We believe in clear, respectful communication and prioritize the needs of our team and customers. 

Join us on this journey. Be part of a team that is redefining what is possible in API management, and shaping the future of digital transformation. The possibilities are endless - be a part of the revolution!

The Role & Why It Exists

As a Senior Platform Engineer, you will be part of a Platform Team dedicated to making Gravitee's products best in class in terms of both product and infrastructure. You will be responsible for building and maintaining the cloud infrastructure that powers Gravitee's platform, while also supporting our customers with exceptional technical expertise. 

This is a hands-on, critical role in our organization. The right candidate will enjoy problem solving in a highly specialized and technical way - from delivering production-ready Kubernetes-based environments to investigating complex customer issues. 

As Gravitee expands into AI Agent Management, the Platform team plays a critical role in ensuring our infrastructure can support AI workloads, agent orchestration, and the demanding performance requirements of real-time AI gateway operations. 

What You Will Be Doing

Your Responsibilities Will Include, But Are Not Limited To

- Participate in delivering Gravitee NextGen Cloud infrastructure, including environments that support AI Gateway and Agent Management workloads
 - Deliver production-ready, Kubernetes-based, customer-facing environments - not just POCs
 - Assist the support team to help customers have the best experience possible with our products
 - Work with other team members to develop and maintain new infrastructure features
 - Share your knowledge (tech and non-tech) during internal Gravitee TechTalks
 - Lead investigation of support tickets and work collaboratively to resolve customer issues
 - Create knowledge articles to complete documentation and enable customers to better understand product use cases
 - Be innovative within the team to help improve processes and tools, including exploring AI-driven automation for operations

AI & Automation Mindset

At Gravitee, We See AI As a Force Multiplier For Engineers, Not a Replacement For Solid Engineering Fundamentals. We Expect You To

- Be open and proactive in using AI-assisted tools (e. g. , AI coding assistants, troubleshooting aids, automation helpers) to accelerate day-to-day work
 - Use AI thoughtfully to improve existing processes, reduce manual toil, and increase reliability in operations and support workflows
 - Experiment with AI-driven approaches to problem solving, documentation, and incident analysis, while maintaining a strong critical mindset
 - Understand the limits of AI tools and apply engineering judgment to validate, refine, and productionize outcomes
 - Contribute ideas on how AI can be safely and effectively integrated into our platform, infrastructure, and internal tooling

AI at Gravitee is not about shortcuts - it is about working smarter, faster, and more sustainably at scale. 

Essential Skills

The right candidate will possess at least the following skills: 

- 5+ years of professional experience in infrastructure management
 - Fluency with creating and managing Kubernetes clusters and Helm-based deployments
 - Strong understanding of infrastructure and deployment automation
 - Experience with Terraform, Docker, and certificate management (ZeroSSL, Let's Encrypt)
 - Experience with continuous delivery tools (Argo Workflows, ArgoCD, Helm Charts)
 - Cloud platform experience (Azure, AWS, GCP)
 - Observability tooling (Grafana, Prometheus)
 - Curiosity and commitment to continuous learning
 - Patient, resilient problem-solver with great attention to detail

Desired Skills

Additionally, these skills are not required but preferable: 

- Experience with API Management or Identity and Access Management platforms
 - Familiarity with AI/ML infrastructure requirements and GPU workload orchestration
 - Experience supporting AI Gateway or LLM-serving infrastructure
 - Knowledge of networking, service mesh, and traffic management patterns

Core Values

At Gravitee, We Believe Strongly In Living Our Core Values As a Team And As a Company. We Do Not Just Write Them - We Live Them

- Passion: We bring excitement to everything we do, constantly innovating to stay ahead of the curve. 
 - Hold Nothing Back: We go above and beyond to help customers and teammates succeed, holding ourselves to the highest standards. 
 - Professionalism: We believe in clear, respectful communication and prioritize the needs of our team and customers. 

At Gravitee, You'll Get. . . 

- Excellent medical coverage to keep your body and mind healthy
 - Pension and 401k program options for all locations
 - Stock option plan for employees
 - 25 days holiday/vacation in addition to in-country national holidays
 - 3 mental health days per year with an allowance toward a mood-boosting activity of your choice
 - Birthday off to celebrate your day
 - Professional development allowance to invest in your career growth
 - Quarterly outings and annual offsites in exciting locations
 - Hybrid culture with options to work from one of our hubs
 - Access to cutting-edge AI development tools and a culture that embraces innovation
 - A meaningful, progressive, global company culture that is as fun as it is hardworking
 - Endless growth opportunities

data.title: Principal Cloud Engineer
data.description:
Powering the world's payments ecosystem
ACI powers the payments ecosystem - globally, and you power ACI. You'll innovate, collaborate, and grow in an energetic technology culture with decades of proven success. ACIers - in all roles and levels - are truly your colleagues and many are your friends. Our size and reach allow you to see the global impact of your work. You are visible, your talents are valued, and you are empowered to shape the future of payments. 
As a Principal Cloud Engineer in Pune, you will join a diverse, passionate team dedicated to powering the world's payments ecosystem. This role is focused on designing, automating, and evolving cloud platform capabilities that support ACI's enterprise infrastructure strategy and next-generation payment solutions. AWS, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code, automation, and continuous compliance are key focus areas for this role. 
Job Summary
ACI Worldwide is seeking a highly experienced Principal Cloud Engineer to provide technical leadership for enterprise cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, automation, and cloud governance initiatives. This role is ideal for a hands-on technical leader with AWS, Kubernetes, EKS, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, Platform Engineering, Cloud Security, and Automation expertise who can drive technical strategy, influence engineering direction, and mentor engineering teams across the organization. The ideal candidate will bring a software-defined mindset and the ability to architect, automate, and orchestrate cloud solutions at scale. 
Key Responsibilities
- Define and drive cloud architecture, technical strategy, and engineering standards across enterprise platforms. 
- Lead the design and implementation of scalable, secure, highly available cloud infrastructure solutions. 
- Drive adoption of Infrastructure as Code (IaC), automation, and platform engineering best practices. 
- Architect and implement AWS and Kubernetes-based solutions, including Amazon EKS environments. 
- Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines, automated deployment workflows, and cloud operational frameworks. 
- Lead cloud governance, security, compliance automation, and operational excellence initiatives. 
- Provide technical leadership across engineering teams and serve as the escalation point for complex cloud infrastructure challenges. 
- Partner with Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, and Security teams to align technology investments with business objectives. 
- Mentor engineers and promote engineering excellence, innovation, automation, and cloud-first strategies. 
- Drive enterprise cloud modernization and continuous compliance initiatives through automated controls and evidence generation. 

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field. 
- 12+ years of experience in Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, DevOps, or Infrastructure Engineering. 
- Proven experience designing and delivering large-scale cloud infrastructure solutions. 
- Strong experience leading architecture, automation, and cloud transformation initiatives. 
- Experience influencing technical direction and mentoring engineering teams. 
- Experience in Payments, Financial Services, FinTech, or other regulated industries preferred. 

Technical Expertise
- Expert-level experience with AWS Cloud Services, Kubernetes, Amazon EKS, and Cloud-Native Infrastructure. 
- Deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep, or equivalent technologies). 
- Strong knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, Git-based workflows, platform automation, and DevOps practices. 
- Experience with Containerization Technologies, Kubernetes Orchestration, and Cloud Platform Operations. 
- Strong understanding of Cloud Networking, Security, Compliance, Reliability Engineering, and Governance. 
- Experience implementing automated configuration management and secure cloud deployment frameworks. 
- Experience developing pipeline-driven infrastructure delivery and enterprise cloud automation solutions. 
- Strong understanding of scalability, performance optimization, operational resilience, and security best practices. 
- Experience evaluating and adopting emerging technologies, including AI-powered engineering tools. 

AI & Emerging Technologies
- Proven experience evaluating and integrating AI/ML capabilities into cloud platforms and engineering operations. 
- Strong understanding of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), AI Agents, and AI-driven automation concepts. 
- Experience leveraging AI-powered cloud services from AWS, Azure, OpenAI, or equivalent providers. 
- Ability to identify opportunities where AI can improve cloud operations, infrastructure management, compliance automation, and engineering productivity. 
- Experience establishing governance, security, privacy, and responsible AI practices within enterprise environments. 
- Demonstrated use of AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate delivery, automation, and platform reliability. 
- Ability to drive technical strategy and architectural decisions related to AI adoption within cloud engineering organizations. 

Professional Skills
- Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills. 
- Strong strategic and architectural thinking with a business-outcome mindset. 
- Ability to influence technical direction without direct authority. 
- Passion for mentoring and developing engineering talent. 
- Strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities. 
- Ability to balance technical depth with enterprise-wide impact. 

Preferred Qualifications
- Advanced AWS, Kubernetes, or Cloud Platform Certifications. 
- Experience leading enterprise cloud transformation initiatives. 
- Experience with FinOps, cloud cost optimization, and cloud governance frameworks. 
- Knowledge of continuous compliance and automated audit evidence generation. 
- Windows administration experience is considered a plus. 
- Industry thought leadership, conference speaking, publications, or technical community contributions. 

Ideal Candidate
The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in AWS, Kubernetes, Amazon EKS, Infrastructure as Code, Cloud Automation, Platform Engineering, and Cloud Security with the ability to architect and scale AI-enabled cloud platforms, driving innovation while ensuring security, compliance, reliability, and business value. The successful candidate will possess a software-defined mindset and demonstrate the ability to build, automate, and orchestrate cloud solutions at enterprise scale. 
Core Capabilities
We seek colleagues who embody our core capabilities - these shape our culture and enable us to make a meaningful impact together: 
- Ensure Accountability: holding self and others accountable to meet commitments. 
- Drives Results: consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances. 
- Customer Focus: building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions. 
- Cultivate Innovation: creating new and better ways for the organization to be successful. 
- Collaborates: building partnerships and working collaboratively with others. 
- Courage: stepping up to address difficult issues, saying what needs to be said. 

In return for your expertise, we offer opportunities for growth, career development, and a competitive compensation and benefits package-all within an innovative and collaborative work environment. 
Are you ready to help us transform the payments ecosystem? To learn more about ACI Worldwide, visit our web site at www. aciworldwide. com

With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks. 

Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more. 

Life as a Sprinter -
Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane. 

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in. 

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction. 

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching. 

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone. 

The mission -
Most BDR manager jobs are a dead end if you care about marketing. You book meetings, you hit a number, you repeat. 

This one is not that. This team sits inside Demand Generation, not Sales. You own the humans and the plays that turn demand into pipeline, and you work shoulder to shoulder with performance marketing, SEO, and lifecycle on the same funnel. If your goal is to grow into demand gen or growth marketing, this is the fastest seat in the building to do it from. We are specifically hiring someone who wants that path, not someone who wants to manage a dialer forever. 

You run Sprinto's BDR function end to end: the entire inbound engine, and the net-new intent plays we are building from scratch. You own the number across SMB and mid-market, the team that hits it, and the systems (sequences, routing, reporting, AI) that make it repeatable. 

This is a growth role by design. The intent funnel, the AI automation, the campaign-level conversion work, and the reporting are all demand gen muscles. As you prove them, the path opens toward owning a channel (lifecycle, paid, or intent/ABM) or a broader demand gen mandate. 

We will invest in that deliberately: exposure to campaign planning, budget thinking, and the full funnel, not just the BDR slice. If you show up curious about why a campaign converts and not only how many dials it took, you will move fast here. 

Where you'll leave your mark

- Hitting the number. Carry and hit the demo and pipeline number across both the SMB and the mid-market motion. 
 - Make the inbound engine efficient. Move the engine from volume to conversion. Lift conversion rates campaign by campaign and hold the gains, not just for a spike month. 
 - Build a net-new demos engine. Stand up an intent-based funnel that produces demos predictably, turn at least one intent signal into a repeatable documented playbook, and diversify pipeline beyond the top-priority campaigns so growth isn't riding on a couple of plays. 
 - Raise outreach quality. Improve response rates and the quality of the pitch on live calls, not just activity volume. 
 - Put AI to work inside the team. Automate the manual ops (lead assignment, reporting) end to end, build real-time reporting leadership can trust, and extend coverage with AI so inbound doesn't go dark on weekends. 
 - Build the talent engine. Turn the BDR team into a farm system for Associate AEs. The goal: a repeatable pipeline that brings BDRs in and graduates them into AAEs inside 12 months

What You'll Own Day To Day

- Build and lead the team. Recruit, ramp, and train BDRs across inbound and outbound. Run recurring 1: 1s, live call reviews, and feedback that changes what happens on the next call
 - Run the operating rhythm. Weekly reviews against pipeline, activity, qualification, and conversion targets. Scorecards over vibes
 - Forecast honestly. Own pipeline predictability on both volume and value, so leadership can actually plan on your number
 - Own the playbook. SOPs, sequences, scripts, email pitches, and qualification criteria. Build them, keep them sharp, kill what stops working
 - Watch ramp and productivity. Time to productivity for new hires, activity levels, meeting quality, and opportunity conversion. Know where every rep is and why
 - Build the culture. Accountability, recognition, honest feedback, and a career path people can actually see. This is also what feeds the AAE bench
 - Work across functions. With content marketing on webinars, messaging, campaign follow-up, and events. With AEs and Sales on target accounts, outbound execution, and handoff quality. With RevOps on the tooling and the tech stack

The kind of builder we're looking for -

- 3-5+ years in BDR/SDR, with at least 1-2 years managing or leading a team (or a strong senior IC ready to step up) 
 - You have carried and hit a pipeline number, and you can explain exactly how you did it 
 - You think in funnels and conversion rates, not just activity counts 
 - You are genuinely curious about marketing: campaigns, positioning, channels, the whole funnel 
 - You are AI-forward: you have already used AI to make outreach or ops faster, or you are itching to 
 - You write well. Punchy, plain, no fluff. We care about this a lot 
 - Comfortable in HubSpot and modern outbound/sequencing tooling

Nice to have

- Experience selling compliance, security, or developer/infra tooling 
 - Built an outbound motion or intent play from scratch before 
 - Comfort with data: light SQL, spreadsheets, or a BI tool

How we care for our Sprinters?

- Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach
 - Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance
 - We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1, 000 annually to help you level up your skills
 - We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to
 - Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary
 - Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35, 000 to help you build a setup that works for you

Inclusion & Diversity -
At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed-not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful. 

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
