data.title: High Speed IO Validation Engineer
data.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. Today, we are tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing - an era in which our GPUs act as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that understand the world. Doing what has never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world's best talent. 

NVIDIA's Silicon Co-Design Group is the team that gets every GPU, SoC, and CPU silicon program from first power-on to high-volume production. We are hiring an HSIO Validation Engineer to own characterization and qualification of high-speed I/Os - PCIe, NVLink, NVLink-C2C, UCIe, USB, UFS, and Ethernet - on brand-new silicon serving datacenter, AI, and client markets. Your bench is where silicon meets the signal - where every link train, jitter sweep, eye diagram, and protocol corner gets exercised before the part ships. You drive characterization and debug for IO interconnects across silicon, board, firmware, and driver - designing tests that anticipate rack-scale deployment so marginality surfaces at die-and-board scale, never in a rack. Your decisions show up in link margin, BER, power per lane, and the go/no-go calls that gate samples and production. 

What You Will Be Doing

- Own end-to-end characterization and validation of high-speed IO - PCIe, NVLink, NVLink-C2C, UCIe, USB, UFS, Ethernet - from silicon die through package and board, on NVIDIA GPUs, CPUs, and SoCs. 
 - Develop and execute validation test plans for silicon and SoC-level HSIO features - bring-up, corner qualification, stress, productization, and structured DOE across PVT, board, cable/connector, thermal, and firmware variables - left-shifting silicon failures before deployment. 
 - Drive power characterization and optimization across IO interconnects under workload-representative stimuli (MLPerf-class patterns at silicon/board level) - analyze trade-offs across V/F, lane config, and protocol state - and feed back into design, firmware, and binning. 
 - Drive systematic root-cause analysis for complex HSIO bugs - isolating contributions across silicon, package, board, firmware, and driver, with platform/thermal/mechanical partners when system context matters. Convert rack-observed failures into silicon/board reproducers so future spins fix the root cause upstream. 
 - Assess manufacturing and yield implications of HSIO margin distributions - identify gaps in scaling from chip to product, and feed back into binning and design. 
 - Develop and improve validation methodologies, automation frameworks, and margin-tracking infrastructure - increase efficiency and coverage as platform complexity grows. 

What We Need To See

- BS or MS in Electrical or Computer Engineering (or equivalent), with 8+ years in post-silicon HSIO validation, characterization, or a closely related discipline. 
 - Deep understanding of high-speed serial link protocols (PCIe Gen5+, NVLink, NVLink-C2C, UCIe, CXL) and the underlying SERDES architecture - equalization, link training, electrical characterization - with strong signal integrity and jitter knowledge. 
 - Strong SI and PI fundamentals - S-parameters, eye diagrams, channel margin, crosstalk, return loss, PDN noise, jitter decomposition - and validation experience across silicon and platform boundaries (CoWoS/interposer/substrate, board), translating rack-environment effects into silicon/board characterization. 
 - Hands-on with lab instrumentation (DSOs, BERTs, VNAs, protocol/logic analyzers, TDR), DOE/shmoo/margin-trending, and Python-based test automation - with a track record of driving cross-functional debug across chip, package, board, firmware, driver, and system teams. 

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Hands-on experience with PCIe Gen5/Gen6 or NVLink validation on production silicon - link training, equalization tuning, BER margining, or compliance debug. 
 - Prior SERDES, mixed-signal, or analog circuit design experience - sufficient to independently form hypotheses, design Sim-to-Si correlation experiments, and propose silicon/system-side fixes during debug. 
 - Track record of translating rack-environment conditions (thermal, connector reliability, neighbor noise) into silicon/board characterization - finding marginality at die-and-board scale before it appears in the field. 
 - Comfortable using AI productivity tools (Claude, Copilot, or equivalent) to compress log triage, regression analysis, scripting, and reporting workflows.

data.description:
Provides expert level IT technical lead services, including the direction, evaluation, selection, configuration, implementation, and integration of new and existing technologies and tools. 

About Vanguard

Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe-directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries. 

Vanguard India

Vanguard's office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients. 

Role Summary

This role provides expert-level IT technical lead services, including the integration and implementation of technologies, while applying deep backend expertise to optimize performance, ensure secure architecture, and enhance system scalability. 

Responsibilities

- Provides expert-level technical leadership for critical software, middleware, or hardware projects across multiple platforms, ensuring successful architecture, development, and implementation. Evaluates and approves development options and technical 
 - deliverables. Oversees comprehensive testing for functionality, performance, and security. 
 - Approves technical solutions proposed by team members, resolves complex technical problems, and anticipates issues to enable preventive action. 
 - Acts as a key technical liaison with stakeholders, effectively communicating technical implications, project risks, and solution strategies. 
 - Maintains expertise in IT methodologies, architecture design, and enterprise standards; mentors staff and ensures team adoption of evolving standards.

 - Ensures compliance with IT and Information Security policies, validating that deliverables meet internal and external requirements. 
 - Leads or contributes to special projects and cross-functional initiatives as assigned. 
 - Applies deep server-side development skills, focusing on performance optimization, secure architecture, and database efficiency.

Qualifications And Skills

 - Bachelor's degree (B. E. /B. Tech) in Computer Science or IT, or bachelor's in computer applications (BCA), or master's in computer applications (MCA).

data.description:
Company Description

We enable your best to power our future. 

Job Description

Gracenote, a Nielsen company, is dedicated to connecting audiences to the entertainment they love, powering a better media future for all people. We are the content data business unit of Nielsen that powers innovative entertainment experiences for the world's leading media companies. Our entertainment metadata and connected IDs deliver advanced content navigation and discovery to connect consumers to the content they love and discover new ones Gracenote's Data Platform is the central hub for millions of pieces of TV entertainment data used daily by clients and partners worldwide. It provides the critical services that structure and model data for our editorial, ingest, and delivery systems. This data powers entertainment solutions for the top cable, OTT, CE, and digital clients, reaching hundreds of millions of consumers. 

The Director of DevOps & Platform Engineering Gracenote India will be central to the success of our infrastructure, cloud platform, and engineering enablement teams across geographies. This role is fundamental to the growth and technical excellence of the Gracenote engineering organization as a whole. Key goals of this role are to establish technical rigor, operational efficiency, and a robust platform engineering culture. You will be responsible for managing compute infrastructure, cloud native and managed services, observability stacks, and cloud cost optimization (FinOps), while collaborating closely with local and global stakeholders to ensure high availability, scalability, and security for Gracenote's products. 

Responsibilities

- Manage and scale multiple teams of DevOps, and Cloud Infrastructure engineers in India, with direct and indirect managerial responsibilities. 
 - Work with local and global management across all relevant organizational partners to ensure the success, productivity, and operational alignment of assigned teams. 
 - Create a culture based on Nielsen values, fostering collaboration, continuous learning, and engineering excellence across platform operations. 
 - Establish operating rhythm and cadence within areas of responsibility to ensure transparent communication, inclusive leadership, and a positive, high-retention environment for engineers. 
 - Track and drive key performance indicators (KPIs) including system availability/SLA performance, incident resolution times, infrastructure productivity, cloud spend efficiency, and employee retention. 
 - Oversee and manage Gracenote's AWS footprint, including large-scale compute resources and AWS-managed services such as AWS Glue, Amazon MSK (Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka), EKS, EMR, RDS, and S3. 
 - Drive Kubernetes platform operations (Amazon EKS), focusing on automated scaling, cluster management, workload security, and operational reliability. 
 - Own and evolve the in-house observability stack based on Grafana, Loki, Prometheus, and related telemetry tools to ensure end-to-end visibility across microservices and data pipelines. 
 - Lead FinOps and cloud cost management initiatives, establishing robust cost tracking, forecasting, efficiency benchmarks, and continuous resource optimization strategies without compromising performance. 
 - Apply an automation-first mindset to Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and self-healing systems. 
 - Coordinate and maintain a strong talent pipeline. 
 - Continuously assess, streamline, and improve DevOps processes, incident management workflows, and infrastructure reliability standards. 
 - Ensure strict adherence to toolings, governance, and security best practices within the Product Development Lifecycle. 
 - Represent the India DevOps and Platform Engineering organization in cross-functional engagements (e. g. , Product, Software Engineering, Architecture, and Data Science). 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's/Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering. 
 - 12+ years of experience working in DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure. 
 - Proven track record in people management, team building, and leading multi-disciplinary DevOps teams in a global environment. 
 - 8-10 years of hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure, CI/CD tools, Infrastructure as Code (e. g. , Terraform, CloudFormation), and scripting (Python, Shell, Go, etc. ). 
 - 5+ years of dedicated experience managing production AWS environments at scale, specifically focusing on Amazon EKS and AWS native managed services (AWS Glue, MSK, EMR, S3, RDS, DynamoDB). 
 - Deep expertise in open-source and custom observability tools, particularly Grafana, Loki, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, or ELK stack. 
 - Proven track record in FinOps-managing cloud budgets, identifying cost inefficiencies, implementing auto-scaling/spot instances, and tracking cloud spend metrics. 
 - Strong foundation in Kubernetes architecture, containerization, microservices deployment, and networking/security policies. 
 - Good understanding of enterprise workflow and business tools such as JIRA, Confluence, OpsGenie, Gitlab, and CI/CD tools (e. g. , Jenkins, GitLab CI). 
 - Strong critical thinking, incident response leadership, and analytical problem-solving skills. 
 - Sense of curiosity, operational discipline, and high attention to detail. 

Additional Information

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen. com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen. com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

data.title: Senior Golang Developer
data.description:
Solvd Inc. is a rapidly growing AI-native consulting and technology services firm delivering enterprise transformation across cloud, data, software engineering, and artificial intelligence. We work with industry-leading organizations to design, build, and operationalize technology solutions that drive measurable business outcomes. 

Following the acquisition of Tooploox, a premier AI and product development company, Solvd now offers true end-to-end delivery-from strategic advisory and solution design to custom AI development and enterprise-scale implementation. Our capability centers combine deep technical expertise, proven delivery methodologies, and sector-specific knowledge to address complex business challenges quickly and effectively. 

We are looking for a Senior Go Developer to design and develop high-performance, secure, and reliable software components for enterprise-scale data collection and processing systems. You'll be building software that runs across Windows and macOS, processes high-frequency events, securely buffers and transmits data, and integrates with cloud-based data platforms - with production-grade engineering practices throughout. 

What You'll Do

- Design, develop, and maintain high-performance applications and background services in Go, following clean architecture and production-grade engineering practices. 
 - Build multi-threaded and concurrent processing components using goroutines, channels, synchronization primitives, worker pools, and efficient memory-management techniques. 
 - Develop reliable event collection, processing, batching, compression, serialization, and transmission mechanisms for high-volume telemetry and event data. 
 - Implement robust local persistence and encrypted buffering - supporting offline operation, checkpointing, retry queues, recovery, and protection against data loss. 
 - Develop secure integrations with cloud platforms and data services using REST APIs, HTTPS, SDKs, and other integration mechanisms. 
 - Implement enterprise-grade authentication and security mechanisms, including RSA key-pair authentication, JWT/OAuth, TLS, certificate validation, encryption, and secure credential handling. 
 - Design resilient distributed-client behavior - idempotency, duplicate prevention, exponential-backoff retries, acknowledgement handling, failure recovery, rate limiting, and network resilience. 
 - Develop efficient data-processing capabilities across formats such as JSON, Parquet, and Protocol Buffers. 
 - Optimize applications for CPU, memory, disk I/O, network utilization, startup time, and long-running stability using Go profiling and diagnostic tools. 
 - Develop and support cross-platform software for Windows and macOS, including interaction with OS APIs, system services, file systems, networking, and OS-native security facilities. 
 - Build comprehensive unit, integration, performance, stress, resilience, and security tests. 
 - Implement production-grade logging, metrics, health monitoring, diagnostics, and telemetry - ensuring sensitive information is never exposed through operational logs. 
 - Contribute to application packaging, versioning, configuration management, automated deployment, upgrade, rollback, and enterprise software-distribution strategies. 
 - Provide senior-level technical leadership through architecture discussions, design reviews, code reviews, troubleshooting, and mentoring. 

Required Skills & Experience

- 7+ years of software development experience with strong hands-on expertise in Golang. 
 - Advanced knowledge of Go concurrency - goroutines, channels, mutexes, contexts, synchronization, and worker-pool patterns. 
 - Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, memory management, and performance optimization. 
 - Experience building long-running services, agents, system utilities, telemetry applications, or distributed client applications. 
 - Strong experience with REST APIs, HTTPS, TLS, JSON, authentication, and secure API integration. 
 - Experience implementing RSA/public-key cryptography, JWT/OAuth, certificate-based authentication, and secure credential management. 
 - Experience with local persistence, caching, queueing, batching, compression, retry, and failure-recovery patterns. 
 - Knowledge of Parquet or similar columnar/binary data formats and high-volume data-processing patterns. 
 - Strong experience with unit testing, integration testing, mocking, profiling, debugging, and performance testing in Go. 
 - Good understanding of CI/CD, Git, code-quality tooling, dependency management, vulnerability scanning, and secure SDLC practices. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Snowflake or comparable cloud data platforms and cloud SDK integration. 
 - Experience with Windows and/or macOS system programming, enterprise endpoint software, or large-scale telemetry systems. 
 - Familiarity with C/C++ or . NET interoperability, Windows APIs, macOS APIs, or OS-level encryption and key stores. 
 - Experience with MSI/MSIX packaging and enterprise device-management platforms. 

When you join Solvd, you'll. . . 

- Shape real-world AI-driven projects across key industries, working with clients from startup innovation to enterprise transformation. 
 - Be part of a global team with equal opportunities for collaboration across continents and cultures. 
 - Thrive in an inclusive environment that prioritizes continuous learning, innovation, and ethical AI standards. 

Ready to make an impact?

If you're excited to build things that matter, champion responsible AI, and grow with some of the industry's sharpest minds. Apply today and let's innovate together. 

Solvd is an equal opportunity employer.

The Arctic Wolf security operations platform ingests and processes upwards of 250 billion events a day from a wide variety of on-premise devices and cloud platforms. The security pipeline is a distributed system of loosely-coupled microservices that constitute our real-time analysis and threat detection systems. These services distill the incoming events into actionable intelligence that our Concierge Security Teams use to protect customers. 

We are growing rapidly, with our data volume increasing ten-fold roughly every two years. Job Description: Quality Team Leader - Criminal Verifications

Department: Quality Assurance - Criminal Verifications (Public Records)

Location: Remote

Work Schedule: Monday to Friday (Night Shift)

Reporting To: Quality Manager / Operations Manager

Role Overview

The Quality Team Leader - Criminal Verifications will lead a team of Quality Coaches/Auditors supporting US criminal background screening and public records research. The primary mandate is to deliver 100% audit coverage, ensure 100% feedback delivery and closure on every audited transaction, and drive weekly calibration sessions with Operations and fellow Quality Coaches so that court record interpretation and reportability decisions are applied consistently across the account. 

Key Responsibilities

Audit Coverage & Feedback (Primary)

- Ensure 100% audit coverage across all criminal verification transactions, researchers, court types, and jurisdictions in scope
 - Ensure 100% feedback closure - every audit finding is communicated to the researcher and their Team Leader within the defined TAT, with acknowledgement captured
 - Maintain audit logs, error trackers, and feedback registers with full traceability (auditor, date, jurisdiction, defect type, severity, root cause, corrective action)
 - Track repeat and researcher-specific errors; drive individual improvement plans in partnership with Operations
 - Monitor coverage dashboards daily and escalate any gap that threatens the 100% target

Calibration & Consistency

- Own and run weekly calibration sessions with Operations leadership, Quality Coaches, and Training
 - Prepare calibration case sets covering felony/misdemeanor calls, disposition edge cases, identifier matching, and record reportability
 - Publish agendas, capture minutes, and track action items to closure
 - Measure and report inter-auditor agreement/variance; drive corrective action where auditors or Ops interpret rules differently
 - Maintain a living decision log / FAQ so calibration outcomes become documented standards and SOP updates

Quality Team Management

- Manage, coach, and develop a team of Quality Coaches/Auditors dedicated to criminal verifications
 - Allocate audit volumes by jurisdiction and researcher, monitor auditor productivity, and ensure daily/weekly audit targets are met
 - Conduct one-on-ones, performance reviews, and skill development plans for the quality team
 - Certify and re-certify auditors through calibration results and accuracy checks

Criminal Verification Domain Quality

- Audit accuracy and completeness of research across local, county, state, and federal US court portals, as well as vendor/court runner and database sources
 - Validate correct review and interpretation of court dockets and legal documentation, including: 
 - Charge levels (felony, misdemeanor, infraction)
 - Case types (criminal / civil)
 - Case statuses and dispositions (convicted, dismissed, acquitted, deferred, pending, expunged/sealed, etc. )
 - Identifier matching (name, DOB, address, and other PII match logic) to prevent false positives and false negatives
 - Verify correct application of client reportability rules, adjudication matrices, and jurisdiction-specific reporting restrictions
 - Ensure criminal records are documented, classified, and reported accurately and within TAT

Compliance & Governance

- Ensure adherence to FCRA, state reporting restrictions, ban-the-box and seven-year rules, client SOPs, and internal criminal screening guidelines
 - Maintain confidentiality and data integrity while handling sensitive criminal record and PII data
 - Support internal, client, and regulatory audits with documented, evidence-backed audit trails
 - Flag critical/fatal defects - misreported convictions, missed records, wrong-subject matches - for immediate escalation and containment

Continuous Improvement

- Perform root cause analysis on defect trends by jurisdiction, court type, researcher, and client program; drive CAPA to closure
 - Partner with Training to convert recurring defects into refresher modules, checklists, and updated SOPs
 - Identify process gaps, search-logic issues, and automation opportunities that reduce error leakage
 - Track effectiveness of improvement actions through pre/post accuracy movement

Stakeholder Management

- Act as the quality point of contact for Criminal Operations, Training, Compliance, and Client Services
 - Present quality performance, jurisdiction risk areas, and defect trends in operational and client reviews
 - Manage quality escalations, disputes, and rebuttals with objective, evidence-based resolution
 - Support dispute/reinvestigation reviews where consumer challenges relate to reported criminal records

MIS & Reporting

- Publish daily/weekly/monthly quality dashboards covering coverage %, accuracy, defect categories, and feedback closure
 - Track and report critical vs. non-critical error rates, auditor variance, and calibration outcomes
 - Analyze trends, forecast risk, and recommend corrective actions to leadership

Mandatory Requirements (Non-Negotiable)

- Hands-on experience in US criminal / public records background verification is mandatory
 - Prior experience in quality auditing of criminal verification transactions
 - Minimum 18 months of experience as a Quality Coach (on paper)
 - Total experience of 3-6 years in BGV / KPO / Quality Assurance
 - Demonstrated experience running audits, feedback cycles, and calibration sessions
 - Strong understanding of US legal terminology, court hierarchy, and court documentation
 - No employment gaps exceeding 5-6 months
 - Willingness to work in US Shift (Night Shift)

Skills & Competencies

- Strong working knowledge of US court websites, court structures, and public record systems
 - Sound grasp of quality frameworks - sampling methodology, defect classification, RCA, CAPA
 - Working knowledge of FCRA and state-level criminal reporting restrictions
 - Excellent analytical, interpretation, and attention-to-detail abilities
 - Strong coaching and feedback delivery skills; able to influence without direct authority
 - Clear written and verbal communication for audit documentation and stakeholder reviews
 - Ability to remain objective and evidence-driven in a fast-paced, target-driven environment

Technical Skills

- Advanced proficiency in MS Excel (pivots, lookups, dashboards) and MIS reporting
 - Familiarity with BGV platforms and quality audit tools is an advantage
 - Strong data handling, trend analysis, and presentation skills

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Audit coverage - 100%
 - Feedback delivery and closure - 100% within TAT
 - Weekly calibration completion and inter-auditor variance within threshold
 - Accuracy / quality score movement of supported criminal research teams
 - Critical (fatal) error rate - missed records, wrong-subject matches, misreported dispositions
 - Defect leakage to client and dispute/reinvestigation volumes
 - Repeat error reduction and RCA/CAPA effectiveness
 - Auditor productivity and certification compliance
 - Client satisfaction and audit escalation resolution
 - Team engagement and retention

About The Role

Esko is building Agentic AI as a shared platform capability that enables product teams to create reliable AI-powered workflows without independently rebuilding common foundations. The platform team provides reusable capabilities, engineering patterns, and production foundations; product teams retain ownership of their domain applications and customer experiences. 

This is a hands-on engineering leadership role combining line management with substantial direct technical contribution. You will lead and develop the Agentic AI team, help shape the platform's technical direction, and take end-to-end ownership of substantial technical areas. Success will be measured not only by what the team ships, but by the quality, adoption, and leverage the platform creates across Esko. 

You will work closely with product engineering, architecture, cloud platform, security, compliance, product management, and design to translate shared needs and legitimate domain differences into coherent platform capabilities. You will also contribute to Esko's broader AI direction and participate in customer or industry discussions where your technical perspective is valuable. 

What You Will Do

- Lead and develop the Agentic AI engineering team through clear goals, regular feedback, coaching, performance management, career development, and thoughtful allocation of ownership. 
 - Contribute directly to the design, implementation, and operation of substantial areas of Esko's shared Agentic AI platform. 
 - Help shape the platform's technical direction, architecture, interfaces, and engineering quality bar in collaboration with the wider platform and architecture community. 
 - Translate recurring product and engineering needs into reusable platform capabilities, while accommodating legitimate domain differences without creating product-specific forks. 
 - Establish strong engineering practices for reliability, security, observability, evaluation, performance, and compatibility for consuming teams. 
 - Work directly with product engineering teams to support adoption of the shared platform and help them take domain-specific agentic capabilities from exploration into production. 
 - Create an environment in which engineers can experiment, learn, challenge assumptions, and make evidence-based technical decisions while remaining accountable for production outcomes. 
 - Define and use meaningful measures of platform adoption, quality, operational performance, delivery effectiveness, and team development to guide priorities and improvement. 

What We Are Looking For

- Strong production software engineering experience in Python, TypeScript, Java, or a similar language, including designing, building, and operating reliable systems. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading and developing engineers, including line management, coaching, performance feedback, and creating meaningful technical ownership. 
 - Experience building a platform, API, or shared service used by multiple teams, with sound judgement about abstractions, interfaces, compatibility, and operational responsibilities. 
 - Experience designing or building production AI systems using large language models, tool use, or agentic workflows, together with a practical understanding of their limitations and risks. 
 - A track record of taking uncertain or early-stage technical ideas through evaluation, implementation, and adoption as dependable production capabilities. 
 - Ability to balance platform coherence with legitimate product and domain differences, and to make clear technical trade-offs when needs conflict. 
 - Experience collaborating across product engineering, architecture, infrastructure, security, and business functions in a global organization. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical decisions clearly to engineering, product, and leadership audiences. 
 - Undergraduate, Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science / Machine Learning / Data Science / Artificial Intelligence, or related disciplines. 

Preferred Experience

- Experience in packaging graphics, prepress, CAD, or the wider graphic arts industry. 
 - Experience building or operating multi-tenant SaaS or cloud platform capabilities. 
 - Experience with AI evaluation, observability, security controls, governance, or other production foundations for agentic systems. 

What Success Looks Like

- Delivery of solutions conforming to agreed specifications and architecture that leverage agentic AI to solve valuable customer problems in a way that is explainable and repeatable - resulting in measurable productivity improvements. 
 - Teams across the business ship AI-powered capabilities that solve valuable customer problems by leveraging a shared foundation, rather than "re-inventing the wheel". 
 - Providing adequate space for ideation - and inspiration for team members to try new approaches, technologies and techniques. 
 - Team members are set meaningful, measurable goals - with training and development plans created to facilitate their ongoing personal and career development. 
 - Delivery of initiatives occurs in line with Esko's Software Development Lifecycle and in accordance with company policy and security best practices. 
 - The Agentic AI platform grows as a coherent whole rather than fragmenting into one-off, team-specific solutions. 
 - A class-leading set of capabilities provide a powerful base for Esko cross-functional teams to transform the value of our software using cutting-edge AI technologies.

What Role You Will Play In Our Team
The Wells Quality Engineer - OCTG is a broad role definition for individuals, generally with strong manufacturing quality background, supporting the global Wells business with a focus on Oil Country Tubular Goods (OCTG) products including but not limited to casing, tubing and accessories. This role focusses on application of risk mitigations through quality best practices and processes to ensure integrity and compliance of materials, products, and equipment to industry and specified requirements and provides guidance on fit-for-purpose quality implementation. This position is embedded in the technical center (based in Bengaluru), provides quality expertise and support to business units and the global Wells Quality network. 

What You Will Do

- Responsible for review and approval of supplier Quality Control Plans and Inspection Test Plans for, OCTG and API / Proprietary Threading (VAM, JFE, Tenaris, etc. , ). 
 - Steward supplier evaluations and assessments, facility qualifications (such as OCTG Mill and Threading facility) and API Q1 compliance audits. 
 - Provide assistance to Wells procurement teams to incorporate Wells Quality Manual (WQM) and associated Appendices into quality exhibits for tender documentation packages.

 - Organize, plan, and supervise verification programs via Third Party Inspectors (TPIs) to ensure conformance with the applicable ExxonMobil specifications and industry codes and standards. 
 - Ensure appropriate budget allocation for Third Party inspection agencies in collaboration with Wells Teams. 
 - Assist Wells Engineering staff with resolution of Nonconformance Reports (NCRs) and Requests-for-Exception (RFEs). 
 - Lead or participate in Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and failure investigations for Downhole Completion Equipment's failures or non-conformities. 
 - Review TPI inspection reports, ensure outstanding concerns and issues are effectively addressed by the supplier prior to releasing the equipment for dispatch to project site locations.

Skills and Qualifications

 - You think in terms of scalability, performance, reliability and long- term maintainability.

 - You are comfortable interacting with clients and stakeholders to understand business processes and requirements. 
 - You have handled production environments and real customer-impacting issues. 
 - You can balance technical depth, people management and delivery commitments.

data.description:
About Us. . 

Dyson is a global technology company powered by ingenuity and relentless curiosity. We reimagine everyday products through radical innovation-from vacuums and hair care to air purification and robotics. Our teams thrive on challenge and continuous improvement. 

As we expand into new markets, our technology function is central to Dyson's future-ensuring every solution scales securely and delivers best-in-class experiences for millions of people. Here, architecture isn't just about systems. It's about unleashing ideas, shaping outcomes, and making a real difference. 

Join a community that celebrates disruption, values diverse perspectives, and empowers you to lead at the edge of possibility. 

Please note

- We do not offer hybrid/remote working for this position
 - We ask that you provide evidence of your work with your application (e. g. , website or portfolio)

About The Role

As a Integration Solution Architect, you'll be a senior technical leader within Dyson's Solution Architecture team, reporting to a Principal Solution Architect. You'll set the direction for enterprise integration and interface solutions across a varied technology landscape, lead architects and engineers through complex delivery, and ensure our integration capabilities support Dyson's global growth. 

You'll own integration solution architecture from discovery through delivery, designing secure, reusable interfaces across APIs, events, messaging, data exchange and batch or file-based patterns. Working across platforms including SAP Commerce, Salesforce, Adobe, SAP and other enterprise services, you'll turn complex requirements into pragmatic roadmaps and high-quality solutions that deliver measurable outcomes. 

Beyond individual solution design, you'll provide technical leadership across the integration community: chairing design reviews, guiding delivery teams, coaching architects and engineers, and raising standards through clear governance. You'll champion appropriate integration patterns, reusable assets, automation, observability and responsible innovation across MuleSoft and other integration technologies, while communicating trade-offs and recommendations confidently to senior technical and business stakeholders. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define and evolve Dyson's enterprise integration strategy, reference architecture, standards and roadmap across integration technologies. 
 - Lead solution architecture for complex integration initiatives from discovery and options assessment through implementation and operational handover. 
 - Design scalable interfaces using the most appropriate patterns, including APIs, events, messaging, data synchronization, managed file transfer and batch integration. 
 - Establish reusable patterns and assets for security, error handling, logging, monitoring, data transformation, versioning and lifecycle management. 
 - Lead architecture and design reviews, challenge constructively, document key decisions and ensure solutions comply with enterprise, security and data standards. 
 - Provide technical direction to architects, engineers, partners and suppliers; remove ambiguity, resolve complex design issues and maintain delivery quality. 
 - Coach and mentor others through pairing, design critique and knowledge sharing, building a strong and inclusive integration engineering community. 
 - Partner with business and technology stakeholders to translate outcomes and non-functional requirements into pragmatic architecture decisions and delivery plans. 
 - Drive the reliability, performance and cost effectiveness of integration services through observability, capacity planning, automation and continual improvement. 
 - Manage architectural risks, dependencies and technical debt, escalating decisions clearly and supporting delivery against agreed scope, quality and timelines. 

About You

- Prerequisite: significant hands-on experience designing and delivering enterprise integrations using MuleSoft Anypoint Platform in complex, large-scale environments. 
 - Broad knowledge of enterprise integration patterns, including RESTful and asynchronous APIs, event-driven integration, messaging, data transformation, managed file transfer, batch processing and hybrid integration. 
 - Practical experience across relevant MuleSoft capabilities such as Anypoint Design Center, API Manager, Exchange, Runtime Manager and CloudHub or equivalent runtime models. 
 - Experience selecting and applying appropriate integration technologies and patterns based on business outcomes, architecture principles and non-functional requirements. 
 - A strong grasp of security, identity, resilience, performance, observability, CI/CD and automated testing for integration solutions. 
 - Proven leadership of architects and engineers, including setting direction, delegating effectively, providing constructive challenge and developing others. 
 - Experience governing solution designs and working with delivery partners or suppliers to achieve consistent engineering standards and outcomes. 
 - The judgement to balance strategic architecture with pragmatic delivery, making clear decisions when requirements are incomplete or priorities compete. 
 - Confident communication with senior stakeholders, with the ability to explain complex technical choices, risks and trade-offs in accessible language. 
 - Experience integrating major enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, SAP, Adobe or comparable applications. 
 - MuleSoft certification is desirable; equivalent evidence of deep MuleSoft expertise will also be considered. 
 - A collaborative, inclusive and improvement-focused leadership style, with curiosity about automation, AI and emerging integration approaches. 

Dyson is an equal opportunity employer. We know that great minds don't think alike, and it takes all kinds of minds to make our technology so unique. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other any other dimension of diversity.

 - Technical excellence & standards - Drive best practices in Claude-based development, code review, and design quality; hold the team - and your own work - to the architect's standards

data.title: Senior DevOps Engineer, IT - Data Operations Engineering
data.description:
Edwards Lifesciences is expanding its global technology capabilities with the launch of a new IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India. The Hub strengthens the technology foundation that supports our business worldwide, working in close partnership with teams across regions to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions at scale. 

Designed as a long-term investment, the Pune Hub will advance newer digital capabilities such as automation, data, AI, and cloud, and will include roles spanning end user services, application development, and enterprise platform teams. 

As part of our IT team, your expertise and commitment will help build and operate the platforms that power Edwards' global data and analytics solutions. We are seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer to support Data Operations Engineering and own the operational backbone of our data platforms, including infrastructure as code, continuous integration and delivery, data quality monitoring and incident response, observability, security operations, and cloud cost optimization. Our multi-cloud estate includes Databricks and Snowflake, with data services moving to Azure while AWS continues to host corporate source systems. 

How You Will Make An Impact

- Build and maintain modular Terraform components that provision cloud and Databricks platform capabilities, including workspaces, cluster policies, secret scopes, networking, and Unity Catalog storage credentials and external locations, consistently across environments and clouds. 
 - Design and operate automated GitLab CI/CD pipelines that deploy data platform code and infrastructure through development, staging, and production with approval gates and controlled promotion. 
 - Monitor data quality and pipeline health, own first-line response to production alerts, resolve issues directly where possible, and escalate only when the root cause requires deeper pipeline or platform change. 
 - Build, test, and continuously improve runbooks for recurring failure modes, automating remediation when the response can be made safe and repeatable. 
 - Apply AI- and agent-assisted operations capabilities to accelerate detection, triage, and remediation as those capabilities mature. 
 - Build end-to-end observability across Databricks, Snowflake, and orchestration services by bringing platform and execution metadata into unified dashboards, alerting, and pipeline service-level monitoring. 
 - Containerize and operate platform workloads, orchestration, and CI runners on Docker and Kubernetes across EKS and AKS. 
 - Operate and re-host Apache Airflow, consolidating self-managed instances onto Kubernetes or a managed runtime, while supporting migration of legacy build tooling to GitLab CI. 
 - Embed security operations into the platform lifecycle through secrets management, short-lived credentials, least-privilege access, encryption key policies, audit logging, and vulnerability remediation. 
 - Drive cloud cost optimization through cost attribution, policy enforcement, right-sizing, tagging standards, and anomaly alerting. 
 - Support secure cross-cloud connectivity and data movement between AWS-resident source systems and the Azure data platform. 
 - Identify opportunities for automation, reusable standards, reliability improvement, and technical debt reduction, and provide technical guidance to team members. 

What You Will Need (Required)

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field and a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in DevOps, platform engineering, site reliability engineering, or cloud infrastructure roles. 
 - Strong hands-on experience administering and automating workloads on both Amazon Web Services and Microsoft Azure, including identity, networking, and storage services. 
 - Demonstrated expertise building modular, reusable infrastructure with Terraform across multiple environments. 
 - Proven experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in GitLab CI or an equivalent platform, including environment promotion, approval gates, and secrets handling. 
 - Strong proficiency with Docker and Kubernetes, including EKS or AKS and running CI/CD or orchestration workloads on Kubernetes. 
 - Hands-on experience operating Apache Airflow, including DAG deployment, scheduling, retries, backfills, pools, and failure recovery. 
 - Solid Linux systems administration, shell scripting, and troubleshooting skills. 
 - Hands-on experience implementing metrics, logging, dashboards, and alerting using tools such as Datadog or Grafana. 
 - Demonstrated experience monitoring pipeline and data quality, owning first-line triage of production alerts, and writing and executing runbooks for recurring failures. 
 - Working knowledge of secrets management, least-privilege access control, encryption key management, audit logging, and vulnerability remediation. 
 - Working knowledge of cloud cost monitoring, attribution, tagging standards, and right-sizing practices. 
 - Proficiency in Python or another scripting language used for automation and tooling. 
 - Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and organizational skills with the ability to work across cross-functional and geographically distributed teams. 
 - Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining attention to quality, controls, and long-term outcomes. 
 - Adhere to all company rules and requirements, including Environmental Health & Safety rules, and take adequate control measures to prevent injuries, protect the environment, and prevent pollution under their span of influence or control. 

What Else We Look For (Preferred)

- Experience operating Databricks or Snowflake, including platform administration, policy management, and service principal or access management. 
 - Experience with Databricks Asset Bundles, Unity Catalog, the Databricks Terraform provider, or managed Terraform state and gated production applies. 
 - Experience with keyless authentication from CI, such as OIDC-based role assumption or IRSA. 
 - Experience with data observability or AI-assisted operations capabilities, such as Monte Carlo, Datadog AI capabilities, or Databricks operations automation. 
 - Experience with Astronomer, MWAA, or Airflow on Kubernetes using KubernetesExecutor. 
 - Experience with Azure Data Factory, ADLS Gen2, Key Vault, Azure Monitor, and Entra ID, or AWS Glue, Athena, Lambda, and Secrets Manager. 
 - Experience supporting hybrid or cross-cloud architectures and private connectivity among clouds and on-premises environments. 
 - Experience migrating CI/CD from Jenkins or another legacy build platform. 
 - Experience with streaming or change data capture technologies such as AWS DMS, Amazon MSK, or Kafka. 
 - Experience with SALT, Ansible, Azure DevOps, or related configuration and delivery tooling. 
 - Relevant experience in medical device, pharmaceuticals, or another highly regulated environment, including validation and change control expectations. 
 - Relevant AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, or Terraform certifications. 

Additional Information

- Develops solutions to a variety of complex platform and operational problems and exercises judgment in selecting methods and techniques after considering risk and alternatives. 
 - Works with general direction focused on end results and may provide technical guidance to lower-level personnel. 
 - Participation in an on-call rotation may be required to support platform reliability. 
 - Travel may be required up to 5%. 

Benefits And Equal Opportunity

Aligning our overall business objectives with performance, we offer competitive salaries, performance-based incentives, and a wide variety of benefits programs to address the diverse individual needs of our employees and their families.

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success. 

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe. 

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in. 

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it. 

Endpoint Agent - Senior Software Engineer

Why Kaseya?

Join a fast-growing company transforming the IT management and cybersecurity industry. At Kaseya, we are modernizing how software is designed, built, tested, and operated-combining strong engineering fundamentals with AI-native development practices. 

You will have the opportunity to shape not only our technology architecture, but also how engineering teams leverage AI to build high-quality software faster and more effectively. 

Join the Kaseya growth rocket ship and see how we are #ChangingLives!

Job Summary

We are looking for a motivated Endpoint Software Engineer to help develop and maintain Kaseya's endpoint management agents. You will work alongside senior engineers to deliver new capabilities, improve platform reliability, and solve complex device management challenges across multiple operating systems. 

This role is ideal for engineers passionate about operating systems, systems programming, device management, and endpoint security. 

What You Will Do

- Design and implement new features for endpoint agents across Windows, macOS, Linux, and mobile platforms.

 - Continuously learn and expand expertise in system software and endpoint technologies. 

What You Bring

 - Strong proficiency in C# and . NET 
 - Deep understanding of at least one operating system platform (Windows, macOS, Linux) 
 - Strong knowledge of operating system fundamentals including - Processes, Threads, Filesystems, Networking, Security fundamentals

 - Familiarity with one or more MDM ecosystems - Intune, Apple MDM, Android Enterprise, Linux management tools

Nice to have

What Success Looks Like

A successful Endpoint Engineer at Kaseya:

 - Solves complex customer and platform challenges. 
 - Improves reliability, security, and performance of endpoint agents. 
 - Partners effectively across Product, Support, Security, and Engineering teams. 
 - Learns continuously and stays current with evolving operating system and device management technologies.

Architectural Leadership: Define and implement the end-to-end DFT architecture for complex SoCs, including Hierarchical DFT, Scan compression, and MBIST.

Implementation & Flow: Oversee scan insertion, ATPG (Stuck-at, Transition, Path Delay), and

Logic BIST. 

Cross-Functional Synergy: Collaborate with Design, Physical Design, and Yield teams to ensure high test coverage while minimizing area overhead and power impact.

(IEEE 1149. 1/6).

Job Description Summary

L'ingénierie des systèmes est une discipline d'ingénierie interfonctionnelle axée sur une approche, un état d'esprit et un processus. Toutes les activités qui tiennent compte des besoins à la fois commerciaux et techniques des clients dans le but de fournir un produit de qualité qui réponde aux besoins des utilisateurs. Discipline qui exécute un processus robuste de conception, de création et d'optimisation de systèmes, comprenant l'identification et la quantification des exigences système, la création de concepts de conception de système alternatifs, la réalisation d'études commerciales de conception, la sélection et la mise en œuvre des meilleures conceptions et la vérification que la conception est correctement intégrée et exécutée. Processus allant du concept à l'exploitation en passant par la production. 

Responsable de la planification et/ou de l'exécution des opérations du département ou axé sur l'exécution d'activités professionnelles au sein d'une discipline technique. Fonctions dotées d'une certaine autonomie, mais guidées par les politiques établies ou l'analyse des résultats finaux. 

Ce poste est autorisé à modifier les procédures et les pratiques en relation avec les tâches dans la mesure où les résultats finaux répondent aux normes d'acceptabilité (qualité, volume, respect des délais, etc. ).

Rôles et responsabilités

- Identifie, développe, évalue, introduit et gère des solutions d'ingénierie répondant aux besoins technologiques en matière de contrôle de produits et de systèmes de contrôle. Applique la théorie du contrôle et la modélisation mathématique à la conception et au contrôle de systèmes avec les comportements souhaités. Comprend l'opérabilité, la définition des limites, l'optimisation du cycle, la logique de contrôle, les logiciels liés au contrôle, les capteurs, les algorithmes matériels et logiciels, ainsi que les informations en retour permettant de contrôler les performances des dispositifs, sous-systèmes et systèmes. 
 - Développer une connaissance approfondie d'une discipline technique. Se fonde sur une expérience antérieure et une expertise technique acquise pour mettre en œuvre une politique/stratégie. 
 - Compréhension approfondie des principaux facteurs opérationnels ; utilise cette compréhension pour accomplir son propre travail. Compréhension approfondie de la manière dont le travail de sa propre équipe s'intègre aux autres équipes et contribue à son domaine. 
 - Fait preuve de discernement et est en capacité de proposer différentes solutions en dehors des paramètres définis, dans le cadre d'une orientation. Se fonde sur une expérience antérieure et la formation professionnelle pour résoudre des tâches simples. Possède les compétences techniques et l'esprit d'analyse nécessaires à la résolution de problèmes. Peut utiliser plusieurs sources internes en dehors de sa propre équipe pour prendre des décisions. 
 - Un poste à ce niveau est susceptible d'être un contributeur individuel, avec des compétences interpersonnelles éprouvées ou un People Leader capable d'embaucher et de développer des talents. Fournit des conseils informels aux nouveaux membres de l'équipe. 

Qualifications De Base

- 
 - Pour les rôles en dehors des États-Unis - Ce rôle nécessite une expérience significative de la fonction et de la station de travail audio numérique. Connaissances de niveau équivalent à une licence dans une université accréditée (ou un baccalauréat avec une expérience dans un domaine pertinent). 
 - Pour les rôles aux États-Unis - Licence d'une université accrédité (ou diplôme d'études secondaires et/ou diplôme d'étude général avec au moins 4 ans d'expérience dans la fonction). 

Caractéristiques souhaitées

- Solides compétences en communication orale et écrite. Solides compétences relationnelles et de leadership. Capacité à influencer les autres et à diriger de petites équipes. Mener des initiatives d'envergure et d'impact modérés. Capacité à coordonner plusieurs projets simultanément. Identification efficace des problèmes et compétences en résolution de problèmes. Capacités d'analyse et d'organisation prouvées. Remarque : Pour se conformer aux exigences légales américaines en matière d'immigration et autres, il est nécessaire de préciser le nombre minimum d'années d'expérience requis pour tout poste basé aux États-Unis. Pour les rôles en dehors des États-Unis, pour assurer la conformité avec la législation applicable, les juristes doivent mentionner le niveau d'expérience requis et non PAS un nombre minimum d'années. data.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50, 000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work-but it's work worth doing. If you're driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. 

About Lilly

At Lilly, everything we do starts with patients. We unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our global team of over 50, 000 employees work with urgency and purpose to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. We bring our best to this work because people depend on it. If you're driven by purpose and determined to make a meaningful difference for patients, we invite you to bring your skill and your commitment to Lilly. 

About Technology@Lilly

At Lilly, technology is not a support function. It is how a global medicine company operates, innovates, and delivers. Lilly in Bengaluru builds the capabilities that make this possible, cloud platforms, AI systems, and automation at enterprise scale, all in service of a purpose that makes this technology work genuinely distinctive, from advancing drug discovery to enabling connected clinical trials to keeping a global medicine company running at the standard patients deserve. 

About The Business Function

Eli Lilly's Global DIA organization is seeking an AI Solution Architect / Lead to own the end-to-end AI and analytics architecture across the Manufacturing & Quality (MQ) technology portfolio. This is a strategic, hands-on leadership role for a senior technologist with deep roots in pharmaceutical manufacturing, enterprise AI platforms, and GxP-regulated system design. The architect will set technical direction, govern AI solution quality, and bridge business strategy to production-grade intelligent systems across quality management, manufacturing line analytics, pharmacovigilance, and the Global Manufacturing Data Fabric. 

Role: AI Solution Architect / Lead

Key Responsibilities

AI Architecture & Technical Leadership

- Define and own the AI/analytics solution architecture across the MQ DIA portfolio - covering data ingestion, RAG pipelines, agentic orchestration, MCP server ecosystems, model serving, and GxP-compliant deployment. 
 - Lead Architecture Review Boards (ARBs), produce Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), and enforce design standards across squads and platforms. 
 - Evaluate and select AI/ML frameworks, cloud services, and data platforms - maintaining a technology radar aligned to Lilly's enterprise direction. 
 - Translate executive strategy into multi-quarter technical roadmaps with phased deliverables, resource estimates, and risk registers. 

Agentic AI, RAG & Advanced Analytics

- Architect multi-agent orchestration systems (LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI) for manufacturing workflows: deviation investigation, complaint triage, CAPA recommendation, and batch release support. 
 - Design enterprise RAG architectures across QMS, MES, and regulatory knowledge bases with retrieval fidelity, hybrid search, and audit-ready provenance. 
 - Define MCP server architecture standards for exposing manufacturing APIs (Veeva, MES, LIMS) as structured LLM-consumable tool interfaces. 
 - Architect real-time analytics on OSI PI / Kafka streams for predictive quality, OEE optimization, and process excursion detection. 

Cloud & Data Platform

- Own cloud architecture strategy across AWS, Azure, and Databricks - ensuring security posture, GxP compliance, and cost governance. 
 - Design the data lake integration layer: medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold), data contracts, schema registries, and lineage governance on Delta Lake. 
 - Define MLOps architecture: model registry (MLflow), drift detection, retraining pipelines, and model lifecycle governance. 
 - Govern MuleSoft + MCP integration patterns - clean separation between legacy integration investments and new AI tooling layers. 

GxP Compliance & AI Governance

- Serve as AI governance authority: model explainability, audit trails, human-in-the-loop gates, and regulatory defensibility of AI-assisted decisions. 
 - Lead CSV framework design for AI/ML systems under 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, and GAMP 5 - including IQ/OQ/PQ templates and risk-based validation strategies. 
 - Engage Global QA, Regulatory Affairs, and IT Risk to qualify new AI capabilities for GxP manufacturing environments. 

Team Development & Stakeholder Leadership

- Mentor distributed AI engineering and platform architecture teams; define engineering standards and review processes. 
 - Represent MQ DIA in enterprise AI governance forums, architecture councils, and with executive stakeholders across Manufacturing, Quality, and Regulatory. 
 - Partner with HR to define hiring profiles and skill frameworks for the MQ AI engineering community. 

Qualifications Required

- Bachelor's in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or related field; Master's / PhD preferred. 
 - 10-15 years in AI/ML systems, solution architecture, and enterprise data platforms - minimum 5 years as principal/lead architect. 
 - 3 years in pharmaceutical, biotech, or regulated manufacturing with GxP / 21 CFR Part 11 exposure. 
 - Expert command of RAG, agentic orchestration, MCP, embeddings, and prompt engineering in production environments. 
 - Advanced proficiency in AWS (SageMaker, Bedrock, EKS, Redshift), Azure (Azure OpenAI, Azure ML, Synapse), and Databricks (Delta Lake, MLflow, Mosaic AI). 
 - Strong knowledge of ISA-95/88 manufacturing standards, pharmaceutical QMS concepts (CAPA, OOS, batch disposition), and pharmacovigilance data flows. 

Preferred

- Hands-on experience with Veeva QMS, QBDVision, OSI PI, MES (Tulip, Werum PAS-X), or LabVantage / STARLIMS. 
 - Familiarity with AI Gateway platform, Lakehouse/Databricks environment, or MuleSoft integration architecture. 
 - Knowledge of FDA AI/ML-based SaMD guidance, ICH Q8-Q10, and data mesh / ontology engineering. 
 - Certifications: AWS Solutions Architect Pro, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Databricks ML Professional.

We believe the people who dedicate themselves to making medicines better deserve an environment that makes their lives better too, one where they are supported, respected, and given the space to do their best work. data.title: Sr. Integration Software Engineer
data.description:
The Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center (ENGINE) in Bengaluru India brings together the resources and expertise of the Chevron global network with talent in India to enhance agility and technological innovation to optimize solutions for the world's current and future energy challenges. As one of the leading energy providers worldwide, Chevron is involved in the production of crude oil and natural gas, manufacturing of transportation fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and additives, and the development of enabling technologies. 

Chevron's vision is to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnerships, and performance. With a clear purpose to develop affordable, reliable, ever-cleaner energy that enables human progress, we believe human ingenuity has the power to solve any challenge and overcome any obstacle. Meeting the world's growing energy needs requires the pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all. 

About The Position

The Senior Integration Software Engineer is a hands-on technical leader responsible for architecting, designing, developing, and maintaining scalable full-stack web applications, backend services, APIs, and integration components that support RMF business and engineering systems. With 10 - 15 years of professional experience, this role sets the technical direction for complex, cross-system solutions built on . NET Core / C#, Microsoft Azure, and Angular, applying deep expertise in design patterns, SOLID principles, automated testing, secure engineering, and Agile delivery to ensure quality, reliability, and long-term maintainability. 

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Mentoring

- Provide hands-on technical leadership for one or more RMF applications, setting engineering direction and ensuring solutions meet quality, security, scalability, and maintainability expectations. 
 - Mentor and coach mid-level and junior engineers through pairing, design guidance, and constructive code reviews to raise overall team capability and engineering maturity. 
 - Establish, document, and champion engineering standards, coding guidelines, branching strategies, and Definition of Done across the team. 
 - Lead technical discovery, effort estimation, and risk assessment for complex features and cross-team dependencies, communicating trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Act as an escalation point for critical production issues, leading root cause analysis and driving durable, systemic fixes. 

Architecture & Solution Design

- Own end-to-end solution architecture for full-stack and integration components, balancing performance, scalability, resiliency, security, cost, and maintainability. 
 - Define API contracts, integration patterns, data flows, and service boundaries across enterprise applications, databases, and Azure cloud platforms. 
 - Evaluate and recommend frameworks, tools, and design approaches, producing architecture decision records and reference designs aligned with Chevron enterprise and CDAS standards. 
 - Drive modernization, technical debt reduction, and continuous improvement of legacy and greenfield applications within the RMF product line. 

Software Engineering & Full-Stack Development

- Design, develop, test, and support scalable backend services, REST APIs, and integration components in production environments. 
 - Build and maintain full-stack applications using C#, . NET Core / . NET, ASP. NET Web API, and Angular. 
 - Develop responsive, reusable, and maintainable UI components using Angular, HTML, CSS/SCSS, TypeScript, and JavaScript. 
 - Apply SOLID principles, object-oriented design, and established design patterns to create extensible and maintainable software solutions. 
 - Implement integration solutions across enterprise applications, services, databases, and cloud platforms while ensuring reliability, scalability, and security. 
 - Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and service interfaces, including API documentation using OpenAPI / Swagger. 
 - Apply engineering practices such as exception handling, validation, logging, versioning, dependency management, structured debugging, and secure configuration management. 
 - Write clean, readable, testable, and maintainable code aligned with modern engineering standards and team coding practices. 
 - Create and maintain unit, integration, and regression tests to improve code quality, prevent regressions, and support long-term maintainability. 

Cloud & Azure Development Engineering

- Develop and operate applications within an enterprise Microsoft Azure cloud environment. 
 - Build solutions using Azure PaaS services such as Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure Storage, Azure Service Bus, Azure Redis, Azure SQL Database, and other relevant cloud-native services. 
 - Support deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational support of cloud-hosted applications. 
 - Design solutions for performance, availability, scalability, resiliency, maintainability, and cost awareness in alignment with enterprise cloud standards. 
 - Work with structured and unstructured data storage solutions including SQL databases, document databases, and storage accounts. 
 - Demonstrate familiarity with distributed systems, asynchronous processing, messaging, background jobs, and containerization concepts. 
 - Use Azure monitoring and observability practices to identify issues, improve performance, and support production reliability. 

Frontend Engineering & User Experience

- Develop intuitive, accessible, and responsive user interfaces using Angular and modern frontend engineering practices. 
 - Collaborate with stakeholders and domain users to understand workflows and convert requirements into effective user experiences. 
 - Integrate frontend applications with secure backend APIs and cloud-hosted services. 
 - Maintain frontend code quality through reusable components, modular architecture, state management practices, and consistent UI patterns. 
 - Optimize frontend performance, browser compatibility, and usability across supported application environments. 

Agile Delivery & Collaboration

- Work within Agile teams to deliver features and enhancements iteratively with quality and predictability. 
 - Participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily standups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. 
 - Collaborate effectively with product owners, architects, QA engineers, DevOps engineers, and cross-functional teams to clarify requirements and deliver business value. 
 - Proactively identify risks, dependencies, technical debt, and improvement opportunities during delivery execution. 
 - Support production incidents, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement activities when required. 

Generative AI & Modern Engineering Practices

- Use enterprise-approved Generative AI tools, such as GitHub Copilot, to assist with code generation, refactoring, documentation, test creation, and productivity improvement. 
 - Apply human judgment to validate AI-assisted outputs for security, reliability, maintainability, compliance, and business fit. 
 - Explore and responsibly adopt emerging engineering practices, including AI-assisted development workflows, within approved enterprise guardrails. 
 - Demonstrate awareness of Python, GenAI concepts, and data engineering fundamentals to support modern solution development where relevant. 

Enterprise Tools & Standards

- Work within Chevron-built tools such as Orion, Azure DevOps Pipelines, ACME, NextPage, and Status where applicable. 
 - Use commonly adopted tools including GHAZDO, DAST, GitHub Copilot, Visual Studio, Visual Studio Code, Azure DevOps, and ServiceNow. 
 - Ensure solutions align with Chevron engineering standards including CDAS, cvxcontrols, secure coding expectations, and operational excellence practices. 

Required Skills / Qualifications

- 10 - 15 years of professional software engineering experience, with deep, expert-level hands-on expertise in C#, . NET Core / . NET, ASP. NET Web API, and full-stack application development. 
 - Strong working knowledge of Angular, TypeScript, HTML, JavaScript, and CSS/SCSS for frontend development. 
 - Experience building cloud-native applications using Microsoft Azure PaaS services. 
 - Hands-on experience with REST API development, backend services, system integration, and SQL-based data access. 
 - Strong understanding of software design patterns, SOLID principles, dependency injection, object-oriented programming, asynchronous programming, debugging, source control, and testing. 
 - Experience using Git and Azure DevOps pipelines for source control, CI/CD, and release automation. 
 - Experience working in Agile delivery environments. 
 - Strong problem-solving, collaboration, communication, and ownership skills. 
 - Proven experience owning end-to-end solution and integration architecture for enterprise-grade, cloud-hosted applications. 
 - Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, and drive engineering standards and best practices across a team. 
 - Experience leading design reviews, code reviews, and technical decision-making for complex, cross-system initiatives. 
 - Ability to engage senior stakeholders, communicate technical trade-offs, and influence architecture and delivery decisions. 

Chevron ENGINE supports global operations, supporting business requirements across the world. Accordingly, the work hours for employees will be aligned to support business requirements. The standard work week will be Monday to Friday. Working hours are 8: 00am to 5: 00pm or 1. 30pm to 10. 30pm. 

What We Can Offer You

Everything we do at Chevron is guided by our values and our commitment to The Chevron Way.

Engage with emerging technologies and digital solutions that are shaping the future of energy and enterprise.

data.description:
IC Markets Global is one of the most renowned Forex CFD provider, offering trading solutions for active day traders and scalpers as well as traders that are new to the forex market. IC Markets Global offers its clients cutting edge trading platforms, low latency connectivity and superior liquidity. 

IC Markets Global is revolutionizing online forex trading. Traders are now able to gain access to pricing previously only available to investment banks and high net worth individuals. 

Our management team have significant experience in the Forex, CFD and Equity markets in Asia, Europe and North America. It is this experience that has enabled us to select the best possible technology solutions and hand pick some of the best pricing providers available in the market. 

About the Role

We are seeking a Mobile App Team Lead with strong hands-on mobile development experience and proven leadership capabilities to lead the delivery, release, and ongoing development of our mobile trading application across iOS and Android. 

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in mobile application development, ideally within Fintech, Forex, Trading, Banking, or high-performance digital platforms. The person should have deep knowledge of either iOS development using Swift or Android development using Kotlin/Java, together with a strong understanding of both mobile ecosystems. 

This role is critical for the successful launch and ongoing evolution of our mobile app. The Mobile App Team Lead will be responsible for managing the mobile development team, staying fully on top of all mobile-related activities, driving technical decisions, ensuring delivery timelines are met, and owning the release process for both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store. 

The role requires strong technical oversight, delivery ownership, and cross-functional collaboration with Product, UI/UX, Backend, QA, DevOps, Security, Compliance, and business stakeholders. 

The person must be able to lead with minimal supervision, take ownership of the mobile application, break down work, assign tasks, remove blockers, challenge estimates, and ensure the team delivers high-quality mobile releases. 

Responsibilities

1. Team Leadership

- Lead, mentor, and guide the mobile development team across iOS and Android. 
 - Take ownership of the team's day-to-day execution, delivery progress, technical output, and priorities. 
 - Ensure all team members have clear responsibilities, assigned tasks, and agreed delivery timelines.
