data.title: Engineering Manager-NetSuite
data.description:
About MISUMI Americas

MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas. 

What's in it for you?

Opportunity To Unlock Your Creativity

Think of all the times you were held back from trying new ideas because you were boxed in by bureaucratic legacy processes or old school tactics. Having a growth mindset is deeply ingrained into our company culture since day 1 so Fictiv is an environment where you have the creative liberty and support of the team to try big bold ideas to achieve our sales and customer goals. 

Opportunity To Grow Your Career

There are plenty of jobs out there. The question is whether any of them will help you grow in your career? Will you be challenged by teammates to achieve your potential? Or are they roles that will ask you to do more of what you've already mastered. At Fictiv, you'll be surrounded by supportive teammates who will push you to be your best through their curiosity and passion. 

Impact In This Role

Fictiv is seeking a hands-on, deeply technical Engineering Manager to lead our NetSuite team. This is not a purely people-management role. The right candidate thrives at the intersection of engineering leadership and technical craft - someone who can jump into the code to debug a complex issue, write a detailed technical design document, and then step back to coach an engineer on how to approach the problem differently. 

Our NetSuite environment supports a complex, multi-subsidiary OneWorld deployment spanning multiple regions globally, serving a make-to-order custom manufacturing operation across multiple industries. The Engineering Manager will set the technical bar for the team, drive architectural decisions, and build the processes and practices that allow the engineering team to deliver at high quality and velocity. 

This role reports to the Sr Director of Engineering, IT Systems. 

What You'll Be Doing

Hands-On Technical Leadership

- Actively participate in technical work alongside the team - reviewing, and debugging code as needed to unblock engineers, validate approaches, or accelerate critical deliveries. 
 - Author and own technical design documents (TDDs) for significant platform changes, new integrations, and architectural decisions, covering solution design, data flow, error handling, performance considerations, and trade-offs. 
 - Lead architecture reviews for new features, customizations, and integrations, ensuring decisions are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with NetSuite best practices. 
 - Conduct thorough, constructive code reviews - holding the team to a high and consistent engineering standard. 
 - Set standards for development and customization work, including guidelines for SuiteScript patterns, SuiteFlow design, custom record architecture, and integration approaches. 
 - Review and provide technical direction on team deliverables. 
 - Maintain a deep, current understanding of NetSuite capabilities and stay informed on upcoming release changes that may impact the business. 
 - Lead technical evaluation of new NetSuite modules, third-party tools, and integration platforms, producing structured analysis comparing options on capability, cost, risk, and architectural fit. 
 - Drive proactive identification and remediation of technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and architectural risks before they affect business operations. 

Development & Deployment Practices

- Own and continuously improve the team's software development lifecycle, from requirements intake through design, development, testing, deployment, and post-release monitoring. 
 - Mature the team's CI/CD pipeline built on SuiteCloud Development Framework (SDF) and GitHub Actions, improving reliability, test coverage, deployment speed, and rollback capability across QA, Staging, and Production environments. 
 - Build efficient, repeatable engineering workflows that reduce manual work, minimize deployment risk, and enable the team to ship with confidence. 
 - Establish clear incident response practices for production issues, including on-call expectations, severity classification, root cause analysis, and post-mortem documentation. 
 - Champion the use of tooling, automation, and documentation to reduce knowledge silos and accelerate onboarding of new team members. 

Project Management

- Manage the engineering team's project portfolio, balancing implementation work, enhancements, integrations, and technical debt reduction. 
 - Lead project planning and estimation for initiatives, working with stakeholders to define scope, timelines, deliverables, and success criteria. 
 - Coordinate dependencies across concurrent projects and ensure resources are appropriately allocated to meet commitments. 
 - Partner with business stakeholders and the Director of Engineering to prioritize work, communicate progress, manage scope changes, and escalate risks. 
 - Own delivery accountability for projects, tracking progress against milestones and ensuring the team ships on schedule with quality. 
 - Conduct project retrospectives to identify lessons learned and continuously improve the team's delivery practices. 

Cross-Functional Stakeholder Alignment

- Own the technical architecture of NetSuite across all subsidiaries, ensuring the system is structured to support complex manufacturing workflows including multi-vendor BOMs, intercompany fulfillment, transfer order processing, and landed cost management. 
 - Serve as the engineering point of contact for business stakeholders across Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, Logistics, and Quality functions. 
 - Translate complex business requirements into clearly scoped technical solutions, and communicate technical constraints and trade-offs back to stakeholders in accessible terms. 
 - Partner with regional operations leads across multiple geographies to understand localized system requirements and ensure solutions work across all subsidiaries. 
 - Collaborate with executive leadership to communicate system health, roadmap progress, and technology investment decisions. 
 - Act as the engineering escalation point for critical system issues, coordinating resolution across the team, NetSuite support, and business stakeholders. 

People Leadership & Team Development

- Lead, mentor, and grow the NetSuite engineering team, building individual capability while raising the collective technical bar. 
 - Actively participate in hiring for technical depth and team fit, structured onboarding, performance management, career development planning. 
 - Conduct meaningful 1: 1s, provide regular and specific feedback, and create growth paths for engineers to develop expertise across NetSuite administration, scripting, and integration development. 
 - Run knowledge transfer sessions, technical workshops, and internal documentation efforts to ensure knowledge is distributed across the team. 
 - Foster a culture of engineering excellence, continuous learning, and shared ownership of quality. 

Desired Traits

- 12+ years of experience working in NetSuite, with at least 3 years in a formal engineering management or senior technical lead role responsible for a team. 
 - In-depth knowledge of NetSuite modules such as GL, Order to Cash, Inventory, AP, AR, Billing, Purchasing, Revenue Recognition, Asset Management
 - Deep expertise in NetSuite OneWorld including multi-subsidiary setup, intercompany framework, global financial consolidation, and cross-subsidiary order fulfillment. 
 - Strong understanding of business processes like Engineering Change Orders, Transfer Order Processing
 - Proficiency in NetSuite configuration, customization, and scripting
 - Knowledge of system integrations and data migration. 
 - Familiarity with PLM systems like Arena
 - Proven ability to write production-quality code and review complex scripts with a critical eye for performance, maintainability, and correctness. 
 - Experience authoring technical design documents and leading architecture reviews for significant NetSuite customizations, integrations, or module implementations. 
 - Familiarity with middleware and integration platforms used to connect NetSuite with external systems such as PLM, Salesforce
 - NetSuite certifications such as SuiteFoundation, Administrator, or other relevant certifications, are preferred. 
 - Ability to work independently, handle multiple tasks, and adapt to changing priorities. 
 - Familiarity with Agile Software Development, Jira, Git
 - Demonstrated track record of improving team development and deployment practices - including testing discipline, code review culture, and release management. 
 - Experience managing and growing engineering teams. 
 - Strong cross-functional communication skills, including the ability to present architectural decisions and technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders and executive leadership. 

Interested in learning more? We look forward to hearing from you soon. 

We're actively seeking teammates who: 

- Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company. 
 - Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team. 
 - Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth. 
 - Have an 'always learning' mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins. 
 - Help us continue to build a world-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates

We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

Job Description: 

Hitachi Rail is looking for an enthusiastic self-motivated RAMS Manager / System Assurance Manager who thrives in a fast-paced environment. The successful candidate is comfortable performing a wide range of tasks from administrative to strategic. The position is based in Bangalore, India. 

About the Position: 

The Hitachi Rail SRS RAMS Function ensures proper implementation of the Hitachi Rail SRS RAMS Policy in accordance with company and industry specific standards and best practices, provides support to enable SRS to execute its business, provides governance and guarantees segregation of duties with the aim of ensuring the safety of the solutions developed and deployed by Hitachi Rail SRS and compliance to safety principles, industry specific standards and best practices for the development and deployment of safety-critical systems. 

The RAMS Manager / System Assurance Manager coordinates the project and Product RAMS activities with SRS Business Segment RAMS so that the solutions (whether for testing or deployment to a customer for trial operations or revenue) are safe for their intended scope and purpose and is responsible to demonstrate that the solutions comply with the relevant processes, policies, legislation, standards and regulations. 

Key Accountabilities: 

- Ensure delivery of transportation solution systems in compliance with RAMS guidelines and quality standards, and in accordance with time and budget constraints
 - Provide support for RAMS/System Assurance Planning, including, Safety Management system development, Project Safety / RAMS plan development, Operational Safety / RAMS plan development, Safety Management System implementation. 
 - Ensure Safety Case development and RAM parameters performance demonstration
 - Ensure delivery of project RAMS analysis and documents at system and subsystem level in cooperation with the other technology functions, Operation & Maintenance and external suppliers. 
 - Undertaking and assessment of Qualitative and Quantitative risk assessment
 - Implementation and checking of detailed analysis including, FMECA, FTA / ETA, Root Cause Analysis, Reliability / Availability modelling

data.title: Principal Debug Validation Engineer
data.description:
About Us

Graphcore is one of the world's leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. 

It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry. 

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world's most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone. 

Graphcore's teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore enjoys a culture of continuous learning and constant innovation. 

Job Summary

Reporting to senior leadership within Architecture and Validation, the Debug Validation Lead will drive post-silicon debug and validation activities for next-generation AI compute silicon and systems. The role is responsible for leading teams focused on identifying, reproducing, analysing and resolving complex silicon, firmware and system-level issues during bring-up, characterization and product readiness. 

This position combines deep technical debugging expertise with strong cross-functional collaboration across multiple engineering disciplines. The role will work closely with architecture, RTL, firmware, software and systems teams to improve debug methodologies, accelerate issue resolution and strengthen validation coverage. The role will work closely with architecture, RTL, firmware, software, systems and platform teams to improve debug methodologies, accelerate issue resolution and strengthen validation coverage. 

The Team

The Post-Silicon Debug and Validation team sits within the Architecture and Validation organisation and is responsible for bring-up, debug and validation of Graphcore silicon and systems. 

The team works across the full product lifecycle, supporting first silicon bring-up, subsystem validation, system integration and production readiness activities. Engineers collaborate closely with hardware, firmware, software and systems teams to investigate complex failures, develop debug methodologies and improve validation infrastructure. 

Responsibilities and Duties

- Lead post-silicon debug and validation activities for AI compute silicon and platform technologies
 - Contribute to debug and validation activities across multiple projects and milestones
 - Drive prioritisation, planning and execution of debug and validation activities across multiple projects and milestones
 - Investigate and resolve complex silicon, firmware, software and system-level issues during bring-up and validation
 - Develop structured debug methodologies and failure analysis processes to improve issue resolution efficiency
 - Collaborate closely with architecture, RTL, firmware, software and systems engineering teams to identify root causes and implement corrective actions
 - Drive debug of CPU, memory, interconnect and high-speed I/O subsystems under functional, stress and workload conditions
 - Develop and enhance automated debug, regression and validation infrastructure using Python and related technologies
 - Analyse logs, traces, telemetry and hardware data to isolate and characterize system failures and performance issues
 - Support development of validation tests, debug tooling and custom diagnostics to improve coverage and observability
 - Define validation metrics, debug workflows and reporting standards to ensure consistent and repeatable analysis
 - Drive continuous improvement of debug processes, validation methodologies and engineering workflows
 - Communicate technical risks, status and recommendations clearly to engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders
 - Support silicon readiness reviews and contribute to product quality and release decisions
 - Contribute to continuous improvement of debug methodologies, validation infrastructure and engineering workflows

Candidate Profile

Essential

- Strong experience in bare metal environments
 - Good knowledge of SoC and platform architectures
 - Expertise in debug infrastructure and post-silicon debug methodologies
 - Strong programming skills in Python, C, or debug scripting languages such as CMM
 - Highly motivated self-starter with a collaborative and team-oriented approach
 - Ability to work across teams and programming languages to identify root causes of deep and complex issues
 - Experience of the post-silicon validation process applied in digital ASIC environments
 - Strong Linux and Python experience
 - Exceptional communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively to solve complex problems
 - Excellent problem-solving, analytical and diagnostic skills
 - Deep knowledge of scan, DFT, JTAG and trace infrastructure
 - Strong debug skills including fault tree analysis, failure isolation, fishbone methodologies and system-level debug techniques
 - Ability to work independently on technically complex debug and validation activities across hardware, firmware and software domains

Desirable

- Understanding of DFT flows from insertion through post-silicon validation
 - Experience developing tooling for parsing and analysing debug data, including scan dump parsing
 - Driver-level experience with one or more of the following technologies: 
 - PCIe
 - Ethernet
 - Memory technologies including LPDDR, DDR and HBM
 - Peripheral interfaces such as I2C, I3C and SPI
 - Experience using CoreSight and similar debug infrastructure including CTI, ETx, DStream, JLink, Lauterbach, ATB and STM
 - Good knowledge of mixed-signal building blocks such as PLLs, high-speed PHYs and IC control/communication protocols
 - Experience with Arm CPU architectures, system IP and associated debug tooling
 - Experience with AMBA protocols
 - Understanding of ML applications and associated workloads
 - Experience in characterization, failure analysis, test development, statistical analysis and customer support

data.title: Vice President, Application Engineer
data.description:
About This Role

At BlackRock, technology is the foundation of our business. As a VP, Java Back-End Engineer, you'll lead by example - architecting, coding, and mentoring teams to build resilient systems that power our global post-trade operations. You'll design and deliver enterprise-scale software with a focus on reliability, performance, and clean engineering practices. This role is ideal for a technical leader who enjoys staying close to the code, guiding design decisions, and solving complex data challenges - all while fostering a culture of excellence and continuous improvement. About Post Trade Accounting (PTA) A major strategic area within Aladdin and one of BlackRock's largest engineering investments. Responsible for the systems that ensure accurate, scalable, and efficient accounting across global operations. Expanding into data analytics and pipeline initiatives using Snowflake, Redis, and distributed event streaming and messaging platforms to manage high-volume, real-time data. Collaborates closely with Product, Operations, and other Engineering teams to deliver business-critical capabilities. Agile and collaborative environment that values technical depth, quality, and innovation. Key Responsibilities Design and develop robust, high-performance back-end systems using Java 11+ and the Spring Boot ecosystem. Lead design discussions, code reviews, and architecture sessions with a hands-on approach. Build and maintain microservices and event-driven systems to process and distribute large-scale financial data. Develop data integration and pipeline components that connect systems across Snowflake, SQL Server, and real-time streaming platforms. Implement and optimize Redis-based caching and data stores for low-latency access patterns. Champion best practices for code quality, testing, automation, and performance tuning. Mentor engineers to elevate technical craftsmanship, problem-solving, and design thinking. Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure technical solutions align with product goals and business outcomes. Qualifications / Competencies B. S. /M. S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline. 8+ years of professional experience in Java and object-oriented design. Strong knowledge of Spring Boot, REST APIs, and enterprise integration patterns. Deep expertise in SQL Server, including stored procedures, performance tuning, and data modeling. Experience with Redis for caching or data persistence. Hands-on exposure to distributed event streaming and messaging platforms or similar publish-subscribe systems for real-time event processing. Familiarity with Snowflake and data pipeline concepts (ETL, batch vs. streaming). Experience with Agentic coding and general understanding of how LLMs are working Strong focus on clean architecture, maintainability, and production readiness. Excellent communication and leadership skills - able to guide teams and influence design direction. Nice to Have Experience with Enterprise-grade container orchestration platform supporting declarative infrastructure and horizontal scaling, Open Container Initiative (OCI) container image packaging and runtime, or cloud-native environments (AWS/GCP). Exposure to observability tools (metrics collection, Grafana, Open Telemetry). Scripting experience in Python for automation or data analysis. Exposure to Prompt Engineering and Agentic AI Interest in financial systems, accounting, or investment technology. 

Our Benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about. 

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock's hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person - aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock. 

Guidance on AI use for candidates

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work - enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we've provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self. 

About BlackRock

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children's educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress. 

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment - the one we make in our employees. It's why we're dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive. 

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers. BlackRock. com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok. 

BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

data.title: AI Automation Engineer
data.description:
About OpsLabs

OpsLabs designs, builds, and operates AI automations and software systems that help businesses scale their operations. We build custom AI agents, integrations, databases, dashboards, client portals, and internal tools around the platforms our clients already use. 

We take ownership beyond launch, monitoring, maintaining, and improving systems as business needs evolve. 

Our philosophy: We sell autonomy, not just automation. 

Learn more: opslabs. ai

About the Role

We're looking for an AI Automation Engineer with strong coding skills, hands-on automation experience, and a clear understanding of systems architecture. 

You'll translate business processes into reliable technical solutions, connecting applications, data, and AI through workflows and custom software. You'll own delivery from requirements and architecture through development, deployment, documentation, and ongoing maintenance. 

This role suits someone who enjoys understanding how a business operates and building systems that make its daily work easier. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and build automations: Develop workflows using n8n, Make. com, Zapier, and custom code for onboarding, lead management, reporting, task routing, and internal operations. 

- Develop AI agents and assistants: Use Claude and OpenAI APIs to build systems that retrieve knowledge, classify information, make decisions within defined rules, and perform actions through connected tools. 

- Build integrations: Connect CRMs, email platforms, finance systems, project management tools, and other applications through APIs, webhooks, and custom middleware. 

- Design databases and data flows: Build Airtable bases and Supabase/PostgreSQL schemas, manage relationships and migrations, and keep data consistent across systems. 

- Build internal tools and portals: Develop backend workflows and contribute to dashboards, client portals, and operational command centers. 

- Develop MCP servers: Enable AI assistants to securely access business data and perform authorized actions. 

- Engineer for reliability: Implement validation, deduplication, retries, logging, monitoring, alerts, and approval flows. 

- Deploy and maintain systems: Troubleshoot production issues, improve performance, manage costs, and adapt systems as requirements change. 

- Document and communicate: Maintain clear technical documentation, explain architecture decisions, and flag blockers and dependencies early. 

### Required Skills

- Automation platforms: Practical experience with n8n, Make. com, and/or Zapier, including multi-step workflows, branching logic, scheduling, webhooks, and error handling. Strong n8n proficiency is particularly valuable. 

- Airtable: Experience with linked records, formulas, views, automations, scripting, and API integrations. 

- Coding: Strong proficiency in Python and JavaScript/TypeScript, along with a solid grasp of SQL. Ability to independently read, write, debug, and maintain code. 

- Backend development: Experience building APIs, integration services, and background jobs using Node. js and/or Python. 

- AI development: Hands-on experience with LLM APIs, prompt design, structured outputs, tool calling, and validating AI-generated results. 

- Claude Code: Ability to use Claude Code for development, debugging, refactoring, and testing while reviewing and verifying the resulting code. 

- Databases: Understanding of Supabase/PostgreSQL, relational data modeling, schema design, migrations, indexing, permissions, and data integrity. 

- Systems architecture: Ability to design how databases, applications, APIs, workflows, and AI agents interact, including sources of truth, synchronization, queues, and failure recovery. 

- API fundamentals: Strong understanding of REST APIs, JSON, authentication, OAuth, pagination, and rate limits. 

- Engineering practices: Familiarity with Git/GitHub, secure credential handling, environment configuration, testing, and deployment. 

- Ownership: Ability to work independently, clarify ambiguous requirements, communicate progress, and follow projects through to completion. 

Good to Have

- Experience building MCP servers, RAG systems, embeddings, or vector search. 

- Familiarity with React, Next. js, and Tailwind CSS for dashboards and portals. 

- Experience with Vercel, DigitalOcean, Docker, Linux, and self-hosted n8n. 

- Integrations with Slack, ClickUp, HubSpot, Attio, Salesforce, Google Workspace, Stripe, QuickBooks, Email Bison, or Smartlead. 

- Experience building scrapers, data enrichment pipelines, or scheduled data collection systems. 

- Experience delivering systems for agencies, sales teams, or service businesses. 

What Success Looks Like

You deliver systems that work reliably with real business data and save measurable time. Your solutions are maintainable, failures are visible and recoverable, and another engineer can understand your work through clear documentation. 

You identify opportunities to reuse components, simplify architecture, and improve the systems you operate. 

Why Join OpsLabs?

- Build systems used in real client operations. 

- Work across AI agents, automation, backend engineering, and internal applications. 

- Own projects from architecture through deployment and improvement. 

- Work directly with the team to turn operational problems into working solutions. 

How to Apply

Apply through LinkedIn with your CV and include: 

- Please fill the form and apply

We value demonstrated ability to build, troubleshoot, and maintain working systems.

We're looking for people to join the Access family, who share our passion for believing in better, and who will help us continue to grow. 

Love Work. Love Life. Be You. - is central to our success and how we give our customers the freedom to do more of what's important to them. 

What does Access offer you?

We offer a blended approach to office working, encouraging you to collaborate and connect in one of our thriving offices. We deliver on what we say, taking the development of our people seriously. We'll work with you to progress your success plan and provide opportunities to accelerate your career. 

About you: 

The Senior Software Engineer is a highly technical, hands-on role focused primarily on designing, building, and delivering production software. Rather than being a pathway into management, this position is intended for someone who wants to remain a deep technical expert with significant influence over architecture, engineering standards, and technical direction. 

Day-to-day, you will: 

- Design, develop, and deliver high-quality, scalable software across backend, frontend, APIs, and integrations, ensuring reliability, performance, security, and maintainability. 
 - Lead technical architecture and engineering best practices, driving code quality, CI/CD, testing, observability, incident resolution, and continuous improvement. 
 - Mentor and develop engineers through code reviews, technical guidance, knowledge sharing, and active participation in hiring to maintain a high engineering standard. 
 - Research and adopt modern technologies and AI-driven development practices, proactively addressing technical debt and contributing to long-term platform strategy. 

Key Performance Indicators

- Deliver reliable, high-performing software that meets production SLAs, with strong focus on system availability, security, and operational excellence. 
 - Drive engineering efficiency by improving deployment frequency, reducing lead time, minimizing change failure rates, and ensuring rapid incident resolution. 
 - Maintain high code quality through effective code reviews, proactive security practices, and adoption of AI-enabled development tools. 
 - Mentor engineers to strengthen technical capability, foster continuous improvement, and prevent recurring defects through knowledge sharing and root cause resolution. 

Your skills and experiences might also include: 

- Extensive software engineering experience delivering production systems, with expertise in clean code, automated testing, CI/CD, RESTful APIs, SQL, cloud databases, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and architectural design. 
 - Strong proficiency in modern technologies including C#/. NET, Java, TypeScript/React, and cloud platforms (Azure preferred, with exposure to AWS). 
 - Leverage AI tools (e. g. , GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, Devin) throughout the software development lifecycle to improve coding, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and team productivity. 
 - Solid understanding of secure software development practices, including authentication, authorization, encryption, secrets management, PII protection, and GDPR/UK GDPR compliance. 

What are we all about?

The Access Group is one of the largest UK-headquartered business management software providers. It provides solutions that empower more than 160, 000 small and mid-sized organisations in commercial and non-profit sectors across Europe, USA and APAC, giving every employee the freedom to do more of what's important. Its innovative cloud solutions and integrated AI software experience across multiple Access products transform how business technology is used. 

With over 9, 300 talented individuals driving innovation and customer excellence, we're shaping the future of work. And we want you to be part of it. At Access, people are at the heart of everything we do. We're committed to creating an inclusive, high-performing culture where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive. If you're excited about this role - even if your experience doesn't tick every box - you might be exactly who we're looking for. 

We believe in equality for all and the transformative power of diversity. So why not join our vibrant team, where you can love what you do, love how you live, and most importantly, be authentically you?

Let's make a difference together. 

Love Work. Love Life. Be You.

data.title: Member of Technical Staff, Kernel
data.description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3. 7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem. 

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us. 

THE ROLE

Team lead for a group of engineers with responsibility for Linux and VMWare initiator stack behavior as well as Fibre Channel and NIC drivers on Pure storage array. 

What You'll Do

The Kernel and Driver development team is responsible for several areas

- Working for a team that deals primarily in various storage area network protocols such as Fiber Channel and Ethernet. 
 - On the initiator side, the team will be responsible for Linux initiator behavior attached to Flasharray. Focus is on NVME (ROCE, FC, TCP/IP) but also includes FC-SCSI (FCP) and iSCSI interfaces. This includes software development/fixes for Linux initiator stack, debugging initiator problems, and creating compatibility documents for Purity. For VMWare, focus is on debugging issues with VMWare as an initiator, and creating compatibility documentation. 
 - For FibreChannel and NIC Drivers, focus is responsibility for FC-SCSI driver stack for storage side and responsibility for NIC drivers on networking side. This includes responsibility for related code, utilities, enhancements supporting RAS, as well as debugging failures found internally and in the field. 
 - Maintain Linux kernels for internal testing
 - Documenting supported configurations for customers
 - Responsibility for evaluating Linux initiator behavior and optimizing for Pure Storage Flasharray. This includes correctness as well as optimizing for performances. Will contribute bug fixes and enhancements to Linux upstream. Analyze and debug difficult Linux bugs to optimize Flasharray attachment. 
 - Responsible for maintaining Purity's Fibre Channel SCSI (FCP) target driver. Maintenance includes driver updates for enhancements, bugs fixes and new hardware. 
 - Resolve difficult Fibre Channel bugs found internally or externally and enhancing the resilience of Pure's FC stack. This includes projects around multipathing and link health. 
 - Responsible for maintaining NIC drivers on Pure's storage systems. 
 - Dealing with middle ware C++ modules

What You Bring

- Strong experience writing device drivers and/or kernel development for Linux/Unix. Prefer experience in storage and/or networking drivers
 - Minimum 5 years of development experience, but expect that typically candidates would have 15+ years experience. 
 - Experience designing and implementing significant components in storage protocol stacks and storage systems. 
 - Experience with storage protocols: either SCSI (FC-SCSI or iSCSI/FCP) and/or NVME Fabrics (NVME/ROCE, NVME/TCP or NVME/FC) will be an advantage. 
 - Experience leading other engineers technically. Should be able to mentor more junior engineers and lead other engineers in an overall project. Should demonstrate on time delivery with high quality. 
 - Experience with performance analysis/optimization for storage systems or protocols
 - Should have VMWare experience, with understanding of their initiator stack. 
 - Experience writing Linux storage device drivers, including some sets of Fibre Channel, NVME, ROCE, block and multipath modules. 
 - Experience debugging difficult storage attach issues. 
 - Experience with software development using C and C++, along with Python
 - Experience upstreaming Linux code is preferred
 - Should have experience developing test automation
 - Experience analyzing and optimizing storage performance 
 - Experience writing storage or networking device drivers, preferred in Linux/Unix environment 
 - Demonstrated experience debugging difficult protocol/kernel/system issues
 - Experience with network protocols, including TCP/IP. 

What You Can Expect From Us

- Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers. 
 - Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in TechnologyTM, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay AreaTM, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!
 - Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good. 

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out http: //benefits. everpuredata. com/ for more information. 

Accommodations And Accessibility

Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at TA-Ops@purestorage. com if you're invited to an interview. 

Our Commitment To a Strong And Inclusive Team

We're forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn't just accepted but embraced. That's why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership. 

Everpure is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire. 

Join us and bring your best. 

Bring your bold. 

Pure and simple.

Area(s) of responsibility

We are seeking a visionary PLM AI System Architect to lead the digital transformation of our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) ecosystem. This role sits at the intersection of deep engineering domain expertise and cutting-edge Generative AI. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and scaling agentic AI capabilities that transform how we manage requirements, BOMs, CAD/CAM data, and service lifecycles. The ideal candidate will act as the bridge between our PLM platforms, engineering stakeholders, and enterprise AI architecture. 

How You'll Make An Impact

- Strategic PLM Leadership: Drive AI adoption across the entire product lifecycle-from requirements and EBOM/MBOM management to digital twin enablement. 
 - Agentic AI Engineering: Design and orchestrate multi-agent systems capable of reasoning over complex PLM data, automating classification, and performing automated change impact analysis. 
 - Advanced Data Retrieval (RAG): Architect RAG pipelines that ensure engineering-grade accuracy, specifically tuned for structured PLM data and unstructured technical documentation.

data.title: Test Strategy & Operations Lead for Regression Testing - S/4E Program
data.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

This role is being created as an addition to the ERP Competence Centre to address the increased quantity and complexity of testing requirements driven by the S4E program rollout. You will be critical in establishing a robust testing framework for a multi-year, dynamic project phase, with a focus on developing and governing the overall test strategy for Regression (REG) and Non-Functional Requirements (NFR), overseeing the operational management of all related testing activities, and managing the phased transition of these services to the permanent AMS/Operations team. As an expert-level professional, you will bring extensive experience in large-scale ERP test management, particularly within SAP environments, with a proven ability to define complex test strategies, manage vendor-led execution, and lead service transition initiatives. 

How You'll Make An Impact

- 40% Test Strategy & Governance
 - Develop, implement, and own the end-to-end test strategy for Regression (REG) and Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) across the S4E program. 
 - Define and establish standards, processes, and key performance indicators (KPIs) for test execution, defect management, and quality reporting. 
 - Determine testing scope, entry/exit criteria, and quality gates for various S4E project rollout phases. 
 - Collaborate with solution architects and functional teams to ensure test scenarios provide comprehensive coverage of critical business processes and technical specifications. 

- 40% Test Operations & Execution Management
 - Oversee the planning and execution of all REG and NFR test cycles, coordinating activities between internal teams and the external AMS partner. 
 - Manage the provisioning and maintenance of required test environments, test data, and testing tools for the S4E program. 
 - Monitor test progress, analyze results for trends and risks, and provide regular, clear status reports to program leadership and key stakeholders. 
 - Lead the triage and root cause analysis of critical defects and performance bottlenecks, driving resolution with development and infrastructure teams. 

- 20% Service Transition & Stakeholder Management
 - Design and execute a phased transition plan to hand over established testing services from the S4E project to the long-term SAP Operations/AMS team. 
 - Act as the central point of contact for all matters related to REG and NFR testing, ensuring alignment with program managers, business stakeholders, and IT leadership. 
 - Create comprehensive service documentation and deliver training to the receiving AMS team to ensure a smooth handover and long-term operational stability. 
 - Establish and manage the operational budget and resource plan for the testing workstream. 

What You Bring

- Extensive experience (typically 10+ years) in IT quality assurance and test management, with a significant focus on large-scale ERP programs. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline. 
 - Proven track record of defining and implementing test strategies for complex systems, with direct experience in SAP environments (S/4HANA preferred).

data.title: Lead Architect - AI
data.description:
Landmark Digital

As a part of the Landmark Group, a renowned retail and hospitality conglomerate in the Middle East, North Africa, and India, Landmark Digital is the dynamic digital arm of Landmark Retail, serving as the cornerstone of our omnichannel business strategy. 

Headquartered in Dubai, UAE, we oversee the digital operations of eight leading brands across diverse geographies, with ambitious plans for expansion into new territories and functions. Joining us means becoming a vital part of the Middle East's most significant bricks-to-clicks success story, boasting an impressive year-on-year growth rate exceeding 100%. 

Comprising a talented workforce of over 700 professionals across diverse domains, Landmark Digital spearheads various functions including Enterprise and E-commerce Tech, Product Management, User Design, and MarTech, among others. With our futuristic outlook, we are committed to delivering seamless digital experiences to our customers. 

Job Specification -

We are looking for a Lead AI Architect to lead the design and architecture of AI products, from problem definition and technical discovery through production delivery and continuous improvement. You will turn business and product goals into secure, scalable, measurable AI solutions and help teams choose the right approach across a fast-changing AI landscape. 

You will work closely with product owners, enterprise architects, engineering, data, security and operations teams. This is a hands-on technical leadership role: you will own solution architecture, validate critical design choices through prototypes and reference implementations, and guide teams through delivery. 

Key Focus Areas: 

- Partner with product owners to define AI use cases, user journeys, feasibility, business outcomes and acceptance criteria. Challenge when conventional software or analytics is a better fit than AI. 
 - Lead end-to-end AI product architecture across experience, application, model, data, integration and infrastructure layers. Document decisions, trade-offs, dependencies and non-functional requirements. 
 - Design appropriate solutions using predictive ML, generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), multimodal models and agentic workflows. Use autonomous or multi-agent designs only where they add value. 
 - Work with enterprise architects to align solutions with target architectures, integration patterns, platform standards and governance. Build reusable reference architectures and components without duplicating enterprise capabilities. 
 - Evaluate models, platforms, frameworks and vendors through structured experiments. Recommend build-versus-buy decisions based on quality, security, latency, total cost, portability and operating needs. 
 - Guide engineering teams through implementation, architecture and code reviews, integration and production readiness. Prototype high-risk assumptions and mentor engineers and other architects. 
 - Embed responsible AI and security by design: privacy, access controls, permission-aware retrieval, tenant isolation, prompt-injection defenses, safe tool use, audit trails and human approval for high-impact actions. 
 - Define evaluation, testing, monitoring and lifecycle controls for models, prompts, retrieval and agents. Plan fallbacks, failure handling, rollbacks and incident ownership with platform and operations teams. 
 - Track the AI landscape and translate developments into practical roadmaps and guidance. Communicate decisions clearly to technical teams, product owners and senior stakeholders. 

Additional experience

- Regulated or enterprise environments; AI platform/CoE design; Model Context Protocol (MCP) and other tool-integration patterns; knowledge graphs; model-serving and open-weight deployment; domain-specific AI validation; architecture or cloud certifications; mentoring across multiple product teams. Specific frameworks and certifications are advantages, not substitutes for delivery evidence. 

Knowledge, Skills & Experience Relevant Job Experience

- A strong track record in software, solution or AI architecture, with evidence of shipping and operating enterprise-grade products. Indicative experience: 8+ years in engineering/architecture, including 3+ years working on AI/ML solutions; equivalent demonstrated experience is welcome. 
 - Direct experience taking an LLM-based or agentic product into production, beyond demos and proofs of concept. Ability to explain design choices, evaluation results, operating costs and lessons from real failures. 
 - Broad understanding of the AI landscape: foundation and open-weight models, conventional ML, RAG, embeddings, retrieval/reranking, context engineering, fine-tuning, multimodal systems and agent orchestration. Sound judgment about when each is appropriate. 
 - Hands-on ability to prototype and review production code, preferably in Python and at least one product/backend stack. Strong API, distributed-system, data-pipeline and enterprise integration design skills. 
 - Experience with at least one major cloud and its AI services, plus containerized or managed deployment, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, MLOps/LLMOps and observability. 
 - Practical experience with AI evaluation, grounding quality, safety testing, model/prompt versioning and cost/latency optimization. Familiarity with identity, least privilege, data boundaries and secure tool/API access. 
 - Ability to influence without relying on reporting authority, resolve architectural trade-offs and work effectively with enterprise architects, engineering teams and product owners. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication: architecture diagrams, decision records, delivery guidance and explanations suitable for business audiences. 
 - Degree in computer science, engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 

What Success Looks Like

- Product goals become clear, agreed architectures and measurable delivery/evaluation criteria. 
 - AI products meet agreed quality, safety, reliability, latency and cost targets in production. 
 - Teams reuse approved patterns, and architecture decisions remain aligned with enterprise standards. 
 - Product owners and engineers can make faster, better-informed trade-offs as the AI landscape changes.

Our team is developing a high-performance computing solution for low-latency and high throughput image processing and deep-learning workload that enables our Chip Manufacturing process control equipment to offer differentiated value to our customers.

As an architect, you will get the opportunity to grow in the field of high-performance computing, GPU compute infra, complex system design and low-level optimizations for better cost of ownership. 

Roles and Responsibility

- As a Software Architect, you will be responsible for design and implementation of robust, scalable infrastructure solutions combining diverse processors (CPUs, GPUs, FPGAs). 
 - You will analyze and partition workloads to the most appropriate compute unit, ensuring tasks like AI inference and parallel processing runs on specialized accelerators, while serial tasks run on CPUs.

 - Evaluate and recommend appropriate technologies and frameworks to meet project requirements. 
 - Lead the design and implementation of complex software components and systems. 
 - Ensure that software systems are scalable, reliable, and maintainable. 
 - Your primary focus will be on ensuring that the software systems are scalable, reliable, maintainable and cost effective. 

Our Ideal Candidate

Someone who is passionate about and has deep understanding and experience in design and development of cutting edge HPC systems and heterogenous computing infrastructure. He should have very good hands-on experience in parallel programming (CUDA) and AI inference infrastructure. He should be able to multi-task and switch contexts based on business needs. 

Qualifications

- 12 to 18 years of experience in implementing robust, scalable, and secure infrastructure solutions combining diverse processors (CPUs, GPUs, FPGAs)
 - Working experience of GPU inference server like Nvidia Triton. 
 - Very good knowledge C/C++, Data structure and Algorithms and complexity analysis. 
 - Experience in developing Distributed High Performance Computing software using Parallel programming frameworks like MPI, UCX etc. 
 - Experience in GPU programming using CUDA, OpenMP, OpenACC, OpenCL etc. 
 - In depth experience in Multi-threading, Thread Synchronization, Inter process communication, and distributed computing fundamentals. 
 - Experience in Inter Process communication using Shared memory and Pipes. 
 - Experience in performance profiling at application and system level (e. g. vtune, Oprofiler, perf, Nividia Nsight etc. )
 - Experience in low level code optimization techniques using Vectorization and Intrinsics, cache-aware programming, lock free data structures etc. 
 - Familiarity with microservices architecture and containerization technologies (docker/singularity) and low latency Message queues. 
 - Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration abilities. 
 - Ability to mentor and coach junior team members. 
 - Experience in Agile development methodologies. 

Additional Qualifications: 

- Experience in HPC Job-Scheduling and Cluster Management Software (SLURM, Torque, LSF etc. )
 - Good knowledge of Low-latency and high-throughput data transfer technologies (RDMA, RoCE, InfiniBand)
 - Good Knowledge of Parallel processing and DAG execution Frameworks like Intel TBB flowgraph, OpenCL/SYCL etc.

data.description:
Company Description

With a rich history of groundbreaking innovations in Flash and advanced memory technologies, our solutions have become the beating heart of the digital world we're living in and that we have the power to shape.

These facilities were also recognized as Sustainability Lighthousesforbreakthroughs in efficient operations. With our global reach, we ensure the global supply chain has access to the Flash memory it needs to keep our world movingforward. 

Job Description

We're looking for an experienced Principal Engineer, Firmware Verification Engineering to join our organization in Bengaluru, India. In this leadership role, you will drive the verification strategy and execution for complex firmware and embedded systems. The ideal candidate will bring deep technical expertise in firmware verification methodologies, strong analytical capabilities, and a proven track record of leading high-performing engineering teams to deliver robust, reliable products. 

est Architect - SSD Firmware & Feature Validation (FVT)

Role Summary

Define validation strategy, test methodologies, automation framework and test architectures to validate SSD firmware for NAND-based systems and solutions. Test areas will span across Feature and design level FW verification. 

The candidate will be responsible for architecting comprehensive validation solutions for enterprise SSD products, ensuring robust feature coverage across the FE, FTL and NIL FW modules. The role requires good expertise in NVMe/PCIe specifications, NVMe Cloud SSD specifications, OCP requirements, and customer-specific deployment scenarios. 

As a Test Architect, you will drive validation strategy from product definition through customer deployment, identifying coverage gaps, defining qualification criteria, improving product quality, and reducing customer issue escape rates. 

You will work closely with Firmware, Hardware, Systems Engineering, Product Management, Quality, and Hyperscale/Datacenter customers throughout the product lifecycle. 

The role requires the ability to communicate validation strategies, architecture decisions, risks, quality metrics, program status, and executive-level summaries effectively. The successful candidate must thrive in ambiguous environments, influence cross-functional teams, and drive complex technical initiatives with minimal direction. 

Experience

- 14+ years of experience in Embedded Firmware development/validation or 10+ years of SSD FW Verification with strong firmware and hardware debugging expertise. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in debugging and driving complex issues to closure
 - Good understanding on NVMe and PCIe protocol including Cloud SSD specification
 - Good understanding on SSD/NAND architecture
 - Proven experience in defining test strategies, qualification methodologies, and validation plans covering: Host Interface layer (HIL), Flash Translation Layer (FTL), NAND Management, Error Handling and Recovery Flows, Power Loss Protection (PLP), Reliability and Endurance Validation
 - Extensive experience architecting Feature Validation Test (FVT) coverage for Garbage collection, Wear levelling, Bad block management and Error injections
 - Good to have experience in developing validation plans for AI-centric storage workloads including: Model Training, Checkpointing, KV Cache, Inference, Agentic AI Workloads
 - Experience in test development and coding in Python
 - Experience translating product requirements and customer use cases into scalable validation architectures, test plans, coverage matrices, and automation frameworks. 
 - Prior experience validating SSD firmware and storage solutions for Datacenter, Enterprise, AI Compute, and Hyperscale environments. 
 - Define, develop, and implement new validation methodologies, automation frameworks, and tools to improve test effectiveness, coverage, and execution efficiency. 
 - Drive feature-level risk assessments and ensure validation completeness through requirements traceability and coverage analysis. 
 - Collaborate with architecture, firmware, and system teams to influence product design for testability and quality. 
 - Lead root-cause investigations by analyzing protocol captures, firmware logs, telemetry data, system traces, and performance metrics. 
 - Drive critical issues to closure by interfacing with Firmware, ASIC, Hardware, Systems, Reliability, and Customer Engineering teams. 
 - Own and scale the test infrastructure, improving test repeatability and coverage to accelerate the qualification cycle for next-generation NAND technologies. 
 - Demonstrated experience of leading big initiatives spanning multiple teams and organizations and leveraging deep domain expertise to influence product roadmap
 - Passionate about exploring and deploying noble methods to improve coverage, debugging, and efficiency of our FW releases. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or equivalent. 
 - Good knowledge of NVMe, PCIe and Datacenter SSD specifications
 - Strong understanding of SSD and FW architecture. 
 - Strong understanding of end-to-end storage stack interactions, including: CPU, Memory, PCIe, NVMe, Drivers, Operating Systems, Firmware, Virtualisation Layers, AI Accelerators (GPU/TPU)
 - Deep understanding of Feature Validation methodologies, test architecture design, coverage modelling, qualification metrics, defect escape prevention, and validation sign-off criteria. 
 - Strong expertise in Windows and Linux operating system debugging. 
 - Strong programming and automation skills using Python, including framework development
 - Experience building test frameworks, CI/CD-integrated validation solutions, automated reporting systems, and quality dashboards. 
 - Experience with AI infrastructure platforms, GPU-attached storage environments, and large-scale datacenter storage validation is highly desirable. 
 - Strong problem-solving, analytical, communication, technical leadership, and project management skills. 
 - Demonstrated capability to mentor engineers and provide technical leadership across multiple validation teams. 
 - Expert planning and execution skills with a strong focus on quality, efficiency, risk mitigation, and predictable project delivery. 
 - Highly skilled in leveraging AI-assisted tools for code generation, test creation, log analysis, root-cause identification, defect triage, coverage analysis, and automated report generation. 

Additional Information

Sandisk thrives on the power and potential of diversity. As a global company, we believe the most effective way to embrace the diversity of our customers and communities is to mirror it from within. We believe the fusion of various perspectives results in the best outcomes for our employees, our company, our customers, and the world around us. Role Overview

At Bridgestone Retail Operations the Customer is #1. BSRO operates more than 2, 200 stores and employs over 21, 000 teammates in the United States and is the industry leader in Complete Auto Care. Our locations include the Firestone Complete Auto Care, Tires Plus, Hibdon Tires and Wheel Works brands.

 - Integrate test automation with CI/CD pipelines for continuous testing.

- Ensure test coverage for functional, regression, performance, and security testing. 
 - Implement cross-browser testing, mobile testing, and visual validation. 
 - Work closely with developers, product managers, and DevOps teams to improve quality processes. 
 - Establish QA metrics, reporting, and test dashboards. 

CI/CD & Test Automation Integration

- Implement test automation in Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, or GitHub Actions. 
 - Automate AEM content validation and workflows. 
 - Drive shift-left testing by integrating automation early in the development cycle. 

Collaboration & Leadership

- Work in Agile/Scrum environments, participate in sprint planning, and drive QA excellence. 
 - Identify and resolve testing bottlenecks, flaky tests, and automation gaps.

 - 5+ years of experience in QA automation with Selenium, Cypress
 - Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Python for automation scripting.

AEM & Web Application Testing

- Hands-on experience with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) testing. 
 - Knowledge of AEM authoring, publishing, workflows, and dispatcher testing.

data.title: Supplier Quality Engineer
data.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

As a Supplier Quality Engineer (SQE) for auxiliary systems supporting gas turbines, steam turbines, and generators, you will be responsible for supplier qualification, development, and quality assurance activities across the supply chain. You will work closely with global suppliers and cross-functional teams to ensure product and process compliance while driving continuous improvement and operational excellence. 

In this role, you will leverage quality and digitalization tools, manage supplier performance, resolve quality issues, and implement preventive actions to enhance supplier capability and reliability. 

How You'll Make An Impact

- Conduct supplier qualification, capability assessments, and quality audits to ensure compliance with Siemens Energy requirements. 
 - Drive Product and Process Qualification (PPQ) activities and approve supplier manufacturing processes through Manufacturing Quality Control Plans. 
 - Perform source, virtual, and desk inspections while supporting quality assurance activities for components and systems within your scope. 
 - Manage supplier nonconformances, coordinate root cause analysis (RCA), and ensure effective corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Monitor supplier KPIs, support supplier development initiatives, and drive continuous improvement through structured reviews and risk mitigation plans. 

What You Bring

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 10+ years of experience in Supplier Quality, Quality Management, Supply Chain Management, or similar technical functions. 
 - Experience with industrial process technologies and/or auxiliary systems used in energy generation plants is preferred. 
 - Proven experience conducting supplier audits and strong knowledge of quality systems, including ISO 9001; familiarity with ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 is an advantage. 
 - Strong understanding of root cause analysis, quality methodologies, risk management, and supplier development processes. 
 - Experience working with quality management tools, supplier databases, and digital quality systems. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English with the ability to work effectively in a global environment. 
 - Willingness to travel up to 30% based on business requirements. 

About The Team

You will be part of a global Supplier Quality organization focused on ensuring a high-performing, reliable, and quality-driven supply chain for Siemens Energy products. The team collaborates closely with suppliers, procurement, engineering, and manufacturing functions to drive quality excellence and supplier development. 

The environment promotes collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement, providing opportunities to influence supplier performance and contribute to the successful delivery of critical energy solutions worldwide. 

About The Team

You will be part of the Supply Chain Management team supporting Siemens Energy. The team works closely with suppliers, procurement, manufacturing, and planning functions to ensure the reliable flow of materials and services required to meet customer and production commitments. 

The environment encourages collaboration, continuous improvement, and innovation, providing opportunities to contribute to strategic supplier partnerships and the successful delivery of world-class energy solutions. 

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. Job Description

In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: 

You will be responsible for the full project lifecycle, from requirements gathering and concept design to hardware/software engineering, simulation, testing, and commissioning. 

Project Engineering: 

- Lead end-to-end project engineering for high-current static generator excitation systems, from requirements review and concept development through detailed design, manufacturing support, FAT, site installation, and commissioning. 
 - Design excitation system electrical and mechanical layouts for high-current applications, typically in the 5, 000 A to 10, 000 A range, including cubicle arrangement, power circuit configuration, cooling provisions, and maintainability requirements. 
 - Perform sizing and selection of excitation system components, including transformers, rectifier bridges, thyristors/diodes, bus bars, disconnecting devices, breakers, protection devices, cooling equipment, controllers, I/O, and auxiliary power supplies. 
 - Develop and review electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, interconnection drawings, general arrangement drawings, BOMs, control logic, system architecture, and network topology documents. 
 - Engineer bus work and high-current power connections, including routing, clearance, creepage, thermal performance, short-circuit withstand, and manufacturability considerations. 
 - Coordinate with manufacturing, quality, suppliers, and system integrators to ensure the excitation system design is practical, cost-effective, manufacturable, and compliant with project specifications. 
 - Support manufacturing quality processes, including inspection plans, assembly reviews, test procedures, nonconformance resolution, and corrective actions for high-current excitation equipment. 
 - Implement control logic from SAMA diagrams, functional descriptions, and project-specific operating requirements. 
 - Configure and integrate communication protocols such as Modbus, OPC, IEC 61850, and DNP3, as applicable. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable IEEE, IEC, NEC, ISO, HSE, and regional grid code requirements.

Job Title

Senior Solution Architect - Service Platform

Job Description

ServiceNow Solutions Architect

Enterprise ServiceNow architecture, platform governance, custom application development, integration, CMDB/CSDM maturity, and transformation delivery

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced ServiceNow Solutions Architect to lead the design, development, and implementation of scalable ServiceNow solutions across the enterprise. The architect will translate business requirements into practical platform architectures, guide delivery teams, establish governance standards, and ensure the platform supports automation, service quality, security, and measurable business value. 

This role is suitable for a senior ServiceNow professional who is both architecture-oriented and hands-on: comfortable leading workshops, designing integrations, reviewing scripts and custom applications, advising stakeholders, and mentoring developers and administrators. 

Role Scope

- Primary modules and domains: ITSM, ITOM, CMDB, Discovery, Service Mapping, ITAM, HRSD, CSM, SecOps, App Engine, Service Portal, Service Catalog, SPM, EAM, FSM, and custom application development. 
 - Core architecture themes: Platform roadmap, governance, scalable workflows, automation frameworks, integrations, data quality, CMDB/CSDM maturity, security, compliance, performance, and upgrade-safe solution design. 
 - Delivery environment: Enterprise Service Management, Agile/Scrum delivery, DevOps practices, cross-functional implementation teams, and global enterprise stakeholder groups. 

Key Responsibilities

Architecture and Solution Design

- Design end-to-end ServiceNow solutions based on business requirements, enterprise architecture principles, and platform best practices. 
 - Create solution designs, technical specifications, integration points, data mapping documentation, architecture decisions, and implementation guidance. 
 - Define scalable platform architectures, workflows, automation frameworks, security models, and governance standards aligned to business objectives. 
 - Ensure solutions are secure, performant, maintainable, upgrade-safe, and compliant with internal standards and industry practices. 

Requirements, Workshops, and Stakeholder Advisory

- Lead technical workshops and requirements-gathering sessions with business and IT stakeholders. 
 - Collaborate with product owners, process owners, business analysts, project managers, developers, administrators, and enterprise architects. 
 - Translate business needs into user stories, technical designs, platform patterns, data requirements, and implementation plans. 
 - Communicate technical tradeoffs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership and client stakeholders. 

Platform Governance, Roadmap, and Best Practices

- Develop and maintain ServiceNow architectural standards, roadmaps, governance practices, coding standards, and design review processes. 
 - Stay current with ServiceNow releases, platform capabilities, AI-enabled features, and new modules; recommend adoption where there is clear value. 
 - Drive platform optimization, technical debt reduction, customization rationalization, performance improvement, and upgrade readiness. 
 - Identify architectural risks early and recommend mitigation plans across delivery, data, integration, licensing, and supportability dimensions. 

Custom Application Development and Automation

- Design and oversee custom applications, scoped apps, workflows, catalog items, portals, forms, automation, and enhancements within ServiceNow. 
 - Provide hands-on guidance for JavaScript, Glide APIs, GlideScript, Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Actions, Script Includes, Flow Designer, and App Engine patterns. 
 - Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues related to custom applications, workflows, integrations, security, and platform behavior. 
 - Guide teams on when to configure, extend, integrate, or avoid customization to preserve long-term platform health. 

Integration, Data, and Migration

- Design integrations between ServiceNow and enterprise systems using REST/SOAP APIs, Integration Hub, eBonding, MID Server, middleware, import sets, transform maps, and event-driven patterns. 
 - Define data migration, synchronization, mapping, validation, error handling, monitoring, and reconciliation approaches. 
 - Ensure integration designs preserve data integrity, security, reliability, observability, and performance. 
 - Work with automation and scripting technologies such as JavaScript, Python, and PowerShell where relevant to integration or migration delivery. 

CMDB, CSDM, Discovery, and Operations

- Define and mature CMDB and Common Service Data Model strategy, including CI classes, service models, ownership, lifecycle governance, and relationship quality. 
 - Support Discovery, Service Mapping, ITOM, Service Graph, and related operational data initiatives across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments. 
 - Improve CMDB health, data quality, reconciliation, service visibility, and operational decision-making. 
 - Partner with operations teams to align platform architecture with incident, problem, change, request, asset, and service management processes. 

Project Delivery and Team Leadership

- Successfully deliver ServiceNow projects in a lead architecture or technical leadership role. 
 - Collaborate with project managers, Agile delivery managers, Scrum Masters, and team members to manage timelines, dependencies, risks, and priorities. 
 - Handle multiple projects or workstreams simultaneously and adapt to changing business priorities. 
 - Provide mentorship, code/design review, technical direction, and knowledge transfer to ServiceNow developers and administrators. 

Quality, Testing, and Documentation

- Define testing strategies covering unit testing, integration testing, regression testing, performance validation, user acceptance, and release readiness. 
 - Use or guide ServiceNow Automated Test Framework where appropriate to improve release confidence and regression coverage. 
 - Maintain clear architectural documentation, design specifications, integration contracts, decision logs, runbooks, and platform standards. 
 - Support post-implementation validation, defect resolution, continuous improvement, and operational handover. 

Required Experience And Qualifications

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field; equivalent practical experience may be considered. 
 - ServiceNow experience: Minimum 5+ years of ServiceNow platform experience with at least 2-3 years in an architect, lead consultant, or technical lead role; for senior enterprise roles, 10+ years of ServiceNow architecture/consulting experience is preferred. 
 - Overall IT experience: 10+ years is strongly preferred; 15+ years is ideal for global enterprise transformation or principal architect roles. 
 - Implementation depth: Demonstrable hands-on experience in ServiceNow implementations, custom application development, integrations, and enterprise module rollouts.

Key Responsibilities

Operates, calibrates, installs, programs, repairs, designs, and fabricates instrumentation and data acquisition systems. Evaluates and specifies new equipment; develops new technology; installs and maintains electronic engine monitoring systems. Fabricates and assembles test fixtures and servo-hydraulic systems; operates, troubleshoots, and repairs hydraulic systems, shakers, and rigs; calibrates transducers and systems; installs and calibrates strain gauges and thermocouples (micro). Maintains parts and equipment inventories. Creates and maintains electronic documentation. Uses a number of general tools including but not limited to digital multimeter, soldering iron, function generator, and frequency generator. Reads and interprets electrical wiring diagrams. Works with and trains apprentices and technicians. Interfaces with customers, suppliers, engineers, and other functions. Coordinates programs including planning, scheduling, ordering, and tracking. Participates in the maintenance of quality procedures. Leads and participate in improvement projects. Develops and gives presentations to customers and suppliers. Performs other duties as required. 

- Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to emission equipment such as Horiba MEXA, AVL SPC478, PN Counter, and FTIR. 
 - Ensure test accuracy, correctness, and data integrity. 
 - Support operations across three shifts, including Sundays and holidays. 
 - Perform preventive maintenance and calibration of emission systems as per the maintenance schedule. 
 - Maximize emission system uptime through proactive maintenance and continuous improvement. 
 - Maintain workplace safety and 5S standards. 

Competencies

Data Acquisition - Prepares samples, verifies equipment calibration and performs tests according to an approved standard procedure or work instruction in a manner which ensures, and results in, data that can be trusted and delivered to the engineer or customer. 

Data Reporting - Prepares documentation in a manner which clearly organizes and presents testing methods, instrument settings, the data and analysis to allow the engineer and customer to understand the results and form accurate conclusions and recommendations.
