data.description:
About Us

Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here. 

The Sr. Engineering Manager (SEM) leads and develops engineering teams that build and operate business-critical transportation capabilities supporting Target's domestic first-mile and middle-mile network. This portfolio spans carrier scheduling, delivery and trailer services, transportation movement data, yard and gate operations, shipping documentation, and integrations across internal and external systems. 

As an SEM, you are accountable for engineering strategy, product delivery, technical health, and production operations across these capabilities. You will build strong engineering teams and establish practices that enable secure, resilient, observable, scalable, and highly available systems. 

Working closely with Product, engineering partners, business and operations teams, and external technology partners, you will translate business priorities into technology strategy and execution. Success requires strong people leadership, systems thinking, technical judgment, operational discipline, stakeholder management, and clear communication. 

Skills

Use your skills, experience, and talents to be part of groundbreaking thinking and visionary goals. As a Sr. Engineering Manager, you'll take the lead as you: 

- Lead and develop a high-performing engineering team. Create clarity of purpose and ownership, coach engineers and technical leaders, and own staffing, performance management, career development, succession planning, and capability growth. 
 - Partner with Product, business, and operations leaders to translate priorities into an executable technology roadmap. Balance new capabilities with reliability, security, scalability, modernization, and technical health while connecting engineering investments to measurable business and operational outcomes. 
 - Drive operational excellence and resilience for distributed, event-driven systems and APIs. Establish measurable reliability practices across observability, service levels, incident response, root-cause analysis, capacity and performance, recovery, and business continuity. Use production insights to reduce recurring incidents, systemic risk, and operational toil. 
 - Provide engineering leadership across complex integrations spanning transportation, shipment, appointment, trailer, movement, and shipping-document workflows. Ensure teams build reliable interfaces and treat data contracts, quality, reconciliation, traceability, and end-to-end observability as first-class engineering concerns. 
 - Shape technical strategy and modernization in partnership with senior engineers. Guide architecture and engineering standards, simplify systems, reduce technical debt and operational complexity, and improve engineering velocity while maintaining production stability. 
 - Guide teams building distributed enterprise systems using modern application, event-streaming, API, relational/document data, cloud/platform, and web technologies. Promote strong CI/CD, automated testing, secure development, DevOps, and engineering automation practices. 
 - Manage external technology partnerships while retaining Target engineering accountability. Establish clear integration contracts, non-functional requirements, production-readiness expectations, escalation paths, service reviews, and remediation plans. 
 - Accelerate responsible adoption of approved AI-assisted engineering practices. Help teams identify high-value use cases across development, testing, modernization, debugging, documentation, and operational analysis while maintaining appropriate quality, security, privacy, compliance, and human-review standards. 
 - Lead through influence across organizational boundaries. Manage cross-team dependencies and risks, remove roadblocks, develop technical leadership, and enable engineers to own technical design and execution. Communicate technology health, risks, tradeoffs, decisions, and investment needs clearly across technical and non-technical audiences. 

Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs. 

About You

- 4-year degree or equivalent experience. 
 - 7+ years of engineering/software-development experience, including building and operating distributed enterprise applications in production. 
 - 1-3 years of engineering-management experience, with a demonstrated track record of developing engineers and delivering cross-functional products or platforms. 
 - Strong experience with production operations, observability, and reliability engineering, including service levels, incident management, root-cause analysis, capacity/performance management, and recovery practices. 
 - Experience leading teams responsible for resilient APIs, microservices, event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, and complex system integrations. 
 - Broad technical understanding of modern application development, event-streaming, relational and document data technologies, cloud/platform infrastructure, CI/CD, automated testing, secure software development, and DevOps. 
 - Demonstrated ability to guide architecture and modernization, manage technical debt, and balance near-term product delivery with long-term engineering health. 
 - Experience managing external technology partners and complex cross-team dependencies in large enterprise technology ecosystems. 
 - Experience enabling responsible adoption of AI-assisted engineering tools and practices. 
 - Strong people leadership, including coaching, performance management, career development, succession planning, and building sustainable engineering capability. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical health, risk, tradeoffs, and decisions across engineering, Product, business, operations, and external partners. 
 - Deep understanding of agile product development, with a mindset of delivering business value incrementally while continuously improving reliability, maintainability, and operational excellence.

data.title: Programmable Clock leadership role
data.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. 

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world's most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. 

Whether you're designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger - technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we'll advance your career. 

Programmable Clock India lead, Adaptive Computing Group

The Role

As the leader of the Programmable Clock Design & Methodologies team in India for AMD's Adaptive-Embedded Computing products, you will be responsible for driving the development of clocking solutions that meet the high standards of AMD's AECG products. This will involve leading a team of highly skilled engineers in India, as well as collaborating with the global Clock team of experts at the San Jose office, inventing and implementing original solutions, addressing challenging clock problems in some of the industry's largest and most complex SOCs. 

Every new Adaptive SOC brings a new set of programable Clock challenges with their latest system and functional architectures and their adoption of new semiconductor and packaging technologies. The Global Clock team works closely with functional Architecture, Programable fabric, Integration and SW teams to craft and implement new clock solutions, including new architectures, Clock IPs and development of new tools, flows & Methodology. 

This can be a challenging but exciting opportunity. 

The Person

This is a critical role within the company, and requires a combination of technical expertise, leadership skills, and effective communication. If you are passionate about clocking methodologies and have a track record of leading successful teams, this could be an exciting opportunity for you to join a innovative programmable Clock team at AMD. 

You will lead by bringing people together and drive towards consensus, decisions, and results. Working independently, you will convert high level concepts down to tangible specifications that can be implemented efficiently. You should enjoy collaborating with engineers with their diverse skillsets and bring their expertise to bear on solving challenging Programable Clock problems. 

Key Responsibilities

- Developing Programable global Clock distribution methodologies, optimizing Clock - Skew, Signal integrity and power integrity issues for AMD's next generation of programmable product families. 
 - Large Scale Block to Block Clock timing analysis, within the Die & Die to Die Clock interposer crossing. 
 - Deep analysis of timing paths to identify and debug key issues. 
 - Collaborate with functional IP teams (RTL, Ckt, physical design, Full Chip Timing, Integration) during the implementation and qualification of a growing number of programable Clock IPs. 
 - Identify key positions and required skills: Based on the team's objectives, the candidate should identify the key positions required to achieve them. These could include Circuit Design, STA, Physical Design & RTL etc. 

Preferred Experience

- You should have a deep understanding of System level clocking methodologies and experience in leading teams to deliver complex projects with 15+ Years of experience. Working knowledge of Programable clocking is a plus. 
 - You should be an expert in the development of Programmable clocking solutions and have the ability to work effectively with global teams (USA & India) to ensure that on time product delivery with high quality is met. 
 - Strong Clock fundamentals (Clock switching and gating, synchronization, Clock skew balancing, Jitter, Fmax, DCD and CDC analysis). 
 - Familiarity with test, debug, yield, post-Silicon Validation & Characterization is a plus. 
 - Working experience of Package level Clock SIPI is a plus. 
 - Proficient in STA and methodologies for timing closure and have a good understanding of noise, cross-talk, Aging and OCV effects, among others. 
 - Defined timing/SDC and placement constraints for IPs. 
 - EDA tools, Design Compiler, ICC2, Primetime. Working knowledge of extraction and STA methodology and tools. 
 - Familiar with circuit modeling, including AMS sim, and worst-case corner selection. 
 - Familiarity with Verilog and system Verilog for design. 
 - Additionally, you should be a skilled communicator, able to provide technical guidance and mentorship to your team members to help them develop their skills and advance their careers. 

Academic Credentials

- BS, MS or PhD in Electrical and/or Computer Engineering, Computer Science or related field. 

LOCATION: 

Bangalore, India

AMD and its subsidiaries are equal opportunity, inclusive employers and will consider all applicants without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, race, religion, political and/or third-party affiliation, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will accommodate applicants' needs under the respective laws throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process.

This is where your work makes a difference. 

At Baxter, we believe every person-regardless of who they are or where they are from-deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond. 

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results. 

Here, you will find more than just a job-you will find purpose and pride. 

Job Summary

We are seeking a Development and Test Manager with 12+ years of experience leading software development, verification, and quality engineering for connected healthcare and regulated medical software. The manager will provide technical and people leadership across the complete product lifecycle-from requirements, architecture, design, and implementation through functional, automation, performance, reliability, and release-readiness testing. This role owns delivery of cloud-native applications, REST and GraphQL APIs, user interfaces, microservices, medical-device integrations, and EMR/EHR workflows within agreed quality, schedule, and budget commitments. The role combines engineering leadership, development and test governance, technical direction, stakeholder management, design-control compliance, and audit-ready delivery. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Define and continuously improve the integrated software development and test strategy in alignment with product roadmaps, business priorities, regulatory commitments, architecture direction, and release plans. 
 - Lead software developers, automation engineers, performance engineers, and functional verification engineers; manage capacity, hiring, onboarding, objectives, coaching, technical development, succession planning, and delivery accountability. 
 - Plan and lead engineering assignments involving the evaluation, selection, and adaptation of software designs, technologies, development methods, test approaches, tools, and engineering practices. 
 - Provide technical direction from product conception through requirements, architecture, detailed design, implementation, integration, verification, release, and sustaining activities. 
 - Establish software engineering governance covering estimation, design and code reviews, coding standards, branching and configuration management, unit and component testing, static analysis, code coverage, technical debt, defect management, and quality metrics. 
 - Ensure software architecture and implementation meet requirements for maintainability, security, scalability, performance, reliability, interoperability, observability, and supportability. 
 - Own delivery of cloud-native applications, microservices, REST and GraphQL APIs, web user interfaces, integration services, and data processing capabilities using appropriate C#/. NET and related technologies. 
 - Establish test governance, risk-based planning, entry and exit criteria, requirements traceability, defect management, quality dashboards, and release-readiness assessments. 
 - Own the roadmap and governance for reusable C#-based REST API and UI automation frameworks, including coding standards, test-data management, parallel execution, logging, reporting, and environment configuration. 
 - Ensure unit, component, integration, smoke, regression, performance, scalability, reliability, security, and release-level testing is incorporated into CI/CD pipelines with appropriate automated quality gates. 
 - Guide design, development, integration, and verification of HL7 ADT, FHIR resources, clinical workflows, EMR/EHR interfaces, connected medical devices, real-time communications, notifications, and downstream clinical systems. 
 - Implement configuration and change management throughout the complete product lifecycle, including design, development, verification, release, and sustaining phases. 
 - Partner with product, clinical, systems, architecture, DevOps, cybersecurity, quality, regulatory, service, manufacturing, and external integration teams to resolve dependencies, technical issues, and product risks. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis by correlating application behavior, source code, automated and performance results, logs, API traces, network data, database records, queues, container metrics, and infrastructure telemetry. 
 - Incorporate field issues, customer feedback, post-market learnings, and production trends into product design improvements, corrective actions, regression coverage, reliability testing, and performance validation. 
 - Ensure compliance with the product development process, design controls, Quality System requirements, software lifecycle procedures, cybersecurity expectations, and applicable regulatory standards. 
 - Maintain audit-ready requirements, architecture and design records, code and review evidence, plans, test cases, objective evidence, reports, approvals, and traceability in approved tools such as Jira, Jama, source-control platforms, and validated test-management systems. 
 - Develop project plans, engineering milestones, resource strategies, budgets, and delivery forecasts; identify and mitigate issues that could affect quality, cost, scope, or schedule. 
 - Manage external development partners, contractors, vendors, and third-party service providers, including technical direction, deliverable acceptance, and performance monitoring. 
 - Communicate development progress, quality status, technical risks, mitigation plans, resource needs, architecture decisions, test findings, and go/no-go recommendations to program and leadership forums. 

What You'll Bring

- 12-18 years of software engineering, software development, testing, verification, quality engineering, or performance engineering experience, including at least 5 years leading multidisciplinary technical teams in a regulated or safety-critical environment. 
 - B. E/B. Tech in Computer Science / Electronics & Communication / Electrical or related field 
 - Demonstrated experience managing the complete software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, architecture, design, implementation, code review, unit testing, integration, verification, release, and sustaining engineering. 
 - Strong hands-on or technical leadership experience with C#/. NET, object-oriented design, design patterns, REST and GraphQL APIs, microservices, web applications, and distributed systems. 
 - Demonstrated ownership of functional and automation test strategy for REST APIs, web user interfaces, integration workflows, and end-to-end regression using Playwright, Selenium, NUnit, xUnit, MSTest, or comparable technologies. 
 - Experience with software architecture and engineering practices such as clean architecture, secure coding, static analysis, code quality, code coverage, configuration management, branching strategies, dependency management, and technical-debt reduction. 
 - Experience validating distributed microservices, event-driven systems, JSON/XML, SQL/PostgreSQL, authentication, authorization, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, MQTT, or comparable technologies. 
 - Working knowledge of Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, autoscaling, service discovery, role-based access control, secrets management, service mesh, resilience, and cloud observability. 
 - Experience with CI/CD architecture, Git, build automation, automated quality gates, pipeline troubleshooting, artifact management, deployment practices, test reporting, and engineering dashboards. 
 - Healthcare domain expertise covering HL7 v2, ADT messages and acknowledgements, FHIR REST resources, EMR/EHR workflows, connected medical devices, data integrity, patient safety, privacy, and clinical risk. 
 - Knowledge of regulated healthcare software practices and standards such as IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, design controls, cybersecurity expectations, and formal verification evidence.

Preferred Skills

data.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
data.description:
All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description. 

About JumpCloud®
JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times. 

  

JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT. 

What You'll Be Doing: 

- 
Architect, scale, and continuously improve the reliability, availability, and performance of JumpCloud's multi-region microservices, APIs, and authentication infrastructure (AWS/GCP). 

- 
Architect, build, and maintain Disaster Recovery (DR) process, multi-region failover automation, and business continuity strategies to ensure rapid recovery against strict RTO and RPO objectives. 

- 
Lead the design and enforcement of SLIs, SLOs, and Error Budget frameworks across multi-disciplinary engineering teams. 

- 
Drive end-to-end observability strategy using Datadog, implementing actionable Golden Signals monitoring to drastically reduce MTTD/MTTR and eliminate alert fatigue. 

- 
Lead on-call escalation, major incident management, and drive strict adherence to 99. 99% availability SLAs. 

- 
Facilitate blameless post-incident reviews, executing systemic root-cause remediations to prevent recurring failure modes. 

- 
Architect, manage, and scale production Kubernetes (EKS) clusters, implementing advanced GitOps workflows (Argo CD, Kargo) and deployment patterns. 

- 
Design and maintain modular, enterprise-grade Infrastructure-as-Code using Terraform across multi-account, multi-region cloud environments. 

- 
Design, build, and maintain interactive FinOps and cost-optimization dashboards to provide engineering and leadership teams with actionable insights into multi-cloud spend, unit economics, and resource utilization. 

- 
Eliminate complex operational toil by writing production-grade Python or Go tooling, platform automation, and custom integrations. 

- 
Champion AI-assisted software development workflows (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate automation, runbook creation, and incident triage across the team. 

- 
Author operational runbooks, architecture decision records, and mentor mid-level/junior engineers to raise the overall technical bar. 

We're Looking For: 

- 
8+ years of professional software engineering experience in SRE, DevOps, or Platform Engineering operating 24/7 mission-critical, highly available distributed systems. 

- 
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent technical discipline. 

- 
Strong Python/Go Capabilities: Advanced software engineering skill set for writing internal SRE platforms, tools, and API integrations. 

- 
Deep Kubernetes Expertise: Hands-on experience with production EKS/GKE cluster lifecycles, ingress/egress, networking, RBAC, and GitOps tooling (Argo CD). 

- 
Advanced IaC & AWS/GCP: Deep Terraform proficiency (module architecture, state management refactoring) across complex multi-account AWS environments (IAM, VPCs, Transit Gateway, ALB/NLB, Route53). 

- 
FinOps & Cost Optimization Leadership: Demonstrated experience driving cloud cost-efficiency strategies, resource right-sizing, cost-allocation tagging, workload optimization, and building FinOps dashboards to embed financial accountability into engineering workflows. 

- 
Disaster Recovery & High Availability: Proven background in designing and testing multi-region Disaster Recovery architectures, automating failover systems, and monitoring recovery health via DR dashboards. 

- 
Observability & Reliability Architecture: Track record of defining SLI/SLOs, managing PagerDuty schedules, and optimizing production observability platforms. 

- 
Experience designing and operating enterprise service meshes (Istio, Linkerd, or similar) and production ingress/proxy systems (HAProxy, NGINX, or similar). 

- 
Technical Mentorship: Demonstrated ability to lead technical discussions, write architectural design docs/RFCs, and mentor engineering peers. 

- 
Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills with a passion for solving complex distributed systems challenges at scale. 

- 
A strong team player who helps us live by our core values: building connections, thinking big, and getting 1% better every day. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

- 
Basic understanding of chaos engineering principles or testing resilience in staging/production. 

- 
Experience with secrets management architectures (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, External Secrets Operator, Cert-Manager). 

- 
Background in DevSecOps practices, service meshes (Istio), and automated vulnerability remediation within cloud infrastructure code. 

- 
Background supporting identity services, IAM, enterprise directory platforms, or security-focused SaaS solutions. 

Where you'll be working/Location: 

JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description. 

  

You must be located in and authorized to work in the country noted in the job description to be considered for this role.   

  

Please note: There is an expectation that our engineers participate in on-call shifts. You will be expected commit to being ready and able to respond during your assigned shift, so that alerts don't go unaddressed. 

  

Language: 

JumpCloud has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently.   Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description. 

  

Why JumpCloud?   

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You'll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We're out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You'll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.     

  

One of JumpCloud's three core values is to "Build Connections. " To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed. " - Rajat Bhargava, CEO

  

Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud.   Please note JumpCloud is not accepting third party resumes at this time.     

  

JumpCloud is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. 

  

Scam Notice: 

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment. 

  

All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud. com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud. com with the subject line "Scam Notice"  

  

#BI-Remote

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, transcribing or summarizing interviews, and assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans. Please see our Privacy Policy (https: //jumpcloud. com/privacy) for more information about our personal data practices.

data.title: Quality Assurance Specialist | Night Shift (On-site Kolkata)
data.description:
Company Description

Comparison Junction is a unified comparison and switching platform that helps customers find better-value deals across Energy, Telecom, Travel, Insurance, Banking, and other essential services. 

With over a decade of experience in telesales, digital sales, and inbound customer acquisition, our teams help customers compare available options, understand their choices, and complete their switching journey with confidence. 

Role Description

We are looking for a Quality Assurance Specialist with strong Call Centre and Sales Quality experience to join our team in New Town, Kolkata. 

The Quality Assurance Specialist will be responsible for auditing customer interactions, ensuring compliance with process and client requirements, identifying quality gaps, and providing actionable feedback to improve customer experience and sales performance. 

This is a hands-on quality role involving call auditing, BQ management, compliance checks, RCA, CAPA, reporting, coaching support, and client reporting. 

The successful candidate should be comfortable working with large volumes of calls, analysing customer interactions, identifying root causes, and converting quality findings into measurable process and performance improvements. 

Key Responsibilities
☎️ Call Auditing & Quality Monitoring
 - Conduct regular call audits based on defined quality parameters, sampling methodology, and audit plans. 
 - Evaluate customer interactions for: 
 - Sales effectiveness
 - Customer experience
 - Communication quality
 - Process adherence
 - Product/process knowledge
 - Objection handling
 - Disclosure requirements
 - Accuracy of information
 - Compliance
 - Closing and conversion practices
 - Identify critical errors, behavioural gaps, process deviations, and missed sales opportunities. 
 - Maintain accurate and timely quality scores and audit records. 
 - Ensure consistency and objectivity in the evaluation process. 
💬 Feedback & Coaching
 - Provide specific, actionable and timely feedback to Sales Advisors and Team Leaders. 
 - Identify recurring behavioural and process gaps and recommend targeted coaching interventions. 
 - Support Team Leaders and Training teams with insights from call audits. 
 - Conduct calibration sessions to ensure consistent understanding and application of quality standards. 
 - Track whether corrective coaching results in sustained improvement. 
📋 BQ Management
 - Own and maintain the BQ (Bad Quality) management process. 
 - Identify and classify BQ cases based on defined quality and compliance criteria. 
 - Track BQ trends by agent, team, process, campaign, error type, and root cause. 
 - Ensure BQ cases are communicated to relevant stakeholders within defined TAT. 
 - Monitor corrective actions and recurrence of BQ. 
 - Provide regular BQ analysis to Operations and Management. 
🛡️ Compliance & Process Audits
 - Conduct compliance checks across customer interactions. 
 - Ensure advisors follow approved scripts, disclosures, sales processes, and regulatory/client requirements. 
 - Identify critical compliance breaches and escalate them immediately. 
 - Monitor adherence to client-specific quality requirements and SOPs. 
 - Maintain appropriate documentation and audit trails. 
 - Support internal and client audits when required. 
🔎 RCA - Root Cause Analysis
 - Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring quality, compliance, customer experience, and sales issues. 
 - Identify whether the root cause is related to: 
 - People
 - Process
 - Product
 - Training
 - Technology/System
 - Communication
 - Policy
 - Leadership/management
 - Use data and call evidence to validate the identified root cause. 
 - Distinguish between symptoms and actual root causes. 
 - Present RCA findings with clear evidence and recommended corrective actions. 
🔧 CAPA - Corrective & Preventive Action
 - Develop and track CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) plans arising from quality and compliance findings. 
 - Define: 
 - Problem statement
 - Root cause
 - Corrective action
 - Preventive action
 - Owner
 - Target date
 - Success measure
 - Track CAPA implementation and effectiveness. 
 - Conduct follow-up checks to confirm that issues have been permanently addressed. 
 - Escalate overdue or ineffective CAPAs to the relevant stakeholders. 
📊 Reporting & MISPrepare and publish regular quality reports covering: 

- Quality Score
 - Audit Volume
 - Pass/Fail Rate
 - BQ Trends
 - Critical Errors
 - Compliance Performance
 - Customer Experience Indicators
 - Process Deviations
 - Agent/Team Performance
 - Repeat Errors
 - RCA Trends
 - CAPA Status
 - Improvement TrendsDevelop daily, weekly and monthly quality dashboards and reports for Operations and Management. 

🤝 Client Reporting
 - Prepare accurate and professional client quality reports. 
 - Provide quality insights, trends, observations, and corrective-action updates. 
 - Support client review meetings with relevant quality data. 
 - Respond to client quality queries and audit observations. 
 - Ensure client-specific quality and compliance requirements are accurately reflected in internal audits and reporting. 
 - Coordinate with Operations and Management to close client-identified quality gaps. 
📈 Continuous Improvement
 - Identify recurring quality issues and recommend process improvements. 
 - Analyse trends across teams, campaigns, products, and customer journeys. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve customer experience, sales conversion, compliance, and process efficiency. 
 - Participate in quality improvement projects and process reviews. 
 - Recommend changes to scripts, SOPs, training modules, and workflows based on quality insights. 

Key Performance Areas

The Quality Assurance Specialist will be measured on: 

- Audit Accuracy & Completion
 - Quality Score Accuracy
 - BQ Identification & Reduction
 - Compliance Adherence
 - RCA Quality & Timeliness
 - CAPA Closure & Effectiveness
 - Repeat Error Reduction
 - Feedback TAT & Quality
 - Client Reporting Accuracy & TAT
 - Quality Reporting & Data Accuracy
 - Customer Experience Improvement
 - Process Improvement Contribution
Qualifications
 - 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance / Quality Analyst roles within a Call Centre, Contact Centre, BPO, Telesales, or Sales environment. 
 - Mandatory experience in a sales/contact-centre environment. 
 - Strong experience in call auditing and quality monitoring. 
 - Experience handling BQ / Bad Quality management. 
 - Good understanding of sales processes, customer experience, compliance, and call-centre operations. 
 - Experience conducting RCA and CAPA. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
 - Strong understanding of quality metrics and performance reporting. 
 - Proficiency in MS Excel / Google Sheets and reporting tools. 
 - Experience preparing client-facing quality reports is preferred. 
 - Strong attention to detail and documentation skills. 
 - Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities. 
 - Comfortable working in a night-shift environment. 
 - Bachelor's degree preferred. 
What We Look For

We are looking for a QA professional who goes beyond "checking calls and giving scores. "

The right candidate should be able to connect: Call Finding → Customer Impact → Root Cause → Corrective Action → Preventive Action → Measurable Improvement

You should be comfortable challenging processes, asking "Why did this happen?", validating the root cause with evidence, and ensuring that corrective actions actually prevent recurrence. 

Strong sales understanding is particularly important because the role requires evaluating not only compliance and customer experience but also sales conversations, objection handling, persuasion, and closing behaviour. 

Work Details📍 Location: New Town, Kolkata

💼 Employment: Full-time | On-site

🌙 Shift: Night Shift / USA Shift

🕐 Timing: 7: 30 PM - 5: 00 AM

📅 Working: 5 days a week

If you have a strong eye for quality, understand sales conversations, and can turn call-level findings into measurable business improvement, we want to hear from you.

data.title: Hardware Lead
data.description:
Overview: Dozee Health AI is a pioneer in Contactless Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), proven to drive transformation at scale. Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, Dozee has emerged as India's no. 1 RPM Company. 

We are seeking visionary individuals to help us in this very exciting journey. As a part of our dynamic team, you'll have the opportunity to collaborate with top healthcare providers in the country, applying AI-powered RPM solutions to tackle some of the most pressing challenges in healthcare - enhancing staff efficiency, improving patient outcomes, and pioneering the next generation of care models. 

The Hardware Team Lead owns end-to-end delivery of Dozee's medical IoT hardware, from concept through design transfer. This person leads a cross-disciplinary team spanning hardware, firmware, and mechanical engineering, and is accountable for shipping products on schedule, to spec, and in line with the regulatory and compliance standards required of medical devices. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead, mentor, and grow a team of hardware, firmware, and mechanical engineers, setting priorities and holding the team accountable for output. 
 - Own product delivery end to end: translate product requirements into engineering plans, track milestones, and ensure devices ship on schedule and to spec. 
 - Drive hardware and firmware architecture and design for Dozee's contactless RPM devices, from concept and prototyping through verification - scope of ownership runs through design transfer. 
 - Guide firmware development choices - embedded/RTOS architecture, driver design, and hardware-firmware integration - working closely with firmware engineers even where they own day-to-day implementation. 
 - Build and test functional prototypes at each design stage to validate performance before moving to verification. 
 - Plan and oversee compliance testing (EMC, electrical safety, environmental, biocompatibility where applicable) so designs meet IEC and ISO standards before submission. 
 - Own the hardware and firmware contribution to regulatory submissions and technical documentation (FDA 510(k), CE MDR, CDSCO) in partnership with the regulatory affairs team. 
 - Own risk management across hardware and firmware: maintain risk files, run hazard/FMEA analyses, and drive mitigations in line with ISO 14971. 
 - Triage and resolve field complaints and hardware/firmware-related support tickets, driving root-cause analysis and corrective/preventive action (CAPA). 
 - Work cross-functionally with product management, quality, supply chain, and software teams to align hardware plans with business goals. 
 - Report progress, risks, and resourcing needs to leadership. 

Required Qualifications & Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical, Electronics, Embedded/Computer Engineering (or a related field). 
 - 8+ years of hands-on hardware and firmware engineering experience, with at least 2-3 years leading or managing an engineering team. 
 - Prior experience in the medical device industry is required - familiarity with how design controls, risk management, and regulatory submissions shape hardware and firmware decisions. 
 - Well-versed in firmware development and architecture - embedded/RTOS or bare-metal firmware, driver design, and hardware-firmware integration
 - Track record of taking hardware and firmware together from concept through prototyping, verification, and design transfer. 
 - Hands-on experience running or overseeing risk management activities (FMEA, hazard analysis) in line with ISO 14971. 
 - Experience coordinating mechanical engineering work streams (enclosure, thermal, DFM) alongside electrical and firmware scope. 
 - Comfortable owning delivery timelines and communicating trade-offs to product and leadership stakeholders. 

Regulatory & Compliance Knowledge

- Working knowledge of IEC 60601-1 (general safety and essential performance) and its collateral standards, such as IEC 60601-1-2 (EMC). 
 - Working knowledge of IEC 62304 (software lifecycle for medical devices) - directly relevant given this role's ownership of firmware architecture, not just electrical/PCB design. 
 - Understanding of ISO 13485 (quality management systems) and ISO 14971 (risk management) and how they shape hardware design decisions. 
 - Exposure to IEC 61010 (safety for lab/test equipment) and other bench-testing standards where relevant to the product line. 
 - Familiarity with how compliance testing (EMC/EMI, electrical safety, environmental, biocompatibility) is planned and executed with test labs and certification bodies. 
 - Working knowledge of the regulatory pathways Dozee operates under: FDA 510(k), CE MDR, and CDSCO, and how hardware documentation feeds into these submissions. 

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Qualifications

- Experience with contactless or wearable vital-signs monitoring hardware (PPG, ECG, or similar sensing modalities). 
 - Prior experience scaling a hardware / firmware team in a startup or fast-growing company. 
 - Experience with RTOS-based or bare-metal firmware architectures (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or similar) for battery-powered, connected medical/IoT devices. 
 - Hands-on experience with PCB design tools (Altium, Cadence, or similar) and EMI/EMC troubleshooting. 
 - Exposure to connected/IoT device architectures (BLE, Wi-Fi, cellular) and cloud-connected fleets. 

Vision & Mission

Save Million lives with Health AI

Dozee is India's leading AI-Powered contactless Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) and Early Warning System (EWS). A solution that continuously monitors patients and provides early warnings of clinical deterioration, enabling timely interventions and enhancing patient safety in hospitals, nursing facilities and patient homes. A "Made in India for the World" solution, Dozee has pioneered the world's first non-contact blood pressure monitoring system. Trusted by leading healthcare providers in India, the USA, and Africa, Dozee is transforming patient safety and care by enhancing outcomes and reducing costs. 

Dozee is adopted by 300+ hospitals and monitors 16000+ beds across 4 countries . Dozee has monitored over 1 Mn Patients, Delivered 35000+ Life Saving Alerts and Saved 10 Mn+ Nursing Hours.

From AI Beds to Remote ICUs, Startups are plugging India's health Gaps

data.description:
AI Engineering Manager - Agentic AI & Solution Delivery

Location: Remote

Department: Data Science & AI Innovation

Employment Type: Full-time

Recommended Experience: 7+ years of relevant experience in AI engineering, backend development, or software engineering, including 2+ years leading technical teams and project delivery. 

Role Overview

We are looking for a hands-on AI Engineering Manager to lead the design, development, and delivery of enterprise AI solutions, with a strong focus on Google Agent Development Kit (ADK), agentic applications, and automated business workflows. 

The role combines technical execution, people management, and delivery ownership. You will translate business requirements into solution designs and actionable project plans, organize work into achievable sprints, guide engineers through implementation, and drive solutions through testing, deployment, and production adoption. 

You will remain actively involved in architecture, coding, code reviews, and technical troubleshooting while managing team capacity, sprint execution, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own End-to-End AI Solution DeliveryTranslate business problems into clearly defined use cases, technical scope, and measurable acceptance criteria. Lead solution discovery, feasibility assessment, implementation, user acceptance testing, and production rollout. Make practical trade-offs between business value, technical complexity, delivery timelines, and operating cost. 

- Provide Hands-On Engineering and System Design LeadershipDesign modular services and APIs using Python and FastAPI, and contribute production code to critical components. Lead architecture discussions, review implementations, and resolve complex technical blockers. Guide decisions around service boundaries, data models, asynchronous processing, background jobs, caching, scalability, and failure recovery. 

- Lead ADK-Based Agents and AI Workflow DevelopmentLead the development of single-agent and multi-agent applications using Google ADK, integrating enterprise data, custom tools, and business APIs. Design workflows that combine LLM-driven tasks with deterministic processing, structured outputs, state management, and human approval checkpoints. Guide RAG, document-processing, and tool-calling implementations, choosing the simplest architecture that meets the requirement. 

- Manage Project Planning, Capacity, and Sprint PlansBreak initiatives into epics, user stories, and engineer-owned tasks with clear estimates, dependencies, and acceptance criteria. Maintain two-week sprint plans and multi-sprint delivery forecasts, accounting for team capacity, skill availability, leave, and production support. Coordinate AI, backend, frontend, and platform work so that each sprint advances a usable business capability. 

- Drive Scrum Execution and Delivery DisciplineLead or facilitate backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives in collaboration with product and delivery stakeholders. Maintain clear sprint goals, remove blockers, and manage scope changes without overcommitting the team. Use Jira, Notion, or equivalent tools to keep ownership, progress, dependencies, and delivery risks visible, and turn retrospective findings into concrete improvements. 

- Lead, Coach, and Develop the Engineering TeamManage and mentor AI engineers, providing regular feedback, technical coaching, and development support. Delegate meaningful ownership while remaining available for hands-on problem-solving. Support hiring, onboarding, performance reviews, and knowledge sharing, and establish consistent expectations for code quality, documentation, collaboration, and accountability. 

- Own Engineering Quality, DevOps, and Production ReadinessEstablish practical standards for automated testing, AI evaluation, code reviews, and release readiness. Guide Docker-based deployments, CI/CD pipelines, environment configuration, secrets management, monitoring, and rollback procedures with platform teams. Ensure solutions include appropriate access controls, validation, auditability, and human review, and investigate production issues across application code, model behavior, integrations, and infrastructure. 

- Align Stakeholders and Demonstrate OutcomesWork closely with business owners, product managers, security, and infrastructure teams to align priorities and resolve dependencies. Communicate delivery forecasts, risks, trade-offs, and decisions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Track both engineering performance and business outcomes, including workflow quality, reliability, adoption, turnaround time, and cost. 

Required Qualifications and Skills

Experience and Leadership

- 7+ years of relevant engineering experience, including hands-on delivery of production AI or LLM applications, with 2+ years leading technical teams and delivery. The experience requirement applies to overall engineering experience, not years using ADK. 
 - Demonstrated ability to manage multiple workstreams, build realistic project and sprint plans, allocate resources, and take solutions from requirements through production. 
 - Experience mentoring engineers, conducting code and design reviews, managing delivery risks, and communicating with business stakeholders. 

Technical and Delivery Capabilities

- Hands-on software engineeringStrong Python, FastAPI, asynchronous programming, API integration, structured validation, testing, and production debugging. 

- ADK and agentic workflowsPractical experience with Google ADK, custom tools, agent orchestration, session and state management, context handling, and human-in-the-loop workflows. 

- LLM application developmentExperience with RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt and context engineering, function calling, structured outputs, and AI evaluation. 

- System designAbility to design maintainable AI services and explain trade-offs involving reliability, scalability, security, latency, and cost. 

- Cloud and DevOpsWorking proficiency with Docker, Git, CI/CD, Linux fundamentals, secrets management, monitoring, and cloud deployment, preferably on GCP. 

- Project and Scrum managementBacklog decomposition, estimation, capacity planning, sprint goals, acceptance criteria, dependency tracking, and delivery forecasting using Jira, Notion, or similar tools. 

- People and stakeholder managementCoaching, delegation, performance feedback, cross-functional coordination, and clear communication of technical decisions and delivery risks. 

Preferred Skills

- Familiarity with Vertex AI, Cloud Run, Cloud Storage, BigQuery, and MongoDB Atlas or comparable cloud and data services. 
 - Exposure to ADK, LangGraph, MCP-based tool integrations, A2A interoperability, and enterprise document-processing workflows. 
 - Experience with infrastructure as code, AI observability, security reviews, or regulated enterprise environments. Agile or Scrum certification is beneficial but not a substitute for demonstrated delivery experience. 

What Success Looks Like

- Predictable delivery: The team works against clear sprint goals and realistic forecasts, with dependencies and risks addressed early. 
 - Strong engineering: Solutions are maintainable, evaluated, secure, observable, and ready for production-not limited to demonstrations. 
 - Effective team ownership: Engineers understand their priorities, receive timely technical guidance, and grow in capability and independence. 
 - Measurable business value: Delivered AI workflows are adopted and demonstrate improvements in quality, turnaround time, or operational efficiency. 

The ideal candidate can design the solution, contribute to the code, plan the sprint, develop the team, and remain accountable for the outcome.

data.description:
Overview

AI at Cvent: Leading the Future

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we're committed to continuous learning and adaptation-AI isn't just a tool for us, it's part of our DNA. We're looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you'll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation Throughout our interview process, you'll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you're excited to be part of a team that's leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we'd love to meet you. 

Disclaimer: Beware of Recruitment Scams - Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will always come from an official 'name@cvent. com' email. We never request any payments or ask for sensitive personal or financial information via chat or social media platforms. For more information, please visit: https: //www. cvent. com/en/notice-recruitment-fraud

THE OPPORTUNITY

The Analytics team is Cvent's internal intelligence engine - the function that powers how the business understands performance, serves commercial teams, and accelerates decision making with data and AI. Within this organization, the AI Engineering & Data Science team designs and deploys production grade AI and ML solutions with a primary mandate across commercial and growth teams - Sales, Marketing, Revenue, Growth teams and others. 

This role is designed for an experienced practitioner ready to step into a leadership position alongside the Head of Data Science & AI. As Manager, you will own delivery, people, and technical standards while remaining a hands-on contributor who can architect and build alongside your team. You are not being hired to manage from a distance - you are being hired to raise the floor and the ceiling of what the team can do. 

The right person for this role brings commercial instinct alongside technical depth. You understand how commercial teams operate, can translate sales and marketing problems into AI solutions, and know how to take work reliably from prototype to production. You are also a developer of people: you build individual capability, hold high standards, and create an environment where engineers grow. 

In This Role, You Will

AI & Data Science Function

- Partner with the Head of Data Science & AI to run the team - owning delivery execution, team health, stakeholder relationships, and technical direction on a day-to-day basis. 
 - Serve as the senior technical expert and partner with Architects to set architectural direction, lead design reviews, and make build-vs-buy decisions that shape how solutions are structured and scaled. 
 - Represent the team in cross-functional forums - with commercial and technical teams translating AI capability nto business language and AI business needs into engineering scope. 

Own End-to-End AI Delivery

- Lead delivery across the full AI and ML lifecycle - from problem framing and data acquisition through model development, evaluation, deployment, and post-production monitoring. 
 - Set and enforce engineering standards: experiment tracking, model versioning, CI/CD for ML pipelines, observability, reproducibility, and documentation. Build a culture that ships with both quality and speed. 
 - Design and implement agentic AI workflows - LLM orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), natural language querying (NLQ), multi-step reasoning pipelines, and human-in-the-loop architectures - across internal commercial and operational use cases. 
 - Own the team's AI observability posture: output quality monitoring, drift detection, evaluation frameworks, and feedback loops that keep production systems reliable, explainable, and auditable. 

Drive AI Use Cases

- Partner closely with cross functional stakeholders to identify, prioritize, and deliver AI solutions that improve pipeline quality, conversion rates, and revenue predictability. 
 - Lead development of Sales and Marketing AI applications - lead scoring, next best action, intent signal modelling, account health prediction, churn early warning, and conversational analytics. 
 - Translate commercial problems into well-scoped AI initiatives with defined success metrics, baseline comparisons, and measurable business outcomes. Own the narrative when presenting to commercial teams' leadership. 
 - Proactively surface new AI use cases with business partners - qualify opportunities by strategic impact and technical feasibility and build the internal case before pursuing them. 

Build and Develop the Team

- Directly manage a team of data scientists and AI engineers - owning hiring, onboarding, performance management, and individual development plans. 
 - Run structured 1: 1s focused on technical growth and career progression. Maintain a skills matrix and design development plans that close capability gaps systematically. 
 - Foster a high-performance delivery culture: rigorous code review, clear working rhythms, cross-functional stakeholder accountability, and a bias toward shipping working solutions over perfect prototypes. 

Shape AI Platform and Architecture

- Work with Data Engineering and the Head of Data Science & AI to evolve the team's tooling stack - model registry, feature pipelines, LLM orchestration layer (LangChain, LangSmith, or equivalent), and evaluation infrastructure. 
 - Contribute to Snowflake as Cvent's enterprise intelligence layer - ensuring ML feature pipelines, semantic layers, and AI workloads are architected for reliability, reuse, and long- term auditability. 
 - Embed responsible AI practices into delivery: privacy assessments, governance reviews, and alignment with Cvent's AI usage policies throughout the build lifecycle. 

Experience

Here's What You Need: 

- 10-13+ years in data science or AI/ML engineering, with a minimum of 2 years in a people management or formal technical lead role with clear delivery ownership. 
 - Demonstrated track record delivering AI and ML solutions for commercial team - lead scoring, churn prediction, intent modelling, revenue forecasting, NLQ, or comparable commercial applications - in a SaaS or B2B environment. 
 - Experience working with Salesforce, Marketo, or equivalent GTM platforms as primary data sources. Familiarity with how commercial data flows from CRM to analytics is essential. 

Technical Depth

- Strong AI engineering fundamentals: LLM application development, RAG and NLQ architectures, agentic frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or equivalent), prompt engineering, and model evaluation at production scale. 
 - Hands- on ML expertise across the full lifecycle: feature engineering, model training and selection, A/B and champion-challenger testing, deployment, monitoring, and drift management in production. 
 - Proficiency in Python and SQL. Hands-on experience with Databricks (MLflow, Delta Lake, Jobs) and Snowflake (Cortex, ML functions, feature pipelines) as the core delivery stack.

Head of Engineering - Full Stack & Applied AI

Founding Team | Airawath | India

Location: India, preferably Hyderabad or Bangalore

Role Type: Full-time | Founding Team

Company: Airawath

Website: https: //www. airawath. com

Airawath is building an AI-native consumer platform at the intersection of events, gifting, vendor marketplace, fintech-style workflows, relationship intelligence, and personalized recommendations. 

We are hiring a Head of Engineering - Full Stack & Applied AI to join our founding team and lead the technical execution of Airawath's product vision. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can architect, build, scale, and lead high-quality engineering execution across web, mobile, AI, marketplace, payments, graphics, and intelligent automation systems. 

This is not a traditional engineering manager role. We are looking for a builder-leader who can code, architect, hire, mentor, review, and ship fast. 

What You Will Own

- Lead end-to-end engineering for Airawath's web, mobile, backend, AI, marketplace, and automation systems. 

- Architect and scale a high-quality consumer platform using Python, Next. js, Flutter, and AWS. 

- Build and manage engineering systems for invitations, gifting, RSVP workflows, vendor marketplace, user profiles, payments, recommendations, and intelligent event workflows. 

- Build and scale AI recommendation systems, especially around gifting, vendors, user preferences, relationships, events, and personalized experiences. 

- Design and implement agentic AI systems that can execute end-to-end business workflows, automate decision pipelines, and improve user experience. 

- Lead engineering execution across B2C, B2B2C, marketplace, fintech-style, and social/community product flows. 

- Drive architecture decisions around APIs, databases, cloud infrastructure, security, performance, observability, analytics, and scalability. 

- Work closely with the Founder on product strategy, technical roadmap, AI roadmap, hiring, execution priorities, and company-building. 

- Build and mentor a high-performing engineering team in India. 

- Establish engineering standards, code quality, sprint discipline, architecture reviews, release processes, and production monitoring. 

- Move fast without compromising product quality, reliability, security, or user experience. 

Must-Have Background

We are looking for someone who has built and scaled real products, not just managed teams. 

The ideal candidate should have strong domain expertise in at least two of the following areas: 

- E-commerce / Vendor Marketplace

- Fintech / Payments / Wallets / Transactional Systems

- Social Media / Community / Consumer Engagement Applications

- Consumer Mobile or Web Platforms

- AI-powered personalization or recommendation platforms

Required Experience

- Prior engineering leadership experience in a high-growth startup, unicorn-level startup, or FAANG-style product company. 

- Proven ability to deliver products fast while building scalable architecture. 

- Hands-on experience leading full-stack product engineering teams. 

- Strong experience with consumer applications, marketplace systems, or high-scale transactional platforms. 

- Ability to work in a fast-moving, ambiguous, early-stage startup environment. 

- Strong product thinking, not just technical execution. 

- Prior experience building or leading engineering for platforms with real users, real transactions, and real production scale. 

- Strong ability to hire, mentor, and manage engineers while still staying close to the code and architecture. 

Core Technology Stack

Experience with our current or similar stack is strongly preferred: 

- Python

- Next. js / React

- Flutter

- AWS

- REST APIs / Microservices / Event-driven systems

- PostgreSQL / MySQL / MongoDB / Redis or similar

- CI/CD, cloud deployment, monitoring, logging, and production support

Applied AI Requirements

AI is central to Airawath. We are looking for someone with serious, hands-on applied AI capability. 

You should have experience or strong practical understanding of: 

- AI recommendation systems

- Personalization engines

- RAG pipelines

- LLM-based product workflows

- Agentic AI systems

- AI workflow orchestration

- Embeddings and vector databases

- Semantic search

- Prompt engineering and structured outputs

- AI evaluation, guardrails, cost optimization, and latency management

- Using OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Hugging Face, LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or similar tools

- Applying AI to real product experiences, not just demos or prototypes

This role requires someone who understands how to use state-of-the-art AI providers and frameworks to build production-grade AI features. 

Advanced Technical Areas

Strong plus if you have exposure to: 

- WebGPU

- Three. js

- 3D / interactive graphics

- Creative automation

- AI-generated design or visual experiences

- Real-time applications

- Recommendation ranking and reranking

- Marketplace search and discovery

- Payment workflows

- Vendor onboarding and marketplace operations

- Secure user data and privacy-first architecture

What We Are Looking For

You may be a strong fit if you are: 

- A hands-on engineering leader who still loves building. 

- Someone who has worked in a high-performance product engineering culture. 

- Strong in full-stack architecture, applied AI, and consumer product thinking. 

- Comfortable making technical decisions with limited information. 

- Able to convert founder vision into product architecture and execution. 

- Experienced in building platforms from 0 to 1 and scaling from 1 to 10. 

- Deeply interested in AI-native product development. 

- Obsessed with quality, speed, reliability, and user experience. 

- Capable of building a strong engineering culture from the ground up. 

Not a Fit If

This role may not be the right fit if: 

- You are looking only for a people-management role. 

- You have not built production products hands-on. 

- Your AI experience is limited to using ChatGPT or basic prompt writing. 

- You have not worked in fast-paced product environments. 

- You prefer large-company structure over early-stage ambiguity. 

- You cannot operate with high ownership and urgency. 

- You have only service/project delivery experience without product ownership. 

Why Join Airawath

- Join the founding team of an AI-native consumer platform. 

- Build across events, gifting, marketplace, fintech-style workflows, personalization, and social/community experiences. 

- Own the engineering foundation from the early stage. 

- Work directly with the Founder. 

- Build and lead a high-quality India engineering team. 

- Opportunity to shape product, architecture, AI strategy, and engineering culture from day one. 

How to Apply

Please send your resume, LinkedIn profile, GitHub/portfolio if available, and a brief note on products you have built or scaled. 

📩 Email: sarath@analyticera. io

🌐 Airawath: https: //www. airawath. com

👤 Founder: Sarath Chalamcharla

https: //www. linkedin. com/in/sarathchalamcharla/

AI at Cvent: Leading the Future

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we're committed to continuous learning and adaptation-AI isn't just a tool for us, it's part of our DNA. We're looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you'll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation. 

Throughout our interview process, you'll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you're excited to be part of a team that's leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we'd love to meet you. 

Disclaimer: Beware of Recruitment Scams - Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will always come from an official 'name@cvent. com' email. We never request any payments or ask for sensitive personal or financial information via chat or social media platforms. For more information, please visit: https: //www. cvent. com/en/notice-recruitment-fraud. 

About the Role: 

Cvent's AI Engineering & Data Science function is the engine that translates data into production intelligence - commercial models, agentic workflows, NLQ interfaces, and AI systems operating at scale across a B+ global SaaS business. We are hiring a Director to own it. 

This is an enterprise leadership role with a dual mandate: operational excellence and strategic thought leadership. You own the corporate AI portfolio end-to-end - delivery, architecture governance, cross-functional stakeholder relationships, and long-term direction. You lead the AI Centre of Excellence, shaping how Cvent thinks about, builds, and governs AI as a business-critical capability. 

The right person is a decisive, dynamic leader with 15+ years in AI and data science - operationally rigorous enough to run a complex multi-workstream function, and commercially credible enough to influence C-suite and board-level conversations. As comfortable in a strategy session as in an architecture review. 

In This Role, you will: 

Operations & Enterprise-Grade Delivery

- Run a multi-workstream AI and data science function with the discipline a $B+ enterprise demands - predictable delivery, zero stakeholder surprises, quality as the baseline. 
 - Bring deep domain expertise to GTM projects and corporate use cases across Sales, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Customer Success, Finance, and Tech/IT - ensuring AI/ML solutions are designed with the business context they will operate in, not just the data available. 
 - Partner actively with business leaders and function heads to shape the future AI agenda - co-developing roadmaps, surfacing high-leverage opportunities, and ensuring the team's work is connected to Cvent's most important growth and operational priorities. 
 - Own the operating model: delivery cadences, capacity management, cross-functional dependencies, intake and prioritization, and executive reporting. 
 - Set and enforce engineering standards across the portfolio: experiment tracking, model versioning, ML CI/CD, observability, and documentation - across internal teams and external partners. 

Corporate AI Portfolio Ownership

- Own Cvent's enterprise AI portfolio - spanning commercial AI, marketing intelligence, operational automation, financial governance, and agentic systems - accountable for roadmap, delivery, and measurable business outcomes. 
 - Set AI investment priorities at the corporate level: allocate capacity, sequence initiatives by strategic value, and make explicit trade-offs across competing demands in partnership with senior leadership. 
 - Govern the AI technology stac k: model registry, orchestration layer, observability infrastructure, and data contracts. All production systems meet enterprise-grade standards for reliability, explainability, and auditability. 

AI Centre of Excellence - Charter, Paved Road & Core Capability

- Define and evolve the AI CoE charter - establishing its mandate as an enterprise capability function focused on continuously improving the team's core AI and data science capabilities, strengthening data strategy, and raising the security posture of all AI systems in production. 
 - Define the paved road for AI - reusable patterns, approved tooling, and delivery standards that enable teams to build with speed and confidence while maintaining a reach-oriented posture: scanning the external AI landscape and updating guidance before the business asks for it. 
 - Translate the CoE's work into executive narratives for C-suite and board - connecting capability investment to business value and help position Cvent as an AI-native enterprise. 

People Leadership & Organizational Development

- Lead a team of Data scientists, and AI engineers - owning hiring, performance management, career architecture, and succession planning at Director level. 
 - Set a high-performance standard and hold it. Develop strong leaders within the team. Address under performance directly, constructively, and decisively. 
 - Build institutional resilience: reduce key-person dependency through structured knowledge transfer, role design, and a talent pipeline that scales with Cvent's AI ambitions. 

Executive Stakeholder Leadership

- Serve as Cvent's senior AI voice across Marketing, Sales, RevOps, CS, Product, Finance, and Technology - owning the relationship between AI capability and business demand at the most senior level. 
 - Engage C-suite and business function heads as a strategic partner: presenting portfolio outcomes, advising on competitive AI strategy, and translating the function's work into language that drives decisions. 
 - Communicate proactively on strategy, delivery status, risks, and results. Credibility is built on consistency of delivery and sharpness of insight. 

Here's What You Need: 

Experience

- 15+ years in AI/ML engineering, data science, or enterprise analytics - with a sustained Director-level track record owning large-scale, multi-workstream AI portfolios. 
 - Demonstrated experience building or leading an AI Centre of Excellence or enterprise-wide AI capability in a complex, global B2B or SaaS environment. 
 - Proven ability to engage C-suite and board-level stakeholders on AI strategy and investment - with the executive presence to influence without authority. 
 - Deep experience delivering commercial AI across GTM and corporate functions at enterprise scale: NLQ, personalization, propensity modelling, intelligent automation, and production-grade AI systems. 

Technical Depth

- Authoritative in LLM architecture, RAG/NLQ design, ML lifecycle governance, and enterprise AI observability. Engages as a peer with principal engineers on design decisions and platform trade-offs. 
 - Strong command of Snowflake, Databricks, and Python-based AI engineering. Understands how data architecture and security choices shape the reliability and scalability of AI systems downstream. 

Leadership Profile

- Operationally exceptional: runs complex, multi-team functions with clarity, discipline, and predictability at enterprise scale. 
 - Executive communicator: translates AI complexity into business value for C-suite audiences and business strategy into engineering direction for technical teams. Crisp, direct, proactive. 
 - Dynamic and high-conviction: shapes the agenda rather than responds to it, decides with incomplete information, holds the organization to a high standard of both ambition and execution. 
 - Reach-oriented thought leader: monitors the external AI landscape continuously, forms a point of view fast, and brings it into the organization before the business asks for it. 

What Success Looks Like (12-24 MONTHS)

- Enterprise-grade AI delivery across GTM and corporate functions - commercially impactful, architecturally sound, and trusted by senior leadership as a strategic asset. 
 - A CoE with a defined charter, a living paved road, and a team with measurably stronger core capabilities, data strategy maturity, and AI security posture. 
 - C-suite and business function heads who engage this Director proactively on AI strategy - treating the function as a competitive differentiator, not a support service. 
 - A high-performing organization with leadership depth, reduced key-person risk, and a talent pipeline ready to scale.

data.title: Automation Engineer
data.description:
Company Description ACME Switchgears is a specialized manufacturer focused on high-quality cable products, PCB relays, and related electrical components used in industrial and commercial applications. The company is committed to reliable engineering and consistent product performance that meets the needs of modern electrical and automation systems. ACME Switchgears emphasizes quality control and continuous improvement in its manufacturing processes. The organization offers opportunities for engineering professionals to work with robust technologies and contribute to efficient, safe electrical solutions. 

Role Description The Automation Engineer role at ACME Switchgears is a full-time, on-site position based in Chennai. This role involves designing, implementing, and optimizing automation solutions for manufacturing lines and test systems, ensuring stable and efficient production processes. The Automation Engineer will configure and maintain control systems, PLCs, and robotics equipment, monitor process performance, and address issues affecting productivity, safety, or quality. Daily responsibilities include diagnosing and resolving automation and electrical problems, coordinating with production and maintenance teams, documenting changes, and supporting continuous improvement initiatives. The role also requires collaboration with cross-functional stakeholders to upgrade existing systems, integrate new technologies, and ensure compliance with relevant standards and procedures. 

Qualifications

- Candidates should possess strong Automation and Process Control skills, including experience with PLCs, SCADA, or similar control platforms. 
 - Candidates should possess Electrical Engineering knowledge, with the ability to read and interpret electrical schematics and apply safe electrical practices. 
 - Candidates should possess Troubleshooting abilities for automation, electrical, and control system issues in a manufacturing environment. 
 - Candidates should possess Robotics-related skills, such as programming, configuring, and maintaining robotic equipment used in production or testing. 
 - Relevant skills such as familiarity with industrial safety standards, instrumentation, and basic networking for control systems are beneficial. 
 - A bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Mechatronics, or a related field is preferred, along with prior experience in industrial automation. 
 - Strong analytical thinking, clear communication, and the ability to work collaboratively on-site with multidisciplinary teams are expected.
