data.title: Principal DevOps Engineer (PeopleFluent)
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Principal DevOps Engineer (PeopleFluent) based in India. 

This is a senior infrastructure leadership role focused on designing, automating, and operating hybrid environments across on-premises data centers and AWS. You will set the technical direction for compute, networking, and platform services while driving scalability, security, reliability, and cost efficiency. The role combines hands-on engineering with architectural ownership and end-to-end delivery of complex infrastructure initiatives. You will work closely with engineering and product teams to define requirements and communicate technical trade-offs. As a subject matter expert, you will contribute expertise across areas such as virtualization, cloud architecture, and observability. The position also provides opportunities to mentor engineers and shape how modern hosting infrastructure is built and operated. 

Accountabilities

The Principal DevOps Engineer will own the technical evolution, automation, reliability, and operational effectiveness of the hosting infrastructure. Key responsibilities include: 

- Own and maintain PeopleFluent hosting pipelines and infrastructure automation. 
 - Define the technical vision and architecture for hosting infrastructure across compute, networking, and platform services. 
 - Ensure infrastructure architecture supports long-term scalability, security, reliability, maintainability, and cost-effectiveness. 
 - Proactively identify opportunities to optimize infrastructure performance, capacity, reliability, and operational efficiency. 
 - Take a hands-on role in scaling, securing, and improving hybrid infrastructure environments. 
 - Design and operate infrastructure spanning on-premises data centers and AWS. 
 - Collaborate with engineering and product teams to understand requirements and translate them into robust infrastructure solutions. 
 - Evaluate technical options and clearly communicate architecture decisions, constraints, and trade-offs. 
 - Lead complex infrastructure projects from planning and design through implementation and operational adoption. 
 - Establish and maintain structured processes for infrastructure changes, releases, deployments, and configuration management. 
 - Use Git-based workflows, including branching, pull requests, and code reviews, to govern infrastructure changes. 
 - Maintain and improve monitoring and observability capabilities across infrastructure and applications. 
 - Mentor engineers and share technical expertise across hosting and infrastructure domains. 
 - Contribute to the development of scalable, reliable, secure, and cost-effective hosting solutions. 

Requirements

The role requires extensive infrastructure engineering experience, strong architectural judgment, and deep hands-on knowledge across cloud, Linux, networking, virtualization, automation, and observability. Candidates should demonstrate: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 10+ years of professional industry experience. 
 - Strong experience with Enterprise Linux, including SELinux policies, standard configurations, enforcement, and headless server administration. 
 - Strong networking fundamentals, including DHCP, subnetting, VLANs, network segmentation, and related concepts. 
 - Hands-on experience with virtualization platforms such as Proxmox and/or VMware vSphere. 
 - Experience with advanced virtualization cluster configuration, virtual switches, VLANs, and network segmentation. 
 - Experience owning and administering observability and monitoring platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Strong Git and shell scripting skills. 
 - Extensive hands-on experience with AWS services including EC2, S3, RDS, and Route 53. 
 - Experience provisioning, orchestrating, and administering infrastructure using Terraform, Ansible, and Kubernetes. 
 - Experience implementing release and deployment automation with Jenkins. 
 - Strong understanding of infrastructure-as-code and automated infrastructure management. 
 - Experience managing configuration changes through structured change-control processes. 
 - Familiarity with Git-based development and infrastructure workflows, including branching, pull requests, and code reviews. 
 - Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with a proactive, self-starting approach. 
 - Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering and product teams. 
 - Strong communication skills, particularly when explaining complex technical decisions and trade-offs. 
 - Ability to operate at both strategic architectural and hands-on engineering levels. 

Additional Experience That Would Be Valuable Includes

- Data center operations, including automated network-switch configuration. 
 - Automation of basic firewall rules and network security controls. 
 - Database administration across Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, and/or Microsoft SQL. 
 - Experience with Elasticsearch and Kafka. 
 - Experience working in Agile and Scrum environments. 
 - Background in web-based or SaaS environments. 
 - Experience working in startup or fast-paced technology environments. 

Benefits

- Full-time position. 
 - Fully remote role for candidates based in India. 
 - Senior-level ownership of hybrid infrastructure spanning on-premises data centers and AWS. 
 - Opportunity to shape the architecture and technical direction of enterprise hosting infrastructure. 
 - Hands-on exposure to AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins, virtualization, and observability technologies. 
 - Opportunity to work across compute, networking, platform services, security, scalability, and reliability. 
 - Ability to lead complex infrastructure initiatives from design through implementation. 
 - Opportunity to contribute to modern, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective hosting solutions. 
 - Collaboration with engineering and product teams in a technically driven environment. 
 - Opportunity to mentor other engineers and develop subject matter expertise across infrastructure domains. 

How Jobgether Works

Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. 

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

data.title: Informatica L1 Support Manager
data.description:
9+ years of overall experience in IT support, application support, production support, service desk, or IT service management. Proven experience managing L1 support teams or service-desk operations. Strong knowledge of ITSM and ITIL practices. Hands-on experience with incident, service request, problem, change, and knowledge management. Strong experience in ticket queue management, prioritization, SLA monitoring, and escalation management. Experience with ServiceNow, BMC Remedy, Jira Service Management, HPSM, or a similar ITSM platform. Good understanding of application-support models and L1/L2/L3 escalation processes. Experience handling critical incidents and coordinating with multiple technical and business teams. Strong knowledge of service-desk metrics and operational reporting. Ability to analyze ticket trends and identify opportunities for service and process improvements. Experience managing shift-based or 24/7 support operations. Strong leadership, team-management, coaching, and conflict-resolution skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong customer orientation and stakeholder-management capabilities. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, business-critical support environment. L1 support typically handles initial troubleshooting, service restoration, customer information, and escalation to higher support tiers when required. A support manager oversees analysts or team leads and executes the operational and tactical plans of the support function. Technical and Operational Knowledge ITSM ticketing and workflow management ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM tools SLA, KPI, OLA, and escalation management Incident, problem, change, and request-management processes Major-incident coordination Knowledge management and shift handover Operational reporting and service reviews Application and infrastructure monitoring concepts Windows and Linux fundamentals Basic networking concepts, including DNS, TCP/IP and VPN SQL fundamentals for application or data-related troubleshooting Monitoring tools such as Splunk, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, SolarWinds, Nagios, or equivalent Microsoft Office and reporting tools Automation and self-service concepts Internal support requirements also reference incident management, problem management, RCA, application support, SQL, observability tools such as Dynatrace and Splunk, and coordination across cloud, DevOps, and database environments. 

Manage the day-to-day operations of the L1 support or service-desk team. Lead, mentor, and guide support analysts and team leads to ensure consistent service delivery. Oversee incident intake, ticket categorization, prioritization, assignment, troubleshooting, resolution, and closure. Ensure incidents and service requests are handled within agreed SLA and operational targets. Monitor support queues, ticket backlogs, ageing incidents, reopened tickets, and escalation trends. Establish clear escalation criteria and coordinate unresolved issues with L2, L3, infrastructure, development, vendor, and business teams. Act as the primary escalation point for high-priority incidents and customer-impacting issues. Coordinate major-incident communication, bridge calls, stakeholder updates, and service-restoration activities. Ensure L1 analysts follow approved troubleshooting guides, standard operating procedures, and knowledge articles. Review ticket quality, resolution notes, categorization accuracy, and adherence to support processes. Manage shift rosters, workload distribution, resource allocation, leave planning, and operational coverage. Conduct daily operational reviews, shift handovers, backlog reviews, and service-performance meetings. Track support metrics and prepare weekly and monthly service reports for stakeholders. Identify recurring issues and coordinate problem management and root-cause analysis with relevant technical teams. Drive knowledge-management initiatives to improve first-contact resolution and reduce unnecessary escalations. Identify opportunities for automation, self-service, chatbot adoption, and process standardization. Support change implementations, release activities, outage communication, and post-deployment monitoring. Maintain operational documentation, escalation matrices, support calendars, SOPs, knowledge-base articles, and service reports. Manage stakeholder expectations and provide timely updates on incidents, risks, service performance, and improvement actions. Drive continuous service improvement initiatives to enhance service quality, customer experience, and operational efficiency. These responsibilities align with an internally surfaced Application Support Lead requirement emphasizing support-team management, ServiceNow queue operations, SLA monitoring, incident/problem/change management, stakeholder communication, reporting, and continuous improvement. 

ITIL Foundation or higher certification. ServiceNow certification or strong hands-on platform experience. Experience working with global customers and distributed support teams. Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. Understanding of DevOps, CI/CD, SRE, and observability practices. Experience with support automation, AI-assisted ticket triage, or chatbot solutions. Exposure to Agile delivery or project-management practices. Experience managing vendor-supported applications. data.title: キャリア採用 - ソフトウェアエンジニア（テクニカルマネージャー候補）
data.description:
ユーザーに寄り添ったプロダクト開発を牽引するテクニカルマネージャーを募集

Description

当社は、デジタル領域全般においてパートナーのビジネス課題を解決するソリューション企業です。 特にスマホアプリに軸足を置き、事業開発、デザイン、システム開発・運用、データ分析といった上流から下流まで幅広いソリューションを提供しています。 2025年7月24日に東証グロース市場へ上場を果たし、さらなる事業拡大フェーズに突入しました。今後の成長を共に推進いただける方をお迎えしたいと考えています。 当社におけるテクニカルマネージャーとは、プロジェクトの開発責任者として、プロジェクトマネージャーと協力して主に技術面でプロジェクトを牽引する役割です。 当ポジションでは、テクニカルマネージャーとしてプロジェクトの進捗管理やシステムのアーキテクチャ設計、技術的な意思決定に加え、社内外の調整をお任せします。 プロジェクトにおいては顧客へのシステム開発の提案・要件定義フェーズから携わり、システム全体の方式決定や設計・開発フェーズにおける開発チームの牽引をしていただきます。併せて、大規模案件を円滑に推進するための「組織の仕組み化」へのコミットも期待します。 入社後はご自身の強みや専門性に合わせ、「サーバーサイド」「フロントエンド」「Android」「iOS」等のエンジニアチームに所属いただきます。 【具体的な業務内容】 ■ テクニカルマネージャーとしての業務 各担当プロジェクトにおける以下の業務 ・提案フェーズの要件定義、工数見積 ・企画・要件定義フェーズにおける要望の実現可能性の判断、開発コストの概算、代替案の検討、ユーザー体験 ・設計フェーズにおける技術面での判断、意思決定 ・PMと協力したプロジェクト全体の進捗管理 ・社内外含む関係者との技術面に関するコミュニケーション ・エンジニアのタスクマネジメント ・システム開発におけるリスク管理、品質管理 ・若手メンバーの育成、メンタリング ■ 各チーム所属エンジニアとしての業務 ・プロジェクトにおける担当職種のリードエンジニア業務 ・プロダクトの設計、開発、リリース後の継続的なサービスデリバリ ・安定性およびパフォーマンスを重視した品質改善 ・大規模なアーキテクチャ変更を含む、継続的なコードベースの改善 ・各プロジェクト内の技術標準やルールの検討 ・各プロジェクト内の課題解決 ・各プロジェクトにおける技術戦略の立案 ※変更の範囲: 会社の定める業務(本人と協議のうえ)

Requirements

・開発チームのリード、タスクマネジメントの経験 ・複数のプロダクトのリード経験 ・品質、コスト、納期等に関する社内外の関係者との折衝経験 ・システムのアーキテクチャ設計や技術的な意思決定の経験 ・AWSを使用したシステム構成への理解 ・アプリやWebの開発における知識・経験

Preferred Experiences

・セキュリティに関する知識 ・プロジェクトマネージャーとしての勤務経験 ・プロジェクトマネージャー、システムアーキテクトなどの高度情報処理技術者資格 ・PMBOKなどのプロジェクトマネジメントに関する知識 ・顧客の要望と技術的な実現性を考慮した、仕様策定および顧客折衝の経験 ・リレーショナルデータベースのテーブル設計や運用経験 ・AI活用に関する実践的な知識 ・システム開発におけるリスク管理・品質管理の経験

We are looking for

私たちはスマホアプリのプロフェッショナル集団として、ユーザーにとって本当に必要なものを作り続けたいと考えています。 テクニカルマネージャーには、技術的な意思決定や進捗管理に留まらず、技術とビジネスを高いレベルで両立させ、プロジェクトを成功へ導ける方を求めています。 技術とビジネスの架け橋として、広い視野で課題解決に尽力いただける方、プロジェクトの成功を自身の喜びと感じ、エンジニア組織を強く成長させていきたいという意欲のある方、ぜひ私たちに力を貸してください。

data.title: Lead Full Stack Engineer ID86301
data.description:
AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards. 

WHY JOIN US

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

About The Role

We are looking for a Tech Lead who balances hands-on backend development with team leadership. This role combines Java and Spring Boot engineering with Angular frontend work, guiding a transition toward domain-driven design and clean RESTful API architecture. You will mentor junior developers, uphold strong engineering standards, and help the squad execute with consistency. 

What You Will Do

- Act as the Squad Lead, driving the team to execute on deliverables while maintaining high engineering standards. 
 - Spend a significant portion of your time designing and implementing robust backend services using Java and Spring Boot. 
 - Build and maintain the supporting Angular frontend, ensuring a seamless connection between the UI and your backend logic. 
 - Lead the transition from traditional database-centric designs toward a domain-driven structure (DDD), ensuring strong domain bounded contexts. 
 - Architect RESTful APIs that prioritize proper HTTP verbs and clean, scalable patterns over legacy RPC styles. 
 - Utilize a strong understanding of agile and software development practices to motivate the team, engage junior developers, mentor them, and help them grow. 
 - Demonstrate the ability to confidently push back and say 'no' to power (be it AI or human) when advocating for best practices and architectural integrity. 

MUST HAVES

- Proven experience as a Tech Lead or Squad Lead , with a track record of motivating teams and mentoring junior developers. 
 - Advanced proficiency in Java (Spring Boot) and a solid working knowledge of Angular , with at least 6 years of experience . 
 - Hands-on experience with Kafka . 
 - A strong grasp of Object-Oriented Analysis and Design (OOA/OOD) , software design patterns, and architectural pattern awareness. 
 - Deep understanding and practical experience with strong domain bounded contexts . 
 - Deep experience building and consuming RESTful services with a clear understanding of standard API protocols. 
 - Experience working with relational databases ( PostgreSQL, Oracle ) and JPA/Hibernate . 
 - A passion for server-side logic, performance, and architecture, coupled with good engineering practices. 
 - Upper-intermediate English level. 

NICE TO HAVES

- Experience working with spec-driven development or related (AI-Driven Software Development Life Cycle). 
 - Previous experience in the Loyalty or Fintech sectors. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms (AWS or Azure) and containerization (Docker). 
 - Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI). 
 - Experience refactoring legacy structures into modern, domain-driven architectures. 

Perks And Benefits

- Remote work & local connection: Work where you feel most productive and connect with your team in periodic meet-ups.

data.title: Mgr, Software Development
data.description:
This is where your work makes a difference. 

At Baxter, we believe every person-regardless of who they are or where they are from-deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond. 

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results. 

Here, you will find more than just a job-you will find purpose and pride. 

Job Summary

We are seeking a Development and Test Manager with 12+ years of experience leading software development, verification, and quality engineering for connected healthcare and regulated medical software. The manager will provide technical and people leadership across the complete product lifecycle-from requirements, architecture, design, and implementation through functional, automation, performance, reliability, and release-readiness testing. This role owns delivery of cloud-native applications, REST and GraphQL APIs, user interfaces, microservices, medical-device integrations, and EMR/EHR workflows within agreed quality, schedule, and budget commitments. The role combines engineering leadership, development and test governance, technical direction, stakeholder management, design-control compliance, and audit-ready delivery. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Define and continuously improve the integrated software development and test strategy in alignment with product roadmaps, business priorities, regulatory commitments, architecture direction, and release plans. 
 - Lead software developers, automation engineers, performance engineers, and functional verification engineers; manage capacity, hiring, onboarding, objectives, coaching, technical development, succession planning, and delivery accountability. 
 - Plan and lead engineering assignments involving the evaluation, selection, and adaptation of software designs, technologies, development methods, test approaches, tools, and engineering practices. 
 - Provide technical direction from product conception through requirements, architecture, detailed design, implementation, integration, verification, release, and sustaining activities. 
 - Establish software engineering governance covering estimation, design and code reviews, coding standards, branching and configuration management, unit and component testing, static analysis, code coverage, technical debt, defect management, and quality metrics. 
 - Ensure software architecture and implementation meet requirements for maintainability, security, scalability, performance, reliability, interoperability, observability, and supportability. 
 - Own delivery of cloud-native applications, microservices, REST and GraphQL APIs, web user interfaces, integration services, and data processing capabilities using appropriate C#/. NET and related technologies. 
 - Establish test governance, risk-based planning, entry and exit criteria, requirements traceability, defect management, quality dashboards, and release-readiness assessments. 
 - Own the roadmap and governance for reusable C#-based REST API and UI automation frameworks, including coding standards, test-data management, parallel execution, logging, reporting, and environment configuration. 
 - Ensure unit, component, integration, smoke, regression, performance, scalability, reliability, security, and release-level testing is incorporated into CI/CD pipelines with appropriate automated quality gates. 
 - Guide design, development, integration, and verification of HL7 ADT, FHIR resources, clinical workflows, EMR/EHR interfaces, connected medical devices, real-time communications, notifications, and downstream clinical systems. 
 - Implement configuration and change management throughout the complete product lifecycle, including design, development, verification, release, and sustaining phases. 
 - Partner with product, clinical, systems, architecture, DevOps, cybersecurity, quality, regulatory, service, manufacturing, and external integration teams to resolve dependencies, technical issues, and product risks. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis by correlating application behavior, source code, automated and performance results, logs, API traces, network data, database records, queues, container metrics, and infrastructure telemetry. 
 - Incorporate field issues, customer feedback, post-market learnings, and production trends into product design improvements, corrective actions, regression coverage, reliability testing, and performance validation. 
 - Ensure compliance with the product development process, design controls, Quality System requirements, software lifecycle procedures, cybersecurity expectations, and applicable regulatory standards. 
 - Maintain audit-ready requirements, architecture and design records, code and review evidence, plans, test cases, objective evidence, reports, approvals, and traceability in approved tools such as Jira, Jama, source-control platforms, and validated test-management systems. 
 - Develop project plans, engineering milestones, resource strategies, budgets, and delivery forecasts; identify and mitigate issues that could affect quality, cost, scope, or schedule. 
 - Manage external development partners, contractors, vendors, and third-party service providers, including technical direction, deliverable acceptance, and performance monitoring. 
 - Communicate development progress, quality status, technical risks, mitigation plans, resource needs, architecture decisions, test findings, and go/no-go recommendations to program and leadership forums. 

What You'll Bring

- 12-18 years of software engineering, software development, testing, verification, quality engineering, or performance engineering experience, including at least 5 years leading multidisciplinary technical teams in a regulated or safety-critical environment. 
 - B. E/B. Tech in Computer Science / Electronics & Communication / Electrical or related field 
 - Demonstrated experience managing the complete software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, architecture, design, implementation, code review, unit testing, integration, verification, release, and sustaining engineering. 
 - Strong hands-on or technical leadership experience with C#/. NET, object-oriented design, design patterns, REST and GraphQL APIs, microservices, web applications, and distributed systems. 
 - Demonstrated ownership of functional and automation test strategy for REST APIs, web user interfaces, integration workflows, and end-to-end regression using Playwright, Selenium, NUnit, xUnit, MSTest, or comparable technologies. 
 - Experience with software architecture and engineering practices such as clean architecture, secure coding, static analysis, code quality, code coverage, configuration management, branching strategies, dependency management, and technical-debt reduction. 
 - Experience validating distributed microservices, event-driven systems, JSON/XML, SQL/PostgreSQL, authentication, authorization, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, MQTT, or comparable technologies. 
 - Working knowledge of Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, autoscaling, service discovery, role-based access control, secrets management, service mesh, resilience, and cloud observability. 
 - Experience with CI/CD architecture, Git, build automation, automated quality gates, pipeline troubleshooting, artifact management, deployment practices, test reporting, and engineering dashboards. 
 - Healthcare domain expertise covering HL7 v2, ADT messages and acknowledgements, FHIR REST resources, EMR/EHR workflows, connected medical devices, data integrity, patient safety, privacy, and clinical risk. 
 - Knowledge of regulated healthcare software practices and standards such as IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, design controls, cybersecurity expectations, and formal verification evidence. 
 - Ability to manage complex projects and engineering programs within boundaries of quality, time, scope, and budget while balancing development and verification priorities. 
 - Strong people leadership, stakeholder influencing, conflict resolution, planning, prioritization, vendor coordination, risk management, and executive communication skills. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience with SIP, RTP, WebSocket, WebRTC, audio/video communication, Kamailio, FreeSWITCH, RTPEngine, or comparable real-time communication technologies. 
 - Experience with Grafana, Prometheus, Application Insights, APM platforms, centralized logging, packet analysis, database diagnostics, and automated performance-threshold evaluation. 
 - Knowledge of Azure Key Vault, Azure App Configuration, Redis, Web PubSub, Terraform, KEDA, infrastructure-as-code, service virtualization, and container security. 
 - Experience supporting regulatory audits, formal submissions, post-market investigations, and enterprise-scale healthcare product releases. 
 - Familiarity with IEC 62304, ISO 13485, risk management, cybersecurity expectations, and quality systems for regulated healthcare software. 
 - Experience with Jira, Jama, validated toolchains, Agile/Scrum delivery, and formal release-readiness reviews. 
 - C#, Azure, Kubernetes, performance testing, healthcare interoperability, PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent certification is advantageous. 

Equal Employment Opportunity

Baxter is an equal opportunity employer. Baxter evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic. 

Reasonable Accommodations

Baxter is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities globally. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or interview process, please click on the link here and let us know the nature of your request along with your contact information. 

Recruitment Fraud Notice

Baxter has discovered incidents of employment scams, where fraudulent parties pose as Baxter employees, recruiters, or other agents, and engage with online job seekers in an attempt to steal personal and/or financial information. To learn how you can protect yourself, review our Recruitment Fraud Notice.

data.title: Assistant Manager / Manager – Quality Control (QC)
data.description:
Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Assistant Manager / Manager - Quality Control to oversee daily analytical testing, instrument compliance, and quality operations across our pharmaceutical laboratories (API/Formulation). In this role, you will lead a team of QC analysts, manage chromatographic data integrity, direct laboratory investigations (OOS, OOT, CAPA), ensure pharmacopeial compliance (USP, EP, BP, IP), and represent the QC function during customer and regulatory audits. 

Key Responsibilities

- Laboratory Operations & Release: Direct daily QC testing workflows to ensure the timely testing, review, approval, and analytical batch release of raw materials, intermediates, and finished products. 
 - Data Review & Audit Trails: Oversee electronic chromatographic data systems (Empower, Chromeleon, LabSolutions, OpenLab), conducting thorough data reviews, audit trail assessments, and user access management to maintain strict 21 CFR Part 11 / data integrity compliance. 
 - Laboratory Investigations: Spearhead root-cause investigations for Out of Specification (OOS), Out of Trend (OOT), laboratory incidents, and deviations; formulate and track robust Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA). 
 - Method Validation & Transfer: Guide and review analytical method validation (AMV), verification, method transfers, and long-term stability study protocols and execution. 
 - Equipment Qualification & Calibration: Supervise laboratory compliance programs, including instrument qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ), routine calibration, preventive maintenance, and chemical reference standard management. 
 - Audit & Inspection Readiness: Face and support customer audits, internal laboratory audits, and regulatory inspections, ensuring prompt closure of audit observations. 
 - Team Leadership & cGLP Training: Mentor, manage, and upskill laboratory chemists on cGLP practices, advanced analytical techniques, and regulatory compliance standards. 

Qualifications & Requirements

- Education: M. Sc. (Chemistry), M. Pharm, or B. Pharm in a relevant scientific discipline. 
 - Experience: Minimum 8-10 years of hands-on experience in pharmaceutical Quality Control laboratories handling API and/or Formulation products. 
 - Analytical Expertise: Deep practical knowledge of analytical techniques, including HPLC, GC, UV, FTIR, ICP-MS, Dissolution testing, and Wet Chemistry. 
 - Chromatography Data Systems (CDS): Proven experience managing and reviewing data in systems such as Empower, Chromeleon, LabSolutions, or OpenLab, including audit trail reviews, user management, and data integrity enforcement. 
 - Investigations & CAPA: Proven expertise in leading laboratory failure investigations (OOS, OOT), deviations, and implementing effective CAPAs. 
 - Methodology & Stability: Solid background in analytical method validation (AMV), method transfer, method verification, and ICH stability studies. 
 - Regulatory & Pharmacopeia Standards: In-depth familiarity with pharmacopeial requirements (USP, EP, BP, IP), cGMP/cGLP guidelines, and global regulatory inspection expectations. 
 - Audits & Compliance: Proven track record of successfully handling client quality audits, internal assessments, and regulatory agency inspections. 
 - Leadership: Strong team management and operational capabilities to drive timely laboratory testing, report approvals, and data release. 

Application Process

1

Submit Application

Complete the application form below with your details and CV

2

Initial Screening

Our HR team will review your application and contact suitable candidates

3

Technical Interview

Selected candidates will have a technical interview with the department head

4

Final Discussion

Final round with senior leadership team and offer discussion

data.title: Innovapptive ngineering Manager - AI Infrastructure
data.description:
Role : Engineering Manager - AI

Location : Hyderabad, India

Employment Type : Full-Time; Salaried

Compensation : Base Salary, Bonus, Stock Options, Medical

About Innovapptive

Innovapptive is an enterprise SaaS company building an AI-powered Connected Worker Platform for industrial organizations. Our platform connects frontline workers, back-office systems, and assets in real-time to drive safety, reliability, and operational productivity. 

Leading global enterprises including Shell, Hess, Westlake Chemical, Kimberly-Clark, Scott Miracle-Gro, and Newmont Mining, rely on Innovapptive to transform how work gets done across plants and field operations. 

Our customers have achieved $50M+ EBITDA savings at a single enterprise, 10x improvement in frontline productivity, and 15 - 20% reductions in maintenance costs. 

Innovapptive is recognized as a Leader in Frost & Sullivan's "Frost Radar 2025 - Augmented Connected Worker Platforms", with acknowledgments from Gartner and LNS Research, and is backed by Vista Equity Partners and Tiger Global Management. 

With headquarters in Houston and an engineering center in Hyderabad, we have 300+ employees across the U. S. , India, and ANZ and are on a strong trajectory toward $100M ARR. 

The Role

Innovapptive's Connected Worker Platform is expanding its AI capability from foundational features into a broad portfolio of product-facing AI agents purpose-built for industrial field operations. These agents span maintenance planning, work order automation, safety compliance, operator rounds, and knowledge assistance, all grounded in customer-specific asset data and SOPs. 

This role leads the AI Engineering team responsible for designing, building, and operating that agent portfolio in production. You own the full lifecycle : from architecture and prompt engineering through evaluation, deployment, and reliability. You work closely with Product, Platform, and customer-facing teams to translate industrial use cases into AI capabilities that enterprise customers trust. 

What You Own

- AI Engineering team across agent development, LLM infrastructure, and model evaluation. 
 - End-to-end agent lifecycle : requirements through architecture, build, evaluation, deployment, and production monitoring. 
 - RAG and knowledge infrastructure : document ingestion pipelines, chunking strategies, embedding, vector search, and knowledge graph grounding. 
 - LLM governance : model selection, prompt versioning, bias testing, audit logs, and human-in-the-loop controls. All inference within Innovapptive's AWS VPC - no data to external LLM endpoints. 
 - Agent quality : evaluation frameworks, accuracy benchmarks, hallucination monitoring, and output labelling pipelines. 
 - Sprint delivery and production reliability. Weekly quality scorecard. 
 - Hiring, performance management, and coaching. 

You Must Have

- 7+ years in software engineering with 3+ years managing teams delivering AI/ML or LLM-powered products in enterprise production. 
 - Hands-on experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, or equivalent) and multi-step agentic workflows. 
 - Strong grasp of RAG architecture : document pipelines, chunking, embedding, vector databases, re-ranking, and similarity thresholds. 
 - Experience with managed inference infrastructure : AWS Bedrock, SageMaker, or equivalent. 
 - Track record shipping AI product features on schedule in a SaaS context - not just prototypes or internal tools. 
 - Familiarity with AI observability : prompt tracing, hallucination detection, and output evaluation (Langfuse, Ragas, or equivalent). 
 - Data-driven : model evaluation scores, accuracy/recall metrics, agent success rates, and DORA metrics for the team. 
 - Strong engineering standards : prompt discipline, eval-driven development, responsible AI controls, and production-grade reliability. 

Nice To Have

- Knowledge graph architectures (AWS Neptune, Neo4j) for grounding agent outputs in structured asset data. 
 - Industrial domain knowledge : EAM, ERP integrations (SAP, Maximo), maintenance workflows, or field operations. 
 - Multi-agent orchestration patterns : tool calling, agent-to-agent delegation, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints. 
 - Vision models or multimodal AI : image-based defect detection, document OCR, or form digitisation. 
 - MLOps and LLMOps : model versioning, A/B evaluation, and continuous prompt optimisation pipelines. 
 - Cloud cost optimisation for LLM workloads : token budgets, model tiering, and caching strategies. 
 - MongoDB and change stream-based event architectures. 

Tech Stack & Tools

- AI / ML : AWS Bedrock, SageMaker, LiteLLM, LangGraph, Milvus (vector DB), AWS Neptune (knowledge graph), Langfuse
 - Backend : Node. js / TypeScript, Python, MongoDB
 - Infrastructure : AWS, Docker, GitLab CI/CD
 - Observability : Langfuse, Sentry, CloudWatch
 - Tools : GitLab, Jira, SonarQube

What We Offer

- Competitive compensation and equity tied to measurable impact on AI accuracy and performance. 
 - A platform to shape the semantic intelligence layer of a category-defining industrial SaaS company. 
 - Access to cutting-edge AI, data, and observability toolchains for continuous learning and innovation. 
 - Innovapptive does not accept and will not review unsolicited resumes from search firms.

data.title: Engineer / Sr. Engineer / Assistant Manager
data.description:
Job Description

Position Title: Engineer / Sr. Engineer / Assistant Manager

Department: Production

Industry: Automotive Component Manufacturing & EV - Wire Harness / Sheet Metal / Welded & Molded Parts

Experience Required: 8-10 years of experience in automotive parts manufacturing, with proven expertise in Wire Harness and Electrical Component production. 

Educational Qualification: Diploma / B. E. / B. Tech in Mechanical, Electrical, or Electronics Engineering. 

Reporting To: DGM - Production

Location: Udaipur, Rajasthan

OBJECTIVE OF THE ROLE

To lead and manage the production function for wire and cable harness manufacturing operations, ensuring products meet ISO and customer quality standards, driving continuous improvement, line balancing, lean manufacturing, Low cost automation, fixture concept, Poke-yoke, Kaizen, localization initiatives, and effective troubleshooting of process and product quality issues across all manufacturing stages. 

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Production System

- Lead and manage the production function and teams across wire harness manufacturing lines. 
 - Develop, implement, and maintain the production system in compliance with ISO. 
 - Drive internal audits, management reviews, and CAPA (Corrective & Preventive Action) closures for quality non-conformities. 
 - Collaborate with Plant Head or seniors and cross-functional teams to align production target with plant and business goals. 
 - Champion Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, 5S, and Total Quality Management (TQM) initiatives. 

Wire Harness Production

- Ensure production of wire harness sub-assemblies, assemblies, connectors, and terminals as per customer and engineering specifications. 
 - Drive Line Balancing on wire harness assembly lines to optimize manpower and machine utilization, cycle time, and throughput while maintaining quality standards. 
 - Lead troubleshooting of process, machine, and product quality issues on the shop floor, including crimping, splicing, molding, and continuity/functional testing. 
 - Drive localization of wire harness components, connectors, and raw materials, ensuring supplier qualification, PPAP approval, and quality validation of localized parts. 
 - Conduct root cause analysis (5-Why, Fishbone, 8D) for in-house rejections, customer complaints, and field returns, and implement effective countermeasures. 
 - Ensure SPC application critical/special characteristics as required by the customer. 

Supplier & Customer Quality

- Manage supplier quality assessments, QMS audits, and supplier rating for wire harness components and raw materials. 
 - Production ramp-up through scientifically method. 
 - Address customer complaints and quality escalations, ensuring root cause identification, corrective action, and PPM reduction. 
 - Maintain strong customer relationships to ensure sustained quality satisfaction and reduced return PPM. 

Documentation, Reporting & Team Development

- Ensure accurate and updated quality documentation as per ISO requirements (control plans, PFMEA, work instructions, inspection standards). 
 - Prepare and present production performance reports, KPIs, and improvement trends to senior management. 
 - Train, mentor, and develop the production team including engineers and line inspectors on quality procedures, troubleshooting techniques, and best practices. 

Key Skills & Competencies

- Strong technical knowledge of Wire Harness manufacturing processes (crimping, splicing, molding, testing). 
 - Hands-on experience in Line Balancing and manpower/process optimization on assembly lines. 
 - Proven skills in Troubleshooting of process, product, and machine-related quality issues. 
 - Experience driving Localization of components and supplier development for import substitution. 
 - Sound knowledge of ISO, FMEA, SPC, MSA, 7 QC Tools, 8D Problem Solving. 
 - Strong leadership, team management, and cross-functional collaboration skills. 
 - Proficiency in MS Office, SAP, ERP systems, and quality reporting tools. 

Qualification & Experience

- Diploma / Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Electronics Engineering. 
 - 8-10 years of relevant experience in automotive component manufacturing, with significant exposure to wire harness or electrical/electronic parts quality. 
 - Prior experience in automotive sector Tier-1 organization is mandatory.

data.title: Lead Software Engineer
data.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

Lead Software Engineer

Job Overview: Leads software engineering projects and creates the development and delivery of enhanced software solutions. Researches alternative technical solutions for changing business needs. Responsible for assuring the daily activities of the team meet the requirements of SLA's. Major Accountabilities: 

- Successfully lead major projects and complex assignments with broad scope and long-term business implications. Create solutions with high level of innovation, cost effectiveness, high quality and faster time to market. Lead day to day system development and maintenance activities of the team to meet service level agreements (SLAs). Collaborate with business and technical partners to identify and scope the opportunities, outline potential value and ROI, identify risks, benefits and constraints. Contribute to the overall strategy and manage complex issues within functional area of expertise. 
 - Develop overall strategic technical plan and create architecture proposals based on identified solution gaps. As recognized subject matter expert, lead planning, design and implementation of technical solutions. Create solution definition and solution architecture. Assist Management in Business Case Development and Scenario Planning leading to an effective decision making process. Make presentations to the Management, Business Owners and other Stakeholders. 
 - Assist in examining commercially available and forthcoming industry technologies related to area of expertise. Research on current and upcoming technologies and application appropriate frameworks and provide recommendations to Management. Perform PoCs (Proof of Concept) and help Department in the selection of Technology. Proactively create and maintain solution and technology road maps. 
 - Partner with Project Managers in implementation of processes per the evolving needs of the team and the solutions. Create detailed cost and time estimates for implementing business solutions, define technical scope and requirements of the project and assist project manager with managing scope during the lifecycle of the project. Identify Quality methodology and define Quality Metrics for the Team. Define and Lead Quality Assurance and Quality Control processes in the department. Assist in vendor selection and RFI/RFP process. 
 - Lead Quality Assurance and Quality Control processes in the department. Ensure adequate test coverage in Unit Testing, System Testing/Integration Testing and Performance Testing. Perform Quality Inspections and Walkthroughs through out the SDLC including Requirements Review, Architecture Review, Design Review, Code Review and Security Review to ensure compliance with MasterCard standards. Co-ordinate offshore development and manage day to day activities. Support collection and reporting of project and software metrics. Actively look for opportunities to enhance standards and improve process efficiency. Mentor and guide other team members during all phases of the SDLC. 
 - Lead and guide team through all phases of the SDLC of an application. Successfully lead production incident and problem management, identification of root cause and remediation of the problems. Mentor, coach and assist project team members. Provide Brownbag sessions on new and upcoming technologies, methodologies and frameworks. Provide technical training to the team. Assist with selection of technical resources for the projects. 
 - Ensure compliance to the defined standards. Actively look for opportunities to modify and enhance standards per the needs of the department. Develop documentation templates, lead and enforce development of documentation through out the development lifecycle of the solution. 
 - Ensure compliance of Audit Requirements by proactively educating team on Compliance Requirements and Integrating Compliance Requirements in SDLC. Represent team during Compliance Audits. Education: 
 - Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Information Technology, Computer Science or Engineering or equivalent experience. Knowledge / Experience: 
 - 5 to 8 years of experience in related field, including 5 to 8 years of experience in delivering secure solutions in Financial Services Sector is preferred. 
 - Advanced knowledge and understanding of Software Engineering Concepts and Methodologies is required. 
 - Demonstrate MC Core Competencies. Skills/ Abilities: 
 - Ability to be high-energy, detail-oriented, proactive and able to function under pressure in an independent environment along with a high degree of initiative and self-motivation to drive results. 
 - Strong communication skills -- both verbal and written - and strong relationship, collaboration skills and organizational skills. 
 - Ability to quickly learn and implement new technologies, frameworks and tools and support multiple concurrent activities and to interface with external / internal resources, working as a member of a matrix based diverse and geographically distributed project team. 

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

data.title: Lead/Senior SQA Analyst
data.description:
Job Description

Our Mission: 

We aim to be the leading provider of content management software and expertise, helping clients create, manage, publish, and deliver high-value content. 

About Us

Contiem, Inc. is a global provider of software and services to assist clients in creating, managing, and delivering high-value content - technical documentation, eLearning, online help, visualizations, training materials, etc. We continuously challenge the status quo and empower organizations by delivering effective content solutions and services that help clients achieve their business objectives. 

Contiem headquarters is located in Annapolis, MD, with additional locations in the US and internationally in Sutton, UK, Chennai, India, and Sydney, Australia. Our elite team of subject matter experts works closely with clients to assess, optimize, and transform their content objectives and operations. Our global team allows us to support clients in 40 countries, including many of the world's largest companies and iconic brands, from various industries such as Government, Aerospace, Publishing, Consumer Products, Healthcare, Industrial, Technology, and Financial Services. 

Position Summary

Contiem is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Lead/Senior SQA Analyst to join our team and support testing for our Web, Desktop, and mobile applications. As a Senior SQA Analyst, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and usability of our documentation tools. Your primary responsibility will be to design, execute, and maintain testing strategies and test cases to validate the functionality and performance of our software applications. 

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Quality Ownership & Technical Leadership

- Own end-to-end quality of releases through comprehensive test planning, execution, and risk assessment. 
 - Define and drive test strategies, quality standards, risk-based testing approaches, and release readiness criteria across multiple product areas. 
 - Act as a technical escalation point; mentor colleagues on test case design, automation frameworks, and QA best practices. 
 - Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Professional Services teams to influence product quality decisions. 
 - Conduct root cause analysis, track defect metrics, and drive continuous process improvements. 
 - Participate in release retrospectives, providing actionable testing insights to improve product quality. 
 - Champion quality advocacy across teams, ensuring adherence to standards and compliance requirements. 

Test Strategy & Coverage

- Analyze requirements and user stories to identify gaps, ambiguities, and risks; design targeted test plans accordingly. 
 - Execute manual and automated tests across web, Windows desktop, mobile (iOS/Android), APIs, databases, and XML content. 
 - Validate XML against schemas/DTDs (e. g. , S1000D, DITA, custom) to ensure product compliance. 
 - Perform accessibility testing (WCAG & EAA), performance testing (JMeter), functional, regression, and exploratory testing. 
 - Ensure test coverage across integration, system, and user acceptance testing phases. 

Automation & CI/CD Excellence

- Architect and optimize scalable automation frameworks like Playwright and Selenium. 
 - Implement Power Automate flows to streamline testing workflows. 
 - Integrate and maintain automation within Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines for continuous quality validation. 
 - Maintain test data management strategies to support automation and regression testing. 
 - Assist in expanding automated coverage across UI, API, workflow, and data validation layers. 
 - Develop automation approaches for XML validation, publishing verification, and content quality checks. 
 - Analyze automation effectiveness and continuously improve test coverage. 

Functional & Workflow Testing

- Design and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test strategies for enterprise content management solutions. 
 - Validate complex XML based structured authoring, review, approval, and publishing workflows. 
 - Test automated workflows, including content creation, reuse, versioning, branching, localization, metadata management, and publication processes. 
 - Validate workflow orchestration across multiple integrated systems and services. 
 - Ensure content integrity throughout the content lifecycle. 

XML and Publishing Validation

- Perform validation of XML-based content processing pipelines. 
 - Verify XML structures (e. g. , DITA maps, topics, etc. ), metadata, key references, conrefs, and content reuse mechanisms. 
 - Validate XML transformations and publishing workflows. 
 - Conduct output fidelity testing by validating that rendered outputs accurately reflect source XML structure, metadata, conditional processing rules, content reuse mechanisms, and publishing business rules. 
 - Verify content accuracy across PDF, HTML, WebHelp, and other publishing formats. 
 - Troubleshoot content rendering issues and identify root causes across transformation pipelines. 

Data Layer Testing

- Test both relational and NoSQL data architectures. 
 - Validate data persistence, retrieval, indexing, and content storage processes. 
 - Perform scale and performance testing against our content databases . 
 - Develop and execute XQuery-based validation scripts to verify content integrity and business rules. 
 - Validate database indexing, search relevance, faceted search behavior, metadata retrieval, taxonomy relationships, and content discoverability across large repositories. 
 - Ensure data consistency across systems and environments. 

API and Integration Testing

- Design and execute API testing for REST, GraphML, MCP and SOAP services. 
 - Validate API and Application integrations with authoring tools, publishing engines, translation management systems, identity providers, content delivery platforms, and downstream applications. 
 - Test webhook-based integrations and event-driven workflows. 
 - Verify message processing, asynchronous workflows, and system-to-system communication. 
 - Perform end-to-end validation across integrated platforms. 
 - Ensure reliability, scalability, and fault tolerance of integration points. 

Performance and Reliability Testing

- Validate system performance under realistic content processing workloads. 
 - Test scalability of publishing pipelines and content repositories. 
 - Identify bottlenecks across application, database, and integration layers. 
 - Collaborate with engineering teams to improve system reliability and performance. 

Collaboration & Execution

- Partner closely with global developers, technical writers, product managers, and QA teams. 
 - Document results and issues in Jira with detailed repro steps, severity levels, and acceptance criteria. 
 - Support multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining sprint velocity and meeting deadlines. 
 - Contribute to cross-functional initiatives such as DevOps, release management, and quality governance. 

Experience And Skills

Mandatory Requirements & Qualifications: 

- Excellent English language (written and spoken) skills. 
 - Strong experience with enterprise XML based Component Content Management Systems (CCMS), including structured content authoring, workflow management, content reuse, localization, and publishing processes. 
 - Solid understanding of XML content architectures and structured content management. 
 - Strong understanding of XML technologies and XML-based publishing pipelines. 
 - Experience validating publishing outputs against source XML content. 
 - Hands-on experience testing XML/NoSQL database platforms, with the ability to develop and execute XQuery-based validation scripts. 
 - Experience testing modern APIs. 
 - Experience testing asynchronous, event-driven, and webhook-based workflows. 
 - Strong SQL skills and experience validating relational database systems. 
 - Expertise in Playwright (JS/TS), JMeter, Azure DevOps, and Jira. 
 - Minimum of 10 years' experience in SQA, specifically testing XML based systems. . 
 - Proven experience defining enterprise QA strategy, establishing testing standards, and driving quality initiatives across multiple teams. 
 - Demonstrated ability to influence product, engineering, and architectural decisions through quality leadership. 
 - Experience mentoring QA engineers and leading quality efforts without direct supervision. 
 - Track record of improving release quality, automation maturity, and testing efficiency at an organizational level. 
 - Deep understanding of SDLC/STLC with proven Agile/Scrum experience. 
 - Strong skills in test data creation, maintenance, and management. 
 - Ability to manage multiple projects independently in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Education: MCA / Bachelor's in Engineering (Computer Science or equivalent). 
 - Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. 

Preferred Skills & Qualifications

- Experience with Power Automate for workflow automation. 
 - Strong API and database testing expertise (REST, SOAP, SQL, MarkLogic, NoSQL). 
 - Accessibility testing knowledge (WCAG & EAA compliance). 
 - Proficiency with Git and version control systems. 
 - Experience working with structured content publishing ecosystems, including localization, translation management, or content delivery platforms.

We are present across geographies and in all key energy markets. Our mission is to accelerate the transition to green hydrogen for a carbon-neutral world. We are a recognized leader globally for large-scale decarbonized hydrogen production solutions. 

To support the development of its Hydrogen Business Line, John Cockerill Hydrogen (JC H2) is looking for a Lead Automation Engineer (m/f) to be based in Mumbai India office. 

The Lead Automation Engineer is part of the EAI team, which includes people specialized in industrial electricity, power conversion, automation, and instrumentation, located all over the world in Hydrogen team (India, China, North America). She/He will be responsible to lead the automation design of domestic and international FEED & Details engineering projects. She/He will also be part of the development team of new product for the Hydrogen Business. 

Key Result Areas

- Based on requirement, build the best automation solution in term of reliability, scalability and cost efficiency. 
 - Write the specifications, participate in technical discussions with customer and suppliers
 - Identify future solution, based on market evolution. 
 - Identify improvements and/or weaknesses. 
 - Follow-up new technologies and suppliers' development to ensure the best technical and economic solution for each of our products. 

Key Responsibilities

The Lead Automation engineer will be responsible for: 

- Read and understand the customer' specifications and establish deviation list between John Cockerill usual solution and the request. 
 - Consider local regulations and the specific requirements. 
 - Initiate the basic design (control architecture, integrated control system philosophy, etc. )
 - Define the preliminary purchase specification. 
 - Ensure boundaries of scope and interfaces with suppliers. 
 - Develop solution for PLC programming, configuration, and troubleshooting, starting with Tia Portal Siemens (from V18) to meet project requirements. 
 - Modify and enhance SCADA systems to improve functionality and performance. 
 - Integrate new features and modules into existing SCADA systems as per project specifications. 
 - Safety Compliance (ATEX): 
 - Ensure compliance with safety standards, particularly ATEX directives, in all automation projects. 
 - Implement safety measures and protocols to mitigate risks associated with hazardous environments. 
 - Understand and develop industrial network, in diverse communication protocols, such as Profibus, Profinet, Modbus, etc. 
 - Configure and troubleshoot communication networks to facilitate seamless data exchange between automation components. 
 - Develop the IO list relative to a projet; 
 - Ensure the implementation of robust cybersecurity measures to protect industrial automation systems from cyber threats. 
 - Ensure the follow-up of suppliers, including receipt of material
 - Participate to FAT and SAT related to it's studies, based on checklists for verification of product conformity
 - Engage in short-term assignments at John Cockerill Hydrogen offices, as well as international customer or supplier locations during studies. 
 - Develop engineering process and templates for the team. 
 - Interested and ensure the technological watch, be proactive in the continuous learning of Hydrogen sector
 - Following topics are key advantages. 
 - Knowledge in electrical basic design or instrumentation design
 - Experience in WinCC Unified
 - Perform drive parameter tuning to optimize the performance of motor control systems. 
 - Troubleshoot and fine-tune drive parameters to achieve desired operational outcomes. 
 - Fine-tune control algorithms and parameters to ensure precise regulation and control of industrial processes. 
 - Analyze system performance data and adjust regulation and efficiency. 
 - Conduct on-site commissioning activities, including system testing, integration, and optimization. Collaborate with project teams to ensure successful installation and deployment of automation solutions at client sites. 
Education And Experience

- You have an engineering degree B. E. (Control/Automation/Instrumentation) field, 
 - You have minimum 15-18 years' experience in process design and engineering in an industrial environment
 - Experience and knowledge in the Oil&Gas or Energy sector is an asset
 - Being proficient in process control and P&ID understanding. 
 - Knowledge of the following standards, on top of electrical ones (IEC, NEC): 
 - Functional Safety
 - Electromagnetic Compatibility
 - Explosive Atmosphere
 - API
 - You have a strong and autonomous personality, an entrepreneurial mindset and a will to win
 - You are able to prioritize and have an excellent sense of organization
 - You are able to work in a team and take responsibility on several projects in parallel. 
 - You are adaptable and at ease with evolving in a continuously growing environment. 
 - You are fluent in English and French
 - You are proficient in MS office, Teams, and SharePoint.

data.title: ERP Platform Delivery Associate Manager
data.description:
Job Description

Job Title: Senior SAP Developer (Associate Manager)

Band: 

Location: India

Expected travel: 10%

WHAT YOU WILL DO

This senior-level role is part of the Global Development Factory and serves as a technical anchor across multiple SAP functional domains, including Record to Report (RTR), Order to Cash (OTC), Procure to Pay (PTP), Plan to Manufacture (PTM), and Logistics Execution (LE). The Senior SAP Developer (Associate Manager) brings over 10 years of hands-on SAP development experience and is accountable for end-to-end technical delivery across both ECC and S/4HANA landscapes. 

Operating within an Agile POD model, drives clean-core principles, ensures integration quality, and partners closely with functional Product teams, architects, project managers, and business stakeholders. The role requires the ability to balance deep technical delivery, stakeholder communication, and continuous improvement of development practices. 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Development Leadership

- Act as a technical point of escalation for complex WRICEF objects (Workflows, Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, Forms). 
 - Collaborate with project managers, business analysts, and functional leads to understand requirements, prioritize the development backlog, and manage team capacity. 
 - Uphold Development Factory standards: reusable patterns, coding guidelines, peer review gates, and clean-core compliance. 
 - Drive continuous improvement in development throughput, defect reduction, and documentation quality. 

Multi-Domain SAP Solution Design & Development

- Design and deliver robust SAP technical solutions across the following functional domains: 
 - Record to Report (RTR): General Ledger, Asset Accounting, Controlling, intercompany, period-end close. 
 - Order to Cash (OTC): Sales Order Management, Billing, Credit Management, Customer Master, High Radius integration. 
 - Procure to Pay (PTP): Requisitioning, Purchase Orders, Goods Receipt, Invoice Verification, Accounts Payable, Ariba integration. 
 - Plan to Manufacture (PTM): Production Planning, MRP, Process Orders, Batch Management, Quality integration. 
 - Logistics Execution (LE): Warehouse Management, Shipping, Transportation, Delivery Processing. 
 - Ensure all solutions comply with SAP clean-core principles, minimizing custom code footprint and leveraging BTP/extension side-car patterns where applicable. 
 - Apply deep knowledge of SAP table structures, IDocs, BAdIs, Business Events, and enhancement frameworks. 

Integration & Customization

- Collaborate with integration architects and middleware teams (e. g. , Solace, Azure Integration Services) to ensure seamless connectivity between SAP and non-SAP systems. 
 - Design and govern API-based integrations aligned with the enterprise integration strategy. 
 - Customize SAP S/4HANA and ECC functionalities to meet specific business requirements while safeguarding upgradeability. 

Testing & Quality Assurance

- Oversee the full testing lifecycle for owned technical objects: unit testing, SIT, regression, and UAT support. 
 - Partner with QA and Test Factory teams to ensure comprehensive test coverage, early defect detection, and timely resolution. 
 - Enforce peer code review standards and validate adherence to development best practices prior to transport promotion. 

Documentation & Governance

- Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation for all WRICEF objects, integration specifications, and architectural decisions. 
 - Ensure traceability between business requirements, functional specifications, and technical designs. 
 - Support audit readiness and compliance requirements through accurate and current documentation. 

WHO YOU ARE

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (required). 
 - 10+ years of SAP development experience, with demonstrated delivery across at least three of the following: RTR, OTC, PTP, PTM, LE. 
 - Proven experience in both SAP ECC and S/4HANA environments, including greenfield and brownfield transformation projects. 

Technical Skills

- Expert-level ABAP programming including OO ABAP, ALV, SmartForms/Adobe Forms, BAPIs, BAdIs, User Exits, and enhancement spots. 
 - Strong understanding of SAP S/4HANA clean-core principles and extension model (SAP BTP, RAP, CAP). 
 - Hands-on experience with SAP integration technologies: IDocs, ALE, RFC, REST/SOAP APIs, and event-based architectures. 
 - Knowledge of SAP Fiori/UI5 development is an asset. 
 - Familiarity with CI/CD tooling, gCTS, and transport management in SAP landscapes. 
 - Experience with Ariba, High Radius, or equivalent third-party SAP-integrated platforms is a strong advantage. 

Functional & Domain Knowledge

- Deep understanding of end-to-end business processes across OTC, STP/PTP, RTR, PTM, and LE, including configuration context, table relationships, and IDoc segment structures. 
 - Ability to read and interpret functional specifications and translate them into high-quality technical designs. 
 - Consumer Products or FMCG industry experience strongly preferred. 

Soft Skills & Leadership

- Strong oral and written communication skills; able to articulate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Collaborative team player with experience working in cross-functional environments spanning technology, business, and design. 
 - High degree of initiative, problem-solving ability, and resilience in navigating complex and ambiguous delivery environments. 
 - Structured approach to planning, task prioritization, and deadline management. 

WHY US?

We're accelerating our ambition to become a best-in-class Digital leader by making data-driven investments that drive smarter business decisions. As the guardians of 200 beloved brands and the creators of innovative products, we're dedicated To Sustainably Grow by Delighting More Consumers Globally. What we build today helps bring joy to customers, consumers, and communities around the world tomorrow. Ready to build the future of food, now? Have a seat at our table and join our Digital Revolution. 

Ready to help future-proof our legacy? Join our table, and Let's Make Life Delicious!

Bengaluru - Brookfield GCC

Critical Capabilities And Qualifications

 - Strong decision-making, problem-solving, and strategic thinking capabilities.

 - Demonstrates a high degree of flexibility and adaptability while embracing changing priorities. 
 - Knowledge of Husky products, manufacturing processes, tools, standards, and technologies is an asset. 
 - Experience with Edge Computing, AI/ML applications, predictive analytics, digital twins, and Industry 4. 0 initiatives is an asset. 
 - Experience facilitating cybersecurity, safety, or technology risk assessments is an asset. 
 - Relevant cloud, cybersecurity, or industrial automation certifications are considered an asset. 

Education

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical discipline from an accredited university. 

Experience

- 10+ years of relevant engineering experience in Industrial IoT, software development, industrial automation, connected products, or digital solutions. 
 - Proven leadership experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams. 
 - Experience delivering enterprise-scale software, cloud, or Industrial IoT solutions from concept through deployment. 
 - Experience in manufacturing, automation, machinery, packaging, injection molding, or industrial technology industries is an asset. 
 - Experience managing globally distributed engineering teams and collaborating across multiple functional disciplines is an asset. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

Job Description

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design and implement automation solutions that validate system behavior across UI, APIs, and integrations. You will contribute to building a robust quality engineering ecosystem by integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and supporting continuous delivery. 

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components
 - Build automated test suites across: 
 - UI (Web/Mobile)
 - API and integration layers
 - Ensure automation solutions are maintainable, reliable, and extensible across teams

Test Strategy & Implementation

- Translate requirements into automation-ready test scenarios, test data, and validation strategies
 - Contribute to test strategy, coverage planning, and quality goals
 - Identify test gaps and proactively mitigate risks
 - Perform automation feasibility analysis to determine optimal test approach (manual vs automated)

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Execute a balanced mix of automated and manual tests aligned with sprint goals, ensuring comprehensive validation across functional, integration, and edge-case scenarios. 
 - Contribute to task breakdown, estimation, and sprint commitments
 - Proactively raise risks, blockers, and testability concerns
 - Identify, log, prioritize, and track defects through resolution lifecycle
 - Perform root cause analysis and collaborate with development teams for fixes

Manual & Functional Testing

- Design, document, and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios
 - Perform functional, exploratory, and regression testing across features
 - Validate end-to-end workflows and business scenarios
 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable, and maintainable automation code
 - Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
 - Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)
 - Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality engineering practices

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred)
 - Enable continuous testing and shift-left quality practices
 - Monitor and improve pipeline stability, execution time, and reliability
 - Validate and troubleshoot system integrations, data flows, and error handling based on defined architectural designs and interfaces

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing
 - Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
 - Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets
 - Ensure availability of stable, production-like test environments

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects across environments
 - Support maintenance and continuous improvement of automation suites
 - Analyze and reduce flaky tests and unstable scenarios

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate with developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads
 - Actively learn and adopt new tools, frameworks, and best practices
 - Contribute to team knowledge sharing and a strong quality culture

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field
 - 5+ years of experience in software testing with strong automation focus
 - Experience in designing and implementing test automation frameworks
 - Strong understanding of testing principles, SDLC, STLC, and Agile practices

Technical Skills

- Programming experience in one or more: C#, Java, Python, JavaScript, Swift
 - Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Katalon, Playwright, Cypress
 - Experience with: 
 - API testing (REST, Postman, etc. )
 - Version control (Git)
 - CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)
 - Familiarity with: 
 - Test data management
 - Test reporting and logging tools
 - Debugging and root cause analysis
 - Release Management
Assets

- Experience with: 
 - Performance testing tools (JMeter, k6)
 - Security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA)
 - Exposure to: 
 - Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
 - DevSecOps practices
 - Experience using AI-assisted tools responsibly (e. g. , GitHub Copilot)
Key Expectations

- Drive an automation-first approach (target 60-80% regression automation), while ensuring critical flows and edge cases are validated through manual testing where automation is not feasible or cost-effective. 
 - Own and evolve automation frameworks and quality engineering practices
 - Ensure high reliability, scalability, and stability of automation pipelines
 - Take accountability for quality outcomes, not just test execution
 - Ensure alignment with organizational quality, security, and compliance standards

Why Husky?

- Regulated Working Hours: Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well-being. 
 - Visible Impact: Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency.

 - Empowered Involvement: Take an active role in decision-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy. 
 - Valued Contributions: Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services. 
 - Impactful Role: Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability. 
 - Cutting-Edge Projects: Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer's business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements.
