At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner-and every person here makes that happen. You'll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. 

This position reports to: 

Business Line Manager, Digital - MOSE

__

ABB Motion, a global leader in motors and drives, is at the core of accelerating a more productive and sustainable future. We innovate and push the boundaries of technology to contribute to energy efficient, decarbonizing and circular solutions for customers, industries and societies. With our digitally enabled drives, motors and services we support our customers and partners to achieve better performance, safety and reliability. To help the world's industries outrun - leaner and cleaner, we deliver motor-driven solutions for a wide range of applications in all industrial segments. Building on over 140 years of domain expertise in electric powertrains, our more than 22, 000 employees across 100 countries learn and improve every day. go. abb/motion

Location

This role is open globally, but location is set in Europe - with a preference for Finland (Helsinki), Italy (Sesto San Giovanni), Netherlands (Rotterdam), Poland (Warsaw), Spain (Barcelona), Sweden (Vaesteras), UK (Warrington) - and India (Bangalore). The work model is hybrid . 

Key Responsibilities

In this role you will lead global product development and people leadership for a strategic portfolio of digital and IoT solutions across on-premise, edge, and cloud environments. As a senior business-minded technology leader, you will translate customer and market needs into scalable, secure, and differentiated offerings while driving digital innovation, R&D execution, and AI-enabled software development transformation. You will manage a team of product development managers spanning cloud, edge, analytics, and cybersecurity functions, ensuring strong execution and technical excellence aligned with business priorities. You bring deep software and digital solution engineering expertise, proficiency in SAFe methodologies and modern cloud architectures, knowledge of AI-enabled practices and cybersecurity fundamentals, and a proven ability to convert technology investments into competitive advantage. 

This role reports to Global Digital Business Line Manager, Motion Services. 

You will be mainly accountable for: 

- Lead end-to-end digital IoT solution engineering and technology strategy for advanced solutions aligned with business objectives and customer needs
 - Drive development and delivery of complex digital IoT solutions across hybrid cloud and edge environments with strong execution discipline and quality governance
 - Spearhead AI and agentic AI transformation across software development processes and customer-facing offerings to enhance speed, quality, and productivity
 - Lead and develop a high-performing engineering leadership team overseeing cloud, edge, analytics, and cybersecurity functions with accountability and continuous improvement
 - Own cybersecurity as a core function, embedding secure-by-design principles throughout the entire development lifecycle
 - Establish agile delivery excellence through strong governance, metrics, and quality standards while balancing innovation with operational discipline and technical debt management
 - Drive cross-functional alignment with product management, architecture, operations, and business stakeholders to translate technical capabilities into competitive market advantage
 - Foster an innovation-driven engineering culture that supports organizational scaling, talent development, capability building, and R&D transformation

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Data Engineering, or related technical field
 - Significant leadership experience in digital solution engineering, software R&D, or IoT product development with proven success managing multidisciplinary teams across software, cloud, analytics, edge, and cybersecurity domains
 - Hands-on technical expertise with Azure cloud and experience delivering complex digital products and platforms across hybrid on-premise and cloud environments
 - Demonstrated success leading AI transformation in software development processes and embedding AI capabilities into customer-facing offerings, with strong command of agile methodologies and modern engineering practices
 - Strong business acumen connecting technology decisions to customer value and commercial outcomes, combined with cybersecurity knowledge, secure development practices, and excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

What's in it for you?

We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You'll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that's tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger. Guide the future. This is where innovation accelerates, industries are reimagined, and your impact powers the world ahead. Run What Runs the World. 

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences. 

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https: //www. abb. com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

data.title: Lead Full Stack Data Engineer
data.description:
The Lead Full Stack Data Engineer owns Data products across the full lifecycle: from data ingestion and transformation through to semantic modelling, reporting, documentation, and user adoption. Working closely with commercial, operations, finance, and clinical stakeholders, the role translates complex and often ambiguous business requirements into clear, reliable, and scalable Analytics solutions built on Microsoft Fabric and Power BI. 

This position requires strong technical capability across data engineering and Analytics, a structured analytical mindset, and the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

About Role

- Design, build, and support end-to-end data products from ingestion through to reporting and analytics. 
 - Translate complex business requirements into scalable data models, semantic layers, dashboards, and actionable insights. 
 - Own delivery throughout the full lifecycle, including discovery, development, testing, deployment, and production support. 
 - Ensure data quality, integrity, reliability, and governance across all data solutions. 

Data Engineering & Platform Development

- Develop and maintain data ingestion and transformation pipelines using Microsoft Fabric. 
 - Build and manage Lakehouse and Data Warehouse solutions using modern architectural patterns. 
 - Implement scalable Bronze, Silver, and Gold data architectures to support reusable and maintainable data products. 
 - Define and enforce ETL/ELT standards, performance optimization practices, and engineering best practices. 
 - Build AI-ready datasets by ensuring data is clean, governed, well-modelled, and well-documented. 
 - Drive CI/CD adoption using GitHub, including branching strategies, automated testing, and deployment pipelines. 

Analytics & Reporting

- Design dimensional data models and star schemas optimized for analytics workloads. 
 - Build and maintain Power BI semantic models, datasets, reports, dashboards, and applications. 
 - Develop intuitive, high-performing reporting solutions using DAX and modern visualization techniques. 
 - Implement security controls including Row-Level Security (RLS) and object-level security. 
 - Continuously optimize reporting and semantic models for scalability and performance. 

Data Governance & Quality

- Apply data quality checks, validation frameworks, monitoring, and issue resolution processes. 
 - Ensure compliance with data governance, security, and regulatory standards. 
 - Maintain clear documentation covering ownership, lineage, refresh schedules, business definitions, and known limitations. 
 - Contribute reusable frameworks, templates, standards, and best practices across the Analytics function. 

Leadership & Collaboration

- Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Data Engineers. 
 - Conduct regular performance reviews, coaching conversations, and development planning. 
 - Collaborate with Architecture, Security, Governance, and Engineering teams to align on standards and delivery approaches. 
 - Participate in peer reviews of SQL, Python, DAX, data models, and reporting solutions. 
 - Foster a culture of engineering excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement. 

About You

- Proven experience (typically 5+ years) in a BI, analytics, or data engineering role delivering end-to-end Data solutions. 
 - Strong proficiency in SQL/Python for data transformation, modelling, and performance tuning. 
 - Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric components, including: 
 - Data Factory (pipelines, dataflows Gen2)
 - Lakehouse and/or Data Warehouse
 - Power BI datasets, reports, and apps
 - Strong Power BI skills, including DAX, semantic modelling, and performance optimization. 
 - Solid understanding of data warehousing and dimensional modelling concepts. 
 - Experience implementing BI security models (e. g. RLS). 
 - Familiarity with Git-based source control and CI/CD practices for BI and analytics assets. 
 - Experience working with enterprise source systems (e. g. ERP, CRM, finance systems). 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business needs into technical solutions. 
 - Clear communication skills, able to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences. 
 - Strong attention to detail, documentation, and data quality. 
 - Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional, collaborative environment. 
 - Comfortable working in regulated or compliance-driven environments. 

Education/ Qualifications

- Bachelor/Masters in a relevant field (e. g. Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering), or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Demonstrated experience working across the full Data stack, from data ingestion and modelling to reporting and user adoption.

Job Description

PE Supervisor

Pune

About Citco

Citco is a global leader in fund services, corporate governance and related asset services with staff across 80 offices worldwide. With more than $1 trillion in assets under administration, we deliver end-to-end solutions and exceptional service to meet our clients' needs. 

For more information about Citco, please visit www. citco. com

Fund Administration is Citco's core business, and our alternative asset and accounting service is one of the industry's most respected. Our continuous investment in learning and technology solutions means our people are equipped to deliver a seamless client experience. 

As a core member of our Private Equity team, you will be working with some of the industry's most accomplished professionals to deliver award-winning services for complex fund structures that our clients can depend upon. 

Your Role

- Maintaining books and records and calculating fund Net Asset Values; 
 - Reviewing and/or preparing financial statements and associated reports, including performance metrics; 
 - Reviewing and/or calculating carried interest/performance/incentive fees;

 - Coordinating and/or processing payments and other transactions; 
 - Supervising junior staff, reviewing and signing off on work performed;

 - Any other functions required as part of the business of the Company, and reporting to the Assistant Vice President. 

About You

- Bachelor's degree in Accounting

 - Minimum of 4 - 5 years' experience in accounting for the financial services sector, particularly Private Equity, Asset Management or Fund Administration. 
 - Experienced in reviewing and preparing general ledger and financial statements. 
 - Established knowledge in relation to accounting and consolidations under IFRS. 
 - Excellent communication skills and proficiency in English (both verbal and written). 
 - Motivated, bright and diligent individual who is driven to meet deadlines. 
 - A team player who is able to manage individual responsibilities. 
 - Sound judgment, problem solving and analytical skills. 
 - Proficient with Microsoft Applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint etc. ).

Our Benefits

Your wellbeing is of paramount importance to us, and central to our success. We provide a range of benefits, training and education support, and flexible working arrangements to help you achieve success in your career while balancing personal needs. Ask us about specific benefits in your location. 

We embrace diversity, prioritizing the hiring of people from diverse backgrounds. Our inclusive culture is a source of pride and strength, fostering innovation and mutual respect. 

Citco welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection.

data.title: Engineering Manager 2
data.description:
If you are looking for a challenging and exciting career in the world of technology, then look no further. Skyworks is an innovator of high performance analog semiconductors whose solutions are powering the wireless networking revolution. At Skyworks, you will find a fast-paced environment with a strong focus on global collaboration, minimal layers of management and the freedom to make meaningful contributions in a setting that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking. We are excited about the opportunity to work with you and glad you want to be part of a team of talented individuals who together can change the way the world communicates. 

Requisition ID: 77662

Description

The candidate will help staff, and lead MSB's IC Verification Team in Bengaluru with a mission of building a strong team focused on chip-level verification. This team will be a key part of our Mobile Solutions Business, which consists of highly integrated front end modules that integrate Filters, Switches, LNAs, and matching in densely packed & complex front-end modules for Cellular and WiFi applications. The team will work directly and closely with design teams in the US. 

As the Verification manager, you will be responsible for a team of engineers driving chip top level verification. You and your team will engage in frequent technical meetings and design reviews with chip leads and counterparts abroad. 

In this position, you have the opportunity to make uniquely large impact on the success of the company and will have visibility at the highest levels of the company. 

We are looking for a passion to win/contribute and ability to work in, and thrive in, a fast-paced dynamic team environment. 

Responsibilities

The candidate will report to the Engineering Director locally and have a team of Engineers reporting to them. These Engineers will have a matrix reporting structure to various teams in US leading IC design. 

Responsibilities Will Include, But Not Be Limited To

- Recruiting & Staffing: 
 - 
 - Jointly drive staffing & recruiting with HR to ensure a world-class team is brought together to execute on complex, highly critical programs. 
 - Technical Leadership: 
 - Act as the IC Verification & Technical Leader for a team focused on the verification of RFICs that are integrated into our complex front-end modules
 - Experience managing large technical teams
 - A track record of growing successful design teams
 - Ability to set & articulate clear goals and drive accountability to those 
 - Use of AI tools to improve productivity, efficiency, automation, bug-tracking and reporting
 - Communication: 
 - Drive company communications, strategy, and goals via team meetings and regular 1: 1 and reporting to chip leads and managers in the US. 
 - Travel to US will be required from time to time
Required Experience And Skills

- The candidate must have excellent written and spoken communications, sufficient to present program technical status & schedule progress to senior management. 
 - Technical requirements: 
 - Strong experience with the Cadence suite of EDA tools
 - Deep and broad expertise in functional AMS verification of RFICs including RF/Analog/Digital content
 - Develop and maintain verification plans, strategies and methodology
 - Perform functional, behavioral and regression verification
 - Collaborate with RF designers and chip leads for successful tapeout and release of products to guarantee first-pass success
 - Automate verification flows and reporting infrastructure
 - Strong debug and root-cause analysis skills
 - Circuit Analysis: 
 - Understanding of analog blocks including low bit count data converters (ADC & DAC blocks), Bandgaps, Op-Amps, Bias blocks, Charge-pumps, Temp sensor, LDO, ESD, e-fuse and other supporting cells. 
 - Knowledge of RF SOI technology including RF switch, tuning & RF LNA design. 
 - Digital Design including SPI & MIPI interface design, Decoding logic, and simple state machines. 
 - Semiconductor device and process knowledge including SOI, bulk CMOS, SiGe. 
Minimum Requirements

- BSEE; MS preferred
 - 10+ years of IC Design/Verification experience
 - 6+ years of Technical Leadership and Management experience

Skyworks is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

data.title: Principal Software Architect- High Performance Computing
data.description:
Who We Are

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world's technology. 

What We Offer

Location: 

Bangalore, IND, Chennai, IND

You'll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible-while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. 

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We're committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits. 

As a Software Engineer at Applied Materials, you'll dive deep into ground-breaking technologies-like machine learning and AI-to craft novel software solutions that solve our customers' high-value problems. Our Software Engineers are responsible for designing, prototyping, developing, and debugging software solutions for semiconductor equipment components and devices to ensure quality and functionality. You'll develop software documentation and test procedures, troubleshoot software problems, and communicate with internal customers to understand project requirements. As part of our team, you'll contribute your expertise in intricate systems, deciphering code, and anticipating software behaviors to ensure Applied remains the leader in the semiconductor and display sectors. 

Our Team

Our team is developing a high-performance computing solution for low-latency and high throughput image processing and deep-learning workload that enables our Chip Manufacturing process control equipment to offer differentiated value to our customers. 

Your Opportunity

As an architect, you will get the opportunity to grow in the field of high-performance computing, GPU compute infra, complex system design and low-level optimizations for better cost of ownership. 

Roles and Responsibility

- As a Software Architect, you will be responsible for design and implementation of robust, scalable infrastructure solutions combining diverse processors (CPUs, GPUs, FPGAs). 
 - You will analyze and partition workloads to the most appropriate compute unit, ensuring tasks like AI inference and parallel processing runs on specialized accelerators, while serial tasks run on CPUs. 
 - You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including Algo engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders, to understand requirements and translate them into architectural/software designs that meet business needs. 
 - You will be coding and developing quick prototypes to establish your design with real code and data. 
 - You will be a subject Matter expert to unblock software engineers in the HPC domain. 
 - You will be expected to profile entire cluster of nodes and each node with profilers to understand bottlenecks, optimize workflows and code and processes to improve cost of ownership. 
 - Conduct performance tuning and capacity planning, monitoring GPU metrics (e. g. , using NVIDIA DCGM) for reliability
 - Evaluate and recommend appropriate technologies and frameworks to meet project requirements. 
 - Lead the design and implementation of complex software components and systems. 
 - Ensure that software systems are scalable, reliable, and maintainable. 
 - Your primary focus will be on ensuring that the software systems are scalable, reliable, maintainable and cost effective. 

Our Ideal Candidate

Someone who is passionate about and has deep understanding and experience in design and development of cutting edge HPC systems and heterogenous computing infrastructure. He should have very good hands-on experience in parallel programming (CUDA) and AI inference infrastructure. He should be able to multi-task and switch contexts based on business needs. 

Qualifications

- 12 to 18 years of experience in implementing robust, scalable, and secure infrastructure solutions combining diverse processors (CPUs, GPUs, FPGAs)
 - Working experience of GPU inference server like Nvidia Triton. 
 - Very good knowledge C/C++, Data structure and Algorithms and complexity analysis. 
 - Experience in developing Distributed High Performance Computing software using Parallel programming frameworks like MPI, UCX etc. 
 - Experience in GPU programming using CUDA, OpenMP, OpenACC, OpenCL etc. 
 - In depth experience in Multi-threading, Thread Synchronization, Inter process communication, and distributed computing fundamentals. 
 - Experience in Inter Process communication using Shared memory and Pipes. 
 - Experience in performance profiling at application and system level (e. g. vtune, Oprofiler, perf, Nividia Nsight etc. )
 - Experience in low level code optimization techniques using Vectorization and Intrinsics, cache-aware programming, lock free data structures etc. 
 - Familiarity with microservices architecture and containerization technologies (docker/singularity) and low latency Message queues. 
 - Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration abilities. 
 - Ability to mentor and coach junior team members. 
 - Experience in Agile development methodologies. 

Additional Qualifications: 

- Experience in HPC Job-Scheduling and Cluster Management Software (SLURM, Torque, LSF etc. )
 - Good knowledge of Low-latency and high-throughput data transfer technologies (RDMA, RoCE, InfiniBand)
 - Good Knowledge of Parallel processing and DAG execution Frameworks like Intel TBB flowgraph, OpenCL/SYCL etc. 

Additional Information

Time Type: 

Full time

Employee Type: 

Assignee / Regular

Travel: 

Yes, 10% of the Time

Relocation Eligible: 

Yes

Applied Materials is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

data.description:
Overview

Senior Engineer-1 Back-End Developer | Enterprise Fulfilment

About Catalyst Brands: 

Catalyst Brands is a retail powerhouse bringing together a portfolio of iconic American brands including JCPenney, Aeropostale, Brooks Brothers, Eddie Bauer, Lucky Brand, and Nautica. With more than 60 million customers served through an extensive network of stores, e-commerce platforms, and wholesale channels, Catalyst Brands is focused on delivering exceptional customer experiences while accelerating innovation, operational excellence, and sustainable growth across its brand portfolio. 

The Data & Analytics organization is a strategic capability center that enables data-driven decision-making across Catalyst Brands. Combining expertise in reporting, analytics, business intelligence, and advanced analytical solutions, the team partners with business leaders to transform data into actionable insights that drive growth, operational excellence, and customer value. Through a collaborative analytics environment, the team supports a wide range of business functions, helping shape strategy, optimize performance, and unlock opportunities across the enterprise. 

Primary Responsibilities: 

We are looking for an experienced Back-End Senior Software Engineer to join our team. In this role, your main responsibilities will include updating existing functionality and building new features using agile best practices, leveraging various Java Frameworks such as Spring Boot, Spring Integration, Spring Data, Spring Web etc to enhance our back-end application built upon open-source technologies. Further to this you have to use Microservice Oriented Design & Cloud-Based solutions for building/enhancing features. Apart from this you have to lead mini-projects independently throughout the SDLC Life Cycle starting from Discovery/Design till Production Cut-Over.

 - Propose new ideas when there is strong business value and stay up to date on the latest technology trends and techniques. 
 - Groom Junior Resources to make them up to date with latest technology & produce defect free optimise solutions.

- Strong Java Experience (Preferably Java17 or higher). 
 - Experience building high-performant, heavy-traffic Services using Spring Boot, Spring Integration & Spark. 
 - Experience in Queue-Based Technology. Preferably Kafka. 
 - Ability to write clean, modular, reusable code (using design patterns) and experience with unit-test driven approach to development. 
 - Experience with Microservices & Cloud Framework (Preferably AWS Cloud). 
 - Experience with NoSQL Database (Preferable in Cassandra/Astra). 
 - Experience with SQL Database (Preferable in PostgreSQL). 
 - Experience with Caching Technology (Preferable in Redis/Hazelcast). 
 - Experience with Dynatrace for Issue Analysis & System Health Monitoring. 
 - Experience in using AI Driven tool for Development (Preferably Gemini, AmazonQ). 
 - Knowledge of Log tools (Splunk) and Continuous Deployment (Jenkins & GitLab) is nice to have. 
 - Work experience in Agile Scrum methodologies. 
 - Experience with Adaptive/Responsive Design Principles. 
 - Familiarity with Data Structures, Algorithms, and general Computer Science Fundamentals. 

Minimum Requirements: 

- Bachelor of Science Degree in Computer Information Systems, or equivalent work experience. 
 - 6+ Years of Experience with Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, REST, Cassandra/Astra, Redis Caching Framework Application Development. 

What We Use: 

- Java (Version 17 & Above)
 - Spring Boot
 - Spring Integration
 - Spring Data
 - Spark
 - Kafka Streaming
 - Astra/Cassandra
 - PostgreSQL
 - Redis Caching
 - Hazelcast Caching
 - Jenkins & GitLab
 - RESTful API
 - Spring Scheduler
 - Microservices Components (Feign, Zuul, Hystrix, Log Tracing, Config Service, etc)

 - Dynatrace

About Catalyst Brands: 

Catalyst Brands is a leading U. S. -based retail organization formed in 2025 through the merger of JCPenney and SPARC Group, combining multiple iconic fashion brands under one umbrella. The company manages a diversified portfolio of well-known brands including Aéropostale, Brooks Brothers, Nautica, Lucky Brand, and JCPenney. Headquartered in Plano, Texas, Catalyst Brands focuses on delivering modern retail experiences while leveraging the heritage of established global brands. With a workforce of over tens of thousands and multi-billion-dollar revenue, the organization operates at a large scale across retail, e-commerce, and supply chain domains. The company emphasizes innovation, digital transformation, and customer-centric strategies to enhance brand value and consumer engagement. Catalyst Brands is expanding its global presence, including a growing capability centre in India that supports technology, digital operations, and analytics. It aims to drive operational excellence and business growth by integrating technology, data-driven insights, and efficient retail practices.

data.title: Tech Lead, Post-Trade Platform (Java/Angular)
data.description:
About Millennium

Millennium is a global, diversified alternative investment firm, founded in 1989. Defined by evolution, innovation and focus, Millennium's mission is to deliver results for our investors. 

Our people are empowered with both independence and support: the autonomy to pursue ideas with conviction and the backing of a global network committed to collaboration, disciplined risk management and continuous learning. With opportunities to deepen expertise and accelerate development, talent at Millennium is equipped to adapt, evolve and build lasting impact over time. Discover how transformative growth accelerates impact. 

Meet the Team

Core Technology: Transactions & Data is part of Millennium's Information Technology organization. The team builds and operates platforms that capture and process the firm's trading activity after execution. Based in Bangalore, the team is developing a new cloud-native post-trade platform and applying AI to enhance software delivery and automate Operations and Middle Office processes. 

What You'll Do

- Own the end-to-end design and delivery of a defined functional area within the post-trade platform, from requirements through production support. 
 - Translate post-trade requirements from Operations, Middle Office, and Finance stakeholders into clear technical designs, delivery plans, and well-scoped work. 
 - Lead, coach, and review the work of a small development team while setting standards for code quality, testing, observability, and documentation. 
 - Design and build event-driven Java services using Spring Boot, messaging, and REST APIs, and contribute to Angular front-end development for operations users. 
 - Make and document foundational architecture decisions for a greenfield, cloud-native platform running on Kubernetes in AWS. 
 - Identify and deliver AI-enabled automation for operational processes, including exception triage, break investigation, reconciliation matching, and processing unstructured confirmations, with appropriate controls and human oversight. 
 - Embed effective AI-assisted development practices and establish guardrails for reviewing, testing, and maintaining AI-generated code. 
 - Partner with architecture, data, infrastructure, security, control functions, and global colleagues to deliver reliable platform capabilities. 

What You Bring

- Hands-on experience building financial-services systems across the post-trade lifecycle, including trade capture and enrichment, allocation, confirmation and affirmation, clearing, settlement, reconciliation, lifecycle events, and exception management. 
 - Strong understanding of the trade, position, cash, and reference data that support post-trade workflows, along with the associated operational controls. 
 - Lead-level Java expertise, including Java 17 or later, Spring, Spring Boot, microservice design, event-driven architectures, messaging platforms such as Kafka, RESTful APIs, relational databases, and SQL. 
 - Working experience with Angular and TypeScript, with the ability to build, review, and guide front-end development. 
 - Strong engineering discipline across automated testing, CI/CD, code review, observability, resilience, auditability, and data integrity. 
 - Practical, critical use of AI coding assistants and an understanding of LLM-based techniques-including retrieval-augmented generation, agents, document extraction, and classification-for post-trade and Middle Office use cases. 
 - Awareness of AI-related accuracy, explainability, auditability, data-privacy, and human-review requirements. 
 - Proven experience leading a small team to deliver against agreed scope and timelines, with strong communication skills, sound judgment, and comfort operating in a greenfield environment.

data.title: Lead Platform Engineer, Manager
data.description:

data.title: Director Engineering, Security
data.description:
We are looking for a hands-on Director Engineering, Security to build and lead the engineering organization responsible for our next generation of Network and AI security products. 

You will be expected to operate at both the strategic and technical levels - defining architecture and engineering roadmap while remaining close enough to the code and infrastructure to drive critical technical decisions and managing/mentoring the team. 

You will lead the development of security products spanning DLP, IDPS/IPS, Anti-Virus/Anti-Malware, Threat Detection, Traffic Inspection, Policy Enforcement, and AI security. You will also help define how our platform protects against emerging threats related to AI Traffic. 

The ideal candidate has strong software engineering fundamentals, deep networking and security expertise, experience building, shipping and supporting products/services, and a proven ability to build high-performing engineering teams in a fast-paced environment. 

What You Will Own

- Own product delivery through the complete lifecycle - requirements, architecture, development, testing, release, deployment, monitoring, customer adoption, and production support for enterprise-grade network security solutions. 
 - Build, lead, and scale a high-performing software and security engineering organization. 
 - Drive development of security engines and capabilities including, but not limited: 
 - Data Loss Prevention (DLP)
 - IDS/IPS
 - Anti-Virus / Anti-Malware
 - Threat intelligence
 - Behavioral and anomaly detection
 - AI Security
 - Work closely with PM and Field teams to understand customer pain points and rapidly translate them into product capabilities. 
 - Lead the engineering strategy for securing modern AI environments, including: 
 - LLM and generative AI traffic inspection and security. 
 - Security for AI APIs, AI applications and agents
 - Detection and prevention of sensitive data being sent to AI services. 
 - DLP policies for prompts, responses, files, and contextual data. 
 - Detection of malicious or suspicious prompts and AI-related attacks. 
 - Protection against prompt injection, data leakage, malicious content, and unauthorized AI usage. 
 - Understanding emerging security threats, risks, and attack techniques and translating them into practical product capabilities. 
 - Own and continuously improve a modern, high-velocity software development process and integrate AI Tools into the CI/CD pipeline
 - Establish secure coding standards and security-focused code reviews. 
 - Partner with security research team to translate emerging threats into engineering requirements. 

Required Experience

- 15+ years of software engineering and/or security engineering experience, with significant technical leadership experience. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading and scaling software engineering teams. 
 - Strong hands-on software development background in C/C++/Golang/Rust. 
 - Experience building cybersecurity products or network security platforms and delivering complex enterprise software and/or security products in a SaaS model. 
 - Hands-on experience with multiple security technologies such as DLP, IDPS/IPS, AV/Anti-Malware, traffic inspection, threat detection, and security gateways. 
 - Good understanding of various networking protocols and technologies (TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, IPSEC, Web Proxies, Identity Management etc. )
 - Experience with high-performance networking and low-level packet processing. 
 - Strong understanding of modern software architecture and distributed systems. 
 - Experience owning the complete SDLC with modern CI/CD pipeline, automated testing, DevSecOps, and production operations. 
 - Experience hiring, mentoring, and developing engineering talent. 
 - Demonstrated experience taking products from architecture to production and ongoing customer support. 
 - Experience with AI/LLM security and/or securing enterprise AI traffic. 
 - Experience using AI coding assistants and AI development tools at scale. 
 - Experience with observability platforms and data analytics for threat detection. 
 - Startup experience, particularly in a company building a product from early architecture through scale.

data.title: Principal SOC Modeling Engineer
data.description:
The Software (CE-SW) group is responsible for developing and improving the software ecosystem around Arm's next generation architectures and systems. This means working with processors and other hardware technology not yet available to the public. You will join a team of Software Engineers who share a passion for leaving their mark on the future of computing. 

We are looking for software engineers to join the Arm Fast Models team responsible for building high-performance software models of Arm-based systems. These models enable early software development, architecture exploration, and system validation before silicon is available. Members of the modelling team transform hardware designs and specifications into high-performance software representations of hardware systems and components. 

In this role, you will develop functional models of CPUs, system IP, and complete Arm's reference platforms using C++ and SystemC, working closely with hardware and software teams across Arm. 

If you are similarly passionate about innovative technologies, then we would love to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities Include

- Develop, test, and maintain high-performance functional models of Arm system-level IP using C++ and SystemC. 
 - Build virtual platforms representing complete Arm's reference platforms to enable early firmware, OS, and application development before silicon availability. 
 - Collaborate with hardware architects and RTL designers to understand IP specifications and ensure accurate behavioral modelling. 
 - Work with open-source and software engineering teams to enable software bring-up on virtual platforms and diagnose system-level issues. 
 - Integrate multiple IP models to create scalable system-level simulations. 
 - Participate in planning and execution of development roadmaps, working with project managers and global engineering teams. 

Required Skills and Experience

- Minimum 15-20 years of proven experience. 
 - Strong C/C++ programming skills with experience in developing large-scale software systems. 
 - Experience in SoC or IP modelling using C++, SystemC, or TLM. 
 - Good understanding of computer architecture, microarchitecture, and SoC design concepts. 
 - Experience with software development practices including debugging, testing, and performance optimization. 
 - Experience using version control systems such as Git/Gerrit. 
 - Understanding of RISC-based architectures and familiarity with CPU instruction sets. 
 - Ability to work effectively independently and within distributed global teams. 
 - Strong interpersonal skills, excellent written and spoken English. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with Programmer's View (PV) modelling and SystemC TLM-2. 0 methodologies. 
 - Knowledge of Arm architecture or Arm system IP (CPU, interconnects, GIC, SMMU, etc. ). 
 - Experience building SoC virtual platforms or full-system simulators. 
 - Background in low-level software, firmware, bare-metal programming, or device drivers. 
 - Experience in supporting to large-scale multi-site software projects. 

Why Join Us

- Work on modern virtual platforms used across the Arm ecosystem. 
 - Experience with hardware validation labs and test farms. 
 - Collaborate with world-class engineers across global Arm teams. 
 - A clear path for career progression, with scope to evolve into technical leadership or management roles. 

Accommodations at Arm

At Arm, we want to build extraordinary teams. If you need an adjustment or an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email accommodations@arm. com . To note, by sending us the requested information, you consent to its use by Arm to arrange for appropriate accommodations. All accommodation or adjustment requests will be treated with confidentiality, and information concerning these requests will only be disclosed as necessary to provide the accommodation. Although this is not an exhaustive list, examples of support include breaks between interviews, having documents read aloud, or office accessibility. Please email us about anything we can do to accommodate you during the recruitment process.

Arm's approach to hybrid working is designed to create a working environment that supports both high performance and personal wellbeing. data.title: Sr. DevSecOps Engineer (Hybrid in)
data.description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it's what we show up for every day. 

Automation is the key to creating highly reliable and secure large-scale software systems. Are you someone who engineers solutions to problems rather than simply fixing the same thing over and over again? Can you protect Smartsheet against attackers?

We are looking for a Senior DevSecOps Engineer to join our global Security Operations team. In this critical role, you will be a leader in maturing our security and reliability posture by treating both as software engineering challenges. You will engineer and operate a highly reliable, scalable, and defensible production environment, directly impacting our ability to deliver a world-class service to our customers 24/7. This is a unique opportunity to blend deep expertise in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and modern Security Operations, working at the intersection of infrastructure, automation, and security to build a platform that is resilient and secure by design. 

You Will

- Engineer Secure and Resilient Infrastructure: Design, build, maintain, and improve secure, scalable, and highly available infrastructure in our multi-cloud environment (primarily AWS) using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles with tools like Terraform, Kubernetes, and Helm. 
 - Automate Proactive Security: Engineer and automate threat detection, incident response, and vulnerability management processes. You will build the tools and workflows that allow us to respond to threats at machine speed. 
 - Secure the Software Development Lifecycle: Architect and secure our CI/CD pipelines, integrating automated security tooling (SAST, DAST, SCA) to provide developers with fast, actionable feedback. 
 - Master Container Security: Manage, operate, and secure our container orchestration platform (Kubernetes), implementing best practices for container security from the registry to runtime, including knowledge of hardening requirements such as CIS Benchmarks or DISA STIG. 
 - Lead Incident Response: Act as a technical lead during security and reliability incidents, driving resolution and conducting blameless post-mortems to engineer preventative solutions. 
 - Drive Automated Compliance: Implement and automate technical controls to ensure continuous compliance with frameworks such as FedRAMP, SOC 2, and ISO 27001. 
 - Mentor and Lead: Serve as a subject matter expert for security and reliability, mentoring other engineers and championing a culture of operational excellence and security ownership across the organization. 

You Have

- 8+ years of progressive experience in technology, with at least 5 years in a hands-on senior role such as Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, or Security Engineering. 
 - A BS or MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience. 
 - Expert-level proficiency in at least one major cloud provider, preferably AWS, with deep knowledge of core infrastructure and security services. 
 - Expert-level proficiency with Infrastructure as Code, particularly Terraform. 
 - Expert-level proficiency in a scripting or programming language such as Python, Go, or Ruby, with a proven history of building automation and custom tooling. 
 - Deep experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (Kubernetes), including securing containerized environments. 
 - Proficiency with the modern security operations toolchain, including SIEM, EDR, and vulnerability scanning technologies. 
 - Experience integrating security tools (SAST, DAST, SCA) into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - A critical thinker with a proven ability to troubleshoot complex problems in high-pressure production environments. 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills and a collaborative spirit. This will include fluency in English. 

Nice to Have

- Advanced industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, OSCP, or cloud-specific security certifications. 
 - Experience with compliance frameworks like FedRAMP, ISO27001, SOC2. 

Get To Know Us

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You'll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths-because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you're doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that's magic at work. Let's build what's next, together.

data.description:
The Opportunity

As Engineering Manager -DTT (Traction Transformer) at GEC India, you will lead a multidisciplinary engineering organization delivering tender, order, product, and technology engineering services to global traction transformer factories and business units. You will translate business priorities into a clear engineering strategy, build scalable competencies and capacity, and establish robust governance for safe, compliant, high-quality, and on-time execution. Working closely with HUB engineering leaders, factories, product management, project management, supply chain, quality, and customers, you will drive standardization, digitalization, innovation, and continuous improvement while developing a strong leadership pipeline and an engaged, high-performing team. 

How You'll Make An Impact

- Define and execute the GEC India engineering strategy and capability roadmap for traction transformers in alignment with Business Unit, Global Product Group, HUB, and factory priorities. 
 - Lead engineering delivery for tenders, customer orders, design modifications, product development, value engineering, and lifecycle support, ensuring committed quality, cost, and schedule targets are achieved. 
 - Establish effective governance for project allocation, design reviews, technical risk management, escalation, change control, documentation, and engineering release processes. 
 - Ensure traction transformer designs meet contractual requirements, applicable railway and transformer standards, customer specifications, internal design rules, and safety and regulatory expectations. 
 - Own capacity and workforce planning, competency mapping, succession planning, recruitment, onboarding, and technical development for electrical, mechanical, and related engineering disciplines. 
 - Develop team and technical experts, set clear objectives, coach performance, and foster an inclusive culture of accountability, collaboration, knowledge sharing, innovation, and continuous learning. 
 - Manage resource utilization, productivity, external engineering spending, and cost recovery while balancing demand across factories, HUBs, and projects. 
 - Define and monitor KPIs for on-time delivery, first-time-right quality, engineering hours, productivity, utilization, cost performance, customer satisfaction, and competency development; implement corrective actions where required. 
 - Drive design standardization, modularization, reuse, digital engineering, automation, and deployment of common tools and processes across the traction transformer engineering network. 
 - Partner with factories and cross-functional teams to resolve complex technical issues, support root-cause analysis, capture lessons learned, and improve product quality, manufacturability, reliability, and total cost. 
 - Build trusted relationships with global stakeholders and customers, communicate priorities and risks transparently, and represent GEC India in technical and operational reviews. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, information-security requirements, and engineering guidelines. 
 - Live Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity by taking responsibility for your actions while caring for colleagues and the business. 

Your Background

- Bachelor's degree in electrical or mechanical engineering; a master's degree or formal qualification in engineering or business management is preferred. 
 - Typically, >14 years of progressive transformer engineering experience, including substantial experience in traction transformers and at least 5 years in people or functional leadership. 
 - Strong knowledge of traction transformer design, including electrical and mechanical design interfaces, dielectric and thermal performance, short-circuit withstand, losses, noise, insulation systems, cooling, materials, and manufacturing constraints. 
 - Demonstrated experience in tender engineering, order execution, design reviews, technical risk management, customer interfaces, and delivery of multiple projects in a global matrix organization. 
 - Working knowledge of applicable IEC, EN, railway, quality, and safety standards; familiarity with customer-specific and regional requirements is an advantage. 
 - Experience with engineering tools, product lifecycle management, design automation, digital workflows, and structured problem-solving methods such as Lean or Six Sigma are desirable. 
 - Proven ability to build and scale engineering teams, manage budgets and capacity, develop talent, lead change, and collaborate effectively across cultures, functions, and time zones. 
 - Strong commercial awareness, decision-making, stakeholder management, negotiation, communication, and presentation skills. 
 - Fluent spoken and written English is required; additional languages are an advantage.

Job Description

PE Supervisor

Hyderabad

About Citco

Citco is a global leader in fund services, corporate governance and related asset services with staff across 80 offices worldwide. With more than $1 trillion in assets under administration, we deliver end-to-end solutions and exceptional service to meet our clients' needs. 

For more information about Citco, please visit www. citco. com

About The Team & Business Line

Fund Administration is Citco's core business, and our alternative asset and accounting service is one of the industry's most respected. Our continuous investment in learning and technology solutions means our people are equipped to deliver a seamless client experience. 

As a core member of our Private Equity team, you will be working with some of the industry's most accomplished professionals to deliver award-winning services for complex fund structures that our clients can depend upon. 

Your Role

- Maintaining books and records and calculating fund Net Asset Values; 
 - Reviewing and/or preparing financial statements and associated reports, including performance metrics; 
 - Reviewing and/or calculating carried interest/performance/incentive fees; 
 - Reviewing and/or preparing calculations and investor allocations for capital calls, distributions and equalisations; 
 - Coordinating and/or processing payments and other transactions; 
 - Supervising junior staff, reviewing and signing off on work performed; 
 - Acting as a primary day-to-day contact with clients and other fund participants; 
 - Work closely with the Investor Relations team to respond to investor queries and to disseminate capital activity and other investor notices; 
 - Monitor Senior/Fund Accountants' progression and identify areas for training and development; 
 - Assist Assistant Vice President to coordinate team to meet recurring and ad-hoc client deliverables, including year-end process with respect to audit timelines, financial statement preparation, regulatory filings, tax services etc. 
 - Participating in projects that may be defined from time to time in connection with the continuing expansion and evolution of the business; 
 - Identifying and escalating any material issues effecting service delivery to the Assistant Vice President; 
 - Any other functions required as part of the business of the Company, and reporting to the Assistant Vice President. 

About You

- Bachelor's degree in Accounting 
 - Professional accounting qualification - CA, CPA, ACCA or similar 
 - Minimum of 4 - 5 years' experience in accounting for the financial services sector, particularly Private Equity, Asset Management or Fund Administration. 
 - Experienced in reviewing and preparing general ledger and financial statements. 
 - Established knowledge in relation to accounting and consolidations under IFRS. 
 - Excellent communication skills and proficiency in English (both verbal and written). 
 - Motivated, bright and diligent individual who is driven to meet deadlines. 
 - A team player who is able to manage individual responsibilities. 
 - Sound judgment, problem solving and analytical skills. 
 - Proficient with Microsoft Applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint etc. ). 
 - User experience with enterprise accounting system(s). 

Our Benefits

Your wellbeing is of paramount importance to us, and central to our success. We provide a range of benefits, training and education support, and flexible working arrangements to help you achieve success in your career while balancing personal needs. Ask us about specific benefits in your location. 

We embrace diversity, prioritizing the hiring of people from diverse backgrounds. Our inclusive culture is a source of pride and strength, fostering innovation and mutual respect.

data.title: Advertisers 2nd level support team leader
data.description:
Realize your potential by joining the leading performance-driven advertising company!

As a Team Lead for the Level 2 Advertiser Support team, you will be a driving force behind our Level 2 Advertiser Support team - leading, coaching, and developing a group of technical support engineers to deliver best-in-class support to our advertisers. You will balance people leadership with hands-on technical guidance, helping your team investigate and resolve complex technical issues, and providing consultation when a case needs an expert eye. 

You will act as the critical bridge between Level 1 and Level 3, coordinating with Product, Level 3 and R&D on technical issues and incidents. You will own and drive our AI initiatives and shift-left strategy, continuously raising the technical capabilities and knowledge of your team. You will also stay closely aligned with new product changes and shifts in the industry - and make sure your team is too. 

To Thrive In This Role, You'll Need

- 5+ years of experience in a leadership role, managing, coaching, and developing a team. 
 - Hands-on Performance Management experience. 
 - Relevant experience in technical support, with a strong track record of solving complex, technical issues. 
 - Experience in auditing and quality assurance (QA). 
 - Advanced knowledge of SQL, APIs, Kibana, and Grafana. 
 - Proven ability to mentor and consult engineers through complex technical investigations, and to raise the technical bar of a team. 
 - Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, with a structured approach to diagnosing issues and incidents. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English - for technical consultations, training material, and cross-functional coordination. 
 - Ability to build and maintain strong working relationships with Product, R&D, and other cross-functional teams. 
 - Experience working with Global Stakeholders. 
 - A proactive, improvement-driven mindset - comfortable driving initiatives such as shift-left and AI adoption within a support organization. 

Bonus Points If You Have

- Experience in digital marketing / ad-tech - an advantage. 

How You'll Make An Impact

- Manage and lead the Level 2 Advertiser Support team, helping and guiding engineers to solve complex technical issues. 
 - Provide hands-on technical consultation to team members on challenging cases. 
 - Act as the bridge between Level 1 to Level 2 & Level 2 to Level 3, ensuring technical issues and incidents are escalated, tracked, and resolved smoothly. 
 - Coordinate with the Product, R&D and Level 3 Support team on technical issues, bug prioritization, and incidents. 
 - Manage and lead AI initiatives within the team, driving adoption of AI tools to improve efficiency and support quality. 
 - Drive shift-left efforts, enabling issues to be resolved earlier and more efficiently at the appropriate support level. 
 - Enhance the team's knowledge base and overall technical capabilities through training, mentorship, and knowledge-sharing. 
 - Stay closely aligned and informed on new product changes and industry shifts, and ensure the team is kept up to date. 
 - Identify gaps in work methodologies, supportability, or manual work that can be improved through automation or refined processes, and work towards closing them. 
 - Analyse the data, KPIs and plan actions to improve it further. 
 - Keep the management informed about any critical ongoing incidents and any issues related to the team's performance. 

Why Taboola?

About

If you ask Taboolars what they love about working here, they'll tell you that they've been empowered to realize their full potential while growing and learning from and with smart and talented people. They'll also share more about: 

- Leadership & Growth: This is a role that mixes people leadership with advanced technical problem-solving. If you're looking to grow as a leader while staying close to hands-on technical work, then this is what you're looking for. 
 - Innovation: Drive AI initiatives and shift-left efforts while continuously raising the technical capabilities and knowledge of the team. 
 - Well-being: Enjoy comprehensive benefits, a fully stocked kitchen, and various gym partnerships. 
 - Flexibility: We offer a hybrid work environment with flexibility to support collaboration and productivity. 
 - Work with some of the biggest names: Taboola is an active company with a growing portfolio of features and collaborations, working with some of the biggest names in the business. 

Ready to realize your potential?

Taboola is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity in all forms. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and believe such an environment is critical for success. Employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. 

Learn more about #TaboolaLife on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X, YouTube, & the Taboola Life Blog. 

About Taboola

Taboola empowers businesses to grow through performance advertising technology that goes beyond search and social and delivers measurable outcomes at scale. 

Taboola works with thousands of businesses who advertise directly on Realize, Taboola's powerful ad platform, reaching approximately 600M daily active users across some of the best publishers in the world. Publishers like NBC News, Yahoo, and OEMs such as Samsung, Xiaomi and others use Taboola's technology to grow audience and revenue, enabling Realize to offer unique data, specialized algorithms, and unmatched scale.

Who we want: 

Software Architect - Surgical Planning Platform

We are seeking an experienced Software Architect to contribute to the architecture and technical strategy of next-generation clinical and surgical software products spanning the pre-operative, intra-operative, and post-operative ecosystem. 

The Software Architect will collaborate closely with Technical Leads, Principal Engineers, and Chief Architects to shape and evolve the technical vision across a portfolio of desktop applications, cloud-native platforms, surgical planning and guidance solutions, visualization technologies, mixed-reality applications, and connected healthcare services. 

In this role, the architect will provide architectural leadership, influence technology decisions, promote engineering best practices, and help define scalable, secure, and maintainable software solutions. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in modern software architectures, medical device software development, and platform engineering, while effectively partnering with product teams and fellow architecture leaders to drive consistent architectural direction across multiple product lines. 

What you will do: 

- Set Architecture Vision - Define the technology roadmap for surgical planning and connected healthcare products. 
 - Design Solutions - Own scalable architecture across desktop, cloud, APIs, data, and distributed systems. 
 - Drive Platform Strategy - Establish reusable frameworks, components, and architecture standards across products. 
 - Modernize Technology - Lead migration from legacy systems to modern cloud, microservices, container, and DevOps architectures. 
 - Ensure Regulatory Compliance - Embed medical-device safety, cybersecurity, and standards such as IEC 62304, ISO 13485, and ISO 14971. 
 - Enable Clinical Workflows - Guide architecture for medical imaging, DICOM/PACS, 3D visualization, and surgical planning. 
 - Strengthen Engineering Practices - Drive CI/CD, automation, testing, quality, security, performance, and reliability. 
 - Provide Technical Leadership - Mentor architects and engineers, influence senior stakeholders, and align global product teams. 

Key Qualifications Summary

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, or related field. 
 - 12+ years of software development experience with 5+ years in architecture or technical leadership roles. 
 - Proven experience architecting complex, scalable software products in regulated or mission-critical environments. 
 - Expert knowledge of C++, object-oriented design, software architecture patterns, and system design. 
 - Strong experience with desktop application technologies including Qt/QML, OpenGL, VTK, and ITK. 
 - Hands-on experience designing cloud-native solutions on Azure and/or AWS. 
 - Experience with microservices, REST APIs, containerization, Kubernetes, and distributed systems. 
 - Familiarity with . NET, Java, Python, and modern backend development frameworks. 
 - Experience with DevOps practices including GitLab, Jenkins, CI/CD, automated testing, and software quality engineering. 
 - Knowledge of cybersecurity, software safety, and secure development practices. 
 - Experience working within medical device development standards such as IEC 62304, ISO 13485, and ISO 14971. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Strong understanding of medical imaging, DICOM, PACS, and 3D visualization workflows. 
 - Experience defining common platforms and shared software frameworks across multiple products. 

Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

Required: 

- 10-15 years of relevant hands-on experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Statistical Modeling

 - Assist and participate in pre-sales, client pursuits and proposals 
 - Drive a human-led culture of Inclusion & Diversity by caring deeply for all team members

Preferred: 

- Should follow research papers, comprehend and innovate/present the best approaches/solutions related to DS/ML

Senior AI/ML Platform Engineer / Technical Lead (all genders)

Your Role

As a Senior AI/ML Platform Engineer and Technical Lead, you will be at the heart of building and evolving the AI/ML platform that powers intelligent capabilities across the organisation. In this role, you will lead a team of professional engineers - setting clear objectives, supporting their development, and being accountable for the quality, accuracy, and timeliness of the team's output. You will solve complex, operationally important engineering challenges by filtering and prioritising inputs from a wide range of internal and external sources, drawing on an in-depth understanding of how platform sub-functions work together. Acting as a key technical liaison across Cloud, Cybersecurity, Governance, and adjacent engineering teams, you will ensure the platform remains aligned with enterprise standards and emerging best practices. Your decisions will be guided by resource availability and organisational objectives, and you will contribute to defining team responsibilities, engineering standards, and platform governance practices that raise the quality bar across closely related teams. 

Who You Are

- 8 or more years of relevant industry experience in software or platform engineering, including at least 2 years working with large language model operations (LLMOps) in a production environment. 
 - Hands-on experience with LLM/API gateway technologies such as LiteLLM or comparable solutions, and with multi-provider integration across major cloud AI platforms including Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, and AWS Bedrock. 
 - Practical experience with cloud-native technologies on AWS and/or Azure, including container orchestration (such as ECS Fargate), secrets management, relational and non-relational databases, networking, and load balancing. 
 - Proficiency in developing production-grade backend services using Python and asynchronous programming frameworks; experience with Rust is a plus.

data.title: Software Engineer Specialist
data.description:
Location: India

Function: Engineering

Reports To: Engineering Manager

Are you. . . 

- Interested in building scalable, reliable cloud platform services that power multiple products? 
 - Passionate about hands-on software engineering, distributed systems, and solving complex technical problems? 
 - Excited to take broader technical ownership and raise the engineering bar across the team?

If so, we'd love to meet you. 

Why Esko?

Esko, part of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), is the global leader in packaging and product lifecycle solutions. More than 25, 000 customers across 140+ countries rely on Esko to design, manage, manufacture, and deliver products found on store shelves every day. Packaging for 9 out of 10 major consumer brands is managed using Esko solutions. As we enter our next phase of growth, we're making significant investments in cloud, AI, and platform engineering to build the future of product innovation. 

Our vision is to create the industry's leading AI-native Product Intelligence Platform. This modern, multi-tenant cloud platform unifies product, packaging, regulatory, quality, manufacturing, and supply chain data into a single intelligent ecosystem. By combining cloud-native architecture, intelligent automation, and AI-powered insights, we're helping global consumer goods, life sciences, and manufacturing companies innovate faster, improve compliance, reduce waste, and bring products to market with greater speed and confidence. 

About The Role

We are looking for a Software Engineer Specialist to help build and evolve the cloud foundation services that power Esko's SaaS products. 

This is a hands-on technical role focused on turning architectural direction into robust, production-ready platform capabilities. You will partner closely with Architects, bringing deep implementation expertise to technical decisions while owning the detailed design, implementation, quality, and operational readiness of complex cloud services. 

You will work on shared platform capabilities such as repository and data services, workflow, search, APIs, and other foundational services used across multiple Esko products. You will remain deeply hands-on while mentoring engineers, solving complex technical problems, and raising engineering standards across the team. 

What You Will Do

- Design, build, and evolve scalable cloud foundation services used across multiple Esko products. 
 - Own the detailed technical design and implementation of complex capabilities, from requirements through production. 
 - Remain deeply hands-on, writing high-quality code and solving complex distributed systems and engineering problems. 
 - Partner with Architects to translate architectural direction into production software, providing implementation feedback and identifying technical trade-offs. 
 - Improve the reliability, performance, observability, testability, and maintainability of platform services. 
 - Lead code reviews, technical problem-solving, root-cause analysis, and resolution of complex production issues. 
 - Drive engineering excellence through automated testing, code quality, design practices, and operational readiness. 
 - Mentor engineers through hands-on collaboration, reviews, and technical guidance. 

Required Experience

- 8+ years of professional software engineering experience building backend, cloud-native, or large-scale SaaS applications. 
 - Strong hands-on software engineering experience with Java/JVM technologies and modern backend frameworks. 
 - Strong experience designing and building REST APIs, microservices, and distributed systems. 
 - Experience translating architecture and high-level designs into detailed technical designs and production-quality implementations. 
 - Demonstrated ability to identify implementation trade-offs, challenge assumptions, and provide constructive technical feedback during design discussions. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems concepts including scalability, concurrency, consistency, availability, resiliency, and fault tolerance. 
 - Experience developing and operating scalable applications on AWS or another major cloud platform. 
 - Strong experience with relational and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL and Amazon DynamoDB, including data modeling, access patterns, transactions, indexing, and performance optimization 
 - Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, Git, and modern software delivery practices. 
 - Experience diagnosing complex production problems using logs, metrics, distributed tracing, profiling, and performance analysis. 
 - Experience mentoring engineers and influencing technical decisions through design reviews, code reviews, and sound engineering judgment. 

Preferred Experience

- Experience with Scala or other functional programming languages and functional programming concepts. 
 - Experience with Kafka, Redis, Akka, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, or similar distributed technologies. 
 - Experience building shared cloud platforms or foundation services consumed by multiple products or engineering teams. 
 - Experience modernizing legacy or large-scale distributed systems. 
 - Experience establishing or improving engineering practices within a team or across related engineering teams. 

What Success Looks Like

- Architectural direction is translated into high-quality, scalable, production-ready implementations. 
 - Cloud platform services become more reliable, performant, observable, testable, and maintainable. 
 - Complex engineering problems are resolved with strong technical judgment and effective collaboration with Architects and other engineers. 
 - Engineers around you become more effective through mentoring, code reviews, and hands-on technical guidance. 
 - Engineering standards improve through stronger code quality, automated testing, operational readiness, and disciplined implementation. 
 - You become a trusted technical leader in your area, known for strong engineering judgment, hands-on technical depth, and consistently high-quality execution. 

At Veralto, we value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve. Our associates, customers and shareholders contribute unique and different perspectives as a result of these diverse attributes. 

Unsolicited Assistance

We do not accept unsolicited assistance from any headhunters or recruitment firms for any of our job openings. All resumes or profiles submitted by search firms to any employee at any of the Veralto companies, in any form without a valid, signed search agreement in place for the specific position, approved by Talent Acquisition, will be deemed the sole property of Veralto and its companies.
