Beyond coding, you will develop, validate, and test system structures and user documentation to ensure we deliver robust, high-quality, and well-documented solutions. 

Candidates whose experience is primarily in DevOps, SRE, or cloud administration will not be considered for this position. 

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

- Architects, designs, and oversees the development of cloud software solutions for highly complex technical projects, ensuring alignment with business and technical strategies and highly decoupled microservices optimized for distributed cloud environments. 
 - Creates detailed software specifications and leads the technology roadmap process, recommending project approaches and long-term goals
 - Champions innovation and cultivates creativity among team members, fostering an environment that attracts and retains top talent
 - Leads and advises on all aspects of the software development lifecycle, prioritizing quality and continuous improvement
 - Monitors competitor products and development strategies, ensuring the organization's designs exceed industry standards
 - Develops next-generation technologies and solutions in collaboration with other engineering disciplines, anticipating and addressing client needs before the competition
 - Protects intellectual property by analyzing competitor patents and contributing to related organizational initiatives
 - Serves as a thought leader, representing the organization as a spokesperson on specialized projects and programs
 - Establishes formal networks and coordinates efforts across teams and organizational units to achieve shared objectives
 - Acts as a prime consultant and advisor for projects impacting the organization's long-term technical and business goals
 - Provides strategic mentorship to senior engineers and management, fostering knowledge sharing and technical excellence
 - Lead end-to-end development of high-performance cloud solutions, ensuring maximum reliability and system uptime. 
 - Leverage Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services to design, deploy, and continuously optimize cloud-native products. 
 - Build low-latency, real-time push notification and messaging systems for enterprise mobile devices and peripherals. 
 - Manage and tune highly scalable databases and storage layers (PostgreSQL, BigQuery, MongoDB, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage) to guarantee data integrity and performance. 

Job Requirements

- Bachelors Degree or Advanced Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related engineering discipline
 - 10+ years of relevant full stack development experience with a Bachelors Degree or 7+ years of experience with an Advanced Degree
 - Expert hands-on experience in architecture, design, full-stack development, and coding is essential. Experience limited to DevOps will not qualify for this position. 

Key Skills And Competencies

- Expertise in software architecture, system design, and scalable software solutions for enterprise-level applications
 - In-depth knowledge of multiple programming languages, advanced software development methodologies, and adopting GenAI in the Software Development Lifecycle
 - Proven ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams and drive complex, high impact projects to completion
 - Strong strategic thinking skills, with a focus on long-term technical and business goals
 - Exceptional innovation and creativity in solving complex challenges and developing novel solutions
 - Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop technical talent, fostering a culture of learning and growth
 - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with experience engaging with senior leadership and external customers
 - Familiarity with intellectual property protection, competitor analysis, and industry trends
 - Proven hands-on experience of 10+ years as a Cloud Solutions Engineer with multiple enterprise-grade solutions architected, designed, developed, and delivered. 
 - Proven hands-on experience in architecting and developing highly scalable, multi-tenanted, and real-time solutions. 
 - Proven hands-on experience with microservice architecture, design, and development. 
 - Proven hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Proven hands-on experience with real-time push notifications for mobile devices and peripherals. 
 - Extensive hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, Cloud Functions, Kubernetes Engine, and others. 
 - Expertise in designing and managing highly scalable databases such as PostgreSQL, BigQuery, and MongoDB. 
 - Excellent problem-solving skills, the ability to troubleshoot complex issues, and ability to work in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a global team environment. 
 - Strong programming skills in languages such as JavaScript and Java. 
 - Solid understanding of networking concepts, security best practices, and cloud architecture patterns. 
 - GCP Platform Deployment: Leverage Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services to design, deploy, and continuously optimize cloud-native products. 
 - Real-Time Systems: Build low-latency, real-time push notification and messaging systems for enterprise mobile devices and peripherals. 
 - Data & Database Systems: Manage and tune highly scalable databases and storage layers (PostgreSQL, BigQuery, MongoDB, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage) to guarantee data integrity and performance. 
 - Data Analytics Integration: Seamlessly integrate analytics and telemetry pipelines into cloud platforms to extract actionable system insights.

 - Leadership & Collaboration: Partner with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical specs, and mentor junior engineers to drive continuous improvement.

Position Specific Information

Benefits

We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success.

To protect candidates from falling victim to online fraudulent activity involving fake job postings and employment offers, please be aware our recruiters will always connect with you via @zebra. com email accounts. data.description:
About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success. 

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide. 

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe. 

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in. 

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it. 

About the Role: 

- Kaseya's SaaS Backup products protect M365, Google Workspace, and Salesforce data for hundreds of thousands of businesses globally. 
 - We are building the next generation of our backup storage platform - a unified, cloud agnostic system built to operate at massive scale across trillions of objects and petabytes of data. 
 - As a Staff Engineer, you will own one or more platform services end to end: design, implementation, testing, and production readiness. You work with high autonomy on well-scoped problems and are the go-to technical owner for your domain. 

What You Will Do: 

- Own the full lifecycle of a platform service - from design through production deployment and on call support
 - Build reliable, well tested backend services in Go with a strong focus on correctness and operational simplicity
 - Design and implement integrations with SaaS APIs (M365, Google Workspace, Salesforce) handling rate limits, delta sync checkpointing, and failure recovery
 - Collaborate closely with principal and senior engineers on cross service interfaces and data models
 - Write high quality code that sets the standard for the engineers around you
 - Participate in design reviews and contribute to architectural decisions within your domain

Required Skills: 

- 8-12 years of DevOps / SRE experience, with at least 3 years managing large-scale infrastructure
 - Kubernetes - cluster operations, resource management, custom controllers, multi-tenant workload isolation
 - Infrastructure as Code - Terraform or Pulumi at production scale; versioned, modular, reusable
 - CI/CD pipeline ownership - designing and maintaining pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, ArgoCD or equivalent)
 - Observability stack - metrics, logs, and traces in production (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog or equivalent); defining SLOs/SLAs, not just dashboards
 - Incident management at scale - structured on-call, alert triage, runbooks, post-mortems; experience reducing alert noise (1K+ alerts/month environment)
 - Networking fundamentals - DNS, load balancing, firewalls, VPC/overlay networks in hybrid environments
 - Security & compliance mindset - secrets management (Vault), RBAC, image scanning, audit logging; critical for a backup product handling customer data
 - Scripting proficiency - Go or Python for automation; shell scripting for ops tooling
 - Linux systems depth - performance tuning, kernel parameters, storage I/O, process management at scale

Desired Skills: 

- OpenStack operations - managing Nova, Swift, Neutron, Cinder at scale
 - Multi-cloud abstraction - managing workloads across AWS, GCP, Azure and private cloud with consistent tooling
 - Large-scale infrastructure (5K+ nodes) - capacity planning, hardware lifecycle, rack-level failure domains
 - Cost optimization / FinOps - cloud spend analysis, rightsizing, storage tiering strategies
 - Chaos engineering - fault injection, game days, resilience testing (Chaos Monkey, Litmus)
 - Bare metal provisioning - PXE boot, IPMI, automated OS provisioning at scale (Ironic, MaaS)
 - Backup/DR domain awareness - understanding RPO/RTO, storage replication, data protection pipelines
 - Go proficiency - reading and debugging Go services, contributing to internal tooling

Why Join Kaseya: 

- High ownership over a real production service from day one
 - Greenfield platform with strong technical leadership and a clear roadmap
 - Small team where your contributions are visible and impactful
 - Competitive salary and benefits

Additional Information

Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

data.description:
Description

The Amazon Cross Border Core Technology team is seeking a seasoned Software Engineer to drive the development of innovative technologies that will shape platforms and products impacting a multibillion-dollar business and enhancing the global customer experience. Our team is focused on building next-generation services that will transform international trade at Amazon. We aim to revolutionize how shoppers worldwide discover and purchase global products. We're developing new services in areas like Customer Returns, Accounting, Customer Service and Mobile App to enhance the international shopping experience. Our goal is to offer a seamless, one-stop shopping experience for international customers, which includes: 

Building products (mobile and web based) that reach millions of new customers globally, delivering a world-class shopping experience with localized language, payment options, and currencies. 

Designing API-based services in NAWS that enable scalable platforms for both internal and external partners. 

Advancing customer experience technologies to support shoppers worldwide. 

Innovating strategies for global expansion and developing solutions that will sustain the continued rapid growth of this thriving business. 

Key job responsibilities

You're seeking a career where you can create, deliver, and make a lasting impact. You design solutions that reach millions of new customers globally, addressing complex problems with a holistic approach. You thrive in environments that demand intricate feedback loops and the development of robust ecosystems. You're passionate about solving real-world challenges with creative and thoughtful solutions, leveraging a deep understanding of the problem space. You constantly challenge yourself and others to improve, always striving for better outcomes. By collaborating closely with the business, you help define expansion strategies and develop innovative solutions that support the continued rapid growth of this dynamic and thriving business. 

About The Team

We're going to enable customers around the globe to purchase products on Amazon with guaranteed shipping and import duty fees. We're going to improve this experience by making selection available across all Amazon marketplaces, so that customers can search and browse in their preferred language and currency. Along the way, we're going to face seemingly impossible problems. We're going to argue about how to solve them, and we'll work together to find a solution that is superior to each of the proposals we came in with. We'll make difficult decisions, but we'll all understand why. We'll be the dream team.

 - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

 - Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred Qualifications

At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe. 

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in. 

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it. 

Senior Manager, Software Development Engineering in Test - Backend

Position Summary

Kaseya is seeking a Senior Manager, Software Development Engineering in Test (SDET) to lead our quality engineering and test automation organization supporting endpoint management, device management, and enterprise SaaS platform solutions. 

This leader will be responsible for managing SDET and automation engineering teams, driving quality strategy, defining test architecture, expanding automated validation capabilities, and ensuring the delivery of secure, scalable, and highly reliable software. 

The ideal candidate combines strong engineering leadership with deep experience in software testing, automation frameworks, operating systems, endpoint technologies, and large-scale SaaS platforms. This role requires a hands-on technical leader capable of influencing engineering quality across the entire software development lifecycle while leveraging modern AI-powered development and test automation techniques. 

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Team Management

- Lead and manage teams of SDETs, automation engineers, and technical leads responsible for delivering high-quality software and platform capabilities. 
 - Build, mentor, coach, and develop engineering talent while fostering a culture of accountability, quality ownership, urgency, innovation, and continuous improvement. 
 - Drive hiring, onboarding, career development, and performance management activities across the quality engineering organization. 
 - Establish quality engineering best practices, standards, metrics, and operational excellence initiatives. 

Quality Strategy & Engineering Execution

- Define and execute the organization's quality engineering vision, test automation roadmap, and validation strategy. 
 - Partner closely with Engineering, Product Management, Support, Operations, and Security teams to ensure successful delivery of roadmap initiatives. 
 - Drive engineering process improvements across Agile delivery, DevOps, CI/CD, automated testing, deployment automation, release readiness, and quality governance. 
 - Create measurable quality objectives and reporting mechanisms to communicate risks, trends, coverage, and release readiness to senior leadership. 

Test Automation & Platform Validation

- Lead the design, development, and maintenance of scalable automation frameworks supporting functional, integration, regression, performance, resiliency, and system-level validation. 
 - Oversee automated validation of endpoint agents, endpoint management workflows, patching, monitoring, remote actions, scripting, inventory collection, policy execution, and agent communications. 
 - Build reusable automation infrastructure capable of validating software across Windows, macOS, Linux, and mobile environments. 
 - Drive large-scale automated regression testing strategies supporting enterprise endpoint management and SaaS platform releases. 

Operating Systems & Endpoint Technologies

- Ensure validation of endpoint agent behavior across supported operating systems and major platform versions. 
 - Oversee testing strategies for OS upgrades, endpoint recovery scenarios, disconnected operations, self-healing capabilities, and device lifecycle management. 
 - Validate interoperability with operating system services, security frameworks, APIs, device management technologies, and endpoint security solutions. 
 - Support testing initiatives involving Microsoft Intune, Apple MDM, Android Enterprise, and Linux device management platforms. 

Technical Leadership

- Participate in architecture reviews, design reviews, and technical planning to ensure solutions meet standards for security, scalability, reliability, observability, and maintainability. 
 - Partner with engineering teams to identify testability improvements and quality risks early in the development lifecycle. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis efforts for complex production issues and implement automated safeguards to prevent recurrence. 
 - Support troubleshooting efforts through log analysis, telemetry, debugging, endpoint diagnostics, and distributed system investigation. 

AI-Powered Quality Engineering

- Champion the adoption of AI coding assistants and automation tools throughout the quality engineering lifecycle. 
 - Leverage AI technologies for test generation, code analysis, debugging, coverage expansion, and engineering productivity improvements. 
 - Establish best practices for validating AI-generated test assets and automation solutions. 
 - Drive continuous innovation in AI-assisted software quality practices across engineering teams. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 6+ years of software engineering, SDET, quality engineering, or automation engineering experience. 
 - 2+ years of experience managing software engineering, SDET, or QA automation teams. 
 - Strong experience building and scaling test automation frameworks and engineering validation platforms. 
 - Solid software development experience using C#, Java, Kotlin, or related programming languages. 
 - Deep understanding of at least one major operating system platform: Windows, Linux, or macOS. 
 - Strong knowledge of operating system internals including processes, services/daemons, filesystems, networking, security models, and privilege management. 
 - Experience supporting enterprise SaaS platforms, distributed systems, cloud-native applications, or endpoint management products. 
 - Strong understanding of Agile development methodologies, DevOps practices, CI/CD, automated testing, deployment automation, and release management. 
 - Proven experience partnering with cross-functional teams to drive successful software delivery. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience leading quality engineering organizations supporting enterprise endpoint management, RMM, security, MDM, UEM, or device management platforms. 
 - Experience testing endpoint agents, systems software, device drivers, security software, or operating-system-level components. 
 - Hands-on experience with virtualization technologies, lab automation, large-scale automated testing environments, and device provisioning systems. 
 - Familiarity with Microsoft Intune, Apple MDM, Android Enterprise, Linux device management, or similar endpoint technologies. 
 - Experience with PowerShell, Bash, Python, and operating system automation tools. 
 - Strong understanding of application security testing, performance testing, resiliency testing, and reliability engineering. 
 - Ability to understand deeply interconnected systems from a systems architecture perspective. 
 - Proven ability to translate business priorities and product roadmap objectives into scalable quality engineering execution plans. 
 - Excellent communication, stakeholder management, prioritization, and decision-making skills. 
 - Experience driving AI adoption within software development, software testing, and engineering productivity initiatives. 

Success in This Role

In your first year, you will: 

- Build and scale a high-performing SDET organization. 
 - Increase automated test coverage across endpoint and SaaS platform capabilities. 
 - Improve release quality, stability, and deployment confidence. 
 - Establish modern AI-assisted quality engineering practices. 
 - Strengthen collaboration between Engineering, Product, Operations, and Support teams. 
 - Create measurable improvements in quality metrics, defect prevention, and engineering productivity.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself. 

ROLE SUMMARY

The Lead DevOps Engineer designs, builds, and maintains the CI/CD pipelines, deployment tooling, and infrastructure automation that power Skan's customer delivery operations. Working within the Customer Ops team, this role is the engineering engine behind deployment velocity - ensuring that customer environments are provisioned, upgraded, and maintained reliably, securely, and at pace. 

This role sits at the intersection of software engineering and infrastructure operations. The DevOps Engineer is responsible for making deployment a repeatable, automated, and quality-assured activity - eliminating manual overhead, enforcing DevSecOps standards, and giving the wider Customer Ops and Systems Engineering teams the tooling they need to operate efficiently at scale. 

WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

As Skan's enterprise customer base grows, so does the complexity of managing deployments across cloud-hosted, customer-hosted, and hybrid environments. Without dedicated DevOps engineering, deployment activities are manual, inconsistent, and slow - creating delivery risk, increasing the chance of environment-related incidents, and preventing the Customer Ops team from scaling without linear headcount growth. 

The DevOps Engineer provides the automation and tooling layer that makes Skan's customer delivery operations scalable, auditable, and professionally run - directly supporting SLA commitments, deployment quality, and time-to-value for enterprise clients. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for customer environment deployments, upgrades, and patch cycles - covering cloud-hosted and customer-hosted models
 - Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration management using Infrastructure-as-Code tooling (Terraform, Helm, Ansible)
 - Implement and enforce DevSecOps practices across all product and client deployment pipelines - including security scanning, secrets management, and policy-as-code controls
 - Develop and maintain deployment tooling, scripts, and environment templates that reduce manual effort and improve deployment consistency
 - Support Systems Engineers during new customer environment builds, patch cycles, and major upgrades - providing tooling, automation, and hands-on assistance
 - Build and maintain ops process tooling: SLA tracking dashboards, deployment status portals, environment health monitors, and internal reporting utilities
 - Maintain deployment metrics and reporting - pipeline success rate, deployment frequency, lead time, and change failure rate - to inform continuous improvement
 - Identify and remediate deployment bottlenecks, pipeline failures, and infrastructure configuration drift across customer environments
 - Collaborate with the SRE team to align infrastructure design with operational monitoring and incident response requirements
 - Participate in change management processes - ensuring all production environment changes are logged, reviewed, and reversible
 - Contribute to the Automation Engineering team's agentic workflow initiatives - developing automation that further reduces operational toil
 - Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation for all pipelines, playbooks, and environment configurationsKEY DELIVERABLES

- CI/CD pipeline designs and live implementations for all customer deployment models - cloud, on-prem, and hybrid
 - Infrastructure-as-Code templates and reusable deployment playbooks - maintained, versioned, and documented
 - DevSecOps controls documentation and compliance evidence for all customer-facing pipelines
 - Automated environment provisioning and teardown scripts - reducing manual setup time per new customer deployment
 - Deployment metrics dashboard: pipeline success rate, deployment frequency, lead time, and change failure rate - reported monthly
 - Ops tooling: SLA trackers, status portals, and environment health dashboards operational and actively used by Customer Ops teams
 - Target: pipeline success rate ≥ 95%; zero unplanned production outages attributable to deployment tooling failuresKEY SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

- 8+ years of experience. 
 - CI/CD platforms: Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps - pipeline design, implementation, and maintenance at enterprise scale
 - Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, Helm, Ansible - provisioning, configuration management, and drift detection
 - Container platforms: Docker and Kubernetes - build, deployment, and runtime management in production environments
 - DevSecOps: security scanning (SAST/DAST), secrets management (HashiCorp Vault or equivalent), policy-as-code (OPA, Sentinel)
 - Cloud platforms: AWS, Azure, or GCP - provisioning, networking, IAM, and cost-aware infrastructure management
 - Scripting and automation: Python, Bash, PowerShell - automating deployment workflows and operational tasks
 - Monitoring integration: ability to instrument pipelines with observability hooks compatible with Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or equivalent
 - Change management: familiarity with ITSM processes and structured change control in enterprise environments
 - Collaboration skills: able to work effectively with Systems Engineers, SRE, and customer-facing teams in a fast-moving environment
 - Documentation: clear, maintainable runbooks and pipeline documentation - written for both technical peers and operational teams

This is a hybrid role based in Bangalore, with an expectation to work from the office three days a week.

data.title: Principal Tech Ops Engineer, AWS Rack Manufacturing
data.description:
Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain - and we're looking for talented people who want to help. 

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. 

We are seeking a Principal Tech Operations Engineer to lead and scale regional manufacturing operations across a complex, multi vendor hardware production ecosystem. This role owns the end to end orchestration of external manufacturing partners, driving supplier onboarding, site enablement, technical roadmap development, and sustained performance management across Supply Chain, Quality, Technical Operations, and Procurement functions. You will shape operational planning inputs that determine how the region builds and delivers enterprise hardware at scale. 

You will serve as the single threaded owner for manufacturing operations outcomes, aligning diverse stakeholders, setting strategic direction, and delivering results that meet business scaling targets. You will build consensus and drive decisions at velocity across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Hardware Engineering, Risk Management, Public Policy, Finance, and Customer facing organizations while maintaining full accountability for production performance and customer delivery. 

This is a senior role which requires 10+ years of technical program management experience. The role demands deep, tenured expertise in high mix, high complexity hardware manufacturing. You will have personally led organizations through product transitions, capacity ramps, supplier onboarding cycles, and operational transformations. You thrive in dynamic environments where shifting product mix, evolving customer demand, and technology transitions require rapid, high judgment decision making that balances quality, cost, throughput, and delivery reliability. 

You will own complex integration programs from conception through design, validation, implementation, and scaling across manufacturing sites. The scope includes orchestrating a multi vendor ecosystem of manufacturing partners, managing the largest and most complex supplier engagements in the region, and delivering next generation technology programs. This includes enabling the region's first liquid cooled rack production, supporting the industry transition from air cooled to liquid cooled infrastructure. In 2027, the role expands to lead the site setup, vendor selection, and operational ramp of a purpose built Manufacturing Center of Excellence, a greenfield facility that will double regional manufacturing capacity and set operational standards for global replication.

data.title: Staff Software Development Engineer in Test
data.description:
About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success. 

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide. 

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe. 

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in. 

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it. 

RMM Backend - Staff Software Development Engineer in Test

Why Kaseya?

Join a fast-growing company transforming the IT management and cybersecurity industry. At Kaseya, we are modernizing how software is designed, built, tested, and operated-combining strong engineering fundamentals with AI-native development practices. 

You will have the opportunity to shape not only our technology architecture, but also how engineering teams leverage AI to build high-quality software faster and more effectively. 

Join the Kaseya growth rocket ship and see how we are #ChangingLives!

Job Summary

We are seeking a Senior Staff Software Development Engineer in Test to build and maintain automated testing capabilities for Kaseya's endpoint management platform. 

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on validating system-level software, endpoint agents, device management workflows, and operating system integrations. The ideal candidate is passionate about operating systems, endpoint management, automation engineering, and software quality. 

You will design and develop reusable automation frameworks capable of validating functionality across multiple operating systems and thousands of endpoint scenarios while leveraging AI-assisted development tools to accelerate automation coverage and improve engineering productivity. 

What You Will Do

- Design, develop, and maintain automation frameworks for endpoint agent validation. 
 - Build automated tests covering installation, upgrade, rollback, policy execution, inventory collection, monitoring, patching, remote actions, scripting, and agent communications. 
 - Create reusable test libraries and test infrastructure for Windows, macOS, Linux, and mobile platforms. 
 - Develop automation for functional, integration, regression, performance, resiliency, and system-level testing. 
 - Validate endpoint agent behavior across supported operating systems and versions. 
 - Build automated validation for OS upgrades, endpoint recovery scenarios, disconnected operation, and self-healing capabilities. 
 - Develop automation for MDM and endpoint management workflows. 
 - Verify interoperability with native operating system services, security frameworks, and device management APIs. 
 - Develop large-scale automated regression suites for endpoint releases. 
 - Improve release quality through automated validation of agent stability, performance, resource utilization, and security. 
 - Identify quality risks and proactively expand test coverage. 
 - Troubleshoot complex defects through log analysis, debugging, telemetry, and endpoint diagnostics. 
 - Reproduce customer-reported issues across diverse endpoint environments. 
 - Partner with Support and Engineering teams to perform root-cause analysis. 
 - Create automation preventing recurrence of production issues. 
 - Utilize AI coding assistants and coding agents to generate and maintain automation assets. 
 - Apply AI tools for test generation, code analysis, debugging, and coverage expansion. 
 - Validate AI-generated tests and automation through engineering best practices. 

What You Bring

- 10+ years of hands-on software engineering, SDET, DevTest, or QA Automation experience. 
 - Strong programming skills in Java, Kotlin, C#, or similar languages. 
 - Experience building automation frameworks and test infrastructure. 
 - Deep understanding of at least one platform - Windows, macOS, Linux 
 - Strong understanding of operating system internals - Processes, Services/Daemons, Filesystems, Networking, Security Models, Privilege Management 
 - Experience testing endpoint agents, system software, security software, or device management products. 
 - Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills. 
 - Experience using virtualization platforms and automated device provisioning. 
 - Exposure to Microsoft Intune, Apple MDM, Android Enterprise, or Linux device management. 
 - Familiarity with PowerShell, Bash, Python, and operating system scripting technologies. 

Additional Information

Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

data.title: Sr Quality Assurance Spec [T500-29841]
data.description:
About us: 

We are a highly successful 190-year-old, Fortune 500 commercial property insurance company of 6, 000+ employees with a unique focus on science and risk engineering. Businesses worldwide trust our expertise to protect their assets, relying on our comprehensive risk assessments and robust, engineering-based insurance solutions to safeguard against fire, natural disasters, and other perils. Serving over a quarter of the Fortune 500 and major corporations globally, we deliver data-driven strategies that enhance resilience, ensure business continuity, and empower organizations to thrive. 

FM India is a strategic location for driving our global operational efficiency. Our presence in India allows us to leverage the country's talented workforce and advance our capabilities to serve our clients better. We have diverse corporate functions that emphasize research, advanced technologies like AI and analytics, risk engineering, research, finance, marketing, HR, etc. working together to provide innovative solutions and nurture lasting relationships - from co-workers to clients. 

Role Title: Sr Quality Assurance Spec

Position Summary: 

Contributes directly and provides consultation to one or more project teams and/or application support groups in the analysis, design, and execution of effective Quality Assurance procedures and defect prevention/detection processes for corporate and client area information systems, across multiple computing environments. Determines and reports the quality of a product release at any time by quantifying the degree to which it meets the defined and implied user requirements. This is the second level position within the Quality Assurance job family. Ultimately, the goal of this position is to ensure the system delivered will address the organization's business need or problem as defined in the requirements. 

Job Responsibilities:

Description

READY TO DO SOMETHING BIG?

How would you build the next generation of mission critical systems and services that power the ability to send, store and manage billions of products across the globe on behalf of our selling partners?

Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) is the Amazon service for world-wide sellers that offers access to Amazon's vast distribution network as a service. Similar to how AWS provides infrastructure as a service, FBA allows sellers to only pay for what they use, creating a seamless experience to leverage our world-class infrastructure. Sellers, from Fortune 50 companies to hundreds of thousands of small businesses and entrepreneurs, in 135 countries worldwide, rely upon our world-leading technology to grow and thrive on Amazon's Marketplaces. 

Our team is working to solve what is arguably the most difficult eCommerce problem that exists today: building sophisticated, scalable technology to effectively simplify the complexity of connecting millions of FBA sellers with hundreds of millions of consumers who buy their products. Even small improvements result in millions of dollars in savings for our sellers and customers. Given the importance of small and medium sized businesses, these savings are what helps drive the global economy. 

Specifically, the Send to Amazon - STA Platforms (STAP) team is part of the broader Inbound Workflows and Platforms organization. The STAP team owns the user interface platform that enables sellers to inbound products to Amazon. As the owners of this platform, the STAP engineering team is responsible for the codebase, development practices, CI/CD pipelines, and providing on-call support. The team is also accountable for the inbounding workflow built on this platform, which supports a wide range of marketplaces categorized as "Worldwide" (WW). This encompasses the end-to-end engineering and quality assurance for the seller-facing UI on Seller Central. Additionally, the STAP team owns various services that they have inherited over time from other teams. The QA team within STAP specifically owns manual feature and regression testing across multiple initiatives, both within the inbound workflows organization and beyond. 

We operate as a startup within Amazon, providing our team great flexibility in product and technology direction. Come, join us and build the future!

Key job responsibilities

- Design and develop comprehensive test strategies, test plan, automation, and methodologies to ensure the quality and reliability of software products. 
 - Collaborate and influence cross-functional teams including developers, product managers, and project managers to understand software quality requirements and design effective test strategies.

 - Work with component teams to identify the pain points in their area and provide technical guidance.

 - Identify and document defects, issues, and potential areas of improvement in the software development process. 
 - Perform root cause analysis of complex issues and work with the development team to resolve issues and enhance the overall product quality.

 - Define key metrics for measuring and reporting on the quality of software products and test effectiveness. 

Basic Qualifications

- 5+ years of quality assurance engineering experience
 - Experience in automation testing
 - Experience in manual testing
 - Experience scripting or coding
 - Experience as QA lead on medium to large sized projects
 - 5+ years of delivering test frameworks, test tools, leading the QA projects and initiatives experience
 - Knowledge of QA methodology and tools, with demonstrated experience in an QAE role
 - Excellent English written and verbal skills

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with at least one automated test framework like Selenium or Appium
 - Experience in gathering test requirements to create detailed test plans and defining quality metrics to measure product quality
 - Knowledge of at least one modern object-oriented programming language such as C++, Java, Objective C
 - Experience developing high quality test plans, test designs, test strategies, and test execution

data.title: Salesforce Commerce Cloud - Technical Architect
data.description:
Who We Are

WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12, 000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients' businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience. 

The opportunity

We are looking for an experienced Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) Technical Architect with 8+ years to lead architecture, design, and technical delivery for enterprise-scale ecommerce implementations and support engagements. The candidate should possess strong expertise in SFCC B2C architecture, integrations, performance optimization, and solution design, along with the ability to guide development teams and collaborate with business stakeholders. 

What you'll be doing

- Lead end-to-end technical architecture and solution design for SFCC B2C Commerce projects. 
 - Define scalable, secure, and high-performance ecommerce solutions aligned with business requirements. 
 - Review and govern technical designs, code quality, and implementation best practices. 
 - Drive integrations with third-party systems such as OMS, CRM, Payment Gateways, ERP, PIM, Loyalty, and Marketing platforms. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Business, QA, DevOps, and Product Owners. 
 - Perform technical estimations, solution reviews, and risk assessments. 
 - Support production issue resolution, performance optimization, and platform stability initiatives. 
 - Mentor and guide developers and technical leads across projects. 
 - Ensure adherence to SFCC best practices, coding standards, and release governance. 
 - Participate in client discussions, architecture workshops, and technical roadmap planning. 

What we want from you

- Strong hands-on experience with Salesforce Commerce Cloud (Demandware / SFCC B2C). 
 - Expertise in SFRA architecture, cartridges, controllers, ISML, OCAPI, SCAPI, hooks, and job frameworks. 
 - Strong proficiency in JavaScript, Node. js, REST APIs, and integration patterns. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git, Jenkins, and deployment processes. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS/Azure and serverless integrations (Lambda, API Gateway, S3, etc. )
 - Prepare architecture diagrams, technical design documents, integration specifications, and solution blueprints. 
 - Good understanding of ecommerce concepts including catalog, checkout, promotions, inventory, and order management. 
 - Experience in performance optimization and troubleshooting. 
 - Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. 

If you know some of this even better

- Experience with composable commerce or headless architecture. 
 - Exposure to Salesforce ecosystem products such as Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, or Experience Cloud. 
 - Knowledge of frontend frameworks. 
 - SFCC certifications preferred. 

What we can offer you

Alongside the opportunity to work with some of the most exciting brands around the world, we'll also prioritise your career development and help you grow your skills. We'll empower you to make a difference, allow you to be yourself, and respect who you are. 

Our culture thrives on our core values, designed for impact-driven individuals: Heart, Brains and Courage. 

We lead with Heart, fostering empathy and trust where genuine connections and human-centric work flourish. 

We empower your Brains for innovation, valuing relentless curiosity and collaborative intelligence to solve complex challenges. 

And we champion Courage, inspiring you to speak up, embrace experimentation, and advocate for bold solutions that push our thinking to be better than yesterday. 

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence and world-class partnerships - all united by our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open - we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP. com. 

WPP (VML/WPP Enterprise Solutions) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers. 

When you click "Submit Application", this will send any information you add below to WPP (VML/WPP Enterprise Solutions). Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Recruitment Privacy Policy. California residents should read our California Recruitment Privacy Notice. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

Description

Come innovate with the Amazon Music team!

As a Software Development Manager (SDM) for Amazon Music - Makerting & Growth, you would be managing a talented team of engineers building and scaling large scale systems allowing customers to stream and purchase music on Amazon Retail. You are expected to be a leader in technology, diving deep into problems you own, demonstrate excellent judgement skills in decision making, mentoring and growing talent. You inspire people, motivate the team, drive the culture of innovation, implement engineering best practices, and have commitment and grit to deliver results. 

You operate at the intersection of technology and business growth. Your systems directly impact how millions of customers discover and engage with Amazon Music. You see the results of your team's work in real-time - every experiment launched, every feature shipped, every marketplace expanded into moves the needle on subscriber growth. You operate at the intersection of technology and business growth. Your systems directly impact how millions of customers discover and engage with Amazon Music. You see the results of your team's work in real-time - every experiment launched, every feature shipped, every marketplace expanded into moves the needle on subscriber growth. 

Key job responsibilities

- Lead and manage a team of software engineers responsible for building and scaling large-scale distributed systems that power music streaming and purchasing experiences on Amazon Retail
 - Define technical vision and architecture for systems serving millions of customers across Amazon Website, mobile Apps, Kindle, Fire TV, and web clients
 - Drive Operational Excellence by establishing engineering best practices, defining on-call strategies, and ensuring high availability and reliability of services
 - Partner with product management and cross-functional engineering teams to translate business requirements into technical roadmaps and deliverables
 - Mentor, coach, and grow engineering talent through regular 1: 1s, career development planning, and performance management
 - Own end-to-end delivery of projects from design through deployment, ensuring quality, scalability, and customer impact
 - Influence organizational strategy by collaborating with senior leadership across Amazon Music to align on goals and priorities
 - Drive a culture of innovation and continuous improvement, encouraging the team to experiment, iterate, and raise the bar for customers
 - Make sound technical and business judgement calls, balancing short-term delivery needs with long-term architectural investments
 - Recruit and hire top engineering talent to build a high-performing, diverse team

A day in the life

Making trade-off decisions between speed-to-market and long-term technical investment

Influencing peer SDMs and senior leadership on cross-org priorities

Removing blockers for your team so they can stay in flow

Thinking about how to measure and improve customer engagement, retention, and acquisition through technology

Balancing "keep the lights on" operational work with innovation and experimentation

Basic Qualifications

data.description:
Abou the Role

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to work broadly across our Rails application suite - not a single-initiative hire, but someone who'll move across the codebase as priorities shift, own features end-to-end, and help set technical direction as we modernize. 

This is a product engineering role. You'll partner directly with Product and Design to take a problem from technical discovery through delivery - scoping the approach, surfacing tradeoffs, making the call when things are ambiguous, and following through to a shipped, monitored feature. We're not looking for someone who waits to be told what to build. 

What You'll Work On

- Own features end-to-end across our Rails applications (PostgreSQL, MySQL) serving donors, nonprofits, and platform administrators - from technical discovery and scoping through implementation, rollout, and monitoring
 - Work with a layered frontend: React for stateful UI, Stimulus for behavior on server-rendered HTML, Turbo for partial updates, and Action Cable for real-time features
 - Design and tune asynchronous workflows via Sidekiq across prioritized queues, with CloudWatch instrumentation
 - Participate in ongoing platform modernization - dependency and framework upgrades, migration off legacy patterns, and paying down debt deliberately rather than reflexively
 - Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) as a standard part of your workflow - not just for autocomplete, but for accelerating discovery, testing, and review - while maintaining a critical eye on what they produce
 - Write RSpec/Capybara system specs and Jest unit tests, and own the full quality surface: N+1 detection, dependency/security scanning, and safe migrations (Strong Migrations)
 - Ship and deploy via Capistrano across staged environments (dev → beta → demo → staging → production)
 - Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Design, and DevOps - including communicating tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders and driving alignment on architectural decisions rather than deciding in isolation

You'd Be a Strong Fit If You

- Default to ownership. You can take a loosely defined problem, resolve the ambiguity yourself, and drive it to done - pulling in the right people rather than waiting for direction
 - Are AI-forward. You use AI tools daily in your engineering work and have opinions on where they help and where they don't - you're not a skeptic by default, but you're also not uncritical of the output
 - Have 5+ years of production Rails experience, including work across the full request lifecycle - schema design to rendered HTML to async job
 - Have navigated real technical tradeoffs (simplicity vs. performance, shipping vs. tech debt) and can explain the reasoning, not just the decision
 - Bring a strong testing instinct - you write specs before and after, not as an afterthought
 - Have experience with payment processing or other financially sensitive integrations (bonus)
 - Are comfortable with AWS (S3, EC2, SNS, Lambda) in a Rails deployment context

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Science, Engineering, or related field and 3+ years of ASIC design, verification, validation, integration, or related work experience. 

OR

Master's degree in Science, Engineering, or related field and 2+ years of ASIC design, verification, validation, integration, or related work experience. 

OR

PhD in Science, Engineering, or related field and 1+ year of ASIC design, verification, validation, integration, or related work experience. 

What You'll Do (Key Responsibilities)

- Own SMMU validation at block/IP and subsystem levels: coverage-driven test planning, stimulus development, checking/score boarding, and closure. 
 - Develop test build reusable verification components for SMMU, including page table generators, translation fault injectors, and traffic generators. 
 - Validate system interactions: SMMU with ARM cores, MMU/TLB, NoC/Interconnect, coherency (ACE/CHI or equivalent), and clock/reset domains (including CDC and low-power/clock-gating scenarios). 
 - Exercise page table formats and features: stage-1/stage-2 translations, ASIDs/VMIDs, context banks/stream IDs, MSI/IOMMU operations, address translation faults, and SVA/ATS (if applicable). 
 - Debug complex issues using JTAG and on-chip debug/trace infrastructure (ETM/STM/SWO), bring-up scripts, and logic analyzers; drive root cause with design/architecture teams. 
 - Performance & stress validation: create stress scenarios (burst/atomic/ordering/ QoS), measure bandwidth/latency, and validate backpressure & throttling behavior through NoC. 
 - Contribute to emulation/FPGA and post-silicon: port tests, build bare-metal validation, develop board bring-up sequences and lab automation. 
 - Own quality metrics: functional coverage, code coverage, assertions, defect density/escape rates; author clear test/coverage reports and sign-off criteria. 
 - Collaborate cross-functionally with architecture, RTL design, firmware/driver, physical design, and validation teams to refine specs and close issues quickly. 
 - Continuously improve methodology, tools, and checkers; mentor junior engineers in best practices. 

Minimum Qualifications (Must-Haves)

- B. E/B. Tech/M. Tech in ECE/EE/CS or equivalent with 3-5 years of relevant experience. 
 - Strong ARM architecture knowledge (A-profile preferred): memory model, privilege levels, exception model, caches, TLBs, MMU concepts, and virtual memory flows. 
 - Deep understanding of SMMU/IOMMU fundamentals: stream IDs, context banks, translation stages, page table formats, fault handling, and device DMA interactions. 
 - Familiar with NoC/interconnect protocols and coherency (e. g. , AXI/ACE/CHI), ordering rules, QoS, and interop with SMMU. 
 - Solid grasp of clocks/resets and their impact on SMMU and NoC behavior; experience validating low-power states and clock gating effects. 
 - JTAG basics to intermediate: scan chains, boundary scan, run-control, breakpoints, basic scripting with OpenOCD/DS-5/Arm Development Studio or similar. 
 - Proficient in debugging complex HW/SW issues, using waveforms (e. g. , Verdi/DVE), traces, and logs to isolate root cause. 
 - Scripting in Python/Perl/TCL/Shell for test automation, log parsing, and lab workflows. 
 - Critical thinking & learning agility: ability to infer failure modes from first principles, design edge-case tests, and quickly onboard new IP/flows. 

Preferred Qualifications (Good-to-Have)

- Prior tapeouts with SMMU or IOMMU IP (Arm SMMU v2/v3 or equivalent vendor IP). 
 - Post-silicon validation experience: lab bring-up, firmware integration, board-level debug. 
 - Experience with emulation/FPGA prototyping (Veloce, Palladium, Protium, HAPS). 
 - Familiarity with Linux IOMMU framework, device trees/ACPI, and driver-level validation (DMA mappings, iommu_ops). 
 - Knowledge of PCIe (including ATS/PRI/PASID), CXL, or virtualization stacks (KVM/Hypervisors) and their interaction with SMMU. 
 - Exposure to safety/security: memory isolation, SMMU faults as security boundaries, RAS features, error injection and detection. 
 - Performance modeling/analysis; profiling tools; building synthetic traffic to characterize SMMU/NoC behavior. 
 - CI/CD for verification (Jenkins/GitLab CI), coverage dashboards, and regression triage at scale. 

Tools & Environment

- Languages/Methodology: ARM assembly, C for bare-metal tests, Python/TCL/Perl for scripting. 
 - Emu/FPGA: Veloce/RUMI
 - Versioning/CI: Perforce, Jira. 
 - OS/Drivers: bare-metal frameworks. 

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Test plan completeness and functional/code coverage closure against SMMU spec and use-cases. 
 - Defect discovery rate and escape rate (pre- vs. post-silicon). 
 - Time-to-root-cause for complex issues; quality of triage documentation. 
 - Regression stability and automation coverage. 
 - Performance validation completeness vs. targets (latency, bandwidth, QoS). 

Example Work Items You'll Own

- Create tests for stage-1 and stage-2 translations, ASID/VMID rollover, TLB shootdowns, and context switch stress. 
 - Validate device DMA through SMMU under NoC congestion and clock gating scenarios; confirm ordering and coherency guarantees. 
 - Run JTAG-based bring-up sequences to verify SMMU registers, enable translations, and capture trace for fault analysis. 
 - Automate validation: configure IOMMU groups, map/unmap devices, inject faults, and parse kernel logs for health signals. 

Education

- B. E/B. Tech or M. E/M. Tech in EE/ECE/CS (or equivalent).

data.description:
About Signify

Through bold discovery and cutting-edge innovation, we lead an industry that is vital for the future of our planet: lighting. Through our leadership in connected lighting and the Internet of Things, we're breaking new ground in data analytics, AI, and smart solutions for homes, offices, cities, and beyond. 

At Signify, you can shape tomorrow by building on our incredible 125+ year legacy while working toward even bolder sustainability goals. Our culture of continuous learning, creativity, and commitment to diversity and inclusion empowers you to grow your skills and career. 

Join us, and together, we'll transform our industry, making a lasting difference for brighter lives and a better world. 

More About The Role

If you are a seasoned Software (SW) professional, or a Quality professional with software background with an affinity to HW/FW, this could be a perfect next step to a senior role with a global engineering leader in IoT for Lighting. 

As a Lead Advanced Quality Engineer assuring the quality and reliability of our state-of-the art Connected Lighting & Controls Systems, the backbone of IoT and many other modern building systems. The AQE facilitates the Quality Management processes within R&D, enforcing best practices defined by Signify's Quality System, and champions the major quality pillars related to software & hardware design and development, supplier management, and industrial processes. 

We're on the lookout for forward-thinking innovators with a passion for sustainability. If you match this description, get in touch!

What You'll Do

- Accounts for all end-to-end quality-related deliverables in the NPDL process and fast track development projects. 
 - Coaches, trains and other functions on execution of quality activities such as CTQ, FMEA, Supplier selection, PPAP, QTP, Process validation, Reliability prediction, and Compliance. 
 - Presents the quality status in NPDL Gate and MS review and defines and drives corrective actions to meet deliverables. 
 - Assured that budget is defined in the project to meet quality deliverables. 
 - Sets quality KPI in NPDL Project. 
 - Defines requirements for quality test and measurement equipment. 
 - Closes feedback loops from customer complaints by embedding the learnings into new design rules, QTPs, FMEAs and other AQP tools. 
 - Lead problem-solving activities for internal and Customer concerns relating to assigned responsibilities and documenting all actions in the required format (e. g. 8D). 
 - Ensure project documentation review and authorization. 
 - Act as DfSS ambassador. 

Technical

Your qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Quality Management, or a related technical field, providing foundational knowledge in quality principles and product development. Detailed knowledge of the theory and principles of APQP and statistical methods. 
 - At least 12 years' experience as a Software (FW) professional, or a Quality professional with Software background with an affinity to HW/FW. 
 - Detailed knowledge of the theory and principles of Quality Assurance methods and tools (e. g. DfSS, APQP, etc. ) and Software Methodologies (SAFe and CMMi)
 - Experience in Risk Analysis and Root cause analysis (RCA, FMEA, 8D, 5 Why, etc. ). 
 - Experience with development tooling (JIRA, Confluence) and Software Quality Tooling (SonarQube, TIOBE). 
 - Ability to apply the appropriate statistics to give contents to fact-based decision making. 
 - Familiar with DfSS tools (e. g. DOE's and modelling), SWQ KPI's & CI / CD best practices. 
 - Strong analytical skills. 
 - Prior hands-on software development experience in roles such as Software Engineer, Technical Lead, or Software Architect is considered a strong advantage. 
 - Exposure to Compliance of products & Systems is a plus. 
 - Experience with Field Quality is a plus. 

Behavioural

- Team player and coach. 
 - Demonstrated ability to influence a project team. 
 - Good communicator and presenter, willing to listen and speak-up. 
 - Strong collaborator who keeps stakeholders and team members informed, maintains continuous collaborative process, and drives key initiatives. 
 - Demonstrates strong Leadership in both proactive and reactive Quality management. 
 - Ability to influence stakeholders on Quality. 
 - Result driven, pragmatic mindset, with attention to detail whilst keeping focus on Big Picture. 

What You'll Get In Return. . . 

We're offering multiple opportunities for career development, like mentoring, coaching and stretch assignments, with strong international exposure for dynamic profiles. Learning is fundamental to our culture. Through continuous learning, we are transforming the industry. You have the chance to learn every day, acquire new skills and perspectives through customized online programs, and on-the-job experiences. 

See #SignifyLife through the eyes of our employees!

Who We Are

Signify is the world leader in lighting. We provide professional customers and consumers with quality, energy-efficient LED lighting. And our lights, when connected, bring data to devices, apps and people - redefining what light can do and how you use it. Today, our innovations, such as LiFi - internet connectivity through light - and UV-C, solar and horticultural lighting, contribute to a safer, smarter, more sustainable world. 

We're operating in 74 countries with 32, 000 people worldwide. 

Everything we'll do for you

You can grow a lasting career here. We'll encourage you, support you, and challenge you. We'll help you learn and progress in a way that's right for you, with coaching and mentoring along the way. We'll listen to you too, because we see and value every one of our 27, 000+ people. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace fosters creativity, innovation, and a full spectrum of bright ideas. With a global workforce present in 70+ countries, we are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where every voice is heard and valued, helping us all achieve more together. 

Come join us, and together we can light up the future.

data.title: Shift Lead - Customer Experience
data.description:
Roles And Responsibilities - Shift Leads

The Shift Lead is responsible for supervising and guiding a team of customer service agents during a specific shift. They ensure operational efficiency, adherence to service standards, and delivery of high-quality customer support while acting as the primary point of escalation for the team. 

Key Responsibilities

- Team Management & Supervision
 - Lead and manage a team of Customer Service Representatives, ensuring all performance metrics (FRT, AHT, CSAT/NPS, Quality, Schedule Adherence) targets are consistently met. 
 - Supervise and guide agents to achieve performance targets and service level agreements (SLAs). 
 - Monitor agent attendance, adherence to schedules, and productivity during the shift. 
 - Provide real-time coaching, guidance, and feedback to agents to enhance performance. 
 - Assist in onboarding and training new team members as required. 
 - Facilitate the smooth transition of new agents by actively supporting their event handling, ensuring they quickly grasp comprehensive process knowledge. 
 - A Shift Lead must always be present on the floor during the shift. 
 - Maintain floor decorum and foster a professional work environment. 
 - Operational Oversight & Floor Support
 - Ensure smooth execution of daily operations, including queue monitoring, call/event assignments in coordination with ENS, and workload distribution. 
 - Oversee Reach and Talk desk platforms, managing queues efficiently. 
 - Monitor real-time metrics such as call volume, wait times, abandoned calls, and service levels to maintain operational efficiency. 
 - For resolutions provided during the call, the Agent retains primary ownership. The Shift Lead is designated as the secondary responsible party for validating the resolution and ensuring proper process adherence. 
 - Proactively Logging in to assist all LOBs during high call volume. 
 - Ensure breaks are punched in by associates on Talk desk. 
 - Shift Leads must maintain a shift-end tracker capturing all delay reasons, including half-day instances and any reasons leading to excess AUX usage. 
 - Send the shift-end report to @GCC-ERS-ENS using the format in the attached tracker. 
 - Customer Service Excellence
 - Ensure agents deliver high-quality customer interactions aligned with company policies and customer expectations. 
 - Handle complex or escalated customer issues as needed. 
 - Ensure 100% accuracy in documentation of regular agent audits, call dispositions, and customer interaction records while enforcing strict adherence to client-specific standards. 
 - Follow up on detractor cases and send appropriate communication to the concerned associate. 
 - Assist with escalation calls and emails, ensuring prompt resolution. 
 - Reporting & Documentation
 - Generate shift reports, including key performance indicators (KPIs), service levels, and agent performance, for management review. 
 - Track and document operational incidents, escalations, and resolutions. 
 - Monitor the ERS Admin email distribution list and ensure timely action. 
 - Queue & Notification Management
 - Actively monitor queues and notifications to ensure timely responses and prevent delays. 
 - Communicate critical alerts and updates to relevant stakeholders promptly. 
 - Coaching & Development
 - Conduct coaching sessions for BQ associates when directed by Team Leads. 
 - Deliver real-time feedback to associates to drive performance improvement. 
 - Collaboration & Communication
 - Serve as a bridge between management and agents to communicate updates, policies, and operational changes. 
 - Collaborate with Team Leads, workforce management, quality, and coaching teams to ensure smooth operations across all shifts. 
 - Continuous Improvement
 - Identify opportunities for process improvement, enhanced agent efficiency, or better customer service outcomes. 
 - Provide suggestions to management for operational or workflow enhancements. 
 - Foster a culture of learning, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the team.

Chalhoub Group's Capability Hub is our technology and innovation hub set up with the vision to unite exceptional talent to build technology and capabilities that elevate luxury experiences and define the future of luxury retail. 

For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories. 

Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality - bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse - the Group's innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally. 

Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future proofing. Today, it brings together over 16, 000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM. 

Sustainability is at the core of the Group's strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women's Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead the Data Engineering capability across data platform engineering, data pipelines and processing, data operations, BI and reporting, and data quality engineering, delivering reliable cloud data infrastructure and trustworthy analytics for the business. 
 - Lead the Data Engineering capability, owning data platform engineering across the cloud data platform (Google BigQuery), storage, compute, and data access layers on GCP. 
 - Own data pipelines and processing, engineering robust ETL/ELT ingestion pipelines (Python, Apache Airflow, dbt, Airbyte) and batch and streaming processing from source systems into the data warehouse. 
 - Own data operations, including pipeline monitoring, job orchestration and scheduling, incident resolution, and the reliability and uptime of data ingestion (DataOps). 
 - Own BI and reporting, developing semantic layers (Looker, LookML), reporting models, and dashboards (Power BI, SQL) to deliver actionable business intelligence. 
 - Own data quality engineering, implementing automated data testing, data validation, anomaly detection, and cleansing logic to ensure accuracy and data integrity. 
 - Own engineering leadership, capability and team development, engineering practices, and continuous improvement across the data engineering team. 
 - Remain hands-on: plan, design, execute, and document data validation and automated data testing across integrated data systems for assigned scope. 
 - Use Claude Code for AI-assisted development to accelerate pipeline and query development while maintaining quality. 

What You'll Need To Succeed

- 10 years of data engineering experience, including experience leading or mentoring engineers. 
 - Strong expertise in Google BigQuery, cloud data warehousing, data access control, and GCP. 
 - Hands-on experience with ETL/ELT (Python, Apache Airflow, dbt, Airbyte), batch and streaming processing, and DataOps (pipeline monitoring, job orchestration, incident resolution). 
 - Proficiency in BI and reporting (Looker, LookML, Power BI, SQL, dashboard design) and data quality engineering (data validation, automated data testing, anomaly detection). 
 - Familiarity with Claude Code for AI-assisted development. 

What We Can Offer You

With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality. We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary, every day. 

We recognise the value that you bring, and we strive to provide a competitive benefits package which includes health care, child education contribution, remote and flexible working policies as well as exclusive employee discounts.

To support a fair and consistent experience for all candidates, we ask that assessments and interviews are completed independently and without assistance from generative AI tools. This ensures we understand your strengths, your thinking, and how you approach real situations.

It Takes Diversity Of Thought, Culture, Background, Differing Abilities and Perspectives to truly Inspire, Exhilarate and Delight our customers. At Chalhoub Group, we are committed to inclusion and diversity. 

We welcome all applicants to apply and be part of our exciting future. We ensure equal opportunity for all our applicants without regard to gender, age, race, religion, national origin or disability status.

data.description:
Job Description

Description: 

Lead and grow a high-performing team of 5 RF and physical layer (PHY) systems engineers, driving the technical execution, performance evaluation, and system-level ownership of next-generation wireless modems. In this role, you will act as the core technical focal point while balancing people management, roadmap execution, and cross-functional alignment. 

Your responsibilities include: 

- Team Leadership & Development: Manage, mentor, and scale a team of 5 engineers, fostering technical excellence, career growth, and a collaborative engineering culture. 
 - Technical Ownership & Direction: Guide the team's technical strategy for RF/baseband/PHY system definition, performance characterization, and system-level troubleshooting. 
 - Cross-Functional Execution: Serve as the primary technical and managerial bridge between your team and RFIC design, algorithm, software, and firmware departments. 
 - Framework & Automation Oversight: Oversee the development of advanced Python and MATLAB environments used for automated data analysis, I/Q processing, and system performance evaluations. 
 - Roadmap & Resource Planning: Prioritize project tasks, define technical milestones, and ensure high-quality deliverables across all system development and evaluation phases. 

Job Requirements

Requirements-Must Have

- Experience: 10+ years of engineering experience in wireless communications, with a proven track record of leading technical teams or managing engineering talent in an RF/PHY domain. 
 - Leadership Capability: Demonstrated experience managing or tech-leading a small-to-mid-sized engineering team (around 3 to 8 direct reports), with strong skills in mentoring and project execution. 
 - RF & PHY Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of wireless modem architectures, digital communications, and RF chain performance (Noise Figure, IP3, return loss, Superheterodyne/Zero-IF architectures). 
 - Programming & Tooling Proficiency: Strong background in Python and/or MATLAB for data analysis, automation, and algorithm evaluation. 
 - Lab & Measurement Acumen: Hands-on familiarity with RF test equipment (spectrum analyzers, signal generators, VNAs, power meters) and system-level debugging methodologies. 
 - Communication & Stakeholder Management: Excellent English verbal and written communication skills, with a proven ability to align cross-functional teams and present technical roadmaps to leadership. 

Nice to Have

- Digital Communications & Impairments: Practical knowledge of I/Q modulation (QAM, PSK), Digital Predistortion (DPD), Automatic Gain Control (AGC), and Error Vector Magnitude (EVM) characterization. 
 - Engineering Mindset: Pragmatic problem-solving approach, strong system-level perspective, and experience thriving in fast-paced multidisciplinary environments.
