Acting sustainably is one of the company principles of METRO, which has been listed in various sustainability indices and rankings, including MSCI, Sustainalytics and CDP. 

Job Description

Your responsibilities

Test planning and governance

- Apply and continuously improve the LUCA end-to-end test strategy across assigned releases and rollout waves, covering unit support, system integration, end-to-end, regression, user acceptance and cutover-related validation. 
 - Develop integrated test plans that define scope, cycles, milestones, entry and exit criteria, environments, test data, responsibilities, dependencies and required evidence. 
 - Establish and operate consistent quality gates, governance routines, escalation paths, status reporting and readiness assessments in alignment with the overall LUCA Test Management team. 
 - Maintain transparent traceability from business requirements and process designs to test cases, executions, defects and acceptance evidence. 
 - Coordinate testing dependencies across LUCA process streams, SAP and non-SAP partner systems, migration activities, environments, interfaces and country organisations. Test design, execution and defect management

- Work with Process Leads, Process Owners, solution architects, country teams and implementation partners to translate SAP Finance and SAP Ariba requirements into robust, prioritised end-to-end test scenarios. 
 - Challenge test scope and coverage from a business-process, control, integration and data perspective, ensuring that critical and high-risk scenarios are adequately represented. 
 - Coordinate test preparation and execution across distributed teams, including tester onboarding, script readiness, test-data availability, environment readiness, daily progress monitoring and evidence quality. 
 - Lead defect-management routines, ensure complete and consistent defect documentation, facilitate triage and prioritisation, and drive critical issues to timely resolution and retest. 
 - Provide concise reporting on execution progress, coverage, defect trends, blockers, residual risks and recommendations for test completion and go-live readiness. System Integrator delivery management

- Define, agree and govern the SI test deliverables, responsibilities, milestones, quality expectations and acceptance criteria for each test phase and rollout wave. 
 - Hold the SI accountable for timely and complete preparation of test plans, test scenarios, scripts, test data requirements, execution evidence, defect analysis, status reporting and closure documentation within its scope. 
 - Review and challenge SI estimates, resource plans, test coverage and execution progress, ensuring that delivery commitments are realistic, transparent and aligned with LUCA milestones. 
 - Operate regular SI performance and delivery reviews focused on agreed outcomes, overdue actions, blockers, defect ageing, retest readiness and remediation plans. 
 - Ensure that SI-led testing is coordinated with METRO business teams, LUCA functional and technical teams, partner-system owners and country organisations, with clear handovers and no gaps in accountability. 
 - Escalate material SI delivery risks early, supported by evidence and a clear assessment of their impact on quality gates, UAT readiness and go-live decisions. User Acceptance Testing management

- Own the end-to-end planning and management of the UAT exercise for assigned LUCA rollout waves, in close alignment with the overall LUCA Test Management team and country business leadership. 
 - Define the UAT scope, approach, schedule, entry and exit criteria, business-process coverage, tester organisation, environments, roles, authorisations, test data, evidence standards and sign-off process. 
 - Coordinate the nomination, onboarding and readiness of business testers and key users, ensuring that responsibilities, availability, scripts, data, tools and escalation channels are understood before execution starts. 
 - Ensure the SI and LUCA teams provide a stable, sufficiently tested solution for UAT, including completed prerequisite testing, resolved blocking defects, available interfaces and documented known limitations. 
 - Lead UAT execution governance through daily progress reviews, issue triage, defect prioritisation, retest coordination, coverage monitoring and transparent reporting to programme and country stakeholders. 
 - Drive formal UAT completion and business acceptance by consolidating results, open defects, workarounds, residual risks and sign-off evidence, without substituting for the accountable business approvers. Tools and test automation

- Use Zephyr within the agreed Jira-based testing approach to support structured test-case management, test cycles, execution tracking, traceability, reporting and audit evidence. 
 - Help establish reusable test assets and consistent naming, status and evidence standards across LUCA rollout waves. 
 - Contribute to the LUCA test-automation strategy and identify suitable regression and end-to-end scenarios for automation based on risk, repeatability, stability and business value. 
 - Coordinate UiPath-based SAP test-automation activities with functional teams and automation specialists, including prioritisation, test-data needs, execution scheduling, result review and maintenance requirements. 
 - Promote the reuse of automated tests across SAP GUI, SAP Fiori and connected business processes where this is supported by the agreed LUCA toolchain. Stakeholder and delivery management

- Coordinate virtual and cross-functional testing teams across, LUCA central teams, country organisations and implementation partners. 
 - Facilitate test-planning, execution, defect and readiness forums with a clear focus on decisions, ownership, delivery commitments and unresolved risks. 
 - Escalate quality risks early and communicate their business, process, technology and schedule impacts to the appropriate programme stakeholders. 
 - Support business readiness and UAT by ensuring that testers understand their responsibilities, scripts, test data, evidence expectations and issue-reporting process. 
 - Capture lessons learned and improve test methods, templates, reporting and automation practices across successive rollout waves. 

Qualifications

Experience and knowledge

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Informatics, Computer Science, Engineering, Finance or a related discipline. 
 - At least 10 years of experience in SAP testing or quality management, including substantial responsibility as a Test Manager in complex multinational SAP transformation programmes. 
 - Practical experience across the full testing lifecycle and with waterfall, agile or hybrid delivery approaches. 
 - Strong knowledge of SAP Finance processes and integration points, with the ability to evaluate end-to-end scenarios across General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Controlling and connected systems. 
 - Good knowledge of SAP Ariba and procurement-to-pay integration, including the ability to understand business scenarios spanning procurement, invoicing and Finance. 
 - Experience testing interface-heavy landscapes, data migration, cross-system business processes and third-party applications. 
 - Hands-on knowledge of Jira and Zephyr, including test-case organisation, execution tracking, traceability and reporting. 
 - Knowledge of UiPath for SAP test automation is highly advantageous, particularly for regression testing and connected end-to-end processes. 
 - Proven experience managing System Integrator test-delivery commitments and coordinating internal teams, business testers and implementation vendors across geographies without relying solely on direct authority. 
 - Demonstrated experience planning and leading large-scale UAT exercises, including business-tester mobilisation, readiness management, daily execution governance, defect triage, acceptance evidence and sign-off coordination. 
 - SAP, ISTQB, test-management or UiPath certification is advantageous but not required; retail-industry experience is beneficial. Ways of working

- Strong analytical and risk-based mindset, with the ability to distinguish critical quality issues from lower-priority findings and explain the rationale clearly. 
 - Highly structured and dependable approach to planning, governance, documentation, follow-up and escalation. 
 - Clear and articulate communication with business, functional and technical stakeholders at different levels of seniority. 
 - Confident facilitation skills and the ability to challenge constructively, secure commitments and drive cross-team topics to closure. 
 - Calm and pragmatic behaviour under delivery pressure, combined with a high level of ownership and attention to evidence and detail. 
 - Excellent written and spoken English; willingness and ability to travel when required. 

Additional Information

Measures of success

- Test scope, plans, responsibilities, dependencies and quality gates are agreed early and remain aligned with LUCA milestones. 
 - Requirements and critical business processes have transparent, evidence-based test coverage across SAP Finance, SAP Ariba and connected systems. 
 - Test cycles start with appropriate script, data, environment and resource readiness, reducing avoidable execution delays. 
 - Defects are documented consistently, prioritised appropriately and resolved or accepted with transparent residual risk. 
 - Stakeholders receive reliable reporting and recommendations to support test completion and go-live decisions. 
 - Reusable manual and automated regression assets improve quality and efficiency across successive LUCA rollout waves. 
 - The SI delivers agreed test assets and services on time and at the required quality, with transparent remediation where commitments are at risk. 
 - UAT is appropriately prepared, actively governed and concluded with clear business acceptance evidence and transparent residual risk. 
 - Test governance and delivery from METRO Digital India are fully integrated with the overall LUCA Test Management team.

data.description:

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work - whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. 

Your future team

The Analytics Platform (AP) powers data experiences embedded across Atlassian products, from product reporting and dashboarding to reusable charts, filters, and insights. 

Our mission is to make it easy for product teams to build trustworthy, intuitive analytics experiences without each team having to reinvent charting, dashboard infrastructure, data interaction patterns, or operational foundations. AP provides the shared canvas, components, APIs, and developer platform that turn governed data into customer value. 

As a Senior Principal Engineer, you will set the technical direction for AP: a highly reusable visualisation platform that serves both product teams building embedded experiences and customers making decisions through data. You will work closely with Analytics Platform to ensure the journey from data to insight is fast, reliable, secure, and coherent.

- Define and lead the multi-year technical strategy for a shared analytics platform used across Atlassian products. 
 - Evolve AP's core capabilities: charting libraries, dashboard canvas and editing experiences, global filters, templates, permissions, data interaction patterns, and embedding APIs. 
 - Establish a durable developer-platform model so product teams can integrate AP quickly while retaining the flexibility they need for domain-specific data, configuration, and experiences. 
 - Partner with other data teams, product, design, and AI teams to create a consistent path from governed data and semantic definitions to useful visual and AI-assisted insights. 
 - Lead architectural decisions across frontend performance, query experience, data contracts, visualisation rendering, accessibility, and multi-product extensibility. 
 - Simplify fragmented reporting and dashboard solutions, creating clear migration paths toward a consistent, modern analytics experience. 
 - Set a high bar for customer trust: chart correctness, filtering accuracy, data freshness, query latency, availability, security, and observability. 
 - Make hard trade-offs between a globally consistent platform and product-specific flexibility-and make those trade-offs legible to senior leaders. 
 - Influence architecture and execution across several teams; mentor senior technical leaders and raise the engineering bar across AVP. 

Compensation

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range. 

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity. 

Qualifications

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers.

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
 - Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects across environments

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate with developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads

Qualifications

Why Husky?

data.title: Software Development Engineer - Test
data.description:
At Penguin Solutions (Nasdaq: PENG) - The AI Factory Platform Company - we're building a team of innovators who thrive on collaboration, creativity, and the opportunity to help shape the future of AI. As part of the AI technology revolution, our teams design, build, deploy, and manage AI factories for enterprises, sovereign AI initiatives, and neocloud providers worldwide. 

Headquartered in Silicon Valley, California, Penguin Solutions operates globally through a network of R&D, manufacturing, and sales locations. For nearly three decades, we have operated at the intersection of memory and AI/HPC infrastructure. That engineering expertise positions us to power the next generation of AI workloads, from training to inference and agentic AI at scale. 

Penguin Solutions brings together differentiated infrastructure software, advanced memory, compute systems, end-to-end services, and industry-leading partner solutions in a full-stack AI factory platform designed to help customers deploy and scale AI workloads with speed and precision. 

At Penguin Solutions, we value ideas over hierarchy and believe in servant leadership, where leaders enable teams to do their best work. We empower employees to take ownership, drive innovation, and grow through challenging work, continuous learning, and exposure to advanced AI tools and technologies. With flexibility where it matters and a strong focus on outcomes, Penguin Solutions is a place to do your best work, grow your career, and make a meaningful impact. 

Job Overview

Penguin Computing is seeking an experienced AI QA / SDET Engineer to join our Software Engineering team. Penguin Computing's Scyld Software products are used to deploy, provision, manage, and monitor some of the largest computational systems in the world. As we expand these platforms with AI/LLM-powered and agentic capabilities , this role will drive quality engineering across both our core infrastructure software and emerging AI solutions. 

You will join our agile Software team and collaborate closely with Software Engineers, AI Engineers, Product Owners, Product Managers, and other teams across the organization to ensure our software meets the highest standards of quality, reliability, performance, and security . 

The ideal candidate combines a strong foundation in software testing and automation with hands-on knowledge of LLM evaluation, AI agent testing, AI security testing, and modern AI quality methodologies . You will help define testing strategies, build scalable automation and AI evaluation frameworks, and continuously improve our testing processes and tools. 

This role requires strong technical problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work with a high degree of independence. You will have the opportunity to shape our evolving AI quality engineering practice and ensure that both traditional software and AI-powered capabilities are reliable, secure, measurable, and production-ready. 

Roles & Responsibilities

- Define and execute end-to-end QA strategy for software, AI/LLM features, and AI agents. 
 - Design and maintain scalable test automation frameworks covering API, UI, integration, regression, performance, and infrastructure testing. 
 - Build LLM/AI evaluation frameworks and automated evaluation pipelines integrated with CI/CD. 
 - Define evaluation datasets, test scenarios, golden datasets, and quality benchmarks for AI features. 
 - Evaluate LLM outputs for correctness, relevance, groundedness, hallucination, consistency, and task completion . 
 - Implement automated evaluation methodologies including LLM-as-a-Judge , deterministic checks, model-based grading, and human evaluation. 
 - Test AI agents and agentic workflows including reasoning, tool/function calling, multi-step execution, state management, error handling, and recovery. 
 - Validate RAG pipelines , including retrieval quality, context relevance, grounding, citation accuracy, and response quality. 
 - Perform adversarial and security testing of AI systems, including prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage, unsafe tool execution, excessive agency, and access-control violations . 
 - Apply AI security methodologies such as OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and use appropriate AI red-teaming/security testing tools. 
 - Build automated regression suites to identify behavioral and quality degradation across prompt, model, agent, and application changes . 
 - Define AI quality metrics, dashboards, release gates, and acceptance criteria. 
 - Test AI systems across different models and configurations to validate reliability and model-independent behavior. 
 - Replicate customer environments through simulated data and usage patterns for realistic end-to-end testing. 
 - Partner with Software Engineering, AI Engineering, Product, and Architecture teams to embed quality engineering early in the SDLC . 
 - Troubleshoot complex issues across Linux, Kubernetes, networking, infrastructure, and AI application layers. 

AI QA Methodologies & Tools

Experience with one or more of the following is highly desirable: 

- LLM Evaluation: LLM-as-a-Judge, golden datasets, pairwise evaluation, rubric-based scoring, human-in-the-loop evaluation 
 - Evaluation Frameworks: DeepEval, Ragas, Promptfoo, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals or equivalent 
 - Agent Testing: tool/function-call validation, trajectory evaluation, task-completion testing, multi-agent workflow testing 
 - RAG Evaluation: retrieval precision/recall, context relevance, faithfulness/groundedness, answer correctness 
 - AI Security: prompt injection, jailbreak testing, data-exfiltration testing, privilege/access-control testing, adversarial testing 
 - Security Frameworks/Tools: OWASP LLM guidance, Garak, PyRIT, Promptfoo or equivalent AI red-teaming tools 
 - Observability: tracing and evaluation of prompts, model responses, tool calls, agent decisions, latency, token usage, and failures

Qualifications

- Degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent professional experience. 
 - 6-8 years of experience in QA, SDET, software engineering, or test automation. 
 - Strong understanding of QA methodologies, test architecture, and software development lifecycle. 
 - Strong coding/scripting skills in Python ; Bash, JavaScript, or C experience is beneficial. 
 - Experience building automation frameworks and integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines . 
 - Strong Linux command-line, debugging, and troubleshooting skills. 
 - Experience with API, functional, integration, regression, performance, and security testing. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes, containers, and virtualization . 
 - Hands-on exposure to LLMs, Generative AI applications, RAG, AI agents or Agentic AI Platforms . 
 - Understanding of LLM-specific failure modes including hallucination, non-determinism, prompt injection, and unsafe agent behavior. 
 - Experience with Selenium, Playwright, PyTest, or similar testing frameworks. 
 - Knowledge of HPC/AI infrastructure, networking, GPUs, or distributed systems is a plus. 

What Success Looks Like

Build a modern quality engineering practice where traditional software testing and AI evaluation come together , enabling us to ship infrastructure software and AI agents that are reliable, measurable, secure, and safe to operate in production .

Bangalore

data.title: Lead Engineer, AI Quality
data.description:
About Us

Circle is building the world's leading AI-powered, all-in-one platform for digital businesses. We make it possible for creators, coaches, educators, and businesses to bring together their audience with engaging discussions, live streams, events, chat, courses, and payments - all in one place, all under their own brand. 

We're proud to be a fully remote company of around 270 (and growing!) team members from 30+ countries around the world. We seek exceptional individuals around the world, set them up to do the best work of their lives, and in turn, create a meaningful impact in their own lives. We don't track hours, but we do manage for high expectations very closely. We collaborate across time zones, are highly async, and like to document a lot. 

Twice a year, we bring the whole company together in beautiful places around the world for our company offsites. So far, we've hosted offsites in Turkey, Portugal, Mexico, Thailand, Colombia, Italy, Ireland, and more, with still more to come!

Check out our Careers page for more about working at Circle. 

About The Role

The AI Quality engineering team at Circle owns the foundation for measuring, diagnosing, and improving the quality of Circle's AI-powered features. This team focuses on building the infrastructure to measure, diagnose, and improve production AI systems, rather than ML research or model training. 

We're looking for a Lead Engineer to help us build out the evaluation frameworks, observability tooling, and diagnostic infrastructure that tell us whether our AI Agents are working well, where to improve them, and how to make them faster and more cost-efficient. 

This is a hands-on player-coach role. You'll also lead and manage the AI Quality engineering team, with an ambitious and growing roadmap. 

If you're excited about making AI systems work reliably, efficiently, and at scale, this is for you. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Build and own our evaluation infrastructure. Design the CI/CD pipelines, scorers, and datasets that tell us whether Circle's AI agents (planners, tool-callers, and sub-agents) are actually working, from a single tool call to a full multi-turn conversation. 
 - Diagnose exactly where quality breaks down. Trace failures across the agent pipeline including plan creation vs. execution, tool selection, tool trajectory in complex areas like workflows, site builder, and analytics. Turn what you find into prototypes that solve the issue or identify priorities for AI core engineering can help. 
 - Grow the datasets that make evaluation possible. Stand up annotation workflows and build out AI-generated and simulated conversations so we can cover more of the product faster than manual labeling alone. 
 - Run structured experiments across prompts, models, and the agent harness. Evaluate new and open-source models against our production baseline, build the framework we use to decide when to shift models, and chase cost and latency wins through model swaps, caching, and routing by plan complexity. 
 - Lead and grow the AI Quality engineering team. Set technical direction and manage day-to-day priorities, all while staying hands-on in the code yourself. 
 - Partner closely with AI Core engineering. Work with the engineers building Circle's AI products so they have real confidence that their changes are actually improving quality, not just shipping. 

What You'll Need To Be Successful

- 7+ years of experience building and shipping production software, ideally including LLM-powered agents that take real actions in a product. You've worked on complex, tool-using systems (multiple tools, planning or orchestration, sub-agents) not just simple, single-turn assistants, and you can walk us through something you shipped and how you knew it was actually working. 
 - Comfortable in Ruby on Rails / Python or ready to pick them up quickly. Ruby on Rails is our production system and the foundation that Circle's AI Agents are built on and proficiency in Python is a strong plus, especially for the data and evaluation side of the work. 
 - Experience building evaluation or observability infrastructure for ML/AI systems. You've built eval pipelines, scorers, dashboards, or CI/CD for evals before and have experience with evaluation frameworks like Braintrust, LangSmith, or similar. 
 - Experience designing datasets, annotation workflows, or labeling pipelines for ML/AI evaluation. You know how to turn raw examples into a dataset you can trust through human annotation, AI-generated data, or simulation. 
 - Learn fast, experiment aggressively, and thrive in a highly dynamic environment. You'll need to be comfortable running a lot of experiments and letting the results settle the argument, including the ones that don't work (which will be many of them in the beginning). 
 - Comfortable in a fast-paced environment with ambiguity. You'll need to learn and pick up new technologies when projects require it. 
 - Strong alignment with our company values. 
 - You are proficient in English (spoken, written, and reading) at a CEFR Level C2 / ILR Level 5. 

Compensation & Benefits

Circle offers U. S. -benchmarked compensation globally, equity in the company with ongoing refresh grants, and 35 days of paid time off each year. 

We're a remote-only team that comes together twice a year for company retreats in incredible destinations around the world. Alongside incredible flexibility and autonomy, we offer a benefits package that supports health, wellbeing, and professional growth. Learn more in our Candidate Hub.

data.title: Principal Engineer, Test
data.description:
This is where your work makes a difference. 

At Baxter, we believe every person-regardless of who they are or where they are from-deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond. 

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results. 

Here, you will find more than just a job-you will find purpose and pride. 

About Baxter

Baxter provides a broad portfolio of essential renal and hospital products, including home, acute and in-center dialysis; sterile IV solutions; infusion systems and devices; parenteral nutrition; surgery products and anesthetics; and pharmacy automation, software and services. The company's global footprint and the critical nature of its products and services play a key role in expanding access to healthcare in emerging and developed countries. Baxter's employees worldwide

are building upon the company's rich heritage of medical breakthroughs to advance the next generation of healthcare innovations that enable patient care. 

Job Summary

- Job Title - Principal Eng, Test
 - Location - Whitefield, Bangalore

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

- Lead the verification team to understand fully the design specification; design a verification environment and interact with design engineers to identify important verification scenarios. 
 - Lead the development of tests and the creation of top-level and block-level test-benches, stimulus and coverage metrics. 
 - Coordinate the debug process of failing test cases along with the design team. 
 - Ensure delivery of verified design blocks for sign-off, meeting defined functionality, performance and coverage requirements. Drive improvements in test execution, quality and delivery. 
 - Lead the development and documentation of product test case. 
 - Identifying Testing Risks and own the Risk Mitigation Plans. 
 - Work within Agile team to deliver quality products as one team
 - Guide the team on proper verification approach
 - Assist/guide in authoring, reviewing and execution of verification test cases
 - Provide input to Trace Matrix to ensure the traceability of the requirements to tests is intact
 - Co-ordinate the verification activities during SDLC
 - Compile Verification Test Summary Report at conclusion of formal verification phase for submission

Qualifications

- Ability to lead small to medium sized team technically and raising his/her own performance and others from time to time
 - A demonstrated track record in regulated software development, preferably medical devices or other highly regulated products such as aviation software. 
 - Experience in executing verification strategies including and not limited to functional, non-functional, reliability, performance. 
 - Experience in re-defining test architecture and test automation frameworks
 - Experience working in an Agile/Scrum development process
 - Experienced and demonstrated superior global collaboration
 - Demonstrates spirit of innovation
 - Demonstrated risk taking ability and challenging status quo

Desired Characteristics

- Hand's on experience on defining the test strategy and test architecture for software applications
 - Minimum 3+ years practical software QA experience (
 - Excellent planning and organization skills, and committed to delivering on aggressive deadlines
 - Expertise in ALM and JIRA tool
 - Knowledge of Clear Quest, Team Center is preferred
 - Strong communication skills - written & verbal
 - Strong interpersonal skills with ability to work in a collaborative environment as well as independently with minimal supervision
 - Experience in Test Automation with Selenium is preferred
 - Knowledge of medical device software development is highly preferred including knowledge of standards such as IEC 62304, ISO 14971

Background And/or Experience

Bachelors / Masters in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering or related field and 10+ years of related experience. 

Equal Employment Opportunity

Baxter is an equal opportunity employer. Baxter evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic. 

Reasonable Accommodations

Baxter is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities globally. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or interview process, please click on the link here and let us know the nature of your request along with your contact information. 

Recruitment Fraud Notice

Baxter has discovered incidents of employment scams, where fraudulent parties pose as Baxter employees, recruiters, or other agents, and engage with online job seekers in an attempt to steal personal and/or financial information. To learn how you can protect yourself, review our Recruitment Fraud Notice.

data.title: Director, Integrated Modeling Solutions
data.description:
PFI Innovation Centre India is an exciting new innovation center. We're building a future that helps people live better lives longer - and we're looking for bold thinkers and team players to help us do it. 

Here, you'll tackle complex challenges, collaborate with brilliant minds across the globe, and grow your career while helping millions achieve financial security. 

a Purpose Driven Company - 150 Years

While the PFI Innovation Centre brand is new to India, you'll be a part of the Prudential Financial, Inc. family. Founded in Newark, NJ, we serve 50 million customers across more than 50 countries. With $1. 334 trillion in assets, we're a global leader in institutional asset management. The 2nd largest life insurer in the US and the 9th largest institutional global asset manager. 

At the PFI Innovation Centre India, you'll find high-performance culture that's flexible, collaborative, and grounded in respect. We engage with candor, take calibrated risks, and hold ourselves accountable - always focused on delivering for our customers. It's the standard we choose every day as we grow, perform, and win as one team. We offer valuable leadership, mentoring and learning opportunities, paired with flexibility and support to help you thrive. 

Whether you're just starting out or ready to take your next step, we'll help you grow with purpose and do the best work of your career. 

What You Will Do

Based in India, the Director, Integrated Modeling Solutions will lead the team responsible for the architecture, design, development, testing, governance, and delivery of Prudential's strategic PyVal and Eureka! modeling platforms. This role combines deep financial or actuarial modeling expertise with modern software engineering, people leadership, and disciplined execution to advance an integrated global modeling ecosystem supporting valuation, forecasting, capital management, asset liability management, reinsurance analysis, and strategic decision-making. 

What You Can Expect

- Set the technical direction and actionable roadmap for assigned PyVal and Eureka! capabilities, and lead the architecture, design, development, testing, and controlled deployment of scalable Python-based modeling solutions. 
 - Translate global priorities into a sequenced portfolio of model development, enhancement, and remediation work, managing scope, capacity, dependencies, risks, releases, and delivery commitments across concurrent initiatives. 
 - Maintain rigorous model governance and controls across model logic, assumptions, data lineage, documentation, testing, access, release management, validation, and production support. 
 - Lead, coach, and build a high-performing India-based modeling team, strengthening capability across actuarial and financial modeling, Python engineering, insurance products, governance, and stakeholder management. 
 - Serve as a trusted partner to senior leaders across Finance, Actuarial, Investments, Treasury, Risk, Technology, and business teams, clearly communicating model insights, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations. 

What You Will Bring

- Bachelor's degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field. 
 - Fellowship credential from the Society of Actuaries, Institute and Faculty of Actuaries, Institute of Actuaries of India, or an equivalent recognized actuarial body. 
 - Ten or more years of relevant experience in actuarial modeling, financial modeling, quantitative risk, insurance finance, or a related discipline. 
 - Demonstrated people leadership and experience leading complex model development, transformation, or platform modernization initiatives across multiple stakeholders. 
 - Advanced Python expertise, strong knowledge of modern software development practices for controlled financial or actuarial models, and strong executive communication and decision-making skills. 

What will set you apart?

- Deep experience in life insurance, annuities, retirement, reinsurance, institutional products, or related insurance businesses. 
 - Experience with valuation, forecasting, asset liability management, capital planning, liquidity risk, stress testing, or strategic asset allocation. 
 - Knowledge of US GAAP, US statutory reporting, Bermuda EBS or BSCR, or comparable insurance accounting and regulatory frameworks. 
 - Experience with Prophet, MoSes, or comparable projection systems. 
 - Experience with cloud-enabled platforms, Git-based development, automated testing, continuous integration and deployment, data architecture, or Agile portfolio delivery. 
 - Experience building or expanding a modeling, analytics, actuarial, or finance capability within a global capability center. 
 - *PFI Innovation Centre India welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply.

data.description:
About Us

As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400, 000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. At Target, we have a timeless purpose and a proven strategy and that hasn't happened by accident. Some of the best minds from diverse backgrounds come together at Target to redefine retail in an inclusive learning environment that values people and delivers world-class outcomes. That winning formula is especially apparent in Bengaluru, where Target in India operates as a fully integrated part of Target's global team and has more than 4, 000 team members supporting the company's global strategy and operations. 

Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect and striving to make the most meaningful and positive impact. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values diverse backgrounds. We believe your unique perspective is important, and you'll build relationships by being authentic and respectful. At Target, inclusion is part of the core value. We aim to create equitable experiences for all, regardless of their dimensions of difference. As an equal opportunity employer, Target provides diverse opportunities for everyone to grow and win

Team Overview

Managed Kubernetes is part of Target Infrastructure Services, providing the foundational container platform for deploying and operating applications across Target data centers and public cloud environments. The platform enables engineering teams to build and operate scalable, reliable services without having to manage the complexity of the underlying Kubernetes infrastructure. Through API- and UI-driven automation, teams can provision, upgrade, and manage Kubernetes clusters at scale across on-premises and cloud environments. The platform also provides curated capabilities for security, observability, compliance, and resiliency. By providing a consistent Kubernetes experience across Target data centers and public cloud, Managed Kubernetes reduces operational complexity, improves reliability, and accelerates application and platform development across Target. 

Position Overview

We are looking for a Senior Engineer - Managed Kubernetes Platform to design, build, and operate reliable cloud-native platform capabilities across public cloud, hybrid cloud, and on-premises environments. In this role, you will own Kubernetes platform components and problem spaces end-to-end, independently solve complex technical and operational problems, and partner with product and engineering teams to deliver secure, scalable, and easy-to-use platform services. You will bring deep Kubernetes and platform engineering expertise, improve how the platform performs in production, and help other engineers grow through technical guidance and constructive feedback. 

Responsibilities

- Own Kubernetes platform services or components through design, implementation, deployment, and production operation; make sound decisions that balance customer needs, reliability, security, maintainability, and delivery constraints. 
 - Build and maintain platform automation, tooling, controllers, and services, primarily using Go (Golang), and contribute production-quality code with appropriate tests and clear operational behavior. 
 - Provision, configure, upgrade, troubleshoot, and optimize Kubernetes clusters and supporting infrastructure across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments, including Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) where applicable. 
 - Design and improve Kubernetes networking and connectivity, including CNI, ingress, services, network policies, load balancing, traffic routing, and service-to-service communication. 
 - Automate infrastructure and platform changes using Infrastructure as Code and Kubernetes tools such as Terraform, Helm, and Kustomize; implement and improve GitOps workflows with Argo CD and/or Flux. 
 - Improve platform observability and operations through useful metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, alerts, health indicators, and service thresholds; use production data to identify patterns and drive reliability and performance improvements. 
 - Design for failure and recovery by establishing clear failure boundaries, applying retries, timeouts, and other appropriate resilience patterns, and ensuring services degrade gracefully. 
 - Participate in and independently manage incidents for owned systems, coordinate investigation and resolution, communicate status clearly, and follow through on root-cause analysis and reliability improvements. 
 - Apply secure-by-default practices to platform services and automation, understand relevant threats, manage secrets appropriately, remediate findings, and work with security and platform partners on effective controls. 
 - Lead technical discussions within the team and collaborate with partner teams on multi-component designs, integrations, operational improvements, and delivery of platform capabilities. 
 - Review code and designs with a focus on quality, testability, security, and operational risk; provide coaching-oriented feedback and mentor engineers in Kubernetes and platform engineering practices. 
 - Document technical evaluations, decisions, runbooks, and operational procedures so that engineers and stakeholders can understand and support the platform. 

Required Skills And Experience

- Strong software development experience in Go (Golang), including the ability to build, test, troubleshoot, and maintain production services or platform tooling. 
 - Hands-on experience designing, administering, and operating Kubernetes platforms, including cluster provisioning, configuration, upgrades, troubleshooting, and production support. 
 - Experience operating Kubernetes on a public cloud platform; GCP and GKE experience is preferred, with AWS, Azure, or equivalent cloud experience also relevant
 - Strong understanding of Kubernetes architecture and networking, including CNI plugins, ingress controllers, Services, Network Policies, load balancing, traffic routing, and connectivity. 
 - Experience with Infrastructure as Code and Kubernetes configuration or deployment tools such as Terraform, Helm, and Kustomize. 
 - Experience implementing GitOps practices using tools such as Argo CD and/or Flux, and building or maintaining CI/CD automation for platform changes. 
 - Experience with platform observability, including metrics, logging, monitoring, alerting, and distributed tracing, and using operational data to diagnose issues and improve services. 
 - Experience administering Linux systems and troubleshooting container runtime or host-level issues. 
 - Working knowledge of Kubernetes storage, including CSI drivers, Persistent Volumes, Persistent Volume Claims, Storage Classes, StatefulSets, and backup or recovery considerations. 
 - Demonstrated ability to independently investigate problems involving multiple connected components or systems, identify root causes, and implement durable improvements. 
 - Ability to communicate technical decisions clearly, collaborate with business and engineering partners, and explain platform concepts to audiences with different levels of technical context. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 5+ years of experience in software engineering, platform engineering, cloud engineering, infrastructure engineering, or a related field, including meaningful hands-on Kubernetes experience. 
 - Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) and/or Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) certification. 
 - Experience with multi-cluster or hybrid Kubernetes environments, cluster lifecycle automation, and platform self-service capabilities. 
 - Experience with disaster recovery planning, performance or capacity testing, and safe release practices such as progressive rollout and rollback. 
 - Experience contributing to shared engineering practices, technical learning, or open-source projects.

data.description:
Senior Software Engineer (Backend) - Payment Orchestration & Platform

Location: Bengaluru, India (hybrid) | Team: Platform Engineering | Level: Senior, Backend Track

OVERVIEW

APEXX is an independent, enterprise payment orchestration platform. Merchants connect to APEXX once and reach the world's payment ecosystem: acquirers, alternative payment methods (APMs), Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) providers and network tokenisation. Our routing engine (AIRE), cascading, Smart Split and Revenue Protect decide in milliseconds where each transaction should go to maximise acceptance and minimise cost. We don't own an acquirer, so our only incentive is the merchant's outcome. 

We're backed by MMC, Forward Partners, Alliance VC & Finch Capital and growing with enterprise travel and eCommerce merchants including Jet2, TUI, Ryanair, CarTrawler and Hotelbeds. 

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer in Bengluru to help build and run the core of that platform. 

This role covers everything in orchestration - payment flows, routing, connectors, tokenisation, webhooks and reconciliation - and how we run the platform: reliability, on-call, CI/CD and shared engineering practices. We build it, we run it, and done means released, not dev-complete. 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Own core payment flows end to end: authorisation, capture, refund, void and MIT/recurring across card and APM rails, from design doc to production and beyond. 
 - Evolve our routing and recovery logic: rules-based and data-driven routing, decline cascading, Smart Split and outage failover - making sure a retry never becomes a double charge. 
 - Build and maintain connectors to acquirers, APMs and BNPL providers: normalise responses, handle API version drift and design for partner outages. 
 - Design for correctness under failure: idempotency, timeouts, ambiguous payment states, asynchronous notifications and webhooks, and reconciliation against settlement files. 
 - Protect cardholder data: work within our tokenisation and vault services, HSM-backed cryptography and PCI DSS, SOC 2 and ISO 27001 controls, keeping PCI scope as small as possible. 
 - Run the platform: join the on-call rotation, define and track SLOs and service dashboards, write runbooks, lead incidents and blameless RCAs, and improve our GitLab CI/CD and AWS estate (ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3). 
 - Raise the bar with the team: write technical design docs, give high-quality code reviews, mentor engineers and help us modernise our stack, including our move to Java 17 and newer Spring Boot. 
 - Work across the business with Product, Solutions, Support and our UK colleagues, turning merchant and partner needs into reliable systems. 

ABOUT YOU

- Significant experience building and running production backend services in Java and Spring Boot, or a comparable JVM or backend stack and a willingness to move to ours. 
 - A strong grasp of distributed-systems failure modes: retries, idempotency, timeouts, concurrency, eventual consistency, and how to reason about "we don't know if it happened". 
 - Solid PostgreSQL skills (schema design, transactions and isolation, query tuning) and practical use of Redis or similar caches. 
 - Hands-on AWS experience and comfort with CI/CD, containers and infrastructure-as-code. 
 - You've owned services in production: on-call, debugging with logs, metrics and traces, leading incidents and writing up what the team learned. 
 - Clear written communication: design docs, runbooks, RCAs and merge request descriptions that others can act on. 
 - You use AI coding tools productively and critically: you know when to trust the output, and you verify it with tests and review before it ships. 
 - You help the people around you get better through review, pairing and mentoring. 

NICE TO HAVE

- Payments experience: card acquiring, 3DS2/SCA, network tokens, APMs/BNPL, settlement and reconciliation, or payment orchestration. 
 - Working knowledge of PCI DSS, HSMs and key management, or OAuth2/mTLS for partner integrations. 
 - Observability tooling, SLO-based alerting, or analytics stacks such as Snowflake or QuickSight. 
 - Experience in a Scale-up or Fintech working with UK or global teams. 

HOW WE HIRE

Four conversations: 

- a talent screen, 
 - a conversation with the hiring manager, 
 - a hands-on technical session and
 - a system design session. 

Before your first interview, we'll send you a short guide on how to prepare for each round. You're welcome to use your own AI tools in both technical rounds - we're interested in how you think, verify and decide. Once a decision is made, every candidate receives a written feed-forward from the panel. Tell us about any adjustments you need and we'll make them. 

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

- Competitive compensation that recognises your skills, experience and impact. 
 - Generous time off: annual leave, public holidays and wellbeing-focused time away from work. 
 - Work From Anywhere: up to 90 days a year from eligible locations, subject to our policy. 
 - Comprehensive health insurance for you and your loved ones. 
 - Personal accident insurance for when it's needed most. 
 - Enhanced family leave: enhanced parental and family-friendly leave policies. 
 - Learning & growth: opportunities to learn, grow and build a meaningful career at APEXX. 

WHO WE ARE & WHERE WE ARE

APEXX is a global payment orchestration platform with teams in the UK and India. For more than a decade we've helped enterprise businesses simplify payments through a single, scalable integration, with access to 200+ acquirers, 150+ alternative payment methods and 10+ BNPL providers. We're trusted by leading global brands including Ryanair, TUI, Hotelbeds, CarTrawler, Avon and Jet2. 

APEXX is an equal opportunities employer committed to equality, diversity and inclusion. 

We do not accept speculative CVs or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies.

 - Speak directly with clients on calls, email, and WhatsApp: understand their business, goals, and problems, translate them into a clear growth plan, and explain progress and results in plain English. 
 - Conduct detailed website audits, keyword and audience research, and competitor analysis to identify growth opportunities, and justify every recommendation with data and clear reasoning. 
 - Plan and execute search, AI visibility (AEO/GEO), content, and technical website strategies for multiple UK and international client accounts. 
 - Take full ownership of assigned accounts and run them end to end, from planning and execution through to reporting and client updates, while coordinating with the content, design, and development teams on larger projects. 
 - Use tools such as Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, Google Search Console, and Google Analytics to track and improve performance. Our tool stack is chosen per project, so you should be able to pick up new tools quickly. 
 - Build, document, and maintain AI-powered automations for repetitive daily tasks, such as meta description generation, backlink tracking, brand-mention alerts, rank and index monitoring, internal linking checks, and client reporting. 
 - Review and audit every AI-generated output before it goes live, checking factual accuracy, hallucinated data, search intent match, tone, duplication, and E-E-A-T compliance. You own the output, not the tool. 
 - When rankings drop, traffic falls, or something breaks, investigate the root cause, propose a fix, and see it through, rather than waiting to be told what to do. 
 - Identify manual, repetitive tasks across your own and your team's workflow and progressively automate them, reducing the hours they consume month on month. 
 - Write, test, and refine prompts, and maintain a reusable prompt and SOP library that the wider team can use.

 - Produce monthly reports that connect traffic, keyword growth, and rankings to real business outcomes such as enquiries and leads, not vanity metrics.

 - Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to balance rapid delivery with high-quality standards.

Automation-First Quality Strategy

Manual, Exploratory & Scenario-Based Testing

- Conduct high-quality manual and exploratory testing to cover scenarios where automation is not yet feasible.

Cross-Team Collaboration

- Work collaboratively with Product, Engineering, AgenticOps, RAG & AI teams to ensure cohesive quality standards.

We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

Lead Data Engineer

Who is Mastercard?

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. 

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all. 

Overview

Mastercard is seeking a Lead Data Engineer to join our team in Hyderabad, India. This is a senior individual-contributor and technical leadership role that drives design standards and guides a team's engineering practices. It will appeal to you if you combine deep technical mastery with the ability to lead the technical direction of a team and elevate its overall engineering quality. 

You will set the technical bar for how we build and operate data platforms at scale, balancing hands-on architecture with team leadership. Our teams are small, agile, and focused on the needs of the high growth fintech marketplace, and you will work across functional teams within Mastercard to deliver on our cloud strategy. 

Key Responsibilities

Set and enforce design standards, patterns, and best practices for pipelines built on Databricks, Spark, Python, PySpark, and dbt. 

Provide technical leadership and direction to a team of engineers, owning architecture and design reviews. 

Lead the design of CI/CD (GitLab, Jenkins), DataOps, and data observability strategy for the team. 

Own Databricks platform administration standards and deployment governance using Databricks Asset Bundles. 

Drive resolution of complex technical challenges across pipelines and the platform. 

Mentor and grow engineers, establishing a strong code review and quality culture. 

Partner with product and stakeholders on roadmap, prioritization, and technical trade-offs. 

Own the deployment, migration, and upgrade strategy for the team's data platforms. 

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science or a related technical field. 

8+ years of data engineering experience, including demonstrated technical leadership. 

Expert hands-on experience with Databricks (including administration), Spark, Python, and PySpark. 

Deep dbt/TDD and CI/CD (GitLab, Jenkins) expertise. 

Proven ability to define engineering standards and lead a team's practices. 

Strong architecture and platform ownership across observability, cost, and performance. 

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. 

Ideally you have experience in banking, e-commerce, credit cards or payment processing and exposure to both SaaS and premises-based architectures. In addition, you have a post-secondary degree in computer science, mathematics, or quantitative science. 

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

data.title: Technology Architect
data.description:
Project Role : Technology Architect

Project Role Description : Design and deliver technology architecture for a platform, product, or engagement. Define solutions to meet performance, capability, and scalability needs. 

Must have skills : Automotive Digital Cockpit Solutions

Good to have skills : NA

Minimum 12 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required

Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Summary: 

Leads a squad of engineers delivering a defined slice of the vehicle abstraction stack - for example, the VHAL core and property store, the SOME/IP-to-VHAL bridge, or the Car Framework extensions. Translates the architecture into concrete designs, owns the squad's technical quality and delivery commitment, and remains a hands-on contributor on the hardest parts of the codebase. 

Roles & Responsibilities: 

Design & Hands-on Engineering: 

- Produce detailed design documents for assigned components: class/interface design, threading and concurrency model, property-config data model, error and timeout semantics, memory ownership. 
 - Personally implement or co-implement the most complex or risk-bearing parts: the IVehicle AIDL service skeleton, subscription manager, VehiclePropertyStore concurrency, the vsomeip client integration, the CAN signal-to-property mapping engine. 
 - Own the vendor property ID allocation scheme and the property-config JSON/ARXML generation pipeline for the squad's domain. 
 - Define and enforce the squad's performance budgets: property get/set latency, callback fan-out cost, IPC overhead, boot-time contribution, memory footprint. 
 - Android property operations to real vehicle interfaces. ( Common API, SOME/IP, CAPI style plugin, Handler Integration), Sync/Async Boardnet communication understanding. 
 - Release Management on Component artifactory and App Store. 
 - Complete Automotive domain knowledge. 

Integration & Cross-team: 

- Drive integration with the vehicle network layer: agree signal catalogues with the E/E and Tier-1 teams, resolve semantic mismatches (units, ranges, signal validity/error qualifiers, timeouts, not available handling). 
 - Own the SOME/IP contract for the squad: service/instance/method/event IDs, vsomeip configuration, service discovery behaviour, serialisation alignment with CommonAPI or the OEM IDL, E2E protection where applicable. 
 - Coordinate with app and framework teams consuming the properties review their CarPropertyManager usage patterns for subscription-rate and error-handling correctness. 

Team Leadership: 

- Break down features into level-appropriate tasks assign, estimate and track to sprint and milestone commitments. 
 - Run code review as the final gate for the squad's merge maintain the review standard (no unreviewed vendor-partition or SELinux change). 
 - Mentor engineers own their technical growth plans and provide performance input. 
 - Own the squad's defect triage, root-cause analysis discipline, and technical debt backlog. 

Quality & Compliance: 

- Own VTS coverage for the squad's HAL surface and ensure new properties ship with tests. 
 - Author and review SELinux policy for the squad's services and device nodes ensure no permissive domains or blanket allow rules reach production. 
 - Ensure ASPICE traceability: requirement , design , code , test linkage for the squad's deliverables. 

Professional & Technical Skills: 

- 10+ years total, 6+ years in Android platform/AOSP, with demonstrable VHAL or comparable HAL ownership. 
 - Advanced HAL implementation skills: has written or substantially modified an AIDL/HIDL HAL, including VINTF manifest entries, init. rc service definition, and vendor/system partition placement. 
 - Advanced C++ (17 or 20): RAII, move semantics, std: : concurrency, lock-free or carefully-locked shared state, profiling with perf/simpleperf, sanitizers (ASan, TSan, UBSan). 
 - Strong Java and Kotlin for Car Framework and system-service work understands Binder threading, oneway semantics, and SystemServer lifecycle. 
 - Strong AOSP skills: Soong modules, repo workflows on a multi-manifest tree, incremental builds, lunch targets, flashing/fastboot, adb-based debugging, dumpsys, bugreport analysis. 
 - Solid SELinux: writing . te files, file contexts, hwservice contexts, property contexts, diagnosing denials from audit2allow while resisting the temptation to over-grant. 
 - Practical onboard-network experience: SocketCAN, candump/cansend, DBC files, CAN-FD framing, Automotive Ethernet basics, Wireshark analysis of SOME/IP traffic. 
 - Working experience with SOME/IP stacks (vsomeip, CommonAPI or a commercial equivalent) and their configuration model. 
 - C++. Java, Kotlin, Rust, Python , Bash

Good to have: 

- Experience leading a distributed team across time zones. 
 - Exposure to HIL/SIL test rigs and restbus simulation (CANoe, CANalyzer, or equivalent). 
 - Experience migrating a HIDL VHAL to the AIDL VHAL interface. 

Additional Information: 

- The candidate should have minimum 12 years of experience in Automotive Digital Cockpit Solutions. 
 - This position is based at our Bengaluru office. 
 - A 15 years full time education is required.

data.title: Data Engineering Operations Lead
data.description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice

Team Overview

We are looking for a Data Engineering Operations Lead to join our growing Data Engineering and Analytics Practice who will drive building next generation suite of products and platforms by designing, coding, building, and deploying highly scalable and robust data solutions. The team reports to the Head of Data Engineering & Analytics and is part of the wider Global Technology function. This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week. 

Role Overview And Core Responsibilities

The role exists to own and manage the internal function responsible for development, support and operation of our ingestion pipelines as well as the assets created and owned by the team across our cloud (GCP) and on-premises environments. As Data Engineering Operations lead, you will be responsible to ensure the quality and robustness of the developed pipelines, operational resilience, SLA compliance for all of our main data assets created by our team. As a lead engineer most of your time will be spent on hands-on engineering work with expected ~25% spent on operational activities. 

Responsibilities Include

- Own and manage daily Data Engineering operations, including data ingestion workflows, pipeline monitoring, and incident resolution. 
 - Oversee end-to-end pipeline health - proactively monitor, triage, and resolve failures, bottlenecks, and data quality issues across all ingestion layers. 
 - Organize and prioritize the engineering operations function's daily workload - assign tasks, track progress, and remove blockers to ensure smooth operational delivery. 
 - Maintain and improve ingestion pipelines from various data sources into data lakes, warehouses, and real-time streaming systems. 
 - Act as the first point of escalation for pipeline failures, SLA breaches, and data anomalies - driving root cause analysis and permanent fixes. 
 - Define and enforce operational standards - runbooks, alerting thresholds, on-call procedures, and incident management practices. 
 - Coordinate with upstream data providers and downstream consumers to manage dependencies and communicate pipeline status. 
 - Lead daily stand-ups and work organization for the function under the wider Data Engineering practice. 
 - Mentor and guide junior engineers on operational best practices, debugging, and pipeline development. 
 - Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and product partners to onboard new data sources and meet ingestion SLAs. 
 - Drive continuous improvement in pipeline reliability, observability, and efficiency. 
 - Implement best practices in data governance, data quality monitoring, and compliance across all pipelines. 
 - Design, build, test, and deploy Data solutions at scale, including data lakes, data warehouses, and real-time analytics. 
 - Lead technical delivery on use cases, plan and delegate tasks to junior team members, and oversee work from inception to final product. 

Required Knowledge And Experiences

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics or a related field
 - 10 years of data engineering experience with at least 3 years in lead roles. 
 - 6+ years of experience in Big Data technologies (e. g. , Spark, Hive, Hadoop, Databricks). 
 - Excellent knowledge of data engineering concepts and best practices. 
 - Proven experience leading, mentoring and supporting junior team members. 
 - Ability to lead technical deliverables autonomously and guide junior data engineers. 
 - Ability to organize and manage daily engineering workload - task assignment, prioritization, and delivery tracking. 
 - Strong attention to detail and adherence to best practices and defined policies. 

Essential Technical Skills

- Advanced proficiency with Apache Spark (PySpark) including tuning and performance optimisation experience. 
 - Proficiency in Python, Pandas (Scala/Java knowledge is desirable). 
 - Working knowledge of Apache Hive. 
 - Strong SQL knowledge and experience (T-SQL, working with SQL Server, SSMS, GCP BigQuery). 
 - Expertise in designing and implementing scalable data pipelines and ETL processes using the GCP data stack, including BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Cloud Composer, Cloud Functions, Dataproc (Spark). 
 - Experience with batch, real-time streaming, and ETL processes, including incident resolution and pipeline recovery. 
 - Experience building and managing ETL workflows using Apache Airflow, including DAG creation, scheduling, and error handling. 
 - Source control with Git. 
 - Knowledge of CI/CD concepts and experience designing CI/CD for data pipelines. 
 - Knowledge of Delta Lake concepts and common data formats, Lakehouse architecture. 
 - Software engineering principles including OOP, design patterns, SDLC, Agile, TDD, and performance optimization. 

Desirable Technical Skills

- Experience designing logical data models and physical data models, including data warehouse and data mart designs. 
 - Relevant certifications (e. g. Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer). 
 - Experience with streaming services such as Kafka is a plus. 
 - R & Sparklyr experience is a plus. 
 - Knowledge of MLOps concepts, AI/ML lifecycle management, and MLflow. 
 - Harness experience is a plus. 

We're also looking for the preferred skills below. Whether you are proficient or could use

some brushing up, we're happy to support your career development and growth in: 

- AI engineering fundamentals. 
 - GCP Certificatns

TransUnion Overview

At TransUnion, we encourage and are committed to creating a real, positive impact and shared sense of purpose within our Workforce for Good, which empowers our people to grow, innovate and contribute to a better future for our communities and customers. We strive to build an environment where our associates are in the driver's seat of their professional development- while having access to help along the way. We recognize that success comes when our associates thrive both professionally and personally; that's why we prioritize work/life flexibility and offer resources for our teams across the globe to collaborate and drive excellence. 

Be a part of our Workforce for Good - you'll work with great people, pioneering products and cutting-edge technology.
