The Arctic Wolf security operations platform ingests and processes upwards of 250 billion events a day from a wide variety of on-premise devices and cloud platforms. The security pipeline is a distributed system of loosely-coupled microservices that constitute our real-time analysis and threat detection systems. These services distill the incoming events into actionable intelligence that our Concierge Security Teams use to protect customers. 

We are growing rapidly, with our data volume increasing ten-fold roughly every two years. We are looking for experienced developers to join our pack and work with us to continuously evolve and expand the capabilities of our security platform. This particular role focuses on building components of our Managed Risk Platform. 

You Will

- Create and scale high-performance services in a real-time threat analysis pipeline
 - Architect, design, develop, test and deliver software in an agile environment
 - Deploy containerised services to production within hours after your changes are merged, in keeping with our culture of Continuous Integration and Infrastructure-as-Code

Golang, Docker, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Kubernetes/EKS, PostgresSQL, Kafka, Java, Linux

- Excited to work at the intersection of Big Data and the Cybersecurity problem spaces

You will be successful in this role if you have: 

Required Qualifications

- 10-15 years of overall IT experience, with substantial hands-on experience in ServiceNow engineering and administration

data.title: Principal GenAI & Agentic AI Engineer
data.description:
The Principal GenAI & Agentic AI Engineer is the technical leader responsible for designing, building, and scaling AI systems that combine LLM-powered GenAI and ADK-based agentic workflows on Google Cloud Platform. This role also requires leading and developing data pipelines for necessary data layer for AI/ML. This role sets architecture standards, leads multi-team delivery, and governs safety, reliability, and cost at enterprise scale-accelerating product teams to achieve monetization of AI based products through reusable patterns, platforms, and guardrails. 

Key Responsibilities

Strategy & Architecture

- Define reference architectures for GenAI apps, RAG systems, and agent ecosystems (single/multi-agent) on GCP using ADK. 
 - Leverage capabilities of Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform in the Agentic AI Product development. 
 - Establish domain and platform standards: model selection, RAG/generation patterns, memory architectures, security baselines, observability, and LLMOps. 
 - Lead portfolio-wide technical decisions (build/buy, vendor selection, SLAs, quotas) with a focus on reliability, safety, and cost control. 
 - Define the data pipeline development for lakehouse, delta lake or feature engineering. 

Solution Design & Delivery

- Architect and lead implementation of production-grade GenAI solutions (Vertex AI models, Grounding, Pipelines, Evaluation) and agentic services (planning, tools, memory, HIL). 
 - Design multi-tenant and hub-and-spoke patterns with Okta/IAP/Apigee for secure API exposure and tenant isolation. 
 - Drive end-to-end delivery across teams: data ingestion (Dataflow/Composer), indexing (BigQuery vectors/Vertex Vector Search), services (Cloud Run/Workflows), events (Pub/Sub). 
 - Data Pipeline both near real time and batch. 

Platformization & Reuse

- Build and maintain prompt libraries, tool catalogs, agent templates, and evaluation harnesses for organization-wide reuse. 
 - Standardize LLMOps: CI/CD for prompts/models/agents, model registry, traceability, rollback, canaries, cost/performance scorecards. 
 - Enable a marketplace of agents/services with productized APIs, documentation, chargeback, and KPIs. 

Responsible AI, Security & Compliance

- Implement multi-layer guardrails: policy prompts, filters, memory governance, tool whitelisting, audit logs; ensure regulator-ready posture. 
 - Codify privacy, PII handling, data residency, and per-tenant isolation using VPC-SC, Secret Manager, IAM, and Apigee policies. 

Leadership & Enablement

- Mentor senior engineers and team leads; run architecture reviews, design clinics, and red-team exercises. 
 - Drive continuous evaluation programs and publish org scorecards for quality, safety, and cost. 
 - Partner with Product, Security, and SRE to align roadmaps, SLOs, and operational playbooks. 

Required Technical Competencies

- Dataflow and Apache Beam for data pipeline development. 
 - Strong on using SQL for data analysis. 
 - LLM & GenAI: Model selection (Gemini & Model Garden), prompt engineering, RAG/grounding, multimodal pipelines, fine-tuning/adapter methods. 
 - Agentic AI (ADK): Agent loops, planners, tool/function design, memory (episodic/semantic/long-term), HIL, policy enforcement. 
 - Data & Retrieval: BigQuery (including vector functions), Vertex Vector Search, Document AI, Dataplex for lineage and governance. 
 - Orchestration & Services: Cloud Run, Workflows, Pub/Sub, Dataflow/Composer; HA/DR, backpressure, circuit breakers. 
 - LLMOps/MLOps: Vertex AI Pipelines, registry, CI/CD, trace correlation, cost/performance monitoring. 
 - Security & Compliance: IAM, Secret Manager, VPC-SC, private service connect, DLP, Okta/IAP, Apigee API policies. 
 - Observability & Cost: Central telemetry, user feedback loops, drift/outlier detection, quota/capacity planning. 

Qualifications

- 12-15+ years in software/data/ML engineering; 1+ years hands-on with LLMs/GenAI and agentic systems. 
 - Proven delivery of enterprise-scale GenAI/agent platforms on GCP (Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Workflows). 
 - Demonstrated impact in platformization, governance, and multi-team technical leadership. 
 - Strong proficiency in Java. 
 - Strong proficiency in Python/TypeScript (or equivalent) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/GCP Deployment Manager). 
 - Experience in security-by-design, privacy, and compliance audits. 
 - Proven delivery in building data pipeline using distributed computing frameworks such as Dataflow, Spark.

SONiC is an open source network operating system based on Linux that runs on switches from multiple vendors and ASICs. SONiC offers a full-suite of network functionality, like BGP and RDMA, that has been production-hardened in the data-centers of some of the largest cloud-service providers. About You

- Good understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI concepts, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases, and RAG architectures.

 - Knowledge of AI observability and monitoring concepts. 
 - Understanding of AI security risks including prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage, and model misuse scenarios.

 - Exposure to cloud AI services such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, or OpenAI APIs would be advantageous. 

Feel rewarded

And we'll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work - finding a balance that works for all of us. It's all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. Performance Tester (Contract)

Job Level: Junior (2-3 years of experience)

Nature of Job: Work from Home and Contractual based

About the Company: 

We are a leading technology company passionate about software development for a broad scope of markets, including Aviation, Oil&Gas and Asset Management. The aim of our software is to boost the productivity of our customers via digital work instructions, starting from Task Planning to Task Execution of front-line workers. 

With our product, an open Cloud, Mobile and Wearable platform, we create innovative software solutions, providing technological and analytical services. Our advanced technology (Integration of ATA2200/iSpec2200/S1000D) in Aircraft Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul contributed to our strong international growth and establishing collaborations with the biggest aircraft maintenance companies all over the world. 

Your profile

You bring 2-3 years of hands-on experience in performance testing and thrive in agile, fast-paced environments. You have a solid grasp of performance test strategy and tooling, particularly Apache JMeter, and are comfortable analysing system behaviour under load. You are analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working across cross-functional teams in a remote-first setup. 

You enjoy the challenge of being exposed to different situations, company cultures, aviation domains, and technologies you must master quickly. You will leverage your drive, analytical intellect, and professional skills to help our customers validate the performance of our solutions, and to help us drive our innovations. You show discernment, attention to detail, and want to evolve quickly. Your primary focus will be on designing, scripting, and executing performance test scenarios using Apache JMeter and other related tools. You will work closely with the development, integration, and quality assurance teams to identify non-functional requirements, build load/stress/soak test scripts, and validate system performance ahead of key testing milestones. Additionally, you will analyse performance test results, identify bottlenecks, report defects, and collaborate with the team to resolve issues. 

Your main responsibilities: 

- Design and execute comprehensive performance test scenarios (load, stress, soak, and endurance testing) covering key business transactions
 - Develop and maintain performance test scripts using Apache JMeter or equivalent tools
 - Collaborate with product management, integration, and development teams to define non-functional requirements and performance acceptance criteria
 - Identify, document, and track performance defects and bottlenecks using JIRA; drive resolution in collaboration with developers
 - Participate actively in Scrum ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement of performance testing processes
 - Produce clear performance test reports and dashboards summarising response times, throughput, and resource utilisation for stakeholders

Your qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree / BE / B. Tech or equivalent in a technical field
 - 2-3 years of experience in software QA/testing, with hands-on exposure to performance testing
 - Strong knowledge of performance testing methodologies (load, stress, soak, spike, and endurance testing)
 - Hands-on proficiency with Apache JMeter (Must-Have) for scripting, correlation, and result analysis
 - Working knowledge of Test Estimation, Defect Life Cycle, and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) processes

 - Basic understanding of monitoring/APM tools (e. g. server, database, or network resource monitoring) is a plus
 - Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and excellent written English communication

Joining us means joining a dynamic company driven by its innovations and the interpersonal skills of its employees. You will participate in the development of a growing company, which in return will offer you attractive benefits, innovative projects, and real career opportunities.

data.title: Team Lead, International Accounting
data.description:
Yext (NYSE: YEXT) is the enterprise agentic marketing platform. Built on the world's most comprehensive structured data platform for local businesses, Yext gives brands and their partners the visibility intelligence to win every moment of discovery - across AI and traditional search. Yext's API-first architecture connects structured data to APIs, MCP servers, and generative interfaces, so partners and developers can build purpose-built experiences on the same infrastructure powering Yext's own products. Thousands of brands and digital marketing partners in financial services, healthcare, retail, hospitality, and food rely on Yext to manage, measure, and optimize visibility at scale. For more information, visit yext. com. 

Yext is seeking a Team Lead, International Accounting to join its growing and dynamic International Accounting team. This is a senior, hands-on role that owns statutory accounting, filings, and reporting for a group of Yext's international entities, while reviewing and guiding the team's intercompany and payroll accounting work. This role reports directly to the Sr. Accounting Manager, International Accounting based in India, with a Staff Accountant as a direct report. 

What You'll Do

- Maintain and own statutory accounting, filings, and reporting for assigned entities in compliance with Local GAAP and regulatory requirements
 - Perform and review Local GAAP vs. US GAAP reconciliations for multiple entities, ensuring proper alignment and reporting
 - Prepare and finalize financial statements (FS) in accordance with local regulations and company policies
 - Act as the primary point of contact for statutory auditors; execute audit timelines and prepare and review supporting schedules for audited financial statements
 - Manage ad-hoc regulatory and government filings, including statutory surveys, ensuring accuracy and timely submission
 - Review intercompany transactions and reconciliations across assigned entities, ensuring proper recording, reconciliation, and settlement of balances
 - Review payroll journal entries and reconciliations prepared by the team, and partner with HR/Payroll on payroll-related statutory and compliance matters
 - Support and oversee the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close processes for assigned entities
 - Coach, review, and support Staff Accountants with day-to-day workload and escalations
 - Drive process improvements, standardization, and automation across the International Accounting team
 - Manage, analyze, and reconcile large volumes of data in Excel from various internal systems and the general ledger
 - Support leadership in completing special projects, ad-hoc reporting and analysis requests, and other tasks as assigned

What You Have

- Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) with 6+ years of post-qualification experience
 - Strong working understanding of GAAP / IFRS / Local GAAP, with experience managing statutory reporting and audits for multiple entities
 - Prior experience coaching, reviewing, or managing the work of junior team members
 - Proficient in managing and analyzing large-scale data
 - Ability to identify problems and discrepancies, independently perform research and analysis of causes, and recommend corrective actions
 - Collaborative style with the ability to communicate clearly and precisely on technical and operational issues
 - Must be detail and results-oriented with an ability to work in a cross-functional, fast-paced, and constantly evolving environment
 - Ability to evaluate priorities and multi-task accordingly while keeping others apprised of status with respect to deadlines
 - Excellent written and formal presentation skills
 - Proficient in the Microsoft Office Suite, including MS Excel, Word and Powerpoint
 - Prior experience working in an international business environment
 - Ability and willingness to work shift hours to support the U. S. team during critical close periods, often aligning with U. S. working hours

Bonus Points

- Experience managing statutory reporting and audits in a multinational, GCC, or shared services environment
 - Familiarity with NetSuite, Coupa, Floqast, and Tableau or equivalent systems
 - Prior experience preparing or overseeing intercompany accounting and/or payroll accounting processes

Perks And Benefits

At Yext, we take pride in our diverse workforce and prioritize creating an engaged and connected working environment. Our ambitious mission is to transform the enterprise with AI search, and we know that to achieve that, we need a global team of innovators, visionary thought leaders, and enthusiastic collaborators passionate about making a meaningful impact in the world and contributing to an extraordinary culture. 

Benefits

We believe that people do their best when they feel their best - and to feel their best, they must be well-informed, fuelled, and rested. To ensure our employees are at their best, we offer a wide range of benefits and perks, including: 

- Performance-Based Compensation: We offer an attractive bonus structure and stock options for eligible positions. 
 - Comprehensive Leave Package: Our leave package includes Paid Time Off (PTO), Parental Leave, Sick Leave, Casual Leave, Bereavement Leave, National Holidays, and Floating Holidays to ensure a healthy work-life balance. 
 - Health & Wellness Offerings: We provide medical insurance with 7L coverage, including enhanced parental and outpatient department (OPD) coverage for you, your spouse, two dependent children, and two parents (as applicable and subject to eligibility requirements). 
 - Relocation Benefits: We offer relocation assistance and an allowance to eligible candidates to help ease your transition. 
 - World-Class Office & Building Amenities: Our office has a top-notch infrastructure, including gaming rooms, a plush pantry, and breakout areas. 

Yext is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a results-driven, engaging culture where every employee has the opportunity to contribute to the success of the Company, perform at the highest possible level, and grow their skills and capabilities. Yext welcomes employees and applicants of all backgrounds and demographics, and does not engage in discrimination on the basis of any protected characteristic recognized under applicable law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. The Company believes a broad variety of life experiences across the Yext team is critical to its mission to help every business in the world be visible everywhere customers search. By seeking out fresh perspectives and fostering a positive interview experience and employee experience, Yext can remain at the forefront of innovation, and better serve its customers. 

It is Yext's policy to provide reasonable accommodations to people with disabilities as required by applicable law. If you have a disability that requires an accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, or participating in the employee selection process, please complete this form. 

Security Alert

All legitimate Yext communications come from @yext. com email addresses. Messages from other domains (for example, @yext. team) are not authorized and are likely fraudulent. If you receive a message that seems suspicious, do not share personal information, click on links, or provide payment. Instead, please report the communication to security@yext. com.

In this role, you will provide technical leadership and architectural guidance while developing innovative software solutions that enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. Working in a supportive, multi-functional environment, you will design and implement sophisticated solutions across our product portfolio, from cloud platforms to scientific instrumentation. You will support the growth of other engineers, drive adoption of best practices, and help shape the technical direction of critical projects. This position offers the opportunity to work with advanced technologies while contributing to groundbreaking scientific discoveries. 

Key Responsibilities

- Architect, design, develop, and deliver scalable, secure, and maintainable software solutions for bioprocessing, industrial automation, instrumentation, and process applications. 
 - Develop reusable software components, backend services, REST APIs, integration layers, data pipelines, libraries, and reference architectures for use across multiple products and programs. 
 - Integrate software applications with equipment, instruments, PLC, SCADA, DCS, HMI, historians, MES, sensors, actuators, and enterprise/manufacturing systems using industrial communication technologies. 
 - Design solutions for acquisition, processing, storage, visualization, and analysis of equipment, sensor, process, operational, and time-series data. 
 - Drive software engineering best practices including object-oriented design, design patterns, code reviews, automated testing, source control, CI/CD, DevOps, deployment, and lifecycle management. 
 - Ensure software solutions address cybersecurity, data integrity, validation, software quality, reliability, and regulatory requirements for connected and regulated systems. 
 - Identify and implement practical AI/ML, Generative AI, and advanced analytics opportunities for process monitoring, anomaly detection, forecasting, predictive maintenance, troubleshooting, engineering productivity, knowledge retrieval, and decision support. 
 - Provide technical leadership through architecture guidance, design reviews, technology evaluation, mentoring, troubleshooting, and technical decision-making. 
 - Lead solutions from architecture and proof-of-concept through productization, testing, deployment, and lifecycle support while driving reuse, standardization, automation, and engineering productivity

Required Qualifications

- 9-14 years of relevant experience in software engineering, industrial/process automation, electronics or electrical engineering, or related disciplines. 
 - Strong hands-on development experience in one or more languages such as C#, . NET, Java, or Python. 
 - Strong knowledge of software architecture, object-oriented design, design patterns, multithreading, networking, APIs, data structures, system integration, and scalable application design. 
 - Experience developing backend services, REST APIs, data pipelines, and applications using relational and/or NoSQL databases. 
 - Strong understanding of industrial/process automation, process control, instrumentation, sensors, actuators, control loops, process variables, and data acquisition. 
 - Working knowledge of PLC, SCADA, DCS, HMI, historians, MES and industrial protocols such as OPC UA, Modbus, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, or MQTT. 
 - Experience with automated testing, source control, CI/CD, build automation, deployment, and modern DevOps practices. 
 - Strong architecture, troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate business and product requirements into secure and scalable solutions. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives, influence architectural decisions, mentor engineers, and work effectively with multidisciplinary teams. 
 - Working knowledge of AI/ML and Generative AI, including anomaly detection, predictive analytics, LLMs, RAG, intelligent assistants, AI governance, security, privacy, and responsible AI practices. 
 - Experience in bioprocessing, life sciences, pharmaceutical manufacturing, biotechnology, laboratory/instrumentation products, or process industries is highly desirable. 
 - Knowledge of GxP, validation, data integrity, PAT, APC, soft sensors, digital twins, or model-based approaches is an advantage.

Description

Come join us in our journey to make everything - and yes, we do mean *everything* - that anyone wants to buy, available on Amazon!

We are looking for a Software Development Manager with strong technical knowledge, established background in engineering large scale software systems, and passion for solving challenging problems. The role demands a high-performing and flexible candidate who can take responsibility for success of the team, systems, and drive solutions from definition to launch to achieve results in a fast paced environment. 

The SDM on this team will be playing a key role in defining charter/scope, executing, and delivering innovative solutions to drive complete and correct selection on Amazon's eCommerce platform world wide. Candidate needs to have a high sense of ownership, ability to take on ambiguous and ambitious goals, and lead a highly talented team to achieve results. This role would expose you to solving problems at scale in areas of Agentic AI, automated insights, large scale data processing, and distributed systems . 

Key job responsibilities

As a member of the team, in this role, you will: 

- Work with Org leadership, Principal Engineers to define and drive the technical and architectural vision of Selection Monitoring's External E-commerce source discovery and enrichment. 
 - Build and launch scalable, fault-tolerant, and highly available services and AI Agents that can solve complex problems in entity resolution, deduplication, classification, enrichments and 3rd party data integrations to automatically discovery, catalog, and refresh meta information and signals for millions of eCommerce websites worldwide. 
 - Build and launch efficient storage solutions for managing large-scale datasets, ensuring optimal performance for both write-heavy ingestion and read-heavy analytical workloads. 
 - Build and grow a team of high performing SDEs, and be responsible and invested in career growth of your team members. 
 - Drive operational excellence initiatives and continuously improve quality bar for software delivered by the team. 

About The Team

Amazon's Selection Monitoring team is responsible for making the biggest catalog on the planet even bigger. Our systems process billions of products from millions of sources to algorithmically find products not already sold on Amazon and programmatically add them to the Amazon catalog. We apply parallel processing, AI/GenAI, machine learning and deep learning algorithms to evaluate products and brands in order to identify and prioritize products and brands to be added to Amazon's catalog. The datasets produced by our team are used by teams across Amazon to improve: product information, search and discoverability, pricing, and delivery experience. Our work involves building state-of-the-art Information Retrieval (IR) systems to mine the web and automatically create structured entities from un-structure/semi-structured data. We constantly stretch the boundaries of large scale distributed systems, Elastic Computing, Big Data, Artificial intelligence and SOA technologies to tackle challenges at Amazon's global scale. 

Basic Qualifications

- 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
 - 3+ years of engineering team management experience
 - Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
 - Experience partnering with product or program management teams

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
 - Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. Business Title: Engineering Manager
This role is based in Pune. This location works on a hybrid model, 2-3 days in the office. You will be required to interview in person. 

About SailPoint
SailPoint is defining the next era of identity security. Our unified, AI-powered platform seamlessly secures both the Human Fabric of your workforce and the Agentic Fabric of AI and non-human identities, completely eliminating organizational blind spots. 
Built on core principles like zero-standing privilege and contextualized risk, our platform transforms identity from a vulnerability into a strategic business advantage. Today, we are trusted by some of the largest, most complex organizations in the world to deliver intelligent, autonomous identity security at scale. 

About the Role
As an Engineering Manager, you will lead and empower a high-performing team of software engineers responsible for owning the technical development of SailPoint's core product capabilities. In this role, you will champion technical excellence, write and review quality code, debug complex distributed systems issues, and foster a culture of innovation and continuous delivery. You will work in an Agile environment, collaborating closely with US-based teams and stakeholders to build and maintain cloud-native, event-driven microservices on AWS. 

About the Team
At SailPoint, our Engineering team is where high-quality professional engineering meets individual impact. We are a results-driven crew built on innovation, collaboration, and mutual trust. Our team designs and deploys scalable, enterprise-grade identity security products powered by mature cloud architecture and cutting-edge technologies. 

Requirements

- Bachelors degree in related field, or equivalent professional experience
 - 15+ years of experience in software engineering, with demonstrated experience building, leading, and managing teams of software engineers
 - Strong foundational understanding of software development, particularly in Java, as well as modern front-end architectures. 
 - Proven track record of success delivering complex software solutions in an Agile development environment
 - Solid foundation in software engineering principles, distributed systems, and cloud architecture (AWS preferred)
 - Exceptional leadership, coaching, and mentoring skills with a passion for continuous improvement
 - Strong project management abilities with experience scoping, prioritizing, tracking, and delivering engineering milestones
 - Excellent communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across global time zones
 - Willingness to maintain at least 4 overlapping working hours with US time zones

AI-assisted engineering: 
Our engineers are expected to use AI development tools as a core part of their daily workflow, not as a novelty. We expect you to use these tools to accelerate delivery, expand your scope, and raise the quality bar, while applying strong engineering judgment to review, validate, and own everything that ships under your name. Comfort with prompting, agentic workflows, and human-in-the-loop review of AI-generated code is a baseline expectation for this role. 

AI related Technology: 

- Cursor, Claude Code
 - Python-based AI/ML frameworks and libraries such as scikit-learn, pandas, and numpy
 - Deep Learning Frameworks such as PyTorch
 - LLMs and Foundation Models in Bedrock, VertexAI, or similar
Roadmap for Success

 - Establish relationships with your engineering team, Product Management partners, and US-based counterparts. 
 - Understand the current sprint commitments, team workflows, and active technical priorities. 

60 Days: 

- Assume day-to-day leadership of the engineering team and run Agile ceremonies effectively. 
 - Actively partner with Product Management to review roadmaps, scope incoming projects, and allocate engineering resources. 
 - Begin coaching and setting clear performance objectives for direct reports through regular 1: 1 mentorship sessions. 

90 Days: 

- Own end-to-end project planning, tracking, and risk management for your team's deliverables and key milestones. 
 - Maintain a seamless communication cadence with global stakeholders, ensuring overlapping collaboration with the US team. 
 - Identify operational bottlenecks and implement process or architectural improvements to raise code quality and team velocity. 

6 Months: 

- Drive the successful release of high-impact features and architectural enhancements to production on AWS. 
 - Foster a strong culture of career development, mentoring engineers toward their next career milestones. 
 - Proactively manage technical risk, system reliability, and resource allocation across multiple simultaneous initiatives. 

1 Year: 

- Establish a proven track record of predictable, high-quality product delivery that advances SailPoint's identity security platform. 
 - Scale team capabilities, mentor emerging leaders, and contribute strategic engineering input toward long-term product roadmaps. 

About SailPoint India and our Benefits: 
Nestled in the heart of Pune, a bustling hub of technology and culture, the office exemplifies SailPoint's commitment to excellence. Surrounded by a vibrant atmosphere, the Pune office serves as a strategic center for the company, where cutting-edge solutions are crafted and implemented to address the ever-evolving challenges in identity security. With a team of highly skilled professionals, the office embodies SailPoint's values of Integrity, Innovation, Impact and Individuals. Our Pune team works under a hybrid model enjoying the office 2-3 days a week (unless otherwise specified). We provide excellent office amenities, competitive salaries and strong benefits:

data.title: Staff Engineer, Revenue Experiences
data.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies-from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups-use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. 

About The Team

The Commercial Experiences Engineering team is part of the Commerce Systems organization at Stripe. We focus on ensuring that our users, both internal and external, have a best-in-class experience with billing at Stripe. This includes working on the systems and processes needed to bill our largest and most complex customers, as well as designing and delivering experiences to help guide users through their billing, from fee explainability to deep diving on product usage optimization. We are a cross-functional technical team that seeks to bring clarity to a complex space. The team is at the crux of all Stripe products and builds user-facing as well as internal infrastructure. 

We build platforms and services to define and manage pricing, calculate and collect Stripe's revenue, and empower Stripe and our users to understand and manage revenue and costs. We work on customer-facing experiences, internal platforms, and data pipelines to empower Accounting, Finance, Strategy, Sales, and Stripe's Products to drive business value across the entire user and product lifecycle. 

What you'll do

We are seeking an experienced technical leader to join our India-based team and drive the technical roadmap for Commercial Experiences Engineering, collaborating deeply with partner teams across Commerce Systems in the US, EMEA, and India. In this role, you will work closely with engineering managers, senior engineers, and cross-functional partners to help design architecture, ensure technical excellence, and break down complex problems to make them more tractable with engineering teams. You will be involved in the building of the technical bench, mentoring and growing the next senior engineers within the broader organisation. 

You will work cross-functionally to align on the business challenges in delivering excellent billing and accounting experiences to our users. Often this will include influencing across organizations and grounding your arguments in solid data and a technical roadmap. As such, you will have excellent technical leadership and communication skills. 

You will also be hands-on in building key systems, while mentoring and leading other engineers. Join us in driving change in an area with tremendous opportunity. 

Responsibilities

- Manage the technical leadership, execution, and roadmap for Commercial Experiences Engineering. 
 - Work cross-functionally with business leaders across the company as well as partner engineering teams. 
 - Partner closely with engineering, product, and design leadership to define our product strategy and user experience. 
 - Ensure our platform solutions and user billing data are high quality, meet the needs of our internal users, and position us to meet Stripe's growth. 
 - Drive interoperability across platforms in User Billing and integrations across Stripe with product, accounting, sales, finance, and data science teams. 
 - Scrutinize billing interfaces and data models, elevating our focus on correctness and ease of use within User Billing. 
 - Establish best practices, frameworks, and repeatable processes that enable the team to execute effectively. 
 - Foster a culture of learning and data-driven decision making on the team and to influence the broader organization. 
 - Mentor and support the growth of engineers at different levels in their careers. 

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. 

Minimum Requirements

- 10+ years of hands-on experience building large-scale, distributed systems. 
 - Proven track record of building large-scale, complex distributed systems; identifying shortcomings and optimization opportunities; and making data-driven cost performance tradeoffs to influence design decisions. 
 - Experience building and operating infrastructure and tools that empower developers/product teams to deliver business value. 
 - Experience influencing company strategy at the intersection of business needs and technology (you measure your success in terms of business impact, not lines of code). 
 - Experience leading and creating strong technical teams that balance operational excellence, collaboration, and user needs. 
 - Strong collaboration skills to work effectively across multiple teams and stakeholders. 
 - Are effective in giving and receiving constructive feedback to/from peers and team members. 
 - Past experience mentoring and investing in the development of engineers. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Prior experience in the financial technology space, particularly in payment processing, accounting, or financial reporting. 

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible. 

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally. 

We look forward to hearing from you. 

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out-and set you apart-especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us. 

Apply now

We are actively building new features using Alexa, machine learning, and other AWS technologies that re-shape the way customers browse, discover, and consume web content. 

We operate like a startup in a big company - our engineers work closely with product management and user experience designers to build best-in-class services and apps. Our engineers are owners who identify, define, and build solutions that delight millions of customers every day. We are building our organization based on smart people, diversity of perspective and experience, and looking for individuals with a "can-do" attitude who love to tackle hard problems. 

What You'll Do

- Be an integral part of an exceptionally talented team. Working in a fast paced environment with rapid feature delivery to our customers. 
 - Brainstorm, build and ship new and exciting features that revolutionize the way people browse the web. You have the opportunity to own a features/experiences from inception to delivery. 

This Team Is a Good Fit For You If

- You are sensitive to customer needs and interested in having a firsthand impact on Amazon's global customer base
 - You truly care about the business results of what you build, not just the elegance of the technology
 - You like to solve interesting technology problems
 - You enjoy collaborating in a diverse team environment
 - You are a passionate learner and motivated to take on new challenges. 
 - You want to have fun; surround yourself with a highly talented pool of engineers that like to solve complex problems, but also enjoy work life balance. 

Key job responsibilities

Design and deliver complex features for Silk browser and WebView across multimodal and TV devices, driving end-to-end ownership from architecture to launch. 

Lead Chromium upleveling and platform migrations, ensuring compatibility and performance across Fire OS and Vega OS platforms. 

Own build system improvements and release infrastructure to improve developer productivity and release velocity for the team. 

Drive operational excellence - including security patch releases, crash rate reduction, and production health monitoring across device families. 

Mentor and grow junior engineers through technical guidance, code reviews, design reviews, and knowledge sharing to raise the overall bar of the team. 

A day in the life

As a Senior SDE in the Silk Browser team, you will dive deep into Chromium internals to solve complex rendering and performance challenges across Fire TV and multimodal devices, collaborate with product, design, and platform teams to understand customer needs and unblock cross-functional dependencies, and architect scalable solutions that work across multiple device families and OS versions. You'll spend time reviewing code from teammates, driving technical decisions that balance long-term code health with near-term delivery, and shipping features that reach millions of users. You'll have the autonomy to identify problems, propose solutions, and see your work deployed to real customers in a fast-paced environment that values both rapid iteration and thoughtful engineering. 

About The Team

Silk is Amazon's Chromium-based web browser built for Fire TV and multimodal devices, optimized for the unique constraints of embedded environments to deliver fast, reliable web experiences on television screens and Echo Show devices. Our team owns feature development, performance optimization, and seamless integration with Amazon's device ecosystem, working closely with product managers, and partner teams to build solutions that delight millions of customers. We foster an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives strengthen our work, invest in each other's growth through mentorship, and believe that balancing professional achievement with personal fulfillment leads to our best engineering.

- 8+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 8+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
 - 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred Qualifications

- 8+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

 - Experience with Chromium Browser technology

data.title: Manager Lean
data.description:
Career Area: 

Strategy

Job Description: 

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. 

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do - but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here - we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. 

Role Definition

Leads, manages, and supports projects and supervises teams related to process improvements using Lean, Six Sigma and project management methodologies to achieve business goals. 

Responsibilities

- Monitoring performance and improvements in key metrics. Promoting the use of metrics and data to drive project focus. 
 - Directing, motivating and developing staff, maximizing their individual contribution, professional growth and ability to function effectively with their colleagues as a team. 
 - Tracking financial results and reports on quantifiable goals and objectives; estimating future projects from financial, throughput, lead-time and on-time performance improvements to assist in the prioritization of projects. 
 - Training and mentoring employees; educating personnel on Lean and Six Sigma methodology and identifying the best projects for implementation. 

Degree/Experience Required

B. E/B. Tech/M. E/M. Tech

Experience Required 15 To 20years

Skill Descriptors

Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems. 

Level Working Knowledge: 

- Approaches a situation or problem by defining the problem or issue and determining its significance. 
 - Makes a systematic comparison of two or more alternative solutions. 
 - Uses flow charts, Pareto charts, fish diagrams, etc. to disclose meaningful data patterns. 
 - Identifies the major forces, events and people impacting and impacted by the situation at hand. 
 - Uses logic and intuition to make inferences about the meaning of the data and arrive at conclusions. 

Coaching Others: Knowledge of coaching and mentoring concepts and methods; ability to encourage, motivate, and guide individuals in learning and improving effectiveness. 

Level Basic Understanding: 

- Gives examples of how coaching is used within own organization. 
 - Lists qualities of effective coaching. 
 - Describes the role and value of a coach. 
 - Describes coaching responsibilities that are relevant to a business setting. 

Influencing: Knowledge of effective influencing tactics and strategies; ability to impact decisions within and outside own organization. 

Level Working Knowledge: 

- Develops basic persuasive arguments. 
 - Discusses organizational culture around providing input on decisions. 
 - Uses active listening skills and probing techniques to surface opportunities to influence. 
 - Identifies who the decision makers are and how they receive information. 
 - Regularly presents ideas or suggestions to associates in persuasive terms. 

Interpersonal Relationships: Knowledge of the techniques and the ability to work with a variety of individuals and groups in a constructive and collaborative manner. 

Level Working Knowledge: 

- Explains impact of interactions with individuals and groups. 
 - Identifies roles and responsibilities for self and others. 
 - Demonstrates an understanding of alternative points of view. 
 - Collaborates with departmental associates and management. 
 - Adapts interaction style to situations and people. 

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations. 

Level Working Knowledge: 

- Identifies and documents specific problems and resolution alternatives. 
 - Examines a specific problem and understands the perspective of each involved stakeholder. 
 - Develops alternative techniques for assessing accuracy and relevance of information. 
 - Helps to analyze risks and benefits of alternative approaches and obtain decision on resolution. 
 - Uses fact-finding techniques and diagnostic tools to identify problems. 

Process Improvement: Understanding and insight into evaluating current product quality and production methods and ability to maintains focus on the continuous improvement of processes, products and services. 

Level Working Knowledge: 

- Defines the critical workflow for executing key processes. 
 - Identifies process problems that limit performance. 
 - Implements methods for improving and establishing controls for critical processes. 
 - Focuses on the most significant problems to maximize efficiency gains. 
 - Surfaces systemic problems to be addressed at the organizational level. 

Project Management: Knowledge of effective project management strategies and tactics; ability to plan, organize, monitor, and control projects, ensuring efficient utilization of technical and administrative resources to achieve project objectives. 

Level Working Knowledge: 

- Provides input for Gantt or PERT charts or their equivalent to track project progress and status. 
 - Under guidance, plans and estimates simple projects. 
 - Assists in detailed project plans including cost, schedule, and resource requirements. 
 - Obtains information from stakeholders during the planning stage of a project. 
 - Produces standard project status reports. 

Six Sigma Methodology: Knowledge of the concepts of Six Methodology; ability to use the methodology to improve the processes and procedures and control the improvements by eliminating root causes. 

Level Working Knowledge: 

- Analyzes business priorities for selecting potential critical metrics. 
 - Uses tools (e. g. trend charts, Pareto charts, sigma conversion chart) to measure historical performance. 
 - Researches important causes that have an impact on quality and customer satisfaction with the use of statistical tools. 
 - Resolves routine problems in a cost effective manner. 
 - Reports deviances from process improvements. 

This Job Description is intended as a general guide to the job duties for this position and is intended for the purpose of establishing the specific salary grade. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as an exhaustive summary of all responsibilities, duties and effort required of employees assigned to this job. At the discretion of management, this description may be changed at any time to address the evolving needs of the organization. 

Additional information: This job required 5days working from office.

September 30, 2026 - October 6, 2026

The Company

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. Meet The Team: 

- We are looking for a motivated and experienced Software Development Lead to spearhead the establishment and growth of our new R&D Software design center in Bengaluru (Bangalore), India. 
 - This role is crucial in setting up our software development and test operations, seeking out the best talent to join in our mission, and fostering a culture of innovation, excellence, and collaboration. 
 - In this role, you will provide strategic leadership and oversight, guiding the direction of our software product development and test automation initiatives. 
 - You will be responsible for ensuring the efficient and timely delivery of high-quality solutions. 
 - This position offers a unique opportunity to lead and shape the future of our R&D reference arch and platform software efforts in a fast-paced and collaborative environment. 
 - You will play a crucial role in the creation of new products and features, driving forward our technological advancements and market competitiveness. 
 - The portfolio you will be delivering includes mobile apps (iOS and Android), cloud-based data platforms, web applications, software test frameworks, automation, and test scripts. 

Where You Come In: 

- Lead, develop, and mentor a software engineering team delivering mobile and cloud software solutions supporting Dexcom products and services. 
 - Establish and communicate team priorities and execution plans aligned with product and organizational objectives. 
 - Partner closely with Product Management, Program Management, Quality, Regulatory, Clinical, Marketing, Systems Engineering, and other stakeholders to define requirements, plan development activities, and ensure successful product delivery. 
 - Build and maintain a high-performing engineering team focused on accountability, collaboration, technical excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement. 
 - Drive project planning, resource allocation, risk management, and execution across assigned software initiatives. 
 - Ensure software development activities comply with applicable quality system requirements, medical device regulations, cybersecurity standards, and company policies. 
 - Drive software development best practices across mobile and cloud applications, including iOS and Android development, cloud services, Agile methodologies, automated testing, CI/CD, secure development practices, and performance monitoring. 
 - Provide technical guidance and contribute to software architecture and design decisions across mobile and cloud systems to ensure scalability, maintainability, reliability, security, and product quality. 
 - Manage team staffing, hiring, onboarding, performance management, employee development, and resource planning activities. 
 - Use key performance indicators (KPIs), engineering metrics, and operational data to monitor team effectiveness, delivery performance, and product quality and identify opportunities for improvement. 
 - Collaborate with engineering teams across the organization to manage interfaces and dependencies, share knowledge, improve development practices, and support successful end-to-end product delivery. 
 - Identify and manage technical, schedule, quality, security, and execution risks, escalating significant issues and tradeoffs when appropriate. 
 - Partner with Quality, V&V, Cybersecurity, and other engineering functions to ensure software solutions meet functional, performance, reliability, security, and regulatory requirements. 
 - Support audit activities, inspections, and regulatory submissions as required. 
 - Foster strong cross-functional relationships and advocate for engineering quality, technical excellence, effective execution, and continuous improvement. 

What Makes You Successful: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 - 8+ years of software development experience, including experience delivering complex software products. 
 - 3+ years of people management experience leading software engineers. 
 - Demonstrated success leading, developing, and mentoring a software engineering team. 
 - Strong experience with mobile and/or cloud application development, including iOS, Android, cloud services, or other connected software platforms. 
 - Experience delivering software products through the full software development lifecycle, from requirements and design through development, verification, release, and maintenance. 
 - Experience managing engineering priorities, schedules, dependencies, risks, resources, and delivery commitments. 
 - Strong understanding of software architecture, software development methodologies, automated testing, and software quality practices. 
 - Ability to provide technical guidance and effectively evaluate software architecture, engineering decisions, technical risks, and tradeoffs. 
 - Understanding of distributed and connected software systems, including interactions and dependencies between mobile applications, cloud services, APIs, and other system components. 
 - Proven ability to collaborate with and influence cross-functional stakeholders across Product, Systems Engineering, Quality, Regulatory, V&V, Cybersecurity, and other engineering organizations. 
 - Excellent leadership, communication, interpersonal, problem-solving, and organizational skills. 
 - Experience building and developing high-performing engineering teams. 
 - Ability to balance technical quality, product requirements, regulatory requirements, resources, and delivery commitments. 

What You'll Get: 

- A front row seat to life changing CGM technology. Learn about our brave #dexcomwarriors community. 
 - A full and comprehensive benefits program. 
 - Growth opportunities on a global scale. 
 - Access to career development through in-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement. 
 - An exciting and innovative, industry-leading organization committed to our employees, customers, and the communities we serve.

- 15-25%

Experience And Education: 

- Typically requires a bachelor's degree with 10+ years of industry experience. 
 - 7+ years of years of successful leadership experience in relevant industry.

data.title: Principal Platform Engineer
data.description:
Job Title

Principal Platform Engineer

Job Description

So, who are we?

IG is a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents, serving over 1. 3m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions - built on scale, trust, and proof. We didn't pivot to innovation; it's how we've always operated. What that means for the people who work here is real: genuinely complex problems to solve, the technology and resources to tackle them properly, and the kind of scope that's rare in established businesses. 

The bar is high - bring a curious and forward-thinking mindset and we'll give you the platform to define what comes next. Join us at IG - the future gets built here. 

Your team

This role is part of our Platform Engineering team -- they are responsible for building the cloud and containers platform landscape to support the business applications via self-service capabilities and automation. 

Your role in the Team's Success

The Principal Platform Engineer is a hands-on technical leader responsible for defining, building, evolving, and governing cloud platform architecture and infrastructure to ensure it is secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective. 

This role sets the technical direction and standards for cloud platforms across public and private cloud, working closely with engineering, security, and FinOps teams to embed best practices into platform design and delivery. The Principal Cloud Engineer acts as a hands-on expert and thought leader, influencing complex technical decisions, reducing platform risk, and enabling engineering teams to build and operate services with confidence, speed, and financial discipline. 

What You'll Do

- Design and architect scalable AWS cloud infrastructure, developing IaC solutions using Terraform and leading cloud technology evaluation and standardisation initiatives 
 - Build, optimise, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure deployment, establishing DevOps and DevSecOps best practices across the organisation 
 - Architect and manage Kubernetes environments (EKS, AKS, GKE) and implement platform engineering tools to deliver self-service capabilities via an IDP (e. g. Backstage) 
 - Define and enforce monitoring, alerting, and observability standards to ensure infrastructure reliability and performance 
 - Foster collaboration between development and operations teams, bridging gaps to drive a unified engineering culture 
 - Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineering teams, writing and maintaining documentation to support knowledge sharing. 

What You'll Need For This Role

Key Qualification Requirements: Overall 12+ years of experience

- Cloud Infrastructure & Experience: 4+ years in cloud infrastructure engineering with hands-on experience designing and administering complex platforms across AWS, GCP, and Azure, including deep knowledge of networking (VPC, Direct Connect, Transit Gateways, BGP, OSPF) and IaaS/PaaS architectural patterns 
 - Infrastructure-as-Code & Automation: 2+ years with IaC tools (Terraform or Ansible) and hands-on experience with orchestration and automation platforms (AWX, Ansible Tower, Terragrunt), scripting in Python, Bash, or Go 
 - DevOps & DevSecOps: 2+ years designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitLab, GitHub Actions, or equivalent, with strong knowledge of security best practices including secrets management, vulnerability scanning, and compliance 
 - Kubernetes & Containers: 2+ years of Kubernetes administration across on-premises and cloud environments (EKS preferred, AKS, GKE), with proficiency in networking, RBAC, pod security, service mesh (Istio), and Docker image management 
 - Platform Engineering & Developer Tooling: Experience implementing developer portals (Backstage), artifact repositories (JFrog Artifactory, Nexus), API gateways, and self-service platform engineering tools to support internal teams

data.description:
About Us

Abacus Insights is transforming how data works for health plans. Our mission is simple: make healthcare data usable, so the people responsible for care and cost decisions can act faster, with confidence. 

We help health plans break down data silos to create a single, trusted data foundation. That foundation powers better decisions-so plans can improve outcomes, reduce waste, and deliver better experiences for members and providers alike. Backed by $100M from top investors, we're tackling big challenges in an industry that's ready for change. Our platform enables GenAI use cases by delivering clean, connected, and reliable healthcare data to support automation, prioritization, and decision workflows-and it's why we are leading the way. 

Our innovation begins with people. We are bold, curious, and collaborative-because the best ideas come from working together. We embrace the thoughtful use of AI and automation to drive innovation and efficiency, and we look for individuals who are curious and adaptable-those excited to leverage emerging technologies to enhance how we work-while keeping human insight, connection, and our clients at the center of every decision. 

Ready to make an impact? Join us and let's build the future together. 

About The Role

The Site Reliability and Forward Deployed Engineer is an individual contributor who supports production operations, incident response, and post-launch reliability across the Abacus Insights platform. Working with guidance from experienced engineers and technical leaders, this role builds practical skills in troubleshooting, automation, customer support, and reliable system operations. 

This Role Combines

- Production operations and reliability engineering fundamentals
 - Hands-on technical troubleshooting during incidents and escalations
 - Customer-facing technical support for deployments and production issues
 - Software development and automation to reduce manual operational work

You will help investigate production issues involving AWS infrastructure, Databricks workloads, and data pipelines. You will partner with senior engineers, platform teams, and customer-facing teams to resolve issues, improve operational documentation, and turn recurring problems into reusable solutions. 

You are expected to participate actively in incident response, debug systems using established tools and runbooks, and contribute code and documentation that improve reliability and operability. 

Success in this role is supported through structured onboarding covering the platform, production support processes, incident response, and customer context; pairing and mentorship from experienced SRE, platform, data, and engineering team members; progressive ownership, beginning with documented and well-scoped tasks before moving to more complex incidents and customer engagements; and regular feedback focused on technical growth, operational judgment, communication, and automation skills. 

Your day to day

- Participate in production incident triage, mitigation, recovery, and follow-up activities under the guidance of experienced engineers. 
 - Contribute evidence, technical findings, and follow-up actions to root cause analyses (RCAs). 
 - Investigate and resolve well-scoped production defects and field-reported issues, escalating complex or high-risk problems appropriately. 
 - Collaborate with Engineering, Data, Customer Success, and Support teams during customer-impacting incidents and escalations. 
 - Maintain and improve runbooks, troubleshooting guides, monitoring, alerting, and operational checklists. 
 - Support customer deployments, integrations, and production troubleshooting alongside senior or customer-facing engineers. 
 - Write and maintain Python scripts or small services that automate repeatable operational workflows, improve observability, and reduce manual toil. 
 - Use established tools and procedures to support AWS- and Databricks-based production systems, including basic performance, data quality, and job-failure investigations. 
 - Document incident learnings and customer issues, and help convert recurring patterns into reusable tools, knowledge articles, and product improvement suggestions. 
 - Participate in an on-call or shift-based support rotation after completing the required onboarding and readiness training. 

What You Bring To The Team

- 2-4 years of professional experience in software engineering, site reliability engineering, technical support, production operations, data engineering, or a related field. Relevant internships, academic projects, or hands-on technical training may be considered. 
 - Understanding of cloud computing and interest in supporting production systems in AWS. 
 - Basic Python programming skills and the ability to read, troubleshoot, and modify existing scripts or services. 
 - Familiarity with Linux command-line tools, logs, APIs, or SQL-based troubleshooting. 
 - Basic understanding of incident response, root cause analysis, monitoring, alerting, and observability concepts. 
 - Awareness of distributed systems, CI/CD pipelines, source control, and Infrastructure as Code concepts. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to document findings and provide timely status updates. 
 - A structured troubleshooting mindset, attention to detail, and willingness to ask for help or escalate when appropriate. 
 - Ability to take ownership of assigned tasks through resolution with coaching and guidance. 
 - Curiosity, adaptability, and a strong interest in learning production reliability and customer-facing engineering practices. 
 - Bachelors Degree in engineering or related field. 

What We Would Like To See, But Not Required

- Internship, project, or work experience in a cloud, data, DevOps, technical support, or production operations environment. 
 - Exposure to Databricks, Spark, Snowflake, data pipelines, or other data platforms and warehouses. 
 - Familiarity with Kubernetes or EKS, EMR, Lambda, Terraform, or similar infrastructure technologies. 
 - Experience using ticketing, monitoring, logging, or incident management tools. 
 - Exposure to healthcare, regulated data, or security-conscious environments. 
 - Experience participating in an on-call, lab-support, service-desk, or operational support rotation. 
 - Customer-facing, consulting, implementation, or technical communication experience. 

What You'll Get In Return

- Competitive Leave & Benefits
 - Comprehensive health coverage
 - Equity for every employee - share in our success
 - Growth-focused environment - your development matters here

Work arrangements

- Standard hours: 9 hours/day, 5 days/week
 - Location: Pune, 5 Days from the office

data.title: Quality Check Head
data.description:
Job Purpose: 

The Quality Check Manager is responsible for ensuring that garments meet S4U quality standards from the sample stage through bulk production and final dispatch. The role focuses on checking supplier samples, approving counter samples, ensuring final production matches the approved sample, guiding the QC team, and coordinating closely with merchandisers and production teams to resolve quality issues. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Sample & Counter Sample Control

• Check supplier samples for fabric, colour, measurements, stitching, fitting, embroidery/handwork, trims, accessories and finishing. 

• Check and approve counter samples before bulk production starts. 

• Maintain approved samples as the quality reference for production and final checking. Bulk Production Matching

• Ensure final production is a close replica of the approved sample/counter sample in design, colour, fabric, measurements, stitching, embroidery/handwork, trims and finishing. 

• Identify any differences between the approved sample and bulk production and ensure corrections are made immediately. 

• Check garment measurements and ensure they remain within approved tolerance. QC Team Guidance

• Guide and supervise the QC team on the checking points for each style. 

• Brief QC team members on the approved sample and quality requirements before production checking begins. 

• Conduct/supervise inline, mid-production and final quality checks. 

• Train the QC team to identify defects correctly and improve checking accuracy. Merchandising & Production Coordination

• Coordinate closely with merchandisers regarding sample approvals, measurement details, quality requirements, changes, corrections and production issues. 

• Work with Production, Sampling, Finishing and Packing teams to resolve quality concerns quickly. • Escalate recurring or major quality issues to the concerned team and management. Final Quality & Dispatch

• Ensure defective garments are corrected before final packing. 

• Check final finishing, cleanliness, ironing, labels, tags, size labels, wash-care labels and packaging. • Ensure only approved-quality garments move to final packing and dispatch. S4U by Shivali  |  Quality Check Manager - Job Description Quality Checks to Monitor

• Stitching defects: open seams, uneven stitching, puckering, skipped / broken stitches and loose threads. • Fabric issues: stains, holes, damage, shade variation, printing defects or colour mismatch. 

• Embroidery / handwork defects, incorrect placement or missing work. • Incorrect measurements, fitting, trims, accessories, labels or finishing. 

• Repeated defects and their root causes; ensure corrective action is implemented. Team Management

• Manage and guide the QC team on a daily basis and assign styles / production lots to team members. 

• Review QC performance, checking accuracy and discipline. 

• Conduct regular quality discussions with QC, merchandising and production teams. Key Skills Required

• Strong knowledge of garment construction, stitching, measurements and fitting. 

Good understanding of fabric, embroidery, printing, handwork, trims and finishing. 

• Strong attention to detail and ability to compare samples with bulk production accurately. 

• Good team-handling, coordination, communication and problem-solving skills. 

• Ability to identify quality issues quickly and ensure timely corrective action. 

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Accuracy of supplier sample and counter sample checking

• Bulk production matching with approved samples

• Reduction in production defects, alteration and rework

• Reduction in customer complaints and returns

• QC team performance and checking accuracy

• Timely identification and closure of quality issues

• Final dispatch quality

data.title: Mobile DevOps Engineer
data.description:
Three target platforms, four distribution channels, one team. Join Synmatch AI's client on the founding engineering team for the next generation of power-quality analysis software as the release and observability owner the engineer who keeps shipping boring, predictable, and frequent, and who makes sure they know what happens to the app after it leaves CI. 

The distribution problem here is genuinely unusual. Windows MSIX with EV code signing for tablet customers. App Store and TestFlight for iOS. Play Store internal/closed tracks for Android. And for customers who can't or won't use public stores, a clean sideload/MDM channel (Intune, Workspace ONE). You'll own all of it pipelines, signing keys, secret hygiene, staged rollouts, crash-driven rollback paths. 

Observability is the other half of the role. A local-first Flutter app in the field is invisible by default; you make it legible. Sentry, OpenTelemetry, custom metrics for offline-mode behavior, log redaction for customer data, and the symbolication and dashboards that turn a crash report into an actionable bug for the team. You build it, you run it: the pipeline is yours from green PR to incident response. 

What you will do as a Mobile DevOps & Release Engineer. . . 

- Build CI/CD Pipelines: GitHub Actions or GitLab CI with reusable workflows; Codemagic or Bitrise; Fastlane for iOS/Android signing and store delivery; MSIX packaging and signing for Windows
 - Own Release Lifecycle: TestFlight, Play Internal/Closed, Microsoft Store/direct MSIX, staged rollouts, mandatory-update paths, crash-driven rollback
 - Manage Signing Keys & Secrets: App Store Connect, Play Console, EV code-signing certificates for Windows; secret hygiene via 1Password Secrets Automation, GitHub OIDC, or equivalent
 - Stand Up Production Observability: Sentry/Crashlytics, OpenTelemetry export, custom metrics for offline behavior, log-redaction discipline for sensitive customer data
 - Build Sideload/MDM Channel: Air-gapped distribution paths for utility and regulated customers including Intune/Workspace ONE workflows
 - Manage Supply-Chain Hygiene: SBOM generation (CycloneDX), dependency pinning, license scanning, basic Dart/Flutter security review
 - Run Infrastructure: CI agents, artifact storage, symbolication services on modest Azure or AWS footprint
 - Carry the Release Pager: Anchor on-call rotation for release and observability incidents, lead postmortems, turn each into pipeline improvement

What we are looking for. . . 

- Mobile Release Engineering: Shipped at least one product across iOS, Android, and ideally Windows at scale
 - CI/CD for Flutter: Hands-on with GitHub Actions or GitLab CI reusable workflows, Fastlane, Codemagic or Bitrise
 - Code-Signing Fluency: App Store Connect, Play Console, EV certs for Windows with clean secret management story
 - Production Observability: Sentry/Crashlytics setup, OpenTelemetry export, custom metrics, symbolication experience
 - Update Strategy Thinking: Staged rollouts, mandatory updates, optional sideload channels lived through the trade-offs
 - Supply-Chain Hygiene: SBOMs, dependency pinning, license scanning as habits not afterthoughts
 - Operational Ownership: Expect to own both pipeline and production behavior of what it ships
 - Incident Composure: Clear communication during incidents; treat postmortems as products

Desirable (but not required): 

- Prior experience with air-gapped or regulated-customer distribution (utility, military, healthcare)
 - Microsoft Intune or Workspace ONE workflows
 - SRE/DevOps background before moving into mobile release engineering
 - 1Password Secrets Automation, HashiCorp Vault, or equivalent secret-management tools
 - Renovate/Dependabot housekeeping at scale
 - Test-driven development for pipeline-as-code and infrastructure modules
 - Small-footprint cloud infra (Azure preferred, AWS also fine)

Benefits and perks. . . 

- Compensation: Upto 30 LPA (based on experience). 
 - Real Release Problem: Three platforms, four channels, sensitive customer segments to solve for
 - Autonomy: Own the pipeline as a product with a team that respects "automation-first" as a value
 - Observability Investment: Telemetry budget is real and committed from day one
 - Continuous Delivery Culture: No quarterly mega-releases; small changes flow continuously
 - Fully Remote: Async-first defaults with in-person time for release-day reviews

data.description:
Job Summary

Agile Dev Team Members have collective responsibility for the design, development, testing and/or deployment of system functionality. Agile Dev Team Member II with primarily a development discipline provides technical feasibility using basic coding methods and adheres to coding standards to ensure consistent style and format. Ensures systems are high in code and component quality, and are easily modified to support future requirements with support and guidance of more senior developers or architects. Agile Dev Team Member II with primarily a testing discipline ensures the end product meets the business acceptance criteria and non-functional requirements. Defines and execute tests early, often, and at multiple levels depending on their level of experience. Based on their business products, processes and system knowledge, they provide broad level of thinking for exceptions and other unexpected ways users may interact with systems. They utilize basic to intermediate testing techniques and tools. The Agile Dev Team Member II is moderately capable of working on more than one type of task and is somewhat limited in their ability to consistently pull the next highest priority work item.

Demonstrates understanding to customer needs by interpreting customer needs into viable solutions, providing input into system design. Effectively writes and refines user stories, including clear and accurate acceptance criteria. data.description:
Ready to take your career global?

Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We're looking for a Associate Senior SDET Analyst to join our ever evolving Genius S team and help shape the future of global commerce. 

What You'll Own

- Ability to easily move from manual to automated testing based on the need of the team, feature being tested and timeline of the initiative. 
 - Participates in all steps of the software development life cycle and is accountable for producing quality code. Collaborates with peers to identify and recommend practices for quality assurance at the source using automation. Performs quality checks along with updating of automation scripts. Identifies process improvement and continuous quality measures across the development lifecycle.

Integrates automated suites with continuous integration (CI) tools for frequent execution.

Develops and administers best practices to perform test data conditioning and execution of test sets. Works with programming to create certain account conditions and execute special testing requirements for test validation. Demonstrates a broad knowledge of the multiple environments by evaluating, interpreting and communicating an understanding of the various components of systems and applications to leadership.

What You'll Bring

- 4+ years of experience working with software testing, coding, designing and developing.

 - Experience with maintaining automation framework and test tools

 - Experience creating an automation framework
 - Experience in the Point of Sale domain
 - Knowledge of GCP and AWS
