data.title: Software Development Manager, Product & Offers Experience
data.description:
Description

Do you shop on Amazon? Have you ever browsed a product detail page; scrolling through images, comparing prices, checking delivery dates and then clicked "Add to Cart"? That entire experience? Our team builds it. The Product & Offers Experience organization is responsible for building the world's best product evaluation and discovery experiences for Amazon shoppers. We own the experiences that help hundreds of millions of customers worldwide make confident purchase decisions, from the moment they land on a product page to the moment they add to cart. Our work spans offer selection, offer display, pricing presentation, and the rich product information that surrounds the buy box. As the worldwide product showroom for the "everything store, " we directly drive the majority of purchase decisions on Amazon across all surfaces; mobile, desktop, and voice. Our focus spans three areas: helping customers discover, evaluate, and compare products and offers; enabling effortless shopping without disrupting their current context; and empowering builders through a scalable, federated architecture that allows hundreds of partner teams across Amazon to innovate within the product and offers experience. 

In this role, you will lead a team of talented engineers who are customer obsessed and deeply technical. You will define the vision and build a technical roadmap for your team, identifying where to invest, what to build next, and how to evolve the architecture to meet the needs of customers, the business, and partner teams at scale. You will gather requirements from a broad set of stakeholders across the Amazon Consumer organization, explore existing and emerging technologies, identify opportunities and gaps, and drive your team to deliver results that directly impact how customers shop on Amazon. 

You will also be a people leader first. You will hire, develop, and retain top engineering talent. You will invest deeply in the growth of your engineers - through mentorship, career development, and creating an inclusive team culture where people do their best work. You will set clear expectations, provide regular feedback, and build a high-performing team that is motivated, engaged, and continuously learning. You will champion a healthy work environment and foster psychological safety so your team can take bold bets and innovate fearlessly. 

The ideal candidate has excellent technical depth, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to communicate effectively across all levels. You are equally passionate about building great technology and building great teams. You care deeply about people development, operational excellence, and delivering results that matter. If you want to shape how hundreds of millions of customers make purchase decisions on Amazon and grow the next generation of engineering leaders along the way then we want to meet you. 

Key job responsibilities

As a Software Development Manager on the team, you will be expected to: 

Take on hard, ambiguous problems and break them down to their simple parts. 

Manage a team of high caliber Software Development and Quality Assurance Engineers working on building world class, scalable distributed systems and mobile customer experiences. 

Recruit, hire, mentor, and coach Software Development Engineers at different levels of experience. 

Manage and execute against project plans and deliver commitments within a professional, high paced engineering environment. 

Interface with our internal customers to understand requirements, set priorities and communicate direction and progress. 

Own all operational metrics and support for your teams' software. 

Drive improvements in software engineering practices. 

A day in the life

Brainstorming meetings with product managers and leadership team on new product ideas. 

Work with engineers to design, scope, plan and deliver features for offer display. 

Meet with stakeholders (internal and external) and dependencies to build relationships, align on roadmap and delivery timelines. 

Work with a team of recruiters to hire great talent for the team. 

Basic Qualifications

- 7+ years of engineering experience
 - 3+ years of engineering team management experience
 - 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
 - Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
 - Experience partnering with product or program management teams

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
 - Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

About the job: 

Title: Senior DevOps Lead - Innovation Lab

Location: Bengaluru / Ahmedabad, India

Employment Type: Full-Time

About the Role

Intuitive. ai is looking for a Senior DevOps Lead to join our Innovation Lab and take hands-on ownership of DevOps, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, and production deployments across our AI, GenAI, SaaS, and Application Modernization products. 

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with AWS, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, DevSecOps, and cloud operations, along with experience deploying Java, Python, GenAI, LLM, RAG, and Agentic AI applications. 

This is a highly hands-on role requiring strong ownership, automation mindset, troubleshooting skills, and the ability to work closely with software engineers and product teams in a fast-paced startup/product engineering environment. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Cloud & Infrastructure: 

- Deploy and operate applications primarily on AWS. 
 - Work with EC2, ECS, EKS, VPC, ALB/NLB, IAM, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, WAF, SSM, and KMS. 
 - Support deployments across Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, and Red Hat OpenShift. 
 - Provision and manage infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code. 
 - Manage cloud environments, configurations, backups, and production infrastructure. 
 - Troubleshoot infrastructure, networking, deployment, and production issues. 

CI/CD & DevSecOps

- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for Java, Python, microservices, and AI applications. 
 - Work with GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, and/or Azure DevOps. 
 - Automate application build, testing, deployment, and rollback processes. 
 - Integrate security scanning into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Work with SonarQube, Checkmarx, Black Duck, OWASP ZAP, container scanning, SAST, SCA, and DAST tools. 
 - Automate repetitive deployment and operational activities. 

Containers & Kubernetes

- Build and manage Docker-based application deployments. 
 - Deploy and operate applications on Kubernetes, AWS EKS, ECS, and OpenShift. 
 - Work with Helm charts and Kubernetes configurations. 
 - Manage container registries such as AWS ECR. 
 - Troubleshoot container and Kubernetes production issues. 

AI / GenAI Platform Deployment

- Deploy and operate GenAI, LLM, RAG, and Agentic AI applications. 
 - Support Python/FastAPI and Java/Spring Boot AI services. 
 - Deploy AI applications using AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI/Azure AI, and Google Vertex AI. 
 - Support AI agent orchestration platforms and services. 
 - Work with technologies such as Google ADK, LangGraph, LangChain, MCP, Neo4j, vector databases, and Langfuse. 
 - Support containerized AI workloads and GPU-based workloads where required. 

Production Deployment & Operations

- Execute production deployments and releases. 
 - Implement rolling, blue-green, and canary deployment strategies. 
 - Configure automated health checks, smoke tests, rollback, and deployment validation. 
 - Troubleshoot application, infrastructure, networking, and cloud issues. 
 - Participate in production support and root-cause analysis. 
 - Support disaster recovery, backup, and availability requirements. 

Platform Monitoring

- Implement and maintain application and infrastructure monitoring. 
 - Work with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, ELK/OpenSearch, and CloudWatch. 
 - Support centralized logging, metrics, and tracing. 
 - Monitor application health, infrastructure performance, and deployment issues. 

Collaboration & Technical Leadership

- Work closely with software engineers, AI engineers, architects, and product teams. 
 - Help development teams adopt standardized CI/CD and deployment practices. 
 - Review deployment configurations and identify opportunities for automation. 
 - Mentor junior DevOps engineers and provide hands-on technical guidance. 
 - Take ownership of DevOps activities across multiple Innovation Lab products. 
 - Help build reusable CI/CD pipelines, deployment templates, and automation scripts. 

Required Technical Skills

- Cloud: Strong AWS experience with EC2, ECS, EKS, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS, ALB/NLB, CloudWatch; working knowledge of Azure/GCP. 
 - DevOps & CI/CD: Docker, Kubernetes/EKS, Helm, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps. 
 - Infrastructure as Code: Terraform; Pulumi/CloudFormation is a plus. 
 - DevSecOps: SonarQube, Checkmarx, Black Duck, OWASP ZAP, SAST/SCA/DAST, and container security. 
 - Observability: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, ELK/OpenSearch, and CloudWatch. 
 - AI/GenAI: Deployment of LLM, RAG, AI Agent, and Python/FastAPI applications; exposure to Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, vector databases, and Neo4j is a plus. 
 - Application Platforms: Java/Spring Boot, Python/FastAPI, microservices, REST APIs, and RabbitMQ/Kafka or similar messaging platforms. 
 - Production Engineering: Automated deployments, rollback, smoke testing, blue-green/canary deployments, and performance testing using k6, JMeter, or Gatling. 

Preferred Experience

- Experience supporting SaaS, AI-powered, GenAI, or enterprise modernization products. 
 - Experience deploying applications across AWS and Kubernetes. 
 - Experience with AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, or Google Vertex AI. 
 - Experience with AI agent and RAG application deployments. 
 - Experience with cloud cost optimization is a plus. 
 - Experience with AWS Marketplace or AWS Partner programs is a plus. 
 - Experience in security and compliance environments is a plus.

- Design, configure, and deploy Ignition-based OT Data Operations gateways at the manufacturing edge, including virtual machines, Windows Server environments, plant networks, drivers, tags, MQTT brokers, historians, and security roles.

 - Collaborate with MES engineers, solution architects, and site controls engineers to ensure smooth integration of the OT Data Operations layer with TrakSYS MES, existing MQIS capabilities, and future MOM solutions.

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Instrumentation, Electronics, Electrical, or IT Engineering from an accredited university. 
 - Experience: 10+ years of experience in Controls Engineering, Manufacturing Systems Engineering, and Data Analytics, including 5+ years of relevant experience in OT Data Operations on Ignition. 
 - Technical Skills: Strong experience in OT/industrial automation engineering, including PLC/SCADA, historians, industrial networks, and manufacturing data integration/MES implementation. 
 - Platform Expertise: Direct hands-on experience with Inductive Automation Ignition, including gateway configuration, tag historian, alarming, MQTT modules, security/SSO, Perspective, and Jython scripting.

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

Job Description

Embedded Architect

13 - 20 Years Experience. 

We are looking for an experienced Embedded Architect with strong expertise in C++, Embedded Systems, and RTOS to define and drive the architecture of complex embedded products. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience designing real-time embedded software, developing scalable architectures, and leading technical decisions across firmware and embedded software teams. 

You will work closely with engineering, product, hardware, and systems teams to translate product requirements into robust, reliable, and high-performance embedded solutions. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define the software architecture and technical roadmap for complex embedded systems. 
 - Design scalable, modular, and reusable embedded software architectures. 
 - Develop and review embedded software using modern C++. 
 - Design and implement real-time systems using RTOS such as FreeRTOS, Zephyr, QNX, VxWorks, or similar. 
 - Define task/thread architecture, scheduling, inter-task communication, synchronization, memory management, and interrupt handling. 
 - Drive architectural decisions related to performance, latency, reliability, scalability, and resource utilization. 
 - Collaborate with hardware, firmware, systems, and product engineering teams on end-to-end product architecture. 
 - Establish coding standards, design patterns, development methodologies, and best practices. 
 - Review architecture, design documents, source code, and technical implementations. 
 - Mentor senior engineers and technical leads and provide technical direction to embedded development teams. 
 - Troubleshoot complex system-level issues involving concurrency, timing, memory, hardware/software interfaces, and real-time performance. 
 - Drive technical investigations, proof-of-concepts, and evaluation of new embedded technologies. 
 - Support product development through design, development, integration, testing, and production. 
 - Ensure compliance with relevant embedded software quality, safety, and security standards where applicable. 

Programming

- Strong proficiency in C and C++. 
 - Excellent understanding of modern C++ concepts, preferably C++11/14/17 or later. 
 - Object-oriented programming, templates, STL, design patterns, memory management, and multithreading. 
 - Strong understanding of low-level programming and resource-constrained environments. 

RTOS

- Strong hands-on experience with at least one RTOS, such as: 
 - FreeRTOS
 - Zephyr
 - QNX
 - VxWorks
 - ThreadX
 - Embedded Linux real-time environments
Embedded Systems

- Strong understanding of microcontrollers/microprocessors and embedded architectures. 
 - Experience with hardware/software interfaces and peripheral drivers. 
 - Knowledge of communication protocols such as SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, Ethernet, USB, or similar. 
 - Experience with bootloaders, device drivers, BSPs, firmware architecture, and hardware abstraction layers. 
 - Understanding of memory architecture, DMA, interrupts, caches, and low-level debugging. 

Embedded Linux

- Strong understanding of Embedded Linux is preferred. 
 - Experience with Linux kernel, device drivers, BSP, boot process, cross-compilation, and build systems is an advantage. 
 - Experience with Yocto/Buildroot is desirable. 

Architecture & Design

- Strong understanding of embedded software architecture and system design. 
 - Experience with modular, layered, component-based, and event-driven architectures. 
 - Knowledge of UML, architecture/design documentation, and design patterns. 
 - Ability to evaluate architectural trade-offs involving performance, memory, reliability, maintainability, and scalability. 
 - Experience designing systems involving multiple processors, communication interfaces, or distributed embedded components is preferred.

 - Developing GUI experience is a plus

 - Database design experience is a plus

 - Ability to working as part of a multidisciplinary team

 - Curious, creative and a collaborative problem solver

data.title: Regression Sr.Engineer/ Test Lead / Manager – 2G/4G/5G Radio Products
data.description:
Regression Test Lead / Manager - 2G/4G/5G Radio Products

Role Summary

We are looking for a senior technical leader to manage and guide the Regression team responsible for validating 2G, 4G and 5G (including O-RAN) radio products. The role combines hands-on RF and protocol validation expertise, automation leadership, and team mentoring. You will translate the product roadmap into test scenarios, automate them at scale, and ensure radio products meet quality, conformance, and schedule commitments. 

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership and Planning

- Lead and mentor the Regression team technically, guiding engineers on test design, debugging, and automation practices. 
 - Study the product roadmap, derive functional and system-level scenarios, and convert them into automated test cases. 
 - Develop and own complex test plans and strategies aligned with project scope and timelines; track execution and report status to stakeholders. 
 - Drive a strong sense of urgency and accountability to meet product delivery needs on time. 

Test Automation and Frameworks

- Design, implement and maintain automation scripts for functional, regression and performance testing. 
 - Build and maintain automation frameworks using industry best practices and tools such as Unittest and Pytest. 
 - Automate Radio Conformance Test (RCT) and end-to-end (E2E) scenarios. 
 - Develop instrument drivers, validation frameworks and measurement applications in Python (and MATLAB) to improve coverage, repeatability and productivity. 
 - Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines, and use Kubernetes-based environments for scalable test execution. 
 - Apply AI/ML techniques to improve test productivity, such as test generation, log analysis, failure triage, anomaly detection and coverage optimization. 

RF and Radio Validation

- Design, implement and execute 3GPP Radio Conformance Testing (RCT) methodologies for next-generation RF SoC and radio platforms, covering test development, automation, data analysis and debug. 
 - Perform hands-on characterization of RF subsystems and signal chains, including PA, LNA, filters, CFR and DPD algorithms across multiple technologies and carrier configurations. 
 - Develop custom measurement techniques and validation workflows for key metrics: EVM, ACLR, receiver sensitivity, noise figure, spectral emissions and transmitter linearity. 
 - Use and automate Keysight or Rohde & Schwarz equipment, including signal generators and signal/spectrum analyzers. 
 - Evaluate, integrate and optimize advanced RF test equipment and commercial test solutions to improve accuracy and throughput. 

Debug, Analysis and Bring-up

- Investigate and root-cause RF performance issues through lab measurements, statistical analysis, and cross-functional debugging with hardware, firmware and software teams. 
 - Drive silicon bring-up and system-level validation, identify performance gaps, and give actionable recommendations to design teams. 
 - Analyze large RF datasets to identify trends, anomalies and performance limits, and translate them into clear technical insights and design guidance. 

Experience

Required Qualifications

- 18+ years of relevant experience in wireless/radio validation. 
 - Has technically led and/or mentored a team of 6+ engineers. 
 - Has developed a complex test plan and managed its end-to-end execution. 

Technical Skills

- Strong coding skills in Python and shell scripting; working knowledge of C/C++ for developing test cases and scripts. 
 - Solid understanding of cellular wireless protocols (MAC/PHY), especially O-RAN, LTE or 5G. 
 - Knowledge of O-RAN, 5G or 4G technology. 
 - Expertise in using and automating Keysight or R&S RF equipment (signal generators, analyzers). 
 - Experience automating RCT and E2E scenarios. 
 - Familiarity with Kubernetes and containerized test environments. 
 - Practical experience using AI in engineering and testing workflows (a must-have). 

Behavioral Skills

- Able to work productively and independently. 
 - Strong team player with ownership and urgency. 
 - Clear communicator with the ability to report technical findings to both engineering and management audiences. 

Preferred Qualifications

- MATLAB experience for measurement and analysis. 
 - Exposure to silicon bring-up and RF SoC validation. 
 - Experience with certification and manufacturing test readiness. 
 - Background in statistical analysis of large RF datasets.

KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world's leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow's electronic devices. data.title: Staff AI Engineer - Servicing Enablement Platform
data.description:
Job Description

With the right backing, people and businesses have the power to progress in incredible ways. When you join Team Amex, you become part of a global and diverse community of colleagues with an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities and each other. Here, you'll learn and grow as we help you create a career journey that's unique and meaningful to you with benefits, programs, and flexibility that support you personally and professionally. 

At American Express, AI is reshaping the future of commerce and redefining the experiences our commercial customers and card members expect. Within Amex Technology, we are building platforms, products, and governance that enable agentic AI systems to operate responsibly and at scale across the enterprise. 

Our focus is on agentic AI development: designing intelligent, adaptive systems that can plan, reason, and act across complex workflows with appropriate levels of autonomy. These systems power autonomous workflows, decision support, and customer-facing experiences-while meeting the high standards for security, explainability, reliability, and compliance required in financial services. We partner closely with product, design, and business teams to deliver agentic capabilities that reduce operational friction, improve decision-making, and transform how customers interact, transact, and grow. 

Join Team Amex and let's lead the way together. 

The Team

The Service Enablement Platform (SEP) team is responsible for multiple critical platforms that enable the servicing across all channels at American Express. This includes Case Platforms that are used for Global Disputes Management, Fraud Servicing, Credit, Collections and Back-Office Case processing besides Global Card Issuance and Automation. 

From creating next-generation applications and microservices to leveraging AI, you could be doing transformational work that brings our iconic, global brand into the future. American Express is making continuous investments for building and scaling these platforms with security, resilience and innovation to meet our growth agenda and maintain trust, loyalty and premium experience for our customers. We are looking for strong leaders and engineers to be part of high energy and efficient teams that will bring our mission to life. 

Responsibilities

As a Staff Engineer - Agentic AI, you will operate as a senior individual contributor within Amex Technology, helping define how agentic AI systems are designed, built, and operated across the company. 

You will work at the intersection of agentic system architecture and hands-on execution: designing core frameworks, writing production code, reviewing critical designs, and guiding teams through complex technical decisions. This role does not include people management; your impact comes from technical leadership, sound judgment, and the ability to turn ambiguity into reliable, scalable agentic systems. 

You will work closely with Product and UX partners to shape a shared vision for agentic AI experiences. While product team's own prioritization, Staff engineers are expected to actively influence what gets built and how agentic systems come together across teams. 

This is an individual contributor, hands-on, deeply technical role with broad architectural ownership and high organizational impact; however, as the team grows, you will take on increasing responsibility for technical leadership and people development within the agentic AI space. Mentoring, developing and managing direct reports may be in scope for some of our opportunities. 

What You'll Do

- Drive technical direction for agentic AI initiatives, influencing architecture patterns, autonomy boundaries, and system design. 
 - Design, build, and operate production-grade agentic AI systems used across multiple products. 
 - Own and evolve shared agentic AI capabilities, including: 
 - Agent frameworks and orchestration layers
 - Planning, tool use, and memory strategies
 - Retrieval and grounding (RAG) pipelines
 - LLM infrastructure, inference, and model gateways
 - Evaluation, observability, and safety tooling for autonomous systems
 - Lead technical design reviews and help teams navigate tradeoffs involving autonomy, safety, reliability, scalability, and cost. 
 - Partner across teams to deliver complex, cross-cutting agentic AI initiatives from concept to production. 
 - Evaluate emerging models, techniques, and agentic patterns and translate them into practical, enterprise-ready improvements. 
 - Mentor senior engineers and raise the technical bar for agentic AI development through example and influence. 
 - You will be responsible to architect and own coordination across multiple platforms across the portfolio, ensuring scalability, resiliency, and compliance with global standards
 - Build POCs to experiment new technologies, databases and other application infrastructure. 
 - You will constantly pursue and learn industry leading/innovative technologies and solutions. Be acutely aware of enabling technologies and open-source products to build low latency distributed systems. 
 - Drive a culture of innovation and experimentation. 
 - Provide technical consulting support to Global Product teams and regional stakeholders for secure product rollouts
 - Partner with risk, compliance, and cybersecurity teams to ensure solutions meet evolving regulatory and security requirements. 
 - Work with peers, Principal Engineers and Principal Architects to assimilate new technology and delivery methods into scalable software solutions, using and contributing to engineering best practices across the company

Qualifications

We don't hire to a narrow checklist, but candidates should be comfortable operating in a modern, enterprise-scale engineering environment with a strong emphasis on agentic AI. 

Core Engineering Stack

- Languages: Python, Go, TypeScript
 - APIs and RPC: REST, gRPC (and in some areas tRPC)
 - Cloud and infrastructure: AWS and/or GCP, Kubernetes
 - Distributed systems: event-driven architectures, including Kafka
 - Orchestration Frameworks: LangGraph, LangChain, AirFlow, etc
 - Integration of commercial and open-source LLMs into agentic workflows
 - Agent and orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or CrewAI, with strong judgment about when to use frameworks versus building lighter-weight primitives
 - Model-level work using PyTorch and the Hugging Face ecosystem (embeddings, fine-tuning, inference tooling), with some exposure to TensorFlow
 - Strong schema, validation, and state management practices using tools such as Pydantic (Python) and Zod (TypeScript)

Agentic AI and ML

Across all systems, we emphasize evaluation, observability, safety, and reliability, reflecting the responsibility of deploying autonomous AI in a regulated, customer-facing environment. 

What We're Looking For

- Languages: Python, Go, TypeScript
 - APIs and RPC: REST, gRPC (and in some areas tRPC)
 - Cloud and infrastructure: AWS and/or GCP, Kubernetes
 - Distributed systems: event-driven architectures, including Kafka
 - Orchestration Frameworks: LangGraph, LangChain, AirFlow, etc

Preferred Qualifications

- Languages: Python, Go, TypeScript
 - APIs and RPC: REST, gRPC (and in some areas tRPC)
 - Cloud and infrastructure: AWS and/or GCP, Kubernetes
 - Distributed systems: event-driven architectures, including Kafka
 - Orchestration Frameworks: LangGraph, LangChain, AirFlow, etc
 - You have Computer Science / Information Systems degree, or equivalent with at-least 8+ years of work experience. 
 - Experience building intelligent solutions leveraging GenAI and other modern tech stacks
 - Have built and delivered large scale enterprise systems/products. 
 - Have excellent written and verbal communications skills. Create and deliver effective presentations to Senior Leadership. 
 - Ability to partner and influence effectively across multiple business and functional lines, up to and including technology leadership team and business leadership team
 - Exceptional leadership skills to inspire and support a diverse and inclusive team of industry-leading internal and external talent

About Us

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service. 

As part of Team Amex, you'll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express. 

About The Team

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally: 

- Competitive base salaries
 - Bonus incentives

 - Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
 - Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
 - Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
 - Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
 - Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
 - Career development and training opportunities

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer
data.description:
Strength in Trust

OneTrust's mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn't slow teams down-it should accelerate what's possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‐Ready Governance PlatformTM, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society. 

The Challenge

We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to lead technical direction across a major feature area or system domain at OneTrust. Staff Engineers here own outcomes, not just designs; they decide how ambiguous, cross-cutting problems get solved when no existing playbook applies, and their judgment carries weight across teams they don't formally manage. 

Your Mission

Technical Leadership & Architecture

- Lead architecture and design for systems with significant scope and blast radius, ensuring decisions hold up under real growth, compliance, and reliability constraints; not just initial requirements. 
 - Paying attention to application performance 
 - Exercise judgment on where AI-assisted tooling accelerates delivery and where deeper human design thinking is required

Cross-Team Collaboration

- Partner with Product, UX, and other engineering teams early, shaping problems before solutions are locked in. 
 - Build working relationships and technical credibility beyond your immediate team. 

Quality & Standards

- Set engineering practices for code review norms, testing standards, and incident review rigor that outlast your direct involvement and get adopted by teams you don't sit on. 
 - Identify and address systemic risk (technical debt, architectural drift, single points of failure) before it becomes an incident. 

Mentorship

- Mentor Senior and mid-level engineers on technical judgment: how to scope ambiguity, when to escalate vs. decide, and how to use (and not over-rely on) AI tooling in their own work. 
 - Help engineers build the skill of writing decisions down clearly enough that others can disagree productively. 

You Are

Someone who determines methods and approach independently on new, complex assignments, and who is sought out by other engineers for technical guidance beyond your own team. You think in terms of systems and tradeoffs, not just individual tickets. 

Your Experience Includes

- Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools (e. g. , Claude Code, Devin, Windsurf, or similar) in a professional setting, with genuine enthusiasm for applying AI to accelerate and elevate day-to-day engineering work. 
 - 8+ years of professional software engineering/development experience
 - Extensive hands-on experience and expertise in object-oriented design methodology and application development using Java/J2EE, Design Patterns, DSA, Multithreading, Spring MVC, SQL, Web services. 
 - Experience with elastic search and data streaming tools like Kafka. 
 - Good understanding of web services and SOA related standards like REST/OAuth/JSON. 
 - Agile development (Scrum, XP, or Pair Programming) experience
 - Ability to use a wide variety of open-source technologies and cloud services (Azure, Google Computer, or Amazon Web Services)
 - Familiarity with public cloud providers such as (Azure, Google Cloud, or AWS)
 - Proficiency in Kubernetes, including cluster deployment, scaling, and management is highly desirable. 

Where we Work

We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person. 

Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview. 

Benefits

As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you'll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust. com/careers. 

Resources

Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people: 

- OneTrust Careers on YouTube
 - @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

Your Data

You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview. You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form. 

Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust. com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us. greenhouse-mail. io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign. net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust. com. 

Our Commitment to You

When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad - the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career. 

OneTrust provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by local laws.

- Deep Kubernetes expertise (workload types, scheduling, resource requests/limits, namespaces, RBAC)
 - Kubernetes operators for stateful systems - Strimzi (Kafka), Flink Kubernetes Operator, ClickHouse Operator (Altinity)
 - Helm chart authoring and management (not just consumption - writing and maintaining charts)
 - StatefulSet management, persistent volume claims, storage class configuration
 - Multi-cluster and multi-site Kubernetes deployments
 - Node affinity, taints/tolerations, pod disruption budgets for workload isolation
 - Kubernetes networking: services, ingress, network policies, DNS
 - Secrets management (Kubernetes secrets, Vault integration, or equivalent)

Platform Component Expertise

Kafka

- Kafka cluster sizing, broker configuration, topic design (partitions, replication, retention)
 - Strimzi operator - KafkaNodePool, KafkaTopic, KafkaUser, KafkaMirrorMaker2 CRDs
 - Kafka Connect cluster deployment and connector lifecycle management
 - Kafka security: TLS, mTLS, SASL, ACLs
 - Kafka upgrade and rolling restart procedures with zero data lossFlink

- Flink cluster deployment modes on Kubernetes (Application mode, Session mode)
 - Flink Kubernetes Operator - FlinkDeployment, FlinkSessionJob CRDs
 - Checkpointing and savepoint management (S3 or distributed storage backends)
 - Flink HA configuration (Kubernetes-native HA or ZooKeeper)
 - Job submission, monitoring, and restarts without data lossClickHouse

- ClickHouse cluster deployment with Altinity operator or ClickHouse Operator
 - Shard and replica topology design for multi-factory deployments
 - Storage configuration: tiered storage, disk policies, S3-backed cold storage
 - Backup and restore strategies
 - ClickHouse Keeper vs ZooKeeper for coordination

Observability & Monitoring

- Full observability stack deployment: Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager
 - Kafka metrics: broker JMX metrics, consumer lag (Burrow or Cruise Control), under-replicated partitions
 - Flink metrics: checkpoint duration, backpressure, restart frequency, throughput/latency per operator
 - ClickHouse metrics: query latency, merge backlog, insert rate, replication lag, memory/disk pressure
 - Kubernetes cluster metrics: node utilization, pod restarts, OOMKill events, PVC utilization
 - SLO/SLI definition and alerting for platform uptime and data freshness
 - Distributed tracing for pipeline end-to-end latency visibility
 - Log aggregation (EFK stack, Loki, or equivalent) for platform component logs

Load Testing & Capacity Planning

- Load testing frameworks for streaming platforms (Gatling, k6, custom Kafka producer harnesses)
 - Designing load test scenarios that simulate factory production volumes and burst conditions
 - Benchmarking Kafka throughput (MB/s, msg/s) under varying partition counts and consumer configurations
 - Flink job stress testing - measuring backpressure onset, checkpoint interval degradation under load
 - ClickHouse ingestion benchmarking (insert throughput, concurrent query performance under load)
 - Capacity modeling: translating factory data volumes and growth projections into infrastructure sizing
 - Breaking point analysis - identifying bottlenecks before production traffic hits them

Isolation & Multi-Tenancy

- Namespace-level isolation for multiple factory deployments on shared Kubernetes clusters
 - Kafka topic and consumer group isolation strategies across factory sites and teams
 - Resource quotas and LimitRanges to prevent noisy-neighbor problems between factory workloads
 - Network policy enforcement to isolate factory data plane traffic
 - Separate Kafka clusters vs shared clusters with namespace isolation - trade-off analysis and implementation
 - Per-factory ClickHouse cluster deployment vs shared cluster with database/user isolation

CI/CD & GitOps for Platform

- GitOps-driven platform deployment: ArgoCD or Flux for Kubernetes manifest management
 - Helm chart versioning and promotion across environments (dev → staging → factory-prod)
 - Operator upgrade management and CRD migration procedures
 - Automated smoke tests post-deployment to validate platform health
 - Change management for platform updates in production factory environments

Security & Compliance

- mTLS and certificate management (cert-manager on Kubernetes)
 - Kafka ACL management at scale
 - Network segmentation between factory OT and IT data flows
 - Image scanning and supply chain security for platform container images
 - Audit logging for platform access and configuration changes

AI-Assisted Development

- Using AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or equivalent) to accelerate Helm chart authoring, operator configuration, and runbook generation
 - AI-assisted troubleshooting - using LLMs to diagnose Kubernetes events, Flink exceptions, and Kafka error logs faster
 - Generating observability dashboards and alert rules with AI assistance
 - Critical review of AI-generated infrastructure code before applying to production

data.title: AI Automation Specialist_2881
data.description:
Overall Objectives of Job

The AI Generalist is a pivotal technical role within the 'Automation chapter' of the Security Services Tribe. The role is responsible for designing, developing, and operationalising Agentic AI solutions - encompassing LLM-based workflows, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, and multi-step orchestration frameworks - that enable to apply intelligence on large volumes of security data at scale. 

The engineer will work closely with security service product owners across Vulnerability Management, Web Application Firewall (WAF), Governance Risk and Compliance (GRC), and other domains to identify automation opportunities, build secure AI-powered workflows, and enforce robust AI guardrails appropriate for the sensitive cybersecurity environment. 

Core Responsibilities

- Partner with security product teams (Vulnerability Management, WAF, GRC) to analyse operations, identify AI/automation opportunities, and translate them into production-grade agentic workflows. 
 - Design and develop Agentic AI systems using LLM frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, or equivalent) to automate multi-step security workflows with minimal human intervention. 
 - Build and maintain Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines to enable intelligent querying and contextual analysis of large security datasets, logs, and knowledge bases. 
 - Implement AI orchestration and workflow automation solutions that integrate with security tools such as SIEM, SOAR, vulnerability scanners, WAF platforms, and GRC systems via REST APIs. 
 - Apply security-first principles to all AI development - implement guardrails, prompt injection defences, output validation, and rate-limiting controls to protect AI pipelines in a sensitive cybersecurity context. 
 - Develop data analytics capabilities to derive actionable intelligence from large-scale security telemetry, alert data, and threat feeds using Python, SQL, and data visualisation tools. 
 - Ensure responsible AI practices: monitor for model drift, hallucination risks, bias in AI-driven decisions, and maintain audit trails for AI-assisted security actions. 
 - Collaborate with DevSecOps and platform teams to deploy AI models and workflows through CI/CD pipelines with appropriate access controls and secrets management. 

Primary Skills

- Agentic AI Development (Mandatory) - hands-on experience building multi-agent or agentic AI systems using LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or comparable orchestration frameworks. 
 - LLM Integration (Mandatory) - practical experience integrating large language models (OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Mistral, or open-source equivalents) into production applications via APIs. 
 - RAG Pipelines (Mandatory) - design and implementation of Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems including vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, ChromaDB), embedding models, and chunking strategies. 
 - Python (Mandatory) - advanced scripting for AI workflow automation, data processing, API integration, and security tooling. 
 - REST API Integration (Mandatory) - experience integrating AI agents with third-party security platforms (SIEM, SOAR, vulnerability management, ticketing) via REST APIs. 
 - AI Security & Guardrails - knowledge of agentic AI security risks (prompt injection, data leakage, tool misuse) and hands-on experience implementing guardrails, input sanitisation, and safe output handling. 
 - Data Analytics - proficiency in analysing and deriving insights from large structured/unstructured datasets using Python (Pandas, NumPy), SQL, and visualisation tools (Grafana, Power BI, or similar). 
 - Cybersecurity Domain Awareness - working knowledge of security operations concepts: vulnerability management lifecycles, WAF rule logic, GRC frameworks, SOC workflows, and security alert triage.

data.title: Engineering Manager, Trust Platform Capabilities, Geo
data.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. 

Minimum qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 8 years of experience in software development. 
 - 3 years of experience with developing large-scale infrastructure, distributed systems or networks, or experience with compute technologies, storage or hardware architecture. 
 - 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role. 
 - 2 years of experience in a people management or team leadership role. 

Preferred qualifications: 

- Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field. 
 - 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization. 
 - Experience leading software development teams building scalable distributed infrastructure/middlewares. 
 - Strong stakeholder communication, strategic and product thinking, and the ability to influence senior stakeholders. 

About The Job

Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started -- and as a manager, you guide the way. 

With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally. 

User Generated Content (UGC) is a cornerstone of Google Maps, with users submitting over 10 million reviews and photos daily and driving more than 3 billion factual edits annually to model the physical world. 

The team is pioneering an AI-first trust stack that transforms trust from a legacy backend filter into an intelligent, proactive platform across the entire UGC lifecycle. 

The Geo team is focused on building the most accurate, comprehensive, and useful maps for our users, through products like Maps, Earth, Street View, Google Maps Platform, and more. Every month, more than a billion people rely on Maps services to explore the world and navigate their daily lives. 

The Geo team also enables developers to use the power of Google Maps platforms to enhance their apps and websites. As they plot a course for the future of mapping, they are solving complex computer science problems, designing beautiful and intuitive product experiences, and improving our understanding of the real world. 

Responsibilities

- Set and communicate team priorities that support the broader organization's goals. Align strategy, processes, and decision-making across teams. 
 - Set clear expectations with individuals based on their level and role and aligned to the broader organization's goals. Meet regularly with individuals to discuss performance and development and provide feedback and coaching. 
 - Develop the mid-term technical goal and roadmap. Evolve the roadmap to meet anticipated future requirements and infrastructure needs. 
 - Design, guide and vet systems designs and write product or system development code to solve ambiguous problems. Understand UGC requirements for Geo (and beyond for 2P and 3P) and help with the solutions for providing the capabilities as a platform. 
 - Review code developed by other engineers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e. g. , style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency). 

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

data.description:
At Securonix, we're on a mission to secure the world by staying ahead of cyber threats and reinforcing all layers of our platform with AI capabilities. Our Securonix Unified Defense SIEM provides organizations with the first and only AI-reinforced solution built with a cybersecurity mesh architecture on a highly scalable data cloud. Enhanced by Securonix EON's AI capabilities, our innovative cloud-native solution delivers a seamless CyberOps experience, empowering organizations to scale their security operations and keep pace with evolving threats. 

Recognized as a five-time Leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for SIEM and highly rated on Gartner Peer Insights, our award-winning Unified Defense SIEM provides organizations with 365 days of "hot" data for rapid search and investigation, threat content-as-a-service, proactive defense through continuous peer and partner collaboration, and a fully integrated Threat Detection, Investigation, and Response (TDIR) experience all within a single platform. Built on a cloud-native architecture, the platform leverages the Snowflake Data Cloud for unparalleled scalability and performance. 

Securonix is proud to be a cybersecurity unicorn and to be featured in CRN's 2024 Security 100 list. Backed by Vista Equity Partners, one of the largest private equity firms, with over $100 billion in assets under management, we have a unique advantage in driving innovation and growth. With a global footprint, we serve more than 1, 000 customers worldwide, including 10% of the Fortune 100. Our network of 150+ partners and Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs) enables us to deliver unmatched security solutions on a global scale. 

Join us as we redefine cybersecurity, innovate fearlessly, and grow together as one team. 

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Staff Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to lead quality engineering across distributed data platforms, microservices, modern web applications, and agentic AI systems. 

Key Responsibilities

Big Data, Backend, and Microservices Testing

- Define end-to-end test strategies for batch, streaming and data-warehouse workloads using technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Hadoop, Hive, HDFS, and Delta Lake. 
 - Automate data-quality validation using Python, PySpark, Pytest. 
 - Validate ingestion, transformation, schema evolution, partitioning, reconciliation, completeness, accuracy, freshness, and business rules. 
 - Test distributed microservices, REST and GraphQL APIs, and event-driven architectures. 
 - Build API, integration, component, and consumer-driven contract tests using tools such as Postman/Newman, REST Assured, or equivalent frameworks. 
 - Validate authentication, authorization, backward compatibility, retries, timeouts, circuit breakers, data consistency, idempotency, failure recovery, and service resilience. 
 - Evaluate scalability, performance, and fault tolerance under production-like traffic and data volumes. 

Web and Browser Automation

- Design and maintain scalable test frameworks using Playwright and Cypress. 
 - Develop reliable end-to-end, API, integration, visual-regression, and accessibility test coverage. 
 - Use Playwright capabilities such as browser isolation, fixtures, auto-waiting assertions, network interception, API testing, tracing, screenshots, parallel execution, and test sharding. 
 - Test dynamic, data-driven interfaces and validate consistency across the browser, APIs, microservices, and data stores. 
 - Improve automation reliability through stable locators, deterministic test data, service virtualization, API mocking, and effective failure diagnostics. 

Agentic AI and LLM Testing

- Define evaluation strategies for LLM applications, RAG systems, AI copilots, tool-using agents, and multi-agent workflows. 
 - Build evaluation datasets from curated, production-derived, edge-case, and adversarial scenarios. 
 - Measure task completion, accuracy, groundedness, retrieval quality, instruction following, tool selection, structured outputs, state management, and workflow completion. 
 - Test AI systems for prompt injection, jailbreaks, sensitive-data leakage, hallucination, insecure output handling, excessive agency, and unsafe tool use. 
 - Validate guardrails, least-privilege access, sandboxing, rate limits, human approvals, and recovery from failed or unexpected actions. 
 - Implement trace-based evaluation and continuous quality gates for agent decisions, tool calls, latency, errors, token usage, and cost. 
 - Use Playwright to test browser-capable AI agents, including navigation, form interaction, permissions, approval checkpoints, and error recovery. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 8+ years of experience in software quality engineering, test automation, or software development, including senior technical leadership. 
 - Strong experience testing distributed data pipelines, microservices, APIs, or event-driven systems. 
 - Hands-on experience with Spark, Kafka, Hadoop, Hive, or modern cloud-data platforms. 
 - Advanced programming and automation skills in Python, and JavaScript/TypeScript. 
 - Strong browser-automation experience with Playwright or Cypress, including framework design, API testing, parallel execution, and CI integration. 
 - Experience with API contracts, service virtualization, distributed workflows, authentication, and failure handling. 
 - Experience with CI/CD platforms such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps. 
 - Working knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, Linux, cloud environments, and production observability. 
 - Strong communication, collaboration, mentoring, and problem-solving skills. 

Securonix provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, amnesty or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws.

Qualitrol is building an AI-Native Product Engineering team focused on enterprise analytics services for critical electrical infrastructure. data.description:
LEAD PHYSICAL DESIGN ENGINEER

Company: Siliconus Technologies Private Limited

Location: Bengaluru

Employment Type: Full-Time

Experience: 8-15 Years

JOB SUMMARY

Siliconus Technologies is looking for an experienced Lead Physical Design Engineer to lead and manage Physical Design activities across block-level and full-chip projects. 

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on expertise in the RTL-to-GDSII flow, excellent technical leadership skills, and the ability to independently drive PPA optimization, timing closure, physical signoff, project execution, and customer interactions. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Lead the end-to-end Physical Design flow from netlist to GDSII. 

• Own project execution and technical delivery for assigned blocks/projects. 

• Lead floorplanning, power planning, placement, CTS, routing, optimization, and signoff activities. 

• Drive timing closure for setup and hold across multiple modes and corners. 

• Perform and review MCMM STA analysis and resolve timing issues. 

• Drive PPA optimization across performance, power, and area targets. 

• Analyze and resolve congestion, transition, capacitance, fanout, DRC, and routing violations. 

• Drive IR Drop, EM, Signal Integrity, Crosstalk, DRC/LVS and physical signoff activities. 

• Lead ECO implementation and timing optimization. 

• Work closely with RTL, Synthesis, STA, DFT, PV, and Foundry teams to resolve technical issues. 

• Drive block integration and full-chip implementation activities. 

• Own tapeout readiness and ensure all signoff criteria are met.

• Review team deliverables and ensure adherence to project methodologies and quality standards. 

• Plan task allocation, track project progress, and ensure deliverables are completed within timelines. 

• Identify technical risks and proactively develop solutions to avoid project delays. 

• Participate in customer meetings, technical discussions, status calls, and project reviews. 

• Support estimation, resource planning, and technical proposals for new projects. 

• Develop and improve Physical Design methodologies and automation flows. 

• Use Tcl / Perl / Python / Shell scripting for flow automation and productivity improvements. 

REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS

• Strong hands-on experience in the complete RTL-to-GDSII Physical Design flow. 

• Expertise in Floorplanning, Power Planning, Placement & Optimization, CTS, Routing, Post-route Optimization, STA & Timing Closure, ECO, Physical Verification, and Signoff. 

• Strong understanding of MCMM, Setup/Hold, OCV/AOCV/POCV and timing constraints. 

• Good knowledge of IR Drop, EM, Signal Integrity and Crosstalk.

LEADERSHIP & MANAGEMENT SKILLS

• Ability to lead a Physical Design team and take complete technical ownership. 

• Ability to distribute tasks and track team progress effectively. 

• Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills. 

• Ability to review and technically mentor team members. 

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills. 

• Ability to interact confidently with customers and cross-functional teams.

QUALIFICATIONS

• Proven experience leading Physical Design teams/projects.

• Multiple tapeout experience is highly preferred. 

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

• Experience in full-chip integration and signoff. 

• Strong experience in PPA optimization and timing convergence.

WHAT WE OFFER

• Opportunity to work on end-to-end RTL-to-GDSII and tapeout projects. 

• Technical and leadership growth opportunities.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
Senior Software Engineer - Managed Threat Response

Bengaluru, India

About Mimecast

Mimecast is a leading cybersecurity company that helps organizations protect their people, data, and communications. With over 42, 000 customers worldwide, Mimecast has a long history of excellence in Data Archiving and eDiscovery and is recognised as a Leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Digital Communications Governance and Archiving Solutions. 

We are pioneers in Human Risk Management, recognizing that people are both an organization's greatest asset and its most significant security vulnerability. Our platform addresses the human element of cybersecurity through advanced threat detection, awareness training, Incydr risk management, and data governance. Our Governance, Compliance & Insight products play a critical role in this mission, ensuring that communications data is archived, discoverable, and compliant, enabling organizations to manage the risk that stems from human actions. 

AI-First Engineering at Mimecast

Mimecast is an AI-First engineering organization. Our teams actively leverage AI-powered development tools across all facets of engineering, from code development to testing, documentation, and operations. We're looking for leaders who don't just use AI tools but champion their adoption and establish new ways of working. 

Our AI leadership extends beyond how we build to what we build. Our Mihra AI agent delivers 7x faster threat response for customers, and we're recognized as "Agents of Change" in Human Risk Management. Engineers here work at the intersection of cutting-edge AI tooling and AI-powered security products that protect organizations worldwide. 

The driving force behind Collaboration Security at Mimecast

Dive into the forefront of innovation with our Managed Threat Response engineering team, where we build the platforms that detect, investigate, and remediate threats on behalf of our customers. Our products leverage the latest technologies and advances in Artificial Intelligence to stay one step ahead of cybercriminals - and we build them the same way. 

Why Join Our Team?

"At Mimecast we process over a billion emails and collaboration events every day, and our team is what stands between our customers and the threats hiding in that traffic. We are building an engineering team where AI is how the work gets done - not a side experiment. This role is for someone who has already made that shift and can pull a team along with them: lead the design, set the quality bar, and show others what good looks like. " - Hiring Manager

What You'll Do

As a Senior Software Engineer you will lead the engineering design for significant features and system areas across Mailroom and Threat Portal, with contributions into our Managed Email Incident Response and Remediation products. You will work as an AI-first engineer and deliberately raise the level at which the team around you does the same. Your responsibilities will include: 

- Lead the engineering design for significant system areas, from framing the problem through to a system running reliably in production. 
 - Design distributed components that stay available and scale horizontally, reasoning about failure modes - race conditions, partial failure, data consistency - before they reach production rather than after. 
 - Produce design documents others can build from, and model disciplined practice: comprehensive test coverage, proactive observability, and clear technical documentation. 
 - Use agentic AI development tools as your primary working method, and build out the team's practice around them - reusable workflows, context and prompt patterns, evaluations - so that AI is used rigorously rather than as a shortcut. 
 - Own the quality of everything you merge, regardless of what produced it, and set the standard the team applies when reviewing AI-generated code. 
 - Balance technical trade-offs against product and delivery commitments, and make that reasoning visible to Product and Engineering leadership. 
 - Mentor junior and mid-level engineers deliberately through pairing, design review, and code review, and align stakeholders behind a technical direction the team can execute with confidence. 
 - Lead during critical incidents spanning multiple services - diagnosis, clear communication, and the preventive work that follows - and monitor resource usage for cost savings that do not compromise performance or reliability. 
 - Work with Product, Support, and other engineering teams to drive cross-team collaboration, and engage in Agile activities: backlog refinement, planning, design and code reviews, demos, and retrospectives. 

What You'll Bring

We are looking for a strong engineer first. Depth in any single framework or tool matters far less to us than how you think, how fast you learn, and the quality of what you and the people around you ship. 

- Deep expertise and system-level design judgement. Command of your core stack plus fluency in adjacent systems, and a track record of designing components whose failure modes, cost profile, and cross-service effects on reliability and security you thought about up front. 
 - A track record of shipping and owning. Around six or more years building production software, including system areas you owned through multiple iterations, real incidents, and the architectural changes that followed. 
 - Proven AI-first development practice, applied to others as well as yourself. Demonstrable day-to-day development with agentic coding tools rather than occasional autocomplete, plus evidence that you deliberately raised someone else's practice - workflows, tooling, patterns, or standards that others adopted and kept using. We work in Cursor, but we care that you have built this way, not which tool you used. 
 - Critical judgement over AI output. A working understanding of where these tools fail - hallucinated APIs, plausible-but-wrong logic, silent security and performance regressions - the discipline never to merge code you cannot explain, and the credibility to hold a team to that line. 
 - Strong proficiency in at least one modern backend language, and evidence that you have picked up others quickly. Our stack is primarily Python and Django; deep experience is welcome, but demonstrated ability to become productive fast matters more. 
 - Practical platform skills. Relational data modelling and query performance (PostgreSQL or similar), distributed building blocks such as caching (Redis) and search engines (Elasticsearch), containerisation, CI/CD pipelines, and foundational AWS services. 
 - Influence, deliberate mentorship, and clear written communication. You bring others with you rather than working around them, you explain technical concepts credibly to non-technical stakeholders, and you collaborate well across a team distributed over multiple time zones. 
 - Nice to have: front-end experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, Angular or React; Java; prior work in cybersecurity or email security; and hands-on experience building LLM-backed application features such as retrieval, tool use, or evaluation harnesses. 

What We Bring

Join our Managed Threat Response team to accelerate your career journey, working with cutting-edge technologies on projects that have real customer impact. You will be given first-class AI development tooling and the time and mandate to get genuinely good with it: we treat AI engineering capability as a skill we invest in and measure, and we judge engineers on the outcomes they ship and the quality they sustain - not on lines of code written. 

Mimecast offers formal and on-the-job learning opportunities and maintains a comprehensive benefits package that helps our employees and their family members sustain a healthy lifestyle. We believe in 'growth that's good', we have 'a culture that cares' and we are on a 'mission that matters'. 

Our Hybrid Model: We provide you with the flexibility to live balanced, healthy lives through our hybrid working model that champions both collaborative teamwork and individual flexibility. Employees are expected to come to the office at least two days per week, because working together in person: 

- Fosters a culture of collaboration, communication, performance and learning
 - Drives innovation and creativity within and between teams
 - Introduces employees to priorities outside of their immediate realm
 - Ensures important interpersonal relationships and connections with one another and our community!

Belonging at Mimecast

Cybersecurity is a community effort. That's why we're committed to building an inclusive, diverse community that celebrates and welcomes everyone - unless they're a cybercriminal, of course. 

We're proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, and we'd encourage you to join us whatever your background. We particularly welcome applicants from traditionally underrepresented groups. 

We consider everyone equally: your race, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, ability, marital status, nationality, or any other protected characteristic won't affect your application. 

Due to certain obligations to our customers, an offer of employment will be subject to your successful completion of applicable background checks, conducted in accordance with local law. 

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment.

data.description:
Strength in Trust

OneTrust's mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn't slow teams down-it should accelerate what's possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‐Ready Governance PlatformTM, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society. 

The Challenge

We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer with a passion for solving problems to join our agile Product Engineering team at OneTrust. Senior Software Engineers own the delivery of complex features end-to-end and are a go-to technical resource for their immediate team. 

Your Mission

Execution & Delivery

- Independently own delivery of complex features or components from design through production, requiring evaluation of multiple interacting factors. 
 - Drive system architecture and component-design discussions for your area of ownership. 

Collaboration & Influence

- Partner closely with Product, UX, and other engineers to shape solutions during planning, not just execution. 
 - Network with senior engineers across the org to align on shared technical decisions. 
 - Stays curious and has the ability to ideate, innovate & improve by identifying patterns that can bring quality and velocity improvements

Quality & Craft

- Conduct peer code reviews and help set the quality bar for your team. 
 - Champion testing practices, including exploratory and AI-assisted testing approaches. 

Mentorship

- Support the ramp-up and growth of Associate and Software Engineers on your team. 

You Are

A seasoned, fully-capable engineer who requires minimal day-to-day direction and only needs general guidance on genuinely new assignments. You proactively surface risks and ambiguity rather than waiting to be asked. You work independently on established types of work, taking ownership from design through delivery with limited need for oversight. You're not afraid to ask for input mainly when facing unfamiliar or ambiguous problems, where the right approach isn't yet obvious. Your passionate about flagging risks and open questions during planning or design, before they turn into issues later in the process

Your Experience Includes

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field 
 - 8+ years of professional software engineering experience on Core Java, Spring, Spring boot, hibernate, microservices and Kafka messaging. Also looking at experience on agentic platforms like Microsoft foundry, agent core, google vertex, Bedrock. 
 - Demonstrated experience owning complex features end-to-end in either frontend or backend systems 
 - Familiarity with a public cloud provider (Azure, Google Cloud, or AWS) 
 - Experience informally mentoring or supporting the growth of junior engineers is a plus 
 - Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools (e. g. , Claude Code, Devin, Windsurf, or similar) in a professional setting, with genuine enthusiasm for applying AI to accelerate and elevate day-to-day engineering work. 

Where we Work

We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person. 

Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview. 

Benefits

As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you'll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust. com/careers. 

Resources

Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people: 

- OneTrust Careers on YouTube
 - @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

Your Data

You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview. You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form. 

Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust. com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us. greenhouse-mail. io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign. net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust. com. 

Our Commitment to You

When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad - the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career. 

OneTrust provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by local laws.
