Additional Information

Return to Office: PubMatic employees throughout the global have returned to our offices via a hybrid work schedule (3 days "in office" and 2 days "working remotely") that is intended to maximize collaboration, innovation, and productivity among teams and across functions. 

Benefits: Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide, such as paternity/maternity leave, healthcare insurance, broadband reimbursement. As well, when we're back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches and much more!

Diversity and Inclusion: PubMatic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don't just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. 

About PubMatic

PubMatic is one of the world's leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes.

data.title: Senior Staff Engineer, Bare Metal Kubernetes Platform
data.description:
Who are we?

Equinix is the world's digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet. 

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future. 

Help us challenge assumptions, uncover bias, and remove barriers-because progress starts with fresh ideas. You'll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you-because when you feel valued, you're empowered to do your best work. 

Job Summary

We are looking for a Senior Staff Engineer to join the Reliability Engineering team that operates a bare-metal Kubernetes platform across multiple metro locations. The platform's architecture is defined and the build is underway, you will help deploy, operate and continuously improve it, from OS provisioning on racked servers through a multi-cluster fleet managed from a central management plane, with a software-defined data plane deployed via GitOps. 

This is a deliberately broad role. We are not looking for someone who owns a layer and hands everything below it across a boundary. You will work alongside the teams that own the physical hardware, the underlay network, and the data plane software, and you need enough fluency in all three to reason about a fault before escalating it. Where you find the design falls short in practice, we expect you to say so and to shape how it evolves. 

You will join the Digital Interconnection Engineering organization. The team owns the full application stack for interconnection and the Kubernetes platform for the software-defined data plane across multiple metros. We operate with an automation-first, GitOps-driven culture and a strong commitment to operational rigor, documented runbooks, and blameless postmortems. 

Responsibilities

OS Provisioning & Bare-Metal Infrastructure

- Own OS installation (Debian/Ubuntu) across bare-metal servers in multiple metros using PXE/iPXE imaging and cloud-init, and harden the OS prior to cluster bootstrap
 - Build and maintain a repeatable, zero-touch provisioning pipeline so every metro is deployed consistently without manual per-node intervention
 - Partner with the teams that own the hardware on BIOS/firmware baselines, high-speed NIC configuration and disk layout standards (separate NVMe for etcd, SSD for OS) and be able to diagnose faults at that layer, not just report them

Kubernetes Control Plane & Worker Nodes

- Deploy and operate Kubernetes clusters across all metros with quorum-based control-plane fault tolerance and correct failure-domain placement across racks, PDUs, or availability zones
 - Maintain the Layer 4 load balancer or keepalived VIP fronting all kube-apiserver instances, so no client depends on a single node
 - Manage worker node provisioning, CNI configuration, and end-to-end cluster validation before workloads are onboarded

CI/CD & Data Plane Deployment

- Build and own the CI/CD pipeline that deploys the software-defined data plane, including automated throughput and latency validation gates that must pass before promotion to production. The data plane software itself is configured and troubleshot by the team that owns it, your ownership is the pipeline and the gates
 - Own data-plane observability: monitoring, alerting thresholds, and operational runbooks

Network

- Operate on top of a multi-metro underlay and partner with network and security teams on VLANs, BGP peering, NIC bonding, private connectivity, firewall rules and segmentation
 - Validate connectivity end to end across environments, and troubleshoot far enough into the network layer to isolate a problem before handing it over

OS & Kubernetes Upgrades

- Plan and execute rolling OS and Kubernetes upgrades across the fleet with zero unplanned downtime; maintain tested upgrade runbooks and validated etcd snapshot/restore procedures before every major change
 - Own the etcd snapshot schedule, retention policy, and offsite storage; verify restore runbooks before each site goes live
 - Apply the platform's patching cadence across the fleet, tracking CVEs affecting the OS, Kubernetes and cluster components

Management Plane

- Administer the centralized management plane across all clusters, including RBAC, cluster registration and policy enforcement, and keep production and non-production management planes strictly isolated to prevent blast-radius cascades from configuration changes
 - Drive GitOps-based fleet configuration management to keep clusters consistent, auditable, and drift-free

On-Call & Incident Management

- Own your shift of a follow-the-sun on-call rotation, and lead incident response for control-plane, data-plane, and network events
 - Drive blameless postmortems and systematically eliminate recurring failure modes through automation, better runbooks, and sharper alerting
 - Contribute to the shared incident-command process, and maintain the runbooks for the systems you operate

What Success Looks Like, First 9-12 Months

- Provisioning is fully automated and repeatable, new nodes and metros brought up with no manual per-node steps
 - Deployment pipeline in production, with throughput and latency gates enforced before promotion
 - Management plane administered across all clusters; production and non-production planes isolated; GitOps driving cluster configuration
 - OS and Kubernetes upgrades executed on cadence across the fleet with documented, tested runbooks
 - etcd snapshot and restore tested and signed off before each site goes live
 - Observability and alerting in place for the systems you operate, including the data plane
 - Recurring failure modes measurably reduced through automation and runbook improvements

Qualifications

Required

- OS & bare metal: Deep hands-on Linux/Ubuntu provisioning at scale, PXE/iPXE imaging, cloud-init, BIOS/firmware management, OS hardening
 - Hardware fluency: Comfortable with BMC/IPMI, SMART data and platform sensors; able to diagnose disk, memory, NIC and power faults and work with vendors through warranty replacement
 - Kubernetes: Strong experience deploying and operating RKE2 or kubeadm clusters on bare metal, etcd operations, kube-apiserver HA, CNI (Multus/SR-IOV), multi-cluster fleet management
 - Rancher or equivalent management plane: Production experience managing multiple clusters through Rancher Prime, Rancher, or comparable fleet tooling
 - CI/CD for infrastructure: GitOps or pipeline-driven infrastructure deployment, Ansible, Terraform, ArgoCD, or Fleet
 - Networking: Hands-on with VLANs, BGP, bonded NICs, SR-IOV and private connectivity, with enough depth to troubleshoot across the boundary rather than only consume it
 - Upgrades: Demonstrated zero-downtime rolling upgrades of both OS and Kubernetes across a multi-node fleet
 - Operational rigor: Experience running platforms where availability is measured in minutes of downtime per year, and where an unreviewed change is the most likely cause of an outage
 - On-call: Comfortable owning an on-call shift and leading infrastructure incident response
 - Automation mindset: Everything-as-code, repeatable and auditable; strong bias toward automation over manual operations

Preferred

- Familiarity with 6WIND VSR or other DPDK-based data planes, enough to build and validate a deployment and performance-testing pipeline around one
 - SR-IOV NIC tuning and data-plane performance validation
 - SDN or private-connectivity platforms (Equinix Fabric, VyOS, or equivalent)
 - Familiarity with LLM provider APIs and AI/agent gateway proxying patterns, since inference traffic from multiple providers transits this platform
 - Experience operating infrastructure across geographically distributed sites

Equinix is committed to ensuring that our employment process is open to all individuals, including those with a disability. If you are a qualified candidate and need assistance or an accommodation, please let us know by completing this form. 

Equinix is an Equal Employment Opportunity and, in the U. S. , an Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to unlawful consideration of race, color, religion, creed, national or ethnic origin, ancestry, place of birth, citizenship, sex, pregnancy / childbirth or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or domestic partnership status, age, veteran or military status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, political / organizational affiliation, status as a victim or family member of a victim of crime or abuse, or any other status protected by applicable law. 

We use artificial intelligence in our hiring process. Learn more here.

data.description:
Site Reliability Engineer

About AssetMark: 

AssetMark is a leading strategic provider of innovative investment and consulting solutions serving independent financial advisors. We provide investment, relationship, and practice management solutions that advisors use in helping clients achieve wealth, independence, and purpose. 

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to join our engineering team. This role sits at the center of platform resilience - ensuring high availability, performance, recoverability, and operational maturity across AssetMark's production systems. 

This is not a traditional operations role. Our SREs are engineers first: designing automation, building observability frameworks, improving deployment safety, defining reliability standards, and reducing operational toil through code. You will influence architectural decisions, strengthen incident management practices, and raise the reliability bar across both legacy and cloud-native systems. 

You will work on systems that operate 24/7, support financial transactions and advisor workflows, and must meet strict regulatory and security requirements. The right candidate is energized by complex distributed systems, high-stakes production environments, and the responsibility of building durable, scalable financial infrastructure. 

At AssetMark, reliability is a first-order expression of client obsession. Our SRE team plays a critical role in delivering the consistent, trusted technology experience that advisors depend on to run their businesses. 

Key Responsibilities

Reliability Engineering & Operations

- Design, implement, and continuously improve the reliability, availability, and performance of critical AssetMark systems (batch, APIs, integrations, and customer-facing platforms)
 - Define and operationalize SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets for critical services in partnership with engineering and product teams
 - Participate in on-call rotations, incident response, and major incident management
 - Lead and contribute to blameless post-incident reviews, driving root cause analysis and measurable reliability improvements
 - Proactively identify reliability risks and lead remediation efforts before they impact clientsObservability & Monitoring

- Build and maintain end-to-end observability across applications, infrastructure, and integrations (metrics, logs, traces, alerts)
 - Implement actionable monitoring and alerting to reduce noise and improve signal quality
 - Partner with application teams to instrument services using best-in-class observability practices
 - Ensure visibility into system health, capacity, performance, and failure modes across environments
 - Hands-on experience with Grafana, Azure Log Analytics, Prometheus, Datadog, Splunk, or equivalents. Automation & Toil Reduction

- Identify repetitive operational tasks and automate them through code
 - Improve deployment reliability through automation, self-service tooling, and safe rollout patterns
 - Reduce manual intervention in batch processing, integrations, and operational workflows
 - Apply Infrastructure-as-Code and configuration automation to improve consistency and repeatabilityCloud, Platform & Infrastructure Reliability

- Support reliability of Azure-based infrastructure, containerized workloads, and hybrid environments
 - Partner with platform, DevOps, and infrastructure teams to improve resilience, scalability, and recovery
 - Contribute to capacity planning, performance tuning, and cost-aware reliability decisions
 - Ensure systems meet RTO/RPO, backup, and disaster recovery expectationsSecure & Compliant Operations

- Embed security, compliance, and risk controls into operational practices
 - Work closely with Security and Compliance teams to meet financial services regulatory requirements
 - Ensure production systems follow least privilege, secure configuration, and auditability standards
 - Support vulnerability remediation and secure operational processes
 - Deep understanding of environment reliability and stability engineering needs in High Availability, Fault Tolerance, Capacity Planning, Performance Engineering, Disaster Recovery, Multi-Region Architecture, Scalability, and Chaos EngineeringCollaboration & Enablement

- Partner with application engineering teams to improve production readiness and operational maturity
 - Influence system design by advocating for reliability-first architectural decisions
 - Provide guidance on operational best practices, deployment safety, and observability standards
 - Document operational patterns, runbooks, and reliability guidelines in Confluence
 - Act as a reliability advocate across AssetMark engineering teamsKnowledge, Skills, Abilities

- Strong software engineering skills in . NET / C#, Python, Java, NodeJS, or similar
 - Experience operating distributed systems in production
 - Deep understanding of SRE principles: SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, toil reduction, incident management
 - Experience with Azure (or AWS/GCP), including compute, networking, and managed services
 - Knowledge of containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes preferred)
 - Experience with monitoring, logging, tracing, and alerting tools
 - Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, automation, and Infrastructure-as-Code
 - Deep understanding of system administration, networking (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTPS, SSL / TLS), Storage, Load Balancing, and File Systems
 - Understanding of security best practices in regulated enterprise environments
 - Experience with JIRA, PagerDuty, or equivalent
 - Experience supporting financial services or highly regulated systems (preferred)Education & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or related technical field
 - 5-8 years of software engineering experience of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, Platform Engineering, or production operations
 - Proven experience in troubleshooting and improving production system reliability
 - Experience supporting 24/7 systems, batch processing, and mission-critical workloads
 - Strong collaboration skills across engineering, security, and infrastructure teams
 - Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments
 - Experience building APIs, services, and/or platform components
 - Understanding of enterprise integration patterns, service-oriented architecture, and large-scale system design
 - Experience with DevOps practices, cross-functional collaboration, and agile/scrum development methodologies

Meet the Team

Cisco's CX Engineering organization is a global team of experts dedicated to delivering world-class digital experiences by building advanced applications and capabilities hosted on Cisco IQ. These tools provide high value directly to our customers and empower our internal teams to deliver superior, data-driven service. We pride ourselves on a culture that balances customer-centricity with technical rigor, solve challenges at the intersection of AI/ML and modern backend engineering. 

Your Impact

As a Software Engineer, you will build and scale high-performance server-side applications while integrating modern AI capabilities, including Large Language Models (LLMs). You will own small-to-medium features, collaborate with senior engineering leadership, and help deliver low-latency, reliable software solutions that bring AI into real-world enterprise workflows. 

- Design, build, and maintain scalable, low-latency microservices, data pipelines, and RESTful/gRPC APIs using Python and frameworks such as FastAPI, Django, or Flask. 
 - Design clean APIs and robust database interactions across relational and NoSQL data stores, including caching and schema evolution. 
 - Implement and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), prompt orchestration, agentic AI workflows, and vector search capabilities in production systems. 
 - Automate deployments and maintain unit, integration, and API test suites; support containerized workloads using Docker and Kubernetes on AWS, Azure, or GCP. 
 - Monitor production systems, triage incidents, profile performance and resource utilization, and participate in code reviews, postmortems, and on-call rotations. 

Minimum Qualifications

- 3 years of professional software engineering experience delivering production backend services and AI-enabled capabilities. 
 - Proficiency in Python, including object-oriented and asynchronous programming, and experience building RESTful or gRPC APIs with FastAPI, Django, or Flask. 
 - Experience with relational databases and data-access tooling, including PostgreSQL or MySQL, Redis, SQLAlchemy or Django ORM, and database schema migrations. 
 - Experience integrating LLM APIs or open-source models and implementing AI orchestration, RAG, vector search, or hybrid-query workflows. 
 - Experience with Git, automated CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes concepts, and at least one cloud platform: AWS, Azure, or GCP. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, DSPy, LlamaIndex, OpenAI or Anthropic APIs, and Hugging Face models. 
 - Experience with Pytest, performance profiling, production observability, incident triage, and service reliability practices. 
 - Experience working in Agile teams and collaborating across product, platform, and engineering functions. 
 - Knowledge of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, routing and switching, subnetting, and network protocols. 
 - Cisco CCNA, CCNP, Cisco DevNet, or comparable technical certification. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Disclaimer

About

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will: 

- be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
 - begin with screening or an interview
 - originate from a Cisco email address, and
 - be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https: //careers. cisco. com or cisco. wd5. myworkday. com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport. 

If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

data.title: Senior Program Manager, Quality – GTM Vendor Solutions
data.description:
LinkedIn is the world's largest professional network, built to create economic opportunity for every member of the global workforce. Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. We're also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture that's built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun - where everyone can succeed. 

Join us to transform the way the world works. 

Job Description

We are seeking a strategic and highly collaborative Senior Program Manager, Quality to lead Quality orchestration across the GTM Vendor Solutions (GTMVS) ecosystem. This role will be responsible for driving a consistent, scalable, and data-driven quality framework across our global vendor programs supporting both Sales and Support motions. 

The Senior Program Manager will serve as the central point of orchestration between GTMVS, business stakeholders, program managers, and our external Quality partner which provides Third-Party Quality Assurance (3PQA) across our vendor programs. 

This role goes beyond quality reporting. The successful candidate will translate business priorities into quality strategies, identify systemic risks and opportunities, drive accountability across stakeholders and vendors, and use data and insights to influence operational decisions and improve customer and business outcomes. 

The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker who understands how Sales and Support organizations operate, is highly analytical, communicates with executive presence, and can navigate complex stakeholder environments. They will be equally comfortable defining a quality strategy, challenging assumptions with data, diving into operational details, and holding internal and external partners accountable for outcomes. 

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team. 

Responsibilities: 

1. Quality Strategy & Orchestration

- Own and evolve the GTMVS quality operating model across global vendor programs supporting Sales and Support. 

- Translate business priorities, customer expectations, and operational goals into clear quality strategies, frameworks, and measurement mechanisms. 

- Establish consistent quality standards, methodologies, governance, and ways of working across vendor programs while allowing for appropriate program-level flexibility. 

- Partner with GTMVS leadership and business stakeholders to define quality priorities, identify emerging risks, and establish measurable improvement goals. 

- Serve as the strategic quality advisor to Program Managers, Vendor Managers, and operational leaders. 

- Continuously assess the effectiveness of the quality model and identify opportunities to simplify, scale, automate, and innovate. 

2. 3PQA Vendor Management & Accountability

- Own the strategic partnership and operating model with our 3PQA Vendor provider across GTMVS programs. 

- Establish clear expectations, performance standards, SLAs, governance mechanisms, and accountability frameworks for the quality partner. 

- Orchestrate quality execution across programs, ensuring consistent sampling, evaluations, calibration, reporting, and feedback mechanisms. 

- Hold the vendor accountable for quality outcomes, delivery against commitments, and continuous improvement. 

- Identify gaps in vendor performance and lead structured remediation plans, ensuring actions have clear owners, timelines, and measurable outcomes. 

- Build a strong partnership with Vendors while maintaining the appropriate level of rigor, challenge, and accountability. 

3. Quality Analytics, Insights & Business Impact

- Develop and maintain a comprehensive view of quality performance across vendor programs, identifying trends, risks, root causes, and opportunities. 

- Analyze quality data alongside operational metrics to identify the drivers of performance and understand the impact on customer experience, productivity, revenue, and business outcomes. 

- Move beyond reporting metrics to provide actionable insights and recommendations to leadership. 

- Establish mechanisms to identify systemic issues and recurring failure patterns across programs and vendors. 

- Partner with Analytics, Operations, Training, WFM, and other GTMVS functions to connect quality insights to broader operational performance. 

- Develop executive-level reporting and business reviews that clearly articulate performance, risks, opportunities, and required decisions. 

4. Stakeholder Management & Cross-Functional Influence

- Act as the central quality partner across GTMVS, connecting Vendor Management, Program Management, Operations, Training, Analytics, and business stakeholders. 

- Build strong relationships with Sales and Support leaders and understand the distinct operating models, customer journeys, and quality requirements of each motion. 

- Influence senior stakeholders and vendor leadership without direct authority to drive alignment and action. 

- Facilitate quality governance forums, business reviews, calibrations, and performance discussions. 

- Create clear communication mechanisms that ensure quality insights and expectations are understood and acted upon across internal and external teams. 

- Confidently challenge stakeholders when performance, process, or quality outcomes do not meet expectations. 

5. Continuous Improvement & Innovation

- Identify opportunities to improve quality processes, methodologies, tooling, and operating mechanisms. 

- Drive initiatives that improve the scalability, efficiency, and effectiveness of the 3PQA model. 

- Explore and implement innovative approaches, including automation, AI-enabled quality analysis, and new methods of identifying customer and operational insights. 

- Partner with Training and Operations to ensure quality findings translate into meaningful coaching, enablement, and process improvements. 

- Establish closed-loop feedback mechanisms that connect Quality → Insights → Coaching/Training → Operational Improvement → Business Outcomes. 

- Develop scalable playbooks and best practices that can be adopted across global vendor programs. 

6. Quality Governance & Operational Excellence

- Establish robust governance mechanisms to ensure quality programs operate consistently and effectively across vendors and geographies. 

- Maintain clear documentation of quality standards, methodologies, processes, and decision rights. 

- Drive regular calibration and alignment across internal stakeholders and the 3PQA partner. 

- Monitor adherence to quality requirements and proactively identify operational or compliance risks. 

- Establish structured action tracking and escalation mechanisms to ensure commitments are delivered. 

Drive a culture of continuous improvement, transparency, and accountability across the quality ecosystem. 

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications: 

- 5+ years of experience in Program Management, Quality, Operations, Vendor Management, or a related field. 
 - 2+ years of experience working with external vendors, BPOs, or third-party operational partners. 
 - Experience working in either Sales, Customer Support, Customer Success, or another customer-facing operational environment. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Proven experience managing complex, cross-functional programs across global teams and external partners. 
 - Strong understanding of Sales and/or Support operating models, workflows, and performance metrics. 
 - Experience designing or managing Quality Assurance / Quality Management programs, preferably in a BPO or outsourced operating model. 
 - Demonstrated ability to translate data and operational metrics into actionable business insights and recommendations. 
 - Good analytical skills, with the ability to identify trends, diagnose root causes, and connect quality performance to business outcomes. 
 - Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and external partners without direct authority. 
 - Demonstrated ability to hold internal and external stakeholders accountable while maintaining strong, collaborative relationships. 
 - Experience managing vendor performance through governance, SLAs, KPIs, business reviews, and structured improvement plans. 
 - Experience driving process improvement, operational excellence, or transformation initiatives. 
 - Good executive communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex information and clearly articulate recommendations. 
 - Demonstrated curiosity and an innovation mindset, with a willingness to challenge existing processes and explore new technologies, tools, and approaches. 
 - Comfortable operating in ambiguity and able to balance strategic thinking with strong execution discipline. 
 - Experience working across geographically distributed teams and global vendor ecosystems. 
 - Experience in Reporting, Analytics & Automation: Working knowledge of Power BI, Power Automate, Tableau, and AI-enabled automation tools, with the ability to support data analysis, reporting, workflow automation, and dashboard development. 

Suggested Skills: 

- Strategic Program Management 
 - Quality Management & Continuous Improvement 
 - Vendor Management & Accountability 
 - Stakeholder Management & Influence 
 - Data & Analytics 
 - Sales & Support Operations 
 - Executive Communication 
 - Problem Solving & Root Cause Analysis 
 - Operational Excellence 
 - Innovation & Change Management

Additional Information

India Disability Policy

LinkedIn is an equal employment opportunity employer offering opportunities to all job seekers, including individuals with disabilities. For more information on our equal opportunity policy, please visit https: //legal. linkedin. com/content/dam/legal/Policy_India_EqualOppPWD_9-12-2023. pdf

Global Data Privacy Notice and Compliance Posters for Job Candidates

Please use this link to access documents that provide information about how LinkedIn handles the personal data of employees and job applicants, as well as the E-Verify Participation Notice and the Department of Justice Immigrant and Employee Rights Section Right to Work posters: https: //www. linkedin. com/legal/candidate-portal.

data.title: Engineering Manager
data.description:
Role Summary: 

The Engineering Manager owns technical outcomes and delivery for backend engineering teams building and operating enterprise applications at Tenerity India. Quality is primary engineering ownership-not a handoff to a separate QA organization: you define quality bars, testing strategy, automation, and release readiness criteria with your teams and hold engineering accountable for outcomes in production. You translate business and product priorities into executable engineering plans, align execution with security and compliance expectations, and partner closely with Product Management and Security so releases are predictable, observable, and defensible. You are accountable for architecture coherence, operational posture, and raising the bar for engineering excellence while growing Associate Architects, Architects, and senior individual contributors. You will operate at the intersection of hands-on engineering, multi-team leadership, and cross-functional alignment: clarifying tradeoffs, de-risking complex initiatives, and ensuring security and compliance expectations are reflected in how we design, build, test, and ship software. We expect a leader who remains technically engaged-contributing to architecture reviews, code reviews, and technical decisions-while managing multiple teams, applications, and concurrent projects. Domain Expertise: 

Payment & Subscription Billing We are looking for a leader with deep expertise in the Payment and Subscription Billing domain. This role requires hands-on experience building, scaling, and operating billing systems that handle recurring revenue, complex pricing models, and payment processing at scale. 

Required Domain Experience

- Subscription Lifecycle Management: Design and implement end-to-end subscription workflows including sign-up, trial periods, upgrades/downgrades, renewals, cancellations, and reactivations. 
 - Recurring Billing Systems: Build and operate systems handling automated recurring charges, prorated billing, usage-based billing, and metered pricing models 
 - Payment Gateway Integration: Hands-on experience integrating with payment processors (Stripe, Braintree, Adyen, PayPal, or similar) including tokenization, PCI compliance, and multi-currency support 
 - Dunning & Revenue Recovery: Implement intelligent retry logic, dunning workflows, and churn prevention mechanisms for failed payments Page 1 of 6 Domain-Specific Technical Knowledge

- PCI-DSS Compliance: Understanding of PCI requirements for handling cardholder data
 - Payment Security: Tokenization strategies, 3D Secure (3DS2) implementation, fraud detection, and chargeback management Key Responsibilities: 

People Management & Team Development

- Manage multiple engineering teams and applications while understanding individual team members' aspirations, skill sets, and career goals 
 - Leverage diverse backgrounds and abilities to align with business vision and organizational success 
 - Develop effective communication, leadership, and mentoring skills to drive team performance
 - Conduct monthly 1: 1s with direct reportees and document feedback as necessary 
 - Build high-performing engineering teams through strategic hiring, retention, and development 
 - Ensure compliance with internal and mandatory training requirements across teams

Multi-Team & Project Leadership

- Lead multiple engineering teams and concurrent initiatives; prioritize and remove systemic blockers so delivery stays predictable without constant executive intervention 
 - Coordinate across different teams and manage multiple concurrent projects simultaneously
 - Take accountability for various applications, strategic decisions, and innovation initiatives within assigned domain 
 - Own delivery practices: planning rhythms, execution hygiene, quality gates, and predictability across teams 
 - Improve estimation, dependency management, and cross-team coordination Architecture & Technical Direction

- Own and communicate system architecture across teams (diagrams, ADRs, standards) 
 - Lead architecture and design reviews; maintain living documentation and technical standards
 - Guide teams on microservices architecture, service boundaries, and domain-driven design principles 
 - Design scalable, resilient, and maintainable systems serving multiple clients across multiple countries 
 - Identify technical debt, quantify risk and cost, align prioritization with Product and business, and drive mitigation plans with measurable progress
 - Mentor Associate Backend Architects and Backend Architects on architecture patterns and design decisions Technology Stack Expertise

- Backend Development: Guide teams on Java (Spring Boot, Spring Framework) and Python (FastAPI, Django, Flask) development 
 - Database Architecture: Oversee PostgreSQL and MySQL implementations including data modeling, query optimization, scaling strategies (read replicas, sharding, partitioning) API Design: Establish API design standards, governance, and versioning strategies; ensure OAuth 2. 0 authentication and authorization implementations

- Batch Processing: Design and oversee batch processing architectures using Spring Batch, Apache Airflow, or AWS Batch for large-scale data operations Cloud & AWS Architecture

- Design and guide cloud-native architectures leveraging AWS services: 
 - Compute: EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, Fargate for serverless and containerized workloads
 - Databases: RDS (PostgreSQL, MySQL), Aurora, DynamoDB, ElastiCache 
 - Storage: S3, EBS, EFS for various storage needs 
 - Networking: VPC design, CloudFront, API Gateway, ALB/NLB 
 - Messaging: SQS, SNS, EventBridge, Kinesis for event-driven architectures 
 - Monitoring: CloudWatch, X-Ray for distributed tracing, CloudTrail for auditing 
 - Security: IAM policies, Secrets Manager, KMS, WAF 
 - Optimize cloud costs through right-sizing, reserved instances, and resource optimization
 - Establish infrastructure as code practices using Terraform or AWS CDK 
 - Design CI/CD pipelines for cloud-native deployments (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, AWS CodePipeline) Engineering-Owned Quality

- Own end-to-end quality for the domain-test strategy across phases (unit, integration, contract, E2E where appropriate) 
 - Drive shift-left practices, meaningful automation, flaky-test hygiene, and clear "definition of done" for release readiness 
 - Establish comprehensive testing strategies using JUnit (Java), pytest (Python), and TestContainers 
 - Maintain high standards using code quality tools (SonarQube, Checkstyle, pylint) 
 - Drive systematic defect reduction and post-release quality metrics without depending on a separate QA department as the primary owner Page 3 of 6 Deployment & Release Engineering

- Partner with teams on safe rollout patterns, observability, rollback posture, and progressive delivery 
 - Implement deployment strategies (Blue/Green, Canary) and educate teams on best practices
 - Ensure practices are understood and followed in production systems 
 - Lead or support major incidents with strong troubleshooting and analytical discipline 
 - Drive root-cause analysis and durable remediation Security & Compliance

- Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements: 
 - GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) for European users 
 - CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act) for California residents 
 - SOC 2 compliance for security, availability, and confidentiality 
 - Champion secure SDLC practices (threat modeling, patching, secrets management, IAM patterns) 
 - Design security architecture, practices, and governance 
 - Implement risk mitigation strategies across managed applications and teams AI-Native Engineering Practices

- Lead AI adoption strategy for engineering: tooling, training, governance, and metrics tied to delivery and quality outcomes 
 - Drive adoption of AI coding assistants (Cursor IDE, Amazon Q) across backend engineering teams 
 - Establish best practices and guidelines for AI-assisted development 
 - Design workflows integrating AI tools into the development lifecycle 
 - Establish AI-native engineering practices (review, testing, security, observability) so AI assisted work meets the same production bar as traditional development 
 - Drive safe use of agentic workflows (orchestrated agents/tools) with clear guardrails, approvals, and operational controls 
 - Champion an AI-first approach to problem solving: faster exploration and iteration grounded in verification, cost awareness, and responsible use of data and models 
 - Measure and optimize team productivity improvements from AI tools 
 - Partner with platform, security, and legal to align vendor/model choices, data handling, and compliance with organizational risk appetite Required Qualifications

- 10-15+ years of professional experience building and operating software with modern technology stacks, spanning Java (Spring Boot, Spring Framework) and/or Python (FastAPI, Django, Flask) 
 - 5+ years in engineering leadership roles with minimum 3-4 years as an Engineering Manager (or equivalent scope: direct people management, performance management, hiring, and delivery accountability for multiple teams) 
 - 3+ years of experience in payment systems or subscription billing domain (preferred)
 - Demonstrated recent hands-on technical engagement with documented experience leading architecture decisions and technical reviews at scale (ADRs, design reviews, standards bodies)
 - Expert-level understanding of distributed systems design patterns and microservices architecture in production environments 
 - Strong systems design and architecture skills; able to own technical direction for complex, business-critical domains serving multiple clients across multiple countries 
 - Deep expertise in relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) including data modeling, query optimization, scaling strategies, and migration patterns 
 - Hands-on AWS experience in production systems, including serverless workloads (Lambda), containerized workloads (ECS/EKS), and other AWS services for reliability, security, and scale 
 - Experience with OAuth 2. 0 authentication/authorization implementations and security architecture 
 - Proven ability to troubleshoot complex production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and drive fixes that reduce recurrence 
 - Solid grasp of secure SDLC, vulnerability management, and practical application of security standards and regulatory/compliance expectations (GDPR, CCPA, SOC 2, PCI DSS) 
 - Experience partnering with Product Management and Security on delivery and risk, with a track record of engineering-led quality ownership 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication; able to align executives, peers, and engineers on technical decisions and tradeoffs 
 - Prior success rolling out AI-assisted development workflows with governance, training, and measurable productivity or quality outcomes 
 - Experience operating without a dedicated QA organization as the primary quality owner- or successfully transitioning teams to engineering-owned quality Leadership & Organizational Competencies

- Multi-team leadership: Coordinates across teams, resolves cross-team dependencies, and maintains coherent technical direction when priorities compete
 - Technical credibility: Remains technically engaged-moves fluently between architecture discussions, code reviews, and org-level technical direction without defaulting to "hands off management only" 
 - Mentoring and upskilling: Grows technical depth on the team; mentors Associate Architects and Architects; sponsors stretch assignments; reinforces learning and mandatory training expectations 
 - Stakeholder management: Builds trust with Product, Security, Compliance, and business partners; communicates risks early and proposes actionable mitigations 
 - Accountability: Owns outcomes for applications under scope-including reliability, security posture, and delivery commitments-with minimal need for executive escalation 
 - Quality as engineering discipline: Ownership of testing, observability, and release readiness in teams; does not treat quality as an external gate owned primarily by another department
 - Prioritization under constraint: Balances technical debt, new capabilities, and operational load with clear rationale tied to business outcomes 
 - Process at scale: Introduces and evolves lightweight, repeatable practices that raise engineering excellence without unnecessary bureaucracy 
 - Inclusive leadership: Fosters psychological safety, equitable feedback, and high standards; builds diverse, high-performing teams 
 - Innovation with judgment: Encourages experimentation where risk is bounded and learning is fast; drives OPEX optimization and operational efficiency; creates reusable systems for organizational benefit Career Path Context

This role represents a significant career achievement requiring mastery of both technical expertise and people management skills. The Engineering Manager: 

- Shifts from service-focused to team-focused approach, emphasizing capability delivery and business value 
 - Delivers highly complex projects independently with minimal executive oversight 
 - Creates scalable processes and systems that benefit the broader organization 
 - Establishes engineering excellence standards and best practices across multiple teams
 - Represents the natural progression for Technical Leads demonstrating strong people leadership alongside technical depth

data.title: Electrification Reliability Engineer
data.description:
Position: Electrification Reliability Engineer

Domain: Automotive

Job Type: Permanent/Contract

Location: Hybrid - Project Site Bangalore, India. 

  

Key Responsibilities: 

  

The Reliability Engineer for Traction Battery Systems is responsible for ensuring robust, durable, and safe performance of high‐voltage battery packs across the full development lifecycle. You will lead structured reliability analysis, define verification strategies, model degradation behaviour, and drive cross‐functional issue resolution. The role requires strong technical depth in battery systems, analytical rigour, and the ability to influence design teams through data‐driven reliability insights. 

  

Design Reliability & Structured Analysis

- Lead and review DFMEA, DRBFM, FMA, and other structured reliability and risk‐assessment activities. 
 - Ensure reliability requirements, mitigations, and lessons learned are embedded into design releases. 
 - Provide early‐phase reliability input into system architecture, component selection, and design trade‐offs.   

Verification Strategy & DVP Ownership

- Define, set, and maintain Design Verification Plans (DVPs) for battery packs, modules, and sub‐systems. 
 - Create detailed test procedures, acceptance criteria, and instrumentation strategies for reliability, durability, and abuse testing. 
 - Monitor reliability target assessment at successive development gateways, ensuring maturity progression and risk closure.   

Failure Analysis & Mechanism Identification

- Lead root‐cause investigations for failures observed in CAE, validation, or field operation. 
 - Identify and model failure mechanisms including thermal, electrical, mechanical, chemical, and ageing‐related degradation pathways. 
 - Drive corrective actions and design improvements using structured reliability engineering methods.   

Reliability Modelling & Prediction

- Develop and maintain reliability models (Weibull analysis, degradation modelling, life prediction, reliability block diagrams). 
 - Quantify reliability risks and forecast long‐term performance using physics‐of‐failure and data‐driven approaches. 
 - Support reliability target setting and compliance with internal and regulatory requirements.   

Battery Degradation & Lifecycle Analysis

- Lead analysis of battery ageing, including calendar ageing, cycle ageing, SEI growth, impedance rise, and capacity fade. 
 - Validate degradation models with supplier data, CAE predictions, and physical test results. 
 - Provide insights to design, thermal, controls, and BMS teams to optimize battery life, warranty performance, and customer usage robustness.   

Quality & Current Reliability Projects

- Own reliability deliverables for current production and development programmes. 
 - Drive cross‐functional quality improvement initiatives, including field issue reduction, warranty analysis, and reliability KPIs. 
 - Represent reliability engineering in programme reviews, supplier discussions, and senior management forums. 

Stakeholder Collaboration

- Work closely with Battery Design, CAE, Thermal, BMS, Safety, Manufacturing, and Supplier Quality teams. 
 - Act as the primary reliability interface for internal and external stakeholders, ensuring alignment across engineering and programme functions. 

Skills, Knowledge & Experience: 

- Degree or higher in Mechanical, Electrical, Automotive, or Reliability Engineering. 
 - Strong technical background in traction battery systems, cell chemistry, pack design, and BMS interactions. 
 - Proven experience in reliability or quality engineering within automotive or high‐reliability industries. 
 - Deep understanding of DFMEA, DRBFM, FMA, root‐cause analysis, and structured problem‐solving. 
 - Experience with reliability modelling tools (Weibull++, Reliasoft, Python‐based modelling, etc. ). 
 - Knowledge of battery degradation mechanisms, ageing models, and validation methods. 
 - Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and a rigorous approach to data interpretation. 
 - Excellent communication and presentation skills, able to influence senior stakeholders. 
 - Proactive, self‐driven, and able to manage multiple technical streams simultaneously. 
 - Knowledge of System Safety is highly desirable. Safety Standard ISO26262 Experience &/Or Certification

Controls Project Engineer I | Pune, India | Full-time

If you are passionate about industrial automation, PLC-based control systems, and delivering advanced automation solutions for material handling environments, this could be the ideal opportunity for you. 

Your Role

As a Senior Controls Engineer, you will be responsible for the design, development, testing, integration, and commissioning of Low-Level Controls (LLC) software for medium-to-large automated material handling systems. You will work with Siemens PLC technologies, SCADA, HMI, drives, and safety systems to deliver reliable and high-quality control solutions.

We are seeking a results-oriented Senior Performance Advertising Engineer to own and drive the optimization of our buyer-side and performance marketing systems. In this role, you will be directly responsible for designing algorithms, building data systems, and refining optimization loops that drive Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) for our Advertisers and Agencies. You will own the technical architecture and end-to-end evaluation, implementation, and scaling of robust data pipelines for attribution data. This position spans our complete omnichannel environment, requiring expert-level performance engine development across Mobile App (including privacy-aware frameworks like SKAdNetwork and Privacy Sandbox), Video, Connected TV (CTV), and Desktop environments. 

What You'll Do

- ROAS Optimization & Algorithmic Design: Develop, benchmark, and deploy real-time bidding (RTB) algorithms, pacing controls, and predictive models aimed squarely at maximizing ROAS and conversion tracking across all screens (CTV, Mobile App, Video, and Desktop). 
 - Attribution Data Pipelines: Design, evaluate, and implement scalable, low-latency streaming and batch data pipelines that ingest, validate, and process complex conversion and multi-touch attribution (MTA) datasets. 
 - Omnichannel Execution: Advance PubMatic's performance capabilities across specific programmatic formats. 
 - Mobile: Build robust mechanisms that thrive within SKAdNetwork, Attribution API, and Android Privacy Sandbox constraints.

 - Desktop: Innovate alternative identity framework integrations (e. g. , UID2, LiveRamp ATS) to sustain high attribution fidelity post-third-party cookies. 
 - Data Pipeline Evaluation: Constantly audit existing data ingestion points for architectural flaws, data loss, or systemic latencies that negatively skew attribution accuracy and campaign performance. 
 - Scalable Systems Engineering: Write high-performance, low-latency, and memory-efficient code (Python, Go, Java, or C++) matching our ultra-scaled backend layer that processes trillions of monthly events.

 - Deep understanding of the OpenRTB protocol, DSP/SSP mechanics, and supply-path optimization (SPO).

 - Strong system-level performance benchmarking skills (profiling memory allocation, reducing I/O bottlenecks. 

Qualification

Should have a bachelor's degree in engineering or an equivalent degree from a well-known institute/university.

PubMatic is one of the world's leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes.

data.title: QA Test Engineer (Pre -Trade Risk)
data.description:
Why Nasdaq

When you work at Nasdaq, you're working for more open and transparent markets so that more people can access opportunities. Connections can be made, jobs can be created, and communities can thrive. We want all our employees to have access to opportunities, too. 

What we offer

Nasdaq financial platforms run some of the world's largest exchange markets with billions of trades completed every day. Any problem or software fault can have far-reaching consequences and that is why we work hard on finding even more innovative ways to uphold quality in ever increasingly sophisticated systems. 

If you have an inquisitive mind and want to work in an environment where we practice experiment-fail-learn to explore how we can automate and further secure quality in our products we believe you will enjoy working with us. 

You can expect an autonomous but fast-paced work environment where you are recognized for your results and ability to drive things forward. Every day brings many opportunities to learn & grow and rewards with the global impact we build. 

Our Team

Our team, that you will be joining, is working on a crucial part of the systems crafted to maintain the trust of the exchange (and market) by preventing "bad" orders from being entered. This is what we call Pre-Trade-Risk-Analysis. To do this, a sophisticated graph analysis must be completed in microseconds by our system and hence we have very high requirements for our system. 

What you will do: 

- Test Automation and Quality Engineering
 - Design, develop and maintain automated test suites in our in-house automation framework on Python. 
 - Build scalable, maintainable and reusable test automation solutions for backend services, APIs and complex business workflows. 
 - Review existing automated coverage and continuously improve automation effectiveness, reliability and maintainability. 
 - Integrate and maintain automated tests into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Analyze test failures, identify root causes and collaborate with developers to resolve issues efficiently. 

- Test Design and Execution
 - Plan, implement and report tests in qTest, our test orchestration platform. 
 - Design comprehensive test scenarios covering positive paths, negative paths, edge cases, boundary conditions and stress scenarios. 
 - Apply risk-based testing techniques to ensure critical business flows receive appropriate coverage. 
 - Execute exploratory, integration and regression testing when required. 

- Continuous Improvement
 - Use quality metrics and test analytics to identify coverage gaps and improve testing effectiveness. 
 - Take ownership of initiatives that improve test coverage, automation efficiency and overall product quality. 
 - Partner with developers, business analysts and product owners to ensure quality is built into the product lifecycle. 
What We Expect: 

Required Experience

- A minimum of 4-8+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance, with significant hands-on test automation experience. 
 - Strong proficiency in Python 3 and proven experience developing non-trivial automation frameworks, test suites, scripts or applications. 
 - Demonstrated experience building and maintaining automated tests for complex enterprise applications. 
 - Strong knowledge of test design techniques, including risk-based testing, boundary value analysis, equivalence partitioning, negative testing, edge-case testing and exploratory testing. 
 - Strong experience working in Agile software development teams. 
 - Hands-on experience with Git, GitLab, Jira, Confluence and qTest or similar test management tools. 
 - Good experience working with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated tests into build and deployment workflows. 
 - Ability to independently investigate complex issues, identify risks and drive quality improvements. 
 - Solid understanding of running systems on a Linux platform. 
 - Showing examples of positive impact on both teams and quality processes in previous workplaces. Help us see your passion and dedication to continuous improvement in both yourself and the team you are working with!

Nice to Have

- Basic knowledge of non-functional testing (NFT). 
 - Exposure to Capital Market domain - Trading and Pre-Trade Risk. 
 - Experience with Selenium or similar UI automation tools. 
 - Familiarity with code quality and software composition tools such as SonarQube, Nexus IQ Server, or equivalent. 
 - Prior programming experience (Java, Python, bash-scripting, etc. )

What Would Be Helpful: 

- A strong automation-first mindset with a proven track record of increasing automated test coverage. 
 - The ability to challenge requirements and identify high-risk scenarios before defects reach production. 
 - A history of driving measurable improvements in product quality, test efficiency and engineering practices. 
 - Strong collaboration skills and the ability to influence quality across cross-functional. 

Come as You Are

Nasdaq is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and identities. 

We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives, experiences, and identities are valued and celebrated. 

We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation throughout the hiring process.

Our platforms power top-tier banks, NBFCs, and financial institutions where security, scalability, resilience, regulatory compliance, and delivery predictability are critical. As we continue to expand our engineering organization, we are looking for a hands-on Engineering Manager who combines strong technical depth with exceptional execution and people leadership. 

The Role

This is not a traditional people-management role. We are looking for an engineering leader who enjoys solving complex technical problems, building high-performing teams, and delivering enterprise software at scale. 

As an Engineering Manager, you will lead one or more product engineering squads responsible for designing, building, deploying, and operating mission-critical platforms. While your primary responsibility is engineering leadership, you are expected to remain technically engaged-reviewing designs, mentoring engineers, debugging complex problems, reviewing code, and contributing production code whenever required. 

You will help shape engineering culture, improve developer productivity, drive AI adoption, and ensure predictable, high-quality software delivery. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Lead High-Performing Engineering Teams

- Build, mentor, and grow high-performing engineering squads. 
 - Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning. 
 - Coach engineers and technical leads through regular feedback, performance reviews, and career development. 
 - Hire exceptional engineering talent and build strong succession planning within the team. 
 - Create an environment where engineers take end-to-end ownership of customer outcomes. 2. Drive Technical Excellence

- Review architecture, solution designs, and critical engineering decisions. 
 - Establish high engineering standards through rigorous design and code reviews. 
 - Contribute production-quality code or prototypes when required. 
 - Lead investigation and resolution of complex production issues. 
 - Drive engineering simplicity, maintainability, scalability, and performance. 
 - Continuously reduce technical debt and improve overall platform health. 3. Deliver Predictably

- Own engineering delivery for product initiatives, customer implementations, and platform modernization. 
 - Drive sprint planning, estimation, release planning, and execution discipline. 
 - Remove delivery bottlenecks and proactively manage risks and dependencies. 
 - Partner closely with Product, Architecture, QA, DevOps, Security, Customer Success, and Support teams. 
 - Ensure every release meets quality, security, and operational readiness expectations. 4. Build Engineering Excellence

- Improve code quality through peer reviews, coding standards, and test automation. 
 - Champion automated testing, CI/CD, observability, and DevSecOps practices. 
 - Use engineering metrics (DORA metrics, defect leakage, etc. ) to continuously improve productivity, quality, and delivery predictability. 
 - Lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for production incidents and ensure permanent corrective actions. 
 - Build systems that are secure, resilient, observable, and easy to operate. 5. Lead AI-Enabled Engineering

- Drive adoption of AI-assisted software development across the engineering organization. 
 - Encourage responsible use of AI for coding, testing, documentation, debugging, and code reviews. 
 - Establish engineering guardrails and security standards for AI-generated code. 
 - Continuously evaluate emerging AI tools that improve engineering productivity while maintaining quality and security. 6. Partner Across the Business

- Communicate engineering progress, risks, trade-offs, and delivery status clearly to leadership. 
 - Build trusted relationships with Product, Delivery, Business, Architecture, Security, and Executive Leadership. 
 - Represent Engineering during customer discussions, executive reviews, and technical escalations. 
 - Translate complex technical decisions into clear business outcomes. What We're Looking For

Experience & Background

- 10+ years of total software engineering experience, with at least 2 years in an Engineering Manager or Technical Leadership role. 
 - Strong software engineering background prior to moving into engineering management. 
 - Proven experience building enterprise SaaS, fintech, banking, or large-scale B2B platforms. 
 - Experience leading cross-functional engineering teams across backend, frontend, QA, and DevOps. 
 - Demonstrated track record delivering cloud-native, API-first, microservices-based applications. 
 - Experience working with regulated enterprise customers such as banks, financial institutions, NBFCs, or insurance companies. 
 - Strong understanding of Agile delivery, release management, DevSecOps, engineering governance, and production operations. 
 - Desirable: Prior domain experience with Lending Origination Systems (LOS), Digital Lending, Supply Chain Finance (SCF), or Financial Services platforms. Technical Competencies

Core Stack

- Backend: Java (Java 17/21 preferred), Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, REST APIs, Microservices, Event-Driven Architecture, Distributed Systems, SQL (Oracle, PostgreSQL) & NoSQL/Caching (Redis) Databases. 
 - Frontend: Angular (preferred), TypeScript, Modern JavaScript Frameworks, Responsive Web Applications. 
 - Cloud & DevOps: AWS (preferred), Docker, Kubernetes, NGINX, Git, GitHub, GitHub Actions / Jenkins, CI/CD Pipelines, Infrastructure Automation. Engineering Practices

- API-First Architecture and Specification-Driven Development (OpenAPI). 
 - Contract-First API Design and API Governance. 
 - Design Patterns, System Design, and Microservices Architecture. 
 - Secure Coding, SAST/DAST, Software Composition Analysis (SCA), and DevSecOps. 
 - Performance, Scalability, and Reliability Engineering. 
 - Production Debugging, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and Incident Management. 
 - Automated Testing (Unit, Integration, API, UI) & Shift-Left Quality Engineering. 
 - Observability, Logging, Monitoring, and Distributed Tracing. 
 - AI-Assisted Software Development and Productivity Engineering.

data.title: Manager - Software
data.description:
Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies, and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King, sustainability is not just how we do business-it is our business. Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities? Do you want to contribute to making a better future? If the answer is yes, we invite you to consider joining us in boldly challenging what's possible for a sustainable world. 

Learn about our benefits designed for you to Thrive at work and at home. 

We boldly go. 

Where Is The Work

Monday to Thursday, work onsite with your colleagues. Fridays, choose your work location, balancing what your work requires. 

What's In It For You

The Manager, Embedded Controls Software Development leads a team responsible for the architecture, design, development, integration, and support of embedded controls software for product and platform applications. This role provides both technical and people leadership, ensuring delivery of reliable, scalable, and high-quality software solutions that support product performance, connectivity, and customer value

This leader partners closely with cross-functional teams across systems, Application, firmware, test, quality, product management, and program management to drive execution from concept through launch and ongoing support. The ideal candidate brings strong expertise in embedded systems, hands-on software development in C/C++ and Rust, and experience with embedded communication protocols. 

What You Will Do

- Lead, coach, and develop a team of software engineers focused on embedded controls development. 
 - Drive planning, prioritization, and execution of software deliverables across multiple projects and product initiatives. 
 - Provide technical leadership in software architecture, design, coding, debugging, integration, and validation activities. 
 - Guide design reviews, code reviews, and technical decision-making to ensure robust and maintainable solutions. 
 - Partner with cross-functional engineering and business teams to align technical execution with product requirements, quality expectations, cost targets, and project timelines. 
 - Support definition of project scope, schedules, resource needs, and risk mitigation strategies. 
 - Drive issue resolution through structured problem-solving, root cause analysis, and corrective action. 
 - Promote best practices in software development, coding standards, documentation, version control, and defect management. 
 - Support continuous improvement in development processes, software quality, team effectiveness, and delivery performance. 
 - Build organizational capability through performance management, coaching, feedback, and development planning. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable development processes, quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and regulatory standards. 

What You Will Bring

- Required Qualifications
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field. 
 - 15+ years of experience in embedded software or controls software development. 
 - Strong programming experience in C/C++ and Rust. 
 - Experience with embedded systems development, troubleshooting, and debugging. 
 - Experience with embedded communication protocols such as CAN, UART, SPI, I2C, Modbus, BACnet, or similar. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading engineering teams, major technical workstreams, or complex software projects. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. 
 - Ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams and influence technical direction. 
 - Preferred Qualifications
 - Direct people leadership or engineering management experience. 
 - Experience in HVAC controls, building automation, industrial automation, or related embedded product environments. 
 - Familiarity with real-time operating systems (RTOS) and microcontroller-based software development. 
 - Experience with software architecture, control algorithm implementation, and hardware/software integration. 
 - Knowledge of unit testing, integration testing, and system validation practices. 
 - Experience with agile development methodologies, continuous integration, and modern software development tools. 
 - Familiarity with cybersecurity requirements for connected embedded devices. 
 - Master's degree in a related technical or business discipline. 
 - Leadership Expectations
 - Create an inclusive, accountable, and high-performing team environment. 
 - Build strong partnerships across engineering and business functions. 
 - Balance technical excellence with execution discipline and business priorities. 
 - Develop talent through coaching, feedback, and growth opportunities. 
 - Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement. 
We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. We are an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, pregnancy, age, marital status, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any legally protected status.

data.title: Senior Backend Engineer (Go)
data.description:
About the Role

We're looking for a senior backend engineer who writes production Go and enjoys building reliable, distributed systems. You'll join a small, early engineering team and take ownership of core backend services, from design through to running them in production. 

This role sits close to the infrastructure: the services you build will orchestrate cloud resources, handle long-running background work, and need to behave correctly when things fail. We value reliability and clear design over cleverness. 

What you'll do

- Design and build backend services and APIs in Go
 - Build and maintain asynchronous job processing: queues, retries, idempotent operations and failure recovery
 - Integrate with cloud provider APIs and third-party services
 - Design data models and write performant, safe PostgreSQL code
 - Build secure, multi-tenant REST APIs with authentication and role-based access control
 - Add metrics, structured logging and alerting to everything you ship
 - Take part in architecture decisions, code reviews and a shared on-call rotation

What we are looking for

Must have

- 5+ years of backend engineering, with at least 3  years writing production Go
 - Solid concurrency in Go: goroutines, channels, context cancellation and timeouts, and graceful shutdown
 - Strong PostgreSQL: schema design, transactions, row locking, migrations and query tuning
 - Experience building distributed or asynchronous systems: job queues, retries, idempotency and failure handling
 - Comfort with Linux, networking basics (DNS, TLS, HTTP, TCP) and debugging on real servers
 - REST API design, authentication (sessions, JWT, MFA) and multi-tenant access control
 - Docker and Kubernetes experience, as a user deploying services
 - Writing tests, including integration tests against real dependencies

Nice to have

- Linux containers and virtualisation internals
 - Google Cloud Platform (GKE, IAM, VPC, Cloud SQL) and Terraform
 - Workflow engines such as Temporal
 - TLS/certificate automation, reverse proxies (nginx, Caddy)
 - Storage systems, snapshots and backup/restore tooling
 - Subscription billing integrations (e. g. Stripe)

data.title: Senior Software Engineer - Golang
data.description:
Job Type

Full-time

Description

About CloudBees

CloudBees helps organizations build, run, and govern software factories, giving enterprises the confidence to ship software better, faster, and safer. 

Writing code is no longer the bottleneck. Governing what reaches production and validating its impact is. As enterprises adopt agentic coding, software is created faster than most teams can review, secure, and validate. Without consistent governance, organizations risk shipping code they cannot explain, audit, or trust. 

CloudBees addresses this challenge without asking teams to replace the tools they already use. Across every toolchain a customer runs, CloudBees makes each change, human or AI, visible, auditable, and accountable before it reaches production. CloudBees Unify is the product behind this: a governance layer, with context and control-plane capabilities, that enforces consistent policy and evidence across every tool, team, and workflow. 

Founded in 2010, CloudBees is backed by Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Bridgepoint Capital, HSBC, Golub Capital, Delta-v Capital, Matrix Partners, and Lightspeed Venture Partners. 

Visit us at www. cloudbees. com. 

What You'll Do

Work with your team to design, develop, and deploy secure, scalable and reliable server-side applications and services. 

- Develop and own microservices using Golang, ensuring they are performant, observable, and built for long-term maintainability. 
 - Ensure high test coverage for all code, including unit and integration tests. 
 - Actively participate in the prioritization of the task for the team. 
 - Mentor peers and contribute to a culture of shared ownership, psychological safety. 

Think like a product engineer: 

- Be the voice of the customer in every technical discussion. Understand how they use the platform, what slows them down, and what would unlock the most value. 
 - Collaborate with product managers and engineers across the org to understand how platform decisions ripple outward. 
 - Write documentation, runbooks, and internal guides that make the platform understandable and self-serviceable for the teams that depend on it. 

Requirements

What Do You Need to Shine in This Role?

- 5+ years of experience. 
 - Strong experience in Golang programming language and its ecosystem, with a solid understanding of core language concepts and standard library. 
 - Strong knowledge and understanding of server-side development concepts, patterns, and best practices. 
 - Good experience with DevOps, Kubernetes, AWS, Docker and database systems such as PostgreSQL or Cassandra. 
 - Track record of learning new technologies and tackling challenging problems. 
 - Ability to leverage the expertise of others to facilitate professional growth and know when to seek assistance. 
 - Strong experience with LLM for coding. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills.
