data.description:
At Kandou, we are redefining the economics of AI infrastructure. Our mission is to democratise AI by significantly reducing the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) of hardware systems - a critical barrier to scalable adoption. 

Our proprietary MIMO-over-copper technology powers a high-performance, chiplet-based AI memory fabric that is both scalable and energy-efficient. Unlike traditional interconnects, our solution reduces power consumption significantly while preserving high bandwidth and ultra-low latency - unlocking unprecedented efficiency for AI training and inference at scale. 

Kandou's architecture is not just an incremental improvement - it's a foundational shift in how AI hardware is built for the future. 

We are actively seeking a Software Architect either based in Hyderabad OR Bangalore. 

Responsibilities: 

- Architect CMIS 5. x stack (DataPath State Machine, VDM, I2C/MCTP, FW-SW interface)
 - Lead host interop tests for hyperscalers (Meta, AWS, etc. ), build test matrix and regression suite
 - Develop manufacturing test orchestration (ATE integration, yield analytics, on-chip stimulus)
 - Build telemetry pipeline from FW to host/cloud (formats, compression, SDK APIs)
 - Own customer SDK and tools (C/Python, CLI, log analysis), release management
 - Ensure standards compliance (CMIS 5. x, OSFP MSA, SFF-8024, OIF)

 - Self-motivated, with strong sense of ownership and responsibility
 - Good communication and reporting skills

data.title: Quality Engineer I
data.description:
TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration - and we want you to be part of it. You'll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as equal opportunities, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 21, 000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go. 

Job Purpose

Provide quality support to all projects and manufacturing operational activities(curing, welding). Enables organizational ownership for achieving related benchmark performance and proactive to drives process improvements in Quality assurance process. Work under minimal guidance to ensure TechnipFMC's products are manufactured in accordance with TechnipFMC's Quality Management System, Business Processes and Client requirements. 

Job Description

Perform Contract Review focusing on quality requirements for systems, products, manufacturing, operations and documentation. This will require engagement with relevant TechnipFMC SME (Welding, NDE, Engineering and etc. )

Ensure that project quality requirements are identified and translated to the organization and relevant internal stakeholders (including supply chain)

Initiate and aligned with project the need for additional specifications to address contract/ client requirements in part report

Establish Quality and Inspection Test Plan and ensure the requirement are roll out to manufacturing and supply chain. 

Identify and ensure approval of all quality documentation (TechnipFMC Qspec, WPS, MPQP, etc. ) in project to meet client requirements. 

Ensure effective execution of all inspection and test activities in Inspection Test Plan (ITP) during manufacturing. 

To establish and report overall status on product Quality Notifications in regular basis as requested by the management. 

Coordinate Non Conformance Review Board (NRB) to ensure smooth processing of quality non conformance and to facilitate and monitor QN's close in timely manner in SAP. 

Facilitate investigations (RCA) on shop floor related issues Quality Notifications, or Quality escapes . drive verified and sustainable solutions

Initiate and follow-up required preventive and corrective actions as a result from CSS , Quality Alert. 

Support process compliance within Product Quality environment through an established Process Verification Programme. Perform Process Verification and validation to ensure process sustainability

Participate in kick-off meetings and pre-production reviews both internally and at Suppliers to ensure understanding and compliance to quality requirements. 

Manage Customer issued NCRs and track them through closure. 

Participate in Internal (QMS) and External Audit (API, DNV, Client, etc. )

Perform Final Acceptance of the product and Witness FAT as per part report requirement

Establish the Index of Project Manufacturing Record book (MRB) for Customer approval. 

Lead and Facilitate to support the Process Continuous Improvement Programme in the Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing&Production environment using established tools and systems available. 

Maintain 5S at work area all the time. 

Works in a safe manner and keeps all employees and visitors to work area aware of potential dangers

To adhere company HSE (Health, Safety & Environmental) policy, rules & regulations. 

You Are Meant For This Job If

Bachelors degree in mechanical engineering. 

Minimum 2 Years' Experience In Quality

Assurance(ability to create control plans, SOPs and work instructions) and quality control processes(ability to perform dimensional inspections and follow inspection and test plans). 

Knowledge in curing or welding process. 

Ability to prepare QMS documentation.

data.description:
About The Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Finance Test Analyst with strong Oracle Fusion Finance testing expertise to join our testing team. This role will serve as the primary liaison between offshore testing teams and onshore Test Leads, combining hands-on test delivery with test coordination, governance, reporting, and stakeholder communication. 

The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring offshore testing activities are planned, coordinated, executed, and reported effectively while maintaining high quality standards across all testing deliverables. 

This role combines approximately 80% hands-on testing and quality assurance activities with 20% coordination, communication, and governance responsibilities. 

Key Responsibilities Offshore-Onshore Coordination & Communication

- Act as the primary point of contact between offshore test teams and onshore Test Leads. 
 - Participate in governance, status, and project meetings. 
 - Communicate testing priorities and requirements to offshore resources. 
 - Consolidate offshore progress, risks, issues, dependencies, and blockers. 
 - Provide clear and concise status updates to onshore stakeholders. 
 - Coordinate and track queries between offshore and onshore teams. 
 - Ensure agreed actions are understood and executed by offshore teams. 
 - Maintain efficient communication channels and minimize unnecessary escalations. 

Test Coordination & Governance

- Support detailed planning and coordination of offshore testing activities. 
 - Break down testing scope into manageable work packages. 
 - Monitor progress against milestones and delivery timelines. 
 - Identify and escalate risks that may impact testing schedules. 
 - Coordinate test data, environment readiness, and testing dependencies. 
 - Ensure consistent quality standards across testing deliverables. 
 - Review and quality assure test cases and supporting evidence. 
 - Highlight resource and capacity constraints proactively. 

Test Analysis, Preparation & Execution

- Execute and support complex Oracle Fusion Finance test scenarios. 
 - Review requirements and identify required test coverage. 
 - Develop, review, and maintain test cases and test scripts. 
 - Support end-to-end business process testing. 
 - Identify gaps and recommend additional testing where necessary. 
 - Ensure accurate documentation of testing activities and outcomes. 

Defect Management

- Review defects before escalation to ensure completeness and quality. 
 - Ensure defects contain sufficient detail to support investigation. 
 - Participate in defect triage sessions and defect review meetings. 
 - Identify recurring issues and potential root causes. 
 - Escalate critical defects, risks, and blockers promptly. 

Reporting & Tracking

- Maintain accurate test execution status in Azure DevOps (ADO). 
 - Consolidate and report offshore testing progress. 
 - Track defects, risks, dependencies, and blockers. 
 - Participate in daily stand-ups and status meetings. 
 - Provide visibility into resource utilization and testing capacity. 

Required Skills & Experience Oracle Fusion Finance Testing

- Professional testing qualification (ISTQB or equivalent preferred).

 - Strong understanding of end-to-end Finance processes and controls.

Oracle Fusion Finance Modules

- General Ledger (GL)

 - Accounts Receivable (AR)
 - Cash Management
 - Fixed Assets
 - Expenses
 - Intercompany
 - Tax

Business Process Knowledge

- Procure-to-Pay (P2P)

Communication & Stakeholder Management

This is a critical requirement for the role. 

The Successful Candidate Should Demonstrate

 - Experience working with UK-based or other international stakeholders. 
 - Ability to explain testing and technical issues to non-technical audiences. 
 - Strong stakeholder management and coordination skills. 
 - Ability to consolidate detailed testing information into concise management updates. 
 - Confidence in escalating risks, issues, and blockers appropriately. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working in large-scale ERP transformation or Oracle Fusion implementation programs. 
 - Experience using Azure DevOps (ADO) for test management and defect tracking. 
 - Experience coordinating distributed offshore and onshore testing teams. 
 - Exposure to Agile, Waterfall, or Hybrid delivery methodologies. 

Why Join Us?

- Work on enterprise-scale Oracle Fusion Finance transformation programs. 
 - Collaborate with global stakeholders and cross-functional teams. 
 - Contribute to high-impact finance transformation initiatives. 
 - Opportunity to combine hands-on testing expertise with leadership and coordination responsibilities.

data.description:
Company Overview

Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential. 

Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone's best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3, 000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed. 

Job Overview

About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented and business-focused Senior Quality Analyst to join our growing team and play a critical role in delivering high-quality Salesforce and Conversational ITSM solutions. 

The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring that business requirements are thoroughly validated, tested, and implemented in alignment with customer expectations. This role goes beyond traditional testing and requires someone who can understand business processes, challenge assumptions, identify gaps, and ensure that the delivered solution truly addresses business needs. 

You will work closely with Business Analysts, Product Owners, Developers, Architects, and Client Stakeholders to validate Salesforce, Agentforce, ITSM, and enterprise integration solutions throughout the delivery lifecycle. 

If you enjoy being the quality gatekeeper, ensuring business value realization, and advocating for the customer experience, this role is for you. 

Key Responsibilities

Business Validation & Quality Assurance

- Act as the quality champion for all functional and business solution deliveries. 
 - Ensure business requirements, user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria are complete, testable, and aligned with customer expectations. 
 - Analyze BRDs, Functional Specifications, User Stories, and Solution Designs to identify ambiguities, gaps, and risks before development begins. 
 - Validate that delivered functionality addresses the intended business outcomes and process requirements. 
 - Ensure quality is built into every phase of the delivery lifecycle rather than being treated as a final activity. 

Test Planning & Execution

- Develop comprehensive test strategies and test plans for Salesforce, ITSM, Agentforce, and integration-based solutions. 
 - Create detailed: 
 - Test Scenarios
 - Test Cases
 - Traceability Matrices
 - Test Data Requirements
 - Defect Reports
 - UAT Support Documentation
 - Execute functional, integration, regression, end-to-end, and user acceptance testing activities. 
 - Validate Salesforce configurations, customizations, workflows, automations, and integrations. 
 - Ensure all business scenarios, exception handling, and edge cases are adequately tested. 
Salesforce & ITSM Solution Testing

- Test solutions developed on: 
 - Agentforce
 - Enterprise Service Management (ITSM) Platforms
 - Validate business processes such as: 
 - Incident Management
 - Service Request Management
 - Knowledge Management
 - Employee Service Processes
 - Customer Service Workflows
 - Case Management
 - Verify conversational and AI-powered workflows to ensure accurate business outcomes and user experience. 
Integration & End-to-End Validation

- Validate integrations across Salesforce and enterprise applications. 
 - Test APIs, data synchronization, workflow orchestration, and middleware integrations, including MuleSoft-enabled solutions. 
 - Ensure data accuracy, consistency, security, and business process continuity across systems. 
 - Perform end-to-end validation for complex business processes spanning multiple platforms. 

UAT & Stakeholder Collaboration

- Partner with Business Analysts and Product Owners to establish clear acceptance criteria. 
 - Coordinate and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities. 
 - Facilitate defect triage sessions and help prioritize business-critical issues. 
 - Collaborate with client stakeholders to validate delivered solutions and ensure business readiness. 
 - Participate in sprint reviews, showcase sessions, and production readiness assessments. 

Continuous Improvement

- Identify process improvement opportunities within testing and quality practices. 
 - Contribute to test automation strategies and quality engineering best practices. 
 - Recommend enhancements that improve customer experience, business efficiency, and platform reliability. 
 - Promote a quality-first culture across business and technology teams. 

Required Qualifications

Must Have

- 5 to 8 years of Quality Assurance and Testing experience in enterprise application environments. 
 - Strong experience testing: 
 - Enterprise Service Management or ITSM Platforms
 - Strong understanding of business process validation and requirement-based testing. 
 - Experience creating and executing detailed test plans, test cases, and test scenarios. 
 - Experience supporting Agile and Scrum-based delivery teams. 
 - Strong knowledge of defect management, root cause analysis, and quality governance processes. 
 - Experience performing integration and end-to-end testing across enterprise applications. 
 - Excellent analytical, documentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills. 
Preferred Qualifications

- Experience testing Salesforce transformation programs. 
 - Experience validating ITSM or Enterprise Service Management implementations. 
 - Experience working with API integrations, middleware solutions, and MuleSoft-based integrations. 
 - Knowledge of test automation frameworks and automation strategies. 
 - Exposure to Agile testing, DevOps, and Continuous Testing methodologies. 
 - Salesforce Administrator, Salesforce Business Analyst, or Quality Engineering certifications. 

Added Advantage

- Experience testing Agentforce implementations and conversational service experiences. 
 - Exposure to AI-powered workflows, virtual agents, copilots, or conversational platforms. 
 - Experience validating Generative AI-driven business processes and service automation workflows. 
 - Knowledge of enterprise service delivery processes and operational support models. 

What We Are Looking For

We are seeking professionals who: 

- Think from a business value perspective rather than just a testing perspective. 
 - Challenge requirements and proactively identify gaps before they impact delivery. 
 - Have a strong customer-first mindset and advocate for user experience and quality. 
 - Can confidently work with Business Analysts, Developers, Architects, and Client Stakeholders. 
 - Have exceptional attention to detail and a passion for delivering defect-free solutions. 
 - Thrive in fast-paced environments where innovation and continuous learning are encouraged. 
 - Want to be part of a growing organization building next-generation Salesforce and Conversational ITSM solutions. 

Why Join Us?

- Be part of a strategic initiative focused on building Salesforce-powered Conversational ITSM and Agentic Service Platforms. 
 - Work with cutting-edge technologies including Agentforce, Salesforce, AI, MuleSoft, and Enterprise Service Management solutions. 
 - Collaborate with experienced business, technology, and product teams driving large-scale transformation programs. 
 - Play a critical role in ensuring customer success and quality excellence. 
 - Join a growing organization where quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction are key pillars of success. 
 - Enjoy a flexible hybrid work model across Kochi, Bangalore, and Hyderabad. 

Join Us

If you are a Senior Quality Analyst who believes that quality is about ensuring business outcomes and not just finding defects, and you are passionate about validating innovative Salesforce, Agentforce, and ITSM solutions, we would love to hear from you. Join us and help deliver world-class Conversational and AI-powered service experiences that delight our customers. 

Compensation

Estimated Pay Range: 

Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location. 

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

At Milestone we strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and work with, where we all feel empowered to bring our full, authentic selves to work. We know creating a diverse and inclusive culture that champions equity and belonging is not only the right thing to do for our employees but is also critical to our continued success.

data.title: Principal Technical Architect
data.description:
Job Title: 

Principal Software Engineer - Java Architect, Microservices, Cloud, Springboot

Overview

The Real time Payments (RTP) program is driving the global shift toward instant, account to account payments, enabling secure, low latency, and highly resilient payment services across multiple live markets worldwide. 

RTP platforms operate as mission critical financial infrastructure, supporting high transaction volumes, strict regulatory expectations, and near zero downtime requirements. The program spans multiple products and shared services, deployed across diverse market and customer environments, while adhering to Mastercard's enterprise architecture, security, and operational standards. 

Engineering within RTP is focused not only on feature delivery, but on building scalable, resilient platforms that can evolve safely over time-through strong architecture, disciplined engineering practices, and a relentless focus on non functional excellence. 

Role

We are seeking a Principal Software Engineer to provide hands on technical execution and leadership for one or more RTP products and platform capabilities across multiple markets. 

This is a senior individual contributor role for a deeply experienced engineer who: 

• Owns the design and implementation of complex services or subsystems

• Stays close to the code on complex and high risk areas

• Is deeply hands‐on and leads by technical excellence

• Contributes meaningfully to architecture and product design aspects

• Owns key implementation decisions including all non-functional aspects across performance, scalability, reliability, security, and observability

The role combines strong technical depth with engineering leadership with end‐to‐end ownership for delivery quality, correctness, and maintainability in their area of responsibility. 

Key Responsibilities

The role spans five core dimensions, with ownership across end to end technical outcomes. 

1. Design & Technical Execution

• Own the architecture and detailed design for one or more RTP products or platform capabilities across markets. 

• Define and enforce reference architectures, design patterns, and engineering standards (e. g. , microservices, event driven architecture, domain driven design). 

• Design, build, and maintain high‐quality software components and services for RTP products. 

• Lead and participate in technical design reviews, ensuring alignment with RTP and enterprise architecture principles. 

• Make clear, well reasoned technology and design trade offs, balancing delivery speed, risk, and long term maintainability. 

• Own end‐to‐end delivery of complex features or subsystems, from design through production. 

• Translate functional and non‐functional requirements into robust technical implementations. 

• Ensure solutions adhere to RTP architecture standards and engineering best practices. 

2. Hands‐on Engineering & Code Quality

• Remain hands on for critical components, complex problem areas, prototypes, and reference implementations. 

• Lead by example in code quality, testing discipline, and maintainable design. 

• Perform and participate in code reviews, raising the bar for engineering quality. 

• Drive high quality implementations for low latency, high throughput, distributed systems. 

• Support teams in solving deep technical problems across application, messaging, data, and platform layers. 

3. Non Functional Excellence (NFR Ownership)

• Design and implement solutions that meet defined performance, scalability, reliability, and security requirements. 

• Define and enforce measurable non functional requirements, SLIs, and SLOs. 

• Ensure production readiness through strong observability (metrics, logs, traces), capacity planning, and failure mode design. 

• Proactively identify and remediate architectural, capacity, and resilience risks. 

• Support performance testing, capacity validation, and production readiness activities. 

• Actively participate in incident analysis and remediation when issues arise. 

4. Cross Market Consistency & Platform Evolution

• Drive cross market alignment, preventing architectural and Technology drift and duplicated solutions. 

• Promote reuse of patterns, components, and learnings across RTP markets and shared services. 

• Contribute to and influence the technology roadmap, including platform evergreening and technical debt reduction. 

• Act as a trusted technical partner to product, operations, and governance forums. 

5. Engineering Leadership & Bar Raising

• Mentor senior engineers and technical leads; raise the quality of design reviews, code reviews, and technical decision making. 

• Influence engineering culture toward ownership, quality, and operational excellence. 

• Support hiring and technical assessments, helping set the bar for senior technical talent. 

• Communicate complex technical topics clearly to both technical and non technical stakeholders. 

All About You

Experience & Technical Expertise

• 16+ years of experience in software engineering, with significant time spent designing and building distributed systems at scale. 

• Proven experience owning architecture and design for complex, business critical platforms. 

• Strong hands on expertise with microservices and event driven architectures. 

• Deep understanding of performance engineering, scalability patterns, resilience design, and failure handling. 

• Solid experience with observability, production diagnostics, and operational readiness.

At Albertsons Companies India associates collaborate directly with international teams, enhancing decision-making processes and organizational agility through exciting and pivotal projects. Your work will make history and help millions of lives each day come together around the joys of food and inspire their well-being. 

Senior Full Stack Engineer: 

- 6-9 years of professional software engineering experience, including 6+ years building/operating backend systems in Python at scale. 

ROLE SUMMARY: 

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer you will own features and services end to end - from frontend architecture to scalable backend services and their production operation. You will design systems at the module and service level, make performance, scalability and security decisions, carry on-call and production ownership, mentor engineers, and help shape technical direction within your team. 

WHAT YOU'LL DO: 

- Own features and services end to end, from design through production operation
 - Design systems at the module and service level: frontend feature modules, routing and reusable component library/design system; backend multi-service workflows, tool layer and retrieval
 - Lead the team's testing strategy: strong component tests + Playwright E2E in CI, reducing flakiness
 - Make performance decisions: code-splitting, rendering optimization, bundle analysis, Core Web Vitals; backend concurrency limits, queueing/backpressure and benchmarking
 - Make scalability decisions for workflow reliability: idempotency, compensation, isolation, multi-tenant readiness, cost/latency controls
 - Make security decisions: AuthN/AuthZ (JWT/OAuth/service-to-service), secrets, auditing and access controls
 - Hold on-call and production ownership: SLOs, incident playbooks, postmortems, observability and capacity planning
 - Mentor engineers and drive review discipline and accessibility standards
 - Help shape technical direction within the team

MUST-HAVE: 

Frontend: 

- Strong production experience with React + TypeScript (hooks, routing, React architecture)
 - Tailwind CSS at scale - consistent patterns and reusable UI primitives
 - Testing with React Testing Library, Jest/Vitest and Playwright E2E, integrated in CI
 - State and caching with React Query/SWR and Zustand/Redux Toolkit
 - Accessibility standards (WCAG). 
 - Refactoring and frontend architecture ownership (feature modules, component library, design system)
 - Testing leadership: CI integration and flaky test debugging
 - Performance profiling and optimization: code splitting, bundle analysis, Core Web Vitals, Lighthouse

Backend / Platform: 

- Strong Python backend ownership(FastAPI preferred) and production API design: versioning, pagination, error contracts
 - Streaming via SSE/WebSocket
 - SQL/PostgreSQL: data modeling, schema design, indexing and query optimization; Redis caching
 - Concurrency: asyncio, thread pools, process pools and their performance tradeoffs
 - Distributed systems fundamentals: queues/workers (Kafka/RabbitMQ/SQS), retries, backoff, DLQ, rate limiting, backpressure, circuit breaker
 - Docker, deployment/operations basics and CI/CD
 - 6+ years building/operating backend systems in Python at scale
 - Expert async/concurrency/parallelism and distributed systems depth
 - Workflow/state machine orchestration, idempotency and compensation patterns
 - AuthN/AuthZ design (OAuth2, JWT, service-to-service auth), secrets management and security fundamentals for production systems
 - Observability: logs, metrics, tracing(OpenTelemetry/Datadog/Prometheus); SLO/SLI; load/performance testing
 - Proven delivery of AI-backed systems in production (agents/RAG/tooling)

Leadership & collaboration: 

- Mentors engineers and raises the team's engineering bar
 - Operational leadership: on-call, incident management and postmortems
 - Sound judgement on performance, scalability and security tradeoffs
 - Helps shape technical direction within the team; collaborates closely with design and product

NICE-TO-HAVE: 

- gRPC and Kubernetes (K8s), Service mesh, Vector DB + reranking/hybrid search, Policy/guardrails and evaluation pipelines

SCREENING KEYWORDS: 

- Full stack, end-to-end feature and service ownership
 - Frontend architecture, feature modules, routing, component library, design system
 - React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
 - Test strategy: React Testing Library, Jest/Vitest, Playwright E2E, flake reduction
 - Performance: code splitting, bundle analysis, Core Web Vitals, Lighthouse
 - Python backend at scale, FastAPI, API design, SSE / WebSocket
 - Async/concurrency/parallelism, queueing/backpressure, benchmarking, load/performance testing
 - Workflow/state machine orchestration, idempotency, compensation, multi-tenant readiness
 - Security: AuthN/AuthZ, OAuth2, JWT, service-to-service auth, secrets, auditing
 - SLO/SLI, on-call, incident playbooks, postmortems, capacity planning
 - Observability: OpenTelemetry/Datadog/Prometheus
 - PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, CI/CD
 - AI-backed systems in production: agents, RAG, tooling
 - Mentoring, technical direction.

Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence. 

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk. 

Company Description

    Okta is the leading independent provider of enterprise identity. The Okta Identity Cloud enables organizations to securely connect the right people to the right technologies at the right time. With over 6, 500 pre-built integrations to

    applications and infrastructure providers, Okta customers can easily and securely use the best technologies for their business. Over 7, 950 organizations, including 20th Century Fox, JetBlue, Nordstrom, Slack, Teach for America, and Twilio, 

    trust Okta to help protect the identities of their workforces and customers. 

  

    Position Description

      We are seeking an experienced Full Stack Senior Software Engineer to play a key role in building and scaling the Okta Recovery Vault (ORV). This team is responsible for Okta's enterprise-grade soft-delete and object recovery capability, 

    designed to protect critical identity objects (Users and Groups) from accidental or malicious deletion. 

    As a Senior Engineer, you will own the technical design, implementation, and operational reliability of critical components within our real-time, high-fidelity recovery system - spanning backend services and the admin-facing UI that customers

    use to review and restore their data. You will solve complex engineering problems around identity preservation (UUIDs) and relationship restoration-including group memberships, app assignments, and password hashes-while also crafting

    intuitive, performant workflows that let admins confidently recover from data loss events. 

  

  Job Duties and Responsibilities

    - Feature Execution: Drive the technical design and end-to-end implementation of complex features, such as granular and bulk recovery workflows across Free and Advanced Resilience tiers - from backend APIs to the admin console UI. 

    - Component Design: Design and build reliable core components for real-time recovery systems that capture deletion events, support scalable data restoration, and surface clear, actionable recovery status to end users. 

    - UI/UX for Recovery Workflows: Build responsive, accessible front-end experiences (e. g. , recovery dashboards, bulk restore flows, audit views) that make complex backend recovery operations easy for admins to understand and act on. 

    - Relationship & State Management: Solve challenging engineering problems around relationship restoration (group memberships, app assignments, device enrollments) and state consistency, and reflect that state accurately in the UI. 

    - Security & Compliance: Implement secure logging and tracking for all recovery operations (soft-delete, restore, permanent-delete) in Syslog to adhere to strict audit and compliance standards. 

    - Product & Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner with Product Managers, Designers, and technical leads to clarify requirements, define technical scope, and break down complex projects into actionable milestones across the stack. 

    - Operational Excellence: Participate in on-call rotations, troubleshoot production issues (backend and frontend), perform root cause analysis (RCAs), and enhance system observability, logging, and metrics. 

    - Code Quality & Technical Standards: Champion engineering best practices through thorough code reviews, automated testing (unit, integration, and UI), and comprehensive technical documentation. 

    - Team Growth: Provide guidance and peer mentorship to intermediate and junior engineers on the team to foster technical growth and code quality across the full stack.

data.title: Assistant Manager - FQA (Mechanical)
data.description:
About Business

JOB DESCRIPTION

Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India. 

Adani Power Limited (APL Adani Power Limited (APL), a part of the diversified Adani Group, is the largest private thermal power producer in India. We have a power generation capacity of 15, 250 MW comprising thermal power plants in Gujarat, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, and Jharkhand, and a 40 MW solar power project in Gujarat. 

Job Purpose: This role is responsible to uphold and enhance the quality and integrity of mechanical components and systems through rigorous inspection and testing procedures. This includes coordinating for site inspections, conducting tests, overseeing boiler and pressure part surveys, and managing welder qualifications. The role also involves preparing and reviewing quality assurance plans and field quality plans, as well as leading quality training sessions to ensure high standards of workmanship and engineering practices. 

Responsibilities

Quality Assurance and Inspection: 

- Coordinate and conduct site inspections with O&M engineers as per quality procedures, codes, and standards. 
 - Execute all inspection activities of BTG and BOP, including PDI of materials and spares. 
 - Execute inspection of boiler, pressure parts, welding, turbine and auxiliaries. 
 - Identify and inspect Boiler Tube Leakage rectification works with NDT testing and other quality procedures. 
 - Conduct visual inspections and witness various Destructive and Non-Destructive Testing (DPT, MPT, UT, RT) to verify equipment integrity. 
 - Execute inspections and thickness surveys of boiler pressure parts, coal bunkers, APH, HP and LP Valves, rotary parts, etc. 
 - Arrange PDI inspections of procurement material/spares at vendor premises and provide MDCC (Material Dispatch Claims Certification). 
 - Provide support for third-party inspections and certifications of safety equipment and healthiness of equipment. 

Quality Control And Testing

- Conduct welder qualification tests (for both IBR and non-IBR) and maintain welder performance records. 
 - Prepare, review, and approve materials, QAPs, and FQPs of various site packages. 
 - Prepare and review WPS, PQR, and WPQ documents. 
 - Operational Excellence and Compliance: 
 - Raise NFA (Note for Approval) for deviations and modifications and obtain approval through the system. 
 - Provide budget inputs and ensure the sustainability of resources and processes. 

Resource Management, Training, And Innovation

- Provide TNI inputs and drive feedback sessions for continuous learning. 
 - Provide innovative ideas and recommendations. 
 - Support quality awareness training sessions for maintenance engineers and agency engineers/supervisors to foster a culture of quality and excellence at the site. 
 - Manage relationships with external agencies to ensure the timely submission of bills, closure of accounts, and resolution of financial matters related to mechanical works. 

Business Sustainability

- Implement and follow IMS, AWMS, DISHA and CHETNA guidelines within the department. 
 - Maintain the safety of business associates/other contractors and equipment through proper training and adherence to safety protocols. 
 - Ensure compliance with technical audits, safety audits, and business excellence assessments. 
 - Implement CHETNA Safety standards in the department to achieve zero harm. 
 - Conduct regular safety audits and risk assessments to identify and mitigate potential hazards. 
 - Ensure compliance with all relevant environmental, health, and safety regulations and company policies. 

Digitization And Automation

- Execute integration of advanced technology and comprehensive digitization strategies in mechanical quality assurance processes to optimize operational efficiency. 
 - Implement automation solutions to support overall organizational goals and strategy. 
 - Implement process and system improvements, adopting newer technologies and innovative ideas. 
 - Monitor and analyse data from digital systems to inform decision-making and improve quality outcomes. 

Key Stakeholders - Internal

- Maintenance Mechanical
 - Operations & Maintenance
 - Techno Commercial

Key Stakeholders - External

- Agencies and contractors

Qualifications

Educational Qualification: 

Bachelor's in Mechanical Engineering or a related field from a recognized institution. 

Work Experience (Range Of Years)

6+ years of experience in quality assurance/control, with a significant portion in a leadership role within the power sector or related heavy industries. 

Preferred Industry

Candidates with experience in the power generation, energy, or related heavy industrial sectors are preferred, with a strong background in operational excellence and quality management systems.

data.description:

Your role: 

As Manager, Quality Management, you will build and lead the hosted Quality Management team based at our Global Business Services (GBS) campus in Bangalore. You will be accountable for quality deliverables across Fresenius Medical Care's global product portfolio as a full member of the global SQR team. 

- Build, lead and develop a high-performing Quality Management team - recruitment, onboarding, coaching, performance management and succession planning, in partnership with global SQR leadership and GBS enabling functions

 - Cloud & Infra: Azure, Kubernetes, Docker, Rancher, TeamCity, Octopus, Grafana 
 - Databases: MS SQL Server (T-SQL), NoSQL, Postgres 
 - Tooling: GitHub, Visual Studio/Rider, ReSharper 
 - AI Tools: MS Copilot, GitHub Copilot

Primary Duties Will Include

- Define automation-first test strategy and quality gates early with product, developers, and BAs, translating requirements into measurable coverage, risk-based priorities, and release criteria. 
 - Own and evolve the automated test architecture (frameworks, patterns, reusable components), ensuring maintainability, scalability, and consistent engineering standards across repositories. 
 - Design and implement robust automated tests (API/service, component, end-to-end, and contract/compatibility), including BDD specifications, test data management, and deterministic execution. 
 - Establish and run performance and reliability testing (baseline, regression, load) and translate results into actionable engineering feedback to improve latency, stability, and user experience. 
 - Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines to provide fast feedback loops (reporting, trends, flaky-test detection, artifacts) and ensure failures block releases when quality thresholds are not met. 
 - Lead defect prevention and rapid root-cause analysis , including log/telemetry review and failure triage, partnering with engineers to drive fixes and reduce recurrence through systemic improvements. 
 - Own testing across environments and release readiness , coordinating with Service Delivery/Release teams, adhering to change processes, and validating production behavior post-release. 
 - Driving process/tooling improvements and influencing cross-team quality standards through documentation and knowledge sharing. 

Qualifications

To land this role you will need: 

- 3+ years of hands‐on experience in Test Automation, with strong proficiency in C# and automation frameworks. 
 - Solid experience testing distributed systems, including RESTful, SOAP, gRPC APIs, Windows services, and messaging platforms such as Kafka or ActiveMQ. 
 - Strong test automation skills , including BDD approaches (preferably SpecFlow/Reqnroll), debugging, code reviews, and building custom automation tools and utilities. 
 - Experience testing web and client‐server applications , with good understanding of databases and SQL. 
 - Practical knowledge of containerized and orchestrated environments , such as Docker, Kubernetes, or similar platforms, including deployment and release workflows. 
 - Deep understanding of the full software testing lifecycle , from requirements analysis through QA/UAT sign‐off and production release, within an Agile delivery model. 
 - Strong grasp of QA best practices, SDLC , and experience working with version control, build, deployment, and test management tools. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills , with do main knowledge in financial systems (e. g. Trading platforms, CFDs, Forex, real‐time data) considered a strong plus. 

Education

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or related field - or equivalent hands-on experience.

data.title: IT Quality Assurance Analyst, Senior
data.description:
Overview

At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer's and partner's needs and solve their challenges. 

Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve. 

You'll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about-locally and globally. 

Come make an impact every day at Zebra. 

What We're Looking For

We're seeking a Senior Quality Assurance Analyst with strong Salesforce (SFDC) domain expertise to lead quality assurance strategy and test automation across Sales, Service, and integrated enterprise platforms. This role requires hands‐on experience with modern test automation frameworks using Tricentis Tosca or Playwright, applied thoughtfully to Salesforce‐centric and web‐based applications. You will partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Service, and IT teams to ensure high‐quality, scalable, and reliable Salesforce solutions by leveraging automation, API testing, AI‐assisted development techniques, and CI/CD pipelines in an Agile environment

Salesforce‐Focused Quality Assurance Strategy

- Lead QA efforts for Salesforce (SFDC) platforms including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and integrated enterprise systems. 
 - Define and execute end‐to‐end test strategies covering Salesforce configurations, customizations, workflows, validations, and integrations. 
 - Apply risk‐based, business‐process‐driven testing aligned to CRM, sales operations, marketing, and customer service use cases. 

Test Automation (Tosca or Playwright)

- Design, build, and maintain automation frameworks using Tricentis Tosca or Playwright for Salesforce and web applications. 
 - Use Tosca (model‐based automation, Vision AI, API testing) to support enterprise‐scale regression and integration testing where applicable. 
 - Use Playwright to implement robust, code‐based UI automation, focusing on speed, reliability, and maintainability. 
 - Leverage AI‐assisted / "vibe coding" approaches using tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or Cursor to accelerate development and iteration of Playwright automation scripts, while ensuring code quality, readability, and long‐term maintainability. 
 - Apply the right automation approach for the use case, balancing low‐code and code‐based strategies. 

API, Integration & End‐to‐End Testing

- Validate Salesforce integrations using API testing (REST/SOAP), middleware, and downstream enterprise systems. 
 - Ensure end‐to‐end test coverage across Salesforce, web applications, and integrated platforms. 

CI/CD, Release Quality & Agile Collaboration

- Integrate Tosca or Playwright automation into CI/CD pipelines (e. g. , Flosum, Azure DevOps, Jenkins). 
 - Enable unattended and parallel execution with clear, actionable reporting and dashboards. 
 - Establish and enforce quality gates for Salesforce and web application releases. 
 - Participate in backlog grooming, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives with a quality‐first mindset. 

Test Data, Defect Management & Stakeholder Communication

- Drive Salesforce‐specific test data strategies, including reusable and dynamic test data. 
 - Lead defect triage, root cause analysis, and quality risk assessments. 
 - Communicate quality insights and release readiness clearly to business and technical stakeholders. 

Enablement & Best Practices

- Coach teams on Salesforce QA best practices, automation standards, and scalable test design. 
 - Promote consistency, reusability, and maintainability across test assets and frameworks. 
 - Required
 - Bachelor's degree (4 years) in Computer Science or a related field (preferred). 
 - 4+ years of hands‐on QA experience, with strong focus on Salesforce (SFDC) platforms. 
 - Proven experience testing Salesforce business processes (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, CRM workflows). 
 - Hands‐on experience with Tricentis Tosca or Playwright for test automation. 
 - Strong understanding of automation framework design, test stability, and maintainability. 
 - Experience with API and integration testing. 
 - Solid knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and Agile/Scrum practices. 
 - Experience with JIRA and test management tools such as ALM Quality Center or qTest. 
 - Excellent analytical, communication, and cross‐functional collaboration skills. 
Preferred

- Salesforce certifications or formal Salesforce training (Admin, Platform App Builder, or equivalent). 
 - Experience testing Salesforce integrations with ERP, e‐commerce, or middleware platforms. 
 - Tosca certifications (AS2, AE2, TDS1/TDS2). 
 - Experience optimizing Playwright test suites for performance and parallel execution. 
 - Knowledge of AI‐assisted / "vibe coding" techniques using tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or Cursor for developing and accelerating Playwright automation scripts. 
 - Knowledge of Sales, Marketing, and Customer Service domains. 

Benefits

We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success. 

Job Posting Statement

To protect candidates from falling victim to online fraudulent activity involving fake job postings and employment offers, please be aware our recruiters will always connect with you via @zebra. com email accounts. Applications are only accepted through our applicant tracking system and only accept personal identifying information through that system. Our Talent Acquisition team will not ask for you to provide personal identifying information via e-mail or outside of the system. If you are a victim of identity theft contact your local police department. 

AI Technology Statement

Zebra Technologies leverages AI technology to evaluate job applications using objective, job-relevant criteria. This approach enhances efficiency and promotes fairness in the hiring process. However, every decision regarding interviews and hiring is made by our dedicated team, because we believe people make the best decisions about people. For more on how we use technology in hiring and how we process applicant data, see our Zebra Privacy Policy.

data.title: Senior QA Engineer - Trading
data.description:
Overview

Connecting clients to markets - and talent to opportunity. 

With 5, 400+ employees and over 80, 000 institutional, commercial, and payments clients, we operate from more than 80 offices spread across six continents. As a Fortune 100, Nasdaq-listed provider, we connect clients to the global markets - focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world-class products and services to all types of investors. 

Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, StoneX Group is made up of four business segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth. 

Corporate Functions Engage in a deep variety of business-critical activities that keep our company running efficiently. From strategic marketing and financial management to human resources and operational oversight, you'll have the opportunity to optimize processes and implement game-changing policies. 

Responsibilities

Position Purpose: The QA Engineer is responsible for assuring the quality and stability of the Nexus Futures trading ecosystem, including order management, execution services, broker and exchange connectivity, and post-trade processing. The role delivers comprehensive test coverage across business initiatives and platform modernisation efforts through a combination of functional testing, automation, risk-based quality assurance, and release validation. Working closely with cross-functional teams, the QA Engineer helps ensure reliable, resilient, and scalable trading solutions that support StoneX's futures business and clients globally. 

The team is actively investing in AI-assisted software delivery and quality engineering. The successful candidate will be encouraged to leverage AI tools to improve test design, automation development, defect analysis, documentation, and overall delivery efficiency, while maintaining appropriate governance and quality controls. 

Testing is performed in both manual and automated fashion, but the team focuses on expanding the automated test suites. The projects you will be working on are mainly server-side. 

Technology Ecosystem: 

- API Tools: Swagger, Postman, Devtools 
 - Back End: C#, SQL Server, WebApi, ReqNRoll/Specflow, Gherkin, Cucumber, FIX 
 - Architect: Docker Kubernetes, TeamCity, BitBucket, Jira, Confluence, Octopus, Rancher, Influx, KPI Metrics, Nolio 
 - Cloud: DataDog, Kafka, Databricks, Redis 
 - AI & Productivity Tools: Claude, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT

Primary duties will include: 

- Collaborate with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to understand project requirements and ensure comprehensive test coverage. 
 - Own test strategy, estimation, test planning and test execution for new features, enhancements, and production fixes. 
 - Identify and prioritize test cases for automation, considering both functional and non-functional requirements and implementing the existing test automation frameworks for backend side of trade system in Specflow/ReqNRoll. 
 - Test end-to-end trading flows across, execution services, FIX gateways, exchange/broker connectivity and downstream processing. 
 - Analyse server and application logs, system data to isolate defects, support root-cause analysis and provide clear evidence to Engineering. 
 - Analyse complex systems, spot trends, draw conclusions, and produce specifications and decisions. 
 - Perform API, service, database and message-level testing using appropriate tools and SQL queries. 
 - Assess release risk, define test exit criteria and provide clear QA recommendations for UAT, production deployment and operational readiness. 
 - Managing the release deployment in various environments with cooperation with different teams. 
 - Contribute actively to requirements refinement, Three Amigos discussions, sprint planning, defect triage, demonstrations and retrospectives. 
 - Document test plans, test cases, and test results to facilitate communication and knowledge sharing within the team. 
 - Improve QA practices through peer review, reusable test assets, knowledge sharing and measurable reduction of manual regression effort. 

Qualifications

To Land this role you will need: 

- Strong professional experience testing complex trading, financial, transactional or other high-integrity backend systems. 
 - Hands-on experience of manual functional, integration, regression and end-to-end testing in an Agile delivery environment. 
 - Confident API and backend-service testing, with the ability to validate requests, responses, events and persisted data. 
 - Basic SQL skills for data interrogation, reconciliation and test-evidence preparation. 
 - Experience diagnosing issues through application logs, service behaviour, databases and message flows. 
 - Practical automation experience using C# or a comparable language to extend the existing test framework. 
 - Experience with Git-based version control, CI/CD pipelines and test execution within build and deployment tooling. 
 - Ability to translate requirements and business workflows into clear, risk-based test coverage and traceable evidence. 
 - Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail and clear written and verbal communication. 
 - Experience taking testing from requirements analysis through QA sign-off, UAT support and production release. 

What will make you stand out: 

- Exchange-traded derivatives, particularly US Futures. 
 - Electronic order entry, order management or execution management systems. 
 - FIX protocol, including session behaviour and execution-report-based order lifecycles. 
 - High-throughput or low-latency distributed systems and asynchronous messaging technologies. 
 - Operational resilience, failover, disaster recovery and controlled production releases. 
 - Experience with tools or technologies such as Postman, Swagger, SQL Server, Kafka, Kubernetes, Rancher, TeamCity, Jenkins, Octopus, Jira and Confluence. 
 - Experience evaluating and adopting emerging QA technologies, including AI-assisted test generation, intelligent test selection, automated defect analysis, synthetic test data generation, and quality analytics. 
 - Keen interest in understanding the distributed architecture

Ways of working

- Builds effective relationships across Product, Business Analysis, Engineering, QA and Operations. 
 - Challenges requirements constructively and raises delivery or quality risks early with supporting evidence. 
 - Takes ownership of test outcomes while remaining collaborative and pragmatic. 
 - Balances detailed functional investigation with automation and continuous improvement. 
 - Shares domain knowledge and supports peer review to strengthen team resilience. 

Education / Certification Requirements: 

- Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience. 
 - ISTQB or relevant testing certification is advantageous but not essential. 

Working environment: 

- 4 days in office per week

data.description:
About Albertsons Companies Inc: 

As a leading food and drug retailer in the United States, Albertsons Companies, Inc. operates over 2, 200 stores across 35 states and the District of Columbia. Our well-known banners across the United States, including Albertsons, Safeway, Vons, Jewel-Osco and others, serve more than 36 million U. S customers each week. 

We build and shape technology solutions that solve customers' problems every day, making things easier for them when they shop with us online or in a store. We have made bold, strategic moves to migrate and modernize our core foundational capabilities, positioning ourselves as the first fully cloud-based grocery tech company in the industry. 

Our success is built on a one-team approach, driven by the desire to understand and enhance customer experience. By constantly pushing the boundaries of retail, we are transforming shopping into an experience that is easy, efficient, fun and engaging. 

About Albertsons Companies India: 

At Albertsons Companies India, we're not just pushing the boundaries of technology and retail innovation, we're cultivating a space where ideas flourish and careers thrive. Our workplace in India is a vital extension of the Albertsons Companies Inc. workforce and important to the next phase in the company's technology journey to support millions of customers' lives every day. 

At the Albertsons Companies India, we are raising the bar to grow across Technology & Engineering, AI, Digital and other company functions, and transform a 165-year-old American retailer. At Albertsons Companies India associates collaborate directly with international teams, enhancing decision-making processes and organizational agility through exciting and pivotal projects. Your work will make history and help millions of lives each day come together around the joys of food and inspire their well-being. 

QA Engineer: 

- 3-6 years in software quality engineering, including2+ years building test automation for modern web applications and APIs. 

ROLE SUMMARY: 

We're looking for a QA Engineer who treats quality as an engineering discipline, not a final checkpoint. You'll own test strategy and automation across our React/TypeScript frontend and Python/FastAPI backend services, including AI-powered workflows. You'll build fast, creliable test suites that run in CI on every change. You'll work with engineer sand product from requirements through release so issues are caught early and shipping stays safe and fast. 

WHAT YOU'LL DO: 

Test strategy & planning: 

- Own test strategy and test plans for features end to end (UI, API, data and integrations), with risk-based coverage and clear acceptance criteria agreed with product and engineering. 
 - Take part in design and refinement sessions to shift quality left: review requirements and PRs for testability and edge cases. 
 - Report release readiness and track quality metrics: escaped defects, automation coverage, flake rate and pipeline duration. 

Automation: 

- Design, build and maintain UI automation in Playwright (TypeScript), using fixtures, Page Object Model, parallel execution, sharding and trace viewer debugging. 
 - Maintain existing Selenium WebDriver suites and migrate them to Playwright where it makes sense. 
 - Build API and integration test suites for REST/FastAPI services with PyTest, Playwright API testing, Postman/Newman or REST Assured. Validate schemas, auth, error handling and contracts. 
 - Validate data in PostgreSQL, caching behaviour in Redis, and async/queue-based workflows. Build reliable test-data setup and teardown. 
 - Mock dependencies and third-party services using MSW, Wiremock or Playwright network interception. 

CI/CD & environments: 

- Integrate test suites into CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or Jenkins)with PR gating, parallel runs and clear reporting (Allure, Playwright HTML reports). 
 - Run tests in containerized environments using Docker/Docker Compose and ephemeral review environments on Kubernetes. 
 - Hunt down and fix flaky tests: root-cause failures and improve locators, waits and test isolation. 

Non-functional & AI quality: 

- Run performance and load tests with k6, JMeter or Locust, and set performance baselines. 
 - Cover cross-browser and device testing (BrowserStack, Lambda Test or Sauce Labs), visual regression (Playwright snapshots, Percy or Applitools) and accessibility (axe-core, Lighthouse, WCAG 2. 2). 
 - Test AI/LLM-powered features: build evaluation data sets and check output quality, consistency, hallucinations, guardrails and regressions with tools such as Prompt foo, DeepEval or Ragas. 
 - Use AI-assisted testing tools (GitHub Copilot, Playwright codegen/MCP, AI test generation) to speed up test authoring while keeping suites maintainable. 

Defect management: 

- Do structured exploratory testing and log clear, reproducible bugs in Jira with steps, logs, screenshots and traces. Follow them through to closure. 

MUST-HAVE: 

Test automation: 

- 3+years of hands-onUI automation, with strong Playwright (TypeScript/JavaScript) skills and working experience with Selenium WebDriver (Python). 
 - Strong coding skills in TypeScript/JavaScript and/or Python. Writes clean, maintainable test code using Page Object Model, fixtures and data-driven patterns. 
 - Solid API testing: REST, HTTP, JSON and auth (OAuth2/JWT) using PyTest/requests, Postman/Newman or REST Assured. 
 - Experience integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLabCI or Jenkins) with parallel execution and reporting. 

QA fundamentals: 

- Strong grasp of functional, regression, smoke, integration, end-to-end, exploratory and UAT testing, and of test design techniques (boundary values, equivalence partitioning, decision tables). 
 - Experience writing test plans, test cases and high-quality bug reports in Agile/Scrum teams using Jira and a test management tool (TestRail, Xray or Zephyr). 
 - Working SQL for data validation (PostgreSQL preferred). 
 - Comfortable with Git, code reviews, browser DevTools, network inspection and log-based debugging. 
 - Docker basics, plus hands-on experience with at least one performance testing tool (k6, JMeteror Locust). 

Collaboration: 

- Clear written and verbal communication. Advocates for quality with engineers, product and design. 
 - Takes ownership of quality outcomes, balances speed with risk, and helps teammates adopt good automation practices. 

NICE-TO-HAVE: 

Cypress, WebdriverIO, Appium (mobile), contract testing with Pact, visual regression (Percy, Applitools), accessibility testing (axe-core, WCAG 2. 2), BrowserStack/Lambda Test, LLM evaluation tools (Prompt foo, DeepEval, Ragas), Kubernetes, observability (Grafana, Sentry, OpenTelemetry), security testing basics (OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite), ISTQB certification.

The AI Lead is a senior technical leadership role responsible for driving the end-to-end delivery of AI and Agentic AI solutions. Strength in Trust

OneTrust's mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn't slow teams down-it should accelerate what's possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‐Ready Governance PlatformTM, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society. 

The Challenge

Senior Managers of Engineering at OneTrust make long-term strategic and technical contributions. They set strategic goals for the team, hire and develop engineers, and prioritize projects that create meaningful customer and business impact. They remain technically engaged-helping develop new products, identify requirements, and execute with excellence. 

As a Senior Manager on the AI Governance Engineering team, you will lead the development of OneTrust's next-generation AI Governance platform. You will help turn complex governance, compliance, security, and responsible AI requirements into scalable products that enable organizations to confidently build, evaluate, deploy, and operate AI models and agents. This is an opportunity to shape a high-impact product area at the intersection of AI, enterprise software, and trust. 

Your Mission

Drive strategic planning and execution while developing key technologies that strengthen OneTrust's long-term, proprietary strategic position in AI Governance. Create new concepts from initial design through market release, establish a strong engineering culture, and lead teams that deliver reliable, secure, and extensible AIG capabilities at enterprise scale. 

You Are

- Experienced overseeing end-to-end development activities while monitoring the reliability, security, and performance of internal systems and recommending improvements when required. 
 - Able to translate AI governance, compliance, and responsible AI needs into clear product requirements, technical strategy, and execution plans. 
 - Able to ensure compliance with security regulations while managing software development projects by setting requirements, goals, and timelines.

 - Implementing innovative technologies and architectural patterns for AI model and agent governance. 
 - Coordinating effectively with internal and external stakeholders, including Product, Security, Compliance, and customer-facing teams.

 - Experienced building onboarding and mentoring programs to teach and train other engineers in order to incubate individual and team growth.

data.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
data.description:
We're an early-stage, US-based AI startup building a 0→1 AI-native software platform. 

We're currently operating in stealth and are looking for an exceptional senior engineer to join our small team in Pune. You'll work directly with the founders and have meaningful influence over the product, architecture, and engineering practices from an early stage. 

This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to  build, own, and shape a product. 

What you'll own

You'll take meaningful parts of the product from idea to production: shaping technical approaches, making architecture decisions, writing production code, testing, deploying, observing, and continuously improving what you ship. 

You'll work across  Python, TypeScript, React/Next. js, Node. js, and PostgreSQL, building both the core application and the AI-powered workflows behind it. 

You'll help us build  production-grade AI systems. That includes LLM orchestration, structured outputs,   retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool/function calling, multi-step AI workflows, evaluations, guardrails, security and privacy controls, observability, failure handling, and cost/performance optimization. 

You'll make thoughtful decisions about  model selection, prompt and context design, token usage, latency, quality, and cost, and understand when techniques such as retrieval, model routing, caching, fine-tuning, or workflow orchestration are appropriate for a production system. 

You'll design and operate AI workflows involving  sequential and parallel stages, dependencies, retries, validation, and failure recovery, while recognizing when a simpler deterministic solution is the better engineering choice. 

You'll work directly with the founders to turn product ideas and customer learning into software, while helping establish the technical standards and engineering practices of a growing team. 

What we're looking for

- 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with substantial experience owning and shipping production applications end-to-end. 
 - You have personally shipped AI/LLM-powered products or features to production that were used by real users. 
 - Strong Python expertise is required.   You should be comfortable designing and building production systems in Python. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with  TypeScript/JavaScript, React or Next. js, Node. js, and PostgreSQL or comparable relational databases. 
 - Practical experience building production AI/LLM systems using capabilities such as  RAG, structured outputs, tool/function calling, multi-step workflow orchestration, evaluations, guardrails, and observability. 
 - Experience making production decisions around  model choice, prompt and context design, token usage, latency, quality, and cost. 
 - Understanding of  retrieval, model routing, caching, fine-tuning, and orchestration patterns, including the judgment to determine when each is and is not appropriate. 
 - Strong fundamentals in  application security, authentication/authorization, API design, data modeling, testing, observability, privacy, and production reliability. 
 - Strong architecture and engineering judgment. You can take ambiguous product problems, reason through technical trade-offs, and independently turn them into well-engineered software. 
 - A strong  product mindset. You care about what users need and why we're building something, not just how to implement it. 
 - Deep technical curiosity.   You actively keep up with advances in AI, developer tooling, frameworks, infrastructure, and software engineering and have the judgment to distinguish genuinely useful advances from hype. 

You might be a great fit if

You're the kind of engineer who experiments with a new model, framework, architecture, or development tool because you want to understand what it makes possible. 

You enjoy moving between  product thinking, architecture, and implementation. You're comfortable making decisions when the answer isn't obvious, and equally comfortable changing direction when the evidence says you should. 

You value speed, but not at the expense of building something brittle. You know when to keep things simple, when to invest in stronger foundations, and how to make those trade-offs explicit. 

When building with AI, you naturally ask:   How do we know this works? How does it fail? How do we evaluate it? How do we keep user data safe? What should happen when the model gets it wrong?

And above all, you still want to be a hands-on  builder. 

Why join now

You'll join early enough to have real influence over the product and technical foundation of the company while working directly with the founders. 

As the engineering team grows, this role has the opportunity to expand into  technical leadership  for someone who demonstrates the engineering judgment, ownership, and leadership ability to take on that responsibility. 

Location:   Pune, India

Employment:   Full-time

Compensation:   ₹45-55 LPA, depending on experience and fit. 

We're intentionally keeping the company in stealth while we build. We'll share significantly more about the product, founders, and company during the interview process. 

Application question

Along with your application, please briefly describe  one AI/LLM-powered product or feature you personally helped ship to production and that was used by real users. 

In approximately  200-400 words, tell us: 

- What did the product or feature do?
 - What did you personally own or build?
 - What was the most challenging technical or product problem you encountered, and how did you approach it?
 - How did you evaluate whether the AI behavior was working as intended?

Please focus on  your own contribution and decisions, rather than describing the work of the broader team. Please do not share any confidential information, proprietary code, customer names, or other sensitive details.

data.title: Shopify Developer
data.description:
About Sliq Group

Sliq Group is an AI-powered tech consulting and product engineering company. We work across e-commerce, product, and AI, partnering with startups, mid-market brands, and enterprises to build and scale digital experiences that perform. 

Role Description

We are hiring a Shopify Developer with 4 years of hands-on experience to build Shopify stores and custom themes from scratch for multiple brands. 

You will take a Figma design and deliver a production-ready store, covering setup, architecture, development, integrations, and launch, and then maintain and optimize it after go-live. 

You will also work on headless setups, where Shopify is the shared commerce backend, and the frontend is a separate application built in a technology such as React or Next. js. Knowledge of headless setups is an additional advantage and is not mandatory. 

Key Responsibilities

- Build custom Shopify themes from scratch using Liquid, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript on Online Store 2. 0, based on Figma designs. 
 - Set up and configure Shopify stores end-to-end, including products, collections, metafields, metaobjects, markets, shipping, tax, and payments. 
 - Build catalog-heavy and interactive features such as variant selectors, bundles, filtering, search, quizzes, and wishlists. 
 - Integrate third-party apps (reviews, email/SMS, search, analytics) and resolve app and script conflicts. 
 - Build custom integrations with ERPs, CRMs, and other systems using webhooks and the Admin API. 
 - Migrate stores from WooCommerce, Magento, or BigCommerce to Shopify, including data and URL redirects. 
 - Optimize Core Web Vitals and page speed, and implement tracking (GA4, GTM, Meta Pixel).   
 - Support Shopify Markets, multi-currency, and localization. 
 - Ensure accessibility (WCAG/ADA), SEO, and privacy compliance in every build. 
 - Manage QA, staging, go-live, and post-launch support within agreed SLAs. 
 - Follow Git-based workflows and code reviews, and collaborate with designers, project managers, and QA. 

Additional Responsibilities (Headless Setup, Not Mandatory)

- Build decoupled frontends in React, Next. js, or a similar framework that use Shopify as the backend through the Storefront and Admin APIs. 
 - Design headless architecture covering routing, data fetching, caching, rendering (SSR, SSG, ISR), cart, checkout handoff, customer accounts, and deployment on Vercel or Netlify. 
 - Support multiple frontends on a single shared Shopify backend. 
 - Integrate a headless CMS (Contentful, Sanity, Strapi, or similar) with Shopify. 

Required Skills and Qualifications

- 4 years of professional Shopify development experience, including at least 2 complete theme or store builds from scratch. 
 - Strong proficiency in Liquid, HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript (ES6+). 
 - Deep experience with the Shopify Storefront API and Admin API (GraphQL and REST). 
 - Deep hands-on experience with Online Store 2. 0, sections, blocks, metafields, and metaobjects. 
 - Ability to convert Figma designs into production-ready Shopify themes. 
 - Experience with Shopify CLI, Git, and staging-to-production workflows. 
 - Strong understanding of performance, SEO, and accessibility best practices. 
 - Clear communication and a strong sense of ownership. 

Good to Have

- Headless setup experience: delivering a project in production with Shopify as the backend and a separate frontend in React, Next. js, or a similar framework (Vue, Nuxt). 
 - Understanding of headless architecture (additional, not mandatory), including API-driven data flow, SSR, SSG, ISR, caching, and customer authentication. 
 - Experience with Hydrogen and Oxygen. 
 - Experience with Shopify Plus, checkout extensibility, and Shopify Functions. 
 - Experience with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and a headless CMS. 
 - Experience with one shared Shopify backend serving multiple frontends or regional sites. 
 - Familiarity with Klaviyo, Yotpo, Judge. me, Recharge, Gorgias, and similar apps. 
 - Experience building custom Shopify apps (Node. js, Remix). 
 - Exposure to AI-assisted development tools and workflows. 
 - Shopify certifications.
