data.description:
Location: Bangalore. 

Function: Software Engineering

Reports to: Manager, Esko AI

About The Role

The Esko AI team is a group of specialists focused on leveraging AI to solve valuable and often challenging customer problems that have historically resisted automation via purely rule-based approaches. To succeed in the complex domain of packaging graphics, AI agents must operate reliably according to regulatory requirements, technical specifications, brand guidelines, customer-specific conventions - and invoke expert human judgement when required. This is a complex engineering problem that goes beyond the boundaries of standard agentic scenarios. 

We're looking for a Technical Expert to take technical ownership of core agentic capabilities within Esko's AI Platform, from experimentation and design through production implementation. be a senior authority and author on agentic AI across Esko's AI Platform. This is a hands-on technical role, not a management one: you'll set direction and raise the bar through writing code, leading experiments, writing documentation, and mentorship of team members for a platform that spans multiple agentic capabilities (knowledge & reasoning, tool use and orchestration, evaluation, and safety/guardrails) and which is used by many product teams across the business. 

You should bring experience from multiple agentic AI projects with a similar order of complexity in terms of the technical challenges you have successfully tackled, together with a 'sixth sense' for agentic AI operation to predict the approaches which are likely yield successful results as the platform grows into new domains. 

What You Will Do

- Go deep on the hardest technical problems inside the agentic AI platform - the ones where progress depends on specialist expertise, not just engineering effort: data discovery & consolidation, agent planning and tool-use, retrieval and grounding, validation-before-action, conflict/ambiguity handling, and similar hard sub-problems. 
 - Personally design, build, and harden the platform's most technically demanding components - the pieces where correctness, edge cases, and failure modes are subtle enough to need deep, hands-on ownership rather than delegation. 
 - Act as the team's go-to technical expert on agentic AI and LLM systems: the person others bring their hardest "how do we actually make this work" problems to, providing depth on specific technical questions rather than setting overall team direction. 
 - Diagnose and resolve the platform's toughest technical issues - performance, reliability, correctness, and edge-case failures - where specialist knowledge is the difference between a real fix and a workaround. 
 - Contribute into architecture discussions, stress-testing designs against hard technical realities (scaling limits, failure modes, subtle correctness issues) that come from real specialist experience. 
 - Evaluate emerging techniques, frameworks, and tools in agentic AI and LLM tooling, and give the team pragmatic, evidence-based recommendations on what's worth adopting. 
 - Write technical deep-dives and documentation that make complex mechanisms legible to the rest of the team, so your expertise compounds rather than staying tacit. 

What We Are Looking For

- Strong software engineering experience designing, building, and operating production systems in Python, TypeScript, Java, or a similar language. 
 - 10+ years of software engineering experience, including substantial time as a senior/staff/principal-level individual contributor architecting and operating production agentic AI systems involving multi-step reasoning, tool use, planning, or orchestration, where alignment and dependability of the agent's output is a key success factor. 
 - Experience across multiple distinct agentic AI projects, able to draw on that breadth to guide technical decisions in unfamiliar contexts.

- The platform's hardest technical problems get solved correctly and durably. 
 - The team turns to you as the deep technical authority on agentic AI and LLM systems - for the "how" and "why it breaks, ". 
 - The components you build are robust, well-tested, and well-documented, with edge cases and failure modes properly accounted for rather than discovered in production.

data.title: Principal Data Systems Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Build the next generation of Oracle Zero Data Loss Recovery Appliance (ZDLRA) software, helping fortune 500 enterprises protect and recover their business-critical Oracle databases. Work on software where data integrity, recoverability, cyber resilience, and performance at scale directly affect customers' most important operations. 

Join our growing engineering team in Bengaluru and collaborate with experienced ZDLRA engineers in India and the US. You will contribute to shared product priorities, deliver new features and projects, and help evolve an enterprise data protection platform. This role offers the opportunity to help shape a new team while building deep product expertise within an established global engineering organization. 

The work spans Oracle database kernel development and systems programming, primarily in C and PL/SQL on Linux. You will tackle engineering problems involving buffers and caches, memory management, storage, file systems, I/O, networking, concurrency, and distributed systems. Strong algorithms, thoughtful design, and an understanding of how these components interact will be central to delivering correct, efficient, and maintainable software. 

You will participate throughout the development lifecycle: understanding problems, exploring the codebase, identifying root causes, designing solutions, implementing changes, writing tests, and validating results. The work combines new development and enhancements with complex defect resolution, including issues encountered in customer environments. As your product knowledge grows, you will take increasing technical ownership of assigned features and components, contributing to design decisions, code reviews, ongoing maintenance, and knowledge sharing. 

We value engineers who investigate problems systematically, use documentation and diagnostic tools resourcefully, communicate clearly, and help colleagues succeed. You will use modern engineering tools, including LLMs and AI coding agents, to accelerate code exploration, development, and testing while applying independent judgment and rigorous validation to the resulting designs and code. 

We welcome experienced developers with strong C, Linux, system programming skills and practical knowledge of database internals, storage, distributed systems, or other demanding enterprise software. Prior Oracle Database, RMAN, PL/SQL, or backup and recovery product experience is an advantage. Strong systems fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to translate complex requirements into reliable production software are essential. 

This position is based in Bengaluru, India. 

Responsibilities

Product development and technical ownership

- Design, implement, and maintain ZDLRA features and enhancements in C and PL/SQL on Linux, contributing to Oracle database kernel and systems software development. 
 - Translate requirements and technical problems into clear designs, manageable tasks, and deliverable milestones. Evaluate alternatives and document trade-offs involving correctness, performance, scalability, compatibility, and maintainability. 
 - Apply appropriate algorithms and data structures to build efficient, reliable software. Reason about memory use, concurrency, synchronization, and behavior under demanding workloads. 
 - Develop and improve assigned components involving buffers, caches, storage, file systems, I/O, networking, and distributed processing, with careful attention to data integrity and recovery behavior. 
 - Build product expertise through code exploration, technical documentation, collaboration, and delivery of fixes and enhancements. Progress toward ownership of assigned features and projects, including subsequent development, maintenance, and defect resolution. 

Investigation, performance, and quality

- Investigate complex defects, including issues reported from customer deployments. Reproduce failures, trace relevant code paths, establish root causes, and implement durable fixes. 
 - Use GDB, core dumps, logs, traces, profiling tools, and Linux utilities to gather evidence and understand software behavior across interacting components. 
 - Diagnose performance and scalability bottlenecks involving CPU, memory, storage, I/O, and networking. Establish useful measurements and validate the impact of changes against representative workloads. 
 - Design and implement tests alongside production code. Cover functional behavior, boundary conditions, regressions, concurrency, and relevant failure and recovery scenarios using the team's engineering and test frameworks. 
 - Use shell scripting and automation to improve diagnostic data collection, issue reproduction, testing, and other repeatable development tasks. 
 - Follow secure coding practices and engineering standards. Evaluate error handling, resource management, backward compatibility, and versioning implications when modifying existing code or interfaces. 

Engineering execution and collaboration

- Take assigned work through the software development lifecycle, from analysis and design through implementation, review, testing, integration, and maintenance. 
 - Plan work realistically, identify dependencies, and communicate progress, design decisions, risks, and blockers. Coordinate with the engineering team to deliver agreed project milestones. 
 - Collaborate closely with ZDLRA engineers in India and the US and with relevant database engineering teams to resolve cross-component issues and deliver shared product objectives. 
 - Participate in design and code reviews, providing constructive feedback on correctness, clarity, performance, security, test coverage, and long-term maintainability. 
 - Write and maintain useful design notes, implementation documentation, and troubleshooting guidance. Share findings so that investigations and engineering decisions benefit the wider team. 
 - Use internal documentation, specifications, and existing code resourcefully to understand unfamiliar areas. Ask focused questions, seek timely feedback, and help colleagues solve technical problems. 
 - As product expertise grows, provide technical guidance, mentor colleagues, and contribute to improvements in the team's development practices and engineering quality. 

AI-assisted engineering

- Use LLMs and AI coding agents to accelerate code exploration, problem analysis, implementation, test development, and documentation where they are useful. 
 - Critically review AI-generated suggestions and verify them against the actual codebase, requirements, and observed behavior. Validate changes through appropriate reviews and tests, and remain accountable for the correctness, security, performance, and maintainability of delivered software. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs. 

We're committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle. com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States. 

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans' status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

data.title: Staff Backend Engineer - Trust & Control Safety Systems
data.description:
About HighLevel: 

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes. 

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently. 

Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2. 5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability. 

Our people

With over 2, 000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home. 

Our impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1. 5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We're proud to be a part of that. 

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About The Team

Even a simple configuration error can lead to significant unintended usage. At HighLevel, we aim to build robust systems that protect our customers and the platform from accidental surges and intentional abuse alike. This team creates the intelligent safeguards that ensure our automation remains safe and reliable for everyone. 

We are looking for a Staff Engineer to architect the future of Trust, Controls & Safety. You will lead the technical direction of a real-time platform that secures critical workflows across HighLevel-including Signups, SaaS checkouts, User management, and global communication usage. This system processes 160M+ events and $4M+ in transactions daily, serving as the essential foundation for platform integrity. 

The challenge is to build a highly available, low-latency control plane that balances strict enforcement with a seamless user experience. By integrating synchronous metering with asynchronous signal correlation, you will help us stay ahead of evolving fraud vectors while ensuring that legitimate business activities, from new user signups to complex SaaS billing cycles, proceed without friction. 

As a Staff Engineer, you'll set the technical direction, own the hardest problems on the platform, mentor engineers across squads, and partner closely with EMs, PMs, Finance, Risk, Support and the channel teams. Getting this right means customers stop getting bills they didn't intend, and abuse stops being a cost the honest majority carries. 

Responsibilities

- Database architecture: Redesign and optimize data models, queries, and indexing strategies across MongoDB, Firestore, and ElasticSearch
 - Search at scale: Own ElasticSearch reliability - ingestion, indexing, shard strategy, and query performance for billions of documents
 - Reliability & performance: Eliminate bottlenecks, improve replication health, and enforce predictable query and index latency
 - System design: Define data flow and integration boundaries between storage, cache, and APIs with clear contracts and fault isolation
 - Observability: Build visibility into every data path - metrics, traces, slow query logs, replication lag, and cluster health dashboards
 - Testing & quality: Make testing non-negotiable - enforce unit, integration, and load testing standards across all backend modules
 - Engineering culture: Drive RFCs, ADRs, and design reviews that push clarity and precision. Codify patterns that make good engineering repeatable
 - Hands-on leadership: Write code, design systems, and debug production issues. Lead by technical example, not by delegation
 - Mentorship & influence: Level up engineers around you - reviews that teach, feedback that sticks, and systems that outlive individuals

Requirements

- Heavyweight Engineering Pedigree: 8+ years of experience building high-scale, mission-critical backend systems where p99 regressions are unacceptable. 
 - Distributed Systems Mastery: Deep expertise in concurrency, event-driven architectures, and consistency primitives (CAS, atomic dry-runs, idempotency). 
 - Financial Rigor: Experience with systems where code correctness has direct financial impact-metering, ledgers, or payment gateways. 
 - Operational Instinct: A track record of technical leadership through influence, driving architecture for multi-team platforms from design to production. 
 - Experience with systems where correctness has financial consequences - metering, ledgers, billing, reservations, or comparable transactional domains
 - Strong experience with relational and NoSQL data models (especially with complex transactional data), plus working knowledge of streaming and analytical stores for time-windowed aggregation
 - Experience designing policy- or rules-driven systems that change through configuration rather than deploys - versioning, safe rollout, and rollback of behavioural change
 - Sound judgement on the enforcement trade-off: how to set thresholds and actions that stop real harm without punishing legitimate customers, and how to measure whether you got it right
 - Familiarity with monitoring, SLOs, and root-cause analysis in production environments
 - Familiarity with hallucination mitigation strategies (e. g. , code constraints, test scaffolding, embeddings, context injection)
 - Track record of technical leadership without formal authority - driving cross-team architecture to a decision, writing designs others build from, and lifting the engineering standard around you
 - Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills, including with Finance, Risk and Support stakeholders
 - A pragmatic, hands-on engineer who balances long-term vision with iterative execution

Nice to Have

- Experience with ElasticSearch cluster management, multi-tenant indexing, or lifecycle policies
 - Familiarity with ClickHouse or other OLAP systems for analytics
 - Background in event-driven systems, data pipelines, or message brokers
 - Contributions to open-source or public technical writing on database performance or systems design

Preferred Experience

- Abuse & Fraud Expertise: Experience building rules engines, velocity checks, or adversarial defense systems at massive scale. 
 - Modern Data Stack: Hands-on with high-throughput tools like Go, Redis (Lua), ClickHouse, and Flink for real-time aggregation. 
 - Hyper-Growth Scaling: Experience navigating the transition from early architecture to load-bearing platform at scale. 
 - Exposure to stream processing at scale (Flink, Kafka Streams, Beam) and columnar analytical stores (ClickHouse, BigQuery) for real-time aggregation
 - Hands-on experience with Node. js and Go in production services, particularly on latency-sensitive or high-throughput paths
 - Experience working with AI Tools, Billing & Metered Systems
 - Contributions to open-source tools, internal platforms, or engineering blogs

data.title: Senior Software Engineer – Data Platform (Tech Lead)
data.description:
Company Description

Company Description

Continental develops pioneering technologies and services for sustainable and connected mobility of people and their goods. Founded in 1871, the technology company offers safe, efficient, intelligent, and affordable solutions for vehicles, machines, traffic and transportation. In 2023, Continental generated sales of €41. 4 billion and currently employs around 200, 000 people in 56 countries and markets. 

Guided by the vision of being the customer's first choice for material-driven solutions, the ContiTech group sector focuses on development competence and material expertise for products and systems made of rubber, plastics, metal, and fabrics. These can also be equipped with electronic components in order to optimize them functionally for individual services. ContiTech's industrial growth areas are primarily in the areas of energy, agriculture, construction, and surfaces. In addition, ContiTech serves the automotive and transportation industries as well as rail transport. 

The IT Digital and Data Services Competence Center of ContiTech caters to all the Business Areas in ContiTech and responsible among other on areas of Data & Analytics, Web and Mobile Software Development and AI

The team for Data services specializes in all platforms, business applications and products in the domain of data and analytics, covering the entire spectrum including AI, machine learning, data science, data analysis, reporting and dashboarding. 

Job Description

Job Description

▪ Own and govern the data ingestion and integration architecture for the enterprise data platform. 

▪ Define and evolve scalable, reusable, and production-grade data interfaces across all source systems and business domains. 

▪ Provide technical leadership and design authority for all data platform ingestion and integration components, ensuring engineering quality, scalability, and reliability. 

▪ Establish and enforce software engineering and architecture standards across data platform development (CI/CD, testing, observability, design patterns). 

▪ Act as the primary escalation point and technical authority for complex ingestion, integration, and data platform challenges. 

▪ Guide and support a distributed team of software engineers and data engineers in building production-grade ingestion services and platform components. 

▪ Collaborate closely with platform architecture, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and business IT teams to ensure secure, compliant, and sustainable system design. 

▪ Drive consistency and reuse across data platform patterns, frameworks, and engineering practices. 

Main Tasks: 

▪ Define and evolve ingestion frameworks for batch, streaming, API-based, and event-driven architectures. 

▪ Establish and govern standards for structured and unstructured data (JSON, CSV, XML), including schema evolution and compatibility strategies. 

▪ Design and review production-grade ingestion and integration patterns, ensuring fault tolerance, observability, and performance. 

▪ Define and enforce API design standards, reliability patterns, and contract management. 

▪ Lead design reviews for high-risk or complex ingestion pipelines, focusing on scalability, security, and maintainability. 

▪ Support engineers in implementing robust error handling, retry mechanisms, orchestration, and monitoring. 

▪ Collaborate with system owners to define interface specifications and integration strategies. 

▪ Align ingestion architecture with overall platform design, governance, and business requirements. 

▪ Enable ingestion patterns for advanced use cases, including data science, machine learning, and AI/LLM integrations. 

▪ Maintain and evolve reusable libraries, templates, and framework components to accelerate development. 

▪ Promote engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing strategies (unit, integration), and CI/CD pipelines. 

▪ Define and maintain architecture blueprints, design guidelines, and engineering standards. 

▪ Create reusable architecture patterns for lakehouse-based data platform. 

▪ Provide guidance on scalability strategies, resource utilization, and performance optimization. 

▪ Support cost transparency, usage optimization, and efficient resource consumption across the platform. 

Qualifications

Qualifications

Qualifications

▪ Degree in Computer Science or a related field. 

▪ 6-10 years of experience in software engineering and data platform development, with a focus on large-scale, enterprise-grade systems. 

▪ Proven track record of technical leadership and architectural ownership in distributed systems or data platforms. 

▪ Strong hands-on experience with Scala / Java and Python in a production software engineering environment. 

▪ Deep understanding of data integration patterns (APIs, CDC, streaming, event-driven architectures). 

▪ Experience designing and governing reusable frameworks, platform components, and engineering standards. 

▪ Strong knowledge of CI/CD, version control, automated testing, and observability practices. 

▪ Experience With Microsoft Azure Or Other Hyperscaler Environments. 

▪ Familiarity with lakehouse and data warehousing architectures; Databricks experience is a plus. 

▪ Ability to guide and mentor engineers while collaborating across global teams and stakeholders. 

NOT a Fit If Your Experience Is Primarily: 

▪ Notebook-based data processing (e. g. Jupyter, ad-hoc PySpark) without production deployment

▪ Dashboarding / analytics / BI tools

▪ SQL-only roles without software engineering experience

Job Title: Quality Assurance Team Leader (Associate I)

Location: Banglore - In-Office

Experience: 4-7 Years

Shift: Flexible (US Shift / India Overlap)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Role Summary

The Quality Assurance Team Leader is responsible for supporting quality assurance operations across assigned clients, programs, and service lines. This role serves as a subject matter expert and quality lead for a designated portfolio, ensuring audit accuracy, calibration consistency, reporting integrity, compliance with client requirements, and adherence to organizational quality standards. 

The Team Leader partners closely with Quality Management, Operations, Training, and client stakeholders to identify quality trends, mitigate risks, improve audit consistency, and drive continuous improvement initiatives. While this role does not have direct reports, it provides day-to-day guidance, mentorship, and quality leadership to Quality Auditors supporting assigned clients and programs. 

Duties and Key Responsibilities

- Serve as the primary quality lead for an assigned portfolio of clients, providing oversight and support to Quality Auditors aligned to those programs. 
 - Conduct audit validations and "audit-the-auditor" reviews to ensure audit accuracy, scoring consistency, and adherence to established quality methodologies. 
 - Review audit results, quality trends, performance data, and key metrics to identify risks, recurring errors, compliance concerns, and opportunities for improvement. 
 - Lead and facilitate calibration sessions with Quality Auditors, Operations, Training, and client stakeholders to ensure scoring consistency and alignment. 
 - Oversee quality reporting, dashboards, scorecards, and performance analyses for assigned clients, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and actionable insights. 
 - Partner with Quality Management and Operations leaders to develop remediation plans and targeted action plans addressing identified quality gaps and performance risks. 
 - Identify training needs and knowledge gaps through audit findings and performance trends, collaborating with Training teams to support development initiatives. 
 - Provide coaching, guidance, and quality-related support to Quality Auditors while promoting best practices and audit consistency across programs. 
 - Support quality governance activities, process standardization efforts, and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance quality outcomes, compliance, and operational effectiveness. 
 - Monitor compliance with client requirements, organizational policies, operational procedures, and established quality standards. 
 - Escalate significant quality risks, performance concerns, audit inconsistencies, and compliance issues to Quality Management with data-driven recommendations. 
 - Assist with new client implementations, process changes, quality program enhancements, and special projects as assigned. 

Required Skills & Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business, Finance, Revenue Cycle Management, or a related field. 
 - 4-7 years of healthcare Revenue Cycle Management experience. 
 - 2-4 years of quality assurance, auditing, quality leadership, or operational support experience. 
 - Experience conducting quality audits, audit validations, calibrations, root cause analysis, and performance trend analysis. 
 - Strong understanding of healthcare revenue cycle processes, operational workflows, client requirements, and quality assurance principles. 
 - Experience developing and maintaining quality dashboards, scorecards, and reporting. 
 - Ability to analyze performance data and translate findings into actionable recommendations that improve quality, compliance, and operational outcomes. 
 - Strong communication, collaboration, stakeholder management, and influencing skills. 
 - Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, reporting tools, and quality management systems. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, drive continuous improvement, and support quality governance initiatives. 
 - Strong attention to detail and commitment to operational excellence and customer service quality.

Associate

Country

India

Job Family Definition: 

The Cloud Developer builds from the ground up to meet the needs of mission-critical applications, and is always looking for innovative approaches to deliver end-to-end technical solutions to solve customer problems. 

Brings technical thinking to break down complex data and to engineer new ideas and methods for solving, prototyping, designing, and implementing cloud-based solutions.

Contributions have visible technical impact on a product or major subcomponent. Applies in-depth professional knowledge and innovative ideas to solve complex problems. Recognized internal authority on key technology area applying innovative principles and ideas. Provides technical leadership for significant project/program work. - Own end-to-end architecture and technical roadmap for data-intensive and AI-enabled enterprise applications.

 - Drive engineering best practices including TDD, code reviews, CI/CD, automation, and MLOps/LLMOps practices. 
 - Architect data platforms, APIs, microservices, distributed systems, and AI service integration patterns. 
 - Lead the design and operationalization of AI/ML solutions, including model deployment, monitoring, drift detection, and retraining strategies. 
 - Evaluate and implement Generative AI use cases such as LLM-powered assistants, RAG architectures, prompt orchestration, and agent-based workflows where relevant.

- 12+ years of software engineering experience.

 - Strong OOAD, design patterns, microservices, and distributed systems experience. 
 - Strong API design experience using REST, JSON/XML, Swagger, and Postman. 
 - Experience with PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle, and exposure to NoSQL databases. 
 - Experience with Linux/Unix, HTTP, caching, scalability, and performance optimization. 
 - Agile/Scrum, TDD, unit testing, and troubleshooting expertise. 
 - Strong understanding of AI/ML fundamentals, model lifecycle, feature engineering, and production deployment patterns. 
 - Hands-on experience with AI/ML frameworks and platforms such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, or equivalent. 
 - Experience building or integrating Generative AI solutions using LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases, and RAG patterns. 
 - Knowledge of MLOps/LLMOps practices including model versioning, evaluation, monitoring, experimentation, and governance. 
 - Ability to assess AI solution trade-offs across accuracy, latency, scalability, security, explainability, and cost. 
 - Effectively communicate product architectures, design proposals, and negotiate options at business unit and executive levels. 

Preferred Qualifications

- AWS and/or Azure/GCP cloud platforms. 
 - Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation). 
 - Monitoring, Observability, SRE, and Platform Engineering practices. 
 - Experience with AI platform services such as Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, or equivalent. 
 - Familiarity with vector databases, model serving and inference optimization. 
 - Knowledge of responsible AI, model governance, privacy, and security considerations for enterprise AI adoption.

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have - whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

Ascendion | Engineering to elevate life

 - Solve complex problems - and learn new skills
 - Experience the power of transforming digital engineering for Fortune 500 clients
 - Master your craft with leading training programs and hands-on experience

Experience a community of change makers! Join a culture of high-performing innovators with endless ideas and a passion for tech. Our culture is the fabric of our company, and it is what makes us unique and diverse. The way we share ideas, learning, experiences, successes, and joy allows everyone to be their best at Ascendion. 

About The Role

A hands-on player-coach. You write production code daily - designing ports, building adapters, reviewing every PR - and you own the architecture, set engineering standards, break the roadmap into work for three developers, and represent the team technically to Roche stakeholders. This is not a purely managerial or purely architectural seat: roughly 60% hands-on engineering, 40% technical leadership. 

Job Title: Technical Lead

Key Responsibilities

- 8+ years in software / data engineering, including 2+ years in a technical lead, staff, or architect capacity with direct responsibility for other engineers' output. 
 - Expert Python for production systems: OOP and abstract base classes, type hints, packaging, dependency management; comfortable authoring a library others build on. 
 - Proven software architecture experience with clean / hexagonal (ports & adapters) architecture, dependency injection, and interface-driven design - demonstrable on real systems, not just theory. 
 - Snowflake - hands-on production experience (databases/schemas, roles/warehouses, cloning, access model). 
 - AWS - hands-on production experience building and operating services on AWS. 
 - CI/CD with GitLab (or equivalent) - designing pipelines that build, test, and deploy. 
 - Infrastructure as Code with Terraform - authored and maintained real infrastructure. 
 - Secure secret management - hands-on experience keeping credentials/secrets out of code, logs, and state and sourcing them from a secrets backend (e. g. HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager / Parameter Store). 
 - Concept-level mastery (can explain how they work and design for them, independent of any specific vendor tool) of: data governance, data warehousing, data transformation, and data ingestion/ETL. 
 - Strong SQL (to design and validate backend/migration adapters - not for production data work). 
 - Professional working English and the communication skills to lead a distributed team and brief non-engineering stakeholders. 
 - Orchestrators beyond CI: Airflow / Dagster. 

Minimum Qualifications

Experience: 8+ years in software/data engineering, including 2+ years in a tech lead, staff, or architect role managing others. 

Tech Stack: Expert Python, strong SQL, AWS, Snowflake, Terraform, GitLab CI/CD, Airflow/Dagster, and secure secret management. 

Architecture & Skills: Proven hexagonal/clean architecture experience, strong data domain mastery, and fluent English communication for leadership. 

Location: Pune

data.title: Plant In - Charge Quality
data.description:
Job Purpose

To ensure quality assurance and quality control systems of concrete products. Promotion of VAC and optimization of mixes. 

Job Context & Major Challenges

The RMC Industry is highly fragmented and very competitive. As a major RMC player we face competition from other organized players and local players which makes superior service delivery along with quality products important for good margins. There is huge growth in infrastructure which opens up opportunities for setting up commercial and dedicated plants. The plant and its resources need to be cost effective with focus on maximizing capacity utilization. This makes it imperative for each plant to be efficient and profitable. The plant employees need to be focused and deliver high performance in each of their KRAs and accountabilities. 

Key Result Areas

KRA (Accountabilities) (Max 1325 Characters)Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)

KRA1 Business Development

Customer Feedback

- Conducting demos for VAC products to clients to help them understand their functionality
 - Resolve day to day customer grievances related to cracks, workability, slump control, pumping issues cube failures etc. and take corrective and preventive actions based on site feedback
 - Visit customer/ site periodically to gather feedback and identify areas of concern

KRA2 Customer Management

Maintenance Management

- Provide detailed mix design calculation, physical and chemical analysis of raw material to customer as and when required
 - Ensure the upkeep of the quality control labs with proper product display and availability of relevant BIS codes
 - Ensure calibration of instruments is done before due date

KRA3 MIS

- Conduct physical stock measurement and reconciliation
 - Maintain all the quality records on Labsys and update as per QCI and ISO. Maintain records related to calibration of all testing equipment

KRA4 Planning & Budgeting|

Product Development

- Prepare, consolidate and analyze Plant plan and budget
 - Generate mix and competitor data at plant level for further analysis
 - Arrive at the mix design as per customer's requirements

KRA5 Product Testing

- Conduct testing of cubes of concrete to check if they are as per the Quality Standards
 - Conduct statistical analysis of cubes strength results and monitoring performance of the products
 - Conduct trials for VAC Products to check various functional parameters
 - Check the quality of the raw material to ensure adherence to desired standards and specifications. Reject the material that does not match the required specifications
 - Collaborate with third party testing for the cubes as and when required
 - Undertake trials for performance/ dosage of different admixtures, other special materials and routine products to ensure quality parameters are met

KRA6 Production Execution

- Ensure VAC orders to each plant are executed in time and as per required specifications
 - Track the standard deviation of the produced batch to ensure quality of concrete is within permissible limits and take corrective measures
 - Ensure workability and cohesiveness of concrete at plant and at pouring site
 - Implement moisture corrections during production
 - Monitor the right dosage/ admixture at batching plants during production

data.title: SysDE I - Multimedia, Silicon and Systems Group
data.description:
Description

Are you passionate about display subsystems and kernel-level graphics frameworks that power millions of consumer devices? Join our team to work at the core of the Linux display stack, driving DRM/KMS framework development, V4L2 display driver integration, and kernel module development to deliver visually rich and high-fidelity experiences on cutting-edge devices. 

As a SysDE I on the Display Module team, you will own the development and integration of display kernel drivers built on the DRM/KMS framework, enabling features such as plane management, CRTC configuration, and atomic modesetting. You will work with V4L2 drivers for display pipeline processing, develop and extend kernel modules for display processing units, and drive HDR/SDR format conversion across the display pipeline, including support for 8-bit, 10-bit, and 12-bit color depth configurations to ensure accurate tone mapping and color fidelity on diverse panel types. 

You will also be responsible for bootsplash enablement, ensuring seamless visual output from early kernel initialization through kernel hand-off to the userspace display stack, delivering a flicker-free and visually consistent boot experience across product platforms. 

This summary shifts the focus from GPU/compositor work to the Display module domain, specifically emphasizing: 

DRM/KMS framework - plane management, CRTC, atomic modesetting

V4L2 driver - display pipeline processing

Kernel module development - DPU driver work

HDR/SDR conversion - tone mapping across the display pipeline

8/10/12-bit depth - color fidelity and panel support

Bootsplash - early kernel visual output through kernel hand-off

Key job responsibilities

- Own the development, integration, and bring-up of display kernel drivers built on the DRM/KMS framework across multiple product platforms, including CRTC configuration, plane management, connector setup, and atomic modesetting to ensure stable and performant display output
 - Develop and maintain V4L2-based display and video pipeline drivers, enabling hardware-accelerated video processing, format conversion, and display output routing through the kernel media subsystem
 - Design, implement, and extend Linux kernel modules for Display Processing Units (DPU), including driver architecture, power management hooks, interrupt handling, and device tree integration
 - Drive HDR/SDR format conversion and tone mapping across the display pipeline, ensuring accurate rendering of HDR10, HLG, and SDR content with proper metadata handling and color space transitions
 - Enable and validate support for 8-bit, 10-bit, and 12-bit color depth configurations across the display pipeline, ensuring correct pixel format negotiation, dithering strategies, and panel compatibility
 - Own bootsplash enablement and optimization, ensuring seamless visual output from early kernel initialization (bootloader framebuffer handoff) through kernel driver probe to userspace display stack handoff, delivering a flicker-free boot experience
 - Debug and root-cause complex display subsystem issues spanning DRM/KMS, V4L2, DPU firmware, panel timing, and color pipeline using kernel traces, DRM debug logs, and hardware diagnostic tools
 - Collaborate with SoC/silicon vendors on display IP bring-up, driver patch integration, and resolving vendor-specific display controller and panel driver defects
 - Develop and maintain automated test suites and CI validation frameworks for display subsystem regression, compliance testing, and color accuracy verification
 - Author and maintain technical documentation including display driver design specs, integration guides, boot sequence diagrams, and troubleshooting runbooks for the display subsystem

A day in the life

SoC/Silicon Vendor Teams for display IP bring-up, DRM/KMS driver patches, panel driver support, and DPU firmware integration

Video Pipeline Teams for V4L2 driver integration, media framework alignment, and end-to-end display output routing

BSP and Platform Teams for device tree configuration, kernel module integration, and boot sequence validation

Application and UI Framework Teams who consume the display output stack and depend on accurate color depth, HDR metadata, and panel timing

QA and Automation Teams for display compliance testing, color accuracy verification, and regression validation

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, computer engineering, or related field
 - Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting infrastructure
 - Experience with Linux/Unix
 - Hands-on experience with DRM/KMS framework including CRTC configuration, plane management, connector setup, and atomic modesetting

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes
 - Working knowledge of V4L2 driver framework for video and display pipeline integration
 - Understanding of HDR/SDR conversion formats and color space management including HDR10, HLG, and tone mapping concepts
 - Understanding of display color depth configurations across 8-bit, 10-bit, and 12-bit pipelines including pixel format negotiation and dithering
 - Familiarity with bootsplash enablement and early kernel framebuffer initialization through kernel hand-off to userspace display stack
 - Minimum 1 year of experience with Linux kernel display subsystem or embedded display driver development

data.description:
Company Overview

Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1. 5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people's lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign's Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM). 

What you'll do

Docusign's Mobile Engineering team is seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer (P4) to build and scale our Intelligent Agreement Management platform on Android. Docusign is moving beyond e-signatures to make agreements smarter, faster, and more connected across their entire lifecycle. Our team supports complex enterprise use cases while maintaining the world-class usability consumers expect from top Google Play Store applications. As a Senior Engineer, you will lead the technical design of major mobile features and reusable Android SDK modules using your deep Kotlin expertise. In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams while mentoring mid-level engineers to elevate the overall team. 

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to Senior Software Engineer. 

Responsibility

- Design, build, and maintain complex, high-performance native Android features and modular SDK components using Kotlin
 - Drive technical design discussions, author technical specification documents, and ensure codebase modularity, scalability, and maintainability
 - Set high standards for code quality through rigorous code reviews, unit and UI testing, and continuous integration practices
 - Collaborate with Product Managers, UX Designers, QA, and backend platform teams to translate product requirements into robust Android solutions
 - Guide and mentor mid-level and junior engineers, fostering technical growth and sharing best practices across the team
 - Identify bottlenecks in development workflows, Gradle build systems, or testing pipelines, and implement proactive solutions to improve velocity
 - Stay informed on Android platform developments, Kotlin language updates, and Material Design trends, incorporating modern tools and frameworks where appropriate

Job Designation

Hybrid: Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law. 

What you bring

Basic

- B. S. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
 - 7+ years of professional software engineering experience in cloud, SaaS, or enterprise software environments
 - 5+ years specifically building production native Android applications and reusable libraries in Kotlin backed by cloud APIs
 - Demonstrated experience applying modern Android architecture patterns (such as MVVM, Clean Architecture, or Jetpack components) and writing comprehensive unit and functional tests
 - Hands-on experience with Gradle, CI/CD automation, dependency management, and publishing apps to the Google Play Store or libraries to package repositories
 - Proven track record of delivering complex technical initiatives iteratively within an Agile team environment

Preferred

- Experience developing, packaging, and distributing developer-facing Android SDKs or binary libraries (AARs, Maven distribution)
 - Strong proficiency with modern Kotlin paradigms (such as Coroutines and Flow) alongside deep experience in Jetpack Compose and traditional layout architectures
 - Working knowledge of Java for maintaining and modernizing existing framework components
 - Experience with enterprise mobile security standards, including OAuth/SSO integration, secure storage, and data encryption
 - Active involvement in the Android community, such as tech blogging, open-source contributions, or conference speaking

Life at Docusign

Working here

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what's right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal. 

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you'll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live. 

Accommodation

Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign. com. 

If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign. com for assistance.

What you bring

data.title: SDET Engineer
data.description:
As a Senior SDET, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining robust automated test solutions for the company applications. The role requires strong software engineering and test automation skills, with hands-on experience developing automation frameworks, test tools, and automated test scenarios. You will work across applications, operating systems, and CI/CD environments, including Linux, to troubleshoot complex technical issues and ensure the quality, reliability, performance, and scalability of the product. You will contribute to the overall test automation strategy, continuously improve automation frameworks, and work closely with developers, testers, architects, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality software. Key Responsibilities • Design, develop, maintain, and enhance SDET-level test automation frameworks and tools for the E3D Design application. • Develop reliable, maintainable, and scalable automated tests using appropriate programming languages and automation technologies. • Analyze product requirements and technical specifications to identify comprehensive test scenarios and automation opportunities. • Build reusable automation components and utilities to improve test coverage, execution efficiency, and maintainability. • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and ensure reliable execution across supported environments. • Work hands-on with Linux operating systems, including installation/configuration, command-line utilities, shell scripting, process management, file systems, permissions, environment configuration, and troubleshooting. • Develop and execute automated tests in Linux-based environments and investigate issues related to application behaviour, dependencies, configuration, and system resources. • Strong knowledge of AI agents and agentic workflows, with the ability to translate testing requirements into scalable AI-driven automation solutions and identify opportunities to improve test coverage and efficiency. • Troubleshoot and debug automation failures and product issues across applications, framework, and operating-system layers. • Analyze logs, crash reports, test results, and system behaviour to identify root causes and work with development teams to resolve defects. • Contribute to improving test automation reliability by identifying and reducing flaky tests. • Participate in code reviews and follow software engineering best practices for automation code. • Collaborate closely with cross-functional and distributed teams to plan, execute, and deliver testing activities within agreed timelines. • Contribute to continuous improvement of testing processes, tools, frameworks, and engineering practices. 

Desired Experience • 8+ years of experience in software testing, test automation, SDET, or a related software engineering role within a product/project development environment. • Strong hands-on experience in software test automation and automation framework development, with the ability to write production-quality automation code. • Strong programming experience in C#, . NET, Python, or other relevant programming languages. • Hands-on experience working with Linux operating systems, including command-line operations, shell scripting, process management, file permissions, environment variables, package/dependency management, system troubleshooting, and log analysis. • Experience developing and maintaining automation frameworks for Desktop and Web applications and building comprehensive test scenarios and acceptance tests. • Good understanding of CI/CD practices and Azure DevOps, including automated test execution and integration of test automation into pipelines. • Experience with source control, code reviews, build systems, and software development practices. • Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, test design techniques, defect lifecycle, and risk-based test coverage. • Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments. • Ability to independently investigate complex technical problems, perform root-cause analysis, and collaborate with developers to resolve issues. • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, organizational, and prioritization skills. • Self-motivated, proactive, results-oriented, and comfortable working in a collaborative engineering environment. Great Skills to Have Software Engineering & Automation • Strong understanding of SDET principles and automation architecture. • Experience designing scalable, maintainable, and reusable automation frameworks. • Experience improving automation stability, execution time, coverage, and reliability. • Experience identifying opportunities to replace repetitive manual testing with automation. Linux & System Troubleshooting • Strong hands-on experience with Linux-based environments. • Comfortable using the Linux command line for application deployment, configuration, diagnostics, and troubleshooting. • Familiarity with emulators and compatibility layers in Linux environments, particularly Wine/Proton, including basic understanding of their architecture, configuration, and troubleshooting. • Experience with shell scripting and Linux utilities. • Ability to investigate application crashes, processes, permissions, environment configuration, dependencies, and system/resource issues. Quality & Problem Solving • Passion for delivering software that is reliable, performant, and scalable. • Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills, with the ability to investigate complex problems across application, automation, and operating-system layers. • Ability to analyze failures and identify root causes rather than simply reporting symptoms. 

Collaboration & Delivery • Effective communication and collaboration with developers, testers, product teams, and other stakeholders. • Strong ownership of deliverables, with the ability to work independently and make sound technical decisions. • Good time management, prioritization, and ability to work effectively in a fast-paced Agile environment.

data.title: Technology Lead
data.description:
Job Description

We are looking for a dynamic and technically versatile Technology Lead to spearhead the design, development, and delivery of enterprise-grade software solutions. The successful candidate will bring deep proficiency in both Python (Django) and Java (Spring Boot), paired with hands-on AWS cloud experience and a proven ability to lead, mentor, and grow high- performing engineering teams. As a Tech Lead, you will sit at the intersection of engineering excellence and people leadership. You will own the technical direction of one or more squads, drive architectural decisions, ensure code quality, and act as the primary liaison between engineering and product/business stakeholders. You are expected to lead by example, writing production-quality code while enabling those around you to do the same. The candidate will have responsibilities across the following functions: Technical Leadership and Architecture: - Own the end-to-end technical vision for assigned products or streams, driving design decisions from ideation through production. - Conduct architecture reviews and guide system design, API contracts, data modelling, and service boundaries. - Champion engineering best practices: clean code, SOLID principles, design patterns, comprehensive test coverage, and documentation. - Evaluate and introduce new technologies, frameworks, and tooling where they improve delivery speed, reliability, or maintainability. - Lead technical threat-modelling sessions and ensure non-functional requirements (performance, scalability, security) are embedded in every design. Python / Django Development: - Lead the development of back-end services, REST/GraphQL APIs, and data-processing pipelines using Python and Django. - Establish coding standards, review PRs, and maintain a high bar for Python code quality across the team. - Guide the team on Django ORM optimisation, DRF serialiser design, Celery task management, and secure session/auth patterns. - Oversee database migration strategies and ensure zero-downtime deployment of schema changes. Java / Spring Boot Development: - Architect and develop microservices and enterprise integrations using Java and Spring Boot. - Apply Spring ecosystem best practices: dependency injection, Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, Spring Cloud, and Actuator for observability. - Drive inter-service communication design (REST, gRPC, messaging via Kafka or RabbitMQ) and define service-level contracts. - Guide team members on Java concurrency, JVM tuning, and performance profiling. AWS Cloud and Infrastructure: - Define and oversee the cloud infrastructure strategy for team workloads on AWS. - Govern CI/CD pipelines, IaC (CloudFormation/Terraform), and deployment automation across environments. - Ensure secure, cost-optimised, and resilient architectures leveraging appropriate AWS managed services. - Act as the primary escalation point for production incidents, leading root-cause analysis and post-mortems. Team and Project Management: - Manage day-to-day delivery of sprint commitments, maintaining velocity and proactively surfacing risks. - Facilitate Agile ceremonies: sprint planning, standups, retrospectives, and continuously improve team processes. - Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through structured 1-on-1s, code reviews, and pairing sessions. - Collaborate with Product Managers, UX, QA, and DevOps to define roadmaps, estimate effort, and prioritise work. Requirements: - Overall Experience: Minimum 8 years. - At least 8 years of progressive, commercial software engineering experience, with a clear trajectory from individual contributor toward technical leadership. - Demonstrable history of owning and delivering complex, multi-tier applications in production environments with high availability and reliability requirements. - Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams, including active participation in or facilitation of ceremonies. - Track record of effective cross-functional collaboration across product, QA, design, and infrastructure teams. - Python and Django: minimum 5 years. - Candidates must demonstrate at least 5 years of production development using Python and Django: Python 3 x proficiency: async/await, type annotations, decorators, generators, context managers, and idiomatic Pythonic patterns. - Deep familiarity with the Django framework core: ORM complex querysets, annotations, window functions, prefetch_related / select_related, and bulk operations. - Middleware, signals, custom management commands, and the admin interface for internal tooling. - Authentication and authorisation patterns including Django's built-in auth, JWT, OAuth2 and session security hardening. - Extensive experience with Django REST Framework (DRF): serialisers (ModelSerializer, nested writable), viewsets, routers, permissions, throttling, and API versioning. - Asynchronous task processing with Celery + Redis or RabbitMQ: task routing, retry strategies, beat schedules, and monitoring with Flower. - Testing excellence: pytest, Django TestCase, factory_boy, pytest-django, coverage reporting, and integration/E2E test strategies. - Database expertise: PostgreSQL schema design, query optimisation (EXPLAIN ANALYZE), Django migrations at scale, and connection pooling (pgBouncer). - Caching strategies with Redis or Memcached: cache invalidation patterns, cache- aside, write-through in a Django context. - Django security best practices: CSRF, XSS, SQL injection prevention, secure cookie configuration, and rate limiting. Java and Spring Boot (minimum 5 years: - Candidates must demonstrate at least 5 years of production development using Java and Spring Boot. - Strong Java fundamentals: Java 11+ features (records, sealed classes, var), generics, streams/lambdas, concurrency utilities, and JVM internals (GC tuning, heap sizing). Spring Boot expertise: - Spring MVC / WebFlux for reactive and imperative REST APIs. - Spring Security OAuth2 resource servers, JWT validation, method-level security, and CORS configuration. - Spring Data JPA / Hibernate entity mapping, lazy loading strategies, query optimisation, and transaction management. - Spring Cloud Config Server, Service Discovery (Eureka), API Gateway, Circuit Breaker (Resilience4j). - Spring Actuator, Micrometre, and integration with observability platforms. - Microservices architecture: domain-driven design, bounded contexts, synchronous (REST/gRPC) and asynchronous (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS) communication patterns. - Containerisation of Java services: multi-stage Docker builds, JVM options for containers, and deployment on ECS or EKS. - Testing: JUnit 5 Mockito, Spring Boot Test, Testcontainers, WireMock, and contract testing with Spring Cloud Contract or Pact. - Build tooling: Maven or Gradle, dependency management, BOM usage, and multi- module project structures. AWS Cloud (minimum 2 years: - Candidates must demonstrate at least 2 years of practical experience on AWS: Compute: EC2 (auto-scaling, launch templates), ECS (Fargate/EC2), EKS, and Lambda for event-driven workloads. - Networking: VPC design (subnets, NACLs, security groups), ALB/NLB, API Gateway, CloudFront, Route 53 and VPC Endpoints / PrivateLink. - Storage and Data: S3 (lifecycle, versioning, signed URLs, event notifications), RDS/Aurora (PostgreSQL/MySQL), DynamoDB, ElastiCache, and SQS/SNS. - Security and Identity: IAM roles, permission boundaries, and least-privilege policies; AWS. - Secrets Manager; KMS for key management; AWS WAF. - Observability: CloudWatch Logs, Metrics, Alarms, Dashboards; AWS X-Ray for distributed tracing. Team and Project Management Minimum 2 Years: - Candidates must demonstrate at least 2 years in a team-lead, engineering-lead, or project-lead capacity: - Experience managing a team of engineers, including workload distribution, performance feedback, and career development conversations. - Delivery ownership: tracking sprint goals, managing scope changes, identifying blockers early, and communicating status to stakeholders. - Agile/Scrum facilitation: sprint planning, backlog refinement, retrospectives, and velocity tracking. - Stakeholder management: translating technical constraints and trade-offs into language accessible to non-technical business stakeholders. - Risk and dependency management: identifying technical debt, managing cross-team dependencies, and driving mitigations before they impact delivery. - Onboarding and knowledge transfer: creating structured onboarding plans for new joiners and building team documentation culture. Preferred Qualifications: - Exposure to LLM/Generative AI integrations: AWS Bedrock, LangChain, RAG pipelines, or vector databases. - Experience with observability platforms such as Datadog, New Relic, Grafana/Prometheus, or OpenTelemetry. - Knowledge of API security standards: OAuth 2. 0 OpenID Connect, mTLS. - Prior experience in a regulated industry (banking, insurance, healthcare) with knowledge of compliance frameworks (PCI-DSS, ISO 27001 SOC 2). Technical Skills Summary: Languages and Frameworks: - Primary: Python 3 x (Django, DRF, Celery), Java 11+ (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Security, Spring Data JPA). - Supporting: SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL), Bash scripting; JavaScript familiarity is a plus. - Databases and Caching Relational: PostgreSQL (primary), MySQL/MariaDB/Oracle. AWS Services: - Compute and Containers: EC2 ECS (Fargate), EKS, Lambda, Auto Scaling Groups. - Networking: VPC, ALB/NLB, API Gateway, CloudFront, Route 53 PrivateLink. - Storage and Messaging: S3 RDS/Aurora, ElastiCache, SQS, SNS, MSK. - Security: IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, WAF, Shield, AWS Config, Security Hub. - DevOps: CodePipeline, CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, ECR, CloudWatch, X-Ray. DevOps and Engineering Practices: - Containerisation: Docker (multi-stage builds), Kubernetes basics. - IaC: CloudFormation, Terraform. - CI/CD: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or AWS CodePipeline. - Version Control: Git, GitFlow or trunk-based development. - Code Quality: SonarQube, pre-commit hooks, linting (pylint, flake8 Checkstyle). Leadership and Behavioural Competencies: Engineering Leadership: - Ability to set a clear technical vision and rally a team around it without imposing unnecessary top-down constraints. - Comfortable making and defending architectural trade-off decisions under uncertainty and time pressure. - Strong instinct for identifying tech debt, prioritising its resolution, and communicating its business impact. People Development: - Proven track record of growing junior and mid-level engineers through mentoring, structured feedback, and stretch assignments. - Ability to identify individual strengths and align them to team needs and career goals. - Creates a psychologically safe environment where team members raise concerns and experiment without fear of blame. Communication and Stakeholder Management: - Excellent written and verbal communication to present a system design to engineers and summarise the same decision for a CTO or business sponsor. - Skilled in facilitating workshops, design reviews, and technical interviews. - Proactively shares knowledge, writes clear documentation, and encourages team-wide transparency. Delivery and Problem Solving: - Strong delivery mindset: comfortable balancing engineering quality with pragmatic trade- offs to meet business timelines. - Data-driven approach to performance issues, capacity planning, and technology choices. - Calm under pressure, leads incident response effectively, and instils a blameless post- mortem culture. Education: - Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline. - An equivalent combination of education and significant demonstrable professional experience will be considered. - Relevant professional certifications (AWS, Java, Python) are viewed favourably and may supplement formal qualifications. Who We Are. . .

Manager, Software Engineering(Full Stack), Java&Angular - Media Supply Chain

About Warner Bros. Discovery

Warner Bros. Discovery, a premier global media and entertainment company, offers audiences the world's most differentiated and complete portfolio of content, brands, and franchises across television, film, streaming, sports, and gaming. Our streaming portfolio includes leading brands such as HBOMax, Discovery+, CNN, Bleacher Report, and more. 

Meet Our Team

The team manages Warner Bros. Discovery's logical content inventory and descriptive metadata ecosystem. It owns the platforms, services, and workflows that create, enrich, govern, and maintain trusted program records across the content lifecycle, ensuring content is accurate, discoverable, and consistently used across enterprise systems. 

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a team responsible for some of WBD's most critical systems. This role combines technical leadership, operational excellence, and people management, with broad visibility across engineering, product, and business stakeholders. 

Roles & Responsibilities

People Leadership & Team Development

- Lead, coach, and grow a high-performing team of software engineers. 

- Foster a culture of ownership, technical excellence, and operational rigor. 

- Partner with engineering leadership on hiring, organizational planning, and talent development. 

- Set clear expectations and help engineers balance velocity, quality, and reliability. 

- Build an inclusive, collaborative environment where engineers can do their best work. 

Technical & Delivery Leadership

- Lead the development and continuous improvement of business-critical platforms and services that support enterprise content, metadata, and workflow management capabilities. 

- Drive the delivery of scalable, reliable, and high-performance solutions that enable efficient management, governance, and discovery of critical business information. 

- Ensure services are highly available, resilient, secure, and cost-effective while maintaining operational excellence and strong engineering practices. 

- Define and execute technical strategy, architecture direction, and roadmap priorities, balancing short-term business needs with long-term platform evolution. 

- Partner with product, operations and other engineering stakeholders to deliver impactful capabilities that improve efficiency, automation, data quality, and user experience. 

- Foster a culture of engineering excellence through technical leadership, mentoring, process improvement, and adoption of modern development practices and technologies. 

- Drive planning, execution, and delivery across multiple initiatives, ensuring alignment with organizational goals, quality standards, and customer outcomes. 

Product & Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Partner with Product Management to define roadmaps and priorities for content and observability capabilities. 

- Collaborate with engineering, and business stakeholders to deliver trusted metrics and actionable insights. 

- Drive alignment across teams to execute complex, cross-functional initiatives. 

- Act as an advocate for internal customers, treating data and observability capabilities as products. 

- Communicate technical strategy, risks, and progress effectively to leadership and stakeholders. 

What to Bring

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). 

- 12-15 years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years leading and developing high-performing engineering teams. 

- Strong technical foundation in cloud-native applications, microservices, APIs, and distributed systems, with experience defining architecture, driving technical strategy, and guiding engineering teams. Experience in Java/Spring Boot, Angular, AWS, relational and non-relational databases, event-driven architectures, and modern CI/CD practices

- Proven track record of delivering scalable, reliable, and business-critical platforms while balancing engineering excellence, operational efficiency, and business priorities. 

- Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and partnering effectively with Product, Business, Operations, Data, and Engineering stakeholders to deliver strategic outcomes. 

- Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and coaching skills, with the ability to build high-performing teams and foster a culture of ownership, innovation, and continuous improvement. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with graph databases, metadata management platforms, or large-scale content and asset management systems

- Experience leading platform modernization, technology transformation, or consolidation initiatives involving multiple legacy systems and data sources into a unified platform. 

- Experience supporting enterprise-scale platforms with complex data, governance, workflow, and operational requirements. 

- Experience in media, content management, digital asset management, streaming, or other large-scale digital platforms.
