Title: AI/GenAI- Manager

Educational qualification: BTech/Masters/PhD

The opportunity

We are seeking an experienced GenAI Manager with 10+ years of overall experience, including significant hands-on expertise in Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG architectures, Conversational AI, and enterprise AI platforms. The ideal candidate will lead the design, delivery, governance, and scaling of AI solutions while managing cross-functional teams of AI engineers, data scientists, architects, and business stakeholders. 

The role requires a strong blend of technical leadership, solution architecture, AI strategy, delivery management, and stakeholder engagement to drive enterprise-wide adoption of GenAI capabilities. The candidate should have proven experience delivering AI-powered solutions such as RAG applications, AI agents, copilots, knowledge management platforms, AI automation workflows, and multi-agent systems, while ensuring Responsible AI, quality, security, and scalability standards are met. 

The individual will lead AI quality, validation, and governance initiatives to ensure the reliability, security, performance, and scalability of enterprise AI and GenAI solutions while partnering with technical and business teams. 

Important: Hands-on experience delivering AI solutions in enterprise or production environments is required. Certifications, personal projects, and demos alone are not sufficient. 

Application Guidance: Candidates should be able to explain at least two AI/GenAI implementations, including the business use case, their contribution, technical approach, and measurable outcomes. 

Your Key Responsibilities

- Lead the design, development, and delivery of enterprise AI, GenAI, Agentic AI, and RAG-based solutions aligned with business objectives. 
 - Define AI strategy, roadmaps, governance frameworks, and operating models to enable scalable AI adoption across the organization. 
 - Drive the architecture and implementation of AI platforms, copilots, multi-agent systems, conversational AI solutions, and intelligent automation initiatives. 
 - Collaborate with business stakeholders to identify high-value AI use cases, establish success metrics, and realize business value. 
 - Oversee the end-to-end AI solution lifecycle, including ideation, architecture, development, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. 
 - Lead and mentor cross-functional teams of AI engineers, data scientists, architects, and developers, fostering innovation and delivery excellence. 
 - Establish best practices for Responsible AI, security, privacy, compliance, and risk management across AI implementations. 
 - Drive adoption of enterprise AI capabilities leveraging Azure AI Foundry, OpenAI, Databricks, vector databases, and modern AI frameworks. 
 - Ensure AI solutions are scalable, reliable, secure, and aligned with enterprise architecture and governance standards. 
 - Partner with engineering and business teams to define evaluation frameworks, quality standards, and performance metrics for AI systems. 
 - Guide the implementation of RAG architectures, knowledge management solutions, and agentic workflows to enhance business productivity and decision-making. 
 - Manage stakeholder communication, executive reporting, budgeting, resource planning, and delivery governance for AI programs. 
 - Stay current with emerging trends in GenAI, Agentic AI, multimodal AI, AI agents, and enterprise AI platforms to drive innovation and competitive advantage. 
 - Contribute to capability building, reusable accelerators, reference architectures, and thought leadership across the AI practice. 

Skills and Attributes: 

Professional Experience

- 10+ years of overall experience, including 5+ years leading AI/ML, GenAI, or data-driven transformation initiatives in enterprise environments. 
 - Proven experience delivering and scaling production-grade AI, GenAI, Agentic AI, Copilot, and RAG-based solutions from concept through deployment and adoption. 
 - Strong understanding of enterprise AI architecture and hands-on exposure to multiple areas, including: 
 - LLM and GenAI application development
 - RAG architectures and knowledge management solutions
 - Agentic AI and multi-agent systems
 - Conversational AI and Copilot solutions
 - AI evaluation, governance, and Responsible AI
 - AI platform engineering and cloud-based deployments
 - MLOps / LLMOps and operationalization of AI solutions
 - Data engineering, vector databases, and retrieval pipelines
 - Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams of AI engineers, architects, data scientists, and developers. 
 - Strong stakeholder management skills with experience translating business needs into scalable AI solutions and measurable business outcomes. 
 - Experience with enterprise AI platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, OpenAI, Databricks, Microsoft Copilot, and related AI ecosystems. 

Educational Background

- Bachelor's/master's degree in computer science, Data Science, Engineering, or related field. 

Technical Skills

- Strong understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, Agentic AI, Multi-Agent Systems, and RAG architectures. 
 - Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale GenAI, Copilot, Conversational AI, and AI Agent solutions. 
 - Experience defining AI strategy, solution roadmaps, architecture standards, and operating models. 
 - Strong knowledge of AI platform ecosystems including Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Databricks, Vector Databases, and Enterprise Search platforms. 
 - Experience leading the design and implementation of RAG pipelines, knowledge management solutions, and AI-powered business applications. 
 - Understanding of AI evaluation, guardrails, observability, quality metrics, and Responsible AI practices. 
 - Experience establishing governance frameworks covering AI security, privacy, compliance, safety, and risk management. 
 - Strong knowledge of prompt engineering, agent orchestration frameworks, tool integrations, and workflow automation. 
 - Experience managing the end-to-end AI lifecycle, including ideation, development, deployment, monitoring, and adoption. 
 - Proven ability to lead and mentor AI engineers, architects, data scientists, and cross-functional delivery teams. 
 - Experience integrating AI solutions with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, cloud platforms, and business processes. 
 - Strong understanding of MLOps, LLMOps, model monitoring, performance optimization, and operationalization of AI solutions. 
 - Ability to work with executive stakeholders to identify AI opportunities, define business value, and drive adoption. 
 - Experience with enterprise architecture, software engineering best practices, scalability, reliability, and secure solution design. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, stakeholder management, and communication skills. 

Soft Skills

- Excellent problem-solving and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to translate AI capabilities into measurable business outcomes and enterprise value. 
 - Strong communication, stakeholder management, and executive presentation skills, with the ability to influence both technical and business audiences. 

Other Responsibilities: 

- Lead the delivery of enterprise GenAI, Agentic AI, and RAG solutions, from ideation through deployment and business adoption. 
 - Define AI strategy, solution roadmaps, governance frameworks, and best practices to drive scalable AI adoption. 
 - Partner with business and technology stakeholders to identify opportunities, prioritize use cases, and deliver measurable business value. 
 - Mentor and lead cross-functional teams of AI engineers, architects, and data scientists, ensuring delivery excellence and innovation. 
 - Drive AI governance, Responsible AI, security, compliance, and operational readiness across all AI initiatives. 

Why Join Us

- Be at the forefront of AI-driven innovation across multiple client sectors. 
 - Work with global clients to drive real business impact. 
 - Collaborate with a team of AI experts, analytics leaders, and industry specialists in a highly entrepreneurial environment. 

What We Offer

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We'll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career. 

- Continuous learning: You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next. 
 - Success as defined by you: We'll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way. 
 - Transformative leadership: We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs. 
 - Diverse and inclusive culture: You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs. 

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

You will define both macro and micro level architecture and implement with engineering teams to modernize a VC++ platform into Reacts JS/Java based event based high throughput, low latency micro services based platform, ensuring alignment with cloud-native principles. 

Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Platform Design

- Define and evolve the architecture for a distributed, cloud-native Investment Accounting platform, aligned with enterprise principles (scalability, resiliency, availability). 
 - Design modular microservices architectures, ensuring clear service boundaries, domain-driven design, and reusability across business capabilities. 
 - Establish event-driven architecture patterns for real-time processing, enabling decoupled and scalable workflows. 
 - Define data architecture and integration patterns, including unified data models, event contracts, and consistency strategies across IBOR/ABOR domains. 
 - Hands on experience and capability to walk the talk is critical. This is not architecture only role. 

Modernization Leadership (VC++ → Java)

- Lead the modernization of legacy VC++ systems into Java-based, distributed services
 - Define migration patterns, decomposition strategies, and phased transformation roadmaps
 - Ensure functional equivalence where required, while enabling architectural evolution beyond legacy constraints
 - Guide teams on translating low-level C++ constructs into scalable Java service patterns (stateless services, async processing, etc. )

Performance, Throughput & Scalability

- Architect systems for high-throughput transaction processing and near real-time accounting workflows
 - Define cache-driven design strategies (distributed caching, in-memory processing, read/write optimization)
 - Establish performance benchmarks, scalability patterns, and capacity planning principles

Cloud-Native & Engineering

- Design and implement for cloud-native (containerization, orchestration, DevSecOps). 
 - Establish cross-cutting capabilities: 
 - Observability (logging, metrics, tracing) for operational intelligence
 - Resiliency patterns (retry, circuit breaker, idempotency)
 - Security and compliance controls
 - Ensure API-first and contract-first design principles are adhered to. 

Required Qualifications

- Extensive experience in software architecture and distributed systems design
 - Strong programming background in VC++ and Java, with proven experience in system modernization. 
 - Rich experience with AWS/Azure along with modern CICD platforms and pipeline as code. 
 - Deep expertise in: 
 - Event-driven architectures
 - Microservices and domain-driven design
 - High-performance and low-latency systems
 - Experience building large-scale distributed systems with low latency and high throughput
 - Strong understanding of data consistency, transaction processing, and accounting-like systems

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in Investment Accounting / Financial Services platforms (transactions, valuations, positions, multi-currency processing)
 - Familiarity with: 
 - Observability and operational intelligence frameworks
 - Unified data models and ledger-based architectures
 - Experience working in regulatory and audit-heavy environments (traceability, reconciliation. 

About State Street

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success. 

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. data.title: Lead Engineer mbedded SW Development
data.description:
Job Description Summary

As a Lead Engineer - Embedded SW Development (LPB2), you will be a technical cornerstone in the development and evolution of the MarkVIe control platform. Operating within a global, cross-functional environment, you will drive the design, implementation, and optimization of firmware for state-of-the-art power generation control systems. You will provide technical leadership, mentorship, and architectural guidance to ensure the reliability and performance of embedded software - all while embodying the GE Vernova Way through a relentless focus on safety, integrity, customer impact, and continuous learning. 

Job Description

Essential Responsibilities

- Technical Leadership: Translate high-level system requirements into robust firmware architectures and low-level design specifications. 
 - Full-Cycle Development: Lead the design, coding, testing, and debugging of mission-critical system software for the MarkVIe platform. 
 - Performance Optimization: Analyze and enhance the efficiency, stability, and scalability of system resources to meet stringent power generation requirements. 
 - Validation & Integration: Integrate new product designs and collaborate with firmware test teams to develop, perform, and oversee formal design verification and validation (V&V) plans. 
 - Quality Assurance: Lead high-quality technical reviews, including detailed design, source code, unit test frameworks, and requirement documentation. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as a primary interface between hardware design, systems engineering, and product teams. 
 - Continuous Improvement: Champion automated unit and regression testing initiatives; foster a culture of continuous improvement in both product quality and development processes. 
 - Lifecycle Management: Manage software throughout the entire product development lifecycle, from project initiation and design to release and long-term maintenance. 
 - Assessment: Evaluate and integrate third-party and open-source software components while maintaining compliance with cybersecurity standards. 

Qualifications/Requirements

- Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Experience: 6-9 years of professional experience in embedded software programming, with a demonstrated ability to perform hands-on development and complex troubleshooting on embedded targets. 
 - Technical Proficiency: 
 - Advanced C/C++ programming skills. 
 - In-depth understanding of microprocessor architectures. 
 - Hands-on experience with preemptive, multitasking Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS), with a strong preference for QNX. 
 - Methodologies: Proven experience in Agile development environments and automated unit testing for C/C++. 
 - Toolsets: Proficiency in software configuration management tools, defect tracking systems, and peer-review processes. 
 - Communication: Excellent interpersonal skills with a proven track record of working effectively in global, multi-functional teams. 
Desired Characteristics

- Domain Expertise: Direct experience with MarkVIe control systems firmware development. 
 - Protocol Knowledge: Experience working with industrial communication protocols (e. g. , MODBUS, Profibus, Profinet, Foundation Fieldbus, CAN, Industrial Ethernet). 
 - Security Mindset: Knowledge of secure software design and cybersecurity practices for industrial control systems. 
 - Leadership: Demonstrated experience leading global programs and mentoring junior engineers. 
 - Versatility: Exposure to C# development for tooling or utility applications is a strong plus. 
 - Initiative: A self-starter mindset with the ability to navigate complex, cross-functional technical challenges autonomously. 

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

data.title: Senior Staff Agentic AI Engineer
data.description:
About the Team

At Equinix Incubation, we build and scale the next generation of platforms that transform how technology is delivered across the enterprise. Incubation is not a project team with a fixed end date. It is a long-term innovation capability where products evolve, but the mission remains the same: identify game-changing opportunities, validate them, and scale them into business-critical platforms. 

Our current focus is GravityX, Equinix's agentic delivery platform. GravityX orchestrates specialized AI agents across the software delivery lifecycle, from intake and planning to design, development, testing, release, and value tracking. Human oversight remains central, ensuring that AI accelerates delivery while engineers maintain accountability, quality, governance, and trust. 

As part of this team, you'll work at the intersection of AI, software engineering, developer platforms, and enterprise technology, helping define how AI-first engineering operates at global scale. 

About the Role

We are seeking Senior Staff Engineer to help build GravityX and the AI agents that power it. 

This role goes beyond using AI to increase developer productivity. You will design, build, evaluate, and operate production-grade AI agents that perform real software delivery work and are trusted by engineering teams across the organization. 

You will: 

- Build LLM-powered agents that support requirements, design, coding, testing, release, and operations. 
 - Develop agent orchestration capabilities, tool integrations, and multi-agent workflows. 
 - Design evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and governance controls that make AI systems reliable and trustworthy. 
 - Build retrieval and knowledge systems that provide agents with the context they need to perform effectively. 
 - Contribute to platform capabilities including orchestration, observability, auditability, and human-in-the-loop controls. 
 - Drive engineering excellence through strong architecture, testing, automation, and operational practices. 

For Senior Staff Engineers, the role also includes defining standards, influencing platform direction, solving highly ambiguous technical challenges, and mentoring engineers across teams. 

About You

You are an experienced software engineer with a passion for building intelligent systems and solving complex problems at scale. You combine strong engineering fundamentals with a practical understanding of how AI can be applied responsibly in enterprise environments. 

We're looking for someone who has: 

- 6+ years of professional software engineering experience. 
 - Hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications, AI agents, retrieval systems, tool-calling architectures, or multi-agent workflows. 
 - Strong proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript. 
 - Experience building APIs, microservices, cloud-native applications, and event-driven systems. 
 - A strong testing mindset and an interest in designing evaluation frameworks for AI systems. 
 - Experience with modern engineering practices including Git, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and production operations. 
 - Sound judgment about when automation should act independently and when human oversight is required. 
 - Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and business audiences. 
 - Experience with technologies such as MCP, A2A, LangGraph, OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, Vertex AI, Jira, GitHub, ServiceNow, retrieval systems, embeddings, and enterprise AI governance is highly desirable.

- Responsible for independently delivering Java-based backend features and database integrations, while contributing to design, performance optimization, and continuous improvement efforts. 

Our Current Technical Environment

- Software: Java 8, Oracle Sql, any Sql Database, Basic understanding of OOPs, Design patterns, Basic Front end understanding, basic understanding of Data Structures, javascript/react js, Node js. , Python
 - Application Architecture: Service Networking Overlay, aiming for a single, cloud-agnostic architecture that simplifies policy management across public/private clouds via components like service meshes, API gateways, and centralized control planes, allowing consistent security and traffic flow (like a modern microservices approach), differing from simple client-server models by abstracting network complexity. 
 - Cloud Architecture: ** Cloud-Agnostic: ** Runs consistently across different cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP) and on-premise. 
 - Frameworks/Others: Good to know Hibernate and Spring framework. 

What You'll Do

- Design, develop, and maintain backend services and APIs using Java and if needed frameworks such as Spring/Spring Boot. 
 - Write clean, efficient, and secure code while following coding standards and best practices. 
 - Develop and optimize database schemas, queries, and transactions using relational databases (e. g. , Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL). 
 - Participate in system design discussions and contribute to improving scalability, performance, and reliability. 
 - Review code, provide constructive feedback, and mentor junior developers when needed. 
 - Troubleshoot production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement preventive fixes. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions. 
 - Apply automated testing, CI/CD practices, and version control to ensure high-quality deliveries. 
 - Stay current with emerging technologies, including cloud-native development and AI-driven engineering practices, and identify opportunities to apply them. 

What We Are Looking For

- Education: BE/ME or B Tech/M Tech in Computer Science, MCS or MCA in Computer Science, Supply Chain
 - Years of Experience: 6 to 8 years
 - Ready to work from Pune office
 - Strong analytical problem-solving skills
 - Strong Object-Oriented Programming Skills. 
 - Good understanding of data structures and algorithms. 
 - Extensive knowledge of the Java programming language
 - Experience with relational databases (preferably Oracle) and Object/Relational frameworks. 
 - Should be able to write SQL queries, procedures, triggers and do performance tuning. 
 - Functional knowledge of supply chain management domain. 
 - Prior experience in development or consulting with an enterprise software vendor - preferably in supply chain planning or forecasting area. 
 - Experience with enterprise integration patterns & protocols, including SOAP, REST, EDI is a plus. 
 - Capable of building web interfaces using JavaScript, HTML and CSS. 
 - Experience with newer web client technologies such as ReactJS preferred. 
 - Systems implementation skills: requirements/process analysis, conceptual and detailed design, configuration, testing, training, support
 - Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP) and containerization is a plus. 
 - Curiosity and willingness to learn emerging technologies, especially AI/ML concepts and intelligent automation. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills, ownership mindset, and effective collaboration and communication abilities. 

Our Values

If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success - and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
Arm is redefining what is possible in cloud and data center computing. Our Neoverse platforms are helping power a new era of infrastructure - combining advanced silicon with the system software required to turn ambitious technology into production-ready solutions. 

Are you excited by solving complex system-level problems, leading engineers and ensuring sophisticated SoC platforms are ready for production?

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer in the infrastructure solutions software team in our CE-SW group. This role combines hands-on technical leadership with responsibility for leading and developing a local engineering team. The focus will be on driving the validation and productisation of our infrastructure platforms, with strong collaboration across software engineering, quality, test and release functions. 

Come and make an impact at scale!

Responsibilities

You will: 

- Lead and develop a team of software engineers at your site, providing technical direction, coaching and career development while remaining hands-on in solving complex engineering challenges. 
 - Drive system validation and productisation for Infrastructure System Solutions, establishing effective validation plans, quality criteria and approaches to product readiness. 
 - Advance scalable test infrastructure, CI, regression capabilities and quality metrics to improve coverage, efficiency and confidence throughout the development lifecycle. 
 - Collaborate across Arm locations and engineering teams to manage dependencies, resolve complex system-level issues and drive effective execution across pre-silicon and silicon environments. 

Required Skills And Experience

- Strong experience in testing complex system software, with a technical background in SoC, firmware, platform software or system-level validation across pre-silicon and/or silicon environments. 
 - Proven experience leading and developing software engineers, combining line management with strong hands-on technical leadership. 
 - Strong knowledge of software quality, validation methodologies, automated testing, CI and product readiness for complex systems. 
 - Excellent technical judgement, problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering teams and geographical locations. 

"Nice To Have" Skills And Experience

- Knowledge of server-class SoCs, including RAS, power management, PCI Express (PCIe), Compute Express Link (CXL), memory and virtualization. 
 - Familiarity with the Linux kernel, Trusted Firmware-A (TF-A), UEFI EDK II, OpenBMC or Kernel-based Virtual Machine (KVM). 
 - Experience with automated system validation, hardware test environments, server farms or continuous integration infrastructure. 

In Return

At Arm, we're shaping the future of infrastructure computing and turning advanced technology into production-ready solutions. This role offers the scope to influence our products, engineering practices and teams while contributing to some of our most sophisticated platforms. 

Join us and help shape world-class infrastructure technology at Arm!

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. 

Accommodations at Arm

At Arm, we want to build extraordinary teams. If you need an adjustment or an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email accommodations@arm. com . To note, by sending us the requested information, you consent to its use by Arm to arrange for appropriate accommodations. All accommodation or adjustment requests will be treated with confidentiality, and information concerning these requests will only be disclosed as necessary to provide the accommodation. Although this is not an exhaustive list, examples of support include breaks between interviews, having documents read aloud, or office accessibility. Please email us about anything we can do to accommodate you during the recruitment process. 

Hybrid Working at Arm

Arm's approach to hybrid working is designed to create a working environment that supports both high performance and personal wellbeing. We believe in bringing people together face to face to enable us to work at pace, whilst recognizing the value of flexibility. Within that framework, we empower groups/teams to determine their own hybrid working patterns, depending on the work and the team's needs. Details of what this means for each role will be shared upon application. In some cases, the flexibility we can offer is limited by local legal, regulatory, tax, or other considerations, and where this is the case, we will collaborate with you to find the best solution. Please talk to us to find out more about what this could look like for you. 

Equal Opportunities at Arm

Arm is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal opportunities are available to all applicants and colleagues. We are a diverse organization of dedicated and innovative individuals, and don't discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

 - Opportunity to drive modern QA practices, continuous improvement, and measurable quality outcomes.

- 7+ years' experience in Software Testing / Quality Engineering with experience in managing end-to-end project delivery.

 - Strong understanding of STLC, SDLC, Agile, test strategy, test planning, risk management, defect management and quality metrics.

 - Opportunity to drive modern QA practices, continuous improvement, and measurable quality outcomes.

What makes you stand out?

 - Understanding of RAG architecture, embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, retrieval and reranking. 
 - Experience with Generative AI, LLM evaluation, prompt engineering, AI agents and AI safety testing.

 - Strong understanding of AI quality and security risks including prompt injection, jailbreaks, hallucination, data leakage, guardrails and responsible AI. 
 - Experience with modern DevOps and test automation practices, including Git, GitHub, GitHub Actions and CI/CD pipeline integration. 
 - Strong communication, stakeholder management, analytical and people leadership skills. 

Why join our team:

data.title: Principal Cloud Engineer - AWS
data.description:
At MiniMed, you can begin a lifelong career of exploration and innovation, while helping make a difference in the lives of people living with diabetes around the globe. You'll lead with purpose, breaking down barriers to innovation for a more connected, compassionate world. 

About The Role

The Cloud Engineer designs, builds, and operates core cloud platform capabilities with a primary focus on AWS, while supporting Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) where required. This role is responsible for delivering standardized, automated, and reusable cloud foundations-such as account provisioning, identity integration, networking baselines, and deployment pipelines-that enable application teams to move quickly without compromising security, governance, or reliability. 

The Cloud Engineer works closely with Cloud Engineering, Architecture, Security, and Operations to translate architectural standards into durable platform services. The emphasis is on automation-first delivery, infrastructure-as-code, and building platforms that scale through consistency rather than manual effort. 

#BetterDaysStartNow

Principal Cloud Engineer

The Cloud Engineer designs, builds, and operates core cloud platform capabilities with a primary focus on AWS, while supporting Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) where required. This role is responsible for delivering standardized, automated, and reusable cloud foundations-such as account provisioning, identity integration, networking baselines, and deployment pipelines-that enable application teams to move quickly without compromising security, governance, or reliability. 

The Cloud Engineer works closely with Cloud Engineering, Architecture, Security, and Operations to translate architectural standards into durable platform services. The emphasis is on automation-first delivery, infrastructure-as-code, and building platforms that scale through consistency rather than manual effort. 

Cloud Engineering & Delivery

- Design, engineer, and operate foundational cloud services primarily on AWS, with support for Azure and GCP as part of a multi-cloud strategy. 
 - Build and maintain standardized platform components including account provisioning, identity and access integration, networking foundations, and shared services. 
 - Translate architectural standards and guardrails into reusable, production-grade platform implementations. 

Infrastructure as Code & Automation

- Develop and manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform to ensure repeatable, auditable, and version-controlled deployments. 
 - Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub and GitHub Actions to support platform automation and safe change delivery. 
 - Reduce manual effort and operational toil through automation and self-service patterns. 

Observability & Reliability

- Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, and alerting standards for platform services using native cloud tooling and approved third-party observability platforms. 
 - Partner with SRE and Operations teams to improve reliability, resilience, and recovery of platform components. 
 - Participate in incident response and post-incident reviews for platform-related services, driving corrective and preventative improvements. 

Security, Governance & Compliance Enablement

- Partner with Architecture, Security, and Governance teams to enforce identity, access, tagging, and compliance guardrails across cloud environments. 
 - Ensure platform services are secure-by-default, auditable, and aligned with regulatory and enterprise standards. 
 - Support policy-as-code and guardrail automation where applicable. 

Documentation & Enablement

- Contribute to platform blueprints, reference architectures, and technical documentation. 
 - Publish clear guidance and patterns that enable application teams to consume platform services consistently. 
 - Share knowledge and best practices across the engineering organization. 

Minimum Qualifications

- 8+ years of experience in cloud engineering, Cloud Engineering, or DevOps roles. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with AWS; exposure to Azure and/or GCP strongly preferred. 
 - Proven proficiency with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform. 
 - Hands-on experience building CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or similar tooling. 
 - Solid understanding of core cloud services including IAM, networking, compute, storage, and monitoring. 
 - Experience with container platforms and orchestration (e. g. , ECS, EKS, AKS, or GKE). 
 - Ability to work effectively in an Agile environment and collaborate across engineering, security, and operations teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience supporting multi-cloud or hybrid cloud environments. 
 - Familiarity with cloud governance constructs such as AWS Organizations and Control Tower, Azure management groups and policies, or GCP projects and folders. 
 - Exposure to FinOps practices, cost optimization techniques, or automated remediation tooling. 
 - Relevant certifications such as AWS Solutions Architect (Associate or Professional), Azure Solutions Architect, or Google Professional Cloud Engineer. 
 - Strong written communication skills with the ability to produce clear technical documentation and platform standards. 

What Success Looks Like

- Platform services are reliable, repeatable, and consumed broadly by application teams. 
 - Cloud environments launch with consistent security, networking, and governance baselines. 
 - Manual effort decreases as automation and self-service increase. 
 - Platform standards are implemented in code, not enforced through meetings. 
 - Application teams can move faster because the platform "just works. "

Physical Job Requirements

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position. 

Benefits & Compensation

MiniMed offers a competitive salary and flexible benefits package

At MiniMed, we put people first. A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values: We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every stage of your career and life. 

About MiniMed

We want to make every day a better day for people living with diabetes. Our team of creative innovators around the globe share a passion for finding the simplest solutions to the problems that people with diabetes face on a daily basis. For more than 40 years, we've been redefining what's possible, from intelligent dosing systems designed for real life to predictive insights that stay a step ahead, and we're dedicated to continuing to support our customers through every step of their journey - meeting them where and how they need it.

data.description:
Role And Responsibilities

We are looking for a Quality Engineering Lead to join our Team at MMC. 

Your Experience

A visionary forward thinker who views quality holistically andcan drive a quality engineering ethos throughout the POD. Understandingindustry trends around tools, methods, and practice - implementing where possible. You must be a team player who can work across many teams to establish shift left quality and test automation approach. 

Things you will do: 

- Implements and oversees the test automation approach (working with all squads within the POD) to deliver the Test Automation Strategy including CICD, non functional testing - performance, security engineering, compatibility, accessibility testing
 - Testing AI/Gen AI business applications. Demonstrate usage of Gen AI in tooling & AI driven insights reporting. Creating/Reusing AI utilities/components for Testing. 
 - Demonstrate usage of Gen AI for Testing optimization, comparisons , code refactoring , migrations
 - Drives out improvements and innovation around tooling, frameworks and approaches working on shift left first principles and the automation pyramid
 - Able to work constructively with other POD leads and Squad leads to ensure the best value is being driven through the automation approach and that the approach is consistent with other PODs where beneficial
 - Works with the POD leads and the business/POs to ensure there is a holistic and consistent approach to Quality (through RCA, metrics, code quality, (defect) stage containment) and ensures cross communication and collaboration on QA best practices, risks and open issues across other PODs
 - Leads and federates the overall test approach to the Squads - built-in quality, metrics, methods and tools
 - Leads process improvement initiatives focus on Quality, Velocity and Efficiency (agreed across the POD) e. g closer alignment to business acceptance, operations etc
 - Ensure consistency across all squads in line with POD strategy/maturity/priorities/global approach - undertaking quality reviews and deep dives to ensure there is a consistent approach
 - Input into PI planning, and subsequent resourcing planning - including skills profiling andidentify trainingrequirements for POD members
 - Identify supplier training requirementsand feed into global KPI and supplier measures
 - Provides timely reports with qualitative and quantitative analysis of test coverage, defect trends & leakage enabling key stakeholders (including Squad leaders) for timely course correction
 - Define and design quality metrics and dashboard to enable the Pod lead & PO to frequently gauge the quality of the software
 - Manage a team of Test Engineer leads and Test analysts

What you will bring: 

- Strong understanding of Test Engineering and Quality Assurance best practices, tools and policies
 - Experience in using Generative AI for testing activities and experience in testing AI/ML models
 - Proficiency in collecting , processing and assessing data quality and validating test data for AI frameworks, automation for AI powered applications
 - The ability to communicate effectively to both technical and non-technical colleagues in a cross-functional environment
 - Proven track record of successfully delivering Quality software solutions
 - Strong Leadership skills and a team player
 - Experience or knowledge of working with Agile at Scale, Lean and Continuous Delivery approaches such as Continuous Integration, Test-Driven Development and Infrastructure as Code
 - Experience in selenium tools and Configuring Selenium Test Environment (Ex: Eclipse IDE, Java, Selenium WebDriverIO and TestNG etc. . . ). Involvement in Test Environment Setup
 - Familiar with Automation Framework Design and Implementation
 - Understanding of CI/CD and DevOps practices
 - Strong Self-starter and active squad contributor
 - Experience of testing software across a variety of languages, technologies, and platforms. 

Technical Skills Required: 

- Proficient in the following Test automation languages and frameworks; Java, JavaScript, Selenium, WebDriverIO and TestNG, Cypress, RestAssured
 - Strong experience working with MSSQL, API test automation
 - Good understanding of working with a source control systems such as Azure DevOps/TFS, Github or Bitbucket
 - Experience working with Jira

Values and Culture

Our team comprises all sorts of people from all sorts of backgrounds. We believe everyone brings value and a unique perspective and want to promote a fun and diverse culture. To help us succeed we hope that you can demonstrate: 

- A genuine passion for technology
 - A clear commitment to creating brilliant products that will give our clients the edge
 - A willingness to work fluidly and respectfully with our talented team

About Shree Balaji Industries: Shree Balaji Industries (SBI) is a manufacturing organization serving the engineering/automotive manufacturing sector, with a strong focus on quality, process discipline, customer requirements and continuous improvement. 

As we strengthen our Quality function, we are looking for a Quality Engineer who can work closely with Production, Engineering, Suppliers and Customers to maintain product quality, resolve quality issues and continuously improve manufacturing processes. 

This is a hands-on Quality role for a candidate who enjoys working on the shop floor, analysing problems, implementing corrective actions and ensuring that quality systems are effectively followed. 

About the Role: The Quality Engineer will be responsible for supporting and improving the organization's Quality Management System, product/process quality, customer quality, supplier quality and continuous improvement activities. 

The successful candidate will be expected to combine technical quality knowledge with practical shop-floor problem solving. 

Key Responsibilities: 1. Quality Management System
 - Implement and maintain relevant Quality Management System (QMS) procedures. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable quality standards, customer requirements and internal procedures. 
 - Maintain and update quality documentation and records. 
 - Support internal, customer and external certification audits. 
 - Ensure corrective actions arising from audits are effectively implemented. 2. Customer Quality & Complaints
 - Handle customer quality complaints and coordinate immediate containment. 
 - Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and identify permanent corrective actions. 
 - Prepare and implement corrective/preventive action reports. 
 - Implement Poka-Yoke / error-proofing wherever required. 
 - Ensure effectiveness of corrective actions and prevent recurrence. 
 - Capture lessons learned and incorporate them into future processes/products. 3. Process & Product Quality
 - Monitor product and process quality at various stages of manufacturing. 
 - Support Quality Engineers/Technicians in part inspection and quality sign-off. 
 - Establish and improve inspection standards, instructions and documentation. 
 - Conduct regular inspection reviews with Production and other functions. 
 - Analyse internal rejection, rework and other quality issues. 
 - Drive actions to improve overall build quality. 4. Supplier Quality
 - Work with suppliers to reduce non-conforming incoming materials. 
 - Coordinate supplier quality issues and corrective actions. 
 - Support supplier audits and performance improvement. 
 - Work with Supplier Quality Assurance teams to minimise the impact of supplier defects on production. 5. Quality KPIs & Data Analysis
 - Monitor and report Quality KPIs on a regular/monthly basis. 
 - Analyse quality data and identify trends, recurring problems and improvement opportunities. 
 - Support departmental objectives and KPI achievement. 
 - Prepare quality reports and management presentations. 
 - Identify actions required to achieve quality targets. 6. Continuous Improvement
 - Identify recurring quality problems and improvement opportunities. 
 - Lead/participate in Kaizen and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Implement error-proofing and process improvements. 
 - Ensure lessons learned are effectively communicated and implemented. 
 - Work cross-functionally with Production, Engineering, Maintenance, Purchase and other departments. 7. Team & Training
 - Coordinate with Quality Engineers, Inspectors and Technicians. 
 - Support quality-related training and skill development. 
 - Review team performance against defined objectives/KPIs. 
 - Promote quality awareness and a culture of continuous improvement. 8. Safety, Risk & Compliance
 - Follow applicable Health, Safety and Environmental requirements. 
 - Participate in process/task risk assessments. 
 - Ensure Quality activities are conducted in accordance with company procedures and applicable regulations.

data.title: Full Stack Engineering Lead-Vice President
data.description:
The Full Stack Engineering Lead (C13) is a senior technical leadership role responsible for the architecture, design, and end-to-end development of critical, high-performance enterprise applications. This role requires an experienced engineering leader who can bridge the gap between modern, responsive front-end user interfaces and robust, scalable back-end distributed microservices. 

As a C13 Technical Lead, you will drive technical excellence across the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), mentor engineering teams, establish coding and architectural standards, and implement automated CI/CD deployment pipelines within a fast-paced, Agile delivery environment. 

Key Responsibilities

- Technical Leadership & Solution Architecture
 - Architectural Strategy: Design resilient, scalable, and secure full-stack enterprise solutions aligning with modern microservices architectures and cloud-native patterns. 
 - Technical Governance: Drive code quality, code reviews, design patterns, and engineering best practices across front-end and back-end workstreams. 
 - Framework Modernization: Evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and tools to modernize existing legacy systems and accelerate digital transformation. 
 - Full Stack Application Engineering
 - Front-End Development: Lead UI/UX implementation using modern web technologies (Angular 14+ / React 18+, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3/SCSS, State Management like NgRx/Redux, Webpack/Vite). 
 - Back-End & Microservices: Develop high-throughput, low-latency RESTful APIs and distributed services using Core Java (Java 17/21), Spring Framework (Spring Boot, Spring Security, Spring Cloud, Spring Data JPA). 
 - Database Architecture: Design relational database schemas, write complex SQL queries, stored procedures, and packages (Oracle DB, PL/SQL), and perform database performance tuning, indexing, and query optimization. 
 - CI/CD & DevOps Automation
 - Pipeline Delivery: Design and implement robust automated Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, Tekton, Harness, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI. 
 - Containerization & Orchestration: Package and deploy applications using Docker and deploy to container platforms such as Red Hat OpenShift. 
 - Quality & Security Automation: Integrate static code analysis (SonarQube), open-source scanning, dynamic security testing, and automated artifact publishing (Artifactory / Nexus) directly into CI/CD gates. 
 - Agile Delivery & Team Mentorship
 - Agile Leadership: Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Scrum Masters, and QA engineers to define technical user stories, estimate delivery velocity, and manage sprint backlogs. 
 - Team Development: Provide hands-on mentorship, technical guidance, and career coaching to mid-level and junior engineers. 
 - Production Support & Operational Resilience: Drive incident resolution, root cause analysis (RCA), observability (using tools like Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus, or Loki), and maintain high system uptime and disaster recovery readiness. 

Technical Skills & Competencies

Front-End

- Strong expertise in Angular (v12+) or React. js (v16+)
 - Advanced TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, SCSS/CSS3
 - State management libraries (NgRx, RxJS, Redux, Zustand)
 - UI Component Libraries & Responsive Design (Material UI, Bootstrap, Tailwind CSS)

Back-End

- Deep hands-on experience with Java (Java 11/17/21) and Spring Ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data, Spring Security)
 - RESTful API architecture and design (OpenAPI/Swagger specs)
 - Event-driven messaging / asynchronous processing (Apache Kafka, IBM MQ, or RabbitMQ)

Database

- Proficient in Oracle Database 19c+ & PL/SQL (Stored Procedures, Triggers, Views, Functions)
 - ORM frameworks (Hibernate, Spring Data JPA, MyBatis)
 - SQL execution plan analysis, indexing strategies, and performance tuning

DevOps & CI/CD

- Hands-on CI/CD pipeline authoring (Jenkins, Tekton, Harness, GitHub Actions)
 - Build & dependency tools (Maven, Gradle, npm, yarn)
 - Containerization & orchestration (Docker, Podman, Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift)
 - Version control: Git / GitHub / Bitbucket (branching strategies, PR workflows)

Testing & Quality

- Automated unit and integration testing (JUnit 5, Mockito, Testcontainers)
 - Front-end testing frameworks (Jest, Jasmine, Karma, Cypress, Playwright)
 - Code quality gates (SonarQube, Checkmarx, Snyk)

Experience & Leadership Profile

- Total Experience: 10+ years of software development experience with at least 3+ years in a Technical Lead or Senior Full Stack Engineer capacity. 
 - Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Financial Services / Enterprise Experience: Prior experience in banking, financial services, wealth management, or highly regulated enterprise environments is strongly preferred. 
 - Problem Solving & Communication: Outstanding analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical teams and non-technical business stakeholders.

data.title: Manager, Software Engineering - Java, Springboot, Kafka, SQL
data.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

Manager, Software Engineering - Java, Springboot, Kafka, SQL

Job Description Summary

All About Us

MasterCard is a technology company in the global payments business. We connect consumers, financial institutions, merchants, governments and businesses worldwide and enable them to use secure and convenient electronic forms of payment. 

Join the industry's most passionate, motivated & engaged global team - Our employees are encouraged to drive innovation every day in support of a more connected world - A World Beyond Cash. 

Overview

- Do you believe that timely delivery and supporting directs can peacefully co-exist?
 - Are you a self-motivated critical thinker who cultivates innovative ideas?
 - Want to feel your spine tingle by thwarting credit card fraudsters across the globe?

The Transaction Resilience team develops new products for Mastercard's Cyber & Intelligence organization. We protect the payment network ecosystem and aim to deny credit card scammers. Our industry-leading applications scrutinize billions of transactions per month, bolstering the ecosystem and defending cardholders from fraud attacks every second of every day. The Manager position will play a critical role in the coordination of new product functionality within this product portfolio including world-class backend and consumer-facing features. 

Role

- Formally supervise and coach 3+ teams of engineers to build, enhance, and support multiple applications/services in the delivery of internal or market-facing Products, Platforms, or Product bundles
 - Work with business/product owners to develop and deliver on new services to introduce new products and bundles
 - Ensure objectives and development plans are established at the start of the year and reviewed continuously throughout the year
 - Recruit and hire the right talent, always bringing in someone better than at least half the individuals in the role
 - Continuously engage and improve teams' performance by conducting recurring 1-1 meetings, knowing your people, managing career development, and understanding who is at risk
 - Provide and facilitate timely feedback, coaching in the moment, and mentoring for staff at all levels
 - Emulate and drive Mastercard Way behaviors through their behavior, recognitions, coaching, and employee engagement
 - Manage and optimize budgets, forecasting, and cost allocation while delivering on business needs in the area of ownership
 - Provide strategic thinking and leadership related to a wide range of applications and systems, or software-development methodologies
 - Benchmark and drive engineering productivity, quality, and technology policy compliance in the areas of ownership
 - Proactively share and seek knowledge within their Guild/Program to drive reuse of patterns/libraries/practices and enhance productivity

All About You

- IT experience with successful track record in managing small scale development organization (15+ teams) with demonstrated thought-leadership, cross-functional influence, and partnership
 - Progressively grown career with proven design and development experiences in Java technologies, secure coding standards (e. g. , OWASP, CWE, SEI CERT), and vulnerability management. 
 - Has skills in building applications using open frameworks to achieve reuse and reduce development times (e. g. , Spring Boot, REACT, Angular, DXP, others)
 - Understands internals of operating systems (Windows, Linux) to deliver interoperable and performant code
 - Able to perform debugging and troubleshooting to analyse core, heap, thread dumps and remove coding errors
 - Has skills to document and coach team on the development practices and coding guidelines (e. g. , branching, peer reviews, library use, logging, scanning rules, test-driven development, error handling)
 - Understands use cases for advanced design patterns (e. g. , service-to-worker, MVC, API gateway, intercepting filter, dependency injection, lazy loading, all from the gang of four) to implement efficient code
 - Has skills to undertake a technical review of code across applications and their dependencies to look for anti-patterns and promote continuous refactoring
 - Understands and elaborates technical debt and operational issues to drive prioritization discussions with stakeholders to improve the run experience. 
 - Understands system architecture to plan for platform and infrastructure capacity (e. g. , database, compute, network, storage) and drives the dependency prioritization to reduce the delivery lead time
 - Has skills to understand customer journeys and ensure a good customer experience by continuously reducing mean time to mitigate (MTTM) for incidents and ensuring high availability (99. 95% as a starting point)
 - Has skills to simplify deployment and eliminate software and infrastructure snowflakes using standardized platforms, ephemeral instances, and automation
 - Has skills to orchestrate release workflows and pipelines and apply standardized pipelines via APIs to achieve CI and CD using industry-standard tools (e. g. , Jenkins, Bamboo, AWS/Azure pipelines, XL Release, others)
 - Able to configure rules and build automation for code with vulnerability scanning and software composition analysis using standard tools (e. g. , Sonar, Checkmarx, Nexus, JFrog XRay, Veracode, others)
 - Has skills to define, organize, and report on test runs for major, minor, and hotfix releases (including unit, component level, system level, customer journeys, past customer issues, and regulatory controls)
 - Has skills to conduct various performance tests (e. g. , load, spike, breakpoint, endurance) to understand application/service limits and behaviors. 

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

data.title: Software Engineering Manager
data.description:
Drive Innovation. Lead Change. Build the Future of Payments. 

At WEX, we're redefining what's possible in the payments industry. As a Software Engineering Manager, you'll play a key role in shaping the future of our evolving payments platform. Working with cutting-edge technology, you'll be part of a dynamic, fast-paced team that thrives on solving complex problems and delivering scalable, high-performance solutions. 

About The Role

In this role, you'll be an innovator and a leader, delivering new functionality for our customers while supporting and modernizing our platform; you will tackle complex engineering challenges at scale, processing millions of transactions daily on a platform that meets aggressive uptime SLAs. 

How You'll Make an Impact

People Leadership

- Lead a cross-functional team of Engineers to design, develop, QA, deploy and maintain the payments platform. 
 - Mentor and grow engineers through regular 1: 1s, actionable feedback, and deliberate stretch opportunities. 
 - Build a safe, accountable culture where high standards and psychological safety coexist. 
 - Enable autonomy by clarifying intent and guardrails, removing obstacles and then trusting your team to make decisions. 
 - Have the hard conversations regarding performance or behaviour with directness and empathy. 

Technical Leadership

- Spend meaningful time hands-on each week, pairing on complex problems, leading design sessions and pairing on critical issues. 
 - Be the person your team comes to for hard technical calls - you don't defer every decision to a tech lead. 
 - Model engineering excellence through deep, constructive code reviews that teach as well as critique. 
 - Champion responsible, secure adoption of AI tools across the SDLC to accelerate delivery and improve quality. 
 - Play a key role in our architectural direction, evolving our platform to become cloud-native and event-driven. 
 - Continuously explore new technologies to improve our platform and processes. 

Delivery & Operations

- Work with the Product team to translate business requirements into functional, scalable solutions. 
 - Collaborate with your talented peer group to build solutions that are robust, maintainable and future-proof. 
 - Ensure your team delivers reliably, removing friction by unblocking work, reducing tech debt, and streamlining processes to maintain flow. 
 - Ensure availability of the platform through leadership of incident management as required. 
 - Promote resilient architecture and operational excellence across services. 

What You'll Bring

Essential

- Proven track record leading and developing high-performing software engineering teams. 
 - Proven hands-on experience in writing clean, scalable, performant, high quality code. 
 - Deep expertise in modern software engineering practices, cloud platforms, and DevOps approaches including test and deployment automation. 
 - Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. 
 - A collaborative mindset with a passion for learning and problem-solving. 

Preferred

- Background in supporting highly transactional, highly available, low latency systems. 
 - Experience with C#/. NET and MSSQL are highly advantageous. 

Why WEX?

At WEX, we believe that diversity drives innovation. We are a global company that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Here, you'll find a supportive, inclusive environment where your ideas are valued, and your growth is prioritized. You'll collaborate with teams from around the world, expanding your skills and your horizons. 

We offer flexible work arrangements, professional development opportunities, and a culture that fosters inclusion and belonging. Join us in building the future of payments-together.

About the role

As a Senior Platform Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the reliability, scalability, and performance of Prism products and supporting infrastructure in Azure. This is a hands-on role where you'll design and optimize platform services, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment processes for enterprise-grade applications. 

This person should be a can-do, high-achieving individual with strong product and domain expertise, who thrives on collaboration and has experience building secure, resilient cloud infrastructure. You'll champion engineering excellence and automation, foster best practices, and bring a genuine passion for technology and continuous improvement to everything you do. 

Location: Pune, India. 

Permanent, Hybrid working model. 

Your responsibilities

- Develop and maintain Azure infrastructure using the appropriate tooling required. 
 - Design and configure CI/CD pipelines, containers, virtual networks, and monitoring dashboards. 
 - Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) for multi-tenant setups in Azure. 
 - Optimize performance and cost of Azure resources. 
 - Apply governance policies (Azure AD, security, networking). 
 - Collaborate with development, QA, and Product teams to ensure quality and timely delivery. 
 - Contribute to evolving scalable, secure, observable architectures (APIs, microservices, event-driven). 
 - Embed DevSecOps and SRE principles into platform engineering practices (SLOs, error budgets, incident management). 
 - Drive continuous improvement using metrics-led approaches (e. g. , DORA). 

Competencies

- Demonstrated leadership ability, team management, and interpersonal skills. 
 - Change leadership-drives adoption of new ways of working, collaboration, continuous improvement with high levels of trust and autonomy. 
 - Excellent communication and influencing skills, including the capability and gravitas to operate execs, engineers, and regulators/auditors. 
 - Client/Customer-centric mindset; measurable impact on revenue, activation, retention, and costtoserve. -centric mindset; measurable impact on revenue, activation, retention, and cost-to-serve. 
 - Ability to create a positive and collaborative climate in which people want to do their best by providing appropriate challenge, support and direction. 

Your skills

- 8+ years of experience in delivering fast paced and agile system Engineering ideally in regulated FinTech or payments/banking/wealth. 
 - Mentored engineering teams of 10+ across multiple parallel product lines, guiding developers working within microservices architectures and Cloud‐native environments (AWS/Azure/GCP). 
 - Engineering excellence leader with deep SDLC mastery with a pragmatic implementation approach to architecture, platform and tooling. 
 - Embedded DevSecOps and automated policy and quality controls in delivery pipelines, ideally with Azure DevOps. 
 - Extensive change management experience and evidential metrics-based delivery capability. 
 - Standardised logging/metrics/tracing (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana); built comprehensive dashboards and runbooks. 
 - Owned Service reliability: SLOs/SLIs, error budgets, chaos experiments, game days, incident command. 

Nice to haves-to-Haves

- Mortgage origination and servicing, Payments, core banking, or lending domain expertise. 
 - Production experience with Kubernetes, IaC (Terraform), service meshes, and GitOps (Argo CD/Flux). 
 - Navigated PCI DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR; partnered with Risk/Compliance and auditors and delivered audit-ready evidence. 
 - Privacy engineering (GDPR, data residency)
 - Experience leading across multiple geographies/time zones. 

Success Metrics (what you will be measured on)

- DORA: Lead time, Deployment frequency, Change failure rate, MTTR. 
 - Reliability: SLO attainment (%), incident rate and severity mix, mean time to detect (MTTD). 
 - Quality: Escaped defects, defect density, automated test coverage, flaky test rate. 
 - Security/Compliance: Vulnerability SLA adherence, audit/control pass rate. 
 - Delivery & Product: Roadmap predictability, value throughput (e. g. , OKR progress), time-to-market. 
 - People & Culture: eNPS, attrition of regrettable talent, internal mobility, DEI indicators. 
 - Cost & Efficiency: Cloud unit economics, cost-to-serve, build time, onboarding time to first PR.

data.title: AI Quality Engineer, Safety and RAG - Assistant Vice President
data.description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced AI Quality Engineer to join our Retail and Wealth Risk Engineering team under the Enterprise Risk Technology platform. This role spans the full spectrum of modern AI quality engineering - from Agentic AI flow testing and RAG pipeline validation to AI safety, test automation, and performance & reliability engineering. 

You will be the quality pillar for complex autonomous AI systems, ensuring they are safe, accurate, explainable, resilient, and production-ready at scale. This is a high-impact, highly technical role that requires both depth in AI/ML and breadth across testing disciplines. 

Responsibilities

Agentic AI Testing

- Design and execute end-to-end test strategies for Agentic AI pipelines, including single-agent and multi-agent workflows. 
 - Validate agent reasoning, planning, and decision-making chains (e. g. , ReAct, Chain-of-Thought, Plan-and-Execute, Reflexion). 
 - Test tool-use correctness - ensuring agents invoke the right tools, with correct parameters, at the right time. 
 - Evaluate agent memory systems (short-term, long-term, episodic) for accuracy and context retention across sessions. 
 - Validate agent handoff and delegation logic in multi-agent orchestration frameworks (e. g. , AutoGen, CrewAI, LangGraph). 
 - Test termination conditions, loop detection, and infinite loop prevention in autonomous agent loops. 

RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) Testing

- Design comprehensive test strategies for end-to-end RAG pipelines - covering ingestion, chunking, embedding, retrieval, reranking, and generation stages. 
 - Validate retrieval accuracy and relevance - ensuring the correct context chunks are retrieved for a given query. 
 - Test embedding model quality and vector similarity thresholds across different document corpora. 
 - Evaluate faithfulness, groundedness, and answer relevance of generated responses using frameworks like RAGAS, TruLens, DeepEval. 
 - Test chunking strategies (fixed, semantic, hierarchical) for their impact on retrieval quality. 
 - Validate context window management - ensuring retrieved context does not exceed token limits or degrade generation quality. 
 - Conduct end-to-end regression testing when the underlying knowledge base, embedding model, or LLM changes. 
 - Test multi-turn conversational RAG for context coherence and citation accuracy across turns. 

Test Automation

- Build and maintain automated test harnesses for Agentic and RAG systems, including agent trajectory replay, tool mock injection, and prompt simulation. 
 - Develop automated evaluation pipelines integrated into CI/CD workflows for continuous model and agent validation. 
 - Create data validation and data quality frameworks (using Great Expectations, Deequ, or custom tooling) for training, retrieval, and inference data. 
 - Build prompt regression suites to detect behavioral drift across LLM versions or prompt changes. 
 - Implement determinism and reproducibility tests for stochastic LLM-based decisions. 
 - Automate vector database validation - index integrity, embedding drift, and retrieval consistency checks. 

AI Safety & Security Testing

- Conduct red-teaming and adversarial testing to uncover jailbreaks, prompt injection vulnerabilities, and goal misalignment in LLM-based systems. 
 - Test output guardrails and content filters for unsafe, biased, toxic, or out-of-scope model behavior. 
 - Validate privilege escalation controls - ensuring agents do not exceed permitted actions or access unauthorized resources. 
 - Perform data poisoning and backdoor attack simulations to assess model robustness. 
 - Evaluate models for bias, fairness, and discrimination using frameworks such as AI Fairness 360 and Aequitas. 
 - Test PII leakage and data privacy controls in RAG and agent pipelines in accordance with GDPR, CCPA, and internal data governance policies. 
 - Conduct security testing aligned with the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, including: 
 - Prompt Injection (Direct & Indirect)
 - Insecure Output Handling
 - Training Data Poisoning
 - Insecure Plugin / Tool Design
 - Sensitive Information Disclosure
 - Validate constitutional AI constraints, RLHF-aligned behavior boundaries, and system prompt integrity. 
 - Collaborate with cybersecurity teams on AI-specific threat modeling and vulnerability management. 
 - Maintain safety testing playbooks and document red-team findings with severity ratings and remediation recommendations. 
Performance & Reliability Testing

- Define and execute load, stress, soak, and spike testing for AI-powered APIs, inference endpoints, and agent orchestration services. 
 - Measure and optimize end-to-end latency across RAG and agentic pipelines - from query to final response. 
 - Benchmark LLM inference throughput (tokens/second) and identify bottlenecks across model serving infrastructure. 
 - Test auto-scaling behavior of AI services under variable load conditions. 
 - Validate circuit breaker, retry, and fallback mechanisms in agentic and RAG systems for graceful degradation. 
 - Test vector database performance - query latency, index build time, and retrieval accuracy under high concurrency. 
 - Conduct cost efficiency analysis - measuring token consumption, API call costs, and infrastructure spend per agent task. 
 - Establish SLOs (Service Level Objectives) and SLAs for AI system availability, latency percentiles (P50, P95, P99), and error rates. 
 - Collaborate with MLOps teams to set up observability dashboards, monitoring alerts, and automated anomaly detection for production AI systems. 
 - Perform chaos engineering experiments to validate agent and RAG system resilience under infrastructure failures. 

Domain Knowledge

- Deep understanding of RAG architecture patterns - naive RAG, advanced RAG, modular RAG. 
 - Solid grasp of agent design patterns: ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, Reflexion, MRKL, Mixture-of-Agents. 
 - Familiarity with AI safety and alignment principles (RLHF, Constitutional AI, guardrail layers). 
 - Knowledge of token economics, context management, and LLM cost optimization. 
 - Proficiency in performance engineering methodologies for distributed AI systems. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar agentic communication standards. 
 - Exposure to multi-modal agent testing (agents handling text, images, code, documents). 
 - Experience in regulated industries (banking, finance, healthcare) with strict compliance requirements. 
 - Familiarity with chaos engineering tools (Chaos Monkey, Gremlin, LitmusChaos). 

Education

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Master's degree is a plus. 

Experience

- 8+ years of experience in software or AI/ML quality engineering. 
 - 3+ years of hands-on experience with RAG systems, or Agentic AI. 
 - Proven experience building automated test frameworks for non-deterministic AI systems. 
 - Strong background in performance testing and AI safety/security assessments.

Hello Visionary!

We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly evolving world. We're looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you'd make an outstanding addition to our vibrant international team. 

We are looking for a Sub System Test Engineer: ATS - Railway Infrastructure

Work assignments: 

Responsibility for the test execution and test management of mass transit rollouts of ATS for CBTC/ Non-CBTC signaling Systems as part of large-scale railway infrastructure projects. Ensuring economic success and (internal) customer satisfaction for ATS domain in CBTC/ Non-CBTC application projects. Carrying responsibility for the lab data testing scope. Representation of the Test Team within a project when communicating to internal stakeholders, whilst reporting to the line management (test manager/group lead). Ensuring compliance with defined procedures/processes. 

Exploration of further business opportunities: 

Identification and exploitation of additional business opportunities during project implementation, e. g. identifying Change Requests or extending the scope towards project needs. 

You'll make a difference by: 

- Preparation of test checklist specific to project and Create test specification / test cases as per ATS design requirement specifications. 
 - Responsible for lab data testing of ATS Sub-systems in Test lab using real and simulated test environments. 
 - Review / verification of all documents related to Lab data testing. 
 - Evaluation of project, customer, internal requirements towards implementing suitable project specific test cases and test documentation. 
 - Detailed knowhow on functional aspects of ATS and its interface with other subsystems like ATC and IxL with CBTC/non-CBTC projects. 
 - Knowledge about testing and commissioning process and Strategy. 
 - Work with development team to identify and capture test cases, ensure version management
 - Knowledge of test automation for HMI/UI testing
 - Setting up of test environments, writing test scripts and implementing test cases/scenarios. 
 - Providing feedback on usability and serviceability, trace the result to quality risk and report it to concerned people. 
 - Reviewing test logs and results to identify failures, raising CFXs in the change and defect management tool, participating in CCB meetings, and providing test inputs. 
 - Interfacing/Clarification with senior test engineer, test manager, System Manager/Sub PM, Validation, RAMS and project teams. 
 - Collaborating with HQ teams towards tooling requirements, developing/adapting templates/schematics, and parameterization. 
 - Able to support installation and tests activities/teams onsite if required. 
 - Understanding of other subsystems like Interlocking, ATC, Communication and Diagnostic Systems. 
 - Knowledge of Projects Support functions (RM/DM/CM) and Quality Management. 

Essential Soft and Hard skills for IXL Functional Tester: 

- Basic Knowledge of Linux. 
 - Experience with VMware. 
 - Networking knowledge. 
 - Troubleshooting skills for the Test Environment. 
 - Ability to understand and implement IP addressing, subnetting, interface configuration, routing principles, and gateway setup. 
 - Fundamental understanding of server environments, including ESXi and Windows. 
 - Practical experience with Siemens products, particularly WKII, R9k, TGMT, and TG200, will be an added advantage. 

You'll win us over by: 

- Degree in electrical or electronics engineering. 
 - Professional experience of minimum 5 years in railway transportation systems (Main line / Mass Transit) with the focus on testing on ATS sub-system (CBTC / Non CBTC). 
 - Performed hands on testing activities for ATS subsystem besides understanding of operational scenarios, requirements, and interfaces. 
 - Experience with Functional testing, lab testing, test setups. Experience with Integration tests and SAT would be an added advantage. 
 - Proficient English essential both written and oral, knowledge of German/Spanish is an asset
 - Independent and structured approach to work. 

Join us and be yourself!

We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us. 

This role is based in Pune, where you'll get the chance to work with teams, impacting entire cities, countries - and the shape of things to come. 

We're Siemens. A collection of over 312, 000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow.
