Conceptualize, Design and develop Industrialized Solutions in form of Siemens PLC based Control Systems and validate it to formulate all required technical specifications, will perform the role of system architect that involves design and development of Control Logic and hardware cost estimations for Cable Manufacturing and Production facilities, Remotely Operated Vehicles/Vessels (ROVs), Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs) and similar Electro-mechanical systems. 

Responsibilities

- Supervise & mentor entry level Engineers on control and automation projects. 
 - Develop hardware and Software architecture design as per Company standard. 
 - Develop / run software for given hardware platform to test proof of concepts. (PoC) ideas using appropriate tool. 
 - Develop, run, and report on qualification tests for Siemens based control equipment. 
 - Should be able to work on Siemens S7-1500F (Failsafe PLC) / S7-1200F, ET 200SP / ET 200MP (Distributed I/O), Siemens Comfort Panel / Unified Comfort Panel (HMI), Sinamics S120 / G120 (Motion Drives), Scalance X (Industrial Switches), TIA Portal (Totally Integrated Automation), WinCC Advanced / WinCC Professional (SCADA & HMI Development), Siemens Industrial Edge / MindSphere (Data Analytics & Cloud), OPC UA in TIA Portal / SIMATIC NET (OPC Communications), PROFINET / PROFIsafe / PROFIdrive (Siemens Communication & safety standards) and various industry standards in safety and high-performance HMI. 
 - Support field trial of the developed product at various locations worldwide. 
 - Review the block diagrams / layout drawings prepared by Drafters for mechanical, electrical, network, control etc. 
 - Coordinate project deliveries and schedules with the Automation & Control teams globally. 
 - Direct team of Senior Engineers to enable them to handle the assignments effectively. 
 - Review work carried out by other engineers, review the documents prepared by the team and approve the same. 
 - Ascertain compliance to established test processes by the team. 
 - Define functional processes and work towards continuous improvement
 - Share regular updates about work with Stakeholders. 
 - Prepare & conduct technical trainings. 
 - Act as single point of contact for one or more business units for product development projects: 
 - Communicate with business units to understand their analysis needs
 - Define scope of work
 - Plan jobs for duration, cost, etc. 
 - Have resources allocated
 - Share regular updates about work with client
 - Monitor performance on relevant key performance indicators
 - Keep abreast of industry trends and issues. 
 - Should be open to travel as per business needs. 
 - Work towards individual goals aligned with department and organizational objectives. 
 - Comply to organizational HR policies and procedures. 
 - Understand and adhere to organizational HSE policies and practices. 

Required

QUALIFICATIONS

- Post Graduation (Master degree) in Automation & Control, or Electrical Engineering, or Electronics & Communication or equivalent degree with minimum six years of relevant industry experience, OR
 - Graduation (Bachelor degree) in Automation & Control, or Electrical Engineering, or Electronics & Communication or equivalent degree with minimum eight years of relevant industry experience. 

Desired

- Siemens Control HW/SW development experience for at least 2 Years
 - Experience of working with platform to establish communication with third party devices. 
 - Exposure of working on various network protocols viz. EtherNet, ControlNet etc. 
 - Experience in C and/or Python Programming
 - Good communication skills. Must be fluent in the English language. 
 - Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and the general public. 
 - Proven ability to interface with cross-functional teams and all levels of personnel and management. 

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, And Other Characteristics

An individual should demonstrate the following competencies & qualities to be able to perform this role successfully: 

- Communication skills
 - Teamwork & Interpersonal skills
 - Analytical, problem solving & decision-making skills
 - Organizing & planning skills
 - Mentoring skills
 - Leadership abilities

About Us

Oceaneering is a global provider of engineered services and products, primarily to the offshore energy industry. We develop products and services for use throughout the lifecycle of an offshore oilfield, from drilling to decommissioning. We operate the world's premier fleet of work class ROVs. Additionally, we are a leader in offshore oilfield maintenance services, umbilicals, subsea hardware, and tooling. We also use applied technology expertise to serve the defense, material handling, aerospace, science, and renewable energy industries. 

Overview

ABOUT THE TEAM

Since year 2003, Oceaneering's India Center has been an integral part of operations for Oceaneering's robust product and service offerings across the globe. This center caters to diverse business needs, from oil and gas field infrastructure, subsea robotics to automated material handling & logistics. 

Our multidisciplinary team offers a wide spectrum of solutions, encompassing Subsea Engineering, Robotics, Automation, Control Systems, Software Development, Asset Integrity Management, Inspection, ROV operations, Field Network Management, Graphics Design & Animation, and more. 

In addition to these technical functions, Oceaneering India Center plays host to several crucial business functions, including Finance, Supply Chain Management (SCM), Information Technology (IT), Human Resources (HR), and Health, Safety & Environment (HSE). 

Our world class infrastructure in India includes modern offices, industry-leading tools and software, equipped labs, and beautiful campuses aligned with the future way of work. Oceaneering in India as well as globally has a great work culture that is flexible, transparent, and collaborative with great team synergy. 

At Oceaneering India Center, we take pride in "Solving the Unsolvable" by leveraging the diverse expertise within our team. Join us in shaping the future of technology and engineering solutions on a global scale.

data.title: Principal DevOps Engineer
data.description:
Securonix is leading the transformation of cybersecurity by helping organizations stay ahead of modern threats. Security teams are no longer constrained by data or tools. They are constrained by speed, clarity, and confidence. Securonix was built to close that gap. Our mission is to enable security teams to decide and act faster across the entire threat lifecycle. 

The Securonix Unified Defense SIEM is the industry's first platform powered by agentic AI and designed with a human-in-the-loop philosophy. It unifies detection, investigation, and response in a single system. Advanced UEBA delivers deep behavioral insight across users, entities, and data. Native threat intelligence continuously enriches detections and investigations with real-world context. AI reinforces every layer of the platform while keeping accountability with the security team. 

Built cloud-native for scale and performance, the platform enables real-time analytics, deep investigation, and automated response without compromise. Analysts gain faster access to relevant signals. Investigations move from days to minutes. Response becomes consistent and measurable. The result is a CyberOps experience that scales as threats evolve. 

Securonix is recognized as a six-time Leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for SIEM and a Customers' Choice on Gartner Peer Insights. The company has been featured by leading publications including WIRED, Dark Reading, and Fortune for its innovation and leadership in security operations. Organizations rely on the platform for always-available data, rapid search and investigation, continuously updated threat content, and a fully integrated Threat Detection, Investigation, and Response experience. 

Backed by Vista Equity Partners, one of the world's leading enterprise software investors, Securonix benefits from deep operational expertise and a long-term commitment to innovation and growth. This partnership strengthens our ability to scale the platform, accelerate product execution, and support customers as their security needs evolve. 

With more than 1, 000 customers worldwide, including a meaningful portion of the Fortune 100, Securonix operates at global scale. Our ecosystem of partners and managed security service providers extends that reach, helping organizations deploy and operate with confidence wherever they do business. What drives us is how we work. 

- We win as one team. We operate with trust, respect, and shared accountability. 
 - We are customer driven. Innovation is guided by real security challenges and measurable outcomes. 
 - We act with agility. Change is constant, and we stay aligned on purpose while adapting fast. 

That focus is how Securonix helps organizations move from reactive security to proactive, autonomous operations. 

Experience Required

- Total: 12+ years in the IT field, with a focus on DevOps practices and principles. 
 - Relevant: 5+ years with in-depth experience in Python, Ansible, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm charts, Terraform and Octopus Deploy. Demonstrable experience with system architecture and design in a DevOps context. 

Core Skills

- Primary: Expert in Python, with extensive experience using Ansible and Jenkins for CI/CD pipelines. Highly skilled in Docker and Kubernetes for container orchestration, proficient in Helm chart management, and expert knowledge in Octopus Deploy. Ability to design and implement complex CI/CD pipelines and automate deployment processes. 
 - Secondary: In-depth knowledge of AWS, Azure, or GCP for cloud infrastructure management, advanced skills in CI/CD pipeline optimization, expertise in observability tools like Grafana, Prometheus, and ELK stack. 

Good To Have

- Groovy scripting and working experience with groovy shared libraries

Responsibilities

- Lead a DevOps team to architect, develop, and maintain sophisticated release/deployment automation pipelines, focusing on Python, Ansible, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm charts, and Octopus Deploy. 
 - Architect and implement robust, scalable, and efficient CI/CD pipelines that accommodate the specific needs of multiple development teams. 
 - Design and oversee the deployment strategies for containerized applications using Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security. 
 - Spearhead the integration of cloud services and infrastructure as code (IaC) principles into deployment processes, leveraging AWS, Azure, or GCP. 
 - Conduct comprehensive system and architecture reviews to identify and implement optimizations and enhancements. 
 - Drive the adoption of DevOps best practices across the organization, including continuous integration, continuous delivery, automation, and infrastructure as code. 
 - Mentor junior DevOps engineers, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation. 
 - Lead initiatives to incorporate advanced observability and monitoring tools into the infrastructure, ensuring high availability and performance. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment of deployment strategies with business objectives and operational requirements. 
 - Champion the design and implementation of disaster recovery strategies and maintain high standards for security and compliance. 

Qualifications

- BS/MS in Computer Science, Applied Math, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Extensive experience in designing, building, and managing release/deployment pipelines utilizing Python, Ansible, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm charts, and Octopus Deploy. 
 - Proven ability in architecting and managing complex CI/CD environments and integrating various DevOps tools and practices. 
 - Advanced knowledge of Linux system administration, TCP/IP networking, and cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP). 
 - Expertise in scripting languages, with a strong emphasis on Python. 
 - Deep understanding of configuration management tools, particularly Ansible. 
 - Experience with log collection and analysis tools such as Splunk and ELK stack. 
 - Mastery in container orchestration technologies, especially Docker and Kubernetes, and package management with Helm. 
 - A solid background in software development, preferably in Python and containerized environments, with an understanding of architectural patterns and challenges in a DevOps context. 

Benefits -

As a full-time employee with Securonix, you will be eligible for the following employee benefits: 

- Health Insurance with a total sum insured is INR 7, 50, 000
 - Coverage: Self, Spouse, 2 kids, Dependent parents, or parents-in-law
 - Personal Accident with total sum insured is INR 10, 00, 000
 - Term Life Insurance with a sum assured for employees is 5 times fixed base pay is covered. 

Securonix, Inc. provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, amnesty or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. 

Securonix complies with applicable state and local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, and transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

data.title: Principal Information Security Engineer - IAM (Quality Assurance)
data.description:
FC Global Services India LLP (First Citizens India), a part of First Citizens BancShares, Inc. , a top 20 U. S. financial institution, is a global capability center (GCC) based in Bengaluru. Our India-based teams benefit from the company's over 125-year legacy of strength and stability. First Citizens India is responsible for delivering value and managing risks for our lines of business. We are particularly proud of our strong, relationship-driven culture and our long-term approach, which are deeply ingrained in our talented workforce. This is evident across all key areas of our operations, including Technology, Enterprise Operations, Finance, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, and Credit Administration. Job Description

Value Proposition

As part of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team at First Citizens Bank, the Principal Information Security Engineer - IAM (Quality Assurance) will serve as the technical leader responsible for defining and driving the quality engineering strategy for enterprise IAM platforms and services. 

This role requires deep expertise in IAM technologies, quality engineering, test automation, and cybersecurity practices. The successful candidate will provide leadership across multiple IAM initiatives, establish testing standards and frameworks, drive automation maturity, and ensure the security, scalability, reliability, and compliance of IAM solutions. The individual will act as a trusted advisor to engineering, architecture, product, and cyber security teams while influencing strategic technology decisions across the IAM ecosystem. 

Job Details

Career Level: P4

Job Category: Assistant Vice President

Role Type: Hybrid

Job Location: Bangalore

The Identity and Access Management (IAM) Program supports end-to-end identity governance, access lifecycle management, authentication, authorization, and privileged access management capabilities for employees, contractors, partners, and enterprise applications across the organization. 

Impact

This position resides within the Cyber Security organization and is responsible for establishing the quality engineering vision and testing strategy across IAM platforms. The role will drive test automation, security validation, performance engineering, and quality governance for critical IAM capabilities. 

The Principal Engineer will lead complex testing initiatives, influence architecture and design decisions, mentor engineers, and ensure enterprise IAM solutions meet security, operational, regulatory, and business requirements. This individual contributor role partners closely with IAM Product Owners, Enterprise Architecture, Engineering, Operations, and Information Security leadership teams. 

Key Deliverables (Duties And Responsibilities)

- Define and drive the enterprise IAM Quality Engineering and Test Automation strategy.

 - Establish testing standards, frameworks, tools, governance models, and best practices across IAM programs. 
 - Lead quality assurance efforts for Identity Governance, Access Management, SSO, Federation, MFA, PAM, and Directory Services initiatives. 
 - Design and build scalable automated test frameworks leveraging modern programming languages and enterprise automation platforms. 
 - Drive continuous testing practices integrated with CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps methodologies. 
 - Define quality gates, release readiness criteria, risk assessments, and production validation processes. 
 - Provide technical leadership for end-to-end testing across IAM platforms, APIs, workflows, integrations, and cloud services. 
 - Partner with architecture teams to review solution designs and ensure testability, scalability, resilience, and security requirements are met. 
 - Lead security testing initiatives including authentication, authorization, privilege escalation, API security, and identity lifecycle validation. 
 - Establish performance, load, stress, and resilience testing strategies for IAM platforms. 
 - Mentor and coach engineers on quality engineering, automation practices, and testing methodologies. 
 - Drive adoption of shift-left testing and quality-by-design principles across IAM delivery teams. 
 - Collaborate with product, engineering, cyber security, and infrastructure teams to ensure compliance with regulatory and internal security standards. 
 - Evaluate emerging testing technologies, AI-driven automation capabilities, and industry best practices to improve effectiveness and efficiency. 
 - Participate in design reviews, code reviews, architecture discussions, and strategic technology planning. 
 - Develop and report quality metrics, automation coverage, defect trends, and risk indicators to senior leadership. 
 - Serve as the escalation point for complex testing, integration, and production quality challenges. 

Functional Skills

Skills and Qualifications (Functional and Technical Skills)

- Strong leadership and influencing skills with the ability to drive enterprise-wide quality initiatives. 
 - Proven ability to define testing strategies and quality engineering roadmaps for large-scale IAM programs. 
 - Experience leading cross-functional teams across engineering, security, architecture, and operations. 
 - Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills. 
 - Ability to balance strategic planning with hands-on technical execution when required. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. 
 - Experience mentoring senior engineers and developing technical talent. 

Technical / Business Skills

- 12+ years of experience in software quality engineering, test automation, or information security engineering. 
 - 7+ years of experience supporting IAM technologies and identity lifecycle processes. 
 - Deep understanding of IAM concepts including: Identity Governance and Administration (IGA)Single Sign-On (SSO)Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)FederationSAMLOAuth 2. 0OpenID Connect (OIDC)LDAPRole-Based Access Control (RBAC)Privileged Access Management (PAM)
 - Strong experience with SailPoint IdentityIQ and/or SailPoint Identity Security Cloud. 
 - Expertise in building enterprise-scale test automation frameworks using Java, Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Selenium, Rest Assured, Postman, Cucumber, JUnit, TestNG, Playwright, or equivalent frameworks. 
 - Experience implementing automated testing within CI/CD platforms such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab. 
 - Experience testing APIs, microservices, event-driven architectures, and cloud-native applications. 
 - Strong understanding of security testing methodologies and cybersecurity controls. 
 - Experience building performance and scalability testing frameworks using tools such as JMeter, Gatling, or LoadRunner. 
 - Experience working in Agile, DevSecOps, and cloud environments. 
 - Strong understanding of data validation, test data management, and synthetic data generation. 
 - Knowledge of regulatory and compliance requirements applicable to financial services environments is preferred. 
 - Relevant certifications are highly desirable: CISSPCISMCIAMSailPoint CertificationsCertified Software Quality Engineer (CSQE)Agile Testing Certifications

data.title: Site Reliability Engineer - AWS (7 to 12 Years)
data.description:
PhonePe Limited (Formerly PhonePe Private Limited) is a technology company that builds digital platforms for Payments, Digital Distribution Services and Financial Services. Headquartered in India, the PhonePe digital payments app was launched in 2016. As of April 2026, PhonePe has over 70 Crore life-till-date registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 5 Crore merchants. PhonePe's products and services include Consumer Payments (including Digital Distribution Services), Merchant Payments, Lending and Insurance Distribution services, and New Platforms, which comprise Share. Market (stock broking and mutual funds distribution platform), and Indus Appstore (Android-based mobile app marketplace). Culture: 

At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you're excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!

Job Description

We are seeking a highly motivated Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) with more than 7 years of experience to manage, scale, and ensure the high availability of our core infrastructure. This role is designed for experts specialized in AWS. You will leverage a profound background in Linux (specifically RHEL) to drive deep-level cloud architecture, automation, complex networking, and security compliance, supporting a high-volume, mission-critical environment that demands exceptional uptime and resilience. 

Roles And Responsibilities

- Lead advanced Linux/RHEL administration, focusing on OS troubleshooting, kernel-level performance tuning, and executing security hardening for high-volume, mission-critical environments. 
 - Build and scale highly available AWS environments that can handle massive traffic without failing. Drive the long-term strategy for our servers, data storage, and system monitoring. 
 - Architect infrastructure with a strong emphasis on High Availability (HA) and robust Information Security. Set and drive the adoption of security standards and compliance best practices across the infrastructure. 
 - Design and maintain advanced network connectivity and routing using AWS Direct Connect, Transit Gateways, VPNs, and BGP
 - Plan, strategize, and oversee large-scale infrastructure migrations, component upgrades, and database sharding while ensuring minimal to zero disruption to production
 - Lead capacity planning for organic growth and traffic spikes. 
 - Define the best practices and tools we use for Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and configuration management. Continuously reduce manual toil by designing automated, self-healing systems. 
 - Design and implement cross-region database replication, HA scaling strategies, and comprehensive disaster recovery plans for data stores like MySQL and Aerospike. 
 - Establish and track our reliability metrics. Lead the response during production outages, and use post-mortems (RCAs) to fix underlying architectural flaws and reduce technical debt
 - Establish documentation standards for system architecture, disaster recovery plans, and SOPs. Mentor fellow team members and foster a collaborative culture of reliability and continuous learning. 

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements

- Experience: 7+ years as a Senior SRE, Cloud Architect, or Lead Systems Engineer. 
 - Advanced proficiency in Linux/RHEL administration, including hands-on troubleshooting, kernel-level performance tuning, and OS security hardening. 
 - Deep, architectural-level expertise exclusively within the AWS ecosystem. 
 - Strong understanding of BGP routing, complex TCP/IP troubleshooting, and large-scale network design. 
 - Understanding of MySQL/MariaDB/Percona or any other relational database concepts and administration
 - Proven experience defining and tracking site reliability, alongside a strong passion for automation. 
 - Proven ability to scale and optimize load balancers (Nginx, HAProxy) to handle massive web traffic. 
 - Hands-on experience orchestrating and scaling containerization technologies (Docker, Podman, or equivalent). 
 - Ability to effectively communicate complex technical strategies and architectural decisions to internal teams and external stakeholders. 

Preferred Qualifications (A Plus)

- Experience optimizing cloud costs - finding wasted resources and cutting AWS bills without sacrificing performance. 
 - Knowledge of NoSQL databases like Aerospike
 - Experience with distributed event streaming platforms like Kafka. 
 - Experience predicting future infrastructure needs and planning capacity for long-term growth.

data.description:
Overview

At Microsoft, we are transforming the way cloud is enabled to bring it at lowest TCO to our worldwide customers. 

We are looking for highly motivated System integration and validation Engineers with background in Firmware development, integration and validation in embedded systems.

 - 3+ years of professional experience in design/development, integration, validation, or system level debugging in embedded systems 
 - problem solving, debugging, and troubleshooting skills.

 - Demonstrated experience in system level Integration, validation (including validation infrastructure setup), automation framework (such as Robot Framework), and debugging of system software. 
 - Experience in validation / development in server space is big plus. 
 - Experience of creating validation test plans, developing test content to achieve the validation plan and automating the execution of test contents.

 - Experience of firmware development and testing on multiple HW test environments (FPGA, Emulation, Simulation etc. ) 
 - Experience of system level debugging (including customer issues) with good understanding of managing and triaging production level issues. 
 - Good knowledge of hardware debuggers like JTAG, Oscilloscope, and Logic Analyzer etc. 

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

data.description:
Company: 

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area: 

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > ASICS Engineering

General Summary: 

Qualcomm Multimedia Validation and Integration team is a part of the Silicon Validation and Emulation Engineering Team and is responsible for the overall quality of Multimedia-IP in Silicon. data.title: Functional Validation Engineer
data.description:
OUR STORY

At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today. 

When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50, 000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world. 

Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential. 

Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you. 

YOUR ROLE

Lab validation and characterization

Attached to the Imaging Validation department, you will join a dynamic and innovative team, an integral part of R&D, working on projects at the state of the art of image sensor technology targeting various markets and applications. 

As a Functional Validation Engineer, you will be involved in validating all the division products. This activity will aim to ensure the adequacy of the functionalities and performances of the product with the specifications by relying on FPGA prototyping first, and on circuit silicon in a second time. 

The role requires strong expertise in Camera Image Sensors, Imaging Pipelines, Sensor Characterization, High-Speed Interface Validation, Embedded Systems, and Python-based Automation. The candidate will work closely with architecture, design, firmware, and application teams to ensure complete coverage of sensor functionality and system-level performance. 

Throughout the validation, you will also oversee the analysis and resolution of technical challenges. Your product expertise may also be called upon to participate in customer support and integration. 

To succeed in these missions, you will work in close collaboration with all the different product development teams (Design, Architecture, Firmware and embedded software development), with our application teams in order to provide the best validation solution that will meet our customer's needs. 

You will also participate in project meetings, sharing information, actions, and priorities within the team. 

Finally, as a member of a validation team, you will reuse existing tools. You will also propose and participate in methods and tools for improvements. 

Key Responsibilities

Develop and execute comprehensive validation plans based on product specifications and architecture requirements. Verify sensor features including: 

- Exposure Control
 - Gain Control
 - HDR Operation
 - Global Shutter and Rolling Shutter Functionality
 - Region of Interest (ROI)
 - Binning and Sub-Sampling Modes
 - Defect Pixel Correction
 - Embedded Data Functions
 - Synchronization and Trigger Mechanisms
 - Multi-Camera Operation
 - Cybersecurity

Validate sensor configuration registers and firmware interactions. 

Perform feature, integration, system-level, regression, stress, and corner-case testing. 

Analyze failures and drive root-cause investigations with design and firmware teams. 

Your Skills & Experiences

- Object-oriented programming languages (preferably Python, C)
 - Version management tools (git, svn)
 - Software, Hardware knowledge and debug capabilities. 
 - Knowledge: 
 - Embedded electronics / computing (real time)
 - Laboratory tools (oscilloscope, signal generator, etc. )
 - Transmission protocols (high and low speed): I2C, I3C, SPI, MIPI, DP, eDP
 - Automation and/or continuous integration tools (ex: Jenkins, Gerrit, AI tools)
 - Notions in image processing would be an adding competency. 

ST is proud to be one of the 17 companies certified as a 2025 Global Top Employer and the first and only semiconductor company to achieve this distinction. ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics & integrity, purpose & values, organization & change, business strategy, and performance. 

At ST, we endeavor to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we do not tolerate discrimination. We aim to recruit and retain a diverse workforce that reflects the societies around us. We strive for equity in career development, career opportunities, and equal remuneration. We encourage candidates who may not meet every single requirement to apply, as we appreciate diverse perspectives and provide opportunities for growth and learning. Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) is woven into our company culture. 

To discover more, visit st. com/careers.

data.title: Senior QA Engineer
data.description:
Job Title: Senior QA Engineer

Department: Quality Assurance

Location: Mumbai (on-site, Monday to Friday Work From Office)

Experience: 4+ years

About The Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior QA Engineer to own end-to-end quality for one or more of our product areas spanning mobile apps, embedded device firmware, and cloud services. You will drive test strategy, lead release sign-offs, build and extend test automation, and mentor junior testers. This role suits someone who is equally comfortable doing deep exploratory testing on a physical device and writing automation code that runs in CI. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own the test strategy, test planning, and release quality for an assigned product area, from requirement review through production sign-off. 
 - Review PRDs and technical designs early, identify gaps, edge cases, and risks, and influence the team toward testable, robust designs. 
 - Design, execute, and maintain comprehensive functional, regression, integration, performance, and compatibility test suites across Android/iOS apps, device firmware, and backend APIs. 
 - Build and maintain automated test suites (mobile UI, API, and device-level) and integrate them into the CI/CD pipeline; drive automation coverage targets for your area. 
 - Lead root-cause analysis of complex, intermittent, and hardware-software interaction issues (connectivity, OTA, audio/video, sensor behaviour, app-device sync) using logs, device tools, and debugging utilities. 
 - Define and track quality metrics (defect leakage, test coverage, automation pass rate, release readiness) and present release quality status to engineering and product stakeholders. 
 - Act as the QA point of contact for developers, product managers, and support teams for your area; triage production escalations and drive them to closure. 
 - Mentor and review the work of junior testers, establish best practices for test case design and bug reporting, and contribute to the team's QA process and tooling improvements. 
 - Contribute to release planning, risk assessments, and go/no-go decisions. 

Required Skills And Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Electronics, or a related field. 
 - 4 + years of hands-on QA experience, with at least 2 years testing mobile applications and/or hardware or IoT products. 
 - Strong command of testing fundamentals: test design techniques, risk-based testing, regression strategy, and defect life-cycle management. 
 - Proven experience with test automation: at least one of Appium, Selenium, or Playwright, plus strong scripting skills in Python or Java. 
 - Solid API testing experience (Postman, REST Assured, or Pytest with requests) and a working understanding of REST, JSON, authentication, and backend data flows. 
 - Hands-on familiarity with Android/iOS debugging tools (adb, logcat, Xcode Instruments, Charles/Proxyman) and with testing across device fragmentation and OS versions. 
 - Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar) and using Git. 
 - Working knowledge of SQL and Linux command line. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work independently and drive outcomes with cross-functional teams. 
 - Experience testing embedded/IoT devices, robotics, or consumer electronics, including firmware, OTA updates, BLE/Wi-Fi provisioning, and audio/video pipelines. 

Good To Have

- Familiarity with testing AI/ML-driven features such as speech recognition, conversational responses, or vision-based interactions, including non-deterministic output validation. 
 - Understanding of child-safety, privacy, and compliance requirements (COPPA, GDPR-K) for products designed for children. 
 - ISTQB Foundation or equivalent certification. 

What We Offer

- Ownership of quality for AI-powered products used by children and families worldwide. 
 - A senior seat in a small, high-impact QA team with direct influence on product and engineering decisions. 
 - Opportunity to shape the automation roadmap and grow into an architect track.

Further your career at Ball, a world leader in manufacturing sustainable aluminium packaging. Achieve extraordinary things when you join our team, and make a difference in your professional development, the community, and around the globe!

Working as part of a team of Process experts, the role will have responsibility predominantly for New Build, New Line and Line Conversion start- up performance.  - Deliver training to site personnel on process fundamentals and performance expectations, both during recruitment and throughout the start-up period. 
 - Provide emergency breakdown support, applying strong diagnostic capability to quickly restore operations and protect quality and performance during critical phases. 
 - Support size conversions, ensuring safe, accurate, efficient changeovers and building local team capability for ongoing execution. Identify and share best practices, capturing lessons learned to enhance future equipment builds, start-up performance, and long-term operational excellence. 
 - Supports implementation of BOE standards to a level 3, associated with the assignment scope for all safety, quality, business management, and maintenance pillar elements

Position Requirement & Competencies

 - Training/ teaching qualification to minimum Train The Trainer
 - Minimum of 5 years' experience of operating in Can manufacturing
 - Has used basic Problem Solving techniques and the basics of Lean
 - Worked in Cross Cultural Teams
 - 3+ years in a comparable position with demonstrated expertise in quality assurance, customer support, and relevant products. 
 - ISO, Food Safety and audit experience preferred. 
 - Green Belt Certification preferred. 
 - Strong knowledge of the full Can making process and subject expert in at least one specific area. 
 - Ability to transfer Can making process knowledge to others 
 - Strong capability in equipment setup, troubleshooting, optimisation, and supporting line performance
 - Competent computer skills for data analysis and report writing
 - English communication skills (minimum communicative level)
 - Preferred: Experience with line launches or rebuild projects 
 - Ownership mindset with a focus on continuous improvement and waste reduction
 - Ability to mentor and develop less experienced team members 
 - Strong attention to detail and adherence to specifications 
 - Effective communication across all departments and levels 
 - Strong teamwork and collaboration mindset
 - Results-driven, proactive, and forward-thinking
 - Continuous improvement mindset with strong waste-reduction focus
 - High attention to detail and commitment to excellence
 - Able to work autonomously and collaboratively
 - Strong engagement and communication skills across all levels
 - Passionate about coaching, mentoring, and developing others
 - Flexible and willing to travel at short notice
 - Empathetic and supportive in team environments

Work Environment: This role supports central functions and offers flexible work arrangements including hybrid or fully remote options, subject to role requirements and manager approval. 

Hiring Range: 62, 300 - 89, 690 EUR gross per year. The final salary will be determined based on the candidate's education, experience, knowledge, skills, and competencies, while taking into account internal equity and industry benchmarks. Please note that the salary range is related to Germany as base location, however relevant local range applies to candidates based in other locations. 

Incentive Plan: This position is eligible to participate in Ball's annual incentive compensation program. 

Comprehensive Benefits Package: Defined contribution pension, life insurance, accident and disability insurance, employee assistance program, and meal assistance. 

Ball Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We actively encourage applications from everybody, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, faith, ability, or orientation. When you join Ball you belong to a team of over 16, 000 members worldwide. Our products range from infinitely recyclable aluminium cans, cups to aerosol bottles that enable our customers to contribute to a better world. 

Each of us has a deep commitment to diversity and inclusion which is the foundation of our culture of belonging. Everyone at Ball is making a difference by doing what we love. Because what we create may change, but what we will always make is a difference.

Senior Software Developers collaborate with Business and Quality Analysts, Designers, Project Managers and more to design software solutions that will create meaningful change for our clients. For a team to thrive, it needs collaboration and room for healthy, respectful debate. Senior Developers are the technologists who cultivate this environment while driving teams toward delivering on an aspirational tech vision and acting as mentors for more junior-level consultants. You will leverage deep technical knowledge to solve complex business problems and proactively assess your team's health, code quality and nonfunctional requirements.

- You will learn and adopt best practices like writing clean and reusable code using TDD, pair programming and design patterns
 - You will use and advocate for continuous delivery practices to deliver high-quality software as well as value to end customers as early as possible
 - You will work in collaborative, value-driven teams to build innovative customer experiences for our clients
 - You will create large-scale distributed systems out of microservices
 - You will collaborate with a variety of teammates to build features, design concepts and interactive prototypes and ensure best practices and UX specifications are embedded along the way. 
 - You will apply the latest technology thinking from our Technology Radar to solve client problems
 - You will efficiently utilize DevSecOps tools and practices to build and deploy software, advocating devops culture and shifting security left in development
 - You will oversee or take part in the entire cycle of software consulting and delivery from ideation to deployment and everything in between
 - You will act as a mentor for less-experienced peers through both your technical knowledge and leadership skills

Job Qualifications

Technical Skills

- You have 5+ years of experience in Java, React, and AWS with strong proficiency in development and a solid foundation in object-oriented programming
 - You have a foundational understanding of Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) and their application in enterprise software development. 
 - You can skillfully write high-quality, well-tested code and you are comfortable with Object-Oriented programming
 - You are comfortable with Agile methodologies, such as Extreme Programming (XP), Scrum and/or Kanban
 - You have a good awareness of TDD, continuous integration and continuous delivery approaches/tools

Professional Skills

- You enjoy influencing others and always advocate for technical excellence while being open to change when needed
 - Presence in the external tech community: you willingly share your expertise with others via speaking engagements, contributions to open source, blogs and more
 - You're resilient in ambiguous situations and can approach challenges from multiple perspectives

Other things to know

Learning & Development

There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys. 

Onsite Work Expectation

You may be expected to work out of our Thoughtworks office or at our client's office location for all five working days of the week, depending on business or clients' needs. 

About Thoughtworks

Thoughtworks is a global technology consultancy that integrates strategy, design and engineering to drive digital innovation. For 30+ years, our clients have trusted our autonomous teams to build solutions that look past the obvious. Here, computer science grads come together with seasoned technologists, self-taught developers, midlife career changers and more to learn from and challenge each other. Career journeys flourish with the strength of our cultivation culture, which has won numerous awards around the world. 

Join Thoughtworks and thrive. Together, our extra curiosity, innovation, passion and dedication overcomes ordinary.

Are you ready?

Job Description: 

About The Role

SiFive is looking for a Senior Design Verification Engineer to drive verification of a next-generation cache-coherent interconnect subsystem used in high-performance SoCs. 

This is a T3 / Senior Engineer individual-contributor role within the Interconnect horizontal area, focused on coherent interconnect and related subsystem behavior. 

In this role, you will work across architecture, RTL, formal, and design verification teams to verify coherent data movement, protocol correctness, ordering, flow control, quality-of-service behavior, and subsystem integration across multiple interface types and bridge paths. 

We are looking for someone who can independently execute high-quality verification work, build robust environments, debug complex issues efficiently, and contribute to stronger verification methodology across the broader interconnect verification effort. 

Responsibilities

- Understand the coherent interconnect architecture and create effective verification strategies and test plans for the assigned area. 
 - Develop and maintain verification environments, checkers, scoreboards, assertions, stimulus, and coverage models for coherent traffic, ordering rules, backpressure, flow control, buffering behavior, and error handling. 
 - Verify subsystem behavior across interface boundaries, protocol adaptation layers, and bridge paths, including conversion, buffering, deinterleaving, and related data-movement behavior. 
 - Define and execute directed and constrained-random tests that expose corner cases in coherency, concurrency, ordering, credits, arbitration, QoS behavior, and integration scenarios. 
 - Analyze failures, isolate root cause, and drive fixes across RTL, assertions, testbench infrastructure, and test content. 
 - Collaborate closely with architecture, design, formal, and software teams to clarify requirements, review specifications, and improve verification quality early in the development cycle. 
 - Write functional coverage, analyze coverage results, and close coverage holes to ensure verification completeness and signoff quality. 
 - Contribute reusable methodology, automation, and debug improvements that raise team-wide productivity and verification quality. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. 
 - 5+ years of relevant experience in IP, subsystem, or SoC functional verification, preferably in coherent interconnect, cache, memory-system, or CPU-subsystem verification. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with SystemVerilog and UVM-based verification. 
 - Solid understanding of cache-coherent systems, on-chip interconnects, memory-subsystem behavior, and verification of ordering and flow-control semantics. 
 - Experience creating test plans, building testbenches, writing assertions, analyzing coverage, and debugging complex design issues. 
 - Experience verifying protocol behavior such as ordering, backpressure, buffering, arbitration, flow control, and error handling. 
 - Strong debugging skills and the ability to root-cause issues across specification, RTL, and verification environment layers. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work effectively across architecture, design, and verification teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Direct experience verifying coherent interconnect, NoC, cache, or memory-subsystem functionality in multicore or high-performance SoCs. 
 - Experience with subsystem integration and protocol interactions across multiple interfaces or bridge paths. 
 - Familiarity with one or more industry protocols such as AXI, CHI, ACE, CXL, UCIe, or similar high-performance interface standards. 
 - Familiarity with scripting and automation using Python or similar languages. 
 - Experience with formal verification, performance-oriented verification, or emulation / FPGA-assisted debug. 
 - Experience contributing reusable infrastructure or methodology improvements that benefit a broader DV team. 

What Success Looks Like

- Verification plans are complete and aligned with the highest architectural and protocol risks. 
 - Critical coherent-interconnect bugs are found early, debugged efficiently, and closed with durable fixes. 
 - Coverage and verification quality improve meaningfully under your ownership. 
 - The coherent interconnect verification effort becomes more scalable, reusable, and predictable because of your contributions. 
 - Design and architecture teams rely on you as a strong technical partner for difficult protocol, coherency, and integration problems. 

Additional Information: 

This position requires a successful background and reference checks and satisfactory proof of your right to work in: 

India

Any offer of employment for this position is also contingent on the Company verifying that you are a authorized for access to export-controlled technology under applicable export control laws or, if you are not already authorized, our ability to successfully obtain any necessary export license(s) or other approvals.

The Lead Product Owner and System Integration is accountable for the strategic direction and business outcomes of the Digital Energy Software portfolio comprising multiple related Power Management and Building Management System (BMS) product offerings. The role requires deep, hands-on domain knowledge across electrical power monitoring, metering, power quality, protection, energy management, HVAC and building automation, supervisory control, field devices, and their integration with edge supervisors, SCADA platforms and cloud offerings. It translates customer, market and business needs into a coherent portfolio vision and leads end-to-end software system integration testing, product quality and TPO activities across edge, supervisory, SCADA, connectivity and cloud capabilities. The position combines portfolio-level product ownership, leadership of Product Owners, software system integration test leadership, quality governance and controller hardware lifecycle accountability to deliver secure, reliable, scalable and commercially successful Power and BMS solutions. 

The successful candidate will use strong Power and BMS domain expertise to oversee the performance, positioning, roadmaps and investment priorities of multiple product offerings; lead, coach and align the Product Owners responsible for individual offerings or value streams; own the software system integration test strategy, environments, automation and release-quality evidence across edge supervisors, SCADA systems and cloud offerings; and ensure reliable interoperability with controllers, devices, third-party systems and installed-base solutions. 

Key Accountabilities

- Product Ownership and Business Value
 - Define and communicate the portfolio vision, value propositions, target customers and outcome-based roadmaps for multiple Power Management and BMS product offerings, aligned with portfolio and business strategy. 
 - Own the coherence and overall performance of the product portfolio, balancing growth, customer value, innovation, lifecycle health, technical sustainability and investment across offerings. 
 - Lead, coach and develop Product Owners accountable for individual products, platforms or value streams; establish clear decision rights, objectives and accountability for outcomes. 
 - Set the product operating model and common standards for discovery, roadmap management, backlog quality, prioritization, release planning, acceptance and performance measurement. 
 - Integrate offering-level roadmaps into a single portfolio plan, identify dependencies and shared capabilities, and resolve priority or resource conflicts across Product Owners and engineering teams. 
 - Guide Product Owners in translating Power and BMS customer workflows, market needs, electrical and building-system regulations, cybersecurity requirements and operational needs into clear system requirements, epics, user stories and acceptance criteria. 
 - Maintain portfolio-level priorities while ensuring that individual product backlogs are aligned, actionable and focused on the highest-value outcomes. 
 - Make or facilitate timely investment and trade-off decisions across offerings, considering customer value, revenue potential, technical risk, quality, cost, performance, availability and time to market. 
 - Represent the voice of the customer across the portfolio throughout discovery, development, validation, launch, adoption and lifecycle evolution by working closely with league leaders. 
 - Govern release objectives and readiness across offerings, review product increments and support Product Owners in accepting delivered capabilities against agreed outcomes and quality criteria. 
 - Use customer feedback, market evidence, field data, service insights and business metrics to evaluate offering performance and redirect roadmap priorities where needed. 
 - Maintain transparent alignment with stakeholders on portfolio outcomes, investments, dependencies, risks, decisions and delivery progress. 
 - Software System Integration Test Leadership - Edge, SCADA and Cloud
 - Provide site leadership support to System Integration Test team, oversee the end-to-end software system integration test strategy for Power and BMS offerings, validating workflows from field devices and controllers through gateways, edge supervisors and SCADA systems to cloud applications, analytics, APIs and third-party enterprise platforms. 
 - Review critical software integration scope, test sequencing, verification methods, coverage models, entry and exit criteria, acceptance thresholds and release-quality evidence in partnership with System Integration test leads, software architects, DevOps, and cybersecurity teams. 
 - Establish and govern representative software integration environments spanning edge supervisors, SCADA, cloud applications, gateways, controllers, simulated and physical devices, databases, historians, identity services, APIs and third-party integrations. 
 - Oversee validation of edge-to-SCADA and edge-to-cloud interfaces, including protocol translation, data ingestion, command and control, alarms, events, trends, schedules, historian functions, dashboards, reporting and remote operations. 
 - Drive functional, API, protocol, interoperability, regression, user-interface, performance, scale, resilience, failover, cybersecurity, upgrade, migration, backward-compatibility, offline and recovery testing across on-premises, hybrid and cloud deployment models. 
 - Review multi-site and fleet scenarios, tenant isolation, role-based access, configuration deployment, licensing, telemetry, observability, diagnostics and lifecycle-management workflows for Power and BMS cloud offerings. 
 - Ensure end-to-end traceability from customer and software requirements to test cases, automated suites, defects, corrective actions and release evidence. 
 - Participate in cross-functional triage and resolution of complex software integration defects. 
 - Provide technical leadership for the controller and gateway hardware lifecycle supporting regulatory and value engineering activities. 
 - Test Automation and Quality Governance
 - Govern the end-to-end quality strategy across the Power and BMS portfolio. 
 - Drive a risk-based quality approach with consistent quality gates, acceptance thresholds and evidence requirements across all product offerings. 
 - Establish and evolve a scalable test automation strategy spanning API, protocol, user-interface, integration, system and end-to-end layers, with automated execution integrated into CI/CD pipelines where applicable. 
 - Guide the selection and lifecycle management of automation frameworks, reusable libraries, simulators, test rigs, test data and reporting solutions. 
 - Chair portfolio quality reviews at site level and govern defect trends, escape analysis, corrective and preventive actions, technical-debt closure and quality improvement plans. 
 - Define portfolio quality metrics and dashboards, including requirements and risk coverage, automated regression coverage, defect containment, test effectiveness, reliability and field-quality indicators. 
 - Partner with Product Owners, engineering, cybersecurity, operations, suppliers and field teams to embed prevention-focused quality practices throughout discovery, design, development, integration, release and lifecycle support. 

Expected Outcomes

- A coherent Power and BMS portfolio strategy with differentiated product offerings, aligned roadmaps and transparent investment priorities. 
 - Product Owners who operate with clear accountability, consistent product practices and strong ownership of customer and business outcomes. 
 - Coordinated backlogs and release plans that expose and manage dependencies across offerings, platforms and shared capabilities. 
 - Predictable software integration with well-validated interfaces, protocols, data flows, device combinations and end-to-end workflows across edge supervisors, SCADA systems and Power and BMS cloud offerings. 
 - High and reliable automated regression coverage, efficient system test execution, and consistent quality governance across product offerings. 
 - Release decisions supported by objective evidence and end-to-end acceptance criteria. 

Qualifications And Experience

- Bachelor's or master's degree in electrical engineering, Electronics, Computer Engineering, Embedded Systems, Systems Engineering or a related discipline. 
 - 15+ years of relevant product development experience, including significant leadership across integrated hardware-software products. 
 - Mandatory: substantial product and engineering experience in both Power Management and Building Management Systems, with demonstrated understanding of customer applications, market dynamics, installed-base considerations and end-to-end solution architecture. 
 - Demonstrated leadership in software system integration testing, test automation and quality governance for complex Power and BMS solutions spanning edge supervisors, SCADA platforms, cloud offerings, devices and third-party integrations. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading product ownership across multiple product offerings, platforms or value streams, including direct leadership, coaching or functional oversight of Product Owners. 
 - Experience leading globally distributed, cross-functional teams and influencing stakeholders without relying on formal authority. 
 - Experience working with external design partners, manufacturers, certification bodies. 

Technical Knowledge

- Mandatory Power Management expertise: strong knowledge of electrical distribution architectures; power monitoring and control; metering; power quality; protection and control devices; energy management; electrical-system operation; and integration with supervisory, edge and cloud applications. 
 - Mandatory BMS expertise: strong knowledge of building automation architecture; HVAC control; controllers, sensors and actuators; supervisory systems; alarm, trend and scheduling functions; field commissioning; and integration of building subsystems. 
 - Mandatory protocol and interoperability knowledge: practical expertise with relevant Power and BMS communication technologies such as Modbus, BACnet, ION, KNX, M-Bus, OPC UA, MQTT, REST APIs and IP networking, including gateways, edge supervisors, SCADA platforms, cloud connectors, data models, interface specifications and third-party system integration. 
 - Strong understanding of software architecture and end-to-end behaviour across embedded applications, edge supervisors, SCADA platforms, databases, connectivity services, APIs, messaging, identity, observability and Power and BMS cloud offerings. 
 - Working knowledge of requirements engineering, interface specifications and system behaviour sufficient to derive integration test scope, verification methods, coverage and acceptance criteria. 
 - Strong knowledge of software system integration test architecture, test design techniques, requirements and risk traceability, API, protocol and interoperability testing, regression strategy, performance and scalability validation, resilience and failover testing, fault injection, observability and defect root-cause practices. 
 - Hands on experience of test automation frameworks, API and protocol automation, containerised test environments, device and controller simulation, CI/CD integration, cloud test environments, automated reporting and quality analytics. 
 - Strong knowledge of secure-by-design practices, threat modelling, secure boot, identity, encryption, vulnerability management and product security lifecycle expectations for connected Power and BMS products. 
 - Knowledge of applicable electrical, building automation, quality, safety, environmental, electromagnetic compatibility and market certification requirements. 
 - Proficiency with Agile product practices and lifecycle tools for backlog, requirements, architecture, test and defect management. 

Leadership Competencies

- Customer and business orientation: connects technical choices to customer value and commercial outcomes. 
 - Systems thinking: understands end-to-end behaviour, interactions, dependencies, failure modes and test trade-offs across the full product ecosystem. 
 - Decisive ownership: makes timely, evidence-based decisions and remains accountable for outcomes. 
 - Power and BMS software integration-test credibility: applies deep domain knowledge to translate customer applications into representative edge, SCADA and cloud scenarios, assess data, interface, interoperability, performance and cybersecurity risks, and communicate effectively across controls, embedded, software, cloud and quality disciplines. 
 - Influence and collaboration: aligns diverse stakeholders and resolves conflict constructively. 
 - Execution discipline: converts strategy into priorities, plans, acceptance criteria and measurable results. 
 - Quality leadership: establishes a prevention-focused quality culture, uses objective evidence to govern readiness, and balances delivery speed with product reliability and customer risk. 
 - Risk leadership: identifies uncertainty early and creates practical mitigation and contingency plans. 
 - Product leadership and talent development: sets direction for a team of Product Owners, creates clarity of accountability, coaches sound product decisions and builds a strong product ownership community. 

Preferred Experience

- Experience with adjacent connected products, IoT, industrial automation or similar cyber-physical systems beyond the mandatory Power Management and BMS background. 
 - Experience with platform-based product development, reusable architecture and multi-variant product families. 
 - Formal certification in Product Ownership, Agile, systems engineering or project management. 
 - Practical exposure to field deployment, diagnostics, serviceability and telemetry-driven product improvement. 

What's in it for me: 

- Own product strategy for offerings that make a real difference in the market
 - Work alongside passionate, talented teams dedicated to innovation and customer success
 - Career growth opportunities with access to leadership development and mentorship
 - Flexible work environment designed to help you thrive professionally and personally

Bring your product leadership expertise to a team that values your impact - apply today!
