Software Development Engineer II – Sensors / Systems & Security Engineering
data.description:
Most boards and executives are currently flying blind when it comes to cyber risk. They are guessing. At Safe, we've built an AI-driven engine that finally gives the C-Suite a clear, quantified, and real-time view of their security posture. We don't just provide data; we provide certainty. 

We are a $170M Series C-funded category leader. We don't play in the mid-market; we operate at the highest levels of global enterprise. Today, we are proud to serve 10% of the Fortune 500, protecting global icons such as Apple, Netflix, AT&T, Verizon, and Victoria's Secret. 

As we scale toward our next chapter, we are looking for high-performers who want to do the best work of their careers at the intersection of AI and Cybersecurity. 

The Culture Memo: Our Operating System

Safe is not a typical corporate environment. We are a high-intensity, mission-driven team. We value builders who want to define a category and work alongside people who are equally committed to excellence. 

- Extreme Ownership: We don't do "not my job. " We hire people who see a gap and own the solution from start to finish. 
 - The Elite Standard: We serve the most sophisticated companies on the planet. Our work must be bulletproof. Whether it's a line of code or a sales deck, we aim for Tier-1 quality every time. 
 - Methodology & Rigor: We don't wing it. From Force Management and MEDDICC in sales to data-driven sprints in engineering, we rely on proven frameworks to stay disciplined and predictable. 
 - Radical Candor: We move too fast for politics or sugar-coating. We value direct, honest feedback that helps us find the right answer quickly. 
 - The Series C Hustle: We have the stability of a well-funded leader but the heart of a startup. 

The Perks & Ownership: 

We want our team to feel like owners because they are owners. We trust our people to manage their results and their time. 

- Meaningful Equity: Every "Safestar" is a shareholder. You aren't just an employee; you are a partner in our success. 
 - Unlimited Leaves: We don't believe in clock-watching. We offer unlimited leave because we trust you to take the time you need to recharge while staying committed to the mission. 
 - Comprehensive Benefits: We provide top-tier medical insurance and wellness benefits to ensure you and your family are well cared for. 
 - Career Trajectory: We are growing aggressively. For high-performers, the path for advancement moves at the speed of your ambition. 

Role Overview: 

We are looking for an SDE II - Sensors to build customer-deployed security software that runs inside enterprise environments and continuously discovers assets, evaluates exposures, and securely communicates telemetry back to SAFE. 

This role is suited for engineers with strong C++, Go or Python programming skills, Windows/Linux, networking, and cybersecurity fundamentals, particularly those who have worked on endpoint agents, security sensors, network/security products, or other long-running system software. 

What You'll Do: 

- Design and develop lightweight security sensors/agents running inside customer environments. 
 - Build capabilities for asset discovery, network scanning, vulnerability detection and exposure validation. 
 - Develop reliable, long-running system software with a focus on performance, resource usage, concurrency, and stability. 
 - Work extensively with Windows/Linux internals, processes, sockets, filesystems, networking and system APIs. 
 - Build communication between distributed sensors and the SAFE cloud with secure authentication, encryption, retries and offline recovery. 
 - Implement sensor lifecycle management, including installation, configuration, health monitoring and software/rule updates. 
 - Debug complex issues spanning application code, operating systems, customer networks, proxies, firewalls and infrastructure. 
 - Build strong diagnostics, telemetry and logging so problems can be investigated without requiring direct access to customer systems. 
 - Participate in low-level and high-level design discussions and independently own well-defined components/features through production. 

What We're Looking For: 

- 3-6 years of software development experience, preferably building systems, infrastructure or security products. 
 - Strong programming experience in one or more of C++, Go or Python. 
 - Strong understanding of Windows/Linux and operating-system fundamentals. 
 - Good understanding of networking concepts, including: 
 - TCP/IP and sockets
 - DNS
 - HTTP/HTTPS
 - TLS
 - Proxies
 - Routing
 - NAT
 - Firewalls and network segmentation
 - Experience with multithreading/concurrency, asynchronous programming and inter-process communication. 
 - Understanding of software security and secure communication practices. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot issues independently across code, OS and network boundaries. 

Strongly Preferred: 

- Experience building endpoint agents, sensors, collectors, daemons or system services. 
 - Experience working on cybersecurity, endpoint security, vulnerability management, micro-segmentation, EDR or network security products. 
 - Experience building software deployed across large heterogeneous enterprise environments. 
 - Familiarity with CVE, CVSS, vulnerability scanners and exposure management. 
 - Experience with secure auto-update / software distribution mechanisms. 
 - Familiarity with containers and technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Experience developing software that needs to operate reliably across Windows and Linux environments. 

What Good Looks Like: 

You should be comfortable going beyond: 

"The API returned an error. "

and investigating: Sensor → process → socket → DNS → proxy/firewall → network → cloud service to determine exactly where and why something failed. 

You should be equally comfortable reasoning about: 

- Why is a process consuming excessive CPU or memory
 - Why communication works in one customer network but fails in another
 - How to safely upgrade thousands of deployed sensors
 - How to recover when a sensor loses connectivity for several hours
 - How to execute security scans without destabilising customer infrastructure
 - How to collect enough diagnostics to troubleshoot systems you cannot directly access

The ideal candidate is fundamentally a systems/security engineer who can build reliable software, rather than a conventional CRUD/backend application developer. 

If you're passionate about cyber risk, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and want to be part of a team that's redefining security, we want to hear from you! 🚀

data.title: Software Engineer | GO Programming, Cloud-Native, PPPOE/IPOE, Microservices, DHCPV4/DHCPV6 | 8-14 Years
data.description:
Meet the Team

The Cisco cnBNG Control Plane team builds Cisco's cloud-native Broadband Network Gateway - the carrier-grade subscriber-management brain that runs as microservices on the SMI (Subscriber Microservices Infrastructure) / Kubernetes platform and interworks with IOS-XR, Silicon One-based User Plane Functions (UPFs). We power some of the world's largest residential and business broadband deployments, serving millions of subscribers with strict availability and scale requirements. We value technical depth, automation-first engineering, continuous learning, collaborative problem-solving, and responsible adoption of AI-assisted development practices. 

Your Impact

As a Software Engineer on the cnBNG Control Plane, you will own the design, delivery, and end-to-end quality of carrier-grade subscriber-management features in a cloud-native architecture. You will build session-handling, CP-UP separation, redundancy, and scale capabilities that keep millions of subscribers online across Silicon One-based UPFs - and own their unit, integration, system, and scale validation with automation-first practices. You will mentor junior engineers and use modern AI-assisted tools to accelerate development, testing, and debugging. The successful candidate will independently own a significant Control Plane feature area and its unit/integration/system/scale validation and automation, deliver production-quality code and tests, lead sophisticated investigations across CP and Silicon One UPFs, and provide evidence-based release recommendations - while influencing design, mentoring, and using AI-assisted tools responsibly with security and engineering accountability. 

- Design, develop, and maintain cnBNG Control Plane microservices (C/C++/Go) on the SMI/Kubernetes platform, interworking with IOS-XR / Silicon One-based User Plane Functions. 
 - Implement and enhance subscriber-management functionality: PPPoE/IPoE session bring-up, DHCPv4/DHCPv6 (server/proxy/relay), Prefix Delegation, RADIUS/AAA, PAP/CHAP, accounting, Change of Authorization, IPAM, subscriber policy, and QoS. 
 - Develop and harden CP-UP separation over the State Control Interface - session programming, state download/replay, and reconciliation between the Control Plane and Silicon One UPFs. 
 - Build features for scale and high availability: cluster upscale, N: M and geo/warm redundancy (SRG), CP-GR switchover, and subscriber-session continuity during CP-UP communication failures. 
 - Own quality end-to-end: write unit tests and component/integration tests; design and execute system, regression, scale, performance, resiliency, and high-availability tests for your features. 
 - Develop reusable, scalable test automation (Python; pyATS/Genie or equivalent) and integrate it into CI/CD pipelines and regression suites. 
 - Build and maintain containerized/virtual/cloud-based test environments (Docker, Kubernetes, SMI) and validate subscriber-scale, traffic, failover, upgrade/rollback, process-restart, and subscriber-churn scenarios. 
 - Optimize control-plane performance, memory, and convergence for millions of subscribers across large UPF fleets. 
 - Develop and maintain gRPC/REST APIs and YANG/OpenConfig models, plus CLI and model-driven telemetry for configuration and operational visibility. 
 - Troubleshoot sophisticated, distributed issues across CP, Silicon One UPFs, and the SMI/Kubernetes stack; drive RCA using logs, traces, core dumps, RADIUS transactions, and telemetry. 
 - Manage code with Git; participate in code reviews; collaborate with Test Engineering on feature, scale, and HA validation. 
 - Work with architects, DE/DT leads, and PLM to deliver features across the release lifecycle (BC/CC, AC/EC, DEVELOPING, FCS). 
 - Actively use approved AI coding assistants and engineering agents for code generation, unit/automation test creation, static analysis, log analysis, defect triage, and documentation - validating AI-generated output responsibly. 

Minimum Qualifications (Must-Have)

- Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field. 
 - Experience in systems/embedded or cloud-native software engineering for networking products. 
 - Strong programming in C/C++ and/or Go on Linux; Python for test automation and scripting. 
 - Experience writing unit, integration, system, and scale/performance tests, and building automation (pyATS/Genie or equivalent) integrated into CI/CD and regression pipelines. 
 - Solid understanding of IP networking and subscriber/broadband protocols: PPPoE, IPoE, DHCPv4/v6, RADIUS/AAA, PPP, L2TP. 
 - Knowledge of Cisco Silicon One (SiOne) NPU-based User Plane Functions (UPFs) - data-plane/forwarding architecture, CP-to-UPF programming, and how subscriber sessions map to NPU forwarding. 
 - Cloud-native fundamentals: Docker, Kubernetes, microservices, and service meshes. 
 - Experience building and consuming gRPC/REST APIs and data models (YANG, protobuf). 
 - Distributed-systems concepts: high availability, redundancy, state reconciliation, and scale. 
 - Strong Linux skills; experience with Git, code reviews, debugging, and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - AI-assisted engineering is a must: use of AI coding assistants (e. g. , GitHub Copilot) and a working understanding of generative AI, AI agents, MCP (Model Context Protocol), reusable AI skills, prompt/context management, and responsible validation of AI-generated output. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with BNG/CUPS, CP-UP separation, SRG geo/warm redundancy, or 5G/BNG converged-core architectures. 
 - Experience with SMI (Subscriber Microservices Infrastructure) or similar cloud-native telco platforms. 
 - Familiarity with Silicon One platform families (Cisco 8000 / ASR 9000 / NCS) as User Planes. 
 - Scale/performance characterization and traffic/subscriber-simulation tools (IXIA/Spirent). 
 - Databases/caching for network state (SQL/NoSQL, key-value stores, etcd); AAA/policy, IPAM at scale, and QoS. 
 - Telemetry, NETCONF/RESTCONF/gNMI, OpenConfig; Aha/Jira API suites. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Position Summary

JOB DESCRIPTION

- The IBMS System Architecture Expert - Design & Estimation incumbent serves as the primary technical authority for IBMS scope definition, system architecture design, cost estimation, and technical proposal development across mission-critical data centre bids. The role demands deep expertise in Integrated Building Management Systems (IBMS), a thorough understanding of BMS/DDC/PLC controller ecosystems, and the ability to translate complex client requirements into compelling, commercially sound technical proposals. 
 - Working at the intersection of Engineering, Sales, and Solution Architecture, the IBMS System Architecture Expert drives technical credibility during the bid cycle - from RFP/RFQ receipt through final bid submission and post-bid technical clarification. 

B. Bill of Quantities, Cost Estimation & Proposal Development C. Technical Proposals & Bid Documentation D. Client Engagement & Presales Support E. Internal Collaboration & Presales Standards 3. AUTHORITIES

- KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 - System Architecture & Scope Definition
 - Develop full IBMS system architecture proposals for mission-critical data center projects during the bid phase, encompassing BMS, FACP, VESDA, Water Leak Detection (WLD), Access Control, CCTV, Rodent Control, and power/environment monitoring subsystems. 
 - Define BMS controller platform, network topology, and integration architecture - specifying primary, field-level devices, gateways, and communication protocols (BACnet/IP, Modbus, SNMP, OPC-UA). 
 - Prepare detailed I/O point schedules, controller loading calculations, and scan-time calculations for DDC/PLC systems during the estimation phase. 
 - Design IBMS network architecture including data network topology, switch selection criteria, BACnet/IP architecture, and integration requirements for third-party systems (DCIM, EPMS, SCADA/HMI). 
 - Evaluate and recommend open protocol versus proprietary integration strategies, identifying technical risks and mitigations for the proposed architecture. 
 - Define subsystem integration requirements, API/protocol mapping, and IBMS-to-DCIM interoperability architecture for high-density and AI data center environments. 
 - Develop control philosophy summaries and sequences of operation (SOO) drafts to support technical sections of bids, clarifying system-level control strategies without committing to detailed execution design. 
 - Prepare comprehensive Bill of Quantities (BOQ) for IBMS scope across critical and non-critical data center projects, covering all hardware, software, licensing, integration, engineering, and commissioning cost elements. 
 - Develop itemized cost estimation sheets with material, labor, third-party integration, software licensing, and contingency allowances, using established Vertiv rate cards and vendor quotations. 
 - Produce Basis of Estimate (BOE) documents clearly defining scope boundaries, assumptions, exclusions, and unit-cost rationale for each IBMS bid. 
 - Benchmark IBMS costs against historical project data, vendor list prices, and market intelligence to ensure commercial competitiveness without compromising technical quality. 
 - Identify and quantify scope risks in estimates, recommending provisional sums and risk allowances where appropriate. 
 - Prepare and maintain IBMS-specific pricing matrices and parametric estimation models to accelerate turnaround for repeat bid types (colocation, hyperscale, enterprise DC). 
 - Contribute to internal bid review and approval processes - presenting cost models, assumptions, and risks to senior management and business development leads. 
 - Lead preparation of technical proposal sections for IBMS scope in RFP/RFQ responses, including executive summaries, technical narratives, compliance matrices, and scope clarification letters. 
 - Develop technical write-ups describing the proposed IBMS architecture, system capabilities, integration approach, and value differentiators - tailored to client technical and commercial requirements. 
 - Prepare compliance matrices mapping client specifications and standards requirements (IEC 61850, ASHRAE, TIA-942, NFPA 72, EN 54, IS 3043, NBC 2016) against the proposed solution. 
 - Produce scope-of-work documents and exclusion lists that define clear contractual boundaries for the IBMS scope within the overall project. 
 - Develop technical clarification logs and pre-bid query registers, managing responses with accuracy and commercial awareness. 
 - Prepare value engineering proposals and alternative technical solutions where client requirements offer scope for cost optimization without reducing functional integrity. 
 - Ensure all bid documents are produced in accordance with Vertiv brand and documentation standards, with consistent formatting and professional presentation. 
 - Act as the primary technical point of contact for IBMS scope during client pre-bid meetings, site surveys, and technical clarification discussions. 
 - Conduct technical feasibility assessments for proposed IBMS architectures, advising clients and the sales team on achievable scope, realistic timelines, and technical risks. 
 - Prepare and deliver technical presentations, solution overviews, and IBMS architecture demonstrations to client technical teams and procurement stakeholders. 
 - Participate in pre-bid site walks, capturing existing infrastructure constraints, network connectivity requirements, and integration opportunities. 
 - Support post-submission technical discussions, clarifications, and negotiation of technical scope with clients and consultants. 
 - Build and maintain trusted technical relationships with key clients, consultants, and specifiers in the data center and critical infrastructure markets. 
 - Provide technical input to sales team's go/no-go assessments, identifying bid qualification criteria and scope risks early in the sales cycle. 
 - Collaborate with Sales, Solution Architecture, Project Management, and Commercial teams throughout the bid lifecycle, ensuring aligned scope, schedule, and cost assumptions. 
 - Maintain and continuously improve IBMS presales estimation templates, BOQ master libraries, and technical proposal boilerplate in line with evolving product platforms and market requirements. 
 - Conduct lessons-learned analysis on won and lost bids to refine estimation accuracy, technical positioning, and proposal quality. 
 - Support peer review and quality assurance of IBMS proposals prepared by other team members, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and compliance with Vertiv standards. 
 - Provide technical mentoring and knowledge transfer to junior presales engineers and sales staff on IBMS architecture concepts and estimation methodology. 
 - Interface with the Vertiv product management and engineering teams to stay current on controller platforms, new product introductions, and integration capabilities relevant to presales. 

The IBMS System Architecture Expert - Presales & Estimation holds the following delegated authorities within the presales and estimation function: 

- Approve IBMS BOQ, cost estimates, and technical proposals prior to submission to the commercial review board, within authorized value limits. 
 - Define and confirm IBMS technical scope inclusions and exclusions in bid submissions without requiring individual engineering sign-off for standard scope items. 
 - Recommend go/no-go decisions on IBMS scope elements and flag technical red-flags to the Bid Manager or Lead Controls Engineer. 
 - Engage directly with clients, consultants, and specialist vendors during the bid phase for technical clarifications, pre-bid meetings, and scope discussions. 
 - Request vendor quotations for specialist IBMS equipment, software, and integration services to support estimation. 
 - Propose value engineering changes and alternative technical solutions during bid development, subject to review by the Lead Controls Engineer. 
 - Reject internally submitted estimation data or technical content that does not meet Vertiv quality standards or accuracy thresholds. 

4. QUALIFICATIONS 4. 1 Education

- Dip OR bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, Electronics & Communication, Instrumentation, Automation & Control, or a closely related technical discipline. 
 - Additional certifications in BMS/IBMS platforms are strongly preferred: Distech Controls, Niagara Framework / Tridium JACE, Honeywell, or Schneider Electric EcoStruxure. 
 - Training or certification in estimation methodology, technical proposal writing, or pre-sales engineering is a positive differentiator. 
 - Project management training (PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent) is advantageous for managing complex bid timelines and multi-stakeholder reviews. 

4. 2 Experience

- 5-7 years of progressive experience in IBMS/BMS controls engineering, with a minimum of 4 years in a presales, estimation, or solution architecture capacity. 
 - Demonstrated track record of preparing IBMS BOQs, cost estimates, and technical proposals for mission-critical data center projects. 
 - Hands-on experience with BMS controller platforms - DDC/PLC platforms. 
 - Proven experience defining IBMS network architectures and communication integration strategies (BACnet/IP, Modbus TCP, SNMP, OPC-UA, REST API). 
 - Experience engaging with clients, consultants, and specifiers in a presales or solution-advisory capacity for critical infrastructure projects. 
 - Familiarity with data center standards and design criteria: ASHRAE, TIA-942, IEC 61850, EN 54, NFPA 72, IS 3043, NBC 2016. 
 - Exposure to high-density cooling architectures (DLC, liquid cooling, CDUs) and AI data center workloads is highly advantageous. 

4. 3 Technical Skills Matrix

Skill Area Proficiency Required

IBMS Subsystems Deep understanding of BMS, FACP, VESDA, WLD, Rodent Control, CCTV, Access Control, MDBs, and EPMS in critical data center facilities. 

Controller Platforms Proficiency in controller loading calculations, I/O mapping, and scan-time calculations for DDC/PLC systems. 

BOQ & Cost Estimation Ability to prepare detailed, accurate IBMS BOQs and cost estimation sheets including hardware, software, licensing, integration, and engineering effort. 

Network & Integration Architecture Proficiency in IBMS network topology design, protocol selection (BACnet/IP, Modbus, SNMP, OPC-UA), switch sizing, and third-party integration mapping (DCIM, SCADA, EPMS). 

Technical Proposal Writing Ability to produce clear, structured technical narratives, compliance matrices, scope-of-work documents, and value engineering proposals for complex bids. 

Standards & Codes Working knowledge of IEC 61850, EN 54, NFPA 72, ASHRAE, TIA-942, BS EN 62305, IS 3043, NBC 2016, and Vertiv internal standards (G-FI-PL-006). 

Thermal Management Knowledge of data center thermal management: CRAH/CRAC, chilled water plant, CDU/liquid cooling (DLC), and environmental monitoring in high-density environments. 

Software Tools MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, Visio, Project), AutoCAD, estimation/CPQ tools, and documentation management platforms. 

SCADA / HMI / DCIM Familiarity with SCADA/HMI platforms for IBMS visualization, alarm management, and DCIM integration for data center monitoring. 

4. 4 Soft Skills & Competencies

- Excellent written and verbal communication in English; ability to present complex IBMS architecture concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Commercial acumen: ability to balance technical quality with cost competitiveness and understand bid strategy and margin implications. 
 - Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills; able to decompose complex client requirements into definable, priceable scope elements. 
 - High attention to detail with the ability to maintain accuracy across large, multi-subsystem BOQs and complex technical proposals. 
 - Ability to manage multiple concurrent bids under time pressure without compromising quality or accuracy. 
 - Collaborative team player with the confidence to challenge technical and commercial assumptions respectfully and constructively. 
 - Self-motivated with a quality-first mindset; proactive in identifying risks and gaps during the bid cycle. 

5. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience working with the Vertiv InfraSol platform or similar critical infrastructure integrated solutions in a presales or solution architecture capacity. 
 - Familiarity with AI data center workloads - high-density liquid cooling (DLC/immersion), power distribution architecture, and intelligent environmental monitoring. 
 - PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certification, demonstrating structured approach to managing bid timelines and multi-stakeholder reviews. 
 - Knowledge of ISA/IEC instrumentation standards and engineering flowchart conventions for controls systems architecture. 
 - Experience preparing parametric estimation models and CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) frameworks for repeatable IBMS bid packages. 
 - Demonstrated experience with multi-hyperscale or multi-colocation client environments - understanding of client template specifications and standard scope requirements. 
 - Familiarity with sustainability-driven IBMS features: energy monitoring, power analytics, PUE optimization, and ESG reporting integration for data centers. 

6. PHYSICAL & ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS

- Primarily office-based role with occasional site visits required for pre-bid surveys, client technical meetings, and solution demonstration events. 
 - Comfortable working in active data center environments during pre-bid site surveys: raised floors, live electrical equipment, and operational cooling infrastructure. 
 - Ability to work extended hours during peak bid periods, proposal submission deadlines, and multi-bid parallel cycles. 
 - Travel required: approximately 10-25% of working time, primarily domestic within India, with occasional international travel for major client engagements or vendor partner events.

data.title: Lead Software Engineer (AI and DevOps)
data.description:
Lead Software Engineer - AI and DevOps

What Makes Us, Us

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values - caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered. 

If you like what we're saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

In SimCorp, we help some of the biggest financial institutions in the world be successful by simplifying their accounting, operations, and investments. We do this through IT systems, processes, and financial knowledge. High quality, performing, secure, and cost-effective software is at the core of what we do. To build, maintain and operate this software, engineers are essential to us. 

SimCorp's AI & Insights area is building the foundation for the agentic future of investment operations: Running SimCorp agents, leveraging partner agents, and integrating with clients workflows. The AI Platform team owns that foundation: a compliant, standardized, secure, and user-friendly agentic ecosystem that domain teams can leverage when building their AI features. 

The team's recent deliveries and current focus include preparing Agent Orchestrator and SimCorp One Neo for production, publishing the Agent Development Stack, implementing evaluation, trust, safety and guardrails, progressing multi-agent orchestration, and exploring MCP for SimCorp One APIs. 

You will be working with a team located in Noida/Hyderabad in India and Copenhagen, Denmark. The Product Development team functions as a center of enablement for artificial intelligence (AI), providing knowledge and guidelines to other teams, as well as working hands on implementing and operating solutions with AI. 

What You Will Be Responsible For

The Lead Software Engineer (DevOps) at SimCorp, at the IC5 grade, is responsible for

DevOps best practices and the Azure cloud ecosystem for AI enabled software solutions. This role requires a strong mix of hands-on engineering, architectural thinking, and leadership to ensure both immediate delivery and long-term sustainability. You will be part of a scrum team working closely with Product Owner and business stakeholders. The Lead Software Engineer takes ownership of key engineering projects, provides technical guidance to junior engineers, and ensures that software is delivered on time and within scope. This position requires strong problem-solving skills, expertise in software engineering practices, and the ability to work in a collaborative and fast-paced environment. 

We work team-based, so your primary responsibility is as a team member. You need to make sure the team delivers on its commitments, that it's a good place to work for you and your teammates, and that it continuously improves. 

Daily tasks are for example: 

- Build and maintain Infrastructure, CI/CD process and monitoring for AI solutions developed using C#, . Net and Azure. 
 - Going from proof-of-concepts to high quality, production ready solutions. 
 - Lead the design and development of DevOps solutions and infrastructure ensuring they meet business needs and technical requirements
 - Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineering team, fostering a collaborative and high-performance environment
 - Collaborate with product management, design, and quality assurance teams to ensure seamless integration and delivery of software solutions. 
 - Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues, ensuring high-quality solutions that are scalable, reliable, and performant
 - Ensure adherence to Devops best practices, including industry standards, testing, and documentation
 - Take ownership of key features and components, driving their design and implementation from concept to delivery
 - Continuously assess and improve engineering processes, AI advancements, automation, recommending new tools and technologies to enhance productivity and software quality
 - Participate in code reviews, ensuring that the team follows best practices and maintains high standards for azure infrastructure and pipelines. 

What We Value

Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. 

- 7+ years of hands-on experience with DevOps. 
 - Deep understanding of modern CI/CD, industry best practices and tooling
 - Sound understanding of Azure cloud services, infrastructure, pipelines, scalability and architecture
 - Experience deploying solutions using Azure OpenAI, Azure Foundry, model versioning & quota mgmt. 
 - Experience with RAG pipelines (Azure AI Search, embedding pipelines, indexing jobs)
 - Exposure to Agentic frameworks (MAF, MCP/A2A plugins, etc)
 - Observability design (App Insights/Azure Monitor, OpenTelemetry) and incident response
 - Good understanding of Managed Identity first, Key Vault integration, secure network boundaries, Azure Policy, RBAC, networking, private endpoints
 - Solid experience of Azure Bicep, PowerShell scripts and Yaml for IaC. 
 - Understanding of data governance (PII, tenant isolation) for AI workloads

As a person, you have the following traits: 

- Taking ownership. Comfortable taking the lead on tasks. 
 - Earn trust, think big, and take calculated risks. 
 - You collaborate with team members to work towards common goals. 
 - Solid problem-solving skills and comfortable questioning assumptions and as-is. 
 - Exhibits a consistent approach and a creative mindset. 
 - Thrives in a collaborative environment and values teamwork
 - Like to have fun at work and positivity comes easily to you
 - Excellent English verbal and communication skills

Benefits

- Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course you are welcome at the office if that is your preference. 
 - Growth and innovation - Every 6th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team or the application. 
 - Self-Direction - High degree of self-organization. Each team and developer have a high degree of freedom to plan, organize and design their work. 
 - Inclusive and diverse company culture
 - Work-life balance - We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace
 - Empowerment - We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process. 

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks. 

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone's experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated. 

Who We Are

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world's leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3, 000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds. 

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients. 

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

data.title: Lead Engineer, EDT Data & Analytics Cloud Engineering
data.description:
The Lead Cloud Platform Engineer supports the operational excellence, security, and reliability of the enterprise data & analytics platform on Azure and Databricks. The role combines platform operations, DevOps automation, and Infrastructure as Code across the core stack - Azure Databricks, Synapse, ADLS Gen2, Azure SQL, Azure Data Factory, Key Vault, and Unity Catalog - with a reliability-engineering mindset: automate repeatable work, apply security best practices by default, and help keep the platform highly available for global data engineering and analytics teams. 

What you will do: 

DevOps Pipeline Management & CI/CD

- Design, build, test, and operate Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines that package code, run automated quality checks, deploy infrastructure and data workloads, and promote releases across development, testing, and production environments. 
 - Own day-to-day pipeline execution and release readiness by monitoring runs, diagnosing failed builds and deployments, correcting pipeline definitions, and improving rollback, approval, and promotion controls. 

Infrastructure as Code & Environment Provisioning

- Write, review, and maintain Terraform modules for repeatable provisioning of Azure and Databricks platform components; test changes through plan and deployment cycles and keep modules versioned and reusable. 
 - Provision and configure workspaces, compute, storage, networking, private connectivity, identities, and access through automated IaC processes; detect configuration drift and implement corrective changes. 

Platform Security & Access Management

- Configure and troubleshoot RBAC, service principals, managed identities, secrets, storage permissions, cluster policies, and Unity Catalog grants across Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Synapse, Azure SQL, ADLS Gen2, and Key Vault. 
 - Apply and verify least-privilege access, identity integration, and secrets-management controls through hands-on configuration reviews, access testing, and remediation of security findings. 

Platform Operations & Reliability Engineering

- Build and tune monitoring, alerts, dashboards, and operational runbooks; participate directly in incident response, perform root-cause analysis, and implement preventive automation and reliability fixes. 
 - Monitor integration runtimes, clusters, jobs, pipelines, and platform services; inspect logs and metrics, reproduce failures, resolve runtime and performance issues, and validate service recovery against SLAs. 

Data Engineering Operations

- Work directly with Data Platform and Data Product teams to deploy and operationalize ingestion pipelines, orchestration, Databricks jobs, and supporting platform services; provide hands-on support through production rollout. 

Collaboration

- Translate stakeholders into implementable technical changes, contribute code and configuration, lead technical working sessions, and document the resulting solution and operational handoff. 

What you need: 

- Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related technical discipline. 
 - 5-7 years of experience designing, engineering, and supporting cloud-based data and analytics platforms, data warehouses, and modern data ecosystems. 
 - Strong hands-on expertise with Azure data services, including Azure Databricks, Synapse Analytics, ADLS Gen2, Azure SQL, Azure Data Factory, Key Vault, and Unity Catalog. 
 - Proven experience implementing platform security controls, governance frameworks, and Azure data platform best practices to ensure secure, scalable, and compliant solutions. 
 - Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform and Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, with experience automating deployments across multiple environments. 
 - Demonstrated ability to monitor, optimize, and troubleshoot cloud data platforms, including performance tuning, alerting, incident management, and root cause analysis. 
 - Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, operations, security, and business stakeholders. 
 - Proactive mindset with a track record of driving automation, process optimization, operational improvements, and scalable platform enhancements that increase efficiency and reliability. 
 - Cloud Engineering certifications on Azure/Databricks platform is a plus.

Agratas is a global battery business within the Tata Group. We'll design, develop and manufacture high-quality, high performance, sustainable battery solutions. We've entered our industrialization phase, building world-class battery manufacturing facilities in Sanand, India, and in Bridgwater, UK, unlocking green growth opportunities for global customers in the mobility and energy sectors. 

The Opportunity

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Vision Systems Engineer to join our dynamic team in the battery manufacturing industry. The ideal candidate will have a passion for automation and machine vision, with a strong background in engineering and hands-on experience with vision system integration in a manufacturing environment. The Vision Systems Engineer will be proactive, collaborative, and capable of solving complex technical challenges while maintaining a focus on quality, efficiency, and innovation. 

Key Accountabilities and Responsibilities

- Design & Development of Vision Systems: Lead the design, development, and deployment of vision systems to automate inspection, measurement, and quality control in battery production processes. 
 - System Integration & Optimization: Integrate vision systems with existing manufacturing processes, including robotics and automated production lines, ensuring smooth functionality and improved performance. 
 - Image Processing & Algorithm Development: Develop and implement image processing algorithms and vision inspection applications using tools such as Keyence, Cognex, OpenCV, C++, and MATLAB to detect defects, measure components, and support automated decision-making.

data.title: SiC Product Engineer
data.description:
Job Purpose

Navitas Semiconductor (Nasdaq: NVTS) is a next-generation power semiconductor leader driving innovation in gallium nitride (GaN) and high-voltage silicon carbide (SiC) technologies. Our products enable faster, more efficient power delivery across AI data centers, high-performance computing, energy and grid infrastructure, and industrial electrification. 

We are seeking a SiC Product Engineer to support new product development, characterization, qualification, and release of power MOSFET products. The successful candidate will bring hands-on product engineering experience in silicon semiconductor technology and apply strong fundamentals in semiconductor physics, MOSFET and Diode device behavior, device characterization, and data analysis. Experience with SiC power devices is preferred. 

Key Responsibilities And Duties

- Execute product engineering activities for assigned SiC MOSFET products from engineering samples through characterization, qualification, product release, and transition to sustaining support. 
 - Develop and execute device characterization plans covering key static and dynamic electrical parameters across voltage, current, and temperature conditions. 
 - Analyze wafer probe (CP), final test (FT), and quality-control (QC) data to assess distributions, yield, correlations, outliers, and product performance against specifications. 
 - Support definition and optimization of test limits, guard bands, test methods, and product screening requirements in collaboration with test, device, quality, and reliability teams. 
 - Investigate parametric, yield, and reliability excursions using structured data analysis, electrical characterization, and failure-analysis results; drive issues to documented closure. 
 - Support product qualification activities, reliability data review, engineering lot disposition, risk assessment, and formal product-release readiness. 
 - Generate clear characterization reports, data summaries, specification recommendations, datasheet inputs, and technical documentation required for product release. 
 - Coordinate with device engineering, wafer foundry, package engineering, assembly and test partners, quality, reliability, applications, and operations to resolve product issues and meet program milestones. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's or master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Semiconductor Engineering, Applied Physics, or a related discipline. 
 - 3-5 years of semiconductor product engineering experience, with hands-on experience supporting silicon-based semiconductor products. 
 - Experience with SiC power devices is preferred; candidates with strong silicon MOSFET product-engineering experience and demonstrated ability to learn wide-bandgap technology will be considered. 
 - Basic understanding of semiconductor physics and MOSFET device behavior is required. 
 - Hands-on experience with semiconductor device characterization and laboratory equipment. 
 - Experience analyzing electrical test data, yield distributions, correlations, and process or lot variation; proficiency with Excel and statistical analysis tools is expected. 
 - Working knowledge of wafer probe, final test, product qualification, reliability testing, failure analysis, and semiconductor manufacturing flow is preferred. 
 - Strong problem-solving, technical documentation, cross-functional communication, and execution skills in a fast-paced engineering environment. 

What We Offer

- A front-row seat to the future of power electronics. Work on cutting-edge GaN and SiC technologies that are transforming AI data centers, electrification, and global energy infrastructure. 
 - A fast-paced, high-energy environment. We move quickly, make decisions with purpose, and empower employees to take ownership and drive real impact from day one. 
 - A team that shows up and delivers. We care deeply about our mission, our customers, and each other. We collaborate, support one another, and bring intensity and accountability to everything we do. 
 - Full support to succeed. You'll have access to leadership, cross-functional collaboration, and the resources needed to innovate and execute at a high level. 
 - Competitive total rewards. Competitive compensation package including base salary, performance bonus, and equity awards.

data.title: Medical Coding Manager
data.description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all. 

Role Summary

Medical Coding Manager is a people leadership role responsible for overseeing medical coding quality, compliance, and operational performance across front-end coding and denials coding workflows. This position is based in Chennai, India and follows a hybrid work model. In this role, you will help maintain accurate coding practices, support revenue cycle outcomes, and contribute to a collaborative, high-volume healthcare environment. This position reports to the Coding Director. 

Team Summary

The Medical Coding Manager will join a revenue cycle management team focused on coding quality, coding compliance, and denial resolution support. The team partners closely with operational and client-facing groups to help improve coding accuracy, reduce rework, and support timely reimbursement outcomes. This role contributes to a team environment that values accountability, accuracy, and continuous process improvement. 

Job Ad

We are looking for a Medical Coding Manager to join our team within the Technology Enabled Services organization. In this role, you will support medical coding operations that help ensure compliance with healthcare regulations and timely delivery of coding services for clients. 

You will lead daily coding activities across front-end coding and denials coding workflows, while supporting quality, productivity, and consistency across the team. The ideal candidate brings experience in a healthcare revenue cycle management environment, a strong understanding of coding standards, and the ability to guide work in a fast-paced setting. 

This role is well suited for someone who can balance operational oversight with hands-on problem solving, communicate clearly across teams, and use sound judgment to support accurate coding outcomes. You will also help strengthen workflow efficiency, support team development, and contribute to ongoing process improvements. 

Essential Job Responsibilities

- Manage daily medical coding operations across front-end coding and denials coding workflows. 
 - Oversee coding quality, accuracy, and turnaround expectations in alignment with healthcare regulations and internal standards. 
 - Review complex coding scenarios and support resolution of coding-related issues. 
 - Lead team performance through workload coordination, coaching, and regular feedback. 
 - Partner with operational and cross-functional teams to address coding denials and process gaps. 
 - Monitor key performance measures related to quality, productivity, and service delivery. 
 - Support coding compliance efforts by applying current coding guidelines and documentation standards. 
 - Guide the team in applying AI-enabled tools and workflow improvements to increase efficiency, while using professional judgment to validate outputs and maintain coding accuracy. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement efforts that strengthen coding processes and reduce rework. 
 - Ensure timely escalation and resolution of coding issues that may affect client outcomes. 

Additional Job Responsibilities

- Assist with onboarding and knowledge sharing for new team members. 
 - Support audits and internal reviews related to coding quality and compliance. 
 - Collaborate on updates to coding workflows, policies, and team reference materials. 
 - Participate in meetings to discuss operational priorities and service delivery needs. 
 - Provide input on training needs based on trends, findings, or recurring errors. 
 - Help maintain documentation related to coding processes and team standards. 
 - Contribute to special projects supporting coding operations or revenue cycle initiatives. 
 - Perform other duties as assigned based on team and business needs. 

Expected Education & Experience

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience. 
 - Active coding certification required: Certified Professional Coder (CPC), Certified Interventional Coder (CIC), Certified Coding Specialist (CCS), or equivalent. 
 - 10-13 years of experience in medical coding and/or healthcare revenue cycle management. 
 - 8-10 years of experience in a fast-paced healthcare environment, with hands-on experience in front-end coding and denials coding. 
 - Experience in healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM) is required. 
 - Working experience in inpatient Diagnosis-Related Group (DRG) coding is preferred. 
 - Strong knowledge of coding guidelines, documentation standards, and reimbursement workflows. 
 - Ability to manage coding work in a dynamic, deadline-driven environment. 
 - Experience supporting quality review, coding compliance, and denial resolution processes. 
 - Clear communication and collaboration skills for working with internal partners and operational teams. 

About Athenahealth

Our vision: In an industry that becomes more complex by the day, we stand for simplicity. We offer IT solutions and expert services that eliminate the daily hurdles preventing healthcare providers from focusing entirely on their patients - powered by our vision to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all. 

Our company culture: Our talented employees - or athenistas, as we call ourselves - spark the innovation and passion needed to accomplish our vision. We are a diverse group of dreamers and do-ers with unique knowledge, expertise, backgrounds, and perspectives. We unite as mission-driven problem-solvers with a deep desire to achieve our vision and make our time here count. Our award-winning culture is built around shared values of inclusiveness, accountability, and support. 

Our DEI commitment: Our vision of accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all requires addressing the inequities that stand in the way. That's one reason we prioritize diversity, equity, and inclusion in every aspect of our business, from attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce to maintaining an inclusive environment for athenistas, our partners, customers and the communities where we work and serve. 

What We Can Do For You

Along with health and financial benefits, athenistas enjoy perks specific to each location, including commuter support, employee assistance programs, tuition assistance, employee resource groups, and collaborative workspaces - some offices even welcome dogs. 

We also encourage a better work-life balance for athenistas with our flexibility. While we know in-office collaboration is critical to our vision, we recognize that not all work needs to be done within an office environment, full-time. With consistent communication and digital collaboration tools, athenahealth enables employees to find a balance that feels fulfilling and productive for each individual situation. 

In addition to our traditional benefits and perks, we sponsor events throughout the year, including book clubs, external speakers, and hackathons. We provide athenistas with a company culture based on learning, the support of an engaged team, and an inclusive environment where all employees are valued. 

Learn more about our culture and benefits here: athenahealth. com/careers

data.title: Software Architect
data.description:
About the Role

Responsive is looking for a product-minded Software Architect with deep technical expertise and a strong track record of designing and scaling multi-tenant B2B SaaS applications. 

We are looking for someone who can drive architecture across scalability, security, performance, reliability, and cloud-native systems, while also evaluating and adopting emerging technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI, and modern search technologies. 

What You'll Be Doing

- SaaS Architecture: Design and evolve scalable, secure, and reliable multi-tenant SaaS platforms. 
 - Scalability & Performance: Architect systems to support growing customers, users, workloads, and data volumes while maintaining strong performance. 
 - Security & Reliability: Define architecture for tenant isolation, access control, data protection, high availability, and fault tolerance. 
 - Technical Leadership: Lead architecture reviews, drive key technical decisions, mentor engineers, and establish engineering best practices. 
 - Cloud & Platform Engineering: Design cloud-native solutions across microservices, APIs, databases, caching, messaging, and containerized platforms. 
 - Emerging Technologies: Evaluate and guide the adoption of LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI, AI orchestration, semantic search, and other emerging technologies. 
 - Collaboration: Work closely with engineering, product, security, and infrastructure teams to align technology decisions with business goals. 

What We're Looking For

Education: 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Experience: 

- 14+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 5 years in architecture or senior technical leadership roles. 
 - Strong experience designing and scaling multi-tenant B2B SaaS or enterprise applications. Skills, Qualifications & Ability: 

- Deep understanding of multi-tenant SaaS architecture, including tenant isolation, data segregation, authorization, and configuration. 
 - Strong experience with distributed systems, microservices, APIs, and cloud-native architectures. 
 - Strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, and backend system design. 
 - Experience with React and modern frontend technologies, with a good understanding of frontend architecture and integration with backend services. 
 - Experience with MongoDB, SQL/NoSQL databases, caching, messaging, and event-driven architectures. 
 - Strong knowledge of scalability, performance optimization, high availability, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery. 
 - Strong understanding of application security, cloud security, authentication, authorization, and data protection. 
 - Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP, Kubernetes, Docker, and CI/CD. 
 - Experience with observability, monitoring, logging, and distributed tracing. 
 - Understanding of LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI, AI agents, semantic search, vector search, and AI orchestration frameworks. 
 - Strong problem-solving, communication, mentoring, and technical leadership skills. 

What Can Help You Stand Out

- Experience scaling multi-tenant SaaS platforms across large customers, users, and data volumes. 
 - Experience leading major platform modernization, scalability, security, or performance initiatives. 
 - Experience building or architecting AI-powered applications using LLMs, RAG, or Agentic AI. 
 - Experience designing globally distributed, highly available cloud platforms.

Job Category

Software Engineering

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword - it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. 

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. 

About Salesforce

We're Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI+ Data +CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer, too - driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good- you've come to the right place. 

Role Description

The Engineering Manager demonstrates deep business, industry, and product knowledge to ensure the success of our customers by effectively managing a team of Engineers and Architects. In this role, the Engineering Manager will specialize in one or more lines of business, a specific cloud or industry to speak the customer language and ensure customer value realization. They are aligned by cloud strategy, building and encouraging positive relationships to help customers progress on their digital journey. 

Salesforce is looking for technically strong, energetic, highly collaborative, and passionate leaders to lead our software engineering teams! You will run and lead a team/teams of outstanding developers and keep quality in mind. We work in a collaborative environment, and we value open communication and feedback, code reviews, and making learning fun!

Your Impact

- Drive the execution and delivery of features by collaborating with many multi-functional teams, architects, product owners and engineer
 - Make critical decisions that attribute to the success of the product
 - Proactive in foreseeing issues and resolving it before it happens
 - Daily management of stand-ups as the Scrum Master for engineering teams
 - Partner with PO to align with objectives, priorities, tradeoffs, and risk
 - Ensuring teams have clear priorities and adequate resources
 - Empowering the delivery team to self coordinate
 - Be a multiplier and have a passion for team and team members' success
 - Providing technical guidance, career development, and mentoring to team members
 - Maintaining high morale and motivating the delivery team to go above and beyond
 - Vocally advocating for technical excellence and helping the teams make good decisions
 - Participating in architecture discussions and planning
 - Participating in multi-functional coordination, planning, and reviews with leads from other engineering teams
 - Maintaining and encouraging our culture by interviewing and hiring only the most qualified individuals
 - Build and ship high-quality, production-grade software using modern engineering practices, with AI as a core part of your development workflow by pushing the boundaries of AI development tools to deliver secure, optimized, and high-quality code. 
 - Design and orchestrate complex systems where AI agents integrate seamlessly into human workflows, driving efficiency and innovation at scale. 
 - Contribute to building and maintaining the shared system context, an explicit repository of system designs, constraints, and standards that enables AI to operate accurately and reliably. 
 - Critically evaluate code (Human or AI-generated) for correctness, quality, security, and performance. 
 - Occasionally chipping in to development tasks such as coding and feature verifications to assist teams with release commitments, to gain an understanding of the deeply technical product as well as to keep your technical skill sharp

Minimum Requirements

- A demonstrated, genuine AI-first approach to engineering. Using AI to move faster, build fluency across the stack, and contribute well beyond your core specialty. 
 - Experience using AI tools (e. g. , Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor, etc. ) in development workflows. 
 - Advanced prompt engineering skills and the ability to write precise, structured prompts and cultivate the system context that makes AI outputs reliable, secure, and production-ready. 
 - A related technical degree required
 - 3 + years of proven track record leading software engineering teams with a distinguished track record on technically fast paced projects
 - Experience leading large scale distributed systems, working with microservices and/or distributed architecture
 - Strong verbal and written communication skills, organizational and time management skills
 - Ability to be flexible, proactive, comfortable working with minimal specifications
 - Experience with short release cycles, the full software lifecycle, and experience working on a product that's been released for public consumption
 - Experience in hiring, mentoring and leading engineers
 - Working experience of software engineering best practices including coding standards, code reviews, SCM, CI, build processes, testing, and operations
 - Experience with Agile development methodologies. Scrum Master experience required
 - Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and product management to understand requirements, describe software product features, and technical designs

Preferred Requirements

- Strong knowledge of Salesforce product and platform features, capabilities, and best use of it
 - Able to articulate the importance and value of Governance to Business and IT executives
 - A good understanding of enterprise architecture principles is strongly preferred
 - Ability to quickly grasp and distinctly explain technological and business concepts
 - Serve as a trusted advisor, with a deep curiosity to understand your customers, their motivations and needs, and how to approach ensuring their success
 - Degree or equivalent relevant experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core competencies for the role (e. g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc. )

Benefits & Perks

- Comprehensive benefits package including well-being reimbursement, generous parental leave, adoption assistance, fertility benefits, and more!
 - World-class enablement and on-demand training with Trailhead. com
 - Exposure to executive thought leaders and regular 1: 1 coaching with leadership
 - Volunteer opportunities and participation in our 1: 1: 1 model for giving back to the community
 - For more details, visit https: //www. salesforcebenefits. com/

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you'll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we'll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future - but to redefine what's possible - for yourself, for AI, and the world. 

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form. 

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates' resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options. 

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that's inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications - without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

data.title: Senior Member of Technical Staff – SMTS
data.description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all. 

Role Summary

The Senior Member of Technical Staff (SMTS) will join the Dev Portal team within athenahealth's Chennai R&D Internal Developer Platform organization. This role is for an experienced full-stack software engineer with a strong platform engineering mindset who is passionate about improving the developer experience at scale. 

The SMTS will help design and build platform capabilities that simplify how engineering teams discover, build, integrate, and operate software. This role partners with engineering, product, architecture, and platform leaders to solve complex developer productivity problems and translate them into scalable, reusable platform solutions. 

The ideal candidate has strong software engineering fundamentals, high learnability, and the ability to operate across a rapidly evolving technology landscape. The role requires comfort working across frontend applications, backend services, APIs, cloud-native technologies, integrations, and developer tooling while providing technical direction for complex initiatives. 

Team Summary

The Developer Portal team is part of athenahealth's Internal Developer Platform organization and is focused on building a cohesive and scalable developer experience for engineering teams. 

Backstage is one of the foundational technologies in this ecosystem, providing a centralized experience for developers to discover services, APIs, documentation, engineering standards, and platform capabilities. The team builds platform products and reusable engineering capabilities that reduce developer cognitive load, improve engineering efficiency, and enable teams to deliver software safely and effectively at scale. 

Essential Job Responsibilities

- Lead the design, development, and evolution of scalable Internal Developer Platform capabilities that simplify the developer experience and address common engineering needs across teams. 
 - Own complex platform initiatives from problem definition and architecture through implementation, production rollout, observability, and continuous improvement. 
 - Design and implement self-service engineering workflows, golden paths, software templates, platform APIs, and reusable abstractions that reduce developer cognitive load and dependencies on platform teams. 
 - Build full-stack platform solutions spanning modern web applications, backend services, APIs, integrations, data stores, and cloud-native environments. 
 - Define and evolve platform standards, engineering guardrails, design patterns, and best practices that enable teams to build and deliver software consistently and safely. 
 - Drive cloud-native platform solutions leveraging Kubernetes, AWS, containers, and modern infrastructure patterns, with a focus on scalability, reliability, security, performance, and maintainability. 
 - Evaluate architectural alternatives and technical trade-offs, establish technical direction, and drive alignment for initiatives spanning multiple systems and engineering teams. 
 - Improve developer productivity by simplifying and streamlining workflows across the software development lifecycle, from development and source control through build, testing, deployment, observability, and operations. 
 - Proactively identify and eliminate developer friction across source control, CI/CD, testing, deployment, observability, governance, and platform consumption. 
 - Partner closely with engineering teams to understand developer pain points and translate them into scalable platform capabilities rather than one-off solutions. 
 - Use platform adoption signals, engineering effectiveness metrics, and developer feedback to identify opportunities and continuously improve the developer experience. 
 - Build robust integrations with engineering systems including source control, CI/CD platforms, quality engineering tools, observability platforms, cloud infrastructure, documentation systems, and other SDLC technologies. 
 - Provide technical leadership for the development and evolution of Backstage as a key foundation of athenahealth's Developer Portal and Internal Developer Platform ecosystem. 
 - Design and build Backstage plugins, platform integrations, software catalog capabilities, APIs, software templates, and developer self-service experiences. 
 - Drive capabilities around software metadata management, service discovery, software ownership visibility, catalog governance, and operational excellence. 
 - Evolve the Developer Portal into a cohesive experience for discovering services, APIs, documentation, engineering standards, platform capabilities, and developer workflows. 
 - Ensure Backstage integrates effectively with authoritative engineering systems while providing developers with a consistent discovery, aggregation, ownership, and navigation experience. 
 - Provide technical leadership for complex initiatives, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and driving solutions from concept through production. 
 - Establish and promote strong engineering practices around architecture, code quality, automated testing, observability, security, operational readiness, and production ownership. 
 - Mentor engineers through architecture and design discussions, code reviews, technical problem solving, and knowledge sharing. 
 - Collaborate across engineering, product, architecture, security, and platform teams to identify dependencies, influence technical decisions, and deliver cross-functional platform capabilities. 
 - Stay current with evolving technologies and engineering practices, evaluating where new approaches can meaningfully improve the platform and developer experience. 

Additional Job Responsibilities

- Contribute to platform strategy, roadmap planning, and technical prioritization. 
 - Support adoption of platform capabilities through documentation, enablement, and developer engagement. 
 - Help define metrics and feedback loops that measure platform value and developer experience. 
 - Participate in incident response, operational reviews, and continuous improvement efforts for platform services. 
 - Explore and apply AI-assisted capabilities and intelligent automation where they can meaningfully simplify developer workflows and improve engineering productivity. 
 - Perform other duties as assigned in support of team and organizational objectives. 

Expected Education & Experience

- 6 to 8 years of engineering experience. 
 - Strong experience designing and building distributed systems and cloud-native applications. 
 - Strong software engineering fundamentals, including system design, API design, testing, debugging, performance, reliability, and maintainable software development. 
 - Hands-on experience building applications and services using technologies such as TypeScript, JavaScript, Node. js, Java, or comparable modern programming languages. 
 - Experience building modern web applications using React or comparable frontend frameworks. 
 - Strong experience designing and integrating REST APIs, backend services, and distributed systems. 
 - Experience with AI-powered development platforms, coding assistants, agents, or MCP-based integrations. 
 - Experience working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL and designing appropriate application data models. 
 - Experience building and operating applications in cloud-native environments using technologies such as AWS, Kubernetes, and containers. 
 - Understanding of modern CI/CD and software delivery practices and experience working with platforms such as Harness, Jenkins, Bitbucket, GitHub, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to influence technical decisions and work effectively across engineering teams. 

About Athenahealth

Our vision: In an industry that becomes more complex by the day, we stand for simplicity. We offer IT solutions and expert services that eliminate the daily hurdles preventing healthcare providers from focusing entirely on their patients - powered by our vision to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all. 

Our company culture: Our talented employees - or athenistas, as we call ourselves - spark the innovation and passion needed to accomplish our vision. We are a diverse group of dreamers and do-ers with unique knowledge, expertise, backgrounds, and perspectives. We unite as mission-driven problem-solvers with a deep desire to achieve our vision and make our time here count. Our award-winning culture is built around shared values of inclusiveness, accountability, and support. 

Our DEI commitment: Our vision of accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all requires addressing the inequities that stand in the way. That's one reason we prioritize diversity, equity, and inclusion in every aspect of our business, from attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce to maintaining an inclusive environment for athenistas, our partners, customers and the communities where we work and serve.

We also encourage a better work-life balance for athenistas with our flexibility. Specialist - Delivery Excellence

You will provide strategic and technical guidance to delivery teams, enabling them to implement and sustain high-performing controls and practices that support delivery efficiency and continuous improvement. 

By collaborating with key stakeholders-including Delivery Managers and Leaders - you will help deliver a comprehensive view of delivery health, performance metrics, and their impact on business outcomes. What You'll Do: Specialist - Delivery Excellence in the Enterprise will. . . 

- Work closely with delivery teams to embed best practices in delivery excellence, risk management, ensuring successful outcomes for aligned programs
 - Track and report operational KPIs to support data-driven decision-making. Monitor delivery performance metrics and escalate issues to ensure timely resolution

What You'll Bring: 

- Bachelor's degree in IT or relevant field with a strong academic record. 
 - A minimum of 7-10 years of experience in Delivery Excellence and Quality Management 
 - Strong communication & strategic influencing skills. Relevant experience working with senior leaders, building internal networks, and delivering high impact programs in complex -matrixed environments. 
 - Formal training or certification in Delivery/Operations excellence, and/or 5+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in technology Delivery excellence management, Operations excellence, Software Quality Management & Software Quality Standards or related field. 
 - Familiarity with delivery excellence frameworks, industry standards, and pharma regulatory requirements (HIPPA, GXP etc)

 - Proficient in MS Office productivity suite (e. g. , Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint). Advanced Excel skills strongly preferred
 - Six Sigma Black Belt/ITIL/CMMI/ISO9001 Lead auditor/MBA or relevant Delivery excellence / Audit certification
 - Experience with Project management tools (e. g. , Atlassian JIRA, Confluence, MS Project) and Quality Assurance tools
 - CMMI implementation experience (Maturity level 3 at minimum/ High maturity implementation experience preferred )
 - Willingness to adapt to evolving industry standards and technologies
 - Fluency in English
 - Client-first mentality
 - Intense work ethic
 - Collaborative spirit and problem-solving approach

How you'll grow:
